verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بُسَيْسَةَ عَيْنًا يَنْظُرُ مَا صَنَعَتْ عِيرُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ فَجَاءَ وَمَا فِي الْبَيْتِ أَحَدٌ غَيْرِي وَغَيْرُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي مَا اسْتَثْنَى بَعْضَ نِسَائِهِ قَالَ فَحَدَّثَهُ الْحَدِيثَ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَكَلَّمَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ لَنَا طَلِبَةً فَمَنْ كَانَ ظَهْرُهُ حَاضِرًا فَلْيَرْكَبْ مَعَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَعَلَ رِجَالٌ يَسْتَأْذِنُونَهُ فِي ظُهْرَانِهِمْ فِي عُلْوِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلاَّ مَنْ كَانَ ظَهْرُهُ حَاضِرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابُهُ حَتَّى سَبَقُوا الْمُشْرِكِينَ إِلَى بَدْرٍ وَجَاءَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يُقَدِّمَنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ إِلَى شَىْءٍ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَنَا دُونَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَدَنَا الْمُشْرِكُونَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قُومُوا إِلَى جَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَوَاتُ وَالأَرْضُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَقُولُ عُمَيْرُ بْنُ الْحُمَامِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ جَنَّةٌ عَرْضُهَا السَّمَوَاتُ وَالأَرْضُ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ بَخٍ بَخٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا يَحْمِلُكَ عَلَى قَوْلِكَ بَخٍ بَخٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ رَجَاءَةَ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّكَ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَ تَمَرَاتٍ مِنْ قَرْنِهِ فَجَعَلَ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُنَّ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَئِنْ أَنَا حَيِيتُ حَتَّى آكُلَ تَمَرَاتِي هَذِهِ إِنَّهَا لَحَيَاةٌ طَوِيلَةٌ - قَالَ - فَرَمَى بِمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنَ التَّمْرِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَاتَلَهُمْ حَتَّى قُتِلَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu alnnadri bni aabiy alnnadri, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin - waaalfaazuhum mutaqaaribaaun - qaaluwa haddathanaa haashimu bnu alqaasimi, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - wahuwa abnu almughiyraai - 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm busaysaaa 'aynana yanzuru maa sana'at 'iyru aabiy sufyaana fajaa'a wamaa fiy albayti aahadun ghayriy waghayru rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala laa aadriy maa astathnaa ba'da nisaaiihi qaala fahaddathahu alhadiytha qaala fakharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatakallama faqaala ‏"‏ iinna lanaa talibaaan faman kaana zahruhu haadirana falyarkab ma'anaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faja'ala rijaalun yastaadhinuwnahu fiy zuhraanihim fiy 'ulwi almadiynaai faqaala ‏"‏ laa iilaaa man kaana zahruhu haadirana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faantalaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabuhu hattaa sabaquwa almushrikiyna iilaa badrin wajaa'a almushrikuwna faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa yuqaddimanna aahadun minkum iilaa shaa'in hattaa aakuwna aanaa duwnahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadanaa almushrikuwna faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ quwmuwa iilaa jannaain 'arduhaa alssamawaatu waalaardu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala yaquwlu 'umayru bnu alhumaami alaansaariyyu yaa rasuwla alllahi jannaaun 'arduhaa alssamawaatu waalaardu qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala bakhin bakhin ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa yahmiluka 'alaa qawlika bakhin bakhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi iilaaa rajaa'aaa aan aakuwna min aahlihaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinnaka min aahlihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaakhraja tamaraatin min qarnihi faja'ala yaakulu minhunna thumma qaala laiin aanaa hayiytu hattaa akula tamaraatiy hadhihi iinnahaa lahayaaaun tawiylaaun - qaala - faramaa bimaa kaana ma'ahu mina alttamri ‏.‏ thumma qaatalahum hattaa qutila ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik who said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) sent Busaisah as a scout to see what the caravan of Abu Sufyan was doing. He came (back and met the Prophet in his house) where there was nobody except myself and the Messenger of Allah. I do not remember whether he (Hadrat Anas) made an exception of some wives of the Prophet (ﷺ) or not and told him the news of the caravan. (Having heard the news), the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) came out (hurriedly), spoke to the people and said: We are in need (of men) ; whoever has an animal to ride upon ready with him should ride with us. People began to ask him permission for bringing their riding animals which were grazing on the hillocks near Medina. He said: No. (I want) only those who have their riding animals ready. So the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and his Companions proceeded towards Badr and reached there forestalling the polytheists (of Mecca). When the polytheists (also) reached there, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: None of you should step forward to (do) anything unless I am ahead of him. The polytheists (now) advanced (towards us), and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said. Get up to enter Paradise which is equal in width to the heavens and the earth. 'Umair b. al- Humam al-Ansari said: Messenger of Allah, is Paradise equal in extent to the heavens and the earth? He said: Yes. 'Umair said: My goodness! The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) asked him: What prompted you to utter these words (i. e. my goodness! ')? He said: Messenger of Allah, nothing but the desire that I be among its residents. He said: Thou art (surely) amona its residents. He took out dates from his bag and began to eat them. Then he said: If I were to live until I have eaten all these dates of mine, it would be a long life. (The narrator said): He threw away all the dates he had with him. Then he fought the enemies until he was killed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي وَهُوَ، بِحَضْرَةِ الْعَدُوِّ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَبْوَابَ الْجَنَّةِ تَحْتَ ظِلاَلِ السُّيُوفِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ رَثُّ الْهَيْئَةِ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا مُوسَى آنْتَ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ هَذَا قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَجَعَ إِلَى أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكُمُ السَّلاَمَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ كَسَرَ جَفْنَ سَيْفِهِ فَأَلْقَاهُ ثُمَّ مَشَى بِسَيْفِهِ إِلَى الْعَدُوِّ فَضَرَبَ بِهِ حَتَّى قُتِلَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala qutaybaau haddathanaa waqaala, yahyaa aakhbaranaa ja'faru bnu sulaymaana, 'an aabiy 'imraana aljawniyyi, 'an aabiy bakri bni, 'abdi alllahi bni qaysin 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu aabiy wahuwa, bihadraai al'aduwwi yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna aabwaaba aljannaai tahta zilaali alssuyuwfi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama rajulun rathhu alhayiaai faqaala yaa aabaa muwsaa anta sami'ta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu hadhaa qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala faraja'a iilaa aashaabihi faqaala aaqraau 'alaykumu alssalaama ‏.‏ thumma kasara jafna sayfihi faaalqaahu thumma mashaa bisayfihi iilaa al'aduwwi fadaraba bihi hattaa qutila ‏.‏
verses.translation: The tradition has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Qais. He heard it from his father who, while facing the enemy, reported that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Surely, the gates of Paradise are under the shadows of the swords. A man in a shabby condition got up and said; Abu Musa, did you hear the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say this? He said: Yes. (The narrator said): He returned to his friends and said: I greet you (a farewell greeting). Then he broke the sheath of his sword, threw it away, advanced with his (naked) sword towards the enemy and fought (them) with it until he was slain
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ نَاسٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا أَنِ ابْعَثْ مَعَنَا رِجَالاً يُعَلِّمُونَا الْقُرْآنَ وَالسُّنَّةَ ‏.‏ فَبَعَثَ إِلَيْهِمْ سَبْعِينَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ يُقَالُ لَهُمُ الْقُرَّاءُ فِيهِمْ خَالِي حَرَامٌ يَقْرَءُونَ الْقُرْآنَ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَ بِاللَّيْلِ يَتَعَلَّمُونَ وَكَانُوا بِالنَّهَارِ يَجِيئُونَ بِالْمَاءِ فَيَضَعُونَهُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَيَحْتَطِبُونَ فَيَبِيعُونَهُ وَيَشْتَرُونَ بِهِ الطَّعَامَ لأَهْلِ الصُّفَّةِ وَلِلْفُقَرَاءِ فَبَعَثَهُمُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْهِمْ فَعَرَضُوا لَهُمْ فَقَتَلُوهُمْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْلُغُوا الْمَكَانَ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا اللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْ عَنَّا نَبِيَّنَا أَنَّا قَدْ لَقِينَاكَ فَرَضِينَا عَنْكَ وَرَضِيتَ عَنَّا - قَالَ - وَأَتَى رَجُلٌ حَرَامًا خَالَ أَنَسٍ مِنْ خَلْفِهِ فَطَعَنَهُ بِرُمْحٍ حَتَّى أَنْفَذَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ حَرَامٌ فُزْتُ وَرَبِّ الْكَعْبَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَصْحَابِهِ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ إِخْوَانَكُمْ قَدْ قُتِلُوا وَإِنَّهُمْ قَالُوا اللَّهُمَّ بَلِّغْ عَنَّا نَبِيَّنَا أَنَّا قَدْ لَقِينَاكَ فَرَضِينَا عَنْكَ وَرَضِيتَ عَنَّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa hammaadun, aakhbaranaa thaabitun, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala jaa'a naasun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa aani ab'ath ma'anaa rijaalaan yu'allimuwnaa alqurana waalssunnaaa ‏.‏ faba'atha iilayhim sab'iyna rajulaan mina alaansaari yuqaalu lahumu alqurraa'u fiyhim khaaliy haraamun yaqra'uwna alqurana wayatadaarasuwna bialllayli yata'allamuwna wakaanuwa bialnnahaari yajiyiuwna bialmaa'i fayada'uwnahu fiy almasjidi wayahtatibuwna fayabiy'uwnahu wayashtaruwna bihi altta'aama laahli alssuffaai walilfuqaraa'i faba'athahumu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilayhim fa'araduwa lahum faqataluwhum qabla aan yablughuwa almakaana ‏.‏ faqaaluwa alllahumma balligh 'annaa nabiyyanaa aannaa qad laqiynaaka faradiynaa 'anka waradiyta 'annaa - qaala - waaataa rajulun haraamana khaala aanasin min khalfihi fata'anahu birumhin hattaa aanfadhahu ‏.‏ faqaala haraamun fuztu warabbi alka'baai faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laashaabihi ‏ "‏ iinna iikhwaanakum qad qutiluwa waiinnahum qaaluwa alllahumma balligh 'annaa nabiyyanaa aannaa qad laqiynaaka faradiynaa 'anka waradiyta 'annaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that some people came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said to him:Send with us some men who may teach us the Qur'an and the Sunnah. Accordingjy, he sent seventy men from the Ansar. They were called the Reciters and among them was my maternal uncle. Haram. They used to recite the Qur'an, discuss and ponder over its meaning at night. In the day they brought water and poured it (in pitchers) in the mosque, collected wood and sold it, and with the sale proceeds bought food for the people of the Suffa and the needy. The Prophet (ﷺ) sent the Reciters with these people, but these (treacherous people) fell upon them and killed thern before they reached their destination (While dying), they said: O Allah, convey from us the news to our Prophet that we have met Thee (in a way) that we are pleased with Thee and Thou art pleased with us. (The narrator said): A man attacked Haram (maternal uncle of Anas) ) from behind and smote him with a spear which pierced him. (While dying), Haram said: By the Lord of the Ka'ba, I have met with success. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said to his Companions: Your brethren have been slain grid they were saying: O Allah, convey from us to our Prophet the news that we have met Thee in a way that we are pleased with Thee and Thou art pleased with us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ عَمِّيَ الَّذِي سُمِّيتُ بِهِ لَمْ يَشْهَدْ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَدْرًا - قَالَ - فَشَقَّ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ أَوَّلُ مَشْهَدٍ شَهِدَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غُيِّبْتُ عَنْهُ وَإِنْ أَرَانِيَ اللَّهُ مَشْهَدًا فِيمَا بَعْدُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيَرَانِيَ اللَّهُ مَا أَصْنَعُ - قَالَ - فَهَابَ أَنْ يَقُولَ غَيْرَهَا - قَالَ - فَشَهِدَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ - قَالَ - فَاسْتَقْبَلَ سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَنَسٌ يَا أَبَا عَمْرٍو أَيْنَ فَقَالَ وَاهًا لِرِيحِ الْجَنَّةِ أَجِدُهُ دُونَ أُحُدٍ - قَالَ - فَقَاتَلَهُمْ حَتَّى قُتِلَ - قَالَ - فَوُجِدَ فِي جَسَدِهِ بِضْعٌ وَثَمَانُونَ مِنْ بَيْنِ ضَرْبَةٍ وَطَعْنَةٍ وَرَمْيَةٍ - قَالَ - فَقَالَتْ أُخْتُهُ عَمَّتِيَ الرُّبَيِّعُ بِنْتُ النَّضْرِ فَمَا عَرَفْتُ أَخِي إِلاَّ بِبَنَانِهِ ‏.‏ وَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَضَى نَحْبَهُ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَنْتَظِرُ وَمَا بَدَّلُوا تَبْدِيلاً‏}‏ قَالَ فَكَانُوا يُرَوْنَ أَنَّهَا نَزَلَتْ فِيهِ وَفِي أَصْحَابِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, 'an thaabitin, qaala qaala aanasun 'ammiya alladhiy summiytu bihi lam yashhad ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm badrana - qaala - fashaqqa 'alayhi qaala aawwalu mashhadin shahidahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghuyyibtu 'anhu waiin aaraaniya alllahu mashhadana fiymaa ba'du ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm layaraaniya alllahu maa aasna'u - qaala - fahaaba aan yaquwla ghayrahaa - qaala - fashahida ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma auhudin - qaala - faastaqbala sa'du bnu mu'aadhin faqaala lahu aanasun yaa aabaa 'amrinw aayna faqaala waahana liriyhi aljannaai aajiduhu duwna auhudin - qaala - faqaatalahum hattaa qutila - qaala - fawujida fiy jasadihi bid'un wathamaanuwna min bayni darbaain wata'naain waramyaain - qaala - faqaalat aukhtuhu 'ammatiya alrrubayyi'u bintu alnnadri famaa 'araftu aakhiy iilaaa bibanaanihi ‏.‏ wanazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ rijaalun sadaquwa maa 'aahaduwa alllaha 'alayhi faminhum man qadaa nahbahu waminhum man yantaziru wamaa baddaluwa tabdiylaan‏}‏ qaala fakaanuwa yurawna aannahaa nazalat fiyhi wafiy aashaabihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been Deported on the authority of Anas who said:My uncle and I have been named after him was not present with the Messenger of Allah (mav peace be upon him) on the Day of Badr. He felt distressed about it. He would say: I have missed the first battle fought by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and if God now gives me an opportunity to see a battlefield with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), God will see what I do therein. He was afraid to say more than this (lest he be unable to keep his word with God). He was present with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on the Day of Uhud. He met Sa'd b. Mu'adh (who was retreating). Anas said to him: O Abu 'Amr, where (are you going)? Woe (to thee)! I find the smell of Paradise beside the Uhud mountain. (Reprimanding Sa'd in these words) he went forward and fought thein (the enemy) until he was killed. (The narrator says). More than eighty wounds inflicted with swords, spears and arrows were found on his body. His sister, my aunt, ar-Rubayyi', daughter of Nadr, said: I could not recognise my brother's body (it was so badly mutilated) except from his finger-tips. (It was on this occasion that) the Qur'anic verse:" Among the Believers are men who have been true to their covenant with God. Of them some have completed their vow (to the extreme), and some still wait: but they have never changed (their determination) in the least" (xxxiii. 23). The narrator said that the verse had been revealed about him (Anas b. Nadr) and his Companions
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُوسَى، الأَشْعَرِيُّ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَعْرَابِيًّا أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ يُقَاتِلُ لِلْمَغْنَمِ وَالرَّجُلُ يُقَاتِلُ لِيُذْكَرَ وَالرَّجُلُ يُقَاتِلُ لِيُرَى مَكَانُهُ فَمَنْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَاتَلَ لِتَكُونَ كَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ أَعْلَى فَهُوَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa waaiilin, qaala haddathanaa aabuw muwsaa, alaash'ariyyu aanna rajulaan, aa'raabiyyana aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi alrrajulu yuqaatilu lilmaghnami waalrrajulu yuqaatilu liyudhkara waalrrajulu yuqaatilu liyuraa makaanuhu faman fiy sabiyli alllahi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man qaatala litakuwna kalimaau alllahi aa'laa fahuwa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Musa Ash'ari that a desert Arab came to the Prophet (ﷺ) and said:Messenger of Allah, one man fights fgr the spoils of war; another fights that he may be remembered, and another fights that he may see his (high) position (achieved as a result of his valour in fighting). Which of these is fighting in the cause of God? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who fights so that the word of Allah is exalted is fighting in the way of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، مُوسَى قَالَ سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يُقَاتِلُ شَجَاعَةً وَيُقَاتِلُ حَمِيَّةً وَيُقَاتِلُ رِيَاءً أَىُّ ذَلِكَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَاتَلَ لِتَكُونَ كَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ هِيَ الْعُلْيَا فَهُوَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an aabiy, muwsaa qaala suiila rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alrrajuli yuqaatilu shajaa'aaan wayuqaatilu hamiyyaaan wayuqaatilu riyaa'an aaaau dhalika fiy sabiyli alllahi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man qaatala litakuwna kalimaau alllahi hiya al'ulyaa fahuwa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated (through another chain of transmitters) on the authority of Abu Musa who said. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) was asked which of the men fights in the way of Allah:(one who fights) for displaying his valour; (a man who) fights out of his family pride and (a man who) fights for the sake of show, who amongst these fights in the way of Allah? The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: Who fights that the word of Allah be exalted fights in the way of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ الرَّجُلُ يُقَاتِلُ مِنَّا شَجَاعَةً ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala aataynaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi alrrajulu yuqaatilu minnaa shajaa'aaan ‏.‏ fadhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated (through yet another chain of transmitters) on the same authority, i. e. Abu Musa, who said:We, came to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) and said: Messenger of Allah, one of us hho fights to display his valour... (followed by the same words as we have in the previous tradition)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْقِتَالِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ يُقَاتِلُ غَضَبًا وَيُقَاتِلُ حَمِيَّةً قَالَ فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَيْهِ - وَمَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَيْهِ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ كَانَ قَائِمًا - فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ قَاتَلَ لِتَكُونَ كَلِمَةُ اللَّهِ هِيَ الْعُلْيَا فَهُوَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy, muwsaa alaash'ariyyi aanna rajulaan, saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alqitaali fiy sabiyli alllahi 'azza wajalla faqaala alrrajulu yuqaatilu ghadabana wayuqaatilu hamiyyaaan qaala farafa'a raasahu iilayhi - wamaa rafa'a raasahu iilayhi iilaaa aannahu kaana qaaiimana - faqaala ‏ "‏ man qaatala litakuwna kalimaau alllahi hiya al'ulyaa fahuwa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the same authority, i. e. Abu Musa Ash'ari, that a man asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about fighting in the way of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, a man who fights out of rage or out of family pride. He raised his head towards him-and he did so because the man was standing and said:Who fights that the word of Allah be exalted fights in the way of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، قَالَ تَفَرَّقَ النَّاسُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ نَاتِلُ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ أَيُّهَا الشَّيْخُ حَدِّثْنَا حَدِيثًا سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ النَّاسِ يُقْضَى يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ اسْتُشْهِدَ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ فَعَرَّفَهُ نِعَمَهُ فَعَرَفَهَا قَالَ فَمَا عَمِلْتَ فِيهَا قَالَ قَاتَلْتُ فِيكَ حَتَّى اسْتُشْهِدْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَذَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّكَ قَاتَلْتَ لأَنْ يُقَالَ جَرِيءٌ ‏.‏ فَقَدْ قِيلَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أُمِرَ بِهِ فَسُحِبَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ حَتَّى أُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ وَرَجُلٌ تَعَلَّمَ الْعِلْمَ وَعَلَّمَهُ وَقَرَأَ الْقُرْآنَ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ فَعَرَّفَهُ نِعَمَهُ فَعَرَفَهَا قَالَ فَمَا عَمِلْتَ فِيهَا قَالَ تَعَلَّمْتُ الْعِلْمَ وَعَلَّمْتُهُ وَقَرَأْتُ فِيكَ الْقُرْآنَ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَذَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّكَ تَعَلَّمْتَ الْعِلْمَ لِيُقَالَ عَالِمٌ ‏.‏ وَقَرَأْتَ الْقُرْآنَ لِيُقَالَ هُوَ قَارِئٌ ‏.‏ فَقَدْ قِيلَ ثُمَّ أُمِرَ بِهِ فَسُحِبَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ حَتَّى أُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ ‏.‏ وَرَجُلٌ وَسَّعَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَعْطَاهُ مِنْ أَصْنَافِ الْمَالِ كُلِّهِ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ فَعَرَّفَهُ نِعَمَهُ فَعَرَفَهَا قَالَ فَمَا عَمِلْتَ فِيهَا قَالَ مَا تَرَكْتُ مِنْ سَبِيلٍ تُحِبُّ أَنْ يُنْفَقَ فِيهَا إِلاَّ أَنْفَقْتُ فِيهَا لَكَ قَالَ كَذَبْتَ وَلَكِنَّكَ فَعَلْتَ لِيُقَالَ هُوَ جَوَادٌ ‏.‏ فَقَدْ قِيلَ ثُمَّ أُمِرَ بِهِ فَسُحِبَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ أُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, haddathaniy yuwnusu bnu yuwsufa, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, qaala tafarraqa alnnaasu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, faqaala lahu naatilu aahli alshhaami aayyuhaa alshhaykhu haddithnaa hadiythana sami'tahu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna aawwala alnnaasi yuqdaa yawma alqiyaamaai 'alayhi rajulun astushhida faautiya bihi fa'arrafahu ni'amahu fa'arafahaa qaala famaa 'amilta fiyhaa qaala qaataltu fiyka hattaa astushhidtu ‏.‏ qaala kadhabta walakinnaka qaatalta laan yuqaala jariy'un ‏.‏ faqad qiyla ‏.‏ thumma aumira bihi fasuhiba 'alaa wajhihi hattaa aulqiya fiy alnnaari warajulun ta'allama al'ilma wa'allamahu waqaraaa alqurana faautiya bihi fa'arrafahu ni'amahu fa'arafahaa qaala famaa 'amilta fiyhaa qaala ta'allamtu al'ilma wa'allamtuhu waqaraatu fiyka alqurana ‏.‏ qaala kadhabta walakinnaka ta'allamta al'ilma liyuqaala 'aalimun ‏.‏ waqaraata alqurana liyuqaala huwa qaariiun ‏.‏ faqad qiyla thumma aumira bihi fasuhiba 'alaa wajhihi hattaa aulqiya fiy alnnaari ‏.‏ warajulun wassa'a alllahu 'alayhi waaa'taahu min aasnaafi almaali kullihi faautiya bihi fa'arrafahu ni'amahu fa'arafahaa qaala famaa 'amilta fiyhaa qaala maa taraktu min sabiylin tuhibbu aan yunfaqa fiyhaa iilaaa aanfaqtu fiyhaa laka qaala kadhabta walakinnaka fa'alta liyuqaala huwa jawaadun ‏.‏ faqad qiyla thumma aumira bihi fasuhiba 'alaa wajhihi thumma aulqiya fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman b. Yasar who said:People dispersed from around Abu Huraira, and Natil, who was from the Syrians. said to him: O Shaikh, relate (to us) a tradition you have heard from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: Yes. I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: The first of men (whose case) will be decided on the Day of Judgment will be a man who died as a martyr. He shall be brought (before the Judgment Seat). Allah will make him recount His blessings (i. e. the blessings which He had bestowed upon him) and he will recount them (and admit having enjoyed them in his life). (Then) will Allah say: What did you do (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I fought for Thee until I died as a martyr. Allah will say: You have told a lie. You fought that you might be called a" brave warrior". And you were called so. (Then) orders will be passed against him and he will be dragged with his face downward and cast into Hell. Then will be brought forward a man who acquired knowledge and imparted it (to others) and recited the Qur'an. He will be brought And Allah will make him recount His blessings and he will recount them (and admit having enjoyed them in his lifetime). Then will Allah ask: What did you do (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I acquired knowledge and disseminated it and recited the Qur'an seeking Thy pleasure. Allah will say: You have told a lie. You acquired knowledge so that you might be called" a scholar," and you recited the Qur'an so that it might be said:" He is a Qari" and such has been said. Then orders will be passed against him and he shall be dragged with his face downward and cast into the Fire. Then will be brought a man whom Allah had made abundantly rich and had granted every kind of wealth. He will be brought and Allah will make him recount His blessings and he will recount them and (admit having enjoyed them in his lifetime). Allah will (then) ask: What have you done (to requite these blessings)? He will say: I spent money in every cause in which Thou wished that it should be spent. Allah will say: You are lying. You did (so) that it might be said about (You):" He is a generous fellow" and so it was said. Then will Allah pass orders and he will be dragged with his face downward and thrown into Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، قَالَ تَفَرَّجَ النَّاسُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، فَقَالَ لَهُ نَاتِلُ الشَّامِ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'aliyyu bnu khashramin, aakhbaranaa alhajjaaju, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - 'ani abni jurayjin, haddathaniy yuwnusu bnu yuwsufa, 'an sulaymaana bni yasaarin, qaala tafarraja alnnaasu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, faqaala lahu naatilu alshhaami waaqtassa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythi khaalidi bni alhaarithi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has been handed down through a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَيْوَةُ بْنُ، شُرَيْحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هَانِئٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ غَازِيَةٍ تَغْزُو فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَيُصِيبُونَ الْغَنِيمَةَ إِلاَّ تَعَجَّلُوا ثُلُثَىْ أَجْرِهِمْ مِنَ الآخِرَةِ وَيَبْقَى لَهُمُ الثُّلُثُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يُصِيبُوا غَنِيمَةً تَمَّ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu yaziyda aabuw 'abdi alrrahmani, haddathanaa haywaau bnu, shurayhin 'an aabiy haaniiin, 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani alhubuliyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa min ghaaziyaain taghzuw fiy sabiyli alllahi fayusiybuwna alghaniymaaa iilaaa ta'ajjaluwa thuluthaa aajrihim mina alakhiraai wayabqaa lahumu althhuluthu waiin lam yusiybuwa ghaniymaaan tamma lahum aajruhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. 'Amr that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:A troop of soldiers who fight in tile way of Allah and get their share of the booty receive in advance two-thirds of their reward in the Hereafter and only one-third will remain (to their credit). If they do not receive any booty, they will get their full reward
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هَانِئٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحُبُلِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ غَازِيَةٍ أَوْ سَرِيَّةٍ تَغْزُو فَتَغْنَمُ وَتَسْلَمُ إِلاَّ كَانُوا قَدْ تَعَجَّلُوا ثُلُثَىْ أُجُورِهِمْ وَمَا مِنْ غَازِيَةٍ أَوْ سَرِيَّةٍ تُخْفِقُ وَتُصَابُ إِلاَّ تَمَّ أُجُورُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu sahlin alttamiymiyyu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa naafi'u bnu yaziyda, haddathaniy aabuw haaniiin, haddathaniy aabuw 'abdi alrrahmani alhubuliyyu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa min ghaaziyaain aaw sariyyaain taghzuw fataghnamu wataslamu iilaaa kaanuwa qad ta'ajjaluwa thuluthaa aujuwrihim wamaa min ghaaziyaain aaw sariyyaain tukhfiqu watusaabu iilaaa tamma aujuwruhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abdullah b. Amr (through a different chain of transmitters) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:A troop of soldiers, large or small, who fight (in the way of Allah), get their share of the booty and return safe and sound, receive in advance two-thirds of their reward (only one-third remaining to their credit to be received in the Hereafter) ; and a troop of soldiers, large or small, who return empty-handed and are afflicted or wounded, will receive their full reward (in the Hereafter)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّةِ وَإِنَّمَا لاِمْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَتَزَوَّجُهَا فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an muhammadi, bni iibraahiyma 'an 'alqamaaa bni waqqaasin, 'an 'umara bni alkhattaabi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa alaa'maalu bialnniyyaai waiinnamaa laimriiin maa nawaa faman kaanat hijratuhu iilaa alllahi warasuwlihi fahijratuhu iilaa alllahi warasuwlihi waman kaanat hijratuhu lidunyaa yusiybuhaa aawi amraaaain yatazawwajuhaa fahijratuhu iilaa maa haajara iilayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Umar b. al-Khattab that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:(The value of) an action depends on the intention behind it. A man will be rewarded only for what he intended. The emigration of one who emigrates for the sake of Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) is for the sake of Allah and His Messenger (ﷺ) ; and the emigration of one who emigrates for gaining a worldly advantage or for marrying a woman is for what he has emigrated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ يَعْنِي الثَّقَفِيَّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ غِيَاثٍ - وَيَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يَحْيَى، بْنِ سَعِيدٍ بِإِسْنَادِ مَالِكٍ وَمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يُخْبِرُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi ya'niy althhaqafiyya, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, sulaymaanu bnu hayyaana h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi, alllahi bni numayrin haddathanaa hafsun, - ya'niy abna ghiyaathin - wayaziydu bnu haaruwna h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu, al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kulluhum 'an yahyaa, bni sa'iydin biiisnaadi maalikin wama'naa hadiythihi wafiy hadiythi sufyaana sami'tu 'umara bna alkhattaabi 'alaa alminbari yukhbiru 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated through a different chain of transmitters on the authority of Sufyan who said that he heard 'Umar b. al-Khattab relate (this tradition) from the Prophet (ﷺ) while he was delivering a sermon from the pulpit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ طَلَبَ الشَّهَادَةَ صَادِقًا أُعْطِيَهَا وَلَوْ لَمْ تُصِبْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man talaba alshhahaadaaa saadiqana au'tiyahaa walaw lam tusibhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (may peace he upon him) said:Who seeks martyrdom with sincerity shall get its reward, though he may not achieve it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، حَرْمَلَةُ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو شُرَيْحٍ، أَنَّ سَهْلَ بْنَ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ، بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ سَأَلَ اللَّهَ الشَّهَادَةَ بِصِدْقٍ بَلَّغَهُ اللَّهُ مَنَازِلَ الشُّهَدَاءِ وَإِنْ مَاتَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ بِصِدْقٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu liharmalaaa - qaala aabuw alttaahiri aakhbaranaa waqaala, harmalaau haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy aabuw shurayhin, aanna sahla bna aabiy aumaamaaa bni sahli, bni hunayfin haddathahu 'an aabiyhi, 'an jaddihi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man saaala alllaha alshhahaadaaa bisidqin ballaghahu alllahu manaazila alshhuhadaa'i waiin maata 'alaa firaashihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur aabuw alttaahiri fiy hadiythihi ‏"‏ bisidqin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been reported on the authority of Sahl b. Aba Umama b. Sahl b. Hunaif who learned the tradition from his father who (in turn) learned it from his grandfather-that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Who sought martyrdom with sincerity will be ranked by Allah among the martyrs even if he died on his bed. In his version of the tradition Abd Tahir did not mention the words:" with sincerity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَهْمٍ الأَنْطَاكِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ وُهَيْبٍ الْمَكِّيِّ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ مَاتَ وَلَمْ يَغْزُ وَلَمْ يُحَدِّثْ بِهِ نَفْسَهُ مَاتَ عَلَى شُعْبَةٍ مِنْ نِفَاقٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ سَهْمٍ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ فَنُرَى أَنَّ ذَلِكَ كَانَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni sahmin alaantaakiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki, 'an wuhaybin almakkiyyi, 'an 'umara bni muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an sumaaain, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man maata walam yaghzu walam yuhaddith bihi nafsahu maata 'alaa shu'baain min nifaaqin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu sahmin qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki fanuraa aanna dhalika kaana 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:One who died but did not fight in the way of Allah nor did he express any desire (or determination) for Jihad died the death of a hypocrite. 'Abdullah b. Mubarak said: We think the hadith pertained to the time of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ بِالْمَدِينَةِ لَرِجَالاً مَا سِرْتُمْ مَسِيرًا وَلاَ قَطَعْتُمْ وَادِيًا إِلاَّ كَانُوا مَعَكُمْ حَبَسَهُمُ الْمَرَضُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazaaain faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna bialmadiynaai larijaalaan maa sirtum masiyrana walaa qata'tum waadiyana iilaaa kaanuwa ma'akum habasahumu almaradu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir who said:We were with the Prophet (ﷺ) on an expedition. He said: There are some people in Medina. They are with you whenever you cover a distance or cross a valley. They have been detained by illness
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ، يُونُسَ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏ "‏ إِلاَّ شَرِكُوكُمْ فِي الأَجْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu, yuwnusa kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythi wakiy'in ‏ "‏ iilaaa sharikuwkum fiy alaajri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: In a version of the tradition narrated on the authority of A'mash, we have the words:" They will share with you the reward (for Jihad)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي، طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَى أُمِّ حَرَامٍ بِنْتِ مِلْحَانَ فَتُطْعِمُهُ وَكَانَتْ أُمُّ حَرَامٍ تَحْتَ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فَأَطْعَمَتْهُ ثُمَّ جَلَسَتْ تَفْلِي رَأْسَهُ فَنَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ مَا يُضْحِكُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ يَرْكَبُونَ ثَبَجَ هَذَا الْبَحْرِ مُلُوكًا عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ أَوْ مِثْلَ الْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَشُكُّ أَيَّهُمَا قَالَ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ فَدَعَا لَهَا ثُمَّ وَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ فَنَامَ ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ مَا يُضْحِكُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ غُزَاةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ فِي الأُولَى قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهَ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتِ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَكِبَتْ أُمُّ حَرَامٍ بِنْتُ مِلْحَانَ الْبَحْرَ فِي زَمَنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ فَصُرِعَتْ عَنْ دَابَّتِهَا حِينَ خَرَجَتْ مِنَ الْبَحْرِ فَهَلَكَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy, talhaaa 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yadkhulu 'alaa aummi haraamin binti milhaana fatut'imuhu wakaanat aummu haraamin tahta 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti fadakhala 'alayhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana faaat'amathu thumma jalasat tafliy raasahu fanaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma astayqaza wahuwa yadhaku qaalat faqultu maa yudhikuka yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ naasun min aummatiy 'uriduwa 'alaaaa ghuzaaaan fiy sabiyli alllahi yarkabuwna thabaja hadhaa albahri muluwkana 'alaa alaasirraai aaw mithla almuluwki 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ yashukku aayyahumaa qaala qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum fada'aa lahaa thumma wada'a raasahu fanaama thumma astayqaza wahuwa yadhaku qaalat faqultu maa yudhikuka yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ naasun min aummatiy 'uriduwa 'alaaaa ghuzaaaan fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ kamaa qaala fiy alauwlaa qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllaha ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum qaala ‏"‏ aanti mina alaawwaliyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ farakibat aummu haraamin bintu milhaana albahra fiy zamani mu'aawiyaaa fasuri'at 'an daabbatihaa hiyna kharajat mina albahri fahalakat ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been reported on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to visit Umm Haram daughter of Milhan (who was the sister of his foster-mother or his father's aunt). She was the wife of 'Ubada b. Samit, One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) paid her a visit. She entertained him with food and then sat down to rub his head. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) dozed off and when he woke up (after a while), he was laughing. She asked:What made you laugh. Messenger of Allah? He said: Some people from my Umma were presented to me who were fighters in the way of Allah and were sailing in this sea. (Gliding smoothly on the water), they appeared to be kings or like kings (sitting) on thrones (the narrator has a doubt about the actual expression used by the Holy Prophet). She said: Messenger of Allah, pray to Allah that He may include me among these warriors. He prayed for her. Then he placed his head (down) and dozed off (again). He woke up laughing, as before. (She said) I said: Messenger of Allah, what makes you laugh? He replied: A people from my Umma were presented to me. They were fighters in Allah's way. (He described them in the same words as he had described the first warriors.) She said: Messenger of Allah, pray to God that He may include me among these warriors. He said: You are among the first ones. Umm Haram daughter of Milhan sailed in the aea in the time of Mu'awiya. When she came out of the sea and (was going to mount a riding animal) she fell down and died
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَرَامٍ، وَهْىَ خَالَةُ أَنَسٍ قَالَتْ أَتَانَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فَقَالَ عِنْدَنَا فَاسْتَيْقَظَ وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ فَقُلْتُ مَا يُضْحِكُكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بِأَبِي أَنْتَ وَأُمِّي قَالَ ‏"‏ أُرِيتُ قَوْمًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَرْكَبُونَ ظَهْرَ الْبَحْرِ كَالْمُلُوكِ عَلَى الأَسِرَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّكِ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ ثُمَّ نَامَ فَاسْتَيْقَظَ أَيْضًا وَهُوَ يَضْحَكُ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ مِثْلَ مَقَالَتِهِ فَقُلْتُ ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يَجْعَلَنِي مِنْهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتِ مِنَ الأَوَّلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَزَوَّجَهَا عُبَادَةُ بْنُ الصَّامِتِ بَعْدُ فَغَزَا فِي الْبَحْرِ فَحَمَلَهَا مَعَهُ فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَتْ قُرِّبَتْ لَهَا بَغْلَةٌ فَرَكِبَتْهَا فَصَرَعَتْهَا فَانْدَقَّتْ عُنُقُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'an muhammadi bni, yahyaa bni habbaana 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'an aummi haraamin, wahaa khaalaau aanasin qaalat aataanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana faqaala 'indanaa faastayqaza wahuwa yadhaku faqultu maa yudhikuka yaa rasuwla alllahi biaabiy aanta waaummiy qaala ‏"‏ auriytu qawmana min aummatiy yarkabuwna zahra albahri kaalmuluwki 'alaa alaasirraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum qaala ‏"‏ faiinnaki minhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat thumma naama faastayqaza aaydana wahuwa yadhaku fasaaaltuhu faqaala mithla maqaalatihi faqultu ad'u alllaha aan yaj'alaniy minhum ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aanti mina alaawwaliyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fatazawwajahaa 'ubaadaau bnu alssaamiti ba'du faghazaa fiy albahri fahamalahaa ma'ahu falammaa aan jaa'at qurribat lahaa baghlaaun farakibathaa fasara'athaa faandaqqat 'unuquhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Umm Haram (and she was the aunt of Anas) who said:The Prophet (ﷺ) came to us one day and had a nap in our house. When he woke up, he was laughing. I said: Messenger of Allah, what made you laugh? He said: I saw a people from my followers sailing on the surface of the sea (looking) like kings (sitting) on their thrones. I said: Pray to Allah that He may include me among them. He said: You will be among them. He had a (second) nap, woke up and was laughing. I asked him (the reason for his laughter). He gave the same reply. I said: Pray to Allah that He may include me among them. He said: You are among the first ones. Anas said: 'Ubada b. Samit married her. He joined a naval expedition and took her along with him. When she returned, a mule was brought for her. While mounting it she fell down, broke her neck (and died)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ حَبَّانَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ خَالَتِهِ أُمِّ حَرَامٍ بِنْتِ مِلْحَانَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ نَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا قَرِيبًا مِنِّي ثُمَّ اسْتَيْقَظَ يَتَبَسَّمُ - قَالَتْ - فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَضْحَكَكَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَاسٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عُرِضُوا عَلَىَّ يَرْكَبُونَ ظَهْرَ هَذَا الْبَحْرِ الأَخْضَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, wayahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, 'ani abni habbaana, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'an khaalatihi aummi haraamin binti milhaana, aannahaa qaalat naama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana qariybana minniy thumma astayqaza yatabassamu - qaalat - faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi maa aadhakaka qaala ‏ "‏ naasun min aummatiy 'uriduwa 'alaaaa yarkabuwna zahra hadhaa albahri alaakhdari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi hammaadi bni zaydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been reported on the authority of Umm Haram daughter of Milhan (through another chain of transmitters). She said:One day the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) slept (at a place) near me. He woke up smiling. She said: Messenger of Allah. what made thee laugh? He said: A people from my followers were presented to me. They were sailing on the surface of this green sea... (here follows the tradition that has gone before)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ أَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ابْنَةَ مِلْحَانَ خَالَةَ أَنَسٍ فَوَضَعَ رَأْسَهُ عِنْدَهَا ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَبَّانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu aataa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm abnaaa milhaana khaalaaa aanasin fawada'a raasahu 'indahaa ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi iishaaqa bni aabiy talhaaa wamuhammadi bni yahyaa bni habbaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been reported by 'Abdullah b. 'Abd al-Rahman that he heard Anas b. Malik say:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) paid a visit to Milhan's daughter, maternal aunt of Anas (and the sister of the Holy Prophet's foster-mother). He placed his head near her (from this point onward, the narrator carried on the previous tradition to its end)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بَهْرَامَ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ السَّمِطِ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ رِبَاطُ يَوْمٍ وَلَيْلَةٍ خَيْرٌ مِنْ صِيَامِ شَهْرٍ وَقِيَامِهِ وَإِنْ مَاتَ جَرَى عَلَيْهِ عَمَلُهُ الَّذِي كَانَ يَعْمَلُهُ وَأُجْرِيَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ وَأَمِنَ الْفَتَّانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni bahraama alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw alwaliydi alttayaalisiyyu, haddathanaa laythun, - ya'niy abna sa'din - 'an aayyuwba bni muwsaa, 'an makhuwlin, 'an shurahbiyla bni alssamiti, 'an salmaana, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ ribaatu yawmin walaylaain khayrun min siyaami shahrin waqiyaamihi waiin maata jaraa 'alayhi 'amaluhu alladhiy kaana ya'maluhu waaujriya 'alayhi rizquhu waaamina alfattaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Salman who said:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Keeping watch for a day and a night is better (in point of reward) than fasting for a whole month and standing in prayer every night. If a person dies (while, performing this duty), his (meritorious) activity will continue and he will go on receiving his reward for it perpetually and will be saved from the torture of the grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ السَّمِطِ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ مُوسَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni shurayhin, 'an 'abdi alkariymi, bni alhaarithi 'an aabiy 'ubaydaaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an shurahbiyla bni alssamiti, 'an salmaana alkhayri, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi alllaythi 'an aayyuwba bni muwsaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has been handed down on the authority of Salman al-Khair through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ سُمَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي بِطَرِيقٍ وَجَدَ غُصْنَ شَوْكٍ عَلَى الطَّرِيقِ فَأَخَّرَهُ فَشَكَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فَغَفَرَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ الشُّهَدَاءُ خَمْسَةٌ الْمَطْعُونُ وَالْمَبْطُونُ وَالْغَرِقُ وَصَاحِبُ الْهَدْمِ وَالشَّهِيدُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an sumaaain, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ baynamaa rajulun yamshiy bitariyqin wajada ghusna shawkin 'alaa alttariyqi faaakhharahu fashakara alllahu lahu faghafara lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ alshhuhadaa'u khamsaaun almat'uwnu waalmabtuwnu waalghariqu wasaahibu alhadmi waalshhahiydu fiy sabiyli alllahi 'azza wajalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the, Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:While a man walks along a path, finds a thorny twig lying on the way and puts it aside, Allah would appreciate it and forgive him The Prophet (ﷺ) said: The martyrs are of five kinds: one who dies of plague; one who dies of diarrhoea (or cholera) ; one who is drowned; one who is buried under debris and one who dies fighting in the way of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا تَعُدُّونَ الشَّهِيدَ فِيكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ قُتِلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ شُهَدَاءَ أُمَّتِي إِذًا لَقَلِيلٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَمَنْ هُمْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ قُتِلَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ وَمَنْ مَاتَ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ وَمَنْ مَاتَ فِي الطَّاعُونِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ وَمَنْ مَاتَ فِي الْبَطْنِ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ مِقْسَمٍ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى أَبِيكَ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالْغَرِيقُ شَهِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa ta'udduwna alshhahiyda fiykum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi man qutila fiy sabiyli alllahi fahuwa shahiydun qaala ‏"‏ iinna shuhadaa'a aummatiy iidhana laqaliylun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa faman hum yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ man qutila fiy sabiyli alllahi fahuwa shahiydun waman maata fiy sabiyli alllahi fahuwa shahiydun waman maata fiy alttaa'uwni fahuwa shahiydun waman maata fiy albatni fahuwa shahiydun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu miqsamin aashhadu 'alaa aabiyka fiy hadhaa alhadiythi aannahu qaala ‏"‏ waalghariyqu shahiydun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira (through another chain of transmitters) that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:Whom do you consider to be a martyr among you? They (the Companions) said: Messenger, of Allah, one who is slain in the way of Allah is a martyr. He said: Then (if this is the definition of a martyr) the martyrs of my Umma will be small in number. They asked: Messenger of Allah, who are they? He said: One who is slain in the way of Allah is a martyr; one who dies in the way of Allah, is a martyr; one who dies of plague is a martyr; one who dies of cholera is a martyr. Ibn Miqsam said: I testify the truth of your father's statement (with regard to this tradition) that the Prophet (ﷺ) said: One who is drowned is a martyr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ سُهَيْلٌ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مِقْسَمٍ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى أَبِيكَ أَنَّهُ زَادَ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏ "‏ وَمَنْ غَرِقَ فَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alhamiydi bnu bayaanin alwaasitiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an suhaylin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aanna fiy hadiythihi qaala suhaylun qaala 'ubaydu alllahi bnu miqsamin aashhadu 'alaa aabiyka aannahu zaada fiy hadhaa alhadiythi ‏ "‏ waman ghariqa fahuwa shahiydun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Suhail contains the additional words:" And one who is drowned is a martyr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، وَزَادَ، فِيهِ ‏ "‏ وَالْغَرِقُ شَهِيدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa suhaylun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythihi qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu miqsamin, 'an aabiy saalihin, wazaada, fiyhi ‏ "‏ waalghariqu shahiydun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Another version of the tradition narrated on the authority of Suhail thouch a different chain of transmitters contains the additional words:" A drowned person is a martyr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ حَفْصَةَ بِنْتِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ لِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ بِمَا مَاتَ يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ بِالطَّاعُونِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الطَّاعُونُ شَهَادَةٌ لِكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haamidu bnu 'umara albakraawiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin - haddathanaa 'aasimun, 'an hafsaaa binti siyriyna, qaalat qaala liy aanasu bnu maalikin bimaa maata yahyaa bnu aabiy 'amraaa qaalat qultu bialttaa'uwni ‏.‏ qaalat faqaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alttaa'uwnu shahaadaaun likulli muslimin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Hafsa daughter of Sirin who said:Anas b. Malik asked me the cause of death of Yahya b. 'Abu 'Amra. I said: (He died) of plague. He said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said that death by plague is martyrdom for a Muslim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu alwaliydu bnu shujaa'in, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an 'aasimin, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim through the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ، ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ شُفَىٍّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُمْ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ أَلاَ إِنَّ الْقُوَّةَ الرَّمْىُ أَلاَ إِنَّ الْقُوَّةَ الرَّمْىُ أَلاَ إِنَّ الْقُوَّةَ الرَّمْىُ ‏"‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an aabiy 'aliyyin, thumaamaaa bni shufaaain aannahu sami'a 'uqbaaa bna 'aamirin, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa 'alaa alminbari yaquwlu ‏ "‏ waaa'idduwa lahum maa astata'tum min quwwaain aalaa iinna alquwwaaa alrramau aalaa iinna alquwwaaa alrramau aalaa iinna alquwwaaa alrramau ‏"‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Amir who said:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say-and he was delivering a sermon from the pulpit: Prepare to meet them with as much strength as you can afford. Beware, strength consists in archery. Beware, strength consists in archery. Beware, strength consists in archery
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ سَتُفْتَحُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَرَضُونَ وَيَكْفِيكُمُ اللَّهُ فَلاَ يَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَلْهُوَ بِأَسْهُمِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an aabiy 'aliyyin, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ satuftahu 'alaykum aaraduwna wayakfiykumu alllahu falaa ya'jizu aahadukum aan yalhuwa biaashumihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Uqba b. Amir who said:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: Lands shall be thrown open to you and Allah will suffice you (against your enemies), but none of you should give up playing with his arrows
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، عَنْ بَكْرِ بْنِ مُضَرَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُقْبَةَ بْنَ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu daawudu bnu rushaydin, haddathanaa alwaliydu, 'an bakri bni mudara, 'an 'amriw bni alhaarithi, 'an aabiy 'aliyyin alhamdaaniyyi, qaala sami'tu 'uqbaaa bna 'aamirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has also been narrated on the same authority through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شَمَاسَةَ، أَنَّ فُقَيْمًا اللَّخْمِيَّ، قَالَ لِعُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ تَخْتَلِفُ بَيْنَ هَذَيْنِ الْغَرَضَيْنِ وَأَنْتَ كَبِيرٌ يَشُقُّ عَلَيْكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُقْبَةُ لَوْلاَ كَلاَمٌ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ أُعَانِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَارِثُ فَقُلْتُ لاِبْنِ شُمَاسَةَ وَمَا ذَاكَ قَالَ إِنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ عَلِمَ الرَّمْىَ ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنَّا أَوْ قَدْ عَصَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani alhaarithi bni ya'quwba, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni shamaasaaa, aanna fuqaymana alllakhmiyya, qaala li'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin takhtalifu bayna hadhayni algharadayni waaanta kabiyrun yashuqqu 'alayka ‏.‏ qaala 'uqbaau lawlaa kalaamun sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam au'aanihi ‏.‏ qaala alhaarithu faqultu laibni shumaasaaa wamaa dhaaka qaala iinnahu qaala ‏ "‏ man 'alima alrramaa thumma tarakahu falaysa minnaa aaw qad 'asaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been reported by 'Abd al-Rahman b. Shamasa that Fuqaim al- Lakhmi said to Uqba b. Amir:You frequent between these two targets and you are an old man, so you will be finding it very hard. 'Uqba said: But for a thing I heard from the Prophet (ﷺ), I would not strain myself. Harith (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) said: I asked Ibn Shamasa: What was that? He said that he (the Holy Prophet) said: Who learnt archery and then gave it up is not from us. or he has been guilty of disobedience (to Allah's Apostle)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ لاَ يَضُرُّهُمْ مَنْ خَذَلَهُمْ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ كَذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ قُتَيْبَةَ ‏"‏ وَهُمْ كَذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw alraabiy'i al'atakiyuu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaaluwa hadaathanaa hamaaadun, - wahuwa abnu zaydin - 'an aayuuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy aasmaa'a, 'an thawbaana, qaala qaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tazaalu taaiifaaun min aumaatiy zaahiriyna 'alaa alhaqii laa yaduruuhum man khadhalahum hataaa yaatiya aamru allaahi wahum kadhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi qutaybaaa ‏"‏ wahum kadhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Thauban that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:A group of people from my Umma will always remain triumphant on the right path and continue to be triumphant (against their opponents). He who deserts them shall not be able to do them any harm. They will remain in this position until Allah's Command is executed (i.e. Qiyamah is established). In Qutaiba's version of the tradition, we do not have the words:" They will remain in this position
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَعَبْدَةُ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِي الْفَزَارِيَّ - عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَنْ يَزَالَ قَوْمٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى النَّاسِ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُمْ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ ظَاهِرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, wa'abdaau kilaahumaa 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa marwaanu, - ya'niy alfazaariyya - 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an qaysin, 'ani almughiyraai, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ lan yazaala qawmun min aummatiy zaahiriyna 'alaa alnnaasi hattaa yaatiyahum aamru alllahi wahum zaahiruwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Mughira who said:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to be triumphant over the people until the Command of Allah overtakes them while they are still triumphant
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَرْوَانَ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathaniy iismaa'iylu, 'an qaysin, qaala sami'tu almughiyraaa bna shu'baaa, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu bimithli hadiythi marwaana sawaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: The same tradition has been narrated through another chain of transmitters on the same authority
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَنْ يَبْرَحَ هَذَا الدِّينُ قَائِمًا يُقَاتِلُ عَلَيْهِ عِصَابَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaaki bni harbin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ lan yabraha hadhaa alddiynu qaaiimana yuqaatilu 'alayhi 'isaabaaun mina almuslimiyna hattaa taquwma alssaa'aau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Samura that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:This religion will continue to exist, and a group of people from the Muslims will continue to fight for its protection until the Hour is established
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي يُقَاتِلُونَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ ظَاهِرِينَ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, qaalaa haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tazaalu taaiifaaun min aummatiy yuqaatiluwna 'alaa alhaqqi zaahiriyna iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah who said:I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to fight In defence of truth and remain triumphant until the Day of judgment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، بْنِ جَابِرٍ أَنَّ عُمَيْرَ بْنَ هَانِئٍ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَزَالُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي قَائِمَةً بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ لاَ يَضُرُّهُمْ مَنْ خَذَلَهُمْ أَوْ خَالَفَهُمْ حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ أَمْرُ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ ظَاهِرُونَ عَلَى النَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mansuwru bnu aabiy muzaahimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hamzaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, bni jaabirin aanna 'umayra bna haaniiin, haddathahu qaala sami'tu mu'aawiyaaa, 'alaa alminbari yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tazaalu taaiifaaun min aummatiy qaaiimaaan biaamri alllahi laa yadurruhum man khadhalahum aaw khaalafahum hattaa yaatiya aamru alllahi wahum zaahiruwna 'alaa alnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It his been narrated on the authority of Umair b. Umm Hani who said:I heard Mu'awiya say (while delivering a sermon from the pulpit) that he heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to obey Allah's Command, and those who desert or oppose them shall not be able to do them any harm. They will be dominating the peeple until Allah's Command is executed (i. e. Resurrection is established)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ بُرْقَانَ - حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ الأَصَمِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، ذَكَرَ حَدِيثًا رَوَاهُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ رَوَى عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مِنْبَرِهِ حَدِيثًا غَيْرَهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ وَلاَ تَزَالُ عِصَابَةٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ يُقَاتِلُونَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى مَنْ نَاوَأَهُمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa kathiyru bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa ja'farun, - wahuwa abnu burqaana - haddathanaa yaziydu bnu alaasammi, qaala sami'tu mu'aawiyaaa bna aabiy sufyaana, dhakara hadiythana rawaahu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam aasma'hu rawaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa minbarihi hadiythana ghayrahu qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man yuridi alllahu bihi khayrana yufaqqihhu fiy alddiyni walaa tazaalu 'isaabaaun mina almuslimiyna yuqaatiluwna 'alaa alhaqqi zaahiriyna 'alaa man naawaaahum iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been related by, Yazid b. al-Asamm that he heard Mu'awiya b. Abu Sfyan quote a tradition from the Prophet (ﷺ) which he related from the Prophet (mail peace he upon him) -and he did not hear him quote from the Prophet (masy peace be upon him) any tradition other than this in the course of his sermon from the pulpit-that whom Allah wants to do a favour, He grants him an understanding of religion. A group of people from the Muslims will remain on the Right Path and continue until the Day of Judgment to triumph over those who oppose them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ شُمَاسَةَ الْمَهْرِيُّ، قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ مُخَلَّدٍ وَعِنْدَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ إِلاَّ عَلَى شِرَارِ الْخَلْقِ هُمْ شَرٌّ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ لاَ يَدْعُونَ اللَّهَ بِشَىْءٍ إِلاَّ رَدَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏.‏ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ أَقْبَلَ عُقْبَةُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَسْلَمَةُ يَا عُقْبَةُ اسْمَعْ مَا يَقُولُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُقْبَةُ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَزَالُ عِصَابَةٌ مِنْ أُمَّتِي يُقَاتِلُونَ عَلَى أَمْرِ اللَّهِ قَاهِرِينَ لِعَدُوِّهِمْ لاَ يَضُرُّهُمْ مَنْ خَالَفَهُمْ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَهُمُ السَّاعَةُ وَهُمْ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَجَلْ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ رِيحًا كَرِيحِ الْمِسْكِ مَسُّهَا مَسُّ الْحَرِيرِ فَلاَ تَتْرُكُ نَفْسًا فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةٍ مِنَ الإِيمَانِ إِلاَّ قَبَضَتْهُ ثُمَّ يَبْقَى شِرَارُ النَّاسِ عَلَيْهِمْ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni wahbin, haddathanaa 'ammiy 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, haddathaniy yaziydu bnu aabiy habiybin, haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu shumaasaaa almahriyyu, qaala kuntu 'inda maslamaaa bni mukhalladin wa'indahu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amriw bni al'aasi faqaala 'abdu alllahi laa taquwmu alssaa'aau iilaaa 'alaa shiraari alkhalqi hum sharrun min aahli aljaahiliyyaai laa yad'uwna alllaha bishaa'in iilaaa raddahu 'alayhim ‏.‏ fabaynamaa hum 'alaa dhalika aaqbala 'uqbaau bnu 'aamirin faqaala lahu maslamaau yaa 'uqbaau asma' maa yaquwlu 'abdu alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala 'uqbaau huwa aa'lamu waaammaa aanaa fasami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa tazaalu 'isaabaaun min aummatiy yuqaatiluwna 'alaa aamri alllahi qaahiriyna li'aduwwihim laa yadurruhum man khaalafahum hattaa taatiyahumu alssaa'aau wahum 'alaa dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi aajal ‏.‏ thumma yab'athu alllahu riyhana kariyhi almiski massuhaa massu alhariyri falaa tatruku nafsana fiy qalbihi mithqaalu habbaain mina aliiymaani iilaaa qabadathu thumma yabqaa shiraaru alnnaasi 'alayhim taquwmu alssaa'aau ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Shamasa al- Mahri who said:I was in the company of Maslama b. Mukhallad, and 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. 'As was with him.
