'Abdullah said: The Hour shall some oniy when the worst type of people are left on the earth. They will be worse than the people of pre-Islamic days. They will get whatever they ask of Allah. While we were yet sitting when 'Uqba b. 'Amir came, and Maslama said to him: 'Uqba, listen to what 'Abdullah says. 'Uqba said: He knows better; so far as I am concerned, I heard the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) say: A group of people from my Umma will continue to fight in obedience to the Command of Allah, remaining dominant over their enemies. Those who will oppose them shall not do them any harm. They will remain ill this condition until the Hour overtakes them. (At this) 'Abdullah said: Yes. Then Allah will raise a wild which will be fragrant like musk and whose touch will be like the touch of silk; (but) it will cause the death of all (faithful) persons, not leaving behind a single person with an iota of faith in his heart. Then only the worst of men will remain to be overwhelmed by the Hour
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَزَالُ أَهْلُ الْغَرْبِ ظَاهِرِينَ عَلَى الْحَقِّ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an daawuda bni aabiy hindin, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yazaalu aahlu algharbi zaahiriyna 'alaa alhaqqi hattaa taquwma alssaa'aau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated by Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:The people of the West will continue to triumphantly follow the truth until the Hour is established
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَافَرْتُمْ فِي الْخِصْبِ فَأَعْطُوا الإِبِلَ حَظَّهَا مِنَ الأَرْضِ وَإِذَا سَافَرْتُمْ فِي السَّنَةِ فَأَسْرِعُوا عَلَيْهَا السَّيْرَ وَإِذَا عَرَّسْتُمْ بِاللَّيْلِ فَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّرِيقَ فَإِنَّهَا مَأْوَى الْهَوَامِّ بِاللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa saafartum fiy alkhisbi faaa'tuwa aliibila hazzahaa mina alaardi waiidhaa saafartum fiy alssanaai faaasri'uwa 'alayhaa alssayra waiidhaa 'arrastum bialllayli faajtanibuwa alttariyqa faiinnahaa maawaa alhawaammi bialllayli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:When you journey through a fertile land, you should (go slow and) give the camels a chance to graze in the land. When you travel In an arid (land) where there is scarcity of vegetation, you should quicken their pace (lest your camels grow feeble and emaciated for lack of fodder). When you halt for the night, avoid (pitching your tent on) the road, for it is the abode of noxious little animals at night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَافَرْتُمْ فِي الْخِصْبِ فَأَعْطُوا الإِبِلَ حَظَّهَا مِنَ الأَرْضِ وَإِذَا سَافَرْتُمْ فِي السَّنَةِ فَبَادِرُوا بِهَا نِقَيَهَا وَإِذَا عَرَّسْتُمْ فَاجْتَنِبُوا الطَّرِيقَ فَإِنَّهَا طُرُقُ الدَّوَابِّ وَمَأْوَى الْهَوَامِّ بِاللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa saafartum fiy alkhisbi faaa'tuwa aliibila hazzahaa mina alaardi waiidhaa saafartum fiy alssanaai fabaadiruwa bihaa niqayahaa waiidhaa 'arrastum faajtanibuwa alttariyqa faiinnahaa turuqu alddawaabbi wamaawaa alhawaammi bialllayli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated (through another chain of transmitters) on the authority of Abu Huraira that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:When you travel (through a land) where there is plenty of vegetation, you should (go slow and) give the camels a chance to enjoy the benefit of the earth. When you travel (through a land) where there is scarcity of vegetation, you should hasten with them (so that you may be able to cross that land while your animals ore still in a good condition of health). When you make a halt for the night, avoid (doing so on) the road, for the tracks are the pathways of wild beasts or the abode of noxious little animals
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ أَبِي أُوَيْسٍ، وَأَبُو مُصْعَبٍ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَمَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - قَالَ قُلْتُ لِمَالِكٍ حَدَّثَكَ سُمَىٌّ عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ السَّفَرُ قِطْعَةٌ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ يَمْنَعُ أَحَدَكُمْ نَوْمَهُ وَطَعَامَهُ وَشَرَابَهُ فَإِذَا قَضَى أَحَدُكُمْ نَهْمَتَهُ مِنْ وَجْهِهِ فَلْيُعَجِّلْ إِلَى أَهْلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, waiismaa'iylu bnu aabiy auwaysin, waaabuw mus'abin alzzuhriyyu wamansuwru bnu aabiy muzaahimin waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin qaaluwa haddathanaa maalikun, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa, bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu - waalllafzu lahu - qaala qultu limaalikin haddathaka sumaaaun 'an aabiy saalihin 'an aabiy hurayraaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alssafaru qit'aaun mina al'adhaabi yamna'u aahadakum nawmahu wata'aamahu washaraabahu faiidhaa qadaa aahadukum nahmatahu min wajhihi falyu'ajjil iilaa aahlihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: On the authority of Abu Huraira that the Prophet (ﷺ) said:Travelling is a tortuous experience. It deprives a person of his sleep. his food and drink. When one of you has accomplished his purpose, he should hasten his return to his family
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ هَمَّامٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ لاَ يَطْرُقُ أَهْلَهُ لَيْلاً وَكَانَ يَأْتِيهِمْ غُدْوَةً أَوْ عَشِيَّةً ‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, 'an hammaamin, 'an iishaaqa, bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana laa yatruqu aahlahu laylaan wakaana yaatiyhim ghudwaaan aaw 'ashiyyaaan ‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) would not come (back) to his family by night. He would come to them in the morning or in the evening
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ لاَ يَدْخُلُ ‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala kaana laa yadkhulu ‏
verses.translation: Another version of the tradition narrated on the same authority worded slightly differently. It says:(He) would not enter (upon his household at night)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَيَّارٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ ذَهَبْنَا لِنَدْخُلَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمْهِلُوا حَتَّى نَدْخُلَ لَيْلاً - أَىْ عِشَاءً - كَىْ تَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ وَتَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iismaa'iylu bnu saalimin, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa sayyaarun, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa hushaymun, 'an sayyaarin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazaaain falammaa qadimnaa almadiynaaa dhahabnaa linadkhula faqaala ‏ "‏ aamhiluwa hattaa nadkhula laylaan - aaa 'ishaa'an - kaa tamtashita alshha'ithaau watastahidda almughiybaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah who said:We accompanied the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) on an expedition. When we came (back) to Medina and were going to enter our houses, he said: Wait and enter (your houses) in the later part of the evening so that a woman with dishevelled hair may have used the comb, and a woman whose husband has been away from home may have removed the hair from her private parts
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَيَّارٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا قَدِمَ أَحَدُكُمْ لَيْلاً فَلاَ يَأْتِيَنَّ أَهْلَهُ طُرُوقًا حَتَّى تَسْتَحِدَّ الْمُغِيبَةُ وَتَمْتَشِطَ الشَّعِثَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sayyaarin, 'an 'aamirin, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa qadima aahadukum laylaan falaa yaatiyanna aahlahu turuwqana hattaa tastahidda almughiybaau watamtashita alshha'ithaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated on the authority of Jabir that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said:If one of you comes (back from a journey) at night. he should not enter his house as a night visitor (but should wait) until a woman whose husband has been away from house has removed the hair from her private parts and a woman with dishevelled hair has combed her hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَيَّارٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa sayyaarun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has been handed down through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 33 — The Book on Government
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَطَالَ الرَّجُلُ الْغَيْبَةَ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ أَهْلَهُ طُرُوقًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'aasimin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aataala alrrajulu alghaybaaa aan yaatiya aahlahu turuwqana ‏.‏
verses.translation: It has been narrated (through a different chain of tranmitters) on the authority of Jabir who said:The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade that a man who had long absent should come to his family like (an unexpected) night visitor
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي أُرْسِلُ الْكِلاَبَ الْمُعَلَّمَةَ فَيُمْسِكْنَ عَلَىَّ وَأَذْكُرُ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ الْمُعَلَّمَ وَذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ فَكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَإِنْ قَتَلْنَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنْ قَتَلْنَ مَا لَمْ يَشْرَكْهَا كَلْبٌ لَيْسَ مَعَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنِّي أَرْمِي بِالْمِعْرَاضِ الصَّيْدَ فَأُصِيبُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا رَمَيْتَ بِالْمِعْرَاضِ فَخَزَقَ فَكُلْهُ وَإِنْ أَصَابَهُ بِعَرْضِهِ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an hammaami bni alhaarithi, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy aursilu alkilaaba almu'allamaaa fayumsikna 'alaaaa waaadhkuru asma alllahi 'alayhi faqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa aarsalta kalbaka almu'allama wadhakarta asma alllahi 'alayhi fakul ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu waiin qatalna qaala ‏"‏ waiin qatalna maa lam yashrakhaa kalbun laysa ma'ahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu lahu faiinniy aarmiy bialmi'raadi alssayda faausiybu faqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa ramayta bialmi'raadi fakhazaqa fakulhu waiin aasaabahu bi'ardihi falaa taakulhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi b. Hatim reported:I said: Messenger of Allah, I set off trained dogs and they catch for me (the game) and I recite the name of Allah over it (I slaughter the game by reciting Bismillah-i-Allah-o-Akbar), whereupon he said: When you set off your trained dogs, if you recited the name of Allah (while setting them off), then eat (the game). I said: Even if they (the trained dogs) kill that (the game)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Even if these kill, but (on the condition) that no other dog, which you did not set off (along with your dogs), participates (in catching the game). I said to him: I throw Mi'rad, a heavy featherless blunt arrow, for hunting and killing (the game). Thereupon he said: When you throw Mi'rad, and it pierces, then eat, but if it falls flatly (and beats the game to death), then do not eat that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ بَيَانٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ، بْنِ حَاتِمٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ إِنَّا قَوْمٌ نَصِيدُ بِهَذِهِ الْكِلاَبِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كِلاَبَكَ الْمُعَلَّمَةَ وَذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا فَكُلْ مِمَّا أَمْسَكْنَ عَلَيْكَ وَإِنْ قَتَلْنَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الْكَلْبُ فَإِنْ أَكَلَ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ إِنَّمَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ وَإِنْ خَالَطَهَا كِلاَبٌ مِنْ غَيْرِهَا فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an bayaanin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'adiyyi, bni haatimin qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qultu iinnaa qawmun nasiydu bihadhihi alkilaabi faqaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aarsalta kilaabaka almu'allamaaa wadhakarta asma alllahi 'alayhaa fakul mimmaa aamsakna 'alayka waiin qatalna iilaaa aan yaakula alkalbu faiin aakala falaa taakul faiinniy aakhaafu aan yakuwna iinnamaa aamsaka 'alaa nafsihi waiin khaalatahaa kilaabun min ghayrihaa falaa taakul ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi b. Hatim reported:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saying: We are a people who hunt with these (trained) dogs, then (what should we do)? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: When you set of your trained dogs having recited the name of Allah, then eat what these (hounds) have caught for you, even if it (the game) is killed, provided (the hunting dog) has not eaten (any part of the game). If it has eaten (the game), then you don't eat it as I fear that it might have caught for its own self. And do not eat it if other dogs have joined your trained dogs
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، أَبِي السَّفَرِ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمِعْرَاضِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَصَابَ بِحَدِّهِ فَكُلْ وَإِذَا أَصَابَ بِعَرْضِهِ فَقَتَلَ فَإِنَّهُ وَقِيذٌ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْكَلْبِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ وَذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَكُلْ فَإِنْ أَكَلَ مِنْهُ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنَّهُ إِنَّمَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ وَجَدْتُ مَعَ كَلْبِي كَلْبًا آخَرَ فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَيُّهُمَا أَخَذَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنَّمَا سَمَّيْتَ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ وَلَمْ تُسَمِّ عَلَى غَيْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, aabiy alssafari 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almi'raadi faqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa aasaaba bihaddihi fakul waiidhaa aasaaba bi'ardihi faqatala faiinnahu waqiydhun falaa taakul ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alkalbi faqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa aarsalta kalbaka wadhakarta asma alllahi fakul faiin aakala minhu falaa taakul faiinnahu iinnamaa aamsaka 'alaa nafsihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu faiin wajadtu ma'a kalbiy kalbana akhara falaa aadriy aayyuhumaa aakhadhahu qaala ‏"‏ falaa taakul faiinnamaa sammayta 'alaa kalbika walam tusammi 'alaa ghayrihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi b. Hatim reported that he asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about (hunting) with the help of an arrow having a stub end. He said:If it strikes (the game) with its point, then eat, but if it strikes flatly and it dies, that is Waqidh (beaten into death), do not eat that. I asked the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) about (hunting with the help of) dogs, whereupon he said. When you send your dog (for hunting) reciting the name of Allah, then eat (the game), but if some part of it is eaten (by the dogs, then do not eat that, for it (your dog) has caught that (the-game) for itself. I (again) said: If I find along with my dog another dog, and do not know which of (the dogs) has caught (the game). then (what should I do)? Thereupon he ('Allah's Messenger) said: Then don't eat that, for you recited the name of Allah on your dog and not on the other one
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، أَبِي السَّفَرِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الشَّعْبِيَّ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ، يَقُولُ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمِعْرَاضِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, qaala waaakhbaraniy shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, aabiy alssafari qaala sami'tu alshha'biyya, yaquwlu sami'tu 'adiyya bna haatimin, yaquwlu saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almi'raadi ‏.‏ fadhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi b. Hatim reported:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about Mi'rad (i. e. hunting with the help of arrow having a stub end, and he stated the same (as we find in the previous hadith)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ، أَبِي السَّفَرِ وَعَنْ نَاسٍ، ذَكَرَ شُعْبَةُ عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْمِعْرَاضِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu, aabiy alssafari wa'an naasin, dhakara shu'baau 'ani alshha'biyyi, qaala sami'tu 'adiyya bna haatimin, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani almi'raadi ‏.‏ bimithli dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ صَيْدِ الْمِعْرَاضِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَصَابَ بِحَدِّهِ فَكُلْهُ وَمَا أَصَابَ بِعَرْضِهِ فَهُوَ وَقِيذٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَيْدِ الْكَلْبِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَمْسَكَ عَلَيْكَ وَلَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ فَكُلْهُ فَإِنَّ ذَكَاتَهُ أَخْذُهُ فَإِنْ وَجَدْتَ عِنْدَهُ كَلْبًا آخَرَ فَخَشِيتَ أَنْ يَكُونَ أَخَذَهُ مَعَهُ وَقَدْ قَتَلَهُ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ إِنَّمَا ذَكَرْتَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ وَلَمْ تَذْكُرْهُ عَلَى غَيْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'an 'aamirin, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an saydi almi'raadi faqaala ‏"‏ maa aasaaba bihaddihi fakulhu wamaa aasaaba bi'ardihi fahuwa waqiydhun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaaltuhu 'an saydi alkalbi faqaala ‏"‏ maa aamsaka 'alayka walam yaakul minhu fakulhu faiinna dhakaatahu aakhdhuhu faiin wajadta 'indahu kalbana akhara fakhashiyta aan yakuwna aakhadhahu ma'ahu waqad qatalahu falaa taakul iinnamaa dhakarta asma alllahi 'alaa kalbika walam tadhkurhu 'alaa ghayrihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi b. Hatim reported:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about hunting the game with the help of Mi'rad, whereupon he said: If it strikes (the game) with its point, then eat it, but if it strikes flat, that is (the game is) beaten (into death), (then do not eat that) 'Adi further said: I asked him about hunting with the help of a dog, whereupon he said: If that (the dog) catches it (the game) for you and does not eat out of that, then you eat (the game) for Dhakat (slaughtering) of that is its being caught by it (by the dog). But if you find another dog besides it, and you fear that that dog (the second one) had caught it (the game) along with that (your dog) and killed it. then don't eat; for you recited the name of Allah on your dog and did not recite that on the other one (which joined your dog incidentally)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ أَبِي، زَائِدَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu aabiy, zaaiidaaa bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zakariya b. Abu Za'ida with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الشَّعْبِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَدِيَّ بْنَ حَاتِمٍ، - وَكَانَ لَنَا جَارًا وَدَخِيلاً وَرَبِيطًا بِالنَّهْرَيْنِ - أَنَّهُ سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أُرْسِلُ كَلْبِي فَأَجِدُ مَعَ كَلْبِي كَلْبًا قَدْ أَخَذَ لاَ أَدْرِي أَيُّهُمَا أَخَذَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنَّمَا سَمَّيْتَ عَلَى كَلْبِكَ وَلَمْ تُسَمِّ عَلَى غَيْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu alwaliydi bni 'abdi alhamiydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'iydi bni masruwqin, haddathanaa alshha'biyyu, qaala sami'tu 'adiyya bna haatimin, - wakaana lanaa jaarana wadakhiylaan warabiytana bialnnahrayni - aannahu saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aursilu kalbiy faaajidu ma'a kalbiy kalbana qad aakhadha laa aadriy aayyuhumaa aakhadha ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ falaa taakul faiinnamaa sammayta 'alaa kalbika walam tusammi 'alaa ghayrihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sha'bi reported:I heard Adi b. Hatim say-and he was our neighbour, and our partner and co worker at Nahrain-that he asked Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) saying: I let off my dog and find another dog along with my dog and that (any one of them) catches the (game), but I do not know which one had caught it, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Then don't eat that, for you recited the name of Allah while letting off your dog and did not recite on the other
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithla dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated oif the authority of 'Adi b. Hatim through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ السَّكُونِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَرْسَلْتَ كَلْبَكَ فَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ أَمْسَكَ عَلَيْكَ فَأَدْرَكْتَهُ حَيًّا فَاذْبَحْهُ وَإِنْ أَدْرَكْتَهُ قَدْ قَتَلَ وَلَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْهُ فَكُلْهُ وَإِنْ وَجَدْتَ مَعَ كَلْبِكَ كَلْبًا غَيْرَهُ وَقَدْ قَتَلَ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ فَإِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي أَيُّهُمَا قَتَلَهُ وَإِنْ رَمَيْتَ سَهْمَكَ فَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ غَابَ عَنْكَ يَوْمًا فَلَمْ تَجِدْ فِيهِ إِلاَّ أَثَرَ سَهْمِكَ فَكُلْ إِنْ شِئْتَ وَإِنْ وَجَدْتَهُ غَرِيقًا فِي الْمَاءِ فَلاَ تَأْكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alwaliydu bnu shujaa'in alssakuwniyyu, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an 'aasimin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aarsalta kalbaka faadhkuri asma alllahi faiin aamsaka 'alayka faaadraktahu hayyana faadhbahhu waiin aadraktahu qad qatala walam yaakul minhu fakulhu waiin wajadta ma'a kalbika kalbana ghayrahu waqad qatala falaa taakul faiinnaka laa tadriy aayyuhumaa qatalahu waiin ramayta sahmaka faadhkuri asma alllahi faiin ghaaba 'anka yawmana falam tajid fiyhi iilaaa aathara sahmika fakul iin shiita waiin wajadtahu ghariyqana fiy almaa'i falaa taakul ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi b. Hatim reported:Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said to me: When you let off your dog, recite the name of Allah, and if it catches (game for you) and you find it alive, then slaughter it; if you find it killed and that (your dog) has eaten nothing out of that, (even then) you may eat it; but if you find along with your dog another dog, and (the game an) dead, then don't eat, for you do not know which of the two has killed it. And if you shoot your arrow, recite the name of Allah, but if it (game) goes out of your sight for a day and you do not find on that but the mark of your arrow, then eat that it you so like, but if you find it drowned in water, then don't eat that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ حَاتِمٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الصَّيْدِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَمَيْتَ سَهْمَكَ فَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ وَجَدْتَهُ قَدْ قَتَلَ فَكُلْ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَجِدَهُ قَدْ وَقَعَ فِي مَاءٍ فَإِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي الْمَاءُ قَتَلَهُ أَوْ سَهْمُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki, aakhbaranaa 'aasimun, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an 'adiyyi bni haatimin, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alssaydi qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa ramayta sahmaka faadhkuri asma alllahi faiin wajadtahu qad qatala fakul iilaaa aan tajidahu qad waqa'a fiy maa'in faiinnaka laa tadriy almaa'u qatalahu aaw sahmuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi b. Hatim reported:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about hunting. He said: When you shoot your arrow, recite the name of Allah, and if you find it (the arrow) killed (that). then eat, except when you find it fallen into water, for in that case you do not know whether it is water that caused its death or your arrow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، عَنْ حَيْوَةَ بْنِ شُرَيْحٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَبِيعَةَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ الدِّمَشْقِيَّ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ، عَائِذُ اللَّهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا بِأَرْضِ قَوْمٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ نَأْكُلُ فِي آنِيَتِهِمْ وَأَرْضِ صَيْدٍ أَصِيدُ بِقَوْسِي وَأَصِيدُ بِكَلْبِيَ الْمُعَلَّمِ أَوْ بِكَلْبِيَ الَّذِي لَيْسَ بِمُعَلَّمٍ فَأَخْبِرْنِي مَا الَّذِي يَحِلُّ لَنَا مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَّا مَا ذَكَرْتَ أَنَّكُمْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ تَأْكُلُونَ فِي آنِيَتِهِمْ فَإِنْ وَجَدْتُمْ غَيْرَ آنِيَتِهِمْ فَلاَ تَأْكُلُوا فِيهَا وَإِنْ لَمْ تَجِدُوا فَاغْسِلُوهَا ثُمَّ كُلُوا فِيهَا وَأَمَّا مَا ذَكَرْتَ أَنَّكَ بِأَرْضِ صَيْدٍ فَمَا أَصَبْتَ بِقَوْسِكَ فَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كُلْ وَمَا أَصَبْتَ بِكَلْبِكَ الْمُعَلَّمِ فَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ كُلْ وَمَا أَصَبْتَ بِكَلْبِكَ الَّذِي لَيْسَ بِمُعَلَّمٍ فَأَدْرَكْتَ ذَكَاتَهُ فَكُلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hannaadu bnu alssariyyi, haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, 'an haywaaa bni shurayhin, qaala sami'tu rabiy'aaa bna yaziyda alddimashqiyya, yaquwlu aakhbaraniy aabuw iidriysa, 'aaiidhu alllahi qaala sami'tu aabaa tha'labaaa alkhushaniyya, yaquwlu aataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa biaardi qawmin min aahli alkitaabi naakulu fiy aniyatihim waaardi saydin aasiydu biqawsiy waaasiydu bikalbiya almu'allami aaw bikalbiya alladhiy laysa bimu'allamin faaakhbirniy maa alladhiy yahillu lanaa min dhalika qaala ‏ "‏ aammaa maa dhakarta aannakum biaardi qawmin min aahli alkitaabi taakuluwna fiy aniyatihim faiin wajadtum ghayra aniyatihim falaa taakuluwa fiyhaa waiin lam tajiduwa faaghsiluwhaa thumma kuluwa fiyhaa waaammaa maa dhakarta aannaka biaardi saydin famaa aasabta biqawsika faadhkuri asma alllahi thumma kul wamaa aasabta bikalbika almu'allami faadhkuri asma alllahi thumma kul wamaa aasabta bikalbika alladhiy laysa bimu'allamin faaadrakta dhakaatahu fakul ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani reported:I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, we are in the land of the People of the Book, (so) we eat in their utensils, and (live) in a hunting region. where I hunt with, the help of my bow, and hunt with my trained dog, or with my dog which is not trained. So inform me what is lawful (Halal) for us out of that. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Regarding what you have mentioned of the fact that you live in the land belonging to the People of the Book and so you eat in their utensils, but if you can get utensils other than theirs, then don't eat in them; but if you do not find any, then wash them and eat in them. And regarding what you have mentioned about (your living) in a hunting region, what you hunt, (strike) with the help of your bow, recite the name of Allah (while shooting an arrow) and then eat; and what you catch with the help of your trained dog, recite the name of Allah (while letting oil) the dog and then eat it, and what you get with the help of your untrained dog, (if you find it alive) and slaughter it (according to the law of the Shari'ah), eat it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُقْرِئُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ حَيْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، لَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِيهِ صَيْدَ الْقَوْسِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa almuqriiu, kilaahumaa 'an haywaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi abni almubaaraki ghayra aanna hadiytha abni wahbin, lam yadhkur fiyhi sayda alqawsi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Haiwa with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَمَّادُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الْخَيَّاطُ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا رَمَيْتَ بِسَهْمِكَ فَغَابَ عَنْكَ فَأَدْرَكْتَهُ فَكُلْهُ مَا لَمْ يُنْتِنْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'abdi alllahi, hammaadu bnu khaalidin alkhayyaatu 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni saalihin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy tha'labaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa ramayta bisahmika faghaaba 'anka faaadraktahu fakulhu maa lam yuntin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Tha'laba reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:If you shoot with your arrow and (the game) goes out of your sight and you find it (later on), then eat that if it has not gone rotten
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الَّذِي يُدْرِكُ صَيْدَهُ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏ "‏ فَكُلْهُ مَا لَمْ يُنْتِنْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu aahmada bni aabiy khalafin, haddathanaa ma'nu bnu 'iysaa, haddathaniy mu'aawiyaau, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayri bni nufayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy tha'labaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alladhiy yudriku saydahu ba'da thalaathin ‏ "‏ fakulhu maa lam yuntin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Tha'laba reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying about one who comes three days later on the game he has shot:Eat it, provided it has not gone rotten
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ مَكْحُولٍ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدِيثَهُ فِي الصَّيْدِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ وَأَبِي الزَّاهِرِيَّةِ عَنْ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ الْعَلاَءِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ نُتُونَتَهُ وَقَالَ فِي الْكَلْبِ ‏ "‏ كُلْهُ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُنْتِنَ فَدَعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni saalihin, 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an makhuwlin, 'an aabiy tha'labaaa alkhushaniyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadiythahu fiy alssaydi thumma qaala abnu haatimin haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin 'an mu'aawiyaaa 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayrin waaabiy alzzaahiriyyaai 'an jubayri bni nufayrin 'an aabiy tha'labaaa alkhushaniyyi ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi al'alaa'i ghayra aannahu lam yadhkur nutuwnatahu waqaala fiy alkalbi ‏ "‏ kulhu ba'da thalaathin iilaaa aan yuntina fada'hu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Tha'laba al- Khushani with a slight variation of (words):He (the Holy Prophet) said in regard to the game killed by (a trained) dog: Eat after three days provided it has not gone rotten
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ أَبِي، ثَعْلَبَةَ قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السَّبُعِ ‏.‏ زَادَ إِسْحَاقُ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا قَالَ الزُّهْرِيُّ وَلَمْ نَسْمَعْ بِهَذَا حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا الشَّامَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy iidriysa, 'an aabiy, tha'labaaa qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aakli kulli dhiy naabin mina alssabu'i ‏.‏ zaada iishaaqu waabnu aabiy 'umara fiy hadiythihimaa qaala alzzuhriyyu walam nasma' bihadhaa hattaa qadimnaa alshhaama ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Tha'laba reported that Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon prohibited the eating of every fanged beast of prey. Zuhri added:We did not bear of it until we came to Syria)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيَّ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ ذَلِكَ مِنْ عُلَمَائِنَا بِالْحِجَازِ حَتَّى حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ وَكَانَ مِنْ فُقَهَاءِ أَهْلِ الشَّامِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy iidriysa alkhawlaaniyyi, aannahu sami'a aabaa tha'labaaa alkhushaniyya, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aakli kulli dhiy naabin mina alssibaa'i ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin walam aasma' dhalika min 'ulamaaiinaa bialhijaazi hattaa haddathaniy aabuw iidriysa wakaana min fuqahaa'i aahli alshhaami ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of all fanged beasts. Ibn Shihab said:I did not bear of this from our 'Ulama' in the Hijaz, until Abu Idris narrated that to me and he was one of the jurists of Syria
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرٌو، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ثَعْلَبَةَ الْخُشَنِيِّ، أَنَّالله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ أَكْلِ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa 'amrunw, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - aanna abna shihaabin, haddathahu 'an aabiy iidriysa alkhawlaaniyyi, 'an aabiy tha'labaaa alkhushaniyyi, aannaallh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an aakli kulli dhiy naabin mina alssibaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Tha'laba al-Khushani reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having prohibited the eating of all fanged beasts of prey
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ وَيُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ وَغَيْرُهُمْ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ الْمَاجِشُونِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَعَمْرٍو كُلُّهُمْ ذَكَرَ الأَكْلَ إِلاَّ صَالِحًا وَيُوسُفَ فَإِنَّ حَدِيثَهُمَا نَهَى عَنْ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السَّبُعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aanasin, waabnu aabiy dhiibin, wa'amruw bnu alhaarithi wayuwnusu bnu yaziyda waghayruhum h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yuwsufu bnu almaajishuwni, h wahaddathanaa alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an ya'quwba bni iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithla hadiythi yuwnusa wa'amrinw kulluhum dhakara alaakla iilaaa saalihana wayuwsufa faiinna hadiythahumaa nahaa 'an kulli dhiy naabin mina alssabu'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through several other chains of transmitters, but some of the chains have a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ عَبِيدَةَ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ فَأَكْلُهُ حَرَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'niy abna mahdiyyin - 'an maalikin, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy hakiymin, 'an 'abiydaaa bni sufyaana, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ kullu dhiy naabin mina alssibaa'i faaakluhu haraamun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The eating of all fanged beasts of prey is unlawful
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aanasin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ، بْنِ مِهْرَانَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ وَعَنْ كُلِّ ذِي مِخْلَبٍ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an maymuwni, bni mihraana 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an kulli dhiy naabin mina alssibaa'i wa'an kulli dhiy mikhlabin mina alttayri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the eating of all fanged beasts of prey, and all the birds having talons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa sahlu bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ، وَأَبُو بِشْرٍ عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ كُلِّ ذِي نَابٍ مِنَ السِّبَاعِ وَعَنْ كُلِّ ذِي مِخْلَبٍ مِنَ الطَّيْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu hanbalin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu daawuda, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, haddathanaa alhakamu, waaabuw bishrin 'an maymuwni bni mihraana, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an kulli dhiy naabin mina alssibaa'i wa'an kulli dhiy mikhlabin mina alttayri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the eating) of all the fanged beasts of prey, and of all the birds having talons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، قَالَ أَبُو بِشْرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مَيْمُونِ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ عَنِ الْحَكَمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy bishrin, h wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu hanbalin, haddathanaa hushaymun, qaala aabuw bishrin aakhbaranaa 'an maymuwni bni mihraana, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala nahaa h wahaddathaniy aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an maymuwni bni mihraana, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi shu'baaa 'ani alhakami ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْنَا أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ نَتَلَقَّى عِيرًا لِقُرَيْشٍ وَزَوَّدَنَا جِرَابًا مِنْ تَمْرٍ لَمْ يَجِدْ لَنَا غَيْرَهُ فَكَانَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ يُعْطِينَا تَمْرَةً تَمْرَةً - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ كَيْفَ كُنْتُمْ تَصْنَعُونَ بِهَا قَالَ نَمَصُّهَا كَمَا يَمَصُّ الصَّبِيُّ ثُمَّ نَشْرَبُ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَتَكْفِينَا يَوْمَنَا إِلَى اللَّيْلِ وَكُنَّا نَضْرِبُ بِعِصِيِّنَا الْخَبَطَ ثُمَّ نَبُلُّهُ بِالْمَاءِ فَنَأْكُلُهُ قَالَ وَانْطَلَقْنَا عَلَى سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ فَرُفِعَ لَنَا عَلَى سَاحِلِ الْبَحْرِ كَهَيْئَةِ الْكَثِيبِ الضَّخْمِ فَأَتَيْنَاهُ فَإِذَا هِيَ دَابَّةٌ تُدْعَى الْعَنْبَرَ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ مَيْتَةٌ ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ بَلْ نَحْنُ رُسُلُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ وَقَدِ اضْطُرِرْتُمْ فَكُلُوا قَالَ فَأَقَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَهْرًا وَنَحْنُ ثَلاَثُ مِائَةٍ حَتَّى سَمِنَّا قَالَ وَلَقَدْ رَأَيْتُنَا نَغْتَرِفُ مِنْ وَقْبِ عَيْنِهِ بِالْقِلاَلِ الدُّهْنَ وَنَقْتَطِعُ مِنْهُ الْفِدَرَ كَالثَّوْرِ - أَوْ كَقَدْرِ الثَّوْرِ - فَلَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِنَّا أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ثَلاَثَةَ عَشَرَ رَجُلاً فَأَقْعَدَهُمْ فِي وَقْبِ عَيْنِهِ وَأَخَذَ ضِلَعًا مِنْ أَضْلاَعِهِ فَأَقَامَهَا ثُمَّ رَحَلَ أَعْظَمَ بَعِيرٍ مَعَنَا فَمَرَّ مِنْ تَحْتِهَا وَتَزَوَّدْنَا مِنْ لَحْمِهِ وَشَائِقَ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْنَا الْمَدِينَةَ أَتَيْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هُوَ رِزْقٌ أَخْرَجَهُ اللَّهُ لَكُمْ فَهَلْ مَعَكُمْ مِنْ لَحْمِهِ شَىْءٌ فَتُطْعِمُونَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهُ فَأَكَلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, h wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala ba'athanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaammara 'alaynaa aabaa 'ubaydaaa natalaqqaa 'iyrana liqurayshin wazawwadanaa jiraabana min tamrin lam yajid lanaa ghayrahu fakaana aabuw 'ubaydaaa yu'tiynaa tamraaan tamraaan - qaala - faqultu kayfa kuntum tasna'uwna bihaa qaala namassuhaa kamaa yamassu alssabiyyu thumma nashrabu 'alayhaa mina almaa'i fatakfiynaa yawmanaa iilaa alllayli wakunnaa nadribu bi'isiyyinaa alkhabata thumma nabulluhu bialmaa'i fanaakuluhu qaala waantalaqnaa 'alaa saahili albahri farufi'a lanaa 'alaa saahili albahri kahayiaai alkathiybi alddakhmi faaataynaahu faiidhaa hiya daabbaaun tud'aa al'anbara qaala qaala aabuw 'ubaydaaa maytaaun thumma qaala laa bal nahnu rusulu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wafiy sabiyli alllahi waqadi adturirtum fakuluwa qaala faaaqamnaa 'alayhi shahrana wanahnu thalaathu miaiaain hattaa saminnaa qaala walaqad raaaytunaa naghtarifu min waqbi 'aynihi bialqilaali aldduhna wanaqtati'u minhu alfidara kaalthhawri - aaw kaqadri althhawri - falaqad aakhadha minnaa aabuw 'ubaydaaa thalaathaaa 'ashara rajulaan faaaq'adahum fiy waqbi 'aynihi waaakhadha dila'ana min aadlaa'ihi faaaqaamahaa thumma rahala aa'zama ba'iyrin ma'anaa famarra min tahtihaa watazawwadnaa min lahmihi washaaiiqa falammaa qadimnaa almadiynaaa aataynaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakarnaa dhalika lahu faqaala ‏ "‏ huwa rizqun aakhrajahu alllahu lakum fahal ma'akum min lahmihi shaa'un fatut'imuwnaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaarsalnaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm minhu faaakalahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) sent us (on an expedition) and appointed Abu 'Ubaida our chief that we might intercept a caravan of the Quraish and provided us with a bag of dates. And he found for us nothing besides it. Abu Ubaida gave each of us one date (everyday). I (Abu Zubair, one of the narrators) said: What did you do with that? He said: We sucked that just as a baby sucks and then drank water over that, and it sufficed us for the day until night. We beat off leaves with the help of our staffs, then drenched them with water and ate them. We then went to the coast of the sea, and there rose before us on the coast of the sea something like a big mound. We came near that and we found that it was a beast, called al-'Anbar (spermaceti whale). Abu 'Ubaida said. It is dead. He then said: No (but it does not matter), we have been sent by the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in the path of Allah and you are hard pressed (on account of the scarcity of food), so you eat that. We three hundred in number stayed there for a month, until we grew bulky. He (Jabir) said: I saw how we extracted pitcher after pitcher full of fat from the cavity of its eye, and sliced from it compact piece of meat equal to a bull or like a bull. Abu 'Ubaida called forth thirteen men from us and he made them sit in the cavity of its eye, and he took hold of one of the ribs of its chest and made it stand and then saddled the biggest of the camels we had with us and it passed under it (the arched rib), and we provided ourselves with pieces of boiled meat (especially for use in our journey). When we came back to Medina, we went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: That was a provision which Allah had brought forth for you. Is there any piece of meat (left) with you, so tnat you give to us that? He (Jabir) said: We sent to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tome of that (a piece of meat) and he ate it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعَ عَمْرٌو، جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ بَعَثَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ ثَلاَثُمِائَةِ رَاكِبٍ وَأَمِيرُنَا أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ نَرْصُدُ عِيرًا لِقُرَيْشٍ فَأَقَمْنَا بِالسَّاحِلِ نِصْفَ شَهْرٍ فَأَصَابَنَا جُوعٌ شَدِيدٌ حَتَّى أَكَلْنَا الْخَبَطَ فَسُمِّيَ جَيْشَ الْخَبَطِ فَأَلْقَى لَنَا الْبَحْرُ دَابَّةً يُقَالُ لَهَا الْعَنْبَرُ فَأَكَلْنَا مِنْهَا نِصْفَ شَهْرٍ وَادَّهَنَّا مِنْ وَدَكِهَا حَتَّى ثَابَتْ أَجْسَامُنَا - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ضِلَعًا مِنْ أَضْلاَعِهِ فَنَصَبَهُ ثُمَّ نَظَرَ إِلَى أَطْوَلِ رَجُلٍ فِي الْجَيْشِ وَأَطْوَلِ جَمَلٍ فَحَمَلَهُ عَلَيْهِ فَمَرَّ تَحْتَهُ قَالَ وَجَلَسَ فِي حَجَاجِ عَيْنِهِ نَفَرٌ قَالَ وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْ وَقْبِ عَيْنِهِ كَذَا وَكَذَا قُلَّةَ وَدَكٍ - قَالَ - وَكَانَ مَعَنَا جِرَابٌ مِنْ تَمْرٍ فَكَانَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ يُعْطِي كُلَّ رَجُلٍ مِنَّا قَبْضَةً قَبْضَةً ثُمَّ أَعْطَانَا تَمْرَةً تَمْرَةً فَلَمَّا فَنِيَ وَجَدْنَا فَقْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu aljabbaari bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'a 'amrunw, jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi yaquwlu ba'athanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu thalaathumiaiaai raakibin waaamiyrunaa aabuw 'ubaydaaa bnu aljarraahi narsudu 'iyrana liqurayshin faaaqamnaa bialssaahili nisfa shahrin faaasaabanaa juw'un shadiydun hattaa aakalnaa alkhabata fasummiya jaysha alkhabati faaalqaa lanaa albahru daabbaaan yuqaalu lahaa al'anbaru faaakalnaa minhaa nisfa shahrin waaddahannaa min wadakihaa hattaa thaabat aajsaamunaa - qaala - faaakhadha aabuw 'ubaydaaa dila'ana min aadlaa'ihi fanasabahu thumma nazara iilaa aatwali rajulin fiy aljayshi waaatwali jamalin fahamalahu 'alayhi famarra tahtahu qaala wajalasa fiy hajaaji 'aynihi nafarun qaala waaakhrajnaa min waqbi 'aynihi kadhaa wakadhaa qullaaa wadakin - qaala - wakaana ma'anaa jiraabun min tamrin fakaana aabuw 'ubaydaaa yu'tiy kulla rajulin minnaa qabdaaan qabdaaan thumma aa'taanaa tamraaan tamraaan falammaa faniya wajadnaa faqdahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) sent us (on an expedition). We were three hundred riders and our chief (leader) was 'Ubaida b. al-Jarrah. We were on the look out for a caravan of the Quraish. So we stayed on the coast for half a month, and were so much afflicted by extreme hunger that we (were obliged) to eat leaves. That is why it was called the Detachment of the Leaves. The ocean cast out for us an animal which was called al-'Anbar (whale). We ate of that for half of the month and rubbed its fat on our (bodies) until our bodies became stout. Abu 'Ubaida caught hold of one of its ribs and fixed that up. He then cast a glance at the tallest man of the army and the highest of the camels. and then made him ride over that, and that-tnan passed beneath it (the rib), and many a man could sit in its eye-socket, and we extracted many pitchers of fat from the cavity of its eye. We had small bags containing dates with us (before finding the whale). 'Ubaida gave every person amongst us a handful of dates (and when the provision ran short), he then gave each one of us one date. And when that (stock) was exhausted, we felt its loss
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ سَمِعَ عَمْرٌو، جَابِرًا يَقُولُ فِي جَيْشِ الْخَبَطِ إِنَّ رَجُلاً نَحَرَ ثَلاَثَ جَزَائِرَ ثُمَّ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ نَهَاهُ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu aljabbaari bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala sami'a 'amrunw, jaabirana yaquwlu fiy jayshi alkhabati iinna rajulaan nahara thalaatha jazaaiira thumma thalaathana thumma thalaathana thumma nahaahu aabuw 'ubaydaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr reported on the authority of Jabir that in the expedition of Khabat (leaves) a person slaughtered three camels, then three, then three, then Abu 'Ubaida forbade him (to do so fearing that the rides may become short)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ - عَنْ هِشَامِ، بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ بَعَثَنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ ثَلاَثُمِائَةٍ نَحْمِلُ أَزْوَادَنَا عَلَى رِقَابِنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau, - ya'niy abna sulaymaana - 'an hishaami, bni 'urwaaa 'an wahbi bni kaysaana, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala ba'athanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu thalaathumiaiaain nahmilu aazwaadanaa 'alaa riqaabinaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent us (on an expedition), and we were three hundred in number, and we were carrying our bags of provisions around our necks
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي نُعَيْمٍ، وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً ثَلاَثَمِائَةٍ وَأَمَّرَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ فَفَنِيَ زَادُهُمْ فَجَمَعَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ زَادَهُمْ فِي مِزْوَدٍ فَكَانَ يُقَوِّتُنَا حَتَّى كَانَ يُصِيبُنَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ تَمْرَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an aabiy nu'aymin, wahbi bni kaysaana aanna jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, aakhbarahu qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sariyyaaan thalaathamiaiaain waaammara 'alayhim aabaa 'ubaydaaa bna aljarraahi fafaniya zaaduhum fajama'a aabuw 'ubaydaaa zaadahum fiy mizwadin fakaana yuqawwitunaa hattaa kaana yusiybunaa kulla yawmin tamraaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent on in expedition a detachment consisting of three hundred (persons) and appointed Abu 'Ubaida b. Jarrah as their chief. Their provisions ran short:'Abu 'Ubaida collected their provisions in the provision bag. and he fed us (for some time). Later on when the provisions ran short he gave us one date every day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ كَثِيرٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ وَهْبَ بْنَ كَيْسَانَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَرِيَّةً أَنَا فِيهِمْ إِلَى سِيفِ الْبَحْرِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقُوا جَمِيعًا بَقِيَّةَ الْحَدِيثِ كَنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ وَأَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا الْجَيْشُ ثَمَانِيَ عَشْرَةَ لَيْلَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa alwaliydu, - ya'niy abna kathiyrin - qaala sami'tu wahba bna kaysaana, yaquwlu sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sariyyaaan aanaa fiyhim iilaa siyfi albahri ‏.‏ wasaaquwa jamiy'ana baqiyyaaa alhadiythi kanahwi hadiythi 'amriw bni diynaarin waaabiy alzzubayri ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi wahbi bni kaysaana faaakala minhaa aljayshu thamaaniya 'ashraaa laylaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition to the sea coast and I was one among them. The rest of the hadith is the same with a slight variation of wording that in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Wahb b. Kaisan (the words are):" The army ate out of that (the whale) for eighteen days
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْمُنْذِرِ الْقَزَّازُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْثًا إِلَى أَرْضِ جُهَيْنَةَ وَاسْتَعْمَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَجُلاً وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa aabuw almundhiri alqazzaazu, kilaahumaa 'an daawuda bni qaysin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni miqsamin, 'an jaabiri bni, 'abdi alllahi qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'thana iilaa aardi juhaynaaa waasta'mala 'alayhim rajulaan wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent an expedition to the land of the tribe of Juhaina, and appointed a person as a chief over them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ وَالْحَسَنِ ابْنَىْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ مُتْعَةِ النِّسَاءِ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ وَعَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الإِنْسِيَّةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maaliki bni aanasin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi, alllahi waalhasani abnaa muhammadi bni 'aliyyin 'an aabiyhimaa, 'an 'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an mut'aai alnnisaa'i yawma khaybara wa'an luhuwmi alhumuri aliinsiyyaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Abi Talib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade on the Day of Khaibar temporary marriage (Muta') with women and the eating of the flesh of domestic asses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَعَنْ أَكْلِ، لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الإِنْسِيَّةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin wazuhayru bnu harbin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythi yuwnusa wa'an aakli, luhuwmi alhumuri aliinsiyyaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri through a different chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا إِدْرِيسَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا ثَعْلَبَةَ قَالَ حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لُحُومَ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'aliyyi alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, kilaahumaa 'an ya'quwba bni iibraahiyma, bni sa'din haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna aabaa iidriysa, aakhbarahu aanna aabaa tha'labaaa qaala harrama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm luhuwma alhumuri alaahliyyaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Tha'laba reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited (the eating) of the flesh of domestic asses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، وَسَالِمٌ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, haddathaniy naafi'un, wasaalimun 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an aakli luhuwmi alhumuri alaahliyyaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) forbade the eating of the flesh of domestic asses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَمَعْنُ بْنُ عِيسَى، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ الْحِمَارِ الأَهْلِيِّ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ وَكَانَ النَّاسُ احْتَاجُوا إِلَيْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, qaala qaala abnu 'umara h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa aabiy wama'nu bnu 'iysaa, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aakli alhimaari alaahliyyi yawma khaybara wakaana alnnaasu ahtaajuwa iilayhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the eating of the (flesh) of domestic asses on the Day of Khaibar in spite of the fact that people needed that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ، فَقَالَ أَصَابَتْنَا مَجَاعَةٌ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ وَنَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَدْ أَصَبْنَا لِلْقَوْمِ حُمُرًا خَارِجَةً مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَنَحَرْنَاهَا فَإِنَّ قُدُورَنَا لَتَغْلِي إِذْ نَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ اكْفَئُوا الْقُدُورَ وَلاَ تَطْعَمُوا مِنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ شَيْئًا فَقُلْتُ حَرَّمَهَا تَحْرِيمَ مَاذَا قَالَ تَحَدَّثْنَا بَيْنَنَا فَقُلْنَا حَرَّمَهَا أَلْبَتَّةَ وَحَرَّمَهَا مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهَا لَمْ تُخَمَّسْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, qaala saaaltu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa 'an luhuwmi alhumuri alaahliyyaai, faqaala aasaabatnaa majaa'aaun yawma khaybara wanahnu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqad aasabnaa lilqawmi humurana khaarijaaan mina almadiynaai fanaharnaahaa faiinna quduwranaa lataghliy iidh naadaa munaadiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aani akfaiuwa alquduwra walaa tat'amuwa min luhuwmi alhumuri shayiana faqultu harramahaa tahriyma maadhaa qaala tahaddathnaa baynanaa faqulnaa harramahaa aalbattaaa waharramahaa min aajli aannahaa lam tukhammas ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shaibani reported:I asked 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa about (the lawfulness or unlawfulness of) the flesh of the domestic asses. He said: We experienced hunger on the Day of Khaibar as we were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). We found domestic asses in the exterior of Medina. We slaughtered them and our earthen pots were boiling when the announcer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned upside down and nothing of the flesh of the domestic asses should be eaten. I said: What kind of prohibition is it that he (the Holy Prophet) has made? He said: We discussed it amongst -ourselves. Some of us aaid that it has been declared unlawful for ever, (whereas others said) it has been declared unlawful since one-fifth (of the booty) has not been given (to the treasury, as is legally required)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يَقُولُ أَصَابَتْنَا مَجَاعَةٌ لَيَالِيَ خَيْبَرَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ خَيْبَرَ وَقَعْنَا فِي الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ فَانْتَحَرْنَاهَا فَلَمَّا غَلَتْ بِهَا الْقُدُورُ نَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ اكْفَئُوا الْقُدُورَ وَلاَ تَأْكُلُوا مِنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ شَيْئًا - قَالَ - فَقَالَ نَاسٌ إِنَّمَا نَهَى عَنْهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَنَّهَا لَمْ تُخَمَّسْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ آخَرُونَ نَهَى عَنْهَا أَلْبَتَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin - haddathanaa sulaymaanu alshhaybaaniyyu, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa, yaquwlu aasaabatnaa majaa'aaun layaaliya khaybara falammaa kaana yawmu khaybara waqa'naa fiy alhumuri alaahliyyaai faantaharnaahaa falammaa ghalat bihaa alquduwru naadaa munaadiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aani akfaiuwa alquduwra walaa taakuluwa min luhuwmi alhumuri shayiana - qaala - faqaala naasun iinnamaa nahaa 'anhaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laannahaa lam tukhammas ‏.‏ waqaala akharuwna nahaa 'anhaa aalbattaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sulaiman Shaibini reported:I heard Abdullah b. Abu Aufa say: We were smitten with hunger during the nights of Khaibar. On the Day of Khaibar, we fell upon domestic asses and we slaughtered them, and when our earthen pots boiled with them, the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made an annoancement that the earthen pots should be turned over, and nothing should be eaten of the flesh of the domestic asses. Some of the people said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden (the use of this flesh) for one-fifth (due to the State) has not been paid, while others said: He prohibited it for ever
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَابِتٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، وَعَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي أَوْفَى، يَقُولاَنِ أَصَبْنَا حُمُرًا فَطَبَخْنَاهَا فَنَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اكْفَئُوا الْقُدُورَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyin, - wahuwa abnu thaabitin - qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, wa'abda alllahi bna aabiy aawfaa, yaquwlaani aasabnaa humurana fatabakhnaahaa fanaadaa munaadiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm akfaiuwa alquduwra ‏.‏
verses.translation: Adi (he was the son of Thabit) said:I heard al-Bara' and 'Abdullah b. Abu Aufa say: We found domestic asses and we cooked them. Then the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned over
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ قَالَ الْبَرَاءُ أَصَبْنَا يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ حُمُرًا فَنَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِ اكْفَئُوا الْقُدُورَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala qaala albaraa'u aasabnaa yawma khaybara humurana fanaadaa munaadiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aani akfaiuwa alquduwra ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' said:We found on the Day of Khaibar domestic asses, and the announcer of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) made an announcement that the earthen pots should be turned over
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتِ بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يَقُولُ نُهِينَا عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala aabuw kuraybin haddathanaa abnu bishrin, 'an mis'arin, 'an thaabiti bni 'ubaydin, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yaquwlu nuhiynaa 'an luhuwmi alhumuri alaahliyyaai, ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bara was heard saying:We were forbidden (to eat) the flesh of the domestic asses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نُلْقِيَ لُحُومَ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ نِيئَةً وَنَضِيجَةً ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْمُرْنَا بِأَكْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'aasimin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, qaala aamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nulqiya luhuwma alhumuri alaahliyyaai niyiaaan wanadiyjaaan thumma lam yaamurnaa biaaklihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Bara' b. 'Azib reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to throw away the flesh of domestic asses whether uncooked or cooked; he then never commanded us to eat that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ غِيَاثٍ - عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa hafsun, - ya'niy abna ghiyaathin - 'an 'aasimin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي إِنَّمَا نَهَى عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَجْلِ أَنَّهُ كَانَ حَمُولَةَ النَّاسِ فَكَرِهَ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ حَمُولَتُهُمْ أَوْ حَرَّمَهُ فِي يَوْمِ خَيْبَرَ لُحُومَ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ ‏.‏
