verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu yuwsufa alaazdiyyu, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an 'aasimin, 'an 'aamirin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala laa aadriy iinnamaa nahaa 'anhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aajli aannahu kaana hamuwlaaa alnnaasi fakariha aan tadhhaba hamuwlatuhum aaw harramahu fiy yawmi khaybara luhuwma alhumuri alaahliyyaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:I do not know whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited (the eating of the domestic ass) due to the fact that they were the beasts of burden for the people, so he (the Holy Prophet) did not like their beasts of burden to be destroyed (as a matter of expediency), or he prohibited the use of the flesh of domestic asses (not as an expediency but as a law of the Shari'ah) on the Day of Khaibar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى خَيْبَرَ ثُمَّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ فَتَحَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ فَلَمَّا أَمْسَى النَّاسُ الْيَوْمَ الَّذِي فُتِحَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ أَوْقَدُوا نِيرَانًا كَثِيرَةً فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا هَذِهِ النِّيرَانُ عَلَى أَىِّ شَىْءٍ تُوقِدُونَ ‏"‏ قَالُوا عَلَى لَحْمٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَى أَىِّ لَحْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا عَلَى لَحْمِ حُمُرٍ إِنْسِيَّةٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَهْرِيقُوهَا وَاكْسِرُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوْ نُهَرِيقُهَا وَنَغْسِلُهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْ ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa haatimun, - wahuwa abnu iismaa'iyla - 'an yaziyda bni aabiy 'ubaydin, 'an salamaaa bni alaakwa'i, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa khaybara thumma iinna alllaha fatahahaa 'alayhim falammaa aamsaa alnnaasu alyawma alladhiy futihat 'alayhim aawqaduwa niyraanana kathiyraaan faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa hadhihi alnniyraanu 'alaa aaaai shaa'in tuwqiduwna ‏"‏ qaaluwa 'alaa lahmin ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ 'alaa aaaai lahmin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa 'alaa lahmi humurin iinsiyyaain ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aahriyquwhaa waaksiruwhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi aaw nuhariyquhaa wanaghsiluhaa qaala ‏"‏ aaw dhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salama b. Akwa' reported:We went to Khaibar with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Then Allah granted (us) victory over them. On that very evening of the day when they had been granted victory, they lit many fires. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What are those fires and what for those have been lit? They said: (These have been lit) for (cooking) the flesh. Thereupon he said: Of what flesh? They said: For the flesh of the domestic asses. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace bo upon him) said: Throw that away and break them (the earthen pots in which the fiesa was being cooked). A person said: Messenger of Allah, should we throw it away and wash them (the cooking pots)? He said: You may do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، وَصَفْوَانُ بْنُ عِيسَى، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ النَّبِيلُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu mas'adaaa, wasafwaanu bnu 'iysaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu alnnadri, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin alnnabiylu, kulluhum 'an yaziyda bni aabiy 'ubaydin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Yazid b. Abu Ubaid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا فَتَحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيْبَرَ أَصَبْنَا حُمُرًا خَارِجًا مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ فَطَبَخْنَا مِنْهَا فَنَادَى مُنَادِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَلاَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَنْهَيَانِكُمْ عَنْهَا فَإِنَّهَا رِجْسٌ مِنْ عَمَلِ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏.‏ فَأُكْفِئَتِ الْقُدُورُ بِمَا فِيهَا وَإِنَّهَا لَتَفُورُ بِمَا فِيهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasin, qaala lammaa fataha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khaybara aasabnaa humurana khaarijana mina alqaryaai fatabakhnaa minhaa fanaadaa munaadiy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aalaa iinna alllaha warasuwlahu yanhayaanikum 'anhaa faiinnahaa rijsun min 'amali alshhaytaani ‏.‏ faaukfiiati alquduwru bimaa fiyhaa waiinnahaa latafuwru bimaa fiyhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) conquered Khaibar, we caught hold of the asses outside the village. We cooked them (their flesh). Then the announcer of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made the announcement: Listen, verily Allah and His Messenger have prohibited you (the eating of) their (flesh), for it is a loathsome evil of Satan's doing. Then the earthen pots were turned over along with what was in them, and these were brimming (with flesh) at that time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ خَيْبَرَ جَاءَ جَاءٍ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُكِلَتِ الْحُمُرُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَ آخَرُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُفْنِيَتِ الْحُمُرُ فَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَنَادَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَنْهَيَانِكُمْ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ فَإِنَّهَا رِجْسٌ أَوْ نَجِسٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأُكْفِئَتِ الْقُدُورُ بِمَا فِيهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu minhaalin alddariyru, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala lammaa kaana yawmu khaybara jaa'a jaa'in faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aukilati alhumuru ‏.‏ thumma jaa'a akharu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aufniyati alhumuru faaamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabaa talhaaa fanaadaa iinna alllaha warasuwlahu yanhayaanikum 'an luhuwmi alhumuri faiinnahaa rijsun aaw najisun ‏.‏ qaala faaukfiiati alquduwru bimaa fiyhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:When it was the Day of Khaibar a visitor came and said: Messenger of Allah, the asses have been eaten. Then another came and said: Messenger of Allah, the asses are being destroyed. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded Abu Talha to make an announcement that Allah and His Messenger have prohibited you (from eating) of the flesh of (domestic) asses, for these are loathsome or impure. He (the narrator) said: The earthein pots were turned over along with what was in them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الأَهْلِيَّةِ وَأَذِنَ فِي لُحُومِ الْخَيْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an muhammadi, bni 'aliyyin 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa yawma khaybara 'an luhuwmi alhumuri alaahliyyaai waaadhina fiy luhuwmi alkhayli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited eating of the flesh of domestic asses on the Day of Khaibar, and permitted the cooking of the flesh of horses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أَكَلْنَا زَمَنَ خَيْبَرَ الْخَيْلَ وَحُمُرَ الْوَحْشِ وَنَهَانَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْحِمَارِ الأَهْلِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu aakalnaa zamana khaybara alkhayla wahumura alwahshi wanahaanaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alhimaari alaahliyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah is reported to have said:We ate during the time of Khaibar the (flesh) of horses and of wild asses, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us (to eat) the flesh of domestic asses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ، عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, h wahaddathaniy ya'quwbu alddawraqiyyu, waaahmadu bnu, 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, kilaahumaa 'ani abni jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has hen transmitted on the authority of Ibn Juraij
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَحَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، قَالَتْ نَحَرْنَا فَرَسًا عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَكَلْنَاهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy wahafsu bnu ghiyaathin, wawakiy'un, 'an hishaamin, 'an faatimaaa, 'an aasmaa'a, qaalat naharnaa farasana 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakalnaahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asma' reported:We slaughtered a horse and ate it during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa kilaahumaa 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Hisham
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الضَّبِّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَسْتُ بِآكِلِهِ وَلاَ مُحَرِّمِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin 'an iismaa'iyla, qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa iismaa'iylu bnu ja'farin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, aannahu sami'a abna 'umara, yaquwlu suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alddabbi faqaala ‏ "‏ lastu biakilihi walaa muharrimihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the eating of (the flesh) of the lizard, whereupon he said: I am neither the eater of it nor its prohibitor
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَكْلِ الضَّبِّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ آكُلُهُ وَلاَ أُحَرِّمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala saaala rajulun rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aakli alddabbi faqaala ‏ "‏ laa akuluhu walaa auharrimuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:A person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the eating of the lizard, whereupon he said. I neither eat it, nor do I prohibit it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ عَنْ أَكْلِ الضَّبِّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ آكُلُهُ وَلاَ أُحَرِّمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala saaala rajulun rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa 'alaa alminbari 'an aakli alddabbi faqaala ‏ "‏ laa akuluhu walaa auharrimuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that a person asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was sitting on the pulpit about the eating of the lizard, whereupon he said:I neither eat it, nor do I prohibit it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِمِثْلِهِ فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa yahyaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, bimithlihi fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ مِغْوَلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا شُجَاعُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُوسَى بْنَ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، الأَيْلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الضَّبِّ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ أَيُّوبَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِضَبٍّ فَلَمْ يَأْكُلْهُ وَلَمْ يُحَرِّمْهُ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أُسَامَةَ قَالَ قَامَ رَجُلٌ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw alrrabiy'i, waqutaybaau, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa maaliku bnu mighwalin, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi, alllahi haddathanaa shujaa'u bnu alwaliydi, qaala sami'tu muwsaa bna 'uqbaaa, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin, alaayliyyu haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy ausaamaau, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alddabbi bima'naa hadiythi alllaythi 'an naafi'in ghayra aanna hadiytha aayyuwba autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidabbin falam yaakulhu walam yuharrimhu wafiy hadiythi ausaamaaa qaala qaama rajulun fiy almasjidi warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith pertaining to the eating of the lizard is transmitted from the Prophet (ﷺ) on the authority of Ibn 'Umar, but in this very hadith narrated through a different chain of transmitters there is a slight variation of wording (and the words are):" A lizard was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) but he neither ate that nor declared it unlawful." And in the hadith transmitted through Usama (the words are):" The man (inquirer) was standing in the mosque and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting on the pulpit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ تَوْبَةَ الْعَنْبَرِيِّ، سَمِعَ الشَّعْبِيَّ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ مَعَهُ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِيهِمْ سَعْدٌ وَأُتُوا بِلَحْمِ ضَبٍّ فَنَادَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ نِسَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّهُ لَحْمُ ضَبٍّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كُلُوا فَإِنَّهُ حَلاَلٌ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ طَعَامِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an tawbaaa al'anbariyyi, sami'a alshha'biyya, sami'a abna 'umara, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana ma'ahu naasun min aashaabihi fiyhim sa'dun waautuwa bilahmi dabbin fanaadati amraaaaun min nisaa'i alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinnahu lahmu dabbin faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kuluwa faiinnahu halaalun walakinnahu laysa min ta'aamiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that there were some persons with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) from among his Companions, Sa'd being one of them. There was brought to them the flesh of the lizard when a lady amongst the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:It is the flesh of the lizard. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said: Eat, for it is lawful, but it is not my diet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ تَوْبَةَ الْعَنْبَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي الشَّعْبِيُّ أَرَأَيْتَ حَدِيثَ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَاعَدْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ قَرِيبًا مِنْ سَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ سَنَةٍ وَنِصْفٍ فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ رَوَى عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرَ هَذَا قَالَ كَانَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِمْ سَعْدٌ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an tawbaaa al'anbariyyi, qaala qaala liy alshha'biyyu aaraaayta hadiytha alhasani 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaa'adtu abna 'umara qariybana min sanatayni aaw sanaain wanisfin falam aasma'hu rawaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayra hadhaa qaala kaana naasun min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhim sa'dun bimithli hadiythi mu'aadhin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Taubat Al-'Anbari reported:Al-Sha'bi (one of the narrators) asked me if I had heard the hadith transmitted on the authority of Hasan from the Prophet (ﷺ). He said: I sat in the company if Ibn 'Umar for two years or a year and a half but I did not hear narrated from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) but this one (pertaining to the flesh of the lizard) as narrated by Mu'adh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْتَ مَيْمُونَةَ فَأُتِيَ بِضَبٍّ مَحْنُوذٍ فَأَهْوَى إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ النِّسْوَةِ اللاَّتِي فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ أَخْبِرُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ فَقُلْتُ أَحَرَامٌ هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ خَالِدٌ فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْظُرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy aumaamaaa, bni sahli bni hunayfin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, qaala dakhaltu aanaa wakhaalidu bnu alwaliydi, ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayta maymuwnaaa faautiya bidabbin mahnuwdhin faaahwaa iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi faqaala ba'du alnniswaai allaaatiy fiy bayti maymuwnaaa aakhbiruwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimaa yuriydu aan yaakula ‏.‏ farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu faqultu aaharaamun huwa yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏ "‏ laa walakinnahu lam yakun biaardi qawmiy faaajiduniy aa'aafuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala khaalidun faajtarartuhu faaakaltuhu warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanzuru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported:I and Khalid b. Walid went to the apartment of Maimuna along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and there was presented to him a roasted lizard. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stretched his hand towards It, whereupon some of the women who had been in the house of Maimuna said: Inform Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) what he intends to eat. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lifted his hand. I said: Messenger of Allah, Is it forbidden? He said: No. It is not found in the land of my people, and I feel that I have no liking for it. Khalid said: I then chewed and ate it, while, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was looking (at me)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ سَيْفُ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ خَالَتُهُ وَخَالَةُ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا ضَبًّا مَحْنُوذًا قَدِمَتْ بِهِ أُخْتُهَا حُفَيْدَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ مِنْ نَجْدٍ فَقَدَّمَتِ الضَّبَّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ قَلَّمَا يُقَدَّمُ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ حَتَّى يُحَدَّثَ بِهِ وَيُسَمَّى لَهُ فَأَهْوَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ إِلَى الضَّبِّ فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ النِّسْوَةِ الْحُضُورِ أَخْبِرْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَا قَدَّمْتُنَّ لَهُ ‏.‏ قُلْنَ هُوَ الضَّبُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ فَقَالَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ أَحَرَامٌ الضَّبُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ خَالِدٌ فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْظُرُ فَلَمْ يَنْهَنِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, jamiy'ana 'ani abni wahbin, qaala harmalaau aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy aumaamaaa bni sahli bni hunayfin alaansaariyyi, aanna 'abda alllahi, bna 'abbaasin aakhbarahu aanna khaalida bna alwaliydi alladhiy yuqaalu lahu sayfu alllahi aakhbarahu aannahu, dakhala ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa maymuwnaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya khaalatuhu wakhaalaau abni 'abbaasin fawajada 'indahaa dabbana mahnuwdhana qadimat bihi aukhtuhaa hufaydaau bintu alhaarithi min najdin faqaddamati alddabba lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana qallamaa yuqaddamu iilayhi ta'aamun hattaa yuhaddatha bihi wayusammaa lahu faaahwaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu iilaa alddabbi faqaalati amraaaaun mina alnniswaai alhuduwri aakhbirna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimaa qaddamtunna lahu ‏.‏ qulna huwa alddabbu yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ farafa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu faqaala khaalidu bnu alwaliydi aaharaamun alddabbu yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏ "‏ laa walakinnahu lam yakun biaardi qawmiy faaajiduniy aa'aafuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala khaalidun faajtarartuhu faaakaltuhu warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanzuru falam yanhaniy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported that Khalid b. Walid who is called the Sword of Allah had informed him that he visited Maimuna, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and she was the sister of his mother (that of Khalid) and that of 'Ibn Abbas, and he found with her a roasted lizard which her sister Hufaida the daughter of al-Harith had brought from Najd, and she presented that lizard to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). It was rare that some food was presented to the Prophet (ﷺ) and it was not mentioned or named. While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was about to stretch forth his hand towards the lizard, a woman from amongst the women present there informed the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) what they had presented to him. They said:Messenger of Allah, it is a lizard. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) withdrew his hand, whereupon Khalid b. Walid said: Messenger of Allah, is a lizard forbidden? There opon he said: No, but it is not found in the land of my people, and I feel that I have no liking for it. Khalid said: I then chewed and ate it, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was looking at me and he did not forbid (me to eat it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ فَقُدِّمَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَحْمُ ضَبٍّ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أُمُّ حُفَيْدٍ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ مِنْ نَجْدٍ وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي جَعْفَرٍ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَأْكُلُ شَيْئًا حَتَّى يَعْلَمَ مَا هُوَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَزَادَ فِي آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ وَحَدَّثَهُ ابْنُ الأَصَمِّ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ وَكَانَ فِي حَجْرِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu alnnadri, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaraniy waqaala aabuw bakrin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy, aumaamaaa bni sahlin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aannahu aakhbarahu aanna khaalida bna alwaliydi aakhbarahu aannahu, dakhala ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa maymuwnaaa binti alhaarithi wahaa khaalatuhu faquddima iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lahmu dabbin jaa'at bihi aummu hufaydin bintu alhaarithi min najdin wakaanat tahta rajulin min baniy ja'farin wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yaakulu shayiana hattaa ya'lama maa huwa ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa wazaada fiy akhiri alhadiythi wahaddathahu abnu alaasammi 'an maymuwnaaa wakaana fiy hajrihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Khalid b. Walid reported that he visited Maimuna daughter of al-Harith with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and she was the sister of his mother. She presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the flesh of a lizard which Umm Hufaid daughter of al-Harith had brought from Najd, and she had been married to a person belonging to Banu Ja'far. It was the habit of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not to eat anything until he knew what that was. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this (addition):" Ibn al-Asamm narrated it from Maimuna and he was under her care
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ بِضَبَّيْنِ مَشْوِيَّيْنِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ يَزِيدَ بْنَ الأَصَمِّ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy, aumaamaaa bni sahli bni hunayfin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala autiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wanahnu fiy bayti maymuwnaaa bidabbayni mashwiyyayni ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihim walam yadhkur yaziyda bna alaasammi 'an maymuwnaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:While we were in the house of Maimuna there were brought to Allah's Messenger two roasted lizards. Here no mention is made of al- 'Asamm narrating from Maimuna
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ، يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، أَنَّ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ بْنَ سَهْلٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ وَعِنْدَهُ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بِلَحْمِ ضَبٍّ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy khaalidu bnu, yaziyda haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy hilaalin, 'ani abni almunkadiri, aanna aabaa aumaamaaa bna sahlin, aakhbarahu 'ani abni, 'abbaasin qaala autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy bayti maymuwnaaa wa'indahu khaalidu bnu alwaliydi bilahmi dabbin ‏.‏ fadhakara bima'naa hadiythi alzzuhriyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that there had been brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the flesh of a lizard and Khalid b. Walid was also present there. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ ابْنُ نَافِعٍ أَخْبَرَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ أَهْدَتْ خَالَتِي أُمُّ حُفَيْدٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمْنًا وَأَقِطًا وَأَضُبًّا فَأَكَلَ مِنَ السَّمْنِ وَالأَقِطِ وَتَرَكَ الضَّبَّ تَقَذُّرًا وَأُكِلَ عَلَى مَائِدَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَوْ كَانَ حَرَامًا مَا أُكِلَ عَلَى مَائِدَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in qaala abnu naafi'in aakhbaranaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu aahdat khaalatiy aummu hufaydin iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm samnana waaaqitana waaadubbana faaakala mina alssamni waalaaqiti wataraka alddabba taqadhhurana waaukila 'alaa maaiidaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaw kaana haraamana maa aukila 'alaa maaiidaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that he heard Ibn 'Abbas says:The sister of my mother Umm Hufaid presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) clarified butter (ghee), cheese and some lizards. He ate out of the clarified butter and cheese, but left the lizard finding no liking for it. But it was eaten on the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Had it been forbidden (haram), it could not be eaten on the table of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ، الأَصَمِّ قَالَ دَعَانَا عَرُوسٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْنَا ثَلاَثَةَ عَشَرَ ضَبًّا فَآكِلٌ وَتَارِكٌ فَلَقِيتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ مِنَ الْغَدِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَأَكْثَرَ الْقَوْمُ حَوْلَهُ حَتَّى قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ آكُلُهُ وَلاَ أَنْهَى عَنْهُ وَلاَ أُحَرِّمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِئْسَ مَا قُلْتُمْ مَا بُعِثَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ مُحِلاًّ وَمُحَرِّمًا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَمَا هُوَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ وَعِنْدَهُ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ وَامْرَأَةٌ أُخْرَى إِذْ قُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِمْ خِوَانٌ عَلَيْهِ لَحْمٌ فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَأْكُلَ قَالَتْ لَهُ مَيْمُونَةُ إِنَّهُ لَحْمُ ضَبٍّ ‏.‏ فَكَفَّ يَدَهُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا لَحْمٌ لَمْ آكُلْهُ قَطُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ كُلُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ الْفَضْلُ وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ وَالْمَرْأَةُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ لاَ آكُلُ مِنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ شَىْءٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an yaziyda bni, alaasammi qaala da'aanaa 'aruwsun bialmadiynaai faqarraba iilaynaa thalaathaaa 'ashara dabbana faakilun wataarikun falaqiytu abna 'abbaasin mina alghadi faaakhbartuhu faaakthara alqawmu hawlahu hattaa qaala ba'duhum qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa akuluhu walaa aanhaa 'anhu walaa auharrimuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'abbaasin biisa maa qultum maa bu'itha nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa muhilaaan wamuharrimana iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm baynamaa huwa 'inda maymuwnaaa wa'indahu alfadlu bnu 'abbaasin wakhaalidu bnu alwaliydi waamraaaaun aukhraa iidh qurriba iilayhim khiwaanun 'alayhi lahmun falammaa aaraada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yaakula qaalat lahu maymuwnaau iinnahu lahmu dabbin ‏.‏ fakaffa yadahu waqaala ‏"‏ hadhaa lahmun lam akulhu qattu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala lahum ‏"‏ kuluwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaakala minhu alfadlu wakhaalidu bnu alwaliydi waalmaraaau ‏.‏ waqaalat maymuwnaau laa akulu min shaa'in iilaaa shaa'un yaakulu minhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yazid b. al-Asamm reported:A newly wedded person of Medina invited us to a wedding feast, and he served us thirteen lizards. There were those who ate it and those who abandoned it. I met Ibn 'Abbas the next day, and informed him (about this) in the presence of many persons. Some of them said that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had observed: I neither eat it nor forbid (anyone) from eating it, nor declare it to be unlawful. Thereupon Ibn 'Abbas said: Sad it is what you say! Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has not been sent, but (to declare in clear words) the lawful and the unlawful (things). We were once with Allah's Messenger (may peace be. upon him) as he was with Maimuna, and there were with him al-Fadl b. 'Abbas, Khalid b. Walid and some women (also) when a tray of food containing flesh was presented to him. As Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was about to eat that, Maimuna said: It is the flesh of the lizard. He withdrew his hand saying: That is the flesh which I never eat; but he said to them (those who were present there): You may eat. Al-Fadl ate out of that, so did Khalid b Walid, and the women. Maimuna (however) said: I do not eat anything but that which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eats
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ، جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِضَبٍّ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ الَّتِي مُسِخَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, 'ani abni, jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidabbin faaabaa aan yaakula minhu waqaala ‏ "‏ laa aadriy la'allahu mina alquruwni allatiy musikhat ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Zubair reported that he heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah saying that there was presented to Allah's Messenger (the flesh) of the lizard, but he refused to eat that, saying:I do not know; perhaps it (lizard) might (be one of those natives of) the distant past whose (forms) had beer, distorted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ جَابِرًا عَنِ الضَّبِّ، فَقَالَ لاَ تَطْعَمُوهُ ‏.‏ وَقَذِرَهُ وَقَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يُحَرِّمْهُ ‏.‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَنْفَعُ بِهِ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ فَإِنَّمَا طَعَامُ عَامَّةِ الرِّعَاءِ مِنْهُ وَلَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي طَعِمْتُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, qaala saaaltu jaabirana 'ani alddabbi, faqaala laa tat'amuwhu ‏.‏ waqadhirahu waqaala qaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi iinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yuharrimhu ‏.‏ iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla yanfa'u bihi ghayra waahidin faiinnamaa ta'aamu 'aammaai alrri'aa'i minhu walaw kaana 'indiy ta'imtuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: (Abu Zubair reported:I asked Jabir about ithe eating) of the lizard, whereupon he said: Don't eat that as he (the Holy Prophet) felt disgust. He (the narrator) said that Umar b. al-Khattab reminded: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not declare it to be unlawful. Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, has (made it a source) of benefit for more than one (persons). It is a common diet of the shepherds. Had it been with me, I would have eaten that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا بِأَرْضٍ مَضَبَّةٍ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنَا أَوْ فَمَا تُفْتِينَا قَالَ ‏ "‏ ذُكِرَ لِي أَنَّ أُمَّةً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مُسِخَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَأْمُرْ وَلَمْ يَنْهَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لَيَنْفَعُ بِهِ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ وَإِنَّهُ لَطَعَامُ عَامَّةِ هَذِهِ الرِّعَاءِ وَلَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي لَطَعِمْتُهُ إِنَّمَا عَافَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an daawuda, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa biaardin madabbaain famaa taamurunaa aaw famaa tuftiynaa qaala ‏ "‏ dhukira liy aanna aummaaan min baniy iisraaiiyla musikhat ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falam yaamur walam yanha ‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin falammaa kaana ba'da dhalika qaala 'umaru iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla layanfa'u bihi ghayra waahidin waiinnahu lata'aamu 'aammaai hadhihi alrri'aa'i walaw kaana 'indiy lata'imtuhu iinnamaa 'aafahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that a person said:Messenger of Allah, we live in a land abounding in lizards, so what do you command or what verdict you give (about eating of it)? Thereupon he said: It was mentioned to me that a people from among Bani Isra'il were distorted (so there is a likelihood that those people might have been distorted in the shape of lizards). So he neither commanded (us to eat that) nor forbade (us). Abu Sa'id said: After some time Umar said: Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, has made it (a source of) benefit for more than one (person), for it is the common diet of shepherds. Had it been with me, I would have eaten that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) disliked it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي فِي غَائِطٍ مَضَبَّةٍ وَإِنَّهُ عَامَّةُ طَعَامِ أَهْلِي - قَالَ - فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ فَقُلْنَا عَاوِدْهُ ‏.‏ فَعَاوَدَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ نَادَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الثَّالِثَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أَعْرَابِيُّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ أَوْ غَضِبَ عَلَى سِبْطٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَمَسَخَهُمْ دَوَابَّ يَدِبُّونَ فِي الأَرْضِ فَلاَ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّ هَذَا مِنْهَا فَلَسْتُ آكُلُهَا وَلاَ أَنْهَى عَنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa aabuw 'aqiylin alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aanna aa'raabiyyana, aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinniy fiy ghaaiitin madabbaain waiinnahu 'aammaau ta'aami aahliy - qaala - falam yujibhu faqulnaa 'aawidhu ‏.‏ fa'aawadahu falam yujibhu thalaathana thumma naadaahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy althhaalithaai faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa aa'raabiyyu iinna alllaha la'ana aaw ghadiba 'alaa sibtin min baniy iisraaiiyla famasakhahum dawaabba yadibbuwna fiy alaardi falaa aadriy la'alla hadhaa minhaa falastu akuluhaa walaa aanhaa 'anhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that an Arab of the desert came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:I live in a low land abounding in lizards, and these are the common diet of my family, but he (the Holy Prophet) did not make any reply. We said to him: Repeat it (your problem) and so he repeated it, but he did not make any reply. (It was repeated thrice ) Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called him out at the third time saying: O man of the desert, verily Allah cursed or showed wrath to a tribe of Bani Isra'il and distorted them to beasts which move on the earth. I do not know, perhaps this (lizard) may be one of them. So I do not eat it, nor do I prohibit the eating of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، أَبِي أَوْفَى قَالَ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ نَأْكُلُ الْجَرَادَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy ya'fuwrin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, aabiy aawfaa qaala ghazawnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sab'a ghazawaatin naakulu aljaraada ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abu Aufa reported:We went on seven expeditions with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and ate locusts
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ وَقَالَ إِسْحَاقُ سِتَّ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ سِتَّ أَوْ سَبْعَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy ya'fuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ qaala aabuw bakrin fiy riwaayatihi sab'a ghazawaatin waqaala iishaaqu sitta waqaala abnu aabiy 'umara sitta aaw sab'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ya'fur with the same chain of transmitters. Abu Bakr (one of the narrators) said" seven expeditions," whereas Ishaq said" six," and Ibn Umar said" six" or" seven
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathanaa abnu bashhaarin, 'an muhammadi, bni ja'farin kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy ya'fuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala sab'a ghazawaatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Ya'fur with the same chain of transmitters, and he mentioned seven expeditions
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَرَرْنَا فَاسْتَنْفَجْنَا أَرْنَبًا بِمَرِّ الظَّهْرَانِ فَسَعَوْا عَلَيْهِ فَلَغَبُوا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَعَيْتُ حَتَّى أَدْرَكْتُهَا فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَذَبَحَهَا فَبَعَثَ بِوَرِكِهَا وَفَخِذَيْهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَبِلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an hishaami bni zaydin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala mararnaa faastanfajnaa aarnabana bimarri alzzahraani fasa'awa 'alayhi falaghabuwa ‏.‏ qaala fasa'aytu hattaa aadraktuhaa faaataytu bihaa aabaa talhaaa fadhabahahaa faba'atha biwarikihaa wafakhidhayhaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaataytu bihaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqabilahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:We chased a hare at Marr az-Zahrin (a valley near Mecca). They (my companions) ran, but felt exhausted; I also tried until I caught hold of it. I brought it to Abu Talha. He slaughtered it and sent its haunch and two hind legs to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) through me; and he accepted them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بِوَرِكِهَا أَوْ فَخِذَيْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythi yahyaa biwarikihaa aaw fakhidhayhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Yahya with a slight change of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، قَالَ رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُغَفَّلِ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ لاَ تَخْذِفْ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَكْرَهُ - أَوْ قَالَ - يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يُصْطَادُ بِهِ الصَّيْدُ وَلاَ يُنْكَأُ بِهِ الْعَدُوُّ وَلَكِنَّهُ يَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَيَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَآهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أُخْبِرُكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَوْ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ ثُمَّ أَرَاكَ تَخْذِفُ لاَ أُكَلِّمُكَ كَلِمَةً كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa kahmasun, 'ani abni buraydaaa, qaala raaaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almughaffali rajulaan min aashaabihi yakhdhifu faqaala lahu laa takhdhif faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yakrahu - aaw qaala - yanhaa 'ani alkhadhfi faiinnahu laa yustaadu bihi alssaydu walaa yunkaau bihi al'aduwwu walakinnahu yaksiru alssinna wayafqaau al'ayna ‏.‏ thumma raahu ba'da dhalika yakhdhifu faqaala lahu aukhbiruka aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yakrahu aaw yanhaa 'ani alkhadhfi thumma aaraaka takhdhifu laa aukallimuka kalimaaan kadhaa wakadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Buraida reported that Abdullah b. al-Mughaffal saw a person from amongst his companions throwing small pebbles, whereupon he said:Don't throw pebbles. for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not like it, or he forbade flinging of pebbles since neither the game is taken thereby, nor an enemy defeated. but it may break a tooth or put out an eye. He, afterwards, again saw him flinging pebbles, and said to him: I inform you that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not approve or he forbade flinging of pebbles, but if I see you again flinging pebbles. I will not speak with you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو دَاوُدَ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا كَهْمَسٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw daawuda, sulaymaanu bnu ma'badin haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa kahmasun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Kahmas
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ صُهْبَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْخَذْفِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ وَقَالَ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَنْكَأُ الْعَدُوَّ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُ الصَّيْدَ وَلَكِنَّهُ يَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَيَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ إِنَّهَا لاَ تَنْكَأُ الْعَدُوَّ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ تَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'uqbaaa bni suhbaana, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mughaffalin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alkhadhfi ‏.‏ qaala abnu ja'farin fiy hadiythihi waqaala iinnahu laa yankaau al'aduwwa walaa yaqtulu alssayda walakinnahu yaksiru alssinna wayafqaau al'ayna ‏.‏ waqaala abnu mahdiyyin iinnahaa laa tankaau al'aduwwa ‏.‏ walam yadhkur tafqaau al'ayna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mughaffal reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited throwing of pebbles. Ibn Ja'far reported (in the narration transmitted by him) that he (the Holy Prophet) said:It neither inflicts defeat to the enemy nor kills the game but breaks the tooth and puts the eye out. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Mahdi with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ، بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ أَنَّ قَرِيبًا، لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ خَذَفَ - قَالَ - فَنَهَاهُ وَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهَا لاَ تَصِيدُ صَيْدًا وَلاَ تَنْكَأُ عَدُوًّا وَلَكِنَّهَا تَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَتَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعَادَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُحَدِّثُكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهُ ثُمَّ تَخْذِفُ لاَ أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an sa'iydi, bni jubayrin aanna qariybana, li'abdi alllahi bni mughaffalin khadhafa - qaala - fanahaahu waqaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alkhadhfi waqaala ‏ "‏ iinnahaa laa tasiydu saydana walaa tankaau 'aduwwana walakinnahaa taksiru alssinna watafqaau al'ayna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fa'aada ‏.‏ faqaala auhaddithuka aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'anhu thumma takhdhifu laa aukallimuka aabadana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that. a near one of 'Abdullah b. Mughaffal threw pebbles. He prohibited him (to do so). He said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had prohibited the throwing of pebbles by saying:It does not catch the game, nor does it inflict defeat on the enemy, but breaks the tooth and puts the eye out. He (the near one of Abdullah b. Mughadal) again repeated it (the act of throwing of pebbles) whereupon he said: I narrate to you that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon hish) disliked and prohibited throwing of pebbles, but I see you again throwing pebbles; I (would therefore) not speak with you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa althhaqafiyyu, 'an aayyuwba, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَشْعَثِ، عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، قَالَ ثِنْتَانِ حَفِظْتُهُمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَإِذَا قَتَلْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الْقِتْلَةَ وَإِذَا ذَبَحْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الذَّبْحَ وَلْيُحِدَّ أَحَدُكُمْ شَفْرَتَهُ فَلْيُرِحْ ذَبِيحَتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy alaash'athi, 'an shaddaadi bni aawsin, qaala thintaani hafiztuhumaa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha kataba aliihsaana 'alaa kulli shaa'in faiidhaa qataltum faaahsinuwa alqitlaaa waiidhaa dhabahtum faaahsinuwa aldhhabha walyuhidda aahadukum shafratahu falyurih dhabiyhatahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shaddid b. Aus said:Two are the things which I remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: Verily Allah has enjoined goodness to everything; so when you kill, kill in a good way and when you slaughter, slaughter in a good way. So every one of you should sharpen his knife, and let the slaughtered animal die comfortably
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، بِإِسْنَادِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa hushaymun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyu, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in, haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, kullu hauulaa'i 'an khaalidin alhadhhaa'i, biiisnaadi hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa wama'naa hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Khalid al-Hadhdha' through different chains o transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ، بْنَ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ مَعَ جَدِّي أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ دَارَ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ فَإِذَا قَوْمٌ قَدْ نَصَبُوا دَجَاجَةً يَرْمُونَهَا قَالَ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُصْبَرَ الْبَهَائِمُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu hishaama, bna zaydi bni aanasi bni maalikin qaala dakhaltu ma'a jaddiy aanasi bni maalikin daara alhakami bni aayyuwba faiidhaa qawmun qad nasabuwa dajaajaaan yarmuwnahaa qaala faqaala aanasun nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan tusbara albahaaiimu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hishim b. Zaid b. Anas b. Milik reported:I visited the house of al-Hakam b. Ayyub along with my grandfather Anas b. Milik, (and there) some people had made a hen a target and were shooting arrows at her. Thereupon Asas said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden tying of the animals (and making them the targets of arrows, etc)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, h wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through other chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَتَّخِذُوا شَيْئًا فِيهِ الرُّوحُ غَرَضًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tattakhidhuwa shayiana fiyhi alrruwhu gharadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:Do not make anything having life as a target
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كَامِلٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ ابْنُ عُمَرَ بِنَفَرٍ قَدْ نَصَبُوا دَجَاجَةً يَتَرَامَوْنَهَا فَلَمَّا رَأَوُا ابْنَ عُمَرَ تَفَرَّقُوا عَنْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَعَنَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, waaabuw kaamilin - waalllafzu laabiy kaamilin - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala marra abnu 'umara binafarin qad nasabuwa dajaajaaan yataraamawnahaa falammaa raaawua abna 'umara tafarraquwa 'anhaa ‏.‏ faqaala abnu 'umara man fa'ala hadhaa iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm la'ana man fa'ala hadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Umar happened to pass by a party of men who had tied a hen and were shooting arrows at it. As soon as they saw Ibn 'Umar, they scattered from it. Thereupon Ibn Umar said:Who has done this? Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has invoked curse upon him who does this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ ابْنُ عُمَرَ بِفِتْيَانٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ قَدْ نَصَبُوا طَيْرًا وَهُمْ يَرْمُونَهُ وَقَدْ جَعَلُوا لِصَاحِبِ الطَّيْرِ كُلَّ خَاطِئَةٍ مِنْ نَبْلِهِمْ فَلَمَّا رَأَوُا ابْنَ عُمَرَ تَفَرَّقُوا فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا لَعَنَ اللَّهُ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَعَنَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ شَيْئًا فِيهِ الرُّوحُ غَرَضًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa aabuw bishrin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala marra abnu 'umara bifityaanin min qurayshin qad nasabuwa tayrana wahum yarmuwnahu waqad ja'aluwa lisaahibi alttayri kulla khaatiiaain min nablihim falammaa raaawua abna 'umara tafarraquwa faqaala abnu 'umara man fa'ala hadhaa la'ana alllahu man fa'ala hadhaa iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm la'ana mani attakhadha shayiana fiyhi alrruwhu gharadana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported that Ibn 'Umar happened to pass by some young men of the Quraish who had tied a bird (and th, is made it a target) at which they had been shooting arrows Every arrow that they missed came into the possession of the owner of the bird. So no sooner did they see Ibn 'Umar they went away. Thereupon Ibn 'Umar said:Who has done this? Allah has cursed him who does this. Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invoked curse upon one who made a live thing the target (of one's marksmanship)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 34 — The Book of Hunting, Slaughter, and what may be Eaten
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُقْتَلَ شَىْءٌ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ صَبْرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni jurayjin, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu, bnu humaydin aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuqtala shaa'un mina alddawaabbi sabrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade that any beast should be killed after it has been tied
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices

verses.chapterTitle: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى، بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنِي جُنْدَبُ بْنُ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ الأَضْحَى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يَعْدُ أَنْ صَلَّى وَفَرَغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ سَلَّمَ فَإِذَا هُوَ يَرَى لَحْمَ أَضَاحِيَّ قَدْ ذُبِحَتْ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَفْرُغَ مِنْ صَلاَتِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ ذَبَحَ أُضْحِيَّتَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ - أَوْ نُصَلِّيَ - فَلْيَذْبَحْ مَكَانَهَا أُخْرَى وَمَنْ كَانَ لَمْ يَذْبَحْ فَلْيَذْبَحْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa alaaswadu bnu qaysin, h wahaddathanaahu yahyaa, bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'ani alaaswadi bni qaysin, haddathaniy jundabu bnu sufyaana, qaala shahidtu alaadhaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam ya'du aan sallaa wafaragha min salaatihi sallama faiidhaa huwa yaraa lahma aadaahiyya qad dhubihat qabla aan yafrugha min salaatihi faqaala ‏ "‏ man kaana dhabaha audhiyyatahu qabla aan yusalliya - aaw nusalliya - falyadhbah makaanahaa aukhraa waman kaana lam yadhbah falyadhbah biasmi alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jundab b. Sufyan reported:I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the day of 'Id al-Adha. While he had not returned after having offered (the Id prayer) and finished it, he saw the flesh of the sacrificial animals which had been slaughtered before he had completed the prayer. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: One who slaughtered his sacrificial animal before his prayer or our prayer ('Id), he should slaughter another one in its stead, and he who did not slaughter, he should slaughter by reciting the name of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، سَلاَّمُ بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، بْنِ قَيْسٍ عَنْ جُنْدَبِ بْنِ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ الأَضْحَى مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلاَتَهُ بِالنَّاسِ نَظَرَ إِلَى غَنَمٍ قَدْ ذُبِحَتْ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَلْيَذْبَحْ شَاةً مَكَانَهَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ ذَبَحَ فَلْيَذْبَحْ عَلَى اسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, salaaamu bnu sulaymin 'ani alaaswadi, bni qaysin 'an jundabi bni sufyaana, qaala shahidtu alaadhaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa qadaa salaatahu bialnnaasi nazara iilaa ghanamin qad dhubihat faqaala ‏ "‏ man dhabaha qabla alssalaaai falyadhbah shaaaan makaanahaa waman lam yakun dhabaha falyadhbah 'alaa asmi alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jundab b. Sufyan reported:I was with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (on the occasion) of 'Id al-Adha. After he had completed the prayer with people, he found that the goats had been slaughtered, whereupon he said: He who slaughtered sacrificial animal before the prayer should slaughter a goat (again) in its stead and he who has not slaughtered he should slaughter it by reciting the name of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ، أَبِي عُمَرَ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالاَ عَلَى اسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ كَحَدِيثِ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu, aabiy 'umara 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, kilaahumaa 'ani alaaswadi bni qaysin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaalaa 'alaa asmi alllahi ‏.‏ kahadiythi aabiy alaahwasi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of al-Aswad b. Qais with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، سَمِعَ جُنْدَبًا الْبَجَلِيَّ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى يَوْمَ أَضْحًى ثُمَّ خَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ فَلْيُعِدْ مَكَانَهَا وَمَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ ذَبَحَ فَلْيَذْبَحْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaaswadi, sami'a jundabana albajaliyya, qaala shahidtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa yawma aadhana thumma khataba faqaala ‏ "‏ man kaana dhabaha qabla aan yusalliya falyu'id makaanahaa waman lam yakun dhabaha falyadhbah biasmi alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jundab al-Bajali reported:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) observing ('Id) prayer on the Day of Sacrifice (10th of Dhu'l-Hijja) and then delivering a sermon and he said: He who sacrificed the (animal) before offering ('Id) prayer, he should offer again in its stead, and he who did not sacrifice the animal should slaughter it by reciting the name of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ ضَحَّى خَالِي أَبُو بُرْدَةَ قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تِلْكَ شَاةُ لَحْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ عِنْدِي جَذَعَةً مِنَ الْمَعْزِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ضَحِّ بِهَا وَلاَ تَصْلُحُ لِغَيْرِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ ضَحَّى قَبْلَ الصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّمَا ذَبَحَ لِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ ذَبَحَ بَعْدَ الصَّلاَةِ فَقَدْ تَمَّ نُسُكُهُ وَأَصَابَ سُنَّةَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an mutarrifin, 'an 'aamirin, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala dahhaa khaaliy aabuw burdaaa qabla alssalaaai faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tilka shaaau lahmin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna 'indiy jadha'aaan mina alma'zi faqaala ‏"‏ dahhi bihaa walaa tasluhu lighayrika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ man dahhaa qabla alssalaaai faiinnamaa dhabaha linafsihi waman dhabaha ba'da alssalaaai faqad tamma nusukuhu waaasaaba sunnaaa almuslimiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported:My maternal uncle Abu Burda sacrificed his animal before ('Id) prayer. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: That is a goat (slaughtered for the sake of) flesh (and not as a sacrifice on the day of Adha). He said: I have a lamb of six months. Thereupon he said: Offer it as a sacrifice, but it will not justify for anyone except you, and then said: He who sacrificed (the animal) before ('Id) prayer, he in fact slaughtered it for his own self, and he who slaughtered after prayer, his ritual of sacrifice became complete and he in fact observed the religious practice of the Muslims
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، أَنَّ خَالَهُ أَبَا بُرْدَةَ بْنَ نِيَارٍ، ذَبَحَ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَذْبَحَ النَّبِيُّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا يَوْمٌ اللَّحْمُ فِيهِ مَكْرُوهٌ وَإِنِّي عَجَّلْتُ نَسِيكَتِي لأُطْعِمَ أَهْلِي وَجِيرَانِي وَأَهْلَ دَارِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَعِدْ نُسُكًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ عِنْدِي عَنَاقَ لَبَنٍ هِيَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ شَاتَىْ لَحْمٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هِيَ خَيْرُ نَسِيكَتَيْكَ وَلاَ تَجْزِي جَذَعَةٌ عَنْ أَحَدٍ بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an daawuda, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, aanna khaalahu aabaa burdaaa bna niyaarin, dhabaha qabla aan yadhbaha alnnabiyyu, sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna hadhaa yawmun alllahmu fiyhi makruwhun waiinniy 'ajjaltu nasiykatiy laut'ima aahliy wajiyraaniy waaahla daariy ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aa'id nusukana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna 'indiy 'anaaqa labanin hiya khayrun min shaataa lahmin ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ hiya khayru nasiykatayka walaa tajziy jadha'aaun 'an aahadin ba'daka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that his maternal'uncle Abu Burda b. Niyar sacrificed his animal earlier than the Prophet (ﷺ) had sacrificed. Thereupon he said:Apostle of Allah, it is the day of meat and it is not desirable (to have longing for it and not to make use of it immediately), so I hastened in offering my animal as a sacrifice, so that I might feed my family and neighbours and my kith and kin. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Offer again your sacrifice. He said: Messenger of Allah, I have a small milch goat of less than one year, and that is better than two dry goats (from which only) meat (can be acquired). Thereupon he said: That is better than the two animals of sacrifice on your behalf, and the sacrifice of a goat, of less than six months shall not be accepted as a sacrifice on behalf of anyone after your (sacrifice)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، بْنِ عَازِبٍ قَالَ خَطَبَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ النَّحْرِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَذْبَحَنَّ أَحَدٌ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ خَالِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ هَذَا يَوْمٌ اللَّحْمُ فِيهِ مَكْرُوهٌ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ هُشَيْمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an daawuda, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani albaraa'i, bni 'aazibin qaala khatabanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma alnnahri faqaala ‏ "‏ laa yadhbahanna aahadun hattaa yusalliya ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala khaaliy yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna hadhaa yawmun alllahmu fiyhi makruwhun ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bima'naa hadiythi hushaymin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered an address on the day (of Nahr) in which he said: None of you should offer sacrifice of animals until he has completed the ('Id) prayer. Thereupon my maternal uncle said: Messenger of Allah, it is the day of meat, so it is not desirable (to keep my family in the state of longing). The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 35 — The Book of Sacrifices
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ صَلَّى صَلاَتَنَا وَوَجَّهَ قِبْلَتَنَا وَنَسَكَ نُسُكَنَا فَلاَ يَذْبَحْ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ خَالِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَدْ نَسَكْتُ عَنِ ابْنٍ لِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ شَىْءٌ عَجَّلْتَهُ لأَهْلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنَّ عِنْدِي شَاةً خَيْرٌ مِنْ شَاتَيْنِ قَالَ ‏"‏ ضَحِّ بِهَا فَإِنَّهَا خَيْرُ نَسِيكَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
