verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرِ بْنِ عُفَيْرٍ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ الْمِصْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنِ، بْنِ عَلِيٍّ أَنَّ حُسَيْنَ بْنَ عَلِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيًّا قَالَ كَانَتْ لِي شَارِفٌ مِنْ نَصِيبِي مِنَ الْمَغْنَمِ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَعْطَانِي شَارِفًا مِنَ الْخُمُسِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَلَمَّا أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبْتَنِيَ بِفَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَاعَدْتُ رَجُلاً صَوَّاغًا مِنْ بَنِي قَيْنُقَاعَ يَرْتَحِلُ مَعِيَ فَنَأْتِي بِإِذْخِرٍ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَبِيعَهُ مِنَ الصَّوَّاغِينَ فَأَسْتَعِينَ بِهِ فِي وَلِيمَةِ عُرْسِي فَبَيْنَا أَنَا أَجْمَعُ لِشَارِفَىَّ مَتَاعًا مِنَ الأَقْتَابِ وَالْغَرَائِرِ وَالْحِبَالِ وَشَارِفَاىَ مُنَاخَانِ إِلَى جَنْبِ حُجْرَةِ رَجُلٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وَجَمَعْتُ حِينَ جَمَعْتُ مَا جَمَعْتُ فَإِذَا شَارِفَاىَ قَدِ اجْتُبَّتْ أَسْنِمَتُهُمَا وَبُقِرَتْ خَوَاصِرُهُمَا وَأُخِذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا فَلَمْ أَمْلِكْ عَيْنَىَّ حِينَ رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ الْمَنْظَرَ مِنْهُمَا قُلْتُ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا قَالُوا فَعَلَهُ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ وَهُوَ فِي هَذَا الْبَيْتِ فِي شَرْبٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ غَنَّتْهُ قَيْنَةٌ وَأَصْحَابَهُ فَقَالَتْ فِي غِنَائِهَا أَلاَ يَا حَمْزَ لِلشُّرُفِ النِّوَاءِ فَقَامَ حَمْزَةُ بِالسَّيْفِ فَاجْتَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا فَأَخَذَ مِنْ أَكْبَادِهِمَا قَالَ عَلِيٌّ فَانْطَلَقْتُ حَتَّى أَدْخُلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ زَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ - قَالَ - فَعَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَجْهِيَ الَّذِي لَقِيتُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا لَكَ ‏"‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ قَطُّ عَدَا حَمْزَةُ عَلَى نَاقَتَىَّ فَاجْتَبَّ أَسْنِمَتَهُمَا وَبَقَرَ خَوَاصِرَهُمَا وَهَا هُوَ ذَا فِي بَيْتٍ مَعَهُ شَرْبٌ - قَالَ - فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِرِدَائِهِ فَارْتَدَاهُ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ يَمْشِي وَاتَّبَعْتُهُ أَنَا وَزَيْدُ بْنُ حَارِثَةَ حَتَّى جَاءَ الْبَابَ الَّذِي فِيهِ حَمْزَةُ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ فَأَذِنُوا لَهُ فَإِذَا هُمْ شَرْبٌ فَطَفِقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلُومُ حَمْزَةَ فِيمَا فَعَلَ فَإِذَا حَمْزَةُ مُحْمَرَّةٌ عَيْنَاهُ فَنَظَرَ حَمْزَةُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى سُرَّتِهِ ثُمَّ صَعَّدَ النَّظَرَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ حَمْزَةُ وَهَلْ أَنْتُمْ إِلاَّ عَبِيدٌ لأَبِي فَعَرَفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ ثَمِلٌ فَنَكَصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى عَقِبَيْهِ الْقَهْقَرَى وَخَرَجَ وَخَرَجْنَا مَعَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, aakhbaranaa sa'iydu bnu kathiyri bni 'ufayrin aabuw 'uthmaana almisriyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'aliyyu bnu husayni, bni 'aliyyin aanna husayna bna 'aliyyin, aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyyana qaala kaanat liy shaarifun min nasiybiy mina almaghnami yawma badrin wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aa'taaniy shaarifana mina alkhumusi yawmaiidhin falammaa aaradtu aan aabtaniya bifaatimaaa binti rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waa'adtu rajulaan sawwaaghana min baniy qaynuqaa'a yartahilu ma'iya fanaatiy biiidhkhirin aaradtu aan aabiy'ahu mina alssawwaaghiyna faaasta'iyna bihi fiy waliymaai 'ursiy fabaynaa aanaa aajma'u lishaarifaaaa mataa'ana mina alaaqtaabi waalgharaaiiri waalhibaali washaarifaaaa munaakhaani iilaa janbi hujraai rajulin mina alaansaari wajama'tu hiyna jama'tu maa jama'tu faiidhaa shaarifaaaa qadi ajtubbat aasnimatuhumaa wabuqirat khawaasiruhumaa waaukhidha min aakbaadihimaa falam aamlik 'aynaaaa hiyna raaaytu dhalika almanzara minhumaa qultu man fa'ala hadhaa qaaluwa fa'alahu hamzaau bnu 'abdi almuttalibi wahuwa fiy hadhaa albayti fiy sharbin mina alaansaari ghannathu qaynaaun waaashaabahu faqaalat fiy ghinaaiihaa aalaa yaa hamza lilshhurufi alnniwaa'i faqaama hamzaau bialssayfi faajtabba aasnimatahumaa wabaqara khawaasirahumaa faaakhadha min aakbaadihimaa qaala 'aliyyun faantalaqtu hattaa aadkhula 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indahu zaydu bnu haarithaaa - qaala - fa'arafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy wajhiya alladhiy laqiytu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa laka ‏"‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi waalllahi maa raaaytu kaalyawmi qattu 'adaa hamzaau 'alaa naaqataaaa faajtabba aasnimatahumaa wabaqara khawaasirahumaa wahaa huwa dhaa fiy baytin ma'ahu sharbun - qaala - fada'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biridaaiihi faartadaahu thumma antalaqa yamshiy waattaba'tuhu aanaa wazaydu bnu haarithaaa hattaa jaa'a albaaba alladhiy fiyhi hamzaau faastaadhana faaadhinuwa lahu faiidhaa hum sharbun fatafiqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaluwmu hamzaaa fiymaa fa'ala faiidhaa hamzaau muhmarraaun 'aynaahu fanazara hamzaau iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma sa''ada alnnazara iilaa rukbatayhi thumma sa''ada alnnazara fanazara iilaa surratihi thumma sa''ada alnnazara fanazara iilaa wajhihi faqaala hamzaau wahal aantum iilaaa 'abiydun laabiy fa'arafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu thamilun fanakasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa 'aqibayhi alqahqaraa wakharaja wakharajnaa ma'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Husain b. 'Ali reported 'Ali having said:There fell to my lot a she-camel out of the spoils of war on the Day of Badr, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me (another) she-camel on that day out of the Khums (one-fifth reserved for Allah and His Messenger). When I made up my mind to consummate my marriage with Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), I prevailed upon a goldsmith of the tribe of Qainuqa' to go along with me so that we might bring Idhkhir wishing to sell that to the goldsmiths and thus I should be able to arrange my wedding feast. While I was arranging the equipments. i. e. litters, sacks and ropes, my two she-camels were sitting down at the side of the apartment of a person of the Ansar. I collected (the different articles of equipment) and found to my surprise that their humps had been chopped off and their haunches had been cut off and their livers had been taken out. I could not help weeping when I saw that plight of theirs. I said: Who has done that? They said: Hamza b. 'Abd al-Muttalib has done this. and he is in this house dead drunk in the company of some of the Ansair with asinging girl singing before him and his companions. She said in her song: O Hamza. get up and attack these falty she-camels. Thereupon Hamza stood up with a sword (in his hand) and cut off their humps and ripped their haunches and tore out their livers. 'Ali said: I went away until I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there was with him Zaid b. Haritha. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recognised from my face what I had experienced, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What has happened to you? I said: Messenger of Allah, by Allah, I have never seen (such an unfortunate day) as this day. Hamza has committed aggression to my she-camels, and has cut off their humps. and ripped their haunches, and he is in a house in the company of some drunkards. (Hearing this) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent for his mantle and, putting it on him, he proceeded, and I and Zaid b. Haritha followed him, until he came to the door (of the house) in which there was Hamza. He (the Holy Prophet) sought permission which they granted him. and they were all drunk. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) began to reprimand Hamza for what he had done. Hamza's eyes were red. He cast a glance at Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then looked towards his knees. and then lifted his eyes and cast a glance at his waist and then lifted his eyes and saw his face. And then Hamza said: Are you anything but the slaves of my father? Alah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to know that he was intoxicated, and he thus turned upon his heels, and came out, and we also came out along with him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُهْزَاذَ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni quhzaadha, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'uthmaana, 'an 'abdi alllahi, bni almubaaraki 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith has been narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْعَتَكِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ سَاقِيَ الْقَوْمِ يَوْمَ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ فِي بَيْتِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ وَمَا شَرَابُهُمْ إِلاَّ الْفَضِيخُ الْبُسْرُ وَالتَّمْرُ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي فَقَالَ اخْرُجْ فَانْظُرْ فَخَرَجْتُ فَإِذَا مُنَادٍ يُنَادِي أَلاَ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ - قَالَ - فَجَرَتْ فِي سِكَكِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ لِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ اخْرُجْ فَاهْرِقْهَا ‏.‏ فَهَرَقْتُهَا فَقَالُوا أَوْ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ قُتِلَ فُلاَنٌ قُتِلَ فُلاَنٌ وَهِيَ فِي بُطُونِهِمْ - قَالَ فَلاَ أَدْرِي هُوَ مِنْ حَدِيثِ أَنَسٍ - فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا إِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَآمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i, sulaymaanu bnu daawuda al'atakiyyu haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - aakhbaranaa thaabitun, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kuntu saaqiya alqawmi yawma hurrimati alkhamru fiy bayti aabiy talhaaa wamaa sharaabuhum iilaaa alfadiykhu albusru waalttamru ‏.‏ faiidhaa munaadin yunaadiy faqaala akhruj faanzur fakharajtu faiidhaa munaadin yunaadiy aalaa iinna alkhamra qad hurrimat - qaala - fajarat fiy sikaki almadiynaai faqaala liy aabuw talhaaa akhruj faahriqhaa ‏.‏ faharaqtuhaa faqaaluwa aaw qaala ba'duhum qutila fulaanun qutila fulaanun wahiya fiy butuwnihim - qaala falaa aadriy huwa min hadiythi aanasin - faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ laysa 'alaa alladhiyna amanuwa wa'amiluwa alssaalihaati junaahun fiymaa ta'imuwa iidhaa maa attaqawa waamanuwa wa'amiluwa alssaalihaati‏}‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:I was the cup-bearer of some people in the house of Abu Talha on the day when liquor was forbidden. Their liquor had been prepared from dry dates or fresh dates when the announcer made the announcement. He (Abu Talha) said to me: Go out and find out (what the announcement is). I got out (and found) an announcer making this announcement: Behold, liquor has been declared unlawful. He said: The liquor (was spilt and) flawed in the lanes of Medina. Abu Talha said to me: Go out and Spill it, and I spilt it. They said or some of them said: Such and such were killed, such and such were killed for (the wine) had been in their stomachs. He (the narrator) said. I do not know whether it is the narration transmitted by Anas, (or by someone else). Then Allah, the Exalted and Majestic, revealed:" There shall be no sin (imputed) unto those who have believed and done good works for what they may have eaten as long as they fear (Allah) and believe and do good works" (v)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ صُهَيْبٍ، قَالَ سَأَلُوا أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ عَنِ الْفَضِيخِ، فَقَالَ مَا كَانَتْ لَنَا خَمْرٌ غَيْرَ فَضِيخِكُمْ هَذَا الَّذِي تُسَمُّونَهُ الْفَضِيخَ إِنِّي لَقَائِمٌ أَسْقِيهَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا أَيُّوبَ وَرِجَالاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَيْتِنَا إِذْ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ هَلْ بَلَغَكُمُ الْخَبَرُ قُلْنَا لاَ قَالَ فَإِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ فَقَالَ يَا أَنَسُ أَرِقْ هَذِهِ الْقِلاَلَ قَالَ فَمَا رَاجَعُوهَا وَلاَ سَأَلُوا عَنْهَا بَعْدَ خَبَرِ الرَّجُلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu suhaybin, qaala saaaluwa aanasa bna maalikin 'ani alfadiykhi, faqaala maa kaanat lanaa khamrun ghayra fadiykhikum hadhaa alladhiy tusammuwnahu alfadiykha iinniy laqaaiimun aasqiyhaa aabaa talhaaa waaabaa aayyuwba warijaalaan min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy baytinaa iidh jaa'a rajulun faqaala hal balaghakumu alkhabaru qulnaa laa qaala faiinna alkhamra qad hurrimat faqaala yaa aanasu aariq hadhihi alqilaala qaala famaa raaja'uwhaa walaa saaaluwa 'anhaa ba'da khabari alrrajuli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Aziz b. Suhaib reported:They (some persons) asked Anas b. Malik, about Fadikh (that is, a wine prepared from fresh dates), whereupon he said: There was no liquor with us except this Fadikih of yours. It was only this Fadikh that I had been serving to Abu Talha and Abu Ayyub and some persons from amongst the Companions of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) in our house. When a person came and said: Has the news reached you? We said, No. He said: Verily liquor has been declared forbidden. Thereupon, Abd Talha said: Anas, spill these large pitchers. He (the narrator) said: They then never reverted to it, nor even asked about this after the announcement by that person
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ إِنِّي لَقَائِمٌ عَلَى الْحَىِّ عَلَى عُمُومَتِي أَسْقِيهِمْ مِنْ فَضِيخٍ لَهُمْ وَأَنَا أَصْغَرُهُمْ سِنًّا فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ إِنَّهَا قَدْ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ فَقَالُوا اكْفَأْهَا يَا أَنَسُ ‏.‏ فَكَفَأْتُهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ مَا هُوَ قَالَ بُسْرٌ وَرُطَبٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَنَسٍ كَانَتْ خَمْرَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ وَحَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ذَلِكَ أَيْضًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, qaala waaakhbaranaa sulaymaanu alttaymiyyu, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala iinniy laqaaiimun 'alaa alhaaai 'alaa 'umuwmatiy aasqiyhim min fadiykhin lahum waaanaa aasgharuhum sinnana fajaa'a rajulun faqaala iinnahaa qad hurrimati alkhamru faqaaluwa akfaahaa yaa aanasu ‏.‏ fakafaatuhaa ‏.‏ qaala qultu laanasin maa huwa qaala busrun warutabun ‏.‏ qaala faqaala aabuw bakri bnu aanasin kaanat khamrahum yawmaiidhin ‏.‏ qaala sulaymaanu wahaddathaniy rajulun 'an aanasi bni maalikin aannahu qaala dhalika aaydana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:I was standing amongst the uncles of my tribe serving them Fadikh while I was the youngest of them, when a person came and said: Verily the use of liqour has been prohibited. They said: Anas, spill it away. So I spilt it. He (one of the narrators. Sulaiman Taimi) said that he asked Anas what that was (the Fadikh). He said: It had been prepared from unripe and ripe dates. Abu Bakr b. Anas said: It was their liquor in those days. Sulaiman said: A person narrated it to me from Anas b. Malik that he had said so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ كُنْتُ قَائِمًا عَلَى الْحَىِّ أَسْقِيهِمْ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَنَسٍ كَانَ خَمْرَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏ وَأَنَسٌ شَاهِدٌ فَلَمْ يُنْكِرْ أَنَسٌ ذَاكَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي بَعْضُ مَنْ كَانَ مَعِي أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسًا يَقُولُ كَانَ خَمْرَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala aanasun kuntu qaaiimana 'alaa alhaaai aasqiyhim ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa ghayra aannahu qaala faqaala aabuw bakri bnu aanasin kaana khamrahum yawmaiidhin ‏.‏ waaanasun shaahidun falam yunkir aanasun dhaaka ‏.‏ waqaala abnu 'abdi alaa'laa haddathanaa almu'tamiru 'an aabiyhi qaala haddathaniy ba'du man kaana ma'iy aannahu sami'a aanasana yaquwlu kaana khamrahum yawmaiidhin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:I was standing amongst the members of my (tribe) and serving them liquor. The rest of the hadith is the same, but with this variation that Abu Bakr b. Anas said: It was their liquor in those days (prepared from dates), and Anas was present there and he did not deny this (fact) Mu'tamir reported on the authority of his father: A person who was with me told me that he had heard Anas saying that that was their liquor in those days
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَسْقِي أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا دُجَانَةَ وَمُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ فِي رَهْطٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا دَاخِلٌ فَقَالَ حَدَثَ خَبَرٌ نَزَلَ تَحْرِيمُ الْخَمْرِ ‏.‏ فَكَفَأْنَاهَا يَوْمَئِذٍ وَإِنَّهَا لَخَلِيطُ الْبُسْرِ وَالتَّمْرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَقَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ لَقَدْ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ وَكَانَتْ عَامَّةُ خُمُورِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَلِيطَ الْبُسْرِ وَالتَّمْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, qaala waaakhbaranaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kuntu aasqiy aabaa talhaaa waaabaa dujaanaaa wamu'aadha bna jabalin fiy rahtin mina alaansaari fadakhala 'alaynaa daakhilun faqaala hadatha khabarun nazala tahriymu alkhamri ‏.‏ fakafaanaahaa yawmaiidhin waiinnahaa lakhaliytu albusri waalttamri ‏.‏ qaala qataadaau waqaala aanasu bnu maalikin laqad hurrimati alkhamru wakaanat 'aammaau khumuwrihim yawmaiidhin khaliyta albusri waalttamri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported I was serving wine to Abu Talha, and Abu Dujana. and Mu'adh b. jabal admidst a group of Ansar when a visitor came to us and said There is a fresh news; the (verses) concerning the prohibition of liquor have been revealed. So we spilt it on that day; and it was a mixture of dry dates and fresh dates. Anas b. Malik said:Whil Khamr was declared unlawful, the common liquor of theirs was then a mixture of dry dates and fresh dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذُ، بْنُ هِشَامٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ إِنِّي لأَسْقِي أَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأَبَا دُجَانَةَ وَسُهَيْلَ ابْنَ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ مَزَادَةٍ فِيهَا خَلِيطُ بُسْرٍ وَتَمْرٍ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaaluwa aakhbaranaa mu'aadhu, bnu hishaamin haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala iinniy laasqiy aabaa talhaaa waaabaa dujaanaaa wasuhayla abna baydaa'a min mazaadaain fiyhaa khaliytu busrin watamrin ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi sa'iydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik said:I was serving wine to Abu Talha, Abu Dujana, and Suhail b. Baida' from a waterskin which contained the mixture of unripe dates and fresh dates. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ قَتَادَةَ بْنَ دِعَامَةَ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُخْلَطَ التَّمْرُ وَالزَّهْوُ ثُمَّ يُشْرَبَ وَإِنَّ ذَلِكَ كَانَ عَامَّةَ خُمُورِهِمْ يَوْمَ حُرِّمَتِ الْخَمْرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, aanna qataadaaa bna di'aamaaa, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa aan yukhlata alttamru waalzzahwu thumma yushraba waiinna dhalika kaana 'aammaaa khumuwrihim yawma hurrimati alkhamru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik is reported to have said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden to mixture fresh dates and unripe dates and then drinking (the wine prepared out of it), and that was their common intoxicant when liquor was prohibited
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كُنْتُ أَسْقِي أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ بْنَ الْجَرَّاحِ وَأَبَا طَلْحَةَ وَأُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ شَرَابًا مِنْ فَضِيخٍ وَتَمْرٍ فَأَتَاهُمْ آتٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ الْخَمْرَ قَدْ حُرِّمَتْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا أَنَسُ قُمْ إِلَى هَذِهِ الْجَرَّةِ فَاكْسِرْهَا ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ إِلَى مِهْرَاسٍ لَنَا فَضَرَبْتُهَا بِأَسْفَلِهِ حَتَّى تَكَسَّرَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an iishaaqa bni, 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qaala kuntu aasqiy aabaa 'ubaydaaa bna aljarraahi waaabaa talhaaa waaubaaaa bna ka'bin sharaabana min fadiykhin watamrin faaataahum atin faqaala iinna alkhamra qad hurrimat ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw talhaaa yaa aanasu qum iilaa hadhihi aljarraai faaksirhaa ‏.‏ faqumtu iilaa mihraasin lanaa fadarabtuhaa biaasfalihi hattaa takassarat ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:I was serving drink to Abu 'Ubaida b. jarrah, Abu Talha and Ubayy b. Ka'b prepared from unripe dates and fresh dates when a visitor came and he said: Verily liquor has been prohibited. Thereupon, Abu Talha said: Anas, stand up and break this pitcher. I stool up and (took hold) of a pointed stone and struck the pitcher with its lower part until it broke into pieces
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، - يَعْنِي الْحَنَفِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ لَقَدْ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ الآيَةَ الَّتِي حَرَّمَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا الْخَمْرَ وَمَا بِالْمَدِينَةِ شَرَابٌ يُشْرَبُ إِلاَّ مِنْ تَمْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw bakrin, - ya'niy alhanafiyya - haddathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi, bnu ja'farin haddathaniy aabiy aannahu, sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu laqad aanzala alllahu alayaaa allatiy harrama alllahu fiyhaa alkhamra wamaa bialmadiynaai sharaabun yushrabu iilaaa min tamrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:Allah revealed the verse in which Allah prohibited the use of liquor. In those days no other liquor was drunk but that prepared from dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبَّادٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ عَنِ الْخَمْرِ تُتَّخَذُ خَلاًّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, h wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, 'ani alssuddiyyi, 'an yahyaa bni 'abbaadin, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm suiila 'ani alkhamri tuttakhadhu khalaaan faqaala ‏ "‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked about the use of Khamr from which vinegar is prepared. He said:No (it is prohibited)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَائِلٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ، أَنَّ طَارِقَ بْنَ سُوَيْدٍ الْجُعْفِيَّ، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْخَمْرِ فَنَهَا أَوْ كَرِهَ أَنْ يَصْنَعَهَا فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا أَصْنَعُهَا لِلدَّوَاءِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ بِدَوَاءٍ وَلَكِنَّهُ دَاءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaaki bni harbin, 'an 'alqamaaa bni waaiilin, 'an aabiyhi, waaiilin alhadramiyyi, aanna taariqa bna suwaydin alju'fiyya, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alkhamri fanahaa aaw kariha aan yasna'ahaa faqaala iinnamaa aasna'uhaa lilddawaa'i faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnahu laysa bidawaa'in walakinnahu daa'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Wa'il al-Hadrami reported that Tariq b. Suwaid a-Ju'fi asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about liquor. He forbade (its use) and he expressed hatred that it should be prepared. He (Tariq) said:I prepare it as a medicine, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: It is no medicine, but an ailment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي، عُثْمَانَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alhajjaaju bnu aabiy, 'uthmaana haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, aanna aabaa kathiyrin, haddathahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alkhamru min haatayni alshhajaratayni alnnakhlaai waal'inabaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:Wine is prepared from the (fruit) of these two trees-date-palm and vine
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَثِيرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ النَّخْلَةِ وَالْعِنَبَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahadaathanaa muhamaadu bnu 'abdi allaahi bni numayrin, hadaathanaa aabiy, hadaathanaa alaawzaa'iyuu, hadaathanaa aabuw kathiyrin, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alkhamru min haatayni alshaajaratayni alnaakhlaai waal'inabaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، وَعِكْرِمَةَ، بْنِ عَمَّارٍ وَعُقْبَةَ بْنِ التَّوْأَمِ عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الْخَمْرُ مِنْ هَاتَيْنِ الشَّجَرَتَيْنِ الْكَرْمَةِ وَالنَّخْلَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ ‏"‏ الْكَرْمِ وَالنَّخْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, wa'ikrimaaa, bni 'ammaarin wa'uqbaaa bni alttawaami 'an aabiy kathiyrin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alkhamru min haatayni alshhajaratayni alkarmaai waalnnakhlaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy kuraybin ‏"‏ alkarmi waalnnakhli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Wine comes from vine and date-palms. Abu Kuraib has narrated it with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءَ بْنَ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُخْلَطَ الزَّبِيبُ وَالتَّمْرُ وَالْبُسْرُ وَالتَّمْرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, sami'tu 'ataa'a bna aabiy rabaahin, haddathanaa jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyu, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa aan yukhlata alzzabiybu waalttamru waalbusru waalttamru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) prohibited the mixing of grapes and fresh dates, and dry dates and fresh dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ التَّمْرُ وَالزَّبِيبُ جَمِيعًا وَنَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الرُّطَبُ وَالْبُسْرُ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy rabaahin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi, alllahi alaansaariyyi 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa aan yunbadha alttamru waalzzabiybu jamiy'ana wanahaa aan yunbadha alrrutabu waalbusru jamiy'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited the (preparation of) Nabidh by mixing together fresh dates and grapes, and he prohibited the preparation of Nabidh by mixing the fresh dates and unripe dates together
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، جُرَيْجٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي عَطَاءٌ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَجْمَعُوا بَيْنَ الرُّطَبِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَبَيْنَ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ نَبِيذًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'ani abni jurayjin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu, jurayjin qaala qaala liy 'ataa'un sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tajma'uwa bayna alrrutabi waalbusri wabayna alzzabiybi waalttamri nabiydhana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not mix fresh dates and dry dates, and grapes and fresh dates for preparing Nabidh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ، مَوْلَى حَكِيمِ بْنِ حِزَامٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الزَّبِيبُ وَالتَّمْرُ جَمِيعًا وَنَهَى أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الْبُسْرُ وَالرُّطَبُ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri almakkiyyi, mawlaa hakiymi bni hizaamin 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyi, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa aan yunbadha alzzabiybu waalttamru jamiy'ana wanahaa aan yunbadha albusru waalrrutabu jamiy'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah al-Ansari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Prohibited the preparation of Nabidh by mixing grapes and fresh dates. and he forbade the preparation of Nabidh by mixing unripe dates with fresh dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ أَنْ يُخْلَطَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَعَنِ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ أَنْ يُخْلَطَ بَيْنَهُمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'ani alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alttamri waalzzabiybi aan yukhlata baynahumaa wa'ani alttamri waalbusri aan yukhlata baynahumaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) prohibited that fresh dates and grapes be mixed together and that fresh dates and unripe dates be mixed together
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبُو مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَخْلِطَ بَيْنَ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَأَنْ نَخْلِطَ الْبُسْرَ وَالتَّمْرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu yaziyda aabuw maslamaaa, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala nahaanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nakhlita bayna alzzabiybi waalttamri waaan nakhlita albusra waalttamra ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us to mix grapes and dry dates together and unripe dates and dry dates (to prepare Nabidh)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - عَنْ أَبِي، مَسْلَمَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna mufaddalin - 'an aabiy, maslamaaa bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abi Maslama with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ الْعَبْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ شَرِبَ النَّبِيذَ مِنْكُمْ فَلْيَشْرَبْهُ زَبِيبًا فَرْدًا أَوْ تَمْرًا فَرْدًا أَوْ بُسْرًا فَرْدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an iismaa'iyla bni muslimin al'abdiyyi, 'an aabiy, almutawakkili alnnaajiyyi 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man shariba alnnabiydha minkum falyashrabhu zabiybana fardana aaw tamrana fardana aaw busrana fardana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who amongst you drinks Nabidh should drink that (prepared either from) grapes alone, or from dates alone, or from unripe dates alone (and not by mixing them with one another)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، الْعَبْدِيُّ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نَخْلِطَ بُسْرًا بِتَمْرٍ أَوْ زَبِيبًا بِتَمْرٍ أَوْ زَبِيبًا بِبُسْرٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ شَرِبَهُ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu muslimin, al'abdiyyu bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala nahaanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nakhlita busrana bitamrin aaw zabiybana bitamrin aaw zabiybana bibusrin ‏.‏ waqaala ‏ "‏ man sharibahu minkum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi wakiy'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Isma'il b. Muslim al-'Abadi reported on the authority of the same chain of transmitters:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited us that we should mix dry dates with unripe dates or (mix) grapes with dry dates (and prepare Nabidh). He also said: He who amongst you drinks-the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ الدَّسْتَوَائِيُّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ، أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا الزَّهْوَ وَالرُّطَبَ جَمِيعًا وَلاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا الزَّبِيبَ وَالتَّمْرَ جَمِيعًا وَانْتَبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عَلَى حِدَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, aakhbaranaa hishaamun alddastawaaiiyyu, 'an yahyaa bni, aabiy kathiyrin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tantabidhuwa alzzahwa waalrrutaba jamiy'ana walaa tantabidhuwa alzzabiyba waalttamra jamiy'ana waantabidhuwa kulla waahidin minhumaa 'alaa hidatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:Do not prepare Nabidh by mixing nearly ripe dates and fresh dates together, and do not prepare Nabidh by mixing grapes and dates together, but prepare Nabidh from each (one of them) separately
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، عَنْ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ أَبِي، عُثْمَانَ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin al'abdiyyu, 'an hajjaaji bni aabiy, 'uthmaana 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيٌّ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ - عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا الزَّهْوَ وَالرُّطَبَ جَمِيعًا وَلاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا الرُّطَبَ وَالزَّبِيبَ جَمِيعًا وَلَكِنِ انْتَبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى حِدَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَزَعَمَ يَحْيَى أَنَّهُ لَقِيَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ فَحَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ هَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'umara, aakhbaranaa 'aliyyun, - wahuwa abnu almubaaraki - 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy qataadaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tantabidhuwa alzzahwa waalrrutaba jamiy'ana walaa tantabidhuwa alrrutaba waalzzabiyba jamiy'ana walakini antabidhuwa kulla waahidin 'alaa hidatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waza'ama yahyaa aannahu laqiya 'abda alllahi bna aabiy qataadaaa fahaddathahu 'an aabiyhi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not prepare Nabidh by mixing nearly ripe and fresh dates and do not prepare Nabidh by mixing together fresh dates and grapes, but prepare Nabidh out of each (one of them) separately. Yahya stated that he had met 'Abdullah b. Abu Qatada and he narrated it on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ الْمُعَلِّمُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، بِهَذَيْنِ الإِسْنَادَيْنِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الرُّطَبَ وَالزَّهْوَ وَالتَّمْرَ وَالزَّبِيبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa husaynun almu'allimu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, bihadhayni aliisnaadayni ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ alrrutaba waalzzahwa waalttamra waalzzabiyba ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir through these two chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانٌ الْعَطَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ خَلِيطِ التَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَعَنْ خَلِيطِ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَعَنْ خَلِيطِ الزَّهْوِ وَالرُّطَبِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ انْتَبِذُوا كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى حِدَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa aabaanun al'attaaru, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy kathiyrin, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy qataadaaa, 'an aabiyhi, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an khaliyti alttamri waalbusri wa'an khaliyti alzzabiybi waalttamri wa'an khaliyti alzzahwi waalrrutabi waqaala ‏ "‏ antabidhuwa kulla waahidin 'alaa hidatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Abu Qatada, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbidding the preparation of the mixture of ripe dates and unripe dates, and the mixture of grapes and dates, and that of nearly ripe dates and fresh dates but the Prophet said:Prepare the Nabidh from each one of them separately
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy qataadaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated on the authority of Abu Qatada through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ، بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ الْحَنَفِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الزَّبِيبِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَالْبُسْرِ وَالتَّمْرِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يُنْبَذُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا عَلَى حِدَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an 'ikrimaaa, bni 'ammaarin 'an aabiy kathiyrin alhanafiyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alzzabiybi waalttamri waalbusri waalttamri waqaala ‏ "‏ yunbadhu kullu waahidin minhumaa 'alaa hidatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation of Nabidh) from grapes and dates, and unripe dates and dry dates (by mixing them together). He (the Prophet also) said:Prepare Nabidh from each one of them separately
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ، - وَهُوَ أَبُو كَثِيرٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa haashimu bnu alqaasimi, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau bnu 'ammaarin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni audhaynaaa, - wahuwa aabuw kathiyrin alghubariyyu - haddathaniy aabuw hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُخْلَطَ التَّمْرُ وَالزَّبِيبُ جَمِيعًا وَأَنْ يُخْلَطَ الْبُسْرُ وَالتَّمْرُ جَمِيعًا وَكَتَبَ إِلَى أَهْلِ جُرَشَ يَنْهَاهُمْ عَنْ خَلِيطِ التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an habiybin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yukhlata alttamru waalzzabiybu jamiy'ana waaan yukhlata albusru waalttamru jamiy'ana wakataba iilaa aahli jurasha yanhaahum 'an khaliyti alttamri waalzzabiybi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade the mixing of dates and grapes together, and mixing of unripe dates and ripe dates together (for preparing Nabidh), and he wrote to the people of Jurash (in Yemen) forbidding them to prepare the mixture of dates and grapes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي الطَّحَّانَ - عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فِي التَّمْرِ وَالزَّبِيبِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْبُسْرَ وَالتَّمْرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi wahbu bnu baqiyyaaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidun, - ya'niy alttahhaana - 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi fiy alttamri waalzzabiybi walam yadhkuri albusra waalttamra ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى، بْنُ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ قَدْ نُهِيَ أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الْبُسْرُ وَالرُّطَبُ جَمِيعًا وَالتَّمْرُ وَالزَّبِيبُ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy muwsaa, bnu 'uqbaaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu kaana yaquwlu qad nuhiya aan yunbadha albusru waalrrutabu jamiy'ana waalttamru waalzzabiybu jamiy'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that he was forbidden to prepare Nabidh by mixing unripe dates and fresh dates, and dates with grapes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ، عُقْبَةَ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَدْ نُهِيَ أَنْ يُنْبَذَ الْبُسْرُ وَالرُّطَبُ جَمِيعًا وَالتَّمْرُ وَالزَّبِيبُ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy muwsaa bnu, 'uqbaaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu qaala qad nuhiya aan yunbadha albusru waalrrutabu jamiy'ana waalttamru waalzzabiybu jamiy'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that they were forbidden to prepare Nabidh by mixing dry dates and fresh dates and dates and grapes together
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ أَنْ يُنْبَذَ فِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alddubbaa'i waalmuzaffati aan yunbadha fiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the preparation of Nabidh in gourd or varnished jar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ فِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alddubbaa'i waalmuzaffati aan yuntabadha fiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith is narrated through a different chain with slight variation in wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَهُ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَنْتَبِذُوا فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَلاَ فِي الْمُزَفَّتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاجْتَنِبُوا الْحَنَاتِمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala waaakhbarahu aabuw salamaaa, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tantabidhuwa fiy alddubbaa'i walaa fiy almuzaffati ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma yaquwlu aabuw hurayraaa waajtanibuwa alhanaatima ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not prepare Nabidh in gourd or jar or in a pitcher besmeared with pitch (known as green pitcher)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى عَنِ الْمُزَفَّتِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالنَّقِيرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قِيلَ لأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ مَا الْحَنْتَمُ قَالَ الْجِرَارُ الْخُضْرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa 'ani almuzaffati waalhantami waalnnaqiyri ‏.‏ qaala qiyla laabiy hurayraaa maa alhantamu qaala aljiraaru alkhudru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation of Nabidh) in varnished jar, pitcher besmeared with green pitch and hollow stump. It was said to Abu Huraira:What that Hantama was? He said: It is green pitcher (besmeared with pitch)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا نُوحُ بْنُ قَيْسٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِوَفْدِ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ ‏ "‏ أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْمُقَيَّرِ - وَالْحَنْتَمُ الْمَزَادَةُ الْمَجْبُوبَةُ - وَلَكِنِ اشْرَبْ فِي سِقَائِكَ وَأَوْكِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, aakhbaranaa nuwhu bnu qaysin, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala liwafdi 'abdi alqaysi ‏ "‏ aanhaakum 'ani alddubbaa'i waalhantami waalnnaqiyri waalmuqayyari - waalhantamu almazaadaau almajbuwbaau - walakini ashrab fiy siqaaiika waaawkihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to the group of Abd al-Qais:I forbid you (to prepare Nabidh) in gourd. and green pitcher, hollow stump and varnished jar and the waterskin having its upper end cut, but (prepare it) in your small waterskin, and tie its mouth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏ هَذَا حَدِيثُ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَبْثَرٍ وَشُعْبَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abtharun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathaniy bishru bnu khaalidin, aakhbaranaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - 'an shu'baaa, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuntabadha fiy alddubbaa'i waalmuzaffati ‏.‏ hadhaa hadiythu jariyrin ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'abtharin washu'baaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alddubbaa'i waalmuzaffati ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade to prepare Nabidh in gourd and varnished jar. This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِلأَسْوَدِ هَلْ سَأَلْتَ أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ عَمَّا يُكْرَهُ أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ فِيهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا أُمَّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَخْبِرِينِي عَمَّا نَهَى عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ فِيهِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَهَانَا أَهْلَ الْبَيْتِ أَنْ نَنْتَبِذَ فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَمَا ذَكَرَتِ الْحَنْتَمَ وَالْجَرَّ قَالَ إِنَّمَا أُحَدِّثُكَ بِمَا سَمِعْتُ أَأُحَدِّثُكَ مَا لَمْ أَسْمَعْ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, kilaahumaa 'an jariyrin, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, qaala qultu lilaaswadi hal saaalta aumma almuuminiyna 'ammaa yukrahu aan yuntabadha fiyhi qaala na'am ‏.‏ qultu yaa aumma almuuminiyna aakhbiriyniy 'ammaa nahaa 'anhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yuntabadha fiyhi ‏.‏ qaalat nahaanaa aahla albayti aan nantabidha fiy alddubbaa'i waalmuzaffati ‏.‏ qaala qultu lahu aamaa dhakarati alhantama waaljarra qaala iinnamaa auhaddithuka bimaa sami'tu aaauhaddithuka maa lam aasma'
verses.translation: Ibrahim reported:I said to Aswad if he had asked the Mother of the Believers (in which utensils) he (the Holy Prophet) disapproved the preparation of Nabidh. He (Aswad) said: Yes. I said: Mother of the Believers, inform me about the utensils in which) Allah's Apostle forbade to prepare Nabidh. She (Hadrat 'A'isha) said: He forbade us, the members of his family, to prepare Nabidh in gourd, or varnished jar. I said to him: Do you remember green pitcher, and pitcher? He said: I narrated to you what I have heard; should I narrate to you which I did not hear?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abtharun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alddubbaa'i waalmuzaffati ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in gourd and varnished jar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، وَشُعْبَةُ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، وَسُلَيْمَانُ، وَحَمَّادٌ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - haddathanaa sufyaanu, washu'baau, qaalaa haddathanaa mansuwrun, wasulaymaanu, wahammaadun, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith has been narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْفَضْلِ - حَدَّثَنَا ثُمَامَةُ بْنُ، حَزْنٍ الْقُشَيْرِيُّ قَالَ لَقِيتُ عَائِشَةَ فَسَأَلْتُهَا عَنِ النَّبِيذِ، فَحَدَّثَتْنِي أَنَّ وَفْدَ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ قَدِمُوا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلُوا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ النَّبِيذِ فَنَهَاهُمْ أَنْ يَنْتَبِذُوا فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa alqaasimu, - ya'niy abna alfadli - haddathanaa thumaamaau bnu, haznin alqushayriyyu qaala laqiytu 'aaiishaaa fasaaaltuhaa 'ani alnnabiydhi, fahaddathatniy aanna wafda 'abdi alqaysi qadimuwa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaaluwa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alnnabiydhi fanahaahum aan yantabidhuwa fiy alddubbaa'i waalnnaqiyri waalmuzaffati waalhantami ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thumama b. Hazn Al-Qushairi reported:I met 'A'isha and asked her (about the utensils in which) Nabidh (may be prepared). She narrated to me that a group of 'Abd al-Qais came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about Nabidh. He (the Holy Prophet) forbade them to prepare Nabidh in varnished jar, hollow stumps and gourd and green pitcher
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ مُعَاذَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu suwaydin, 'an mu'aadhaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alddubbaa'i waalhantami waalnnaqiyri waalmuzaffati ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding (the preparation of Nabidh) in varnished jar, green pitcher, gourd, and hollow stump
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ، سُوَيْدٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ جَعَلَ مَكَانَ الْمُزَفَّتِ الْمُقَيَّرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi althhaqafiyyu, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu, suwaydin bihadhaa aliisnaadi iilaaa aannahu ja'ala makaana almuzaffati almuqayyari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ishaq b. Suwaid reported through the same chain of transmitters but for the difference that he substituted the word" gourd" for" waterskin" (meant for preserving wine)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ قَدِمَ وَفْدُ عَبْدِ الْقَيْسِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنْهَاكُمْ عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْمُقَيَّرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ جَعَلَ - مَكَانَ الْمُقَيَّرِ - الْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abbaadu bnu 'abbaadin, 'an aabiy jamraaa, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, h wahaddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aabiy jamraaa, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu qadima wafdu 'abdi alqaysi 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanhaakum 'ani alddubbaa'i waalhantami waalnnaqiyri waalmuqayyari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi hammaadin ja'ala - makaana almuqayyari - almuzaffati ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that there came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a group of people from the tribe of 'Abd al-Qais. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to them:I forbid you to prepare Nabidh in gourd, in pitcher besmeared with pitch, in hollow stump and in waterskin (meant for preserving wine). In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Hammad the word." gourd" has been used in place of" waterskin
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالنَّقِيرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an habiybin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alddubbaa'i waalhantami waalmuzaffati waalnnaqiyri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the (preparation of Nabidh) in gourd in pitcher besmeared with pitch, in varnished jar, and in hollow stumps
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَأَنْ يُخْلَطَ الْبَلَحُ بِالزَّهْوِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'an habiybi bni aabiy 'amraaa, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alddubbaa'i waalhantami waalmuzaffati waalnnaqiyri waaan yukhlata albalahu bialzzahwi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade, the preparation of Nabidh in gourd, in varnished jar, hollow stump and from mixing up ripe dates with nearly ripe dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى الْبَهْرَانِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي، عُمَرَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an yahyaa albahraaniyyi, qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy, 'umara 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alddubbaa'i waalnnaqiyri waalmuzaffati ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (preparation) of Nabidh in gourd, in hollow stump and in varnished jar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ، أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْجَرِّ أَنْ يُنْبَذَ فِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, 'ani alttaymiyyi, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu, aayyuwba haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu alttaymiyyu, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani aljarri aan yunbadha fiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالنَّقِيرِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, aakhbaranaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alddubbaa'i waalhantami waalnnaqiyri waalmuzaffati ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in gourd, in pitcher besmeared with green pitch, in hollow stump and in varnished jar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa aan yuntabadha ‏.‏ fadhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation of) Nabidh, the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الشُّرْبِ فِي الْحَنْتَمَةِ وَالدُّبَّاءِ وَالنَّقِيرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa almuthannaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - 'an aabiy almutawakkili, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alshhurbi fiy alhantamaai waalddubbaa'i waalnnaqiyri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade drinking in green pitcher, in gourd and in the hollow stump
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ أَشْهَدُ عَلَى ابْنِ عُمَرَ وَابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ أَنَّهُمَا شَهِدَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْحَنْتَمِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ وَالنَّقِيرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wasurayju bnu yuwnusa, - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa, 'an mansuwri bni hayyaana, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala aashhadu 'alaa abni 'umara waabni 'abbaasin aannahumaa shahidaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alddubbaa'i waalhantami waalmuzaffati waalnnaqiyri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported:I bear testimony to the fact that Ibn 'Umar and Ibn 'Abbas testified to the fact that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the preparation) of Nabidh in gourd in vessel besmeared with pitch and hollow stump
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَازِمٍ - حَدَّثَنَا يَعْلَى بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ، فَقَالَ حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيذَ الْجَرِّ ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ فَقُلْتُ أَلاَ تَسْمَعُ مَا يَقُولُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ وَمَا يَقُولُ قُلْتُ قَالَ حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيذَ الْجَرِّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ صَدَقَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ حَرَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَبِيذَ الْجَرِّ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَأَىُّ شَىْءٍ نَبِيذُ الْجَرِّ فَقَالَ كُلُّ شَىْءٍ يُصْنَعُ مِنَ الْمَدَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyrun, - ya'niy abna haazimin - haddathanaa ya'laa bnu hakiymin, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, qaala saaaltu abna 'umara 'an nabiydhi aljarri, faqaala harrama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nabiydha aljarri ‏.‏ faaataytu abna 'abbaasin faqultu aalaa tasma'u maa yaquwlu abnu 'umara qaala wamaa yaquwlu qultu qaala harrama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nabiydha aljarri ‏.‏ faqaala sadaqa abnu 'umara harrama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nabiydha aljarri ‏.‏ faqultu waaaaau shaa'in nabiydhu aljarri faqaala kullu shaa'in yusna'u mina almadari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Jubair reported:I asked Ibn 'Umar about (the preparation of) Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch), whereupon he said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the (preparation of) Nabidh in green pitcher (besmeared with pitch). I then came to Ibn Abbas and said: Do you hear what Ibn 'Umar has said? Thereupon he said: What does he say? I said: He stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden the (preparation of) Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch), whereupon he said: Ibn 'Umar has told the truth. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) declared unlawful the preparation of Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch). I said: What is this thing, the Nabidh of a pitcher (Nabidh prepared in a pitcher)? Thereupon, he said: Everything that is prepared in earthen pitcher
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ النَّاسَ فِي بَعْضِ مَغَازِيهِ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَأَقْبَلْتُ نَحْوَهُ فَانْصَرَفَ قَبْلَ أَنْ أَبْلُغَهُ فَسَأَلْتُ مَاذَا قَالَ قَالُوا نَهَى أَنْ يُنْتَبَذَ فِي الدُّبَّاءِ وَالْمُزَفَّتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khataba alnnaasa fiy ba'di maghaaziyhi qaala abnu 'umara faaaqbaltu nahwahu faansarafa qabla aan aablughahu fasaaaltu maadhaa qaala qaaluwa nahaa aan yuntabadha fiy alddubbaa'i waalmuzaffati ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed people in one of his expeditions. Ibn 'Umar said: I went forward to him but he went away before I reached him. I asked (the people present there): What did he say? They said that he (the Holy Prophet) had forbidden the preparation of Nabidh in gourd and varnished jar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، عَنِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ يَعْنِي، ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ الأَيْلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرُوا فِي بَعْضِ مَغَازِيهِ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ مَالِكٌ وَأُسَامَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, waabnu, rumhin 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, jamiy'ana 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, 'ani althhaqafiyyi, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku ya'niy, abna 'uthmaana h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu alaayliyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy ausaamaau, kullu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi maalikin walam yadhkuruwa fiy ba'di maghaaziyhi ‏.‏ iilaaa maalikun waausaamaau ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar with different chains of transmitters but they have not mentioned:" In one of his expeditions" except Malik and Usama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ قَالَ فَقَالَ قَدْ زَعَمُوا ذَاكَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَنَهَى عَنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قَدْ زَعَمُوا ذَاكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an thaabitin, qaala qultu laibni 'umara nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an nabiydhi aljarri qaala faqaala qad za'amuwa dhaaka ‏.‏ qultu aanahaa 'anhu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala qad za'amuwa dhaaka ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thabit reported:I said to Ibn 'Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden the preparation of Nabidh in the green pitcher (besmeared with pitch). He said: This is what they stated. I said: Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbid this? He said: They said so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ لاِبْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَهَى نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ نَبِيذِ الْجَرِّ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ طَاوُسٌ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, haddathanaa sulaymaanu alttaymiyyu, 'an taawusin, qaala qaala rajulun laibni 'umara aanahaa nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an nabiydhi aljarri qaala na'am ‏.‏ thumma qaala taawusun waalllahi iinniy sami'tuhu minhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A person asked Ibn 'Umar if the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) forbade the preparation of Nabidh in a green pitcher (besmeared with pitch). He said:Yes. Then Tawus said: By Allah, I heard it from him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، جَاءَهُ فَقَالَ أَنَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يُنْبَذَ فِي الْجَرِّ وَالدُّبَّاءِ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
