verses.translit: wahaddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa laythu bnu sa'din, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ faiinna fiy alssanaai yawmana yanzilu fiyhi wabaa'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wazaada fiy akhiri alhadiythi qaala alllaythu faalaa'aajimu 'indanaa yattaquwna dhalika fiy kaanuwna alaawwali ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported on the authority of Laith b. Sa'd with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation in wording (and that is that) he (the Holy Prophet) said:There is a day in a year when descends the pestilence; at the end of the hadith Laith said that the non Arabs save themselves from it in Kanun Awwal (this is the month of December)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَتْرُكُوا النَّارَ فِي بُيُوتِكُمْ حِينَ تَنَامُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, bnu 'uyaynaaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tatrukuwa alnnaara fiy buyuwtikum hiyna tanaamuwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:Do not leave the fire burning in your houses when you go to sleep
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ وَأَبُو عَامِرٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي عَامِرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ احْتَرَقَ بَيْتٌ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ بِالْمَدِينَةِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَلَمَّا حُدِّثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَأْنِهِمْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ النَّارَ إِنَّمَا هِيَ عَدُوٌّ لَكُمْ فَإِذَا نِمْتُمْ فَأَطْفِئُوهَا عَنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin waaabuw 'aamirin alaash'ariyyu waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy 'aamirin - qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala ahtaraqa baytun 'alaa aahlihi bialmadiynaai mina alllayli falammaa hudditha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishaanihim qaala ‏ "‏ iinna hadhihi alnnaara iinnamaa hiya 'aduwwun lakum faiidhaa nimtum faaatfiiuwhaa 'ankum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported that a house was burnt down in Medina during the night over its inhabitants. When their matter was reported to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he said; This fire is an enemy of yours. So when you go to sleep, extinguish it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا إِذَا حَضَرْنَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَعَامًا لَمْ نَضَعْ أَيْدِيَنَا حَتَّى يَبْدَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَيَضَعَ يَدَهُ وَإِنَّا حَضَرْنَا مَعَهُ مَرَّةً طَعَامًا فَجَاءَتْ جَارِيَةٌ كَأَنَّهَا تُدْفَعُ فَذَهَبَتْ لِتَضَعَ يَدَهَا فِي الطَّعَامِ فَأَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهَا ثُمَّ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ كَأَنَّمَا يُدْفَعُ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَسْتَحِلُّ الطَّعَامَ أَنْ لاَ يُذْكَرَ اسْمُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنَّهُ جَاءَ بِهَذِهِ الْجَارِيَةِ لِيَسْتَحِلَّ بِهَا فَأَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهَا فَجَاءَ بِهَذَا الأَعْرَابِيِّ لِيَسْتَحِلَّ بِهِ فَأَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهِ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ يَدَهُ فِي يَدِي مَعَ يَدِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy hudhayfaaa, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala kunnaa iidhaa hadarnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ta'aamana lam nada' aaydiyanaa hattaa yabdaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fayada'a yadahu waiinnaa hadarnaa ma'ahu marraaan ta'aamana fajaa'at jaariyaaun kaaannahaa tudfa'u fadhahabat litada'a yadahaa fiy altta'aami faaakhadha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihaa thumma jaa'a aa'raabiyyun kaaannamaa yudfa'u faaakhadha biyadihi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alshhaytaana yastahillu altta'aama aan laa yudhkara asmu alllahi 'alayhi waiinnahu jaa'a bihadhihi aljaariyaai liyastahilla bihaa faaakhadhtu biyadihaa fajaa'a bihadhaa alaa'raabiyyi liyastahilla bihi faaakhadhtu biyadihi waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi iinna yadahu fiy yadiy ma'a yadihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported:When we attended a dinner along with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) we did not lay our hands on the food until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had laid his hand and commenced eating (the food). Once we went with him to a dinner when a girl came rushingly as it someone had been pursuing her. She was about to lay her hand on the food, when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) caught her hand. Then a desert Arab came there (rushingly) as if someone had been pursuing him. He (the Holy Prophet) caught his hand; and then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Satan considers that food lawful on which Allah's name is not mentioned. He had brought this girl so that the food might be made lawful for him and I caught her hand. And he had brought a desert Arab so that (the food) might be lawful for him. So I caught his hand. By Him, in Whose hand is my life, it was (Satan's) hand that was in my hand along with her hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ الأَرْحَبِيِّ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ، قَالَ كُنَّا إِذَا دُعِينَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى طَعَامٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ كَأَنَّمَا يُطْرَدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي الْجَارِيَةِ ‏"‏ كَأَنَّمَا تُطْرَدُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَدَّمَ مَجِيءَ الأَعْرَابِيِّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَبْلَ مَجِيءِ الْجَارِيَةِ وَزَادَ فِي آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ اسْمَ اللَّهِ وَأَكَلَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, aakhbaranaa alaa'mashu, 'an khaythamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy hudhayfaaa alaarhabiyyi, 'an hudhayfaaa bni alyamaani, qaala kunnaa iidhaa du'iynaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa ta'aamin ‏.‏ fadhakara bima'naa hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa waqaala ‏"‏ kaaannamaa yutradu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy aljaariyaai ‏"‏ kaaannamaa tutradu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaddama majiy'a alaa'raabiyyi fiy hadiythihi qabla majiy'i aljaariyaai wazaada fiy akhiri alhadiythi thumma dhakara asma alllahi waaakala ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa b. al-Yaman reported:When we were invited to a dinner with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of hadith is the same but there is a slight variation of wording (and the variation is) that in that hadith the desert Arab precedes the arrival of that girl, and at the conclusion there is an addition (to this effect):" He (the Holy Prophet) then mentioned the name of Allah and ate
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَدَّمَ مَجِيءَ الْجَارِيَةِ قَبْلَ مَجِيءِ الأَعْرَابِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaddama majiy'a aljaariyaai qabla majiy'i alaa'raabiyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي أَبَا عَاصِمٍ - عَنِ ابْنِ، جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا دَخَلَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْتَهُ فَذَكَرَ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ وَعِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ قَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ لاَ مَبِيتَ لَكُمْ وَلاَ عَشَاءَ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا دَخَلَ فَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ قَالَ الشَّيْطَانُ أَدْرَكْتُمُ الْمَبِيتَ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اللَّهَ عِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ قَالَ أَدْرَكْتُمُ الْمَبِيتَ وَالْعَشَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, haddathanaa alddahhaaku, - ya'niy aabaa 'aasimin - 'ani abni, jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa dakhala alrrajulu baytahu fadhakara alllaha 'inda dukhuwlihi wa'inda ta'aamihi qaala alshhaytaanu laa mabiyta lakum walaa 'ashaa'a ‏.‏ waiidhaa dakhala falam yadhkuri alllaha 'inda dukhuwlihi qaala alshhaytaanu aadraktumu almabiyta ‏.‏ waiidhaa lam yadhkuri alllaha 'inda ta'aamihi qaala aadraktumu almabiyta waal'ashaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When a person enters his house and mentions the name of Allah at the time of entering it and while eating the food, Satan says (addressing himself: You have no place to spend the night and no evening meal; but when he enters without mentioning the name of Allah, the Satan says: You have found a place to spend the night, and when he does not mention the name of Allah while eating food, he (the Satan) says: You have found a place to spend the night and evening meal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ إِنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي عَاصِمٍ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ اسْمَ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ دُخُولِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu iinnahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi aabiy 'aasimin iilaaa aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ waiin lam yadhkuri asma alllahi 'inda ta'aamihi waiin lam yadhkuri asma alllahi 'inda dukhuwlihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir b. Abdullah through the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَأْكُلُوا بِالشِّمَالِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِالشِّمَالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taakuluwa bialshhimaali faiinna alshhaytaana yaakulu bialshhimaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:Do not eat with your left hand, for the Satan eats with his left hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، أَبِي عُمَرَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ جَدِّهِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَأْكُلْ بِيَمِينِهِ وَإِذَا شَرِبَ فَلْيَشْرَبْ بِيَمِينِهِ فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ وَيَشْرَبُ بِشِمَالِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, aabiy 'umara - waalllafzu laibni numayrin - qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy bakri bni 'ubaydi, alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara 'an jaddihi abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aakala aahadukum falyaakul biyamiynihi waiidhaa shariba falyashrab biyamiynihi faiinna alshhaytaana yaakulu bishimaalihi wayashrabu bishimaalihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you intends to eat (meal), he should eat with his right hand. and when he (intends) to drink he should drink with his right hand, for the Satan eats with his left hand and drinks with his left hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ سُفْيَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - kilaahumaa 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, jamiy'ana 'ani alzzuhriyyi, biiisnaadi sufyaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported by Zuhri on the authority of Sufyan with a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، - قَالَ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، حَرْمَلَةُ حَدَّثَنَا - عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، عُمَرَ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَأْكُلَنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ بِشِمَالِهِ وَلاَ يَشْرَبَنَّ بِهَا فَإِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِشِمَالِهِ وَيَشْرَبُ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ نَافِعٌ يَزِيدُ فِيهَا ‏"‏ وَلاَ يَأْخُذُ بِهَا وَلاَ يُعْطِي بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي الطَّاهِرِ ‏"‏ لاَ يَأْكُلَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, - qaala aabuw alttaahiri aakhbaranaa waqaala, harmalaau haddathanaa - 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy 'umaru bnu muhammadin, haddathaniy alqaasimu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni, 'umara haddathahu 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa yaakulanna aahadun minkum bishimaalihi walaa yashrabanna bihaa faiinna alshhaytaana yaakulu bishimaalihi wayashrabu bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wakaana naafi'un yaziydu fiyhaa ‏"‏ walaa yaakhudhu bihaa walaa yu'tiy bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy alttaahiri ‏"‏ laa yaakulanna aahadukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:None of you should eat with his left hand and drink with that (left hand), for the Satan eats with left hand and drinks with that (hand). Nafi' has made this addition in that:" Do not take up anything with that (left hand) and do not give anything with that" ; and in the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Tahir there is a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِيَاسُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً أَكَلَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشِمَالِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ أَسْتَطِيعُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ اسْتَطَعْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مَا مَنَعَهُ إِلاَّ الْكِبْرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا رَفَعَهَا إِلَى فِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa zaydu bnu alhubaabi, 'an 'ikrimaaa bni 'ammaarin, haddathaniy iiyaasu bnu salamaaa bni alaakwa'i, aanna aabaahu, haddathahu aanna rajulaan aakala 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishimaalihi faqaala ‏"‏ kul biyamiynika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa aastatiy'u qaala ‏"‏ laa astata'ta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ maa mana'ahu iilaaa alkibru ‏.‏ qaala famaa rafa'ahaa iilaa fiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salama b. Akwa' reported on the authority of his father that a person ate in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with his left hand, whereupon he said:Eat with your right hand. He said: I cannot do that, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: May you not be able to do that. It was vanity that prevented him from doing it, and he could not raise it (the right hand) up to his mouth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، سَمِعَهُ مِنْ، عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ قَالَ كُنْتُ فِي حَجْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَتْ يَدِي تَطِيشُ فِي الصَّحْفَةِ فَقَالَ لِي ‏ "‏ يَا غُلاَمُ سَمِّ اللَّهَ وَكُلْ بِيَمِينِكَ وَكُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana, qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alwaliydi bni kathiyrin, 'an wahbi bni kaysaana, sami'ahu min, 'umara bni aabiy salamaaa qaala kuntu fiy hajri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaanat yadiy tatiyshu fiy alssahfaai faqaala liy ‏ "‏ yaa ghulaamu sammi alllaha wakul biyamiynika wakul mimmaa yaliyka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. Abu Salama reported:I was under the care of Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him), and as my hand used to roam about in the dish he said to me: Boy, mention the name of Allah, and eat with your right hand and eat from what is near to you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي، مَرْيَمَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ، عَنْ وَهْبِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَكَلْتُ يَوْمًا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَعَلْتُ آخُذُ مِنْ لَحْمٍ حَوْلَ الصَّحْفَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كُلْ مِمَّا يَلِيكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy, maryama aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, aakhbaraniy muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni halhalaaa, 'an wahbi bni kaysaana, 'an 'umara bni aabiy salamaaa, aannahu qaala aakaltu yawmana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faja'altu akhudhu min lahmin hawla alssahfaai faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kul mimmaa yaliyka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. Abu Salama reported:I (had the opportunity) one day to dine with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and I picked up flesh from around the dish. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Eat from that which is near to you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ نَهَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ اخْتِنَاثِ الأَسْقِيَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala nahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani akhtinaathi alaasqiyaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id (Khudri) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade from turning the waterskins upside down and drinking from its mouth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ اخْتِنَاثِ الأَسْقِيَةِ أَنْ يُشْرَبَ مِنْ أَفْوَاهِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aannahu qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani akhtinaathi alaasqiyaai aan yushraba min aafwaahihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's, Messenger (may peace he upon him) forbade from turning the waterskins upside down and drinking from their mouths
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَاخْتِنَاثُهَا أَنْ يُقْلَبَ رَأْسُهَا ثُمَّ يُشْرَبَ مِنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aannahu qaala waakhtinaathuhaa aan yuqlaba raasuhaa thumma yushraba minhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported from Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, but he also said that Ikhtinath means that its head (i. e., of the waterskin) be turned upside down and then (water) be drank from that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَجَرَ عَنِ الشُّرْبِ قَائِمًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm zajara 'ani alshhurbi qaaiimana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) disapproved the drinking of water while standing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ نَهَى أَنْ يَشْرَبَ الرَّجُلُ قَائِمًا ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ فَقُلْنَا فَالأَكْلُ فَقَالَ ذَاكَ أَشَرُّ أَوْ أَخْبَثُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu nahaa aan yashraba alrrajulu qaaiimana ‏.‏ qaala qataadaau faqulnaa faalaaklu faqaala dhaaka aasharru aaw aakhbathu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade that a person should drink while standing. Qatada reported:We said to him: What about eating? Thereupon he (Anas) said: That is even worse and more detestable (abominable)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ قَتَادَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an hishaamin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi walam yadhkur qawla qataadaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported on the authority of Anas with a different chain of transmitters, but no mention is made of the words of Qatada
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عِيسَى الأُسْوَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَجَرَ عَنِ الشُّرْبِ قَائِمًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aabiy 'iysaa alauswaariyyi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm zajara 'ani alshhurbi qaaiimana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) warned against drinking while standing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ وَابْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عِيسَى الأُسْوَارِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الشُّرْبِ قَائِمًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu lizuhayrin waabni almuthannaa - qaaluwa haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aabiy 'iysaa alauswaariyyi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alshhurbi qaaiimana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters but with a slight, variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِي الْفَزَارِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ، حَمْزَةَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو غَطَفَانَ الْمُرِّيُّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَشْرَبَنَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ قَائِمًا فَمَنْ نَسِيَ فَلْيَسْتَقِئْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu aljabbaari bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa marwaanu, - ya'niy alfazaariyya - haddathanaa 'umaru bnu, hamzaaa aakhbaraniy aabuw ghatafaana almurriyyu, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yashrabanna aahadun minkum qaaiimana faman nasiya falyastaqii ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:None of you should drink while standing; and if anyone forgets, he must vomit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ سَقَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ زَمْزَمَ فَشَرِبَ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an 'aasimin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni, 'abbaasin qaala saqaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min zamzama fashariba wahuwa qaaiimun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:I served. (water of) Zamzam to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he drank it while standing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَرِبَ مِنْ زَمْزَمَ مِنْ دَلْوٍ مِنْهَا وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'aasimin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm shariba min zamzama min dalwin minhaa wahuwa qaaiimun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank (water) from Zamzam in a bucket while he was standing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ، الدَّوْرَقِيُّ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ سَالِمٍ - قَالَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، يَعْقُوبُ حَدَّثَنَا - هُشَيْمٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، وَمُغِيرَةُ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَرِبَ مِنْ زَمْزَمَ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa surayju bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, h wahaddathaniy ya'quwbu, alddawraqiyyu waiismaa'iylu bnu saalimin - qaala iismaa'iylu aakhbaranaa waqaala, ya'quwbu haddathanaa - hushaymun, haddathanaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, wamughiyraau, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shariba min zamzama wahuwa qaaiimun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) drank (water) from Zamzam while he was standing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، سَمِعَ الشَّعْبِيَّ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ سَقَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ زَمْزَمَ فَشَرِبَ قَائِمًا وَاسْتَسْقَى وَهُوَ عِنْدَ الْبَيْتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'aasimin, sami'a alshha'biyya, sami'a abna 'abbaasin, qaala saqaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min zamzama fashariba qaaiimana waastasqaa wahuwa 'inda albayti ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported:I served (water from) Zamzam to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and he drank while standing, and he asked for it while he was near the House (i. e. House of Allah-Ka'ba)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا فَأَتَيْتُهُ بِدَلْوٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythihimaa faaataytuhu bidalwin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى أَنْ يُتَنَفَّسَ فِي الإِنَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa althhaqafiyyu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an 'abdi, alllahi bni aabiy qataadaaa 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa aan yutanaffasa fiy aliinaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Qatada reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade breathing in a vessel
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عَزْرَةَ، بْنِ ثَابِتٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ عَنْ ثُمَامَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الإِنَاءِ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an 'azraaa, bni thaabitin alaansaariyyi 'an thumaamaaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aanasin, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yatanaffasu fiy aliinaa'i thalaathana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to breathe three times in the course of a drink (i. e. he drank in three gulps)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي عِصَامٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الشَّرَابِ ثَلاَثًا وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ أَرْوَى وَأَبْرَأُ وَأَمْرَأُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَأَنَا أَتَنَفَّسُ فِي الشَّرَابِ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an aabiy 'isaamin, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yatanaffasu fiy alshharaabi thalaathana wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnahu aarwaa waaabraau waaamraau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aanasun faaanaa aatanaffasu fiy alshharaabi thalaathana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) breathed three times (outside the vessel) in the course of a drink and said:It is more thirst- quenching, healthier and more wholesome. Anas said: So I also breathe three times in the course of a drink
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عِصَامٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَقَالَ فِي الإِنَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an hishaamin, alddastawaaiiyyi 'an aabiy 'isaamin, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi waqaala fiy aliinaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported on the authority of Anas with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِلَبَنٍ قَدْ شِيبَ بِمَاءٍ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَعْرَابِيٌّ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ أَعْطَى الأَعْرَابِيَّ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الأَيْمَنَ فَالأَيْمَنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya bilabanin qad shiyba bimaa'in wa'an yamiynihi aa'raabiyyun wa'an yasaarihi aabuw bakrin fashariba thumma aa'taa alaa'raabiyya waqaala ‏ "‏ alaaymana faalaaymana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that there was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) a cup of milk mixed with water, while there was on his right a desert Arab and on his left Abu Bakr. He (the Holy Prophet) drank; he then gave it to the desert Arab and said:(Give to one) who is on the right, then again who is on the right
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَأَنَا ابْنُ عَشْرٍ وَمَاتَ وَأَنَا ابْنُ عِشْرِينَ وَكُنَّ أُمَّهَاتِي يَحْثُثْنَنِي عَلَى خِدْمَتِهِ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا دَارَنَا فَحَلَبْنَا لَهُ مِنْ شَاةٍ دَاجِنٍ وَشِيبَ لَهُ مِنْ بِئْرٍ فِي الدَّارِ فَشَرِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَعْطِ أَبَا بَكْرٍ ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَاهُ أَعْرَابِيًّا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الأَيْمَنَ فَالأَيْمَنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi, alllahi bni numayrin - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aanasin, qaala qadima alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa waaanaa abnu 'ashrin wamaata waaanaa abnu 'ishriyna wakunna aummahaatiy yahthuthnaniy 'alaa khidmatihi fadakhala 'alaynaa daaranaa fahalabnaa lahu min shaaain daajinin washiyba lahu min biirin fiy alddaari fashariba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lahu 'umaru waaabuw bakrin 'an shimaalihi yaa rasuwla alllahi aa'ti aabaa bakrin ‏.‏ faaa'taahu aa'raabiyyana 'an yamiynihi waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alaaymana faalaaymana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:The Apostle of Allah (may peace he upon him) came to Medina when I was ten years old and he died when I was twenty years old. My mother exhorted me to serve him. He (the Holy Prophet) came to our house, and we ruined a flabby goat for him and mixed it (the milk) with water from the well of the house. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) drank that. Umar and Abu Bakr on his left side said to him: Allah's Messenger, give it to Abu Bakr, but he (the Holy Prophet) gave it to the desert Arab who was on his right. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He who is on the right, then he who is on the right
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ أَبِي طُوَالَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ أَتَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي دَارِنَا فَاسْتَسْقَى فَحَلَبْنَا لَهُ شَاةً ثُمَّ شُبْتُهُ مِنْ مَاءِ بِئْرِي هَذِهِ - قَالَ - فَأَعْطَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَشَرِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ وَعُمَرُ وُجَاهَهُ وَأَعْرَابِيٌّ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ شُرْبِهِ قَالَ عُمَرُ هَذَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ يُرِيهِ إِيَّاهُ فَأَعْطَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الأَعْرَابِيَّ وَتَرَكَ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الأَيْمَنُونَ الأَيْمَنُونَ الأَيْمَنُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَهِيَ سُنَّةٌ فَهِيَ سُنَّةٌ فَهِيَ سُنَّةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni ma'mari bni hazmin aabiy tuwaalaaa alaansaariyyi, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yuhaddithu qaala aataanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy daarinaa faastasqaa fahalabnaa lahu shaaaan thumma shubtuhu min maa'i biiriy hadhihi - qaala - faaa'taytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fashariba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin 'an yasaarihi wa'umaru wujaahahu waaa'raabiyyun 'an yamiynihi falammaa faragha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min shurbihi qaala 'umaru hadhaa aabuw bakrin yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ yuriyhi iiyyaahu faaa'taa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alaa'raabiyya wataraka aabaa bakrin wa'umara waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alaaymanuwna alaaymanuwna alaaymanuwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aanasun fahiya sunnaaun fahiya sunnaaun fahiya sunnaaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to our house and he asked for a drink. We milked a goat for him and then mixed it (the milk) with the water of this well of mine. I gave it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he drank it, while Abu Bakr was on his left and 'Umar was in front of him, and a desert Arab was on his right. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the drink, Umar said: Allah's Messenger, here is Abu Bakr, give him to drink; but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave it to the desert Arab and he left out Abu Bakr and Umar. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Those on the right, those on the right, those on the right (deserve preference). Anas said: This is the Sunnah, this is the Sunnah, this is the Sunnah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُتِيَ بِشَرَابٍ فَشَرِبَ مِنْهُ وَعَنْ يَمِينِهِ غُلاَمٌ وَعَنْ يَسَارِهِ أَشْيَاخٌ فَقَالَ لِلْغُلاَمِ ‏"‏ أَتَأْذَنُ لِي أَنْ أُعْطِيَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْغُلاَمُ لاَ ‏.‏ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُوثِرُ بِنَصِيبِي مِنْكَ أَحَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَلَّهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي يَدِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm autiya bisharaabin fashariba minhu wa'an yamiynihi ghulaamun wa'an yasaarihi aashyaakhun faqaala lilghulaami ‏"‏ aataadhanu liy aan au'tiya hauulaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala alghulaamu laa ‏.‏ waalllahi laa auwthiru binasiybiy minka aahadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fatallahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy yadihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd Sa'idi reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was given a drink, and he drank from that, and there was on his right side a boy. and on his left some old men. He said to the boy:Do you permit me to give it to them (the old men), but that boy said: by God. I will not give preference at your hand over me in my share. He (the narrator) said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then gave it in his hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ، سَعِيدٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَقُولاَ فَتَلَّهُ ‏.‏ وَلَكِنْ فِي رِوَايَةِ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy haazimin, h wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau bnu, sa'iydin haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - kilaahumaa 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli, bni sa'din 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi walam yaquwlaa fatallahu ‏.‏ walakin fiy riwaayaai ya'quwba qaala faaa'taahu iiyyaahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا - سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ طَعَامًا فَلاَ يَمْسَحْ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَهَا أَوْ يُلْعِقَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa - sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'an 'ataa'in, 'ani abni, 'abbaasin qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aakala aahadukum ta'aamana falaa yamsah yadahu hattaa yal'aqahaa aaw yul'iqahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him.) as saying:When any one of you eats food he should not wipe his hand until he has licked it or has it licked
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَطَاءً، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ فَلاَ يَمْسَحْ يَدَهُ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَهَا أَوْ يُلْعِقَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaraniy aabuw 'aasimin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni jurayjin, h wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, qaala sami'tu 'ataa'an, yaquwlu sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa aakala aahadukum mina altta'aami falaa yamsah yadahu hattaa yal'aqahaa aaw yul'iqahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you eats food he should not wipe his hand until he has licked it or have it licked
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، مَهْدِيٍّ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلْعَقُ أَصَابِعَهُ الثَّلاَثَ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ الثَّلاَثَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, qaaluwa haddathanaa abnu, mahdiyyin 'an sufyaana, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'ani abni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yal'aqu aasaabi'ahu althhalaatha mina altta'aami ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri abnu haatimin althhalaatha ‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy shaybaaa fiy riwaayatihi 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni ka'bin 'an aabiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Ka'b b. Malik reported on the authority of his father that he saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) licking his three fingers (after having finished the food). Ibn Hatim made no mention of" three". This hadith is also narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْكُلُ بِثَلاَثِ أَصَابِعَ وَيَلْعَقُ يَدَهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمْسَحَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni sa'din 'ani abni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaakulu bithalaathi aasaabi'a wayal'aqu yadahu qabla aan yamsahahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Ka'b b. Malik reported on the authority of his father that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) used to eat (food) with three fingers and he licked his hand before wiping it (with towel)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، - أَوْ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ كَعْبٍ - أَخْبَرَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، كَعْبٍ أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْكُلُ بِثَلاَثِ أَصَابِعَ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ لَعِقَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni sa'din aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna ka'bi bni maalikin, - aaw 'abda alllahi bna ka'bin - aakhbarahu 'an aabiyhi, ka'bin aannahu haddathahum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaakulu bithalaathi aasaabi'a faiidhaa faragha la'iqahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Ka'b reported that his father Ka'b narrated to him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to eat with three fingers and when he had finished (eating), he licked them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّحَدَّثَاهُ - أَوْ، أَحَدُهُمَا - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni sa'din, aannahaddathaahu - aaw, aahaduhumaa - 'an aabiyhi, ka'bi bni maalikin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been reported on the authority of Ka'b b. Malik through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ بِلَعْقِ الأَصَابِعِ وَالصَّحْفَةِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّكُمْ لاَ تَدْرُونَ فِي أَيِّهِ الْبَرَكَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara bila'qi alaasaabi'i waalssahfaai waqaala ‏ "‏ iinnakum laa tadruwna fiy aayyihi albarakaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded the licking of fingers and the dish, saying:You do not know in what portion the blessing lies
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا وَقَعَتْ لُقْمَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيَأْخُذْهَا فَلْيُمِطْ مَا كَانَ بِهَا مِنْ أَذًى وَلْيَأْكُلْهَا وَلاَ يَدَعْهَا لِلشَّيْطَانِ وَلاَ يَمْسَحْ يَدَهُ بِالْمِنْدِيلِ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَ أَصَابِعَهُ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي فِي أَىِّ طَعَامِهِ الْبَرَكَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa waqa'at luqmaau aahadikum falyaakhudhhaa falyumit maa kaana bihaa min aadhana walyaakulhaa walaa yada'haa lilshhaytaani walaa yamsah yadahu bialmindiyli hattaa yal'aqa aasaabi'ahu faiinnahu laa yadriy fiy aaaai ta'aamihi albarakaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you drops a mouthful he should pick it up and remove any of the filth on it, and then eat it, and should not leave it for the Satan, and should not wipe his hand with towel until he has licked his fingers, for he does not know in what portion of the food the blessing lies
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْحَفَرِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏ "‏ وَلاَ يَمْسَحْ يَدَهُ بِالْمِنْدِيلِ حَتَّى يَلْعَقَهَا أَوْ يُلْعِقَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَمَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aabuw daawuda alhafariyyu, h wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu, raafi'in haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, kilaahumaa 'an sufyaana, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihimaa ‏ "‏ walaa yamsah yadahu bialmindiyli hattaa yal'aqahaa aaw yul'iqahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wamaa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَحْضُرُ أَحَدَكُمْ عِنْدَ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مِنْ شَأْنِهِ حَتَّى يَحْضُرَهُ عِنْدَ طَعَامِهِ فَإِذَا سَقَطَتْ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمُ اللُّقْمَةُ فَلْيُمِطْ مَا كَانَ بِهَا مِنْ أَذًى ثُمَّ لْيَأْكُلْهَا وَلاَ يَدَعْهَا لِلشَّيْطَانِ فَإِذَا فَرَغَ فَلْيَلْعَقْ أَصَابِعَهُ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي فِي أَىِّ طَعَامِهِ تَكُونُ الْبَرَكَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alshhaytaana yahduru aahadakum 'inda kulli shaa'in min shaanihi hattaa yahdurahu 'inda ta'aamihi faiidhaa saqatat min aahadikumu allluqmaau falyumit maa kaana bihaa min aadhana thumma lyaakulhaa walaa yada'haa lilshhaytaani faiidhaa faragha falyal'aq aasaabi'ahu faiinnahu laa yadriy fiy aaaai ta'aamihi takuwnu albarakaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: The Satan is present with any one of you in everything he does; he is present even when he eats food; so if any one of you drops a mouthful he should remove away anything filthy on it and eat it and not leave for the devil; and when he finishes (food) he should lick his fingers, for he does not know in what portion of his food the blessing lies
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏"‏ إِذَا سَقَطَتْ لُقْمَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَوَّلَ الْحَدِيثِ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ يَحْضُرُ أَحَدَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏"‏ iidhaa saqatat luqmaau aahadikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaa akhiri alhadiythi walam yadhkur aawwala alhadiythi ‏"‏ iinna alshhaytaana yahduru aahadakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of words but no mention is made of the first part of the hadith, i. e. the Satan is present with any one of you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي، صَالِحٍ وَأَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ذِكْرِ اللَّعْقِ ‏.‏ وَعَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَذَكَرَ اللُّقْمَةَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy, saalihin waaabiy sufyaana 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy dhikri allla'qi ‏.‏ wa'an aabiy sufyaana 'an jaabirin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wadhakara allluqmaaa nahwa hadiythihimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported from Allah's Messenger. (ﷺ) about mentioning the licking (of fingers) and the (falling of) the mouthful
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ، بْنُ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَكَلَ طَعَامًا لَعِقَ أَصَابِعَهُ الثَّلاَثَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا سَقَطَتْ لُقْمَةُ أَحَدِكُمْ فَلْيُمِطْ عَنْهَا الأَذَى وَلْيَأْكُلْهَا وَلاَ يَدَعْهَا لِلشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَمَرَنَا أَنْ نَسْلُتَ الْقَصْعَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّكُمْ لاَ تَدْرُونَ فِي أَىِّ طَعَامِكُمُ الْبَرَكَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in al'abdiyyu qaalaa haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa hammaadu, bnu salamaaa haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aakala ta'aamana la'iqa aasaabi'ahu althhalaatha ‏.‏ qaala waqaala ‏"‏ iidhaa saqatat luqmaau aahadikum falyumit 'anhaa alaadhaa walyaakulhaa walaa yada'haa lilshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaamaranaa aan nasluta alqas'aaa qaala ‏"‏ faiinnakum laa tadruwna fiy aaaai ta'aamikumu albarakaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ate food he licked his three fingers, and he said:When any one of you drops a mouthful he should remove anything filthy from it and then eat it, and should not leave it for the Satan. He also commanded us that we should wipe the dish saying: You do not know in what portion of your food the blessing lies
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَكَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ فَلْيَلْعَقْ أَصَابِعَهُ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَدْرِي فِي أَيَّتِهِنَّ الْبَرَكَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa suhaylun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aakala aahadukum falyal'aq aasaabi'ahu faiinnahu laa yadriy fiy aayyatihinna albarakaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When any one of you eats food he should lick his fingers, for he does not know in what part of the food sticking to his fingers the blessing lies
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلْيَسْلُتْ أَحْدُكُمُ الصَّحْفَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ فِي أَىِّ طَعَامِكُمُ الْبَرَكَةُ أَوْ يُبَارَكُ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'niy abna mahdiyyin - qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ walyaslut aahdukumu alssahfaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ fiy aaaai ta'aamikumu albarakaau aaw yubaaraku lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hammad with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو شُعَيْبٍ وَكَانَ لَهُ غُلاَمٌ لَحَّامٌ فَرَأَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَرَفَ فِي وَجْهِهِ الْجُوعَ فَقَالَ لِغُلاَمِهِ وَيْحَكَ اصْنَعْ لَنَا طَعَامًا لِخَمْسَةِ نَفَرٍ فَإِنِّي أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَدْعُوَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَامِسَ خَمْسَةٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَصَنَعَ ثُمَّ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَاهُ خَامِسَ خَمْسَةٍ وَاتَّبَعَهُمْ رَجُلٌ فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ الْبَابَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذَا اتَّبَعَنَا فَإِنْ شِئْتَ أَنْ تَأْذَنَ لَهُ وَإِنْ شِئْتَ رَجَعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ بَلْ آذَنُ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - wataqaarabaa fiy alllafzi - qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin alaansaariyyi, qaala kaana rajulun mina alaansaari yuqaalu lahu aabuw shu'aybin wakaana lahu ghulaamun lahhaamun faraaaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fa'arafa fiy wajhihi aljuw'a faqaala lighulaamihi wayhaka asna' lanaa ta'aamana likhamsaai nafarin faiinniy auriydu aan aad'uwa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm khaamisa khamsaain ‏.‏ qaala fasana'a thumma aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fada'aahu khaamisa khamsaain waattaba'ahum rajulun falammaa balagha albaaba qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna hadhaa attaba'anaa faiin shiita aan taadhana lahu waiin shiita raja'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa bal adhanu lahu yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Mas'ud Ansari reported that a person from the Ansar who was called Abu Shu'aib had a slave who was a butcher (by profession). He (Abu Mas'ud) saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and found signs of hunger on his face. He said to the servant:0 ye, prepare for us food sufficient for five persons, for I intend to invite Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who would be the fifth amongst the five. He (the narrator) reported that he then prepared the food and came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and invited all the five (including him) who was the fifth amongst them to the feast. A man followed him and when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reached the door, he said: This man has followed us; if you like you may permit him (to join the meal) and if you like he can go back. Thereupon the person said: Allah's Messenger, I permit him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ لِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، حَدَّثَنَا شَقِيقُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ، الأَنْصَارِيُّ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaahu nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yuwsufa, 'an sufyaana, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, bihadhaa alhadiythi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythi jariyrin ‏.‏ qaala nasru bnu 'aliyyin fiy riwaayatihi lihadhaa alhadiythi haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, haddathanaa shaqiyqu bnu salamaaa, haddathanaa aabuw mas'uwdin, alaansaariyyu ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Mas'ud Ansari through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ أَبِي رَوَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْجَوَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارٌ، - وَهْوَ ابْنُ رُزَيْقٍ - عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni jabalaaa bni aabiy rawwaadin, haddathanaa aabuw aljawwaabi, haddathanaa 'ammaarun, - wahwa abnu ruzayqin - 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, h wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an aabiy mas'uwdin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, bihadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir also
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ جَارًا، لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَارِسِيًّا كَانَ طَيِّبَ الْمَرَقِ فَصَنَعَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ جَاءَ يَدْعُوهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَهَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لِعَائِشَةَ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ فَعَادَ يَدْعُوهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَهَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ عَادَ يَدْعُوهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَهَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فِي الثَّالِثَةِ ‏.‏ فَقَامَا يَتَدَافَعَانِ حَتَّى أَتَيَا مَنْزِلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, aanna jaarana, lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faarisiyyana kaana tayyiba almaraqi fasana'a lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma jaa'a yad'uwhu faqaala ‏"‏ wahadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ li'aaiishaaa faqaala laa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ fa'aada yad'uwhu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wahadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma 'aada yad'uwhu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wahadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ fiy althhaalithaai ‏.‏ faqaamaa yatadaafa'aani hattaa aatayaa manzilahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a Persian neighbour who made excellent soup. He prepared some for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and then came to him to invite him to eat. He (Allah's Messenger) said, "and her too," referring to `Aisha. The man said "No," so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said "No." He returned later to invite him again, so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said "and her too." The man said "No," so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said "No." He returned another time to invite him and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said, "and her too." The man said yes on this third occasion, and they then stood eagerly to go out together to the man's home
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ خَلِيفَةَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ أَوْ لَيْلَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ بِأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَخْرَجَكُمَا مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمَا هَذِهِ السَّاعَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالاَ الْجُوعُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَأَنَا وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لأَخْرَجَنِي الَّذِي أَخْرَجَكُمَا قُومُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامُوا مَعَهُ فَأَتَى رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَإِذَا هُوَ لَيْسَ فِي بَيْتِهِ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ الْمَرْأَةُ قَالَتْ مَرْحَبًا وَأَهْلاً ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيْنَ فُلاَنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ ذَهَبَ يَسْتَعْذِبُ لَنَا مِنَ الْمَاءِ ‏.‏ إِذْ جَاءَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ فَنَظَرَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَاحِبَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ مَا أَحَدٌ الْيَوْمَ أَكْرَمَ أَضْيَافًا مِنِّي - قَالَ - فَانْطَلَقَ فَجَاءَهُمْ بِعِذْقٍ فِيهِ بُسْرٌ وَتَمْرٌ وَرُطَبٌ فَقَالَ كُلُوا مِنْ هَذِهِ ‏.‏ وَأَخَذَ الْمُدْيَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِيَّاكَ وَالْحَلُوبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَبَحَ لَهُمْ فَأَكَلُوا مِنَ الشَّاةِ وَمِنْ ذَلِكَ الْعِذْقِ وَشَرِبُوا فَلَمَّا أَنْ شَبِعُوا وَرَوُوا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَتُسْأَلُنَّ عَنْ هَذَا النَّعِيمِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَخْرَجَكُمْ مِنْ بُيُوتِكُمُ الْجُوعُ ثُمَّ لَمْ تَرْجِعُوا حَتَّى أَصَابَكُمْ هَذَا النَّعِيمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa khalafu bnu khaliyfaaa, 'an yaziyda bni kaysaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata yawmin aaw laylaain faiidhaa huwa biaabiy bakrin wa'umara faqaala ‏"‏ maa aakhrajakumaa min buyuwtikumaa hadhihi alssaa'aaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalaa aljuw'u yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waaanaa waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laakhrajaniy alladhiy aakhrajakumaa quwmuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaamuwa ma'ahu faaataa rajulaan mina alaansaari faiidhaa huwa laysa fiy baytihi falammaa raaathu almaraaau qaalat marhabana waaahlaan ‏.‏ faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayna fulaanun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat dhahaba yasta'dhibu lanaa mina almaa'i ‏.‏ iidh jaa'a alaansaariyyu fanazara iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasaahibayhi thumma qaala alhamdu lillahi maa aahadun alyawma aakrama aadyaafana minniy - qaala - faantalaqa fajaa'ahum bi'idhqin fiyhi busrun watamrun warutabun faqaala kuluwa min hadhihi ‏.‏ waaakhadha almudyaaa faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iiyyaaka waalhaluwba ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhabaha lahum faaakaluwa mina alshhaaai wamin dhalika al'idhqi washaribuwa falammaa aan shabi'uwa warawuwa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laabiy bakrin wa'umara ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi latusaalunna 'an hadhaa alnna'iymi yawma alqiyaamaai aakhrajakum min buyuwtikumu aljuw'u thumma lam tarji'uwa hattaa aasaabakum hadhaa alnna'iymu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out (of his house) one day or one night, and there he found Abu Bakr and 'Umar also. He said:What has brought you out of your houses at this hour? They said: Allah's Messenger, it is hunger. Thereupon he said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, what has brought you out has brought me out too; get up. They got up along with him. and (all of them) came to the house of an Ansari, but he was not at home. When his wife saw him she said: Most welcome, and Allah's Messenger (may peace be Upon him) said to her: Where is so and so? She said: He has gone to get some fresh water for us. When the Ansari came and he saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and his two Companions, he said: Praise be to Allah, no one has more honourable guests today than I (have). He then went out and brought them a bunch of ripe dates, dry dates and fresh dates, and said: Eat some of them. He then took hold of his long knife (for slaughtering a goat or a sheep). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Beware of killing a milch animal. He slaughtered a sheep for them and after they had eaten of it and of the bunch and drank, and when they had taken their fill and had been fully satisfied with the drink, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Abu Bakr and Umar: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, you will certainly be questioned about this bounty on the Day of judgment. Hunger brought you out of your house, then you did not return until this bounty came to you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو هِشَامٍ، - يَعْنِي الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ سَلَمَةَ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَازِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ بَيْنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ قَاعِدٌ وَعُمَرُ مَعَهُ إِذْ أَتَاهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا أَقْعَدَكُمَا هَا هُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالاَ أَخْرَجَنَا الْجُوعُ مِنْ بُيُوتِنَا وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ خَلَفِ بْنِ خَلِيفَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw hishaamin, - ya'niy almughiyraaa bna salamaaa - haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, haddathanaa yaziydu, haddathanaa aabuw haazimin, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu baynaa aabuw bakrin qaa'idun wa'umaru ma'ahu iidh aataahumaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ maa aaq'adakumaa haa hunaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalaa aakhrajanaa aljuw'u min buyuwtinaa waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi khalafi bni khaliyfaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:One day while Abu Bakr was sitting and there was with him Umar also there came to them Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said: What makes you stay here? They said: It is hunger that has brought us out from our houses. By Him Who has stint you with Truth; the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنِي الضَّحَّاكُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، مِنْ رُقْعَةٍ عَارَضَ لِي بِهَا ثُمَّ قَرَأَهُ عَلَىَّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَاهُ حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مِينَاءَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ لَمَّا حُفِرَ الْخَنْدَقُ رَأَيْتُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمَصًا فَانْكَفَأْتُ إِلَى امْرَأَتِي فَقُلْتُ لَهَا هَلْ عِنْدَكِ شَىْءٌ فَإِنِّي رَأَيْتُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَمَصًا شَدِيدًا ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْ لِي جِرَابًا فِيهِ صَاعٌ مِنْ شَعِيرٍ وَلَنَا بُهَيْمَةٌ دَاجِنٌ - قَالَ - فَذَبَحْتُهَا وَطَحَنَتْ فَفَرَغَتْ إِلَى فَرَاغِي فَقَطَّعْتُهَا فِي بُرْمَتِهَا ثُمَّ وَلَّيْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ لاَ تَفْضَحْنِي بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَنْ مَعَهُ - قَالَ - فَجِئْتُهُ فَسَارَرْتُهُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا قَدْ ذَبَحْنَا بُهَيْمَةً لَنَا وَطَحَنَتْ صَاعًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ كَانَ عِنْدَنَا فَتَعَالَ أَنْتَ فِي نَفَرٍ مَعَكَ ‏.‏ فَصَاحَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَهْلَ الْخَنْدَقِ إِنَّ جَابِرًا قَدْ صَنَعَ لَكُمْ سُورًا فَحَيَّهَلاَ بِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُنْزِلُنَّ بُرْمَتَكُمْ وَلاَ تَخْبِزُنَّ عَجِينَتَكُمْ حَتَّى أَجِيءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُ وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْدُمُ النَّاسَ حَتَّى جِئْتُ امْرَأَتِي فَقَالَتْ بِكَ وَبِكَ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ قَدْ فَعَلْتُ الَّذِي قُلْتِ لِي ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجْتُ لَهُ عَجِينَتَنَا فَبَصَقَ فِيهَا وَبَارَكَ ثُمَّ عَمَدَ إِلَى بُرْمَتِنَا فَبَصَقَ فِيهَا وَبَارَكَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ادْعِي خَابِزَةً فَلْتَخْبِزْ مَعَكِ وَاقْدَحِي مِنْ بُرْمَتِكُمْ وَلاَ تُنْزِلُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَهُمْ أَلْفٌ فَأُقْسِمُ بِاللَّهِ لأَكَلُوا حَتَّى تَرَكُوهُ وَانْحَرَفُوا وَإِنَّ بُرْمَتَنَا لَتَغِطُّ كَمَا هِيَ وَإِنَّ عَجِينَتَنَا - أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ الضَّحَّاكُ - لَتُخْبَزُ كَمَا هُوَ ‏.‏
