verses.translit: haddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathaniy alddahhaaku bnu makhladin, min ruq'aain 'aarada liy bihaa thumma qaraaahu 'alaaaa qaala aakhbaranaahu hanzalaau bnu aabiy sufyaana haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu miynaa'a qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi yaquwlu lammaa hufira alkhandaqu raaaytu birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khamasana faankafaatu iilaa amraaatiy faqultu lahaa hal 'indaki shaa'un faiinniy raaaytu birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khamasana shadiydana ‏.‏ faaakhrajat liy jiraabana fiyhi saa'un min sha'iyrin walanaa buhaymaaun daajinun - qaala - fadhabahtuhaa watahanat fafaraghat iilaa faraaghiy faqatta'tuhaa fiy burmatihaa thumma wallaytu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat laa tafdahniy birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waman ma'ahu - qaala - fajiituhu fasaarartuhu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa qad dhabahnaa buhaymaaan lanaa watahanat saa'ana min sha'iyrin kaana 'indanaa fata'aala aanta fiy nafarin ma'aka ‏.‏ fasaaha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala ‏"‏ yaa aahla alkhandaqi iinna jaabirana qad sana'a lakum suwrana fahayyahalaa bikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tunzilunna burmatakum walaa takhbizunna 'ajiynatakum hattaa aajiy'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fajiitu wajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqdumu alnnaasa hattaa jiitu amraaatiy faqaalat bika wabika ‏.‏ faqultu qad fa'altu alladhiy qulti liy ‏.‏ faaakhrajtu lahu 'ajiynatanaa fabasaqa fiyhaa wabaaraka thumma 'amada iilaa burmatinaa fabasaqa fiyhaa wabaaraka thumma qaala ‏"‏ ad'iy khaabizaaan faltakhbiz ma'aki waaqdahiy min burmatikum walaa tunziluwhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahum aalfun faauqsimu bialllahi laakaluwa hattaa tarakuwhu waanharafuwa waiinna burmatanaa lataghittu kamaa hiya waiinna 'ajiynatanaa - aaw kamaa qaala alddahhaaku - latukhbazu kamaa huwa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:When the ditch was dug, I saw Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) feeling very hungry. I came to my wife and said to her: Is there anything with you? I have seen Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) feeling extremely hungry. She brought out a bag of provisions which contained a sa', of barley. We had also with us a lamb. I slaughtered it. She ground the flour. She finished (this work) along with me. I cut it into pieces and put it in the earthen pot and then returned to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) (for inviting him). She said: Do not humiliate me in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and those who are with him. When I came to him I whispered to him saying: Allah's Messenger, we have slaughtered a lamb for you and she has ground a sa' of barley which we had with us. So you come along with a group of people with you. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said loudly: O people of the ditch, Jabir has arranged a feast for you, so (come along). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Do not remove your earthen pot from the hearth and do not bake the bread from the kneaded flour until I come. So I came and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came and he was ahead of the people; and I came to my wife and she said (to me): You will be humbled. I said: I did what you had asked me to do. She (his wife) said: I brought out the kneaded flour and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put some saliva of his in that and blessed It. He then put saliva in the earthen pot and blessed it and then said. Call another baker who can bake with you. and bring out the soup from it, but do not remove it from the hearth, and the guests were one thousand. (Jabir said): I take an oath by Allah that all of them ate (the food to their fill) until they left it and went away and our earthen pot was brimming over as before, and so was the case with our flour, or as Dahhak (another narrator) said: It (the flour) was in the same condition and loaves had been prepared from that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ لأُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ قَدْ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَعِيفًا أَعْرِفُ فِيهِ الْجُوعَ فَهَلْ عِنْدَكِ مِنْ شَىْءٍ فَقَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْ أَقْرَاصًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ ثُمَّ أَخَذَتْ خِمَارًا لَهَا فَلَفَّتِ الْخُبْزَ بِبَعْضِهِ ثُمَّ دَسَّتْهُ تَحْتَ ثَوْبِي وَرَدَّتْنِي بِبَعْضِهِ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَتْنِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَذَهَبْتُ بِهِ فَوَجَدْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَالِسًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَمَعَهُ النَّاسُ فَقُمْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَرْسَلَكَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلِطَعَامٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِمَنْ مَعَهُ ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَانْطَلَقَ وَانْطَلَقْتُ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ حَتَّى جِئْتُ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ قَدْ جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالنَّاسِ وَلَيْسَ عِنْدَنَا مَا نُطْعِمُهُمْ فَقَالَتِ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ - قَالَ - فَانْطَلَقَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ حَتَّى لَقِيَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَقْبَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَهُ حَتَّى دَخَلاَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلُمِّي مَا عِنْدَكِ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَتْ بِذَلِكَ الْخُبْزِ فَأَمَرَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَفُتَّ وَعَصَرَتْ عَلَيْهِ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ عُكَّةً لَهَا فَأَدَمَتْهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ فِيهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ثُمَّ خَرَجُوا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ حَتَّى أَكَلَ الْقَوْمُ كُلُّهُمْ وَشَبِعُوا وَالْقَوْمُ سَبْعُونَ رَجُلاً أَوْ ثَمَانُونَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maaliki bni aanasin 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi, alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu qaala aabuw talhaaa laummi sulaymin qad sami'tu sawta, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm da'iyfana aa'rifu fiyhi aljuw'a fahal 'indaki min shaa'in faqaalat na'am ‏.‏ faaakhrajat aaqraasana min sha'iyrin thumma aakhadhat khimaarana lahaa falaffati alkhubza biba'dihi thumma dassathu tahta thawbiy waraddatniy biba'dihi thumma aarsalatniy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fadhahabtu bihi fawajadtu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jaalisana fiy almasjidi wama'ahu alnnaasu faqumtu 'alayhim faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aarsalaka aabuw talhaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu na'am ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aalita'aamin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu na'am ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liman ma'ahu ‏"‏ quwmuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faantalaqa waantalaqtu bayna aaydiyhim hattaa jiitu aabaa talhaaa faaakhbartuhu faqaala aabuw talhaaa yaa aumma sulaymin qad jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialnnaasi walaysa 'indanaa maa nut'imuhum faqaalati alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu - qaala - faantalaqa aabuw talhaaa hattaa laqiya rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaqbala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'ahu hattaa dakhalaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ halummiy maa 'indaki yaa aumma sulaymin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaatat bidhalika alkhubzi faaamara bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fafutta wa'asarat 'alayhi aummu sulaymin 'ukkaaan lahaa faaadamathu thumma qaala fiyhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa shaa'a alllahu aan yaquwla thumma qaala ‏"‏ aidhan li'asharaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaadhina lahum faaakaluwa hattaa shabi'uwa thumma kharajuwa thumma qaala ‏"‏ aidhan li'asharaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaadhina lahum faaakaluwa hattaa shabi'uwa thumma kharajuwa thumma qaala ‏"‏ aidhan li'asharaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ hattaa aakala alqawmu kulluhum washabi'uwa waalqawmu sab'uwna rajulaan aaw thamaanuwna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Abu Talha said to Umm Sulaim:I felt some feebleness in the voice of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and perceived that it was due to hunger; so have you anything with you? She said: Yes. She brought out barley loaves, then took out a head-covering of hers, in a part of which she wrapped those loaves and then put them beneath my mantle and covered me with a part of it. She then sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I set forth and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sitting in the mosque in the company of some persons. I stood near them, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Has Abu Talha sent you? I said, Yes. He said: Is it for a feast? I said. Yes. Thereupon Allah's messenger (ﷺ) said to'those who were with him to get up He went forth and so I did before them, until I came to Abu Talha and informed him. Abu Talba said: Umm Sulaim, here comes Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with people and we do not have enough (food) to feed them. She said: Allah and His Messenger know best. Abu Talha went out (to receive him) Until he met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came forward along with him until they both (Allah's Messenger, along with Abu Talha) came in. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Umm Sulaim. bring forth that which you have with you. She brought the bread. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that the bread be broken into small pieces, and when Umm Sulaim had squeezed a small waterskin and put seasoning on it, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recited something regarding it what Allah wished him to say. He then said: Allow ten (guests to come in and have their meals). He permitted them; they ate until they had their fill. They then went out. He (the Holy Prophet) again said: Permit ten (more) and he (the host gave permission to them. They ate until they had enough. Then they went out. he again said: Permit ten (more) until all the people had eaten to their fill, and they were seventy or eighty persons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَدْعُوَهُ وَقَدْ جَعَلَ طَعَامًا - قَالَ - فَأَقْبَلْتُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ النَّاسِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَىَّ فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ فَقُلْتُ أَجِبْ أَبَا طَلْحَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِلنَّاسِ ‏"‏ قُومُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا صَنَعْتُ لَكَ شَيْئًا - قَالَ - فَمَسَّهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَدَعَا فِيهَا بِالْبَرَكَةِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَدْخِلْ نَفَرًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِي عَشَرَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ كُلُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ شَيْئًا مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا فَخَرَجُوا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَدْخِلْ عَشَرَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى شَبِعُوا ‏.‏ فَمَا زَالَ يُدْخِلُ عَشَرَةً وَيُخْرِجُ عَشَرَةً حَتَّى لَمْ يَبْقَ مِنْهُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلاَّ دَخَلَ فَأَكَلَ حَتَّى شَبِعَ ثُمَّ هَيَّأَهَا فَإِذَا هِيَ مِثْلُهَا حِينَ أَكَلُوا مِنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sa'du bnu sa'iydin, haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala ba'athaniy aabuw talhaaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laad'uwahu waqad ja'ala ta'aamana - qaala - faaaqbaltu warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'a alnnaasi fanazara iilaaaa faastahyaytu faqultu aajib aabaa talhaaa ‏.‏ faqaala lilnnaasi ‏"‏ quwmuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw talhaaa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnamaa sana'tu laka shayiana - qaala - famassahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wada'aa fiyhaa bialbarakaai thumma qaala ‏"‏ aadkhil nafarana min aashaabiy 'asharaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ kuluwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaakhraja lahum shayiana min bayni aasaabi'ihi faaakaluwa hattaa shabi'uwa fakharajuwa faqaala ‏"‏ aadkhil 'asharaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaakaluwa hattaa shabi'uwa ‏.‏ famaa zaala yudkhilu 'asharaaan wayukhriju 'asharaaan hattaa lam yabqa minhum aahadun iilaaa dakhala faaakala hattaa shabi'a thumma hayyaaahaa faiidhaa hiya mithluhaa hiyna aakaluwa minhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:Abu Talha sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in order to invite him (for meal). She had prepared a meal. So I came and found Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with some people. He looked at me, and I felt shy and said: Accept the invitation of Abu Talha. He (the Holy Prophet) asked the people to get up. Thereupon Abu Talha said: Allah's Messenger, I have prepared something for you. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) touched (the food) and invoked blessings upon it, and then said: Let ten persons from my Companions enter (the house). He then said: Eat, and (in the meanwhile) brought out something from between his fingers for them. They then began to eat until they had their fill and then went out. He then asked ten more men (to have the meal) and they ate to their fill, and the ten persons went on getting in (and eating the food) and then getting out until none was left amongst them who had not got in and eaten to his fill. He then collected (the remaining part of the food) and it (the quantity of the food) was the same (as it had been prior to the serving of guests)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَنِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي آخِرِهِ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ مَا بَقِيَ فَجَمَعَهُ ثُمَّ دَعَا فِيهِ بِالْبَرَكَةِ - قَالَ - فَعَادَ كَمَا كَانَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ دُونَكُمْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy sa'iydu bnu yahyaa alaumawiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa sa'du bnu sa'iydin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, qaala ba'athaniy aabuw talhaaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythi abni numayrin ghayra aannahu qaala fiy akhirihi thumma aakhadha maa baqiya fajama'ahu thumma da'aa fiyhi bialbarakaai - qaala - fa'aada kamaa kaana faqaala ‏ "‏ duwnakum hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b Malik reported:Abu Talha sent me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same, but 'there is a slight variation of wording that he said at the end (The Holy Prophet) took what was left (of the food) and collected it and then invoked blessings upon it and it returned to its original state. He (the Holy Prophet) then said Take this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ الرَّقِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ أَمَرَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ أَنْ تَصْنَعَ، لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَعَامًا لِنَفْسِهِ خَاصَّةً ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَوَضَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ وَسَمَّى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لِعَشَرَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَذِنَ لَهُمْ فَدَخَلُوا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ كُلُوا وَسَمُّوا اللَّهَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَكَلُوا حَتَّى فَعَلَ ذَلِكَ بِثَمَانِينَ رَجُلاً ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَكَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ وَأَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ وَتَرَكُوا سُؤْرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'farin alrraqqiyyu, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'amrinw, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala aamara aabuw talhaaa aumma sulaymin aan tasna'a, lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ta'aamana linafsihi khaassaaan thumma aarsalaniy iilayhi ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha waqaala fiyhi fawada'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu wasammaa 'alayhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ aidhan li'asharaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaadhina lahum fadakhaluwa faqaala ‏"‏ kuluwa wasammuwa alllaha ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaakaluwa hattaa fa'ala dhalika bithamaaniyna rajulaan ‏.‏ thumma aakala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da dhalika waaahlu albayti watarakuwa suurana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:Abu Talha ordered Umm Sulaim to prepare a meal specially for Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He then sent me to him (to the Holy Prophet) ; the rest of the hadith is the same (but there is a slight variation of wording):" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) placed his hand and mentioned the name of Allah upon that, and then said: Admit ten men. He (Abu Talha) admitted them and they got in. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Eat while mentioning the name of Allah upon it (the meal). They ate until eighty persons had taken the food. Then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had his meal and so the members of the household, and still they left some food
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، ‏.‏ بِهَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ فِي طَعَامِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَقَامَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ عَلَى الْبَابِ حَتَّى أَتَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا كَانَ شَىْءٌ يَسِيرٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلُمَّهُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ سَيَجْعَلُ فِيهِ الْبَرَكَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, ‏.‏ bihadhihi alqissaai fiy ta'aami aabiy talhaaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala fiyhi faqaama aabuw talhaaa 'alaa albaabi hattaa aataa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lahu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnamaa kaana shaa'un yasiyrun ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ halummahu faiinna alllaha sayaj'alu fiyhi albarakaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported this incident pertaining to the feast given by Abu Talha to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) with the addition of these words:" Abu Talha stood at the door (to welcome the honourable guest) until Allah's Messenger (may peacec be upon him) came there, He (Abu Talha) said to him: Allah's Messenger, the thing (we intend to offer you as a meal) is small in quantity. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Bring that, for Allah will soon bless it (and increase it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ الْبَجَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَقَالَ فِيهِ ثُمَّ أَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَكَلَ أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ وَأَفْضَلُوا مَا أَبْلَغُوا جِيرَانَهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin albajaliyyu, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu muwsaa, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa alhadiythi waqaala fiyhi thumma aakala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaakala aahlu albayti waaafdaluwa maa aablaghuwa jiyraanahum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported this hadith (with a slight variation of wording) Then AlIah's Messenger (ﷺ) ate and the people of his house also ate. but (still) there was left a surplus, which they sent to their neighbours
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ جَرِيرَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ رَأَى أَبُو طَلْحَةَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُضْطَجِعًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَتَقَلَّبُ ظَهْرًا لِبَطْنٍ فَأَتَى أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُضْطَجِعًا فِي الْمَسْجِدِ يَتَقَلَّبُ ظَهْرًا لِبَطْنٍ وَأَظُنُّهُ جَائِعًا ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِيهِ ثُمَّ أَكَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو طَلْحَةَ وَأُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ وَأَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ وَفَضَلَتْ فَضْلَةٌ فَأَهْدَيْنَاهُ لِجِيرَانِنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa aabiy qaala, sami'tu jariyra bna zaydin, yuhaddithu 'an 'amriw bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala raaaa aabuw talhaaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mudtaji'ana fiy almasjidi yataqallabu zahrana libatnin faaataa aumma sulaymin faqaala iinniy raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mudtaji'ana fiy almasjidi yataqallabu zahrana libatnin waaazunnuhu jaaii'ana ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha waqaala fiyhi thumma aakala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw talhaaa waaummu sulaymin waaanasu bnu maalikin wafadalat fadlaaun faaahdaynaahu lijiyraaninaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:Abu Talha saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lying down upon his belly in the mosque. He came to Umm Sulaim and said: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lying down upon the belly in the mosque, and I think he is hungry. The rest of the hadith is the same (but with the addition of these words) that Allah's messenger (ﷺ) ate (the food) and so did Abu Talha, Umm Sulaim and Anas b. Malik, but there was left some. thing which we presented to our neighbours
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، أَنَّحَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ جِئْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فَوَجَدْتُهُ جَالِسًا مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ يُحَدِّثُهُمْ وَقَدْ عَصَّبَ بَطْنَهُ بِعِصَابَةٍ - قَالَ أُسَامَةُ وَأَنَا أَشُكُّ - عَلَى حَجَرٍ فَقُلْتُ لِبَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ لِمَ عَصَّبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَطْنَهُ فَقَالُوا مِنَ الْجُوعِ ‏.‏ فَذَهَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي طَلْحَةَ وَهُوَ زَوْجُ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ بِنْتِ مِلْحَانَ فَقُلْتُ يَا أَبَتَاهُ قَدْ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَصَّبَ بَطْنَهُ بِعِصَابَةٍ فَسَأَلْتُ بَعْضَ أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالُوا مِنَ الْجُوعِ ‏.‏ فَدَخَلَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ عَلَى أُمِّي فَقَالَ هَلْ مِنْ شَىْءٍ فَقَالَتْ نَعَمْ عِنْدِي كِسَرٌ مِنْ خُبْزٍ وَتَمَرَاتٌ فَإِنْ جَاءَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحْدَهُ أَشْبَعْنَاهُ وَإِنْ جَاءَ آخَرُ مَعَهُ قَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ سَائِرَ الْحَدِيثِ بِقِصَّتِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy ausaamaau, aannahaddathahu aannahu, sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu jiitu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana fawajadtuhu jaalisana ma'a aashaabihi yuhaddithuhum waqad 'assaba batnahu bi'isaabaain - qaala ausaamaau waaanaa aashukku - 'alaa hajarin faqultu liba'di aashaabihi lima 'assaba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm batnahu faqaaluwa mina aljuw'i ‏.‏ fadhahabtu iilaa aabiy talhaaa wahuwa zawju aummi sulaymin binti milhaana faqultu yaa aabataahu qad raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'assaba batnahu bi'isaabaain fasaaaltu ba'da aashaabihi faqaaluwa mina aljuw'i ‏.‏ fadakhala aabuw talhaaa 'alaa aummiy faqaala hal min shaa'in faqaalat na'am 'indiy kisarun min khubzin watamaraatun faiin jaa'anaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahdahu aashba'naahu waiin jaa'a akharu ma'ahu qalla 'anhum ‏.‏ thumma dhakara saaiira alhadiythi biqissatihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one day and found him sitting in the company of his Companions and talking to them, and he had tied his belly with a bandage. Usama said: I am in doubt whether there was stone on that (his belly) or not. I asked some of his Companions why Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had bandaged his belly. They said: (He has done that to relieve) his hunger. I went to Abu Talha, the husband of Umm Sulaim, the daughter of Milhan, and said to him: Father, I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having bandaged his belly. I asked some of his Companions (the reason of it) and they said that it was due to hunger. Abu Talha came to mv mother and said: Is there anything? She said: Yes, I have some pieces of bread with me and some dates. If Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) comes to us alone we can feed him to his fill, but if someone comes along with him this would be insufficient for them. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَرْبُ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنِ النَّضْرِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَعَامِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa harbu bnu maymuwnin, 'ani alnnadri bni aanasin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ta'aami aabiy talhaaa nahwa hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported this hadith pertaining to the entertainment of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) by Abu Talha through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ خَيَّاطًا دَعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِطَعَامٍ صَنَعَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ فَذَهَبْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى ذَلِكَ الطَّعَامِ فَقَرَّبَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خُبْزًا مِنْ شَعِيرٍ وَمَرَقًا فِيهِ دُبَّاءٌ وَقَدِيدٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَرَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَتَتَبَّعُ الدُّبَّاءَ مِنْ حَوَالَىِ الصَّحْفَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أُحِبُّ الدُّبَّاءَ مُنْذُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi, alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu iinna khayyaatana da'aa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lita'aamin sana'ahu ‏.‏ qaala aanasu bnu maalikin fadhahabtu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa dhalika altta'aami faqarraba iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khubzana min sha'iyrin wamaraqana fiyhi dubbaa'un waqadiydun ‏.‏ qaala aanasun faraaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yatatabba'u alddubbaa'a min hawaalaai alssahfaai ‏.‏ qaala falam aazal auhibbu alddubbaa'a mundhu yawmaiidhin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:A tailor invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to a meal which he had prepared. Anas b. Malik said: I went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to that feast. He presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) barley bread and soup containing pumpkin, and sliced pieces of meat. Anas said: I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) going after the pumpkin round the dish, so I have always liked the pumpkin since that day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ دَعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلٌ فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ فَجِيءَ بِمَرَقَةٍ فِيهَا دُبَّاءٌ فَجَعَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْكُلُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ الدُّبَّاءِ وَيُعْجِبُهُ - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا رَأَيْتُ ذَلِكَ جَعَلْتُ أُلْقِيهِ إِلَيْهِ وَلاَ أَطْعَمُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ فَمَا زِلْتُ بَعْدُ يُعْجِبُنِي الدُّبَّاءُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an sulaymaana bni almughiyraai, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala da'aa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun faantalaqtu ma'ahu fajiy'a bimaraqaain fiyhaa dubbaa'un faja'ala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaakulu min dhalika alddubbaa'i wayu'jibuhu - qaala - falammaa raaaytu dhalika ja'altu aulqiyhi iilayhi walaa aat'amuhu ‏.‏ qaala faqaala aanasun famaa ziltu ba'du yu'jibuniy alddubbaa'u ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that a person invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to a meal. I also went along with him. He brought soup containing pumpkin. Allah's 'messenger (ﷺ) ate that pumpkin with relish. He (Anas) said:When I saw that I began to place it before him, and did not eat it (myself). Anas said: It was since then that pumpkin was always my favourite (food)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، وَعَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، خَيَّاطًا دَعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَزَادَ قَالَ ثَابِتٌ فَسَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا يَقُولُ فَمَا صُنِعَ لِي طَعَامٌ بَعْدُ أَقْدِرُ عَلَى أَنْ يُصْنَعَ فِيهِ دُبَّاءٌ إِلاَّ صُنِعَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, wa'aasimin alaahwali, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rajulaan, khayyaatana da'aa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wazaada qaala thaabitun fasami'tu aanasana yaquwlu famaa suni'a liy ta'aamun ba'du aaqdiru 'alaa aan yusna'a fiyhi dubbaa'un iilaaa suni'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik rdported that a tailor invited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to a feast. There has been an addition to this that Thabit said:I heard Anas saying that any meal that was prepared for me after that I tried that it should contain pumpkin
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، بْنِ خُمَيْرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بُسْرٍ، قَالَ نَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى أَبِي - قَالَ - فَقَرَّبْنَا إِلَيْهِ طَعَامًا وَوَطْبَةً فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِتَمْرٍ فَكَانَ يَأْكُلُهُ وَيُلْقِي النَّوَى بَيْنَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ وَيَجْمَعُ السَّبَّابَةَ وَالْوُسْطَى - قَالَ شُعْبَةُ هُوَ ظَنِّي وَهُوَ فِيهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ إِلْقَاءُ النَّوَى بَيْنَ الإِصْبَعَيْنِ - ثُمَّ أُتِيَ بِشَرَابٍ فَشَرِبَهُ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَهُ الَّذِي عَنْ يَمِينِهِ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ أَبِي وَأَخَذَ بِلِجَامِ دَابَّتِهِ ادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِي مَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an yaziyda, bni khumayrin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni busrin, qaala nazala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa aabiy - qaala - faqarrabnaa iilayhi ta'aamana wawatbaaan faaakala minhaa thumma autiya bitamrin fakaana yaakuluhu wayulqiy alnnawaa bayna iisba'ayhi wayajma'u alssabbaabaaa waalwustaa - qaala shu'baau huwa zanniy wahuwa fiyhi iin shaa'a alllahu iilqaa'u alnnawaa bayna aliisba'ayni - thumma autiya bisharaabin fasharibahu thumma naawalahu alladhiy 'an yamiynihi - qaala - faqaala aabiy waaakhadha bilijaami daabbatihi ad'u alllaha lanaa faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma baarik lahum fiy maa razaqtahum waaghfir lahum waarhamhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Busr reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to my father and we brought to him a meal and a preparation from dates, cheese and butter. He ate out of that. He was then given dates which he ate, putting the stones between his fingers and holding his forefinger and middle finger together" - Shu'bah said: "I think we learn from this that one may hold the date stones between two fingers, In shaAllah." Then a drink was brought for him and he drank it, and then gave it to one who was on his right side. He (the narrator) said: My father took hold of the rein of his riding animal and requested him to supplicate for us. Thereupon he said: O Allah. bless them in what You have provided them as a sustenance; and forgive them and have mercy upon them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَشُكَّا فِي إِلْقَاءِ النَّوَى بَيْنَ الإِصْبَعَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hammaadin, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yashukkaa fiy iilqaa'i alnnawaa bayna aliisba'ayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters and they did not doubt about keeping the dates between his fingers (as is expressed in the previous hadith)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَوْنٍ الْهِلاَلِيُّ، - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا - إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْكُلُ الْقُثَّاءَ بِالرُّطَبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, wa'abdu alllahi bnu 'awnin alhilaaliyyu, - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu 'awnin, haddathanaa - iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ja'farin, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaakulu alquthhaa'a bialrrutabi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Ja'far reported:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) eating cucumber with fresh dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ حَفْصٍ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُقْعِيًا يَأْكُلُ تَمْرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju kilaahumaa 'an hafsin, qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, 'an mus'abi bni sulaymin, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm muq'iyana yaakulu tamrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:I saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) squatting and eating dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِتَمْرٍ فَجَعَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقْسِمُهُ وَهُوَ مُحْتَفِزٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَكْلاً ذَرِيعًا ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ زُهَيْرٍ أَكْلاً حَثِيثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana, qaala abnu aabiy 'umara haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an mus'abi bni sulaymin, 'an aanasin, qaala autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bitamrin faja'ala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yaqsimuhu wahuwa muhtafizun yaakulu minhu aaklaan dhariy'ana ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai zuhayrin aaklaan hathiythana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that there were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dates. He distributed them in the state that he had been sitting upright (in an easy posture) and he had also been eating them a (bit) quickly
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَبَلَةَ، بْنَ سُحَيْمٍ قَالَ كَانَ ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ يَرْزُقُنَا التَّمْرَ - قَالَ - وَقَدْ كَانَ أَصَابَ النَّاسَ يَوْمَئِذٍ جُهْدٌ وَكُنَّا نَأْكُلُ فَيَمُرُّ عَلَيْنَا ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَنَحْنُ نَأْكُلُ فَيَقُولُ لاَ تُقَارِنُوا فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الإِقْرَانِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَسْتَأْذِنَ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ لاَ أُرَى هَذِهِ الْكَلِمَةَ إِلاَّ مِنْ كَلِمَةِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الاِسْتِئْذَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu jabalaaa, bna suhaymin qaala kaana abnu alzzubayri yarzuqunaa alttamra - qaala - waqad kaana aasaaba alnnaasa yawmaiidhin juhdun wakunnaa naakulu fayamurru 'alaynaa abnu 'umara wanahnu naakulu fayaquwlu laa tuqaarinuwa faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani aliiqraani iilaaa aan yastaadhina alrrajulu aakhaahu ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau laa auraa hadhihi alkalimaaa iilaaa min kalimaai abni 'umara ‏.‏ ya'niy alaistiidhaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabala b. Suhaim reported:Ibn Zubair used to provide us with dates during the time that the people were hard pressed because of famine (Once) as we were busy in eating there happened to appear before us Ibn 'Umar. He said: Don't eat two dates together, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade eating them together but only after seeking permission from his brother (partner). Shu'ba said: I do not think these words pertaining to seeking permission but from the words of Ibn 'Umar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا قَوْلُ شُعْبَةَ وَلاَ قَوْلُهُ وَقَدْ كَانَ أَصَابَ النَّاسَ يَوْمَئِذٍ جَهْدٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu, alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walaysa fiy hadiythihimaa qawlu shu'baaa walaa qawluhu waqad kaana aasaaba alnnaasa yawmaiidhin jahdun ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but these words of his (are not found):" The people were hard pressed because of the famine during those days
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَبَلَةَ بْنِ سُحَيْمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَقْرِنَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْنَ التَّمْرَتَيْنِ حَتَّى يَسْتَأْذِنَ أَصْحَابَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, 'an jabalaaa bni suhaymin, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yaqrina alrrajulu bayna alttamratayni hattaa yastaadhina aashaabahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabala b. Suhaim reported:I heard Ibn 'Umar as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade anyone taking two dates together without seeking the consent of his companions
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، بْنُ بِلاَلٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَجُوعُ أَهْلُ بَيْتٍ عِنْدَهُمُ التَّمْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu hassaana, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, bnu bilaalin 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yajuw'u aahlu baytin 'indahumu alttamru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A family which has dates will not be hungry
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ طَحْلاَءَ، عَنْ أَبِي، الرِّجَالِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ بَيْتٌ لاَ تَمْرَ فِيهِ جِيَاعٌ أَهْلُهُ يَا عَائِشَةُ بَيْتٌ لاَ تَمْرَ فِيهِ جِيَاعٌ أَهْلُهُ أَوْ جَاعَ أَهْلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu muhammadi bni tahlaa'a, 'an aabiy, alrrijaali muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aummihi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa 'aaiishaau baytun laa tamra fiyhi jiyaa'un aahluhu yaa 'aaiishaau baytun laa tamra fiyhi jiyaa'un aahluhu aaw jaa'a aahluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalahaa marratayni aaw thalaathana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:'A'isha a family which has no dates (in their house) its members will be hungry; (or) 'A'isha the family which has no dates its members may be hungry. He said this twice or thrice
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَكَلَ سَبْعَ تَمَرَاتٍ مِمَّا بَيْنَ لاَبَتَيْهَا حِينَ يُصْبِحُ لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ سُمٌّ حَتَّى يُمْسِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aakala sab'a tamaraatin mimmaa bayna laabatayhaa hiyna yusbihu lam yadurrahu summun hattaa yumsiya ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas, on the authority of his father, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:He who ate seven dates (of the land situated) between these two lava plains in the morning, no poison will harm him until it is evening
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هَاشِمِ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَامِرَ بْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَصَبَّحَ بِسَبْعِ تَمَرَاتٍ عَجْوَةً لَمْ يَضُرَّهُ ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمَ سُمٌّ وَلاَ سِحْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an haashimi bni haashimin, qaala sami'tu 'aamira bna sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, yaquwlu sami'tu sa'dana, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man tasabbaha bisab'i tamaraatin 'ajwaaan lam yadurrahu dhalika alyawma summun walaa sihrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who ate seven 'ajwa' dates in the morning, poison and magic will not harm him on that day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ الْفَزَارِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو بَدْرٍ، شُجَاعُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هَاشِمِ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ وَلاَ يَقُولاَنِ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa alfazaariyyu, h wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa aabuw badrin, shujaa'u bnu alwaliydi kilaahumaa 'an haashimi bni haashimin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu walaa yaquwlaani sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Hashim with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شَرِيكٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي نَمِرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي عَتِيقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي عَجْوَةِ الْعَالِيَةِ شِفَاءً أَوْ إِنَّهَا تِرْيَاقٌ أَوَّلَ الْبُكْرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waabnu, hujrin qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'an shariykin, - wahuwa abnu aabiy namirin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy 'atiyqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna fiy 'ajwaai al'aaliyaai shifaa'an aaw iinnahaa tiryaaqun aawwala albukraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The 'ajwa' dates of 'Aliya' contain healing effects and these are antidote in the early morning
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، وَعُمَرُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو، بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, wa'umaru bnu 'ubaydin 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an 'amriw bni huraythin, 'an sa'iydi bni zaydi bni 'amriw, bni nufaylin qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alkamaaau mina almanni wamaauuhaa shifaa'un lil'ayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Nufail reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are a kind of 'Manna' and their juice is a medicine for the eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ، عُمَيْرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ حُرَيْثٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni, 'umayrin qaala sami'tu 'amraw bna huraythin, qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna zaydin, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alkamaaau mina almanni wamaauuhaa shifaa'un lil'ayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Through another chain of transmitters, Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are a kind of 'Manna' and their juice is a medicine for the eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ عُتَيْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْعُرَنِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ لَمَّا حَدَّثَنِي بِهِ الْحَكَمُ لَمْ أُنْكِرْهُ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala waaakhbaraniy alhakamu bnu 'utaybaaa, 'ani alhasani al'uraniyyi, 'an 'amriw bni huraythin, 'an sa'iydi bni zaydin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau lammaa haddathaniy bihi alhakamu lam aunkirhu min hadiythi 'abdi almaliki ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Zaid reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Truffles are a kind of blessing and their juice is a medicine for the eyes. Shu'ba said: When Hakam narrated this hadith to me, I did not deem it as a Munkar hadith because of the narration of Abd al-Malik
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abtharun, 'an mutarrifin, 'ani alhakami, 'ani alhasani, 'an 'amriw bni huraythin, 'an sa'iydi bni zaydi bni 'amriw bni nufaylin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alkamaaau mina almanni alladhiy aanzala alllahu tabaaraka wata'aalaa 'alaa baniy iisraaiiyla wamaauuhaa shifaa'un lil'ayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Nufail reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Truffles are a kind of 'Manna' which Allah the Glorious and Exalted, sent down upon the people of Israil, and its juice is a medicine for the eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ عُتَيْبَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْعُرَنِيِّ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى مُوسَى وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mutarrifin, 'ani alhakami bni 'utaybaaa, 'ani alhasani al'uraniyyi, 'an 'amriw bni huraythin, 'an sa'iydi bni zaydin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alkamaaau mina almanni alladhiy aanzala alllahu 'alaa muwsaa wamaauuhaa shifaa'un lil'ayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Zaid reported Allal a Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Truffles are a kind of 'Manna' which Allah sent down upon Moses and their juice is a medicine for the eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَمْرَو، بْنَ حُرَيْثٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, qaala sami'tu 'amraw, bna huraythin yaquwlu qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna zaydin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alkamaaau mina almanni alladhiy aanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla 'alaa baniy iisraaiiyla wamaauuhaa shifaa'un lil'ayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Truffles are 'Manna' which Allah, the Exalted the Majestic, sent to the people of Israil, and its juice is a medicine for the eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ، شَهْرِ بْنِ حَوْشَبٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ فَلَقِيتُ عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ فَحَدَّثَنِي عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْكَمْأَةُ مِنَ الْمَنِّ وَمَاؤُهَا شِفَاءٌ لِلْعَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu shabiybin, qaala sami'tuhu min, shahri bni hawshabin fasaaaltuhu faqaala sami'tuhu min 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, qaala falaqiytu 'abda almaliki fahaddathaniy 'an 'amriw bni huraythin, 'an sa'iydi bni zaydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alkamaaau mina almanni wamaauuhaa shifaa'un lil'ayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Truffles are 'Manna' and its juice is the medicine for the eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَرِّ الظَّهْرَانِ وَنَحْنُ نَجْنِي الْكَبَاثَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالأَسْوَدِ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَأَنَّكَ رَعَيْتَ الْغَنَمَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ وَهَلْ مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ رَعَاهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ نَحْوَ هَذَا مِنَ الْقَوْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an yuwnusa, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimarri alzzahraani wanahnu najniy alkabaatha faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ 'alaykum bialaaswadi minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi kaaannaka ra'ayta alghanama qaala ‏"‏ na'am wahal min nabiyyin iilaaa waqad ra'aahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw nahwa hadhaa mina alqawli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:We were with the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) at Marr az-Zahran, and we were plucking the fruit of the Arak tree, whereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: Pluck only its black ones (for they are the most pleasant). We said: Allah's Messenger, it seems you shepherded the flock. He said: Yes. Has there been a prophet who did not shepherd it (or some words like it)?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، بْنُ بِلاَلٍ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ نِعْمَ الأُدُمُ - أَوِ الإِدَامُ - الْخَلُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu hassaana, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu, bnu bilaalin 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ni'ma alaudumu - aawi aliidaamu - alkhallu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The best of condiments or condiment is vinegar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُوسَى بْنُ قُرَيْشِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ صَالِحٍ الْوُحَاظِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ نِعْمَ الأُدُمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَشُكَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muwsaa bnu qurayshi bni naafi'in alttamiymiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu saalihin alwuhaaziyyu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ ni'ma alaudumu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yashukka ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Sulaiman b. Bilal with the same chain of transmitters and he is reported to have said:" The best condiment." And he did not doubt (about this word)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَأَلَ أَهْلَهُ الأُدُمَ فَقَالُوا مَا عِنْدَنَا إِلاَّ خَلٌّ ‏.‏ فَدَعَا بِهِ فَجَعَلَ يَأْكُلُ بِهِ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ نِعْمَ الأُدُمُ الْخَلُّ نِعْمَ الأُدُمُ الْخَلُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm saaala aahlahu alauduma faqaaluwa maa 'indanaa iilaaa khallun ‏.‏ fada'aa bihi faja'ala yaakulu bihi wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ ni'ma alaudumu alkhallu ni'ma alaudumu alkhallu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) asked his family for condiment. They (the members of his household) said:We have nothing with us but vinegar. He asked for it, he began to eat it, and then said: Vinegar is a good condiment, vinegar is a good condiment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِي ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ فَأَخْرَجَ إِلَيْهِ فِلَقًا مِنْ خُبْزٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ أُدُمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لاَ إِلاَّ شَىْءٌ مِنْ خَلٍّ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ الْخَلَّ نِعْمَ الأُدُمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ جَابِرٌ فَمَا زِلْتُ أُحِبُّ الْخَلَّ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهَا مِنْ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَقَالَ طَلْحَةُ مَا زِلْتُ أُحِبُّ الْخَلَّ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهَا مِنْ جَابِرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - 'ani almuthannaa bni sa'iydin, haddathaniy talhaau bnu naafi'in, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu aakhadha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadiy dhaata yawmin iilaa manzilihi faaakhraja iilayhi filaqana min khubzin faqaala ‏"‏ maa min audumin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa laa iilaaa shaa'un min khallin ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinna alkhalla ni'ma alaudumu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala jaabirun famaa ziltu auhibbu alkhalla mundhu sami'tuhaa min nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ waqaala talhaau maa ziltu auhibbu alkhalla mundhu sami'tuhaa min jaabirin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took hold of my hand one day (and led me) to his residence. There was presented to him some pieces of bread, whereupon he said: Is there no condiment? They (the members of his household) said: No, except some vinegar. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Vinegar is a good condiment. Jabir said: I have always loved vinegar since I heard it trom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Talha said: I have always loved vinegar since I heard about it from Jabir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ، بْنِ نَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخَذَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏ "‏ فَنِعْمَ الأُدُمُ الْخَلُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa almuthannaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an talhaaa, bni naafi'in haddathanaa jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhadha biyadihi iilaa manzilihi ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa iilaa qawlihi ‏ "‏ fani'ma alaudumu alkhallu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took hold of his hand and led him to his residence as narrated above up to the words:" Vinegar is a good condiment." But in the hadith transmitted through this chain of transmitters, there is no mention of the subsequent part
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ أَبِي، زَيْنَبَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سُفْيَانَ، طَلْحَةُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا فِي دَارِي فَمَرَّ بِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَشَارَ إِلَىَّ فَقُمْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَأَخَذَ بِيَدِي فَانْطَلَقْنَا حَتَّى أَتَى بَعْضَ حُجَرِ نِسَائِهِ فَدَخَلَ ثُمَّ أَذِنَ لِي فَدَخَلْتُ الْحِجَابَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ مِنْ غَدَاءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِثَلاَثَةِ أَقْرِصَةٍ فَوُضِعْنَ عَلَى نَبِيٍّ فَأَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُرْصًا فَوَضَعَهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَخَذَ قُرْصًا آخَرَ فَوَضَعَهُ بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ ثُمَّ أَخَذَ الثَّالِثَ فَكَسَرَهُ بِاثْنَيْنِ فَجَعَلَ نِصْفَهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَنِصْفَهُ بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ مِنْ أُدُمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ شَىْءٌ مِنْ خَلٍّ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَاتُوهُ فَنِعْمَ الأُدُمُ هُوَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hajjaaju bnu aabiy, zaynaba haddathaniy aabuw sufyaana, talhaau bnu naafi'in qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, qaala kuntu jaalisana fiy daariy famarra biy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaashaara iilaaaa faqumtu iilayhi faaakhadha biyadiy faantalaqnaa hattaa aataa ba'da hujari nisaaiihi fadakhala thumma aadhina liy fadakhaltu alhijaaba 'alayhaa faqaala ‏"‏ hal min ghadaa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa na'am ‏.‏ faautiya bithalaathaai aaqrisaain fawudi'na 'alaa nabiyyin faaakhadha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qursana fawada'ahu bayna yadayhi waaakhadha qursana akhara fawada'ahu bayna yadaaaa thumma aakhadha althhaalitha fakasarahu biathnayni faja'ala nisfahu bayna yadayhi wanisfahu bayna yadaaaa thumma qaala ‏"‏ hal min audumin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laa ‏.‏ iilaaa shaa'un min khallin ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ haatuwhu fani'ma alaudumu huwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:While I was sitting in my house there happened to pass by me Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He made a gesture to me and I stood up for him. He took hold of my hand until we came to one of the apartments of his wives. He entered and then asked me to get in. So I entered and there was hanging a curtain beside her. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Is there any food (with you)? They (the members of the household) said: Yes And then there were brought three loaves of bread for him (the Holy Prophet) and placed in the basket of palm leaves. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) picked up one loaf and placed that before him, and then picked up another one and placed it before me. He then picked up the third one and broke it into two parts, and kept the one-half before him and the other half before me, and then said: Is there any condiment? They (the members of the household) said: There is nothing (in the form of condiment) but some vinegar only. He said: Bring that, for vinegar is a good condiment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أُتِيَ بِطَعَامٍ أَكَلَ مِنْهُ وَبَعَثَ بِفَضْلِهِ إِلَىَّ وَإِنَّهُ بَعَثَ إِلَىَّ يَوْمًا بِفَضْلَةٍ لَمْ يَأْكُلْ مِنْهَا لأَنَّ فِيهَا ثُومًا فَسَأَلْتُهُ أَحَرَامٌ هُوَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ وَلَكِنِّي أَكْرَهُهُ مِنْ أَجْلِ رِيحِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ مَا كَرِهْتَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaaki bni harbin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, 'an aabiy aayyuwba alaansaariyyi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa autiya bita'aamin aakala minhu waba'atha bifadlihi iilaaaa waiinnahu ba'atha iilaaaa yawmana bifadlaain lam yaakul minhaa laanna fiyhaa thuwmana fasaaaltuhu aaharaamun huwa qaala ‏ "‏ laa walakinniy aakrahuhu min aajli riyhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faiinniy aakrahu maa karihta ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd Ayydb Ansari reported that when food was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) he ate out of that, and sent the remaining part to me, and one day he sent to me the left-over; (I found that he) had not taken from it at all for it included garlic. I asked him whether that was forbidden, whereupon he said:No, but I do not like it because of its odour. He (Abu Ayyub Ansiri) said: Then I also do not like what you do not like
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This Hadith is narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ مِنْهُمَا قَرِيبٌ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، - فِي رِوَايَةِ حَجَّاجِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ أَبُو زَيْدٍ الأَحْوَلُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَفْلَحَ، مَوْلَى أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ فَنَزَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي السُّفْلِ وَأَبُو أَيُّوبَ فِي الْعُلْوِ - قَالَ - فَانْتَبَهَ أَبُو أَيُّوبَ لَيْلَةً فَقَالَ نَمْشِي فَوْقَ رَأْسِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَتَنَحَّوْا فَبَاتُوا فِي جَانِبٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ السُّفْلُ أَرْفَقُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ أَعْلُو سَقِيفَةً أَنْتَ تَحْتَهَا ‏.‏ فَتَحَوَّلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْعُلْوِ وَأَبُو أَيُّوبَ فِي السُّفْلِ فَكَانَ يَصْنَعُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَعَامًا فَإِذَا جِيءَ بِهِ إِلَيْهِ سَأَلَ عَنْ مَوْضِعِ أَصَابِعِهِ فَيَتَتَبَّعُ مَوْضِعَ أَصَابِعِهِ فَصَنَعَ لَهُ طَعَامًا فِيهِ ثُومٌ فَلَمَّا رُدَّ إِلَيْهِ سَأَلَ عَنْ مَوْضِعِ أَصَابِعِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقِيلَ لَهُ لَمْ يَأْكُلْ ‏.‏ فَفَزِعَ وَصَعِدَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ أَحَرَامٌ هُوَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ وَلَكِنِّي أَكْرَهُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي أَكْرَهُ مَا تَكْرَهُ أَوْ مَا كَرِهْتَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُؤْتَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, waaahmadu bnu sa'iydi bni sakhrin, - waalllafzu minhumaa qariybun - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa thaabitun, - fiy riwaayaai hajjaaji bni yaziyda aabuw zaydin alaahwalu - haddathanaa 'aasimun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, 'an aaflaha, mawlaa aabiy aayyuwba 'an aabiy aayyuwba, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm nazala 'alayhi fanazala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alssufli waaabuw aayyuwba fiy al'ulwi - qaala - faantabaha aabuw aayyuwba laylaaan faqaala namshiy fawqa raasi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fatanahhawa fabaatuwa fiy jaanibin thumma qaala lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alssuflu aarfaqu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala laa aa'luw saqiyfaaan aanta tahtahaa ‏.‏ fatahawwala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy al'ulwi waaabuw aayyuwba fiy alssufli fakaana yasna'u lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ta'aamana faiidhaa jiy'a bihi iilayhi saaala 'an mawdi'i aasaabi'ihi fayatatabba'u mawdi'a aasaabi'ihi fasana'a lahu ta'aamana fiyhi thuwmun falammaa rudda iilayhi saaala 'an mawdi'i aasaabi'i alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqiyla lahu lam yaakul ‏.‏ fafazi'a wasa'ida iilayhi faqaala aaharaamun huwa faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa walakinniy aakrahuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faiinniy aakrahu maa takrahu aaw maa karihta ‏.‏ qaala wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yuutaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aflah, the freed slave of Abu Ayyub Ansiri, reported:Allah's Messnger (ﷺ) had alighted in his house (viz. of Abu Ayyub Ansari at the time of his emigration to Medina) and he occupied the lower storey, whereas Abu Ayyub Ansari lived in the upper storey. One night, Abu Ayyub Ansari got up and said (to himself): (How unfortunate it is) that we walk above the head of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so they went aside and spent the night in a nook and then told Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) about it whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: The lower storey is more comfortable (for me). but he (Abu Ayyub Ansari) said: We (would not live) over the roof under which you live. So Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) shifted to the upper storey, whereas Abu Ayyub Ansari shifted to the lower storey; and he (Abu Ayyub Ansari) used to prepare food for Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) ; and when it was brought (back) to him he asked (to locate) the part, where his fingers had touched (the food), and he followed his fingers on that part where his fingers (those of the Holy Prophet) had touched it. (One day) he prepared food which contained garlic, and when it was returned to him he asked (to locate) the part which the fingers of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had touched. It was said to him that he had not eaten (the food). He (Abd Ayyub Ansari) was distressed and went up to him (to the Holy Prophet) and said: Is it forbidden? But Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: No, (it is not forbidden), but I do not like it. and he (Abu Ayyub Ansari) said: I also do not like what you do not like or which you did not like. He (Abu Ayyub Ansari) said: (The Prophet did not eat garlic) as Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was visited (by angels) and brought him the message of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ غَزْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ الأَشْجَعِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي مَجْهُودٌ ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَى بَعْضِ نِسَائِهِ فَقَالَتْ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ مَا عِنْدِي إِلاَّ مَاءٌ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَى أُخْرَى فَقَالَتْ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى قُلْنَ كُلُّهُنَّ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ لاَ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ مَا عِنْدِي إِلاَّ مَاءٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يُضِيفُ هَذَا اللَّيْلَةَ رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ أَنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهِ إِلَى رَحْلِهِ فَقَالَ لاِمْرَأَتِهِ هَلْ عِنْدَكِ شَىْءٌ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ لاَ إِلاَّ قُوتُ صِبْيَانِي ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعَلِّلِيهِمْ بِشَىْءٍ فَإِذَا دَخَلَ ضَيْفُنَا فَأَطْفِئِي السِّرَاجَ وَأَرِيهِ أَنَّا نَأْكُلُ فَإِذَا أَهْوَى لِيَأْكُلَ فَقُومِي إِلَى السِّرَاجِ حَتَّى تُطْفِئِيهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَعَدُوا وَأَكَلَ الضَّيْفُ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ غَدَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَدْ عَجِبَ اللَّهُ مِنْ صَنِيعِكُمَا بِضَيْفِكُمَا اللَّيْلَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyru bnu 'abdi alhamiydi, 'an fudayli bni ghazwaana, 'an aabiy haazimin alaashja'iyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinniy majhuwdun ‏.‏ faaarsala iilaa ba'di nisaaiihi faqaalat waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi maa 'indiy iilaaa maa'un ‏.‏ thumma aarsala iilaa aukhraa faqaalat mithla dhalika hattaa qulna kulluhunna mithla dhalika laa waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi maa 'indiy iilaaa maa'un ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ man yudiyfu hadhaa alllaylaaa rahimahu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama rajulun mina alaansaari faqaala aanaa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faantalaqa bihi iilaa rahlihi faqaala laimraaatihi hal 'indaki shaa'un ‏.‏ qaalat laa iilaaa quwtu sibyaaniy ‏.‏ qaala fa'alliliyhim bishaa'in faiidhaa dakhala dayfunaa faaatfiiiy alssiraaja waaariyhi aannaa naakulu faiidhaa aahwaa liyaakula faquwmiy iilaa alssiraaji hattaa tutfiiiyhi ‏.‏ qaala faqa'aduwa waaakala alddayfu ‏.‏ falammaa aasbaha ghadaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ qad 'ajiba alllahu min saniy'ikumaa bidayfikumaa alllaylaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:I am hard pressed by hunger. He sent (message) to one of his wives (to procure food for him). but she said: By Him Who has sent you with Truth, thrre is nothing with me (to serve him) but only water. He (the Holy Prophet) then sent the (same) message to another, and she gave the same reply, until all of them gave the same reply: By Him Who has sent thee with the Truth, there is nothing with me but only water, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Allah would show mercy to him who will entertain this guest tonight. A person from the Ansar stood up and said: Messenger of Allah, I (am ready to entertain). He took him to his house and said to his wife: Is there anything with you (to serve the gdest)? She said: No, but only a subsistence for our children. He said: Distract their attention with something, and when the guest enters extinguish the lamp and give him the impression that we are eating. So they sat down. and the guest had his meal. When it was morning he went to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who said: Allah was well pleased with what you both did for your guest this night
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ غَزْوَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي، حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ‏.‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ بَاتَ بِهِ ضَيْفٌ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ قُوتُهُ وَقُوتُ صِبْيَانِهِ فَقَالَ لاِمْرَأَتِهِ نَوِّمِي الصِّبْيَةَ وَأَطْفِئِي السِّرَاجَ وَقَرِّبِي لِلضَّيْفِ مَا عِنْدَكِ - قَالَ - فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ وَيُؤْثِرُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلَوْ كَانَ بِهِمْ خَصَاصَةٌ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an fudayli bni ghazwaana, 'an aabiy, haazimin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, ‏.‏ aanna rajulaan, mina alaansaari baata bihi dayfun falam yakun 'indahu iilaaa quwtuhu waquwtu sibyaanihi faqaala laimraaatihi nawwimiy alssibyaaa waaatfiiiy alssiraaja waqarribiy lilddayfi maa 'indaki - qaala - fanazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ wayuuthiruwna 'alaa aanfusihim walaw kaana bihim khasaasaaun‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that a guest spent the night with a person from the Ansar who had nothing with him but food (sufficient) for his own self and his children. He said to his wife:(Lull) the children to sleep, and put out the lamp, and serve the guest with what you have with you. It was on this occasion that this verse was revealed:" Those who prefer the needy to their own selves in spite of the fact that they are themselves in pressing need" (Lix)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُضِيفَهُ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ عِنْدَهُ مَا يُضِيفُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ رَجُلٌ يُضِيفُ هَذَا رَحِمَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَانْطَلَقَ بِهِ إِلَى رَحْلِهِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ وَذَكَرَ فِيهِ نُزُولَ الآيَةِ كَمَا ذَكَرَهُ وَكِيعٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liyudiyfahu falam yakun 'indahu maa yudiyfuhu faqaala ‏ "‏ aalaa rajulun yudiyfu hadhaa rahimahu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama rajulun mina alaansaari yuqaalu lahu aabuw talhaaa faantalaqa bihi iilaa rahlihi ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythi jariyrin wadhakara fiyhi nuzuwla alayaai kamaa dhakarahu wakiy'un ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that a man came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he should entertain him as a guest, but he had nothing with which he could entertain him. He, therefore, asked if there was any person who would entertain him (assuring the audience) that Allah would show mercy to him. A person from the Ansar who was called Abu Talha stood up and he took him to his house. The rest of the hadith is the same and mention is (also) made in that about the revelation of the verse as narrated by Waki
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
