verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنِ الْمِقْدَادِ، قَالَ أَقْبَلْتُ أَنَا وَصَاحِبَانِ، لِي وَقَدْ ذَهَبَتْ أَسْمَاعُنَا وَأَبْصَارُنَا مِنَ الْجَهْدِ فَجَعَلْنَا نَعْرِضُ أَنْفُسَنَا عَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ يَقْبَلُنَا فَأَتَيْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَانْطَلَقَ بِنَا إِلَى أَهْلِهِ فَإِذَا ثَلاَثَةُ أَعْنُزٍ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ احْتَلِبُوا هَذَا اللَّبَنَ بَيْنَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكُنَّا نَحْتَلِبُ فَيَشْرَبُ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ مِنَّا نَصِيبَهُ وَنَرْفَعُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَصِيبَهُ - قَالَ - فَيَجِيءُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَيُسَلِّمُ تَسْلِيمًا لاَ يُوقِظُ نَائِمًا وَيُسْمِعُ الْيَقْظَانَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ يَأْتِي الْمَسْجِدَ فَيُصَلِّي ثُمَّ يَأْتِي شَرَابَهُ فَيَشْرَبُ فَأَتَانِي الشَّيْطَانُ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ وَقَدْ شَرِبْتُ نَصِيبِي فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ يَأْتِي الأَنْصَارَ فَيُتْحِفُونَهُ وَيُصِيبُ عِنْدَهُمْ مَا بِهِ حَاجَةٌ إِلَى هَذِهِ الْجُرْعَةِ فَأَتَيْتُهَا فَشَرِبْتُهَا فَلَمَّا أَنْ وَغَلَتْ فِي بَطْنِي وَعَلِمْتُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ إِلَيْهَا سَبِيلٌ - قَالَ - نَدَّمَنِي الشَّيْطَانُ فَقَالَ وَيْحَكَ مَا صَنَعْتَ أَشَرِبْتَ شَرَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ فَيَجِيءُ فَلاَ يَجِدُهُ فَيَدْعُو عَلَيْكَ فَتَهْلِكُ فَتَذْهَبُ دُنْيَاكَ وَآخِرَتُكَ ‏.‏ وَعَلَىَّ شَمْلَةٌ إِذَا وَضَعْتُهَا عَلَى قَدَمَىَّ خَرَجَ رَأْسِي وَإِذَا وَضَعْتُهَا عَلَى رَأْسِي خَرَجَ قَدَمَاىَ وَجَعَلَ لاَ يَجِيئُنِي النَّوْمُ وَأَمَّا صَاحِبَاىَ فَنَامَا وَلَمْ يَصْنَعَا مَا صَنَعْتُ - قَالَ - فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمَ كَمَا كَانَ يُسَلِّمُ ثُمَّ أَتَى الْمَسْجِدَ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ أَتَى شَرَابَهُ فَكَشَفَ عَنْهُ فَلَمْ يَجِدْ فِيهِ شَيْئًا فَرَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَقُلْتُ الآنَ يَدْعُو عَلَىَّ فَأَهْلِكُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَطْعِمْ مَنْ أَطْعَمَنِي وَأَسْقِ مَنْ أَسْقَانِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعَمَدْتُ إِلَى الشَّمْلَةِ فَشَدَدْتُهَا عَلَىَّ وَأَخَذْتُ الشَّفْرَةَ فَانْطَلَقْتُ إِلَى الأَعْنُزِ أَيُّهَا أَسْمَنُ فَأَذْبَحُهَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِذَا هِيَ حَافِلَةٌ وَإِذَا هُنَّ حُفَّلٌ كُلُّهُنَّ فَعَمَدْتُ إِلَى إِنَاءٍ لآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا كَانُوا يَطْمَعُونَ أَنْ يَحْتَلِبُوا فِيهِ - قَالَ - فَحَلَبْتُ فِيهِ حَتَّى عَلَتْهُ رَغْوَةٌ فَجِئْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَشَرِبْتُمْ شَرَابَكُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اشْرَبْ ‏.‏ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَنِي فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ اشْرَبْ ‏.‏ فَشَرِبَ ثُمَّ نَاوَلَنِي فَلَمَّا عَرَفْتُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ رَوِيَ وَأَصَبْتُ دَعْوَتَهُ ضَحِكْتُ حَتَّى أُلْقِيتُ إِلَى الأَرْضِ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِحْدَى سَوْآتِكَ يَا مِقْدَادُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِي كَذَا وَكَذَا وَفَعَلْتُ كَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا هَذِهِ إِلاَّ رَحْمَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ أَفَلاَ كُنْتَ آذَنْتَنِي فَنُوقِظَ صَاحِبَيْنَا فَيُصِيبَانِ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ وَالَّذِي بَعَثَكَ بِالْحَقِّ مَا أُبَالِي إِذَا أَصَبْتَهَا وَأَصَبْتُهَا مَعَكَ مَنْ أَصَابَهَا مِنَ النَّاسِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa shabaabaau bnu sawwaarin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, 'an thaabitin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'ani almiqdaadi, qaala aaqbaltu aanaa wasaahibaani, liy waqad dhahabat aasmaa'unaa waaabsaarunaa mina aljahdi faja'alnaa na'ridu aanfusanaa 'alaa aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaysa aahadun minhum yaqbalunaa faaataynaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faantalaqa binaa iilaa aahlihi faiidhaa thalaathaau aa'nuzin faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ahtalibuwa hadhaa alllabana baynanaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakunnaa nahtalibu fayashrabu kullu iinsaanin minnaa nasiybahu wanarfa'u lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nasiybahu - qaala - fayajiy'u mina alllayli fayusallimu tasliymana laa yuwqizu naaiimana wayusmi'u alyaqzaana - qaala - thumma yaatiy almasjida fayusalliy thumma yaatiy sharaabahu fayashrabu faaataaniy alshhaytaanu dhaata laylaain waqad sharibtu nasiybiy faqaala muhammadun yaatiy alaansaara fayuthifuwnahu wayusiybu 'indahum maa bihi haajaaun iilaa hadhihi aljur'aai faaataytuhaa fasharibtuhaa falammaa aan waghalat fiy batniy wa'alimtu aannahu laysa iilayhaa sabiylun - qaala - naddamaniy alshhaytaanu faqaala wayhaka maa sana'ta aasharibta sharaaba muhammadin fayajiy'u falaa yajiduhu fayad'uw 'alayka fatahliku fatadhhabu dunyaaka waakhiratuka ‏.‏ wa'alaaaa shamlaaun iidhaa wada'tuhaa 'alaa qadamaaaa kharaja raasiy waiidhaa wada'tuhaa 'alaa raasiy kharaja qadamaaaa waja'ala laa yajiyiuniy alnnawmu waaammaa saahibaaaa fanaamaa walam yasna'aa maa sana'tu - qaala - fajaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallama kamaa kaana yusallimu thumma aataa almasjida fasallaa thumma aataa sharaabahu fakashafa 'anhu falam yajid fiyhi shayiana farafa'a raasahu iilaa alssamaa'i faqultu alana yad'uw 'alaaaa faaahliku ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aat'im man aat'amaniy waaasqi man aasqaaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fa'amadtu iilaa alshhamlaai fashadadtuhaa 'alaaaa waaakhadhtu alshhafraaa faantalaqtu iilaa alaa'nuzi aayyuhaa aasmanu faaadhbahuhaa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiidhaa hiya haafilaaun waiidhaa hunna huffalun kulluhunna fa'amadtu iilaa iinaa'in lali muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm maa kaanuwa yatma'uwna aan yahtalibuwa fiyhi - qaala - fahalabtu fiyhi hattaa 'alathu raghwaaun fajiitu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aasharibtum sharaabakumu alllaylaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi ashrab ‏.‏ fashariba thumma naawalaniy faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi ashrab ‏.‏ fashariba thumma naawalaniy falammaa 'araftu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qad rawiya waaasabtu da'watahu dahiktu hattaa aulqiytu iilaa alaardi - qaala - faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iihdaa sawatika yaa miqdaadu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi kaana min aamriy kadhaa wakadhaa wafa'altu kadhaa ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa hadhihi iilaaa rahmaaun mina alllahi aafalaa kunta adhantaniy fanuwqiza saahibaynaa fayusiybaani minhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu waalladhiy ba'athaka bialhaqqi maa aubaaliy iidhaa aasabtahaa waaasabtuhaa ma'aka man aasaabahaa mina alnnaasi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Miqdad reported:I and two of my companions were so much afflicted by hunger that we had lost our power of seeing and hearing. We presented ourselves (as guests) to the Companions of the Prophet (ﷺ), but none amongst them would entertain us. So we came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he took us to his residence and there were three goats. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Milk these for us. So we milked them and every person amongst us drank his share and we set aside the share of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). (It was his habit) to come during the night and greet (the people present there) in a manner that would not wake up one in sleep but make one who was awake hear it. He would then go to the mosque and say prayer, then go to the milk and drink it. Miqdad added: One night the Satan came to me when I had taken my share, and he said: Muhammad has gone to the Ansar, who would offer him hospitality and he would get what is with them, and he has no need for this draught (of milk). So I took (that milk) and drank it, and when it had penetrated deeply in my stomach and I was certain that there was no way out (but to digest it), the Satan aroused (my sense of) remorse and said: Woe be to thee! what have you done? You have taken the drink reserved for Muhammad! When he would come and he would not find it, he would curse you, and you would be ruined, and thus there would go (waste) this world and the Hereafter (for) you. There was a sheet over me; as I placed (pulled) it upon my feet, my head was uncovered and as I placed it upon my head, my feet were uncovered, and I could not sleep, but my two companions had gone to sleep for they had not done what I had done. There came Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he greeted as he used to greet (by saying as-Salamu 'Alaikum). He then came to the mosque and observed prayer and then came to his drink (milk) and uncovered it, but did not find anything in it. He raised his head towards the sky, and I said (to myself) that he (the Holy Prophet) was going to invoke curse upon me and I would be thus ruined; but he (the Holy Prophet) said: Allah, feed him who fed me and give drink to him who provided me drink. I held tight the sheet upon myself (and when he had supplicated), I took hold of the knife and went to the goats (possessed by the Holy Prophet) so that I may slauhter one for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which was the fattest amongst them, and in fact all of them were milch goats; then I took hold of the vessel which belonged to the family of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in which they used to milk and drink therefrom, and milked them in that until it swelled up with foam. I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said: Have you taken your share of the milk during the night? I said: Drink it. and he drank it; he then handed over (the vessel) to me and I said: Allah's Messenger, drink it, and he drank it and handed over (the vessel) to me again, I then perceived that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had been satiated and I had got his blessings. I burst into laughter (so much) so that I fell upon the ground, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Miqdad, it must be one of your mischiefs. I said: Allah's Messenger, this affair of mind is like this and this. and I have done so. Thereupon. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: This is nothing but a mercy from Allah. Why is it that you did not give me an opportunity so that we should have awakened our two friends and they would have got their share (of the milk)? I said: By Him Who has sent you with Truth. I do not mind whatever you give (to them), and whatever the (other) people happen to get, when I had got it along with you from among the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Mughira with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، وَحَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ، الأَعْلَى جَمِيعًا عَنِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ مُعَاذٍ - حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، - وَحَدَّثَ أَيْضًا، - عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَلاَثِينَ وَمِائَةً فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلْ مَعَ أَحَدٍ مِنْكُمْ طَعَامٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا مَعَ رَجُلٍ صَاعٌ مِنْ طَعَامٍ أَوْ نَحْوُهُ فَعُجِنَ ثُمَّ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ مُشْرِكٌ مُشْعَانٌّ طَوِيلٌ بِغَنَمٍ يَسُوقُهَا فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَبَيْعٌ أَمْ عَطِيَّةٌ - أَوْ قَالَ - أَمْ هِبَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ بَلْ بَيْعٌ ‏.‏ فَاشْتَرَى مِنْهُ شَاةً فَصُنِعَتْ وَأَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسَوَادِ الْبَطْنِ أَنْ يُشْوَى ‏.‏ قَالَ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ مَا مِنَ الثَّلاَثِينَ وَمِائَةٍ إِلاَّ حَزَّ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُزَّةً حُزَّةً مِنْ سَوَادِ بَطْنِهَا إِنْ كَانَ شَاهِدًا أَعْطَاهُ وَإِنْ كَانَ غَائِبًا خَبَأَ لَهُ - قَالَ - وَجَعَلَ قَصْعَتَيْنِ فَأَكَلْنَا مِنْهُمَا أَجْمَعُونَ وَشَبِعْنَا وَفَضَلَ فِي الْقَصْعَتَيْنِ فَحَمَلْتُهُ عَلَى الْبَعِيرِ ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, wahaamidu bnu 'umara albakraawiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi, alaa'laa jamiy'ana 'ani almu'tamiri bni sulaymaana, - waalllafzu laibni mu'aadhin - haddathanaa almu'tamiru, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, - wahaddatha aaydana, - 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakrin, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thalaathiyna wamiaiaaan faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hal ma'a aahadin minkum ta'aamun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faiidhaa ma'a rajulin saa'un min ta'aamin aaw nahwuhu fa'ujina thumma jaa'a rajulun mushrikun mush'aannun tawiylun bighanamin yasuwquhaa faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aabay'un aam 'atiyyaaun - aaw qaala - aam hibaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala laa bal bay'un ‏.‏ faashtaraa minhu shaaaan fasuni'at waaamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bisawaadi albatni aan yushwaa ‏.‏ qaala waaymu alllahi maa mina althhalaathiyna wamiaiaain iilaaa hazza lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm huzzaaan huzzaaan min sawaadi batnihaa iin kaana shaahidana aa'taahu waiin kaana ghaaiibana khabaaa lahu - qaala - waja'ala qas'atayni faaakalnaa minhumaa aajma'uwna washabi'naa wafadala fiy alqas'atayni fahamaltuhu 'alaa alba'iyri ‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Abu Bakr reported:We were one hundred and thirty (persons) with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Does any one of You possess food? There was a person with (us) who had a sa' of flour or something about that, and it was kneaded. Then a tall polytheist with dishevelled hair came driving his flock of sheep. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Would you like to sell it (any one of these goats) or offer it as a gift or a present? He said: No, (I am not prepared to offer as a gift), but I would sell it. He (the Holy Prophet) bought a sheep from him, and it was slaughtered and its meat was prepared, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that its liver should be roasted. He (the narrator) said: By Allah, none among one hundred and thirty persons was left whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had not given a part out of her liver; if anyone was present he gave it to him. but if he was absent it was set aside for him. And he (the Holy Prophet) filled two bowls (one with soup and the other with mutton) and we all ate out of them to our hearts' content, but (still) some part was (left) in (those) two bowls, and I placed it on the camel- (or words to the same effect)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، وَحَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، الْقَيْسِيُّ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ مُعَاذٍ - حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبِي حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّ أَصْحَابَ الصُّفَّةِ، كَانُوا نَاسًا فُقَرَاءَ وَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ مَرَّةً ‏ "‏ مَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ طَعَامُ اثْنَيْنِ فَلْيَذْهَبْ بِثَلاَثَةٍ وَمَنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ طَعَامُ أَرْبَعَةٍ فَلْيَذْهَبْ بِخَامِسٍ بِسَادِسٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ ‏.‏ وَإِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ جَاءَ بِثَلاَثَةٍ وَانْطَلَقَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَشَرَةٍ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ بِثَلاَثَةٍ - قَالَ - فَهُوَ وَأَنَا وَأَبِي وَأُمِّي - وَلاَ أَدْرِي هَلْ قَالَ وَامْرَأَتِي وَخَادِمٌ بَيْنَ بَيْتِنَا وَبَيْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَ وَإِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ تَعَشَّى عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ ثُمَّ لَبِثَ حَتَّى صُلِّيَتِ الْعِشَاءُ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ فَلَبِثَ حَتَّى نَعَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَجَاءَ بَعْدَ مَا مَضَى مِنَ اللَّيْلِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ قَالَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتُهُ مَا حَبَسَكَ عَنْ أَضْيَافِكَ - أَوْ قَالَتْ - ضَيْفِكَ قَالَ أَوَمَا عَشَّيْتِهِمْ قَالَتْ أَبَوْا حَتَّى تَجِيءَ قَدْ عَرَضُوا عَلَيْهِمْ فَغَلَبُوهُمْ - قَالَ - فَذَهَبْتُ أَنَا فَاخْتَبَأْتُ وَقَالَ يَا غُنْثَرُ ‏.‏ فَجَدَّعَ وَسَبَّ وَقَالَ كُلُوا لاَ هَنِيئًا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أَطْعَمُهُ أَبَدًا - قَالَ - فَايْمُ اللَّهِ مَا كُنَّا نَأْخُذُ مِنْ لُقْمَةٍ إِلاَّ رَبَا مِنْ أَسْفَلِهَا أَكْثَرُ مِنْهَا - قَالَ - حَتَّى شَبِعْنَا وَصَارَتْ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا كَانَتْ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَإِذَا هِيَ كَمَا هِيَ أَوْ أَكْثَرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاِمْرَأَتِهِ يَا أُخْتَ بَنِي فِرَاسٍ مَا هَذَا قَالَتْ لاَ وَقُرَّةِ عَيْنِي لَهِيَ الآنَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْهَا قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ بِثَلاَثِ مِرَارٍ - قَالَ - فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا كَانَ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ - يَعْنِي يَمِينَهُ - ثُمَّ أَكَلَ مِنْهَا لُقْمَةً ثُمَّ حَمَلَهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَصْبَحَتْ عِنْدَهُ - قَالَ - وَكَانَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ قَوْمٍ عَقْدٌ فَمَضَى الأَجَلُ فَعَرَّفْنَا اثْنَا عَشَرَ رَجُلاً مَعَ كُلِّ رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ أُنَاسٌ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ كَمْ مَعَ كُلِّ رَجُلٍ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ بَعَثَ مَعَهُمْ فَأَكَلُوا مِنْهَا أَجْمَعُونَ ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, wahaamidu bnu 'umara albakraawiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, alqaysiyyu kulluhum 'ani almu'tamiri, - waalllafzu laibni mu'aadhin - haddathanaa almu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, qaala qaala aabiy haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, aannahu haddathahu 'abdu alrrahmani bnu aabiy bakrin, aanna aashaaba alssuffaai, kaanuwa naasana fuqaraa'a waiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala marraaan ‏ "‏ man kaana 'indahu ta'aamu athnayni falyadhhab bithalaathaain waman kaana 'indahu ta'aamu aarba'aain falyadhhab bikhaamisin bisaadisin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala ‏.‏ waiinna aabaa bakrin jaa'a bithalaathaain waantalaqa nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'asharaain waaabuw bakrin bithalaathaain - qaala - fahuwa waaanaa waaabiy waaummiy - walaa aadriy hal qaala waamraaatiy wakhaadimun bayna baytinaa wabayti aabiy bakrin - qaala waiinna aabaa bakrin ta'ashhaa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ thumma labitha hattaa sulliyati al'ishaa'u thumma raja'a falabitha hattaa na'asa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fajaa'a ba'da maa madaa mina alllayli maa shaa'a alllahu qaalat lahu amraaatuhu maa habasaka 'an aadyaafika - aaw qaalat - dayfika qaala aawamaa 'ashhaytihim qaalat aabawa hattaa tajiy'a qad 'araduwa 'alayhim faghalabuwhum - qaala - fadhahabtu aanaa faakhtabaatu waqaala yaa ghuntharu ‏.‏ fajadda'a wasabba waqaala kuluwa laa haniyiana ‏.‏ waqaala waalllahi laa aat'amuhu aabadana - qaala - faaymu alllahi maa kunnaa naakhudhu min luqmaain iilaaa rabaa min aasfalihaa aaktharu minhaa - qaala - hattaa shabi'naa wasaarat aakthara mimmaa kaanat qabla dhalika fanazara iilayhaa aabuw bakrin faiidhaa hiya kamaa hiya aaw aaktharu ‏.‏ qaala laimraaatihi yaa aukhta baniy firaasin maa hadhaa qaalat laa waqurraai 'ayniy lahiya alana aaktharu minhaa qabla dhalika bithalaathi miraarin - qaala - faaakala minhaa aabuw bakrin waqaala iinnamaa kaana dhalika mina alshhaytaani - ya'niy yamiynahu - thumma aakala minhaa luqmaaan thumma hamalahaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaasbahat 'indahu - qaala - wakaana baynanaa wabayna qawmin 'aqdun famadaa alaajalu fa'arrafnaa athnaa 'ashara rajulaan ma'a kulli rajulin minhum aunaasun alllahu aa'lamu kam ma'a kulli rajulin iilaaa aannahu ba'atha ma'ahum faaakaluwa minhaa aajma'uwna ‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rabman b. Abu Bakr reported that the people of Suffa were very poor. Once the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said (to his Companions):He who amongst you has food for two persons should take three (guests with him). and he who has with him food for four persons should take five or six (guests with him for entertaining them). It was (in accordance with these instructions of the Holy Prophet) that Abu Bakr brought three persons, and the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) brought ten persons (as guests to their respective houses). Abu Bakr had brought three persons (he himself, and myself), my father and my mother (along with therm). He (the narrator) said: I do not know whether he also said: My wife and one servant who was common between our house and that of Abu Bakr. Abu Bakr had had his evening meal with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He stayed here until night prayer had been offered. He then came back (to the house of Allah's Apostle) and stayed there until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) felt drowsy and (Abu Bakr) then came (back to his own house) when (a considerable) part of the night had been over, as Allah had desired. His wife said to him: What held you back from your guests? He said: Oh! have you not served them the evening meal (by this time)? She said: It was in fact served to them. but they refused to eat until you came. He ('Abd al-Rahman) said: I slunk away and bid myself. He (Abu Bakr) said: O, you stupid fellow, and he reprimanded me, and said to the guests: Eat, though it may not be pleasant now. He said: By Allah. I will never eat it He ('Abd al-Rahman) said: By Allah. we did not take a morsel when from beneath that (there appeared) more until they had eaten to their fill, and lo! it was more than what it was before. Abu Bakr saw that and found that it was so or more than that. He said to his wife: Sister of Band Firis, what is th-is? She said: By the coolness of my eyes. it is in excess by three times over the previous one. Then Abu Bakr ate saying: That was from the Satan (viz. his vow for not eating the food). He then took a morsel out of that and then took it (the rest) to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ), and it was kept there until morning, and during (those days) there was a covenant between us and some other people, and the period of covenant was over, and we had appointed twelve officials with every person amongst them. It is Allah only Who knows as to how many people were there with each of them. He sent (this food to them) and all of them ate out of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ الْعَطَّارُ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَ نَزَلَ عَلَيْنَا أَضْيَافٌ لَنَا - قَالَ - وَكَانَ أَبِي يَتَحَدَّثُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ اللَّيْلِ - قَالَ - فَانْطَلَقَ وَقَالَ يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ افْرُغْ مِنْ أَضْيَافِكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا أَمْسَيْتُ جِئْنَا بِقِرَاهُمْ - قَالَ - فَأَبَوْا فَقَالُوا حَتَّى يَجِيءَ أَبُو مَنْزِلِنَا فَيَطْعَمَ مَعَنَا - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ لَهُمْ إِنَّهُ رَجُلٌ حَدِيدٌ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِنْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا خِفْتُ أَنْ يُصِيبَنِي مِنْهُ أَذًى - قَالَ - فَأَبَوْا فَلَمَّا جَاءَ لَمْ يَبْدَأْ بِشَىْءٍ أَوَّلَ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ أَفَرَغْتُمْ مِنْ أَضْيَافِكُمْ قَالَ قَالُوا لاَ وَاللَّهِ مَا فَرَغْنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلَمْ آمُرْ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ وَتَنَحَّيْتُ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ يَا عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَنَحَّيْتُ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ يَا غُنْثَرُ أَقْسَمْتُ عَلَيْكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ تَسْمَعُ صَوْتِي إِلاَّ جِئْتَ - قَالَ - فَجِئْتُ فَقُلْتُ وَاللَّهِ مَا لِي ذَنْبٌ هَؤُلاَءِ أَضْيَافُكَ فَسَلْهُمْ قَدْ أَتَيْتُهُمْ بِقِرَاهُمْ فَأَبَوْا أَنْ يَطْعَمُوا حَتَّى تَجِيءَ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ مَا لَكُمْ أَلاَ تَقْبَلُوا عَنَّا قِرَاكُمْ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ أَطْعَمُهُ اللَّيْلَةَ - قَالَ - فَقَالُوا فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ نَطْعَمُهُ حَتَّى تَطْعَمَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا رَأَيْتُ كَالشَّرِّ كَاللَّيْلَةِ قَطُّ وَيْلَكُمْ مَا لَكُمْ أَنْ لاَ تَقْبَلُوا عَنَّا قِرَاكُمْ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَمَّا الأُولَى فَمِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ هَلُمُّوا قِرَاكُمْ - قَالَ - فَجِيءَ بِالطَّعَامِ فَسَمَّى فَأَكَلَ وَأَكَلُوا - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ غَدَا عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَرُّوا وَحَنِثْتُ - قَالَ - فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ بَلْ أَنْتَ أَبَرُّهُمْ وَأَخْيَرُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَلَمْ تَبْلُغْنِي كَفَّارَةٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa saalimu bnu nuwhin al'attaaru, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakrin, qaala nazala 'alaynaa aadyaafun lanaa - qaala - wakaana aabiy yatahaddathu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alllayli - qaala - faantalaqa waqaala yaa 'abda alrrahmani afrugh min aadyaafika ‏.‏ qaala falammaa aamsaytu jiinaa biqiraahum - qaala - faaabawa faqaaluwa hattaa yajiy'a aabuw manzilinaa fayat'ama ma'anaa - qaala - faqultu lahum iinnahu rajulun hadiydun waiinnakum iin lam taf'aluwa khiftu aan yusiybaniy minhu aadhana - qaala - faaabawa falammaa jaa'a lam yabdaa bishaa'in aawwala minhum faqaala aafaraghtum min aadyaafikum qaala qaaluwa laa waalllahi maa faraghnaa ‏.‏ qaala aalam amur 'abda alrrahmani qaala watanahhaytu 'anhu faqaala yaa 'abda alrrahmani ‏.‏ qaala fatanahhaytu - qaala - faqaala yaa ghuntharu aaqsamtu 'alayka iin kunta tasma'u sawtiy iilaaa jiita - qaala - fajiitu faqultu waalllahi maa liy dhanbun hauulaa'i aadyaafuka fasalhum qad aataytuhum biqiraahum faaabawa aan yat'amuwa hattaa tajiy'a - qaala - faqaala maa lakum aalaa taqbaluwa 'annaa qiraakum - qaala - faqaala aabuw bakrin fawaalllahi laa aat'amuhu alllaylaaa - qaala - faqaaluwa fawaalllahi laa nat'amuhu hattaa tat'amahu ‏.‏ qaala famaa raaaytu kaalshharri kaalllaylaai qattu waylakum maa lakum aan laa taqbaluwa 'annaa qiraakum qaala thumma qaala aammaa alauwlaa famina alshhaytaani halummuwa qiraakum - qaala - fajiy'a bialtta'aami fasammaa faaakala waaakaluwa - qaala - falammaa aasbaha ghadaa 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi barruwa wahanithtu - qaala - faaakhbarahu faqaala ‏ "‏ bal aanta aabarruhum waaakhyaruhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala walam tablughniy kaffaaraaun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. Abd Bakr reported:There came to our house some guests. It was a common practice with my father to (go) and talk to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the night. While going he said: 'Abd al-Rahman, entertain the guests. When it was evening we served the food to them, but they refused saying: So long as the owner of the house does not come and join us, we would not take the meal. I said to them: He ('Abd Bakr) is a stern person, and if you would not do that (if you do not take the food). I fear, I may be harmed by him, but they refused. As he (my father) came, the first thing he asked was: Have you served the guests? They (the peopleof the household) said: We have not served them sofar. He said: Did I not command 'Abd al-Rahman (to do this)? He ('Abd al-Rahman) said: I slunk away and kept myself away by that time. He again said: O stupid fellow, I ask you on oath that In case you hear my voice you come to me. I came and said: By Allah, there is no fault of mine. These are your guests; you may ask them. I provided them with food but they refused to eat until you came. He said to them: Why is it that you did not accept our food? By Allah, I shall not even take food tonight (as you have not taken). They said: By Allah, we would not take until you join us. Thereupon he Abu Bakr) said: I have never seen a more unfortunate night than this. Woe be to thee! that you do not accept from us food prepared for you. He again said: What I did first (that is the taking of vow for not eating the food) was prompted by the Satan. Bring the food. The food was brought, and he ate by reciting the name of Allah and they also ate, and when it was morning he came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, their oath (that of the guests) came to be true, but mine was not true, and after that he informed him of the whole incident. He said: Your oath came to be the most true and you are the best of them. He (the narrator) said. I do not know whether he made an atonement for it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ طَعَامُ الاِثْنَيْنِ كَافِي الثَّلاَثَةِ وَطَعَامُ الثَّلاَثَةِ كَافِي الأَرْبَعَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ta'aamu alaithnayni kaafiy althhalaathaai wata'aamu althhalaathaai kaafiy alaarba'aai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Food for two persons suffices three persons and food for three persons suffices four persons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ طَعَامُ الْوَاحِدِ يَكْفِي الاِثْنَيْنِ وَطَعَامُ الاِثْنَيْنِ يَكْفِي الأَرْبَعَةَ وَطَعَامُ الأَرْبَعَةِ يَكْفِي الثَّمَانِيَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ إِسْحَاقَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ سَمِعْتُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, h wahaddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ ta'aamu alwaahidi yakfiy alaithnayni wata'aamu alaithnayni yakfiy alaarba'aaa wata'aamu alaarba'aai yakfiy althhamaaniyaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai iishaaqa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ lam yadhkur sami'tu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:I heard Allah'. s Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Food for one person suffices two persons and food for two persons suffices four persons, and food for four persons suffices eight persons; and in the tradition transmitted on the authority of Ishaq there is no mention of the fact that he heard it directly (from the Holy Prophet)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni jurayjin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this is reported on the authority of Jabir but with a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي، سُفْيَانَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ طَعَامُ الْوَاحِدِ يَكْفِي الاِثْنَيْنِ وَطَعَامُ الاِثْنَيْنِ يَكْفِي الأَرْبَعَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma qaala aabuw bakrin waaabuw kuraybin haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy, sufyaana 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ta'aamu alwaahidi yakfiy alaithnayni wata'aamu alaithnayni yakfiy alaarba'aaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Food for one suffices two and food for two suffices for four
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ طَعَامُ الرَّجُلِ يَكْفِي رَجُلَيْنِ وَطَعَامُ رَجُلَيْنِ يَكْفِي أَرْبَعَةً وَطَعَامُ أَرْبَعَةٍ يَكْفِي ثَمَانِيَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ta'aamu alrrajuli yakfiy rajulayni wata'aamu rajulayni yakfiy aarba'aaan wata'aamu aarba'aain yakfiy thamaaniyaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Food for one (person) suffices two, and food for two (persons) suffices four persons and food for four persons suffices eight persons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْكَافِرُ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ وَالْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaaluwa aakhbaranaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alkaafiru yaakulu fiy sab'aai aam'aa'in waalmuuminu yaakulu fiy mi'ana waahidin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that a non-Muslim eats in seven intestines whereas a Muslim eats in one intestine
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ، حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu, humaydin 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, qaala aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an aayyuwba, kilaahumaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn 'Umar but with a different chain oi transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ وَاقِدِ، بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ نَافِعًا، قَالَ رَأَى ابْنُ عُمَرَ مِسْكِينًا فَجَعَلَ يَضَعُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَيَضَعُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلَ يَأْكُلُ أَكْلاً كَثِيرًا - قَالَ - فَقَالَ لاَ يُدْخَلَنَّ هَذَا عَلَىَّ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْكَافِرَ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu khalaaadin albaahiliyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an waaqidi, bni muhammadi bni zaydin aannahu sami'a naafi'ana, qaala raaaa abnu 'umara miskiynana faja'ala yada'u bayna yadayhi wayada'u bayna yadayhi - qaala - faja'ala yaakulu aaklaan kathiyrana - qaala - faqaala laa yudkhalanna hadhaa 'alaaaa faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alkaafira yaakulu fiy sab'aai aam'aa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Umar saw a poor man. He placed food before him and he ate much. He (Ibn 'Umar) said:He should not come to me. for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that the non-Muslim eats in seven intestines
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، وَابْنِ عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ وَالْكَافِرُ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, waabni 'umara aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almuuminu yaakulu fiy mi'ana waahidin waalkaafiru yaakulu fiy sab'aai aam'aa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A believer eats in one intestine, whereas a non-believer eats in seven intestines
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكَرِ ابْنَ عُمَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi walam yadhkari abna 'umara ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بُرَيْدٌ، عَنْ جَدِّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَأْكُلُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ وَالْكَافِرُ يَأْكُلُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa buraydun, 'an jaddihi, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almuuminu yaakulu fiy mi'ana waahidin waalkaafiru yaakulu fiy sab'aai aam'aa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A believer eats in one intestine, whereas a non-believer eats in seven intestines
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira with a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ، أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَافَهُ ضَيْفٌ وَهُوَ كَافِرٌ فَأَمَرَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَاةٍ فَحُلِبَتْ فَشَرِبَ حِلاَبَهَا ثُمَّ أُخْرَى فَشَرِبَهُ ثُمَّ أُخْرَى فَشَرِبَهُ حَتَّى شَرِبَ حِلاَبَ سَبْعِ شِيَاهٍ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ أَصْبَحَ فَأَسْلَمَ فَأَمَرَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَاةٍ فَشَرِبَ حِلاَبَهَا ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِأُخْرَى فَلَمْ يَسْتَتِمَّهَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُؤْمِنُ يَشْرَبُ فِي مِعًى وَاحِدٍ وَالْكَافِرُ يَشْرَبُ فِي سَبْعَةِ أَمْعَاءٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu 'iysaa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, 'an suhayli bni, aabiy saalihin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm daafahu dayfun wahuwa kaafirun faaamara lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishaaain fahulibat fashariba hilaabahaa thumma aukhraa fasharibahu thumma aukhraa fasharibahu hattaa shariba hilaaba sab'i shiyaahin thumma iinnahu aasbaha faaaslama faaamara lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishaaain fashariba hilaabahaa thumma aamara biaukhraa falam yastatimmahaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ almuuminu yashrabu fiy mi'ana waahidin waalkaafiru yashrabu fiy sab'aai aam'aa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) invited a non-Muslim. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that a goat be milked for him. It was milked and he drank its milk. Then the second one was milked and he drank its milk, and then the other one was milked and he drank its milk. till he drank the milk of seven goats. On the next morning he embraced Islam. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded that a goat should be milked for him and he drank its milk and then another was milked but he did not finish it, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:A believer drinks In one intestine whereas a non-believer drinks in seven intestines
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ مَا عَابَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم طَعَامًا قَطُّ كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَهَى شَيْئًا أَكَلَهُ وَإِنْ كَرِهَهُ تَرَكَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala maa 'aaba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ta'aamana qattu kaana iidhaa ashtahaa shayiana aakalahu waiin karihahu tarakahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) never found fault with food (served to him). If he liked anything, he ate it and if he did not like it he left it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ الأَعْمَشُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa sulaymaanu alaa'mashu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، وَعَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو، وَعُمَرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَبُو دَاوُدَ الْحَفَرِيُّ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, wa'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw, wa'umaru bnu sa'din, aabuw daawuda alhafariyyu kulluhum 'an sufyaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of A'mash
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 36 — The Book of Drinks
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ عَنْ أَبِي يَحْيَى مَوْلَى آلِ جَعْدَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَابَ طَعَامًا قَطُّ كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَهَاهُ أَكَلَهُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَشْتَهِهِ سَكَتَ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu - waalllafzu laabiy kuraybin - qaaluwa aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa haddathanaa alaa'mashu 'an aabiy yahyaa mawlaa ali ja'daaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa qaala maa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aaba ta'aamana qattu kaana iidhaa ashtahaahu aakalahu waiin lam yashtahihi sakata ‏.‏ wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:I never saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) finding fault with food (served to him) ; if he liked it he ate it, and if did not like it he kept silent. This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الَّذِي يَشْرَبُ فِي آنِيَةِ الْفِضَّةِ إِنَّمَا يُجَرْجِرُ فِي بَطْنِهِ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'an zaydi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy bakrin alssiddiyqi, 'an aummi salamaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alladhiy yashrabu fiy aniyaai alfiddaai iinnamaa yujarjiru fiy batnihi naara jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said:He who drinks in the vessel of silver in fact drinks down in his belly the fire of Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، السَّعْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ بِشْرٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ وَالْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا الْفُضَيْلُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، ح . وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَازِمٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، السَّرَّاجِ كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ بِإِسْنَادِهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَزَادَ، فِي حَدِيثِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ‏ "‏ أَنَّ الَّذِي، يَأْكُلُ أَوْ يَشْرَبُ فِي آنِيَةِ الْفِضَّةِ وَالذَّهَبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ ذِكْرُ الأَكْلِ وَالذَّهَبِ إِلاَّ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathaniyhi 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, alssa'diyyu haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu bishrin h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy, shaybaaa waalwaliydu bnu shujaa'in qaalaa haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu, aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu haddathanaa alfudaylu bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, h . wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyrun, - ya'niy abna haazimin - 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, alssarraaji kullu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi maaliki bni aanasin biiisnaadihi 'an naafi'in, wazaada, fiy hadiythi 'aliyyi bni mushirin 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, ‏ "‏ aanna alladhiy, yaakulu aaw yashrabu fiy aniyaai alfiddaai waaldhhahabi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi aahadin minhum dhikru alaakli waaldhhahabi iilaaa fiy hadiythi abni mushirin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmitters. The hadith of Ibn Mushir on the authority of 'Ubaidullah it is as:He who eats or drinks in the vessel of silver and gold, - but there is no mention in any one of the other chains of the words pertaining to eating and gold
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زَيْدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ أَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُرَّةَ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ خَالَتِهِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ شَرِبَ فِي إِنَاءٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ أَوْ فِضَّةٍ فَإِنَّمَا يُجَرْجِرُ فِي بَطْنِهِ نَارًا مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zaydu bnu yaziyda aabuw ma'nin alrraqaashiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'an 'uthmaana, - ya'niy abna murraaa - haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an khaalatihi aummi salamaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man shariba fiy iinaa'in min dhahabin aaw fiddaain faiinnamaa yujarjiru fiy batnihi naarana min jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman reported on the authority of his mother's sister Umm Salama who said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:He who drank in vessels of gold or silver he in fact drank down in his belly the fire of Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَشْعَثُ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ سُوَيْدِ، بْنِ مُقَرِّنٍ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ فَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ أَمَرَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِسَبْعٍ وَنَهَانَا عَنْ سَبْعٍ أَمَرَنَا بِعِيَادَةِ الْمَرِيضِ وَاتِّبَاعِ الْجَنَازَةِ وَتَشْمِيتِ الْعَاطِسِ وَإِبْرَارِ الْقَسَمِ أَوِ الْمُقْسِمِ وَنَصْرِ الْمَظْلُومِ وَإِجَابَةِ الدَّاعِي وَإِفْشَاءِ السَّلاَمِ ‏.‏ وَنَهَانَا عَنْ خَوَاتِيمَ أَوْ عَنْ تَخَتُّمٍ بِالذَّهَبِ وَعَنْ شُرْبٍ بِالْفِضَّةِ وَعَنِ الْمَيَاثِرِ وَعَنِ الْقَسِّيِّ وَعَنْ لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ وَالإِسْتَبْرَقِ وَالدِّيبَاجِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aash'atha bni aabiy alshha'thaa'i, h wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aash'athu, haddathaniy mu'aawiyaau bnu suwaydi, bni muqarrinin qaala dakhaltu 'alaa albaraa'i bni 'aazibin fasami'tuhu yaquwlu aamaranaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bisab'in wanahaanaa 'an sab'in aamaranaa bi'iyaadaai almariydi waattibaa'i aljanaazaai watashmiyti al'aatisi waiibraari alqasami aawi almuqsimi wanasri almazluwmi waiijaabaai alddaa'iy waiifshaa'i alssalaami ‏.‏ wanahaanaa 'an khawaatiyma aaw 'an takhattumin bialdhhahabi wa'an shurbin bialfiddaai wa'ani almayaathiri wa'ani alqassiyyi wa'an lubsi alhariyri waaliistabraqi waalddiybaaji ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mu'awiya b. Suwaid b. Muqarrin reporxed:I visited al-Bara' b. 'Azib and heard him say: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded us to do seven things and forbade us to do seven (things). He commanded us to visit the sick, to follow the funeral procession, to answer the sneezer, to fulfil the vow, to help the poor, to accept the invitation and to greet everybody, and he forbade us to wear rings or gold rings, to drink in silver (vessels), and to use the saddle cloth made of red silk, and to wear garments made of Qassi material, or garments made of silk or brocade and velvet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ وَإِبْرَارِ الْقَسَمِ أَوِ الْمُقْسِمِ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ هَذَا الْحَرْفَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ وَجَعَلَ مَكَانَهُ وَإِنْشَادِ الضَّالِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aash'atha bni sulaymin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu iilaaa qawlahu waiibraari alqasami aawi almuqsimi ‏.‏ faiinnahu lam yadhkur hadhaa alharfa fiy alhadiythi waja'ala makaanahu waiinshaadi alddaalli ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ash'ath b. Sulaim with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight change of wording that he made no mention of:" to fulfil the vows" but substituted these words:" finding of the lost articles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ وَقَالَ إِبْرَارِ الْقَسَمِ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَكٍّ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ وَعَنِ الشُّرْبِ فِي الْفِضَّةِ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ شَرِبَ فِيهَا فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَشْرَبْ فِيهَا فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, h wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy, shaybaaa haddathanaa jariyrun, kilaahumaa 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an aash'atha bni aabiy alshha'thaa'i, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithla hadiythi zuhayrin waqaala iibraari alqasami min ghayri shakkin wazaada fiy alhadiythi wa'ani alshhurbi fiy alfiddaai faiinnahu man shariba fiyhaa fiy alddunyaa lam yashrab fiyhaa fiy alakhiraai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ash'ath b. Abu ashSha'tha' with the same chain of transmitters (and with these words):There is no doubt about the words: To fulfil the vows were mentioned and this addition had been made in the. hadith: (The Holy Prophet) forbade drinking in silver vessels, for one who drinks (in them) in this world would not drink (in them) in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الشَّيْبَانِيُّ، وَلَيْثُ بْنُ، أَبِي سُلَيْمٍ عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، بِإِسْنَادِهِمْ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ زِيَادَةَ جَرِيرٍ وَابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ، مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، قَالُوا جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، بِإِسْنَادِهِمْ وَمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِمْ إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ وَإِفْشَاءِ السَّلاَمِ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ قَالَ بَدَلَهَا وَرَدِّ السَّلاَمِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ نَهَانَا عَنْ خَاتَمِ الذَّهَبِ أَوْ حَلْقَةِ الذَّهَبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, aakhbaranaa aabuw iishaaqa alshhaybaaniyyu, walaythu bnu, aabiy sulaymin 'an aash'atha bni aabiy alshha'thaa'i, biiisnaadihim walam yadhkur ziyaadaaa jariyrin waabni mushirin h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu, mu'aadhin haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu, alrrahmani bnu bishrin haddathanaa bahzun, qaaluwa jamiy'ana haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aash'atha bni sulaymin, biiisnaadihim wama'naa hadiythihim iilaaa qawlahu waiifshaa'i alssalaami ‏.‏ faiinnahu qaala badalahaa waraddi alssalaami ‏.‏ waqaala nahaanaa 'an khaatami aldhhahabi aaw halqaai aldhhahabi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ash'ath b. Sulaim with the same chain of transmitters but with this difference that instead of the words:Ifsha as-Salam (spreading the salutations), he substituted the words Radd as-Saldm (i. e. responding to the words of salutation) and he said: He forbade (the use of) gold ring
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَشْعَثَ بْنِ أَبِي الشَّعْثَاءِ، بِإِسْنَادِهِمْ وَقَالَ وَإِفْشَاءِ السَّلاَمِ وَخَاتَمِ الذَّهَبِ ‏.‏ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَكٍّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, wa'amruw bnu muhammadin, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aash'atha bni aabiy alshha'thaa'i, biiisnaadihim waqaala waiifshaa'i alssalaami wakhaatami aldhhahabi ‏.‏ min ghayri shakkin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the auttiniity of Ash'ath b. Sulaim with the same chain of transmitters but the words (pertaining to) Ifsha as-Salam and the (use) of gold ring have been reported without doubt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الأَشْعَثِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، سَمِعْتُهُ يَذْكُرُهُ، عَنْ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُكَيْمٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ حُذَيْفَةَ بِالْمَدَائِنِ فَاسْتَسْقَى حُذَيْفَةُ فَجَاءَهُ دِهْقَانٌ بِشَرَابٍ فِي إِنَاءٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَرَمَاهُ بِهِ وَقَالَ إِنِّي أُخْبِرُكُمْ أَنِّي قَدْ أَمَرْتُهُ أَنْ لاَ يَسْقِيَنِي فِيهِ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَشْرَبُوا فِي إِنَاءِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَلاَ تَلْبَسُوا الدِّيبَاجَ وَالْحَرِيرَ فَإِنَّهُ لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَهُوَ لَكُمْ فِي الآخِرَةِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amriw bni sahli bni iishaaqa bni muhammadi bni alaash'athi bni qaysin, qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, sami'tuhu yadhkuruhu, 'an aabiy farwaaa, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bna 'ukaymin, qaala kunnaa ma'a hudhayfaaa bialmadaaiini faastasqaa hudhayfaau fajaa'ahu dihqaanun bisharaabin fiy iinaa'in min fiddaain faramaahu bihi waqaala iinniy aukhbirukum aanniy qad aamartuhu aan laa yasqiyaniy fiyhi faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tashrabuwa fiy iinaa'i aldhhahabi waalfiddaai walaa talbasuwa alddiybaaja waalhariyra faiinnahu lahum fiy alddunyaa wahuwa lakum fiy alakhiraai yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Ukaim reported:While we were with Hudhaifa in Mada'in he asked for water. A villager brought a drink for him in a silver vessel. He (Hudhaifa) threw it away saying: I inform you that I have already conveyed to him that he should not serve me drink in it (silver vessel) for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: Do not drink in gold and silver vessels, and do not wear brocade or silk, for these are meant for them (the non-believers) in this world, but they are meant for you in the Hereafter on the Day, of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي فَرْوَةَ الْجُهَنِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُكَيْمٍ يَقُولُ كُنَّا عِنْدَ حُذَيْفَةَ بِالْمَدَائِنِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ‏ "‏ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy farwaaa aljuhaniyyi, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna 'ukaymin yaquwlu kunnaa 'inda hudhayfaaa bialmadaaiini ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu walam yadhkur fiy alhadiythi ‏ "‏ yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of `Abdullah b. `Ukaim with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْجَبَّارِ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، أَوَّلاً عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، سَمِعَهُ مِنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، ثُمَّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو فَرْوَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُكَيْمٍ، فَظَنَنْتُ أَنَّ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، إِنَّمَا سَمِعَهُ مِنِ ابْنِ، عُكَيْمٍ قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ حُذَيْفَةَ بِالْمَدَائِنِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏ "‏ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu aljabbaari bnu al'alaa'i, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy najiyhin, aawwalaan 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'an hudhayfaaa, thumma haddathanaa yaziydu, sami'ahu mini abni aabiy laylaa, 'an hudhayfaaa, thumma haddathanaa aabuw farwaaa, qaala sami'tu abna 'ukaymin, fazanantu aanna abna aabiy laylaa, iinnamaa sami'ahu mini abni, 'ukaymin qaala kunnaa ma'a hudhayfaaa bialmadaaiini ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu walam yaqul ‏ "‏ yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of lbn `Ukaim through another chain of transmitters, but in this hadith no mention is made of the words:"On the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى - قَالَ شَهِدْتُ حُذَيْفَةَ اسْتَسْقَى بِالْمَدَائِنِ فَأَتَاهُ إِنْسَانٌ بِإِنَاءٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَهُ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُكَيْمٍ عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, aannahu sami'a 'abda alrrahmani, - ya'niy abna aabiy laylaa - qaala shahidtu hudhayfaaa astasqaa bialmadaaiini faaataahu iinsaanun biiinaa'in min fiddaain ‏.‏ fadhakarahu bima'naa hadiythi abni 'ukaymin 'an hudhayfaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shu'ba reported from al-Hakam that he heard 'Abd al-Rahmin (i. e. Ibn Abu Laila) as saying:I personally saw Hudhaifa asking for water in Mada'in and a man giving it to him in a silver vessel. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ وَإِسْنَادِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ فِي الْحَدِيثِ شَهِدْتُ حُذَيْفَةَ ‏.‏ غَيْرُ مُعَاذٍ وَحْدَهُ إِنَّمَا قَالُوا إِنَّ حُذَيْفَةَ اسْتَسْقَى.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin, haddathanaa bahzun, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi mu'aadhin waiisnaadihi walam yadhkur aahadun minhum fiy alhadiythi shahidtu hudhayfaaa ‏.‏ ghayru mu'aadhin wahdahu iinnamaa qaaluwa iinna hudhayfaaa astasqaa.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu`ba through another chain of transmitters. But there is no mention of "I personally saw him" in this hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مَنْ ذَكَرْنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, kilaahumaa 'an mujaahidin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an hudhayfaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi man dhakarnaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hudhaila with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سَيْفٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، قَالَ اسْتَسْقَى حُذَيْفَةُ فَسَقَاهُ مَجُوسِيٌّ فِي إِنَاءٍ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَلْبَسُوا الْحَرِيرَ وَلاَ الدِّيبَاجَ وَلاَ تَشْرَبُوا فِي آنِيَةِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَلاَ تَأْكُلُوا فِي صِحَافِهَا فَإِنَّهَا لَهُمْ فِي الدُّنْيَا‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sayfun, qaala sami'tu mujaahidana, yaquwlu sami'tu 'abda alrrahmani bna aabiy laylaa, qaala astasqaa hudhayfaau fasaqaahu majuwsiyyun fiy iinaa'in min fiddaain faqaala iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa talbasuwa alhariyra walaa alddiybaaja walaa tashrabuwa fiy aniyaai aldhhahabi waalfiddaai walaa taakuluwa fiy sihaafihaa faiinnahaa lahum fiy alddunyaa‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahmin b. Abu Laili reported that Hudhaifa asked for water and a Magian gave him water in a silver vessel, whereupon he said:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not wear silk or brocade and do not drink ifi vessels of gold and silver, and do not eat in the dishes made of them (i. e. gold and silver), for these are for them (the non-believers) in this world
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ رَأَى حُلَّةً سِيَرَاءَ عِنْدَ بَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَوِ اشْتَرَيْتَ هَذِهِ فَلَبِسْتَهَا لِلنَّاسِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَلِلْوَفْدِ إِذَا قَدِمُوا عَلَيْكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا يَلْبَسُ هَذِهِ مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جَاءَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهَا حُلَلٌ فَأَعْطَى عُمَرَ مِنْهَا حُلَّةً فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَسَوْتَنِيهَا وَقَدْ قُلْتَ فِي حُلَّةِ عُطَارِدٍ مَا قُلْتَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي لَمْ أَكْسُكَهَا لِتَلْبَسَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَكَسَاهَا عُمَرُ أَخًا لَهُ مُشْرِكًا بِمَكَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara, bna alkhattaabi raaaa hullaaan siyaraa'a 'inda baabi almasjidi faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi lawi ashtarayta hadhihi falabistahaa lilnnaasi yawma aljumu'aai walilwafdi iidhaa qadimuwa 'alayka ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa yalbasu hadhihi man laa khalaaqa lahu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma jaa'at rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm minhaa hulalun faaa'taa 'umara minhaa hullaaan faqaala 'umaru yaa rasuwla alllahi kasawtaniyhaa waqad qulta fiy hullaai 'utaaridin maa qulta faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinniy lam aaksukahaa litalbasahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakasaahaa 'umaru aakhana lahu mushrikana bimakkaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Umar b. Khattab saw (some one selling) the garments of silk at the door of the mosque, whereupon he said:Allah's Messenger, would that you buy it and wear it for the people on Friday and for (receiving) the delegations when they come to you? Upon this. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: go who wears it has no share (of reward) in the Hereafter. Then these garments were sent to Allah" s Messenger (ﷺ), and he presented one of these silk garment to Umar. Thereupon Umar said: You make me wear (this silk garment) Whereas you said about the silk garment of Utarid (the person who had been busy selling this garment at the door of the mosque) what you had to say, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I have not presented you this for wearing it (but to make use of its price) ; so 'Umar presented it to his polytheist brother in Mecca
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ الْمُقَدَّمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy bakrin almuqaddamiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hafsu bnu maysaraaa, 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, kilaahumaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni, 'umara 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythi maalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ رَأَى عُمَرُ عُطَارِدًا التَّمِيمِيَّ يُقِيمُ بِالسُّوقِ حُلَّةً سِيَرَاءَ - وَكَانَ رَجُلاً يَغْشَى الْمُلُوكَ وَيُصِيبُ مِنْهُمْ - فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ عُطَارِدًا يُقِيمُ فِي السُّوقِ حُلَّةً سِيَرَاءَ فَلَوِ اشْتَرَيْتَهَا فَلَبِسْتَهَا لِوُفُودِ الْعَرَبِ إِذَا قَدِمُوا عَلَيْكَ - وَأَظُنُّهُ قَالَ وَلَبِسْتَهَا يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ - فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا يَلْبَسُ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِحُلَلٍ سِيَرَاءَ فَبَعَثَ إِلَى عُمَرَ بِحُلَّةٍ وَبَعَثَ إِلَى أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ بِحُلَّةٍ وَأَعْطَى عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ حُلَّةً وَقَالَ ‏"‏ شَقِّقْهَا خُمُرًا بَيْنَ نِسَائِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَ عُمَرُ بِحُلَّتِهِ يَحْمِلُهَا فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ بَعَثْتَ إِلَىَّ بِهَذِهِ وَقَدْ قُلْتَ بِالأَمْسِ فِي حُلَّةِ عُطَارِدٍ مَا قُلْتَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لَمْ أَبْعَثْ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتَلْبَسَهَا وَلَكِنِّي بَعَثْتُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتُصِيبَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا أُسَامَةُ فَرَاحَ فِي حُلَّتِهِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَظَرًا عَرَفَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ أَنْكَرَ مَا صَنَعَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا تَنْظُرُ إِلَىَّ فَأَنْتَ بَعَثْتَ إِلَىَّ بِهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لَمْ أَبْعَثْ إِلَيْكَ لِتَلْبَسَهَا وَلَكِنِّي بَعَثْتُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتُشَقِّقَهَا خُمُرًا بَيْنَ نِسَائِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, haddathanaa naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala raaaa 'umaru 'utaaridana alttamiymiyya yuqiymu bialssuwqi hullaaan siyaraa'a - wakaana rajulaan yaghshaa almuluwka wayusiybu minhum - faqaala 'umaru yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy raaaytu 'utaaridana yuqiymu fiy alssuwqi hullaaan siyaraa'a falawi ashtaraytahaa falabistahaa liwufuwdi al'arabi iidhaa qadimuwa 'alayka - waaazunnuhu qaala walabistahaa yawma aljumu'aai - faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa yalbasu alhariyra fiy alddunyaa man laa khalaaqa lahu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa kaana ba'da dhalika autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihulalin siyaraa'a faba'atha iilaa 'umara bihullaain waba'atha iilaa ausaamaaa bni zaydin bihullaain waaa'taa 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin hullaaan waqaala ‏"‏ shaqqiqhaa khumurana bayna nisaaiika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fajaa'a 'umaru bihullatihi yahmiluhaa faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi ba'athta iilaaaa bihadhihi waqad qulta bialaamsi fiy hullaai 'utaaridin maa qulta faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy lam aab'ath bihaa iilayka litalbasahaa walakinniy ba'athtu bihaa iilayka litusiyba bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaammaa ausaamaau faraaha fiy hullatihi fanazara iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nazarana 'arafa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad aankara maa sana'a faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi maa tanzuru iilaaaa faaanta ba'athta iilaaaa bihaa faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy lam aab'ath iilayka litalbasahaa walakinniy ba'athtu bihaa iilayka litushaqqiqahaa khumurana bayna nisaaiika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Umar saw Utarid al-Tamimi standing in the market (and selling) the silk garments, and he was the person who went to (courts of) kings and got (high prices) for these garments from them. Umar said:Allah's Messenger I saw 'Utarid standing in the market with a silk garment; would that you buy and wear it for (receiving) the delegations of Arabs when they visit you? I (the narrator) said: I think he ('Umar) also said: You may wear it on Friday (also). Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) said: He who wears silk in this world has no share in the Hereafter. Later on when these silk garments were presented to Allah's Massenger (ﷺ) he presented one silk garment to 'Umar and presented one also to Usama b. Zaid and gave one to 'Ali b. Abu 'Talib. saying: Tear them and make head coverings for your ladies. 'Umar came carrying his garment and said: Allah's Messenger, you have sent it to me, whereas you had said yesterday about the (silk) garment of Utarid what you had to say. He (the Holy Prophet) said: I have not sent it to you that you wear it, but I have sent It to you so that you may derive benefit out of it; and Usama (donned) the garment (presented to him) and appeared to be brisk, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) looked at him with a look by which he perceived that the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did not like what he had done. He said: Allah's Messenger. why is it that you look at me like this. whereas you yourself presented it to me? He said: I never sent it to you to wear it, but I sent It to you so that you may tear it and make out head covering for your ladies
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِحَرْمَلَةَ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ وَجَدَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ حُلَّةً مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ تُبَاعُ بِالسُّوقِ فَأَخَذَهَا فَأَتَى بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ابْتَعْ هَذِهِ فَتَجَمَّلْ بِهَا لِلْعِيدِ وَلِلْوَفْدِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ لِبَاسُ مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَبِثَ عُمَرُ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ .‏ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِجُبَّةِ دِيبَاجٍ فَأَقْبَلَ بِهَا عُمَرُ حَتَّى أَتَى بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قُلْتَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا هَذِهِ لِبَاسُ مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا يَلْبَسُ هَذِهِ مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَىَّ بِهَذِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَبِيعُهَا وَتُصِيبُ بِهَا حَاجَتَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu liharmalaaa - qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu, wahbin aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, qaala wajada 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi hullaaan min iistabraqin tubaa'u bialssuwqi faaakhadhahaa faaataa bihaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi abta' hadhihi fatajammal bihaa lil'iydi walilwafdi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa hadhihi libaasu man laa khalaaqa lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala falabitha 'umaru maa shaa'a alllahu .‏ thumma aarsala iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bijubbaai diybaajin faaaqbala bihaa 'umaru hattaa aataa bihaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi qulta ‏"‏ iinnamaa hadhihi libaasu man laa khalaaqa lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw ‏"‏ iinnamaa yalbasu hadhihi man laa khalaaqa lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aarsalta iilaaaa bihadhihi faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tabiy'uhaa watusiybu bihaa haajataka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported:'Umar b. at-Khattab found a silk garment being sold in the market; he purchased it and brought it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, get it and adorn yourself (by wearing it) on the 'Id (days) and for the delegation. Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: That is the dress of one who has no share (in the Hereafter). 'Umar stayed there so long as Allah wished. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent him a silk cloak. 'Umar came back with that to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger. you said that it is the dress of one who has no share in the Hereafter, but then you sent it to me. Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You sell it and meet your need (with its proceeds)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
