verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ، حَفْصٍ عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، رَأَى عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ آلِ عُطَارِدٍ قَبَاءً مِنْ دِيبَاجٍ أَوْ حَرِيرٍ فَقَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَوِ اشْتَرَيْتَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا يَلْبَسُ هَذَا مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأُهْدِيَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُلَّةٌ سِيَرَاءُ فَأَرْسَلَ بِهَا إِلَىَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ أَرْسَلْتَ بِهَا إِلَىَّ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُكَ قُلْتَ فِيهَا مَا قُلْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا بَعَثْتُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتَسْتَمْتِعَ بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, aakhbaraniy aabuw bakri bnu, hafsin 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna 'umara, raaaa 'alaa rajulin min ali 'utaaridin qabaa'an min diybaajin aaw hariyrin faqaala lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lawi ashtaraytahu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa yalbasu hadhaa man laa khalaaqa lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faauhdiya iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hullaaun siyaraa'u faaarsala bihaa iilaaaa ‏.‏ qaala qultu aarsalta bihaa iilaaaa waqad sami'tuka qulta fiyhaa maa qulta qaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa ba'athtu bihaa iilayka litastamti'a bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: lbn 'Umar reported that 'Umar saw a person of the tribe of 'Utirid selling a garment made of brocade or silk and said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ):Would that you buy it? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: He who wears it has no share for him in the Hereafter. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented with a striped silk garment and he sent it to him ('Umar). He (, Umar) said: You sent it to me whereas I heard from you about it what you had to say, whereupon he (Allah's Messenger) said: I sent it to you so that you may benefit by it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ حَفْصٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، رَأَى عَلَى رَجُلٍ مِنْ آلِ عُطَارِدٍ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا بَعَثْتُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتَنْتَفِعَ بِهَا وَلَمْ أَبْعَثْ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتَلْبَسَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy abnu numayrin, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu hafsin, 'an saalimi, bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara 'an aabiyhi, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, raaaa 'alaa rajulin min ali 'utaaridin ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi yahyaa bni sa'iydin ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ba'athtu bihaa iilayka litantafi'a bihaa walam aab'ath bihaa iilayka litalbasahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Umar through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording (and the words are that the Holy Prophet) said:I sent it to you so that you might derive benefit from it. but I did not send it to you to wear it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي الإِسْتَبْرَقِ قَالَ قُلْتُ مَا غَلُظَ مِنَ الدِّيبَاجِ وَخَشُنَ مِنْهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ رَأَى عُمَرُ عَلَى رَجُلٍ حُلَّةً مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ فَأَتَى بِهَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا بَعَثْتُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتُصِيبَ بِهَا مَالاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, qaala haddathaniy yahyaa bnu aabiy iishaaqa, qaala qaala liy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi fiy aliistabraqi qaala qultu maa ghaluza mina alddiybaaji wakhashuna minhu ‏.‏ faqaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna 'umara yaquwlu raaaa 'umaru 'alaa rajulin hullaaan min iistabraqin faaataa bihaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythihim ghayra aannahu qaala faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ba'athtu bihaa iilayka litusiyba bihaa maalaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that 'Umar saw a person with a garment of brocade and he brought it to Allah's Apostle (may peace he upon him) -the rest of the hadith is the same, except for the words that he (the Holy Prophet) said:I sent it to you that you might get money thereby
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مَوْلَى أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَكَانَ خَالَ وَلَدِ عَطَاءٍ قَالَ أَرْسَلَتْنِي أَسْمَاءُ إِلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ فَقَالَتْ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ تُحَرِّمُ أَشْيَاءَ ثَلاَثَةً الْعَلَمَ فِي الثَّوْبِ وَمِيثَرَةَ الأُرْجُوَانِ وَصَوْمَ رَجَبٍ كُلِّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ أَمَّا مَا ذَكَرْتَ مِنْ رَجَبٍ فَكَيْفَ بِمَنْ يَصُومُ الأَبَدَ وَأَمَّا مَا ذَكَرْتَ مِنَ الْعَلَمِ فِي الثَّوْبِ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا يَلْبَسُ الْحَرِيرَ مَنْ لاَ خَلاَقَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخِفْتُ أَنْ يَكُونَ الْعَلَمُ مِنْهُ وَأَمَّا مِيثَرَةُ الأُرْجُوَانِ فَهَذِهِ مِيثَرَةُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا هِيَ أُرْجُوَانٌ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعْتُ إِلَى أَسْمَاءَ فَخَبَّرْتُهَا فَقَالَتْ هَذِهِ جُبَّةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَخْرَجَتْ إِلَىَّ جُبَّةَ طَيَالَسَةٍ كِسْرَوَانِيَّةً لَهَا لِبْنَةُ دِيبَاجٍ وَفَرْجَيْهَا مَكْفُوفَيْنِ بِالدِّيبَاجِ فَقَالَتْ هَذِهِ كَانَتْ عِنْدَ عَائِشَةَ حَتَّى قُبِضَتْ فَلَمَّا قُبِضَتْ قَبَضْتُهَا وَكَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَلْبَسُهَا فَنَحْنُ نَغْسِلُهَا لِلْمَرْضَى يُسْتَشْفَى بِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'abdi almaliki, 'an 'abdi alllahi, mawlaa aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin wakaana khaala waladi 'ataa'in qaala aarsalatniy aasmaa'u iilaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara faqaalat balaghaniy aannaka tuharrimu aashyaa'a thalaathaaan al'alama fiy althhawbi wamiytharaaa alaurjuwaani wasawma rajabin kullihi ‏.‏ faqaala liy 'abdu alllahi aammaa maa dhakarta min rajabin fakayfa biman yasuwmu alaabada waaammaa maa dhakarta mina al'alami fiy althhawbi faiinniy sami'tu 'umara bna alkhattaabi yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnamaa yalbasu alhariyra man laa khalaaqa lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakhiftu aan yakuwna al'alamu minhu waaammaa miytharaau alaurjuwaani fahadhihi miytharaau 'abdi alllahi faiidhaa hiya aurjuwaanun ‏.‏ faraja'tu iilaa aasmaa'a fakhabbartuhaa faqaalat hadhihi jubbaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faaakhrajat iilaaaa jubbaaa tayaalasaain kisrawaaniyyaaan lahaa libnaau diybaajin wafarjayhaa makfuwfayni bialddiybaaji faqaalat hadhihi kaanat 'inda 'aaiishaaa hattaa qubidat falammaa qubidat qabadtuhaa wakaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yalbasuhaa fanahnu naghsiluhaa lilmardaa yustashfaa bihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah. the freed slave of Asma' (the daughter of Abu Bakr). the maternal uncle of the son of 'Ata, reported:Asma' sent me to 'Abdullah b. 'Umar saying: The news has reached me that you prohibit the use of three things: the striped robe. saddle cloth made of red silk. and the fasting in the holy month of Rajab. 'Abdullah said to me: So far as what you say about fasting in the month of Rajab, how about one who observes continuous fasting? -and so far as what you say about the striped garment, I heard Umar b. Khatab say that he had heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): He who wears silk garment has no share for him (in the Hereafter), and I am afraid it may not be that striped garment; and so far as the red saddle clotb is concerned that is the saddle cloth of Abdullah and it is red. I went back to Asma' and informed her. whereupon she said: Here is the cloak of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). and she brought out to me that cloak made of Persian cloth with a hem of brocade, and its sleeves bordered with brocade and said: This wall Allah's Messenger's cloak with 'A'isha until she died, and when she died. I got possession of it. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) used to wear that, and we waslied it for the sick and sought cure thereby
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ خَلِيفَةَ بْنِ كَعْبٍ، أَبِي ذُبْيَانَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَخْطُبُ يَقُولُ أَلاَ لاَ تُلْبِسُوا نِسَاءَكُمُ الْحَرِيرَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَلْبَسُوا الْحَرِيرَ فَإِنَّهُ مَنْ لَبِسَهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَلْبَسْهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu sa'iydin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an khaliyfaaa bni ka'bin, aabiy dhubyaana qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri, yakhtubu yaquwlu aalaa laa tulbisuwa nisaa'akumu alhariyra faiinniy sami'tu 'umara bna alkhattaabi yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa talbasuwa alhariyra faiinnahu man labisahu fiy alddunyaa lam yalbashu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Khalifa b. Ka'b AbCi Dhubyan reported:I heard 'Abdullah b. Zubair addressing the people and saying: Behold! do not dress yuor women with silk clothes for I heard 'Umar b. Khattab as sayinp that he had heard Allah's messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Do not wear silk, for one who wear it in this world will not wear it in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ أَبِي، عُثْمَانَ قَالَ كَتَبَ إِلَيْنَا عُمَرُ وَنَحْنُ بِأَذْرَبِيجَانَ يَا عُتْبَةَ بْنَ فَرْقَدٍ إِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ كَدِّكَ وَلاَ مِنْ كَدِّ أَبِيكَ وَلاَ مِنْ كَدِّ أُمِّكَ فَأَشْبِعِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فِي رِحَالِهِمْ مِمَّا تَشْبَعُ مِنْهُ فِي رَحْلِكَ وَإِيَّاكُمْ وَالتَّنَعُّمَ وَزِيَّ أَهْلِ الشِّرْكِ وَلَبُوسَ الْحَرِيرِ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ لَبُوسِ الْحَرِيرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِلاَّ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَرَفَعَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِصْبَعَيْهِ الْوُسْطَى وَالسَّبَّابَةَ وَضَمَّهُمَا قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ قَالَ عَاصِمٌ هَذَا فِي الْكِتَابِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَرَفَعَ زُهَيْرٌ إِصْبَعَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, 'an aabiy, 'uthmaana qaala kataba iilaynaa 'umaru wanahnu biaadhrabiyjaana yaa 'utbaaa bna farqadin iinnahu laysa min kaddika walaa min kaddi aabiyka walaa min kaddi aummika faaashbi'i almuslimiyna fiy rihaalihim mimmaa tashba'u minhu fiy rahlika waiiyyaakum waalttana''uma waziyya aahli alshhirki walabuwsa alhariyri faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an labuwsi alhariyri ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ iilaaa hakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ warafa'a lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iisba'ayhi alwustaa waalssabbaabaaa wadammahumaa qaala zuhayrun qaala 'aasimun hadhaa fiy alkitaabi ‏.‏ qaala warafa'a zuhayrun iisba'ayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asim al-Abwal reported on the authority Abu Uthman saying:'Umar wrote to us when we were in Adharba'ijan saying: 'Utba b. Farqad, this wealth is neither the result of your own labour nor the result of the labour of your father, nor the result of the labour of your mother, so feed Muslims at their own places as you feed (members of your family and yourselves at your own residence), and beware of the life of pleasure, and the dress of the polytheists and wearing of silk garments, for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade the wearing of silk garments, but only this much, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) raised his. forefinger and middle finger and he joined. them (to indicate that only this much silk can be allowed in the dress of a man). 'Asim said also: This is what is recorded in the lette., (sent to us), and Zuhair raised his two fingers (to give an idea of the extent to which silk may be used)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ غِيَاثٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْحَرِيرِ‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyru bnu 'abdu alhamiydi, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa hafsu bnu ghiyaathin, kilaahumaa 'an 'aasimin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alhariyri‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Asim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَهُوَ عُثْمَانُ - وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ فَجَاءَنَا كِتَابُ عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَلْبَسُ الْحَرِيرَ إِلاَّ مَنْ لَيْسَ لَهُ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ فِي الآخِرَةِ إِلاَّ هَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ بِإِصْبَعَيْهِ اللَّتَيْنِ تَلِيَانِ الإِبْهَامَ ‏.‏ فَرُئِيتُهُمَا أَزْرَارَ الطَّيَالِسَةِ حِينَ رَأَيْتُ الطَّيَالِسَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy shaybaaa, - wahuwa 'uthmaanu - waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu kilaahumaa 'an jariyrin, - waalllafzu liishaaqa - aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, qaala kunnaa ma'a 'utbaaa bni farqadin fajaa'anaa kitaabu 'umara aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yalbasu alhariyra iilaaa man laysa lahu minhu shaa'un fiy alakhiraai iilaaa hakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw 'uthmaana biiisba'ayhi alllatayni taliyaani aliibhaama ‏.‏ faruiiytuhumaa aazraara alttayaalisaai hiyna raaaytu alttayaalisaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu 'Uthman reported:While we were with 'Utba b. Farqad there came a letter of 'Umar (containing the instructions) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: None should wear silk (with the exception of so much) but he will have nothing of it in the Hereafter. Abu 'Uthman said: To the extent of two fingers which are close to the thumb, and I was shown the (silk) borders of the Tayalisa mantle (which were about two fingers in breadth and I saw them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, 'an aabiyhi, haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, qaala kunnaa ma'a 'utbaaa bni farqadin bimithli hadiythi jariyrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: The previous hadith is narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيَّ، قَالَ جَاءَنَا كِتَابُ عُمَرَ وَنَحْنُ بِأَذْرَبِيجَانَ مَعَ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ أَوْ بِالشَّامِ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ إِلاَّ هَكَذَا إِصْبَعَيْنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو عُثْمَانَ فَمَا عَتَّمْنَا أَنَّهُ يَعْنِي الأَعْلاَمَ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa 'uthmaana alnnahdiyya, qaala jaa'anaa kitaabu 'umara wanahnu biaadhrabiyjaana ma'a 'utbaaa bni farqadin aaw bialshhaami aammaa ba'du faiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alhariyri iilaaa hakadhaa iisba'ayni ‏.‏ qaala aabuw 'uthmaana famaa 'attamnaa aannahu ya'niy alaa'laama‏.‏
verses.translation: Qatada reported:I heard Abe 'Uthman al-Nahdi as saying: There came to us a letter of 'Umar as we were in Adharba'ijan or in Syria in the company of 'Utba b. Farqad (and the letter ran thus): After (usual praise and glorification of Allah) it is stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has forbidden the use of silk btit to the extent of these two fingers, and Abu Uthman said: We at once understood by these words that he meant (silk) patterns on (the cloth)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - wahuwa abnu hishaamin - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu walam yadhkur qawla aabiy 'uthmaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Qatada but there is no mention of the words of Abd Uthman
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَأَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا - مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ سُوَيْدِ بْنِ غَفَلَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ، بْنَ الْخَطَّابَ خَطَبَ بِالْجَابِيَةِ فَقَالَ نَهَى نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ إِصْبَعَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثٍ أَوْ أَرْبَعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, waaabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu wazuhayru bnu harbin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa waabnu bashhaarin - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa - mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'aamirin alshha'biyyi, 'an suwaydi bni ghafalaaa, aanna 'umara, bna alkhattaaba khataba bialjaabiyaai faqaala nahaa nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an lubsi alhariyri iilaaa mawdi'a iisba'ayni aaw thalaathin aaw aarba'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Suwaid b. Ghafala said:'Umar addressed us at a place known as Jabiya (Syria) and he said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade us the wearing of silk but to the extent of two or three fingers or four fingers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرُّزِّيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alrruzziyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi bnu 'ataa'in, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ حَبِيبٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ لَبِسَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا قَبَاءً مِنْ دِيبَاجٍ أُهْدِيَ لَهُ ثُمَّ أَوْشَكَ أَنْ نَزَعَهُ فَأَرْسَلَ بِهِ إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَقِيلَ لَهُ قَدْ أَوْشَكَ مَا نَزَعْتَهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ نَهَانِي عَنْهُ جِبْرِيلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَهُ عُمَرُ يَبْكِي فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَرِهْتَ أَمْرًا وَأَعْطَيْتَنِيهِ فَمَا لِي قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لَمْ أُعْطِكَهُ لِتَلْبَسَهُ إِنَّمَا أَعْطَيْتُكَهُ تَبِيعُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبَاعَهُ بِأَلْفَىْ دِرْهَمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, wayahyaa bnu habiybin, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri - waalllafzu laibni habiybin - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu labisa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana qabaa'an min diybaajin auhdiya lahu thumma aawshaka aan naza'ahu faaarsala bihi iilaa 'umara bni alkhattaabi faqiyla lahu qad aawshaka maa naza'tahu yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ nahaaniy 'anhu jibriylu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fajaa'ahu 'umaru yabkiy faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi karihta aamrana waaa'taytaniyhi famaa liy qaala ‏"‏ iinniy lam au'tikahu litalbasahu iinnamaa aa'taytukahu tabiy'uhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fabaa'ahu biaalfaa dirhamin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that one day Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) put on a cloak made of brocade, which had been presented to him. He then quickly put it off and sent it to 'Umar b. Khattab, and it was said to him:Messenger of Allah. why is it that you put it of immediately. whereupon he said: Gabriel forbade me from it (i. e. wearing of Ods garment), and 'Umar came to him weeping and said: Messenger of Allah you disapproved a thing but you gave it to me. What about me, then? Thereupon be (the Holy Prophet) Wd: I did not give it to you to wear it, but I gave you that you might sell it; and so he (Hadrat Umar) sold it for two thousand dirhams
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ أُهْدِيَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُلَّةُ سِيَرَاءَ فَبَعَثَ بِهَا إِلَىَّ فَلَبِسْتُهَا فَعَرَفْتُ الْغَضَبَ فِي وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لَمْ أَبْعَثْ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتَلْبَسَهَا إِنَّمَا بَعَثْتُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتُشَقِّقَهَا خُمُرًا بَيْنَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'niy abna mahdiyyin - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy 'awnin, qaala sami'tu aabaa saalihin, yuhaddithu 'an 'aliyyin, qaala auhdiyat lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hullaau siyaraa'a faba'atha bihaa iilaaaa falabistuhaa fa'araftu alghadaba fiy wajhihi faqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy lam aab'ath bihaa iilayka litalbasahaa iinnamaa ba'athtu bihaa iilayka litushaqqiqahaa khumurana bayna alnnisaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported:A silk cloak was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). and he sent it to me and I wore it. but then found some sign of disapproval upon his face, whereupon he said: I did not send it to you that you wear it, but I sent it to you so that you might tear it and make out head dream for your women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فِي حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ فَأَمَرَنِي فَأَطَرْتُهَا بَيْنَ نِسَائِي ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ فَأَطَرْتُهَا بَيْنَ نِسَائِي ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فَأَمَرَنِي‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy 'awnin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi fiy hadiythi mu'aadhin faaamaraniy faaatartuhaa bayna nisaaiiy ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi muhammadi bni ja'farin faaatartuhaa bayna nisaaiiy ‏.‏ walam yadhkur faaamaraniy‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. Ja'far but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عَوْنٍ الثَّقَفِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ الْحَنَفِيِّ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، أَنَّ أُكَيْدِرَ، دُومَةَ أَهْدَى إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثَوْبَ حَرِيرٍ فَأَعْطَاهُ عَلِيًّا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ شَقِّقْهُ خُمُرًا بَيْنَ الْفَوَاطِمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ ‏"‏ بَيْنَ النِّسْوَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin wazuhayru bnu harbin - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaala aabuw kuraybin aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an mis'arin, 'an aabiy 'awnin althhaqafiyyi, 'an aabiy saalihin alhanafiyyi, 'an 'aliyyin, aanna aukaydira, duwmaaa aahdaa iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm thawba hariyrin faaa'taahu 'aliyyana faqaala ‏"‏ shaqqiqhu khumurana bayna alfawaatimi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw bakrin waaabuw kuraybin ‏"‏ bayna alnniswaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported that Ukaidir of Duma presented to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a silk garment, and he presented it to 'Ali. and said:Tear it to make head covering for Fitimas out of it. This tradition is transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr, and Abu Kuraib said: Among the women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ كَسَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُلَّةَ سِيَرَاءَ فَخَرَجْتُ فِيهَا فَرَأَيْتُ الْغَضَبَ فِي وَجْهِهِ - قَالَ - فَشَقَقْتُهَا بَيْنَ نِسَائِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni maysaraaa, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, 'an 'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin, qaala kasaaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hullaaa siyaraa'a fakharajtu fiyhaa faraaaytu alghadaba fiy wajhihi - qaala - fashaqaqtuhaa bayna nisaaiiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Abu Talib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me to wear a garment in the form of silk cloak. I went out wearing it, but saw signs of anger on his face, so I tore it and distributed it amongst my women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كَامِلٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى عُمَرَ بِجُبَّةِ سُنْدُسٍ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بَعَثْتَ بِهَا إِلَىَّ وَقَدْ قُلْتَ فِيهَا مَا قُلْتَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لَمْ أَبْعَثْ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتَلْبَسَهَا وَإِنَّمَا بَعَثْتُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ لِتَنْتَفِعَ بِثَمَنِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, waaabuw kaamilin - waalllafzu laabiy kaamilin - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni alaasammi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa 'umara bijubbaai sundusin faqaala 'umaru ba'athta bihaa iilaaaa waqad qulta fiyhaa maa qulta qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy lam aab'ath bihaa iilayka litalbasahaa waiinnamaa ba'athtu bihaa iilayka litantafi'a bithamanihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (may Peace be upon him) sent a silk gown to 'Umar, whereupon 'Umar said:You sent it to me whereas you said what you had to, say (i. e. it is forbidden for men). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: I did not send it to you so that you might wear it, but I sent it to you so that you might derive benefit from its price
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ صُهَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَلْبَسْهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni suhaybin, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man labisa alhariyra fiy alddunyaa lam yalbashu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:He who wore silk in this world would not wear it in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى الرَّازِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الدِّمَشْقِيُّ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي شَدَّادٌ أَبُو عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو أُمَامَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ لَبِسَ الْحَرِيرَ فِي الدُّنْيَا لَمْ يَلْبَسْهُ فِي الآخِرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa alrraaziyyu, aakhbaranaa shu'aybu bnu iishaaqa alddimashqiyyu, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, haddathaniy shaddaadun aabuw 'ammaarin, haddathaniy aabuw aumaamaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man labisa alhariyra fiy alddunyaa lam yalbashu fiy alakhiraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Umama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:He who wore silk in this world would not wear it in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أُهْدِيَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرُّوجُ حَرِيرٍ فَلَبِسَهُ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فِيهِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَنَزَعَهُ نَزْعًا شَدِيدًا كَالْكَارِهِ لَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْبَغِي هَذَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ ‏"‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, aannahu qaala auhdiya lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm farruwju hariyrin falabisahu thumma sallaa fiyhi thumma ansarafa fanaza'ahu naz'ana shadiydana kaalkaarihi lahu thumma qaala ‏ "‏ laa yanbaghiy hadhaa lilmuttaqiyna ‏"‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. 'Amir said:A silk go vn was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he wore it and observed prayer in it and then returned and put it off so violently as if he despised it. He then said: It does not befit the Godfearing persons
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي أَبَا عَاصِمٍ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa alddahhaaku, - ya'niy aabaa 'aasimin - haddathanaa 'abdu, alhamiydi bnu ja'farin haddathaniy yaziydu bnu aabiy habiybin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of azid b. Abu Habib with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، أَنْبَأَهُمْ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَخَّصَ لِعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَالزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ فِي الْقُمُصِ الْحَرِيرِ فِي السَّفَرِ مِنْ حِكَّةٍ كَانَتْ بِهِمَا أَوْ وَجَعٍ كَانَ بِهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, haddathanaa qataadaau, aanna aanasa bna maalikin, aanbaaahum aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rakhhasa li'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin waalzzubayri bni al'awwaami fiy alqumusi alhariyri fiy alssafari min hikkaain kaanat bihimaa aaw waja'in kaana bihimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported to them (his companions) that Allah's Messnger (ﷺ) had granted concession to Abd al-Rahman b. *Anf and Zubair b. 'Awwam for the wearing of a silk shirt during the journey and because of itch which they both had or any other disease from which both of them had been suffering
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي السَّفَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa sa'iydun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur fiy alssafari ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'd with the same chain of transmitters but there is no mention of the word" journey
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - أَوْ رُخِّصَ - لِلزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ الْعَوَّامِ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ فِي لُبْسِ الْحَرِيرِ لِحِكَّةٍ كَانَتْ بِهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala rakhhasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - aaw rukhhisa - lilzzubayri bni al'awwaami wa'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin fiy lubsi alhariyri lihikkaain kaanat bihimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted concession, or Zubair b. Awwam and 'Abd Al-Rahman b. Auf were granted concession, for the wearing of silk because of the itch that they both had
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، أَنَّ أَنَسًا، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ عَوْفٍ وَالزُّبَيْرَ بْنَ الْعَوَّامِ شَكَوَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقَمْلَ فَرَخَّصَ لَهُمَا فِي قُمُصِ الْحَرِيرِ فِي غَزَاةٍ لَهُمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, aanna aanasana, aakhbarahu aanna 'abda alrrahmani bna 'awfin waalzzubayra bna al'awwaami shakawaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alqamla farakhhasa lahumaa fiy qumusi alhariyri fiy ghazaaain lahumaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf and Zu'bair. b. 'Awwam complained to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about lice; he granted them concession to wear shirts of silk
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ ابْنَ مَعْدَانَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ جُبَيْرَ بْنَ نُفَيْرٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ رَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَىَّ ثَوْبَيْنِ مُعَصْفَرَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ مِنْ ثِيَابِ الْكُفَّارِ فَلاَ تَلْبَسْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an yahyaa, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu iibraahiyma bni alhaarithi, aanna abna ma'daana, aakhbarahu aanna jubayra bna nufayrin aakhbarahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'amriw bni al'aasi aakhbarahu qaala raaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaaaa thawbayni mu'asfarayni faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna hadhihi min thiyaabi alkuffaari falaa talbashaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Amr b. al-As reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw me wearing two clothes dyed in saffron. whereupon he said: These are the clothes (usually worn by) the non-believers, so do not wear them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالاَ عَنْ خَالِدِ بْنِ مَعْدَانَ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an 'aliyyi bni almubaaraki, kilaahumaa 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaalaa 'an khaalidi bni ma'daana, ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Yahya b. Abu Kathir with the same chain of trarnmitteis
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ رُشَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ أَيُّوبَ الْمَوْصِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ رَأَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَىَّ ثَوْبَيْنِ مُعَصْفَرَيْنِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَأُمُّكَ أَمَرَتْكَ بِهَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَغْسِلُهُمَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلْ أَحْرِقْهُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa daawudu bnu rushaydin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu aayyuwba almawsiliyyu, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu naafi'in, 'an sulaymaana alaahwali, 'an taawusin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala raaaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaaaa thawbayni mu'asfarayni faqaala ‏"‏ aaaummuka aamaratka bihadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu aaghsiluhumaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ bal aahriqhumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Amr reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saw me in two clothes dyed in saffron, whereupon he said: Has your mother ordered you to do so? And I said: I will wash them. He said: But burn them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ لُبْسِ الْقَسِّيِّ وَالْمُعَصْفَرِ وَعَنْ تَخَتُّمِ الذَّهَبِ وَعَنْ قِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'an iibraahiyma bni 'abdi, alllahi bni hunaynin 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an lubsi alqassiyyi waalmu'asfari wa'an takhattumi aldhhahabi wa'an qiraa'aai alqurani fiy alrrukuw'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Abu Talib reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade wearing of silk and yellow clothes, and the gold ring, and the reciting of the Qur'an in the ruku' (state of kneeling in prayer)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، يَقُولُ نَهَانِي النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ وَأَنَا رَاكِعٌ وَعَنْ لُبْسِ الذَّهَبِ وَالْمُعَصْفَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin, aanna aabaahu, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin, yaquwlu nahaaniy alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alqiraa'aai waaanaa raaki'un wa'an lubsi aldhhahabi waalmu'asfari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Abu Talib reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade me to recite the Qur'an while I am in ruku; and the wearing of gold and clothes dyed in saffron
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُنَيْنٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، قَالَ نَهَانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ التَّخَتُّمِ بِالذَّهَبِ وَعَنْ لِبَاسِ الْقَسِّيِّ وَعَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ وَالسُّجُودِ وَعَنْ لِبَاسِ الْمُعَصْفَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an iibraahiyma, bni 'abdi alllahi bni hunaynin 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin, qaala nahaaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alttakhattumi bialdhhahabi wa'an libaasi alqassiyyi wa'ani alqiraa'aai fiy alrrukuw'i waalssujuwdi wa'an libaasi almu'asfari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Abu Talib reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade me to use gold rings. to wear silk clothes and to recite the Qur'an in ruku' and sajda (prostration), and to wear yellow garments
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ قُلْنَا لأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ أَىُّ اللِّبَاسِ كَانَ أَحَبَّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ أَعْجَبَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ الْحِبَرَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala qulnaa laanasi bni maalikin aaaau alllibaasi kaana aahabba iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw aa'jaba iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala alhibaraau ‏.‏
verses.translation: (Qatada said:We asked Anas b. Malik which garment did Allah's Messenger may peace be upon him) love or like (to wear). He said: The mantle of Yemen
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ أَحَبَّ الثِّيَابِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْحِبَرَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana aahabba althhiyaabi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alhibaraau ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that the garment most liked by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was the mantle of Yemen
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فَأَخْرَجَتْ إِلَيْنَا إِزَارًا غَلِيظًا مِمَّا يُصْنَعُ بِالْيَمَنِ وَكِسَاءً مِنَ الَّتِي يُسَمُّونَهَا الْمُلَبَّدَةَ - قَالَ - فَأَقْسَمَتْ بِاللَّهِ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُبِضَ فِي هَذَيْنِ الثَّوْبَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, haddathanaa humaydun, 'an aabiy burdaaa, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa 'aaiishaaa faaakhrajat iilaynaa iizaarana ghaliyzana mimmaa yusna'u bialyamani wakisaa'an mina allatiy yusammuwnahaa almulabbadaaa - qaala - faaaqsamat bialllahi iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qubida fiy hadhayni althhawbayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Burda reported:I visited A'isha and she brought out for us the coarse lower garfnent (of Allah's Messenger) made in Yemen and clothes made out of Mulabbada cloth, and she swore in the name of Allah that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died in these two clothes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ ابْنُ حُجْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، قَالَ أَخْرَجَتْ إِلَيْنَا عَائِشَةُ إِزَارًا وَكِسَاءً مُلَبَّدًا فَقَالَتْ فِي هَذَا قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ إِزَارًا غَلِيظًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, waya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, qaala abnu hujrin haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'an aayyuwba, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, qaala aakhrajat iilaynaa 'aaiishaau iizaarana wakisaa'an mulabbadana faqaalat fiy hadhaa qubida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala abnu haatimin fiy hadiythihi iizaarana ghaliyzana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Burda reported that A'isha brought out for us the lower garment and the upper garment made of the Mulabbada cloth and said:It was in these (clothes) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died. Ibn Hatim (one of the narrators) in his narration Wd: The lower garment of coarse cloth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ إِزَارًا غَلِيظًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an aayyuwba, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu waqaala iizaarana ghaliyzana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ayyub with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ غَدَاةٍ وَعَلَيْهِ مِرْطٌ مُرَحَّلٌ مِنْ شَعَرٍ أَسْوَدَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy surayju bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu zakariyyaa'a bni aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an aabiyhi, h wahaddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, h wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu hanbalin, haddathanaa yahyaa, bnu zakariyyaa'a aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an mus'abi bni shaybaaa, 'an safiyyaaa binti shaybaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kharaja alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata ghadaaain wa'alayhi mirtun murahhalun min sha'arin aaswada ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) went out one morning wearing a blanket made of (camel's or sheep's) black hair with patterns of camel saddles upon it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ وِسَادَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّتِي يَتَّكِئُ عَلَيْهَا مِنْ أَدَمٍ حَشْوُهَا لِيفٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana wisaadaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm allatiy yattakiiu 'alayhaa min aadamin hashwuhaa liyfun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the pillow on which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) reclined was of leather stuffed with palm fibre
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ إِنَّمَا كَانَ فِرَاشُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الَّذِي يَنَامُ عَلَيْهِ أَدَمًا حَشْوُهُ لِيفٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, aakhbaranaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat iinnamaa kaana firaashu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alladhiy yanaamu 'alayhi aadamana hashwuhu liyfun ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the bedding on which. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) slept was made of leather stuffed with palm fibre
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالاَ ضِجَاعُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ يَنَامُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, kilaahumaa 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaalaa dijaa'u rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fiy hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa yanaamu 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالَ عَمْرٌو وَقُتَيْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمَّا تَزَوَّجْتُ ‏"‏ أَتَّخَذْتَ أَنْمَاطًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَأَنَّى لَنَا أَنْمَاطٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu li'amrinw - qaala 'amrunw waqutaybaau haddathanaa waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni almunkadiri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lammaa tazawwajtu ‏"‏ aattakhadhta aanmaatana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu waaannaa lanaa aanmaatun qaala ‏"‏ aamaa iinnahaa satakuwnu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:When I was married, Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) asked me if I had got the carpet. I said: How can we have carpets? (i. e. I am so poor that I cannot even think of carpets). whereupon he said: You shall soon possess them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا تَزَوَّجْتُ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَّخَذْتَ أَنْمَاطًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَأَنَّى لَنَا أَنْمَاطٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ جَابِرٌ وَعِنْدَ امْرَأَتِي نَمَطٌ فَأَنَا أَقُولُ نَحِّيهِ عَنِّي ‏.‏ وَتَقُولُ قَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala lammaa tazawwajtu qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aattakhadhta aanmaatana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu waaannaa lanaa aanmaatun qaala ‏"‏ aamaa iinnahaa satakuwnu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala jaabirun wa'inda amraaatiy namatun faaanaa aaquwlu nahhiyhi 'anniy ‏.‏ wataquwlu qad qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahaa satakuwnu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:When I was married. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked me if I had got carpets. I said: How can we have carpets? Thereupon he said: You will soon have. Jabir said: My wife had possessed a carpet, and I said to her to remove that away from me, but she would say: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: You will soon have
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فَأَدَعُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, haddathanaa sufyaanu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada faaada'uhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sufyan with the saule chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هَانِئٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، يَقُولُ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ فِرَاشٌ لِلرَّجُلِ وَفِرَاشٌ لاِمْرَأَتِهِ وَالثَّالِثُ لِلضَّيْفِ وَالرَّابِعُ لِلشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy aabuw haaniiin, aannahu sami'a aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani, yaquwlu 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahu ‏ "‏ firaashun lilrrajuli wafiraashun laimraaatihi waalthhaalithu lilddayfi waalrraabi'u lilshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messengor (ﷺ) said:There should be a bedding for a man. a bedding for his wife and the third one for the guest, and the fourth one is for the Satan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، وَزَيْدِ، بْنِ أَسْلَمَ كُلُّهُمْ يُخْبِرُهُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ إِلَى مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ خُيَلاَءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, wa'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, wazaydi, bni aaslama kulluhum yukhbiruhu 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yanzuru alllahu iilaa man jarra thawbahu khuyalaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:Allah will not look upon him who trails his garment out of pride
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أُسَامَةُ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَزَادُوا فِيهِ ‏ "‏ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - kulluhum 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, waabnu, rumhin 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy ausaamaau, kullu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi maalikin wazaaduwa fiyhi ‏ "‏ yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through other chains of transmitters also with the addition of these words:" On the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَسَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَنَافِعٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الَّذِي يَجُرُّ ثِيَابَهُ مِنَ الْخُيَلاَءِ لاَ يَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu muhammadin, 'an aabiyhi, wasaalimi bni 'abdi alllahi wanaafi'in 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alladhiy yajurru thiyaabahu mina alkhuyalaa'i laa yanzuru alllahu iilayhi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:He who trails his (lower) garment out of pride, Allah will not look toward him on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُحَارِبِ بْنِ دِثَارٍ، وَجَبَلَةَ بْنِ، سُحَيْمٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, kilaahumaa 'an muhaaribi bni dithaarin, wajabalaaa bni, suhaymin 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا حَنْظَلَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمًا، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ جَرَّ ثَوْبَهُ مِنَ الْخُيَلاَءِ لَمْ يَنْظُرِ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa hanzalaau, qaala sami'tu saalimana, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man jarra thawbahu mina alkhuyalaa'i lam yanzuri alllahu iilayhi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:He who trailed his garment out of pride, Allah would not look toward him on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا حَنْظَلَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمًا، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ثِيَابَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa hanzalaau bnu aabiy sufyaana, qaala sami'tu saalimana, qaala sami'tu abna 'umara, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aannahu qaala thiyaabahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported:I heard Ibn Umar as saying that he had heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying like this (as mentioned above) but with a slight variation of wording [that instead of the word thaub (cloth) there is the word thiyab (the clothes)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُسْلِمَ، بْنَ يَنَّاقَ يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ رَأَى رَجُلاً يَجُرُّ إِزَارَهُ فَقَالَ مِمَّنْ أَنْتَ فَانْتَسَبَ لَهُ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ مِنْ بَنِي لَيْثٍ فَعَرَفَهُ ابْنُ عُمَرَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِأُذُنَىَّ هَاتَيْنِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ جَرَّ إِزَارَهُ لاَ يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ إِلاَّ الْمَخِيلَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu muslima, bna yannaaqa yuhaddithu 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu raaaa rajulaan yajurru iizaarahu faqaala mimman aanta faantasaba lahu faiidhaa rajulun min baniy laythin fa'arafahu abnu 'umara qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biaudhunaaaa haatayni yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man jarra iizaarahu laa yuriydu bidhalika iilaaa almakhiylaaa faiinna alllaha laa yanzuru iilayhi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muslim b. Yannaq reported that Ibn Umar saw a person trailing his lower garment, whereupon he said:From whom do you come? He described his relationship (with the tribe he belonged) and it was found that he belonged to the tribe of Laith. Ibn. Umar recognised him and said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with these two ears of mine saying: He who trailed his lower garment with no other intention but pride, Allah would not look toward him on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي سُلَيْمَانَ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ نَافِعٍ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ يَنَّاقَ، عَنِ ابْنِ، عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي يُونُسَ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ وَفِي رِوَايَتِهِمْ جَمِيعًا ‏ "‏ مَنْ جَرَّ إِزَارَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُولُوا ثَوْبَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki, - ya'niy abna aabiy sulaymaana - h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw yuwnusa, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy khalafin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy bukayrin, haddathaniy iibraahiymu, - ya'niy abna naafi'in - kulluhum 'an muslimi bni yannaaqa, 'ani abni, 'umara 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi aabiy yuwnusa 'an muslimin aabiy alhasani wafiy riwaayatihim jamiy'ana ‏ "‏ man jarra iizaarahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yaquwluwa thawbahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muslim b. Yannaq through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَابْنُ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ، مُتَقَارِبَةٌ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ عَبَّادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، يَقُولُ أَمَرْتُ مُسْلِمَ بْنَ يَسَارٍ مَوْلَى نَافِعِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَارِثِ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، - قَالَ - وَأَنَا جَالِسٌ، بَيْنَهُمَا أَسَمِعْتَ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الَّذِي يَجُرُّ إِزَارَهُ مِنَ الْخُيَلاَءِ شَيْئًا قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْظُرُ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, waabnu aabiy khalafin, waaalfaazuhum, mutaqaaribaaun qaaluwa haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, qaala sami'tu muhammada bna 'abbaadi bni ja'farin, yaquwlu aamartu muslima bna yasaarin mawlaa naafi'i bni 'abdi alhaarithi aan yasaala abna 'umara, - qaala - waaanaa jaalisun, baynahumaa aasami'ta mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alladhiy yajurru iizaarahu mina alkhuyalaa'i shayiana qaala sami'tuhu yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yanzuru alllahu iilayhi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. 'Abbad b. Ja'far reported:I ordered Muslim b. Yasar, the freed slave of Nafi' b. 'Abd al-Harith, while I was sitting between them, that he should ask Ibn 'Umar if he had heard anything from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pertaining to one who trails his lower garment out of pride. He said: I heard him (the Holy Prophet) as saying: Allah will not look toward him on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، وَاقِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ مَرَرْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي إِزَارِي اسْتِرْخَاءٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ارْفَعْ إِزَارَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعْتُهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ زِدْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَزِدْتُ فَمَا زِلْتُ أَتَحَرَّاهَا بَعْدُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ إِلَى أَيْنَ فَقَالَ أَنْصَافِ السَّاقَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu muhammadin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, waaqidin 'ani abni 'umara, qaala marartu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wafiy iizaariy astirkhaa'un faqaala ‏"‏ yaa 'abda alllahi arfa' iizaaraka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ farafa'tuhu thumma qaala ‏"‏ zid ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fazidtu famaa ziltu aataharraahaa ba'du ‏.‏ faqaala ba'du alqawmi iilaa aayna faqaala aansaafi alssaaqayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported:I happened to pass before Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon bin) with my lower garment trailing (upon the ground). He said: 'Abdullah, tug up your lower garment,, I tugged it up, and he again said: Tug it still further, and I tugged it still further and I went on tugging it afterward, whereupon some of the people said: To what extent? Thereupon he said: To the middle of the shanks
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زِيَادٍ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، وَرَأَى، رَجُلاً يَجُرُّ إِزَارَهُ فَجَعَلَ يَضْرِبُ الأَرْضَ بِرِجْلِهِ وَهُوَ أَمِيرٌ عَلَى الْبَحْرَيْنِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ جَاءَ الأَمِيرُ جَاءَ الأَمِيرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى مَنْ يَجُرُّ إِزَارَهُ بَطَرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadin, - wahuwa abnu ziyaadin - qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, waraaaa, rajulaan yajurru iizaarahu faja'ala yadribu alaarda birijlihi wahuwa aamiyrun 'alaa albahrayni wahuwa yaquwlu jaa'a alaamiyru jaa'a alaamiyru ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha laa yanzuru iilaa man yajurru iizaarahu batarana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraire reported that he saw a person whose lower garment bad been trailin. and he was striking the ground with his foot (conceitedly). He was the Amir of Bahrain and it was being said:Here comes the Amir, here comes the Amir. He (Abu Huraira) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah will not look toward him who trails his lower garment out of pride
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ كَانَ مَرْوَانُ يَسْتَخْلِفُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ الْمُثَنَّى كَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يُسْتَخْلَفُ عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun ya'niy abna ja'farin, h wahaddathanaahu abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythi abni ja'farin kaana marwaanu yastakhlifu aabaa hurayraaa ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni almuthannaa kaana aabuw hurayraaa yustakhlafu 'alaa almadiynaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn ja'far (the words are):Marwan had made Abu Huraira as his deputy. and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Muthanna (the words are). Abu Huraira was the Governor of Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سَلاَّمٍ الْجُمَحِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الرَّبِيعُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُسْلِمٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَمْشِي قَدْ أَعْجَبَتْهُ جُمَّتُهُ وَبُرْدَاهُ إِذْ خُسِفَ بِهِ الأَرْضُ فَهُوَ يَتَجَلْجَلُ فِي الأَرْضِ حَتَّى تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu salaaamin aljumahiyyu, haddathanaa alrrabiy'u, - ya'niy abna muslimin - 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ baynamaa rajulun yamshiy qad aa'jabathu jummatuhu waburdaahu iidh khusifa bihi alaardu fahuwa yatajaljalu fiy alaardi hattaa taquwma alssaa'aau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that there was a person who used to walk with pride because of his thick hair and fine mantles. He was made to sink in the earth and he would go on sinking in the earth until the Last Hour would come
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ، جَعْفَرٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، قَالُوا جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ هَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, 'an muhammadi bni, ja'farin h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, qaaluwa jamiy'ana haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira but with a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَتَبَخْتَرُ يَمْشِي فِي بُرْدَيْهِ قَدْ أَعْجَبَتْهُ نَفْسُهُ فَخَسَفَ اللَّهُ بِهِ الأَرْضَ فَهُوَ يَتَجَلْجَلُ فِيهَا إِلَى يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy alhizaamiyya - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ baynamaa rajulun yatabakhtaru yamshiy fiy burdayhi qad aa'jabathu nafsuhu fakhasafa alllahu bihi alaarda fahuwa yatajaljalu fiyhaa iilaa yawmi alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There was a person who walked with pride because of his (fine) mantles and well pleased with his personality. Allah made him sink in the earth and he would go on sinking in that until the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ بَيْنَمَا رَجُلٌ يَتَبَخْتَرُ فِي بُرْدَيْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ baynamaa rajulun yatabakhtaru fiy burdayni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira but with a slight variation of wording:While there was a man who strutted in his two mantles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ رَجُلاً مِمَّنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ يَتَبَخْتَرُ فِي حُلَّةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna rajulaan mimman kaana qablakum yatabakhtaru fiy hullaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara mithla hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There was a person (living before you) who took pride in his cloak. the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)
