verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا اشْتَرَتْ نُمْرَقَةً فِيهَا تَصَاوِيرُ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ عَلَى الْبَابِ فَلَمْ يَدْخُلْ فَعَرَفْتُ أَوْ فَعُرِفَتْ فِي وَجْهِهِ الْكَرَاهِيَةُ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَإِلَى رَسُولِهِ فَمَاذَا أَذْنَبْتُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ هَذِهِ النُّمْرُقَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتِ اشْتَرَيْتُهَا لَكَ تَقْعُدُ عَلَيْهَا وَتَوَسَّدُهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الصُّوَرِ يُعَذَّبُونَ وَيُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْبَيْتَ الَّذِي فِيهِ الصُّوَرُ لاَ تَدْخُلُهُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa ashtarat numraqaaan fiyhaa tasaawiyru falammaa raahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama 'alaa albaabi falam yadkhul fa'araftu aaw fa'urifat fiy wajhihi alkaraahiyaau faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi aatuwbu iilaa alllahi waiilaa rasuwlihi famaadhaa aadhnabtu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa baalu hadhihi alnnumruqaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalati ashtaraytuhaa laka taq'udu 'alayhaa watawassaduhaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna aashaaba hadhihi alssuwari yu'adhhabuwna wayuqaalu lahum aahyuwa maa khalaqtum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna albayta alladhiy fiyhi alssuwaru laa tadkhuluhu almalaaiikaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that she bought a carpet which had pictures on it. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw that, he stayed at the door and did not get in. I perceived or I was made to perceive upon his face signs of disgust. She said:Allah's Messenger, I offer repentance to Allah and His Messenger. (but tell me) what is the sin that I have committed. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What is this carpet? She said: I bought it for you so that you might sit on it and take rest. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The owners of these pictures would be tormented and they would be asked to bring to life what they tried to create. He then said: Angels do not enter the house in which there is a picture
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ قُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، رُمْحٍ عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَخِي، الْمَاجِشُونِ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَبَعْضُهُمْ أَتَمُّ حَدِيثًا لَهُ مِنْ بَعْضٍ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَخِي الْمَاجِشُونِ قَالَتْ فَأَخَذْتُهُ فَجَعَلْتُهُ مِرْفَقَتَيْنِ فَكَانَ يَرْتَفِقُ بِهِمَا فِي الْبَيْتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu qutaybaau, waabnu, rumhin 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa althhaqafiyyu, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi bnu 'abdi alssamadi, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an jaddiy, 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy ausaamaau bnu zaydin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa alkhuzaa'iyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aakhiy, almaajishuwni 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, bihadhaa alhadiythi waba'duhum aatammu hadiythana lahu min ba'din ‏.‏ wazaada fiy hadiythi abni aakhiy almaajishuwni qaalat faaakhadhtuhu faja'altuhu mirfaqatayni fakaana yartafiqu bihimaa fiy albayti ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'isha through another chain of transmitters also. Some of the other ahadith narrated through other chains of transmitters are more complete and there is an addition in them (transmitted through other chains of transmitters). In the hadith transmitted on the authority of the nephew of Majishun she (A'isha) is reported to have said:I took it and prepared two cushions out of that and he (the Holy Prophet) used to recline against them in the house
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الَّذِينَ يَصْنَعُونَ الصُّوَرَ يُعَذَّبُونَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يُقَالُ لَهُمْ أَحْيُوا مَا خَلَقْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - jamiy'ana 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, aanna abna 'umara, aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alladhiyna yasna'uwna alssuwara yu'adhhabuwna yawma alqiyaamaai yuqaalu lahum aahyuwa maa khalaqtum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:Those who paint pictures would be punished on the Day of Resurrection and it would be said to them: Breathe soul into what you have created
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa althhaqafiyyu, kulluhum 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi 'ubaydi alllahi 'an naafi'in 'ani abni 'umara 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported a hadith like this through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، الأَشَجُّ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَشَدَّ النَّاسِ عَذَابًا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ الْمُصَوِّرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الأَشَجُّ إِنَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin, alaashajju haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna aashadda alnnaasi 'adhaabana yawma alqiyaamaai almusawwiruwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri alaashajju iinna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Verity the most grievously tormented people on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures. Ashajj (one of the narrators) in the hadith narrated by him did not make mention of the word" verity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ يَحْيَى وَأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَشَدِّ أَهْلِ النَّارِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَذَابًا الْمُصَوِّرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدِيثُ سُفْيَانَ كَحَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin kulluhum 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai yahyaa waaabiy kuraybin 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, ‏ "‏ iinna min aashaddi aahli alnnaari yawma alqiyaamaai 'adhaabana almusawwiruwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahadiythu sufyaana kahadiythi wakiy'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Mu`awiya through another chain of transmitters (and the words are):"Verily, the most grievously tormented people amongst the denizens of Hell on the Day of Resurrection would be the painters of pictures." The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَصْحَبُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ رُفْقَةً فِيهَا كَلْبٌ وَلاَ جَرَسٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna mufaddalin - haddathanaa suhaylun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tashabu almalaaiikaau rufqaaan fiyhaa kalbun walaa jarasun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Angels do not accompany the travellers who have with them a dog and a bell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - kilaahumaa 'an suhaylin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْجَرَسُ مَزَامِيرُ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aljarasu mazaamiyru alshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The bell is the musical instrument of the Satan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ، بْنِ تَمِيمٍ أَنَّ أَبَا بَشِيرٍ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، كَانَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ - قَالَ - فَأَرْسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَسُولاً - قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ وَالنَّاسُ فِي مَبِيتِهِمْ - ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبْقَيَنَّ فِي رَقَبَةِ بَعِيرٍ قِلاَدَةٌ مِنْ وَتَرٍ أَوْ قِلاَدَةٌ إِلاَّ قُطِعَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَالِكٌ أُرَى ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْعَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy bakrin, 'an 'abbaadi, bni tamiymin aanna aabaa bashiyrin alaansaariyya, aakhbarahu aannahu, kaana ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di aasfaarihi - qaala - faaarsala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rasuwlaan - qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu aabiy bakrin hasibtu aannahu qaala waalnnaasu fiy mabiytihim - ‏ "‏ laa yabqayanna fiy raqabaai ba'iyrin qilaadaaun min watarin aaw qilaadaaun iilaaa quti'at ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala maalikun auraa dhalika mina al'ayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bashir Ansari reported that he had had (the opportunity of accompanying Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in some of his journeys. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent one of his messengers 'Abdullah b Abi Bakr said:I think he said (these words) when the people were at the places of rest: No necklace of strings be left on the necks of the camels or the necklace kept unbroken. Imam Malik said: To my mind (this practice) of wearing necklace round the necks of camels or animals was because of the fact that they (wanted to save them) from the influence of the evil eye
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الضَّرْبِ فِي الْوَجْهِ وَعَنِ الْوَسْمِ فِي الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani abni jurayjin, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alddarbi fiy alwajhi wa'ani alwasmi fiy alwajhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade (the animals to be beaten) on the face or cauterisation on the face
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، ‏.‏ كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ، بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, ‏.‏ kilaahumaa 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira, bna 'abdi alllahi yaquwlu nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Jabir b. 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ حِمَارٌ قَدْ وُسِمَ فِي وَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الَّذِي وَسَمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm marra 'alayhi himaarun qad wusima fiy wajhihi faqaala ‏ "‏ la'ana alllahu alladhiy wasamahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that there happened to pass before Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) an ass the face of which had been cauterised, whereupon he said:Allah has cursed one who has cauterised it (on the face)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ أَنَّ نَاعِمًا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ وَرَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِمَارًا مَوْسُومَ الْوَجْهِ فَأَنْكَرَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ أَسِمُهُ إِلاَّ فِي أَقْصَى شَىْءٍ مِنَ الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏ فَأَمَرَ بِحِمَارٍ لَهُ فَكُوِيَ فِي جَاعِرَتَيْهِ فَهُوَ أَوَّلُ مَنْ كَوَى الْجَاعِرَتَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'iysaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an yaziyda, bni aabiy habiybin aanna naa'imana aabaa 'abdi alllahi, mawlaa aummi salamaaa haddathahu aannahu, sami'a abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu waraaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm himaarana mawsuwma alwajhi faaankara dhalika qaala fawaalllahi laa aasimuhu iilaaa fiy aaqsaa shaa'in mina alwajhi ‏.‏ faaamara bihimaarin lahu fakuwiya fiy jaa'iratayhi fahuwa aawwalu man kawaa aljaa'iratayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw an ass which had been cauterised on the face. He disapproved of it saying:By Allah, I do not cauterise (the animal) but on a part at a distance from the face, and commanded (for the cauterisation) of his ass and it was cauterised on the buttocks and he was the first to cauterise on the buttocks
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ لَمَّا وَلَدَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ قَالَتْ لِي يَا أَنَسُ انْظُرْ هَذَا الْغُلاَمَ فَلاَ يُصِيبَنَّ شَيْئًا حَتَّى تَغْدُوَ بِهِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَنِّكُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَدَوْتُ فَإِذَا هُوَ فِي الْحَائِطِ وَعَلَيْهِ خَمِيصَةٌ جَوْنِيَّةٌ وَهُوَ يَسِمُ الظَّهْرَ الَّذِي قَدِمَ عَلَيْهِ فِي الْفَتْحِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasin, qaala lammaa waladat aummu sulaymin qaalat liy yaa aanasu anzur hadhaa alghulaama falaa yusiybanna shayiana hattaa taghduwa bihi iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhannikuhu ‏.‏ qaala faghadawtu faiidhaa huwa fiy alhaaiiti wa'alayhi khamiysaaun jawniyyaaun wahuwa yasimu alzzahra alladhiy qadima 'alayhi fiy alfathi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Umm Sulaim gave birth to a child. She said to him:Anas, see that nothing is given to this child until he is brought to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in the morning, so that he should chew some dates and touch his palate with it. I went to him in the morning and he was in the garden at that time having the mantle of Jauniyya over him and he was bus in cauterising (the camels) which had been brought to him (as spoils of war) in victory (over the enemy)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ أُمَّهُ، حِينَ وَلَدَتِ انْطَلَقُوا بِالصَّبِيِّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَنِّكُهُ قَالَ فَإِذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مِرْبَدٍ يَسِمُ غَنَمًا ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَكْثَرُ عِلْمِي أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي آذَانِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an hishaami bni zaydin, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yuhaddithu aanna aummahu, hiyna waladati antalaquwa bialssabiyyi iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhannikuhu qaala faiidhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy mirbadin yasimu ghanamana ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau waaaktharu 'ilmiy aannahu qaala fiy adhaanihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that when his mother gave birth to a child they brought that child to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he might chew some dates and touch his palate with them. and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was at that time in the fold busy in cauterising the animals Shu'ba said:So far as I know (he was cauterising) their ears
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ فِي يَدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمِيسَمَ وَهُوَ يَسِمُ إِبِلَ الصَّدَقَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, 'an iishaaqa, bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala raaaytu fiy yadi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almiysama wahuwa yasimu iibila alssadaqaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:I saw in the hand of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) an instrument for cauterisation and he was cauterising the caracia collected as Zakat
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْقَزَعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِنَافِعٍ وَمَا الْقَزَعُ قَالَ يُحْلَقُ بَعْضُ رَأْسِ الصَّبِيِّ وَيُتْرَكُ بَعْضٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathaniy yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu naafi'in, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alqaza'i ‏.‏ qaala qultu linaafi'in wamaa alqaza'u qaala yuhlaqu ba'du raasi alssabiyyi wayutraku ba'dun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade Qaza. I said to Nafi:What is Qaza'? He said: This means having a part of a boy's head shaved and leaving a part unshaven
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَجَعَلَ التَّفْسِيرَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ مِنْ قَوْلِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ waja'ala alttafsiyra fiy hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa min qawli 'ubaydi alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitters. and the exposition of Qaza' is the same as that of Abu Usama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ الْغَطَفَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ، نَافِعٍ بِإِسْنَادِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَأَلْحَقَا التَّفْسِيرَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu 'uthmaana alghatafaaniyyu, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu naafi'in, h wahaddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaamin, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa rawhun, 'an 'umara bni, naafi'in biiisnaadi 'ubaydi alllahi ‏.‏ mithlahu waaalhaqaa alttafsiyra fiy alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Umar b. Nafi' with the same chain of transmitters and Muhammad b. Muthanna as well as 'Umar b. Nafi have given the same exposition (of the word Qaza') in their narration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ، زَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السَّرَّاجِ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa aabuw ja'farin alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu, zaydin 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alssarraaji, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ، بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْجُلُوسَ فِي الطُّرُقَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَنَا بُدٌّ مِنْ مَجَالِسِنَا نَتَحَدَّثُ فِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَإِذَا أَبَيْتُمْ إِلاَّ الْمَجْلِسَ فَأَعْطُوا الطَّرِيقَ حَقَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا حَقُّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ غَضُّ الْبَصَرِ وَكَفُّ الأَذَى وَرَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَالأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْىُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathaniy hafsu bnu maysaraaa, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i, bni yasaarin 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iiyyaakum waaljuluwsa fiy altturuqaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi maa lanaa buddun min majaalisinaa natahaddathu fiyhaa ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faiidhaa aabaytum iilaaa almajlisa faaa'tuwa alttariyqa haqqahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa wamaa haqquhu qaala ‏"‏ ghaddu albasari wakaffu alaadhaa waraddu alssalaami waalaamru bialma'ruwfi waalnnahau 'ani almunkari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Al-Khudri reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Avoid sitting on the paths. They (his Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, there is no other help to it (but to sit there as we) hold our meetings and discuss matters there. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you have to sit at all, then fulfil the rights, of the path. They said: What are their rights? Thereupon he said: Keeping the eye downward (so that you may not stare at the women), refraining from doing some harm to the other and exchanging mutual greetings (saying as-Salamu 'Alaikum to one another) and commanding the good and forbidding the evil
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ، أَسْلَمَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin almadaniyyu, h wahaddathanaahu muhammadu, bnu raafi'in haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa hishaamun, - ya'niy abna sa'din - kilaahumaa 'an zaydi bni, aaslama bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتِ، الْمُنْذِرِ عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، قَالَتْ جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ لِي ابْنَةً عُرَيِّسًا أَصَابَتْهَا حَصْبَةٌ فَتَمَرَّقَ شَعْرُهَا أَفَأَصِلُهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an faatimaaa binti, almundhiri 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin, qaalat jaa'ati amraaaaun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna liy abnaaan 'urayyisana aasaabathaa hasbaaun fatamarraqa sha'ruhaa aafaaasiluhu faqaala ‏ "‏ la'ana alllahu alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said:I have a daughter who has been newly wedded. She had an attack of smallpox and thus her hair had fallen; should I add false hair to her head? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah has cursed the woman who adds some false hair and the woman who asks for it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، وَعَبْدَةُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّحَدِيثِهِمَا فَتَمَرَّطَ شَعْرُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau, h wahaddathanaahu abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, wa'abdaau h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, aakhbaranaa aaswadu bnu 'aamirin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, kulluhum 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa ghayra aannahadiythihimaa fatamarrata sha'ruhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنِّي زَوَّجْتُ ابْنَتِي فَتَمَرَّقَ شَعْرُ رَأْسِهَا وَزَوْجُهَا يَسْتَحْسِنُهَا أَفَأَصِلُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَنَهَاهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu sa'iydin alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa habbaanu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa mansuwrun, 'an aummihi, 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin, aanna amraaaaan, aatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat iinniy zawwajtu abnatiy fatamarraqa sha'ru raasihaa wazawjuhaa yastahsinuhaa aafaaasilu yaa rasuwla alllahi fanahaahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said:I have married my daughter (whose) hair of head have fallen. Her spouse likes them (the long hair). Allah's Messenger (may add false hair to her head? He forbade her to do this)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ، مُرَّةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْحَسَنَ بْنَ مُسْلِمٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ صَفِيَّةَ بِنْتِ شَيْبَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ جَارِيَةً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ تَزَوَّجَتْ وَأَنَّهَا مَرِضَتْ فَتَمَرَّطَ شَعْرُهَا فَأَرَادُوا أَنْ يَصِلُوهُ فَسَأَلُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَلَعَنَ الْوَاصِلَةَ وَالْمُسْتَوْصِلَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy bukayrin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an 'amriw bni, murraaa qaala sami'tu alhasana bna muslimin, yuhaddithu 'an safiyyaaa binti shaybaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna jaariyaaan, mina alaansaari tazawwajat waaannahaa maridat fatamarrata sha'ruhaa faaaraaduwa aan yasiluwhu fasaaaluwa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an dhalika fala'ana alwaasilaaa waalmustawsilaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that a girl of the Ansar who had fallen ill and had lost the hair was married. They (her relatives) thought of adding false hair (to her head). so they asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about it, whereupon he cursed the woman who adds false hair and the woman who asks for it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَعَنَ اللَّهُ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ وَالنَّامِصَاتِ وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ بَنِي أَسَدٍ يُقَالُ لَهَا أُمُّ يَعْقُوبَ وَكَانَتْ تَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ فَأَتَتْهُ فَقَالَتْ مَا حَدِيثٌ بَلَغَنِي عَنْكَ أَنَّكَ لَعَنْتَ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ وَالْمُتَنَمِّصَاتِ وَالْمُتَفَلِّجَاتِ لِلْحُسْنِ الْمُغَيِّرَاتِ خَلْقَ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَمَا لِيَ لاَ أَلْعَنُ مَنْ لَعَنَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ لَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ مَا بَيْنَ لَوْحَىِ الْمُصْحَفِ فَمَا وَجَدْتُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَئِنْ كُنْتِ قَرَأْتِيهِ لَقَدْ وَجَدْتِيهِ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَمَا آتَاكُمُ الرَّسُولُ فَخُذُوهُ وَمَا نَهَاكُمْ عَنْهُ فَانْتَهُوا‏}‏ فَقَالَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ فَإِنِّي أَرَى شَيْئًا مِنْ هَذَا عَلَى امْرَأَتِكَ الآنَ ‏.‏ قَالَ اذْهَبِي فَانْظُرِي ‏.‏ قَالَ فَدَخَلَتْ عَلَى امْرَأَةِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَلَمْ تَرَ شَيْئًا فَجَاءَتْ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَتْ مَا رَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَمَا لَوْ كَانَ ذَلِكِ لَمْ نُجَامِعْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu liishaaqa - aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala la'ana alllahu alwaashimaati waalmustawshimaati waalnnaamisaati waalmutanammisaati waalmutafallijaati lilhusni almughayyiraati khalqa alllahi ‏.‏ qaala fabalagha dhalika amraaaaan min baniy aasadin yuqaalu lahaa aummu ya'quwba wakaanat taqraau alqurana faaatathu faqaalat maa hadiythun balaghaniy 'anka aannaka la'anta alwaashimaati waalmustawshimaati waalmutanammisaati waalmutafallijaati lilhusni almughayyiraati khalqa alllahi faqaala 'abdu alllahi wamaa liya laa aal'anu man la'ana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa fiy kitaabi alllahi faqaalati almaraaau laqad qaraatu maa bayna lawhaai almushafi famaa wajadtuhu ‏.‏ faqaala laiin kunti qaraatiyhi laqad wajadtiyhi qaala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ wamaa ataakumu alrrasuwlu fakhudhuwhu wamaa nahaakum 'anhu faantahuwa‏}‏ faqaalati almaraaau faiinniy aaraa shayiana min hadhaa 'alaa amraaatika alana ‏.‏ qaala adhhabiy faanzuriy ‏.‏ qaala fadakhalat 'alaa amraaaai 'abdi alllahi falam tara shayiana fajaa'at iilayhi faqaalat maa raaaytu shayiana ‏.‏ faqaala aamaa law kaana dhaliki lam nujaami'haa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported that Allah had cursed those women who tattooed and who have themselves tattooed, those who pluck hair from their faces and those who make spaces between their teeth for beautification changing what God has created. This news reached a woman of the tribe of Asad who was called Umm Ya'qub and she used to recite the Holy Qur'an. She came to him and said:What is this news that has reached me from you that you curse those women who tattooed and those women who have themselves tattooed, the women who pluck hair from their faces and who make spaces between their teeth for beautification changing what God has created? Thereupon 'Abdullah said: Should I not curse one upon whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has invoked curse and that is in the Book also. Thereupon that woman said: I read the Qur'an from cover to cover, but I did not find that in it. whereupon he said: If you had read (thoroughly) you would have definitely found this in that (as) Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has said:" What Allah's Messenger brings for you accept that and what he has forbidden you, refrain from that." That woman said: I find this thing in your wife even now. Thereupon he said: Go and see her. She reported: I went to the wife of 'Abdullah but found nothing of this sort in her. She came back to him and said: I have not seen anything. whereupon he said: Had there been anything like it in her, I would have never slept with her in the bed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُفَضَّلٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُهَلْهَلٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمُسْتَوْشِمَاتِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مُفَضَّلٍ الْوَاشِمَاتِ وَالْمَوْشُومَاتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, wahuwa abnu mahdiyyin haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa mufaddalun, - wahuwa abnu muhalhalin - kilaahumaa 'an mansuwrin, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi jariyrin ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi sufyaana alwaashimaati waalmustawshimaati ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi mufaddalin alwaashimaati waalmawshuwmaati ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Mansur with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ الْحَدِيثَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُجَرَّدًا عَنْ سَائِرِ الْقِصَّةِ، مِنْ ذِكْرِ أُمِّ يَعْقُوبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaaluwa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ alhadiytha 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mujarradana 'an saaiiri alqissaai, min dhikri aummi ya'quwba ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansur without the story pertaining to Umm Ya'qub
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَازِمٍ - حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyrun, - ya'niy abna haazimin - haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ زَجَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تَصِلَ الْمَرْأَةُ بِرَأْسِهَا شَيْئًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu zajara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan tasila almaraaau biraasihaa shayiana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reprimanded that a woman should add anything to her head (in the form of artificial hair)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَامَ حَجَّ وَهُوَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَتَنَاوَلَ قُصَّةً مِنْ شَعَرٍ كَانَتْ فِي يَدِ حَرَسِيٍّ يَقُولُ يَا أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ أَيْنَ عُلَمَاؤُكُمْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْهَى عَنْ مِثْلِ هَذِهِ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا هَلَكَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ حِينَ اتَّخَذَ هَذِهِ نِسَاؤُهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an humaydi bni 'abdi, alrrahmani bni 'awfin aannahu sami'a mu'aawiyaaa bna aabiy sufyaana, 'aama hajja wahuwa 'alaa alminbari watanaawala qussaaan min sha'arin kaanat fiy yadi harasiyyin yaquwlu yaa aahla almadiynaai aayna 'ulamaauukum sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yanhaa 'an mithli hadhihi wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnamaa halakat banuw iisraaiiyla hiyna attakhadha hadhihi nisaauuhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf said that he heard Mu'awiya b. Abi Sufyin during the season of Hajj, (saying) as he sat upon the pulpit holding a bunch of hair in his hand which was (previously) in the hand of his sentinel:O people of Medina, where are your scholars? I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbidding this and saying: That the people of Bani Isra'il were ruined at the time when their women wore such hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا عُذِّبَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi maalikin ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi ma'marin ‏ "‏ iinnamaa 'udhhiba banuw iisraaiiyla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالَ قَدِمَ مُعَاوِيَةُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَخَطَبَنَا وَأَخْرَجَ كُبَّةً مِنْ شَعَرٍ فَقَالَ مَا كُنْتُ أُرَى أَنَّ أَحَدًا يَفْعَلُهُ إِلاَّ الْيَهُودَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَلَغَهُ فَسَمَّاهُ الزُّورَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, qaala qadima mu'aawiyaau almadiynaaa fakhatabanaa waaakhraja kubbaaan min sha'arin faqaala maa kuntu auraa aanna aahadana yaf'aluhu iilaaa alyahuwda iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm balaghahu fasammaahu alzzuwra ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Musayyib reported:Mu'awiya came to Medina and he addressed us and he took out a bunch of hair and said: What do I see that one of you does but that what the Jews did? (I can well recall) that when this act (adding of artificial hair) reached Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he named it as cheating
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَالَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ إِنَّكُمْ قَدْ أَحْدَثْتُمْ زِيَّ سَوْءٍ وَإِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الزُّورِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ بِعَصًا عَلَى رَأْسِهَا خِرْقَةٌ قَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ أَلاَ وَهَذَا الزُّورُ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ يَعْنِي مَا يُكَثِّرُ بِهِ النِّسَاءُ أَشْعَارَهُنَّ مِنَ الْخِرَقِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa mu'aadhun, - wahuwa abnu hishaamin - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, aanna mu'aawiyaaa, qaala dhaata yawmin iinnakum qad aahdathtum ziyya saw'in waiinna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'ani alzzuwri ‏.‏ qaala wajaa'a rajulun bi'asana 'alaa raasihaa khirqaaun qaala mu'aawiyaau aalaa wahadhaa alzzuwru ‏.‏ qaala qataadaau ya'niy maa yukathhiru bihi alnnisaa'u aash'aarahunna mina alkhiraqi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa, id b. Musayyib reported that Mu'awiya said one day:Should I narrate to you the evil make-up. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) forbade cheating. It was during that time that a person came with a staff and there was a cloth on its head, whereupon Mu, awiya said: Behold, that is cheating. Qatada said: This implies how women artificially increase their hair with the help of rags
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صِنْفَانِ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ لَمْ أَرَهُمَا قَوْمٌ مَعَهُمْ سِيَاطٌ كَأَذْنَابِ الْبَقَرِ يَضْرِبُونَ بِهَا النَّاسَ وَنِسَاءٌ كَاسِيَاتٌ عَارِيَاتٌ مُمِيلاَتٌ مَائِلاَتٌ رُءُوسُهُنَّ كَأَسْنِمَةِ الْبُخْتِ الْمَائِلَةِ لاَ يَدْخُلْنَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلاَ يَجِدْنَ رِيحَهَا وَإِنَّ رِيحَهَا لَيُوجَدُ مِنْ مَسِيرَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ sinfaani min aahli alnnaari lam aarahumaa qawmun ma'ahum siyaatun kaaadhnaabi albaqari yadribuwna bihaa alnnaasa wanisaa'un kaasiyaatun 'aariyaatun mumiylaatun maaiilaatun ru'uwsuhunna kaaasnimaai albukhti almaaiilaai laa yadkhulna aljannaaa walaa yajidna riyhahaa waiinna riyhahaa layuwjadu min masiyraai kadhaa wakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: AbU Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:Two are the types of the denizens of Hell whom I did not see: people having flogs like the tails of the ox with them and they would be beating people, and the women who would be dressed but appear to be naked, who would be inclined (to evil) and make their husbands incline towards it. Their heads would be like the humps of the bukht camel inclined to one side. They will not enter Paradise and they would not smell its odour whereas its odour would be smelt from such and such distance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَعَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَقُولُ إِنَّ زَوْجِي أَعْطَانِي مَا لَمْ يُعْطِنِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُتَشَبِّعُ بِمَا لَمْ يُعْطَ كَلاَبِسِ ثَوْبَىْ زُورٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, wa'abdaau, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna amraaaaan, qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi aaquwlu iinna zawjiy aa'taaniy maa lam yu'tiniy faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ almutashabbi'u bimaa lam yu'ta kalaabisi thawbaa zuwrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that a woman said:Allah's Messenger, may I say to my (co-wife) that my husband has given me (such and such) a thing but which he has not in fact gives me? 'Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The one who makes a false statement of that which one has not been given is like one who wears a garment of falsehood
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، جَاءَتِ امْرَأَةٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ لِي ضَرَّةً فَهَلْ عَلَىَّ جُنَاحٌ أَنْ أَتَشَبَّعَ مِنْ مَالِ زَوْجِي بِمَا لَمْ يُعْطِنِي فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُتَشَبِّعُ بِمَا لَمْ يُعْطَ كَلاَبِسِ ثَوْبَىْ زُورٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa 'abdaau, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an faatimaaa, 'an aasmaa'a, jaa'ati amraaaaun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat iinna liy darraaan fahal 'alaaaa junaahun aan aatashabba'a min maali zawjiy bimaa lam yu'tiniy faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ almutashabbi'u bimaa lam yu'ta kalaabisi thawbaa zuwrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asma' reported that a woman came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said:I have a co-wife. Is there any harm for me if I give her the false impression (of getting something from my husband which he has not in fact given me)? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The one who creates such a (false impression) of receiving what one has not been given is like one who wears the garment of falsehood
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 37 — The Book of Clothes and Adornment
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, kilaahumaa 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنَا وَاللَّفْظُ، لَهُ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِيَانِ الْفَزَارِيَّ - عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ نَادَى رَجُلٌ رَجُلاً بِالْبَقِيعِ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ‏.‏ فَالْتَفَتَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنِّي لَمْ أَعْنِكَ إِنَّمَا دَعَوْتُ فُلاَنًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i waabnu aabiy 'umara - qaala aabuw kuraybin aakhbaranaa waqaala, abnu aabiy 'umara haddathanaa waalllafzu, lahu - qaalaa haddathanaa marwaanu, - ya'niyaani alfazaariyya - 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin, qaala naadaa rajulun rajulaan bialbaqiy'i yaa aabaa alqaasimi ‏.‏ faaltafata iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinniy lam aa'nika iinnamaa da'awtu fulaanana ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tasammawa biasmiy walaa takannawa bikunyatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that person at Baqi' called another person as" Abu'l- Qasim," and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) turned towards him. He (the person who had uttered these words) said:Messenger of Allah, I did not mean you, but I called such and such (person), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You may call yourself by my name, but not by my kunya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، - وَهُوَ الْمُلَقَّبُ بِسَبَلاَنَ - أَخْبَرَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، وَأَخِيهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، سَمِعَهُ مِنْهُمَا، سَنَةَ أَرْبَعٍ وَأَرْبَعِينَ وَمِائَةٍ يُحَدِّثَانِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَحَبَّ أَسْمَائِكُمْ إِلَى اللَّهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iibraahiymu bnu ziyaadin, - wahuwa almulaqqabu bisabalaana - aakhbaranaa 'abbaadu bnu 'abbaadin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, waaakhiyhi 'abdi alllahi, sami'ahu minhumaa, sanaaa aarba'in waaarba'iyna wamiaiaain yuhaddithaani 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna aahabba aasmaaiikum iilaa alllahi 'abdu alllahi wa'abdu alrrahmani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The names dearest to Allah are 'Abdullah and 'Abd al-Rahman
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ وُلِدَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَّا غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّاهُ مُحَمَّدًا فَقَالَ لَهُ قَوْمُهُ لاَ نَدَعُكَ تُسَمِّي بِاسْمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ بِابْنِهِ حَامِلَهُ عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ فَأَتَى بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وُلِدَ لِي غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّيْتُهُ مُحَمَّدًا فَقَالَ لِي قَوْمِي لاَ نَدَعُكَ تُسَمِّي بِاسْمِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا قَاسِمٌ أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala 'uthmaanu haddathanaa waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala wulida lirajulin minnaa ghulaamun fasammaahu muhammadana faqaala lahu qawmuhu laa nada'uka tusammiy biasmi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faantalaqa biabnihi haamilahu 'alaa zahrihi faaataa bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi wulida liy ghulaamun fasammaytuhu muhammadana faqaala liy qawmiy laa nada'uka tusammiy biasmi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tasammawa biasmiy walaa taktanuwa bikunyatiy faiinnamaa aanaa qaasimun aaqsimu baynakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a child was born to a person amongst us and he gave him the name of Muhammad. Thereupon his people said:We will not allow You to give the name of Muhammad (to your child) after the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He set forth with his son carrying him on his back and came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and said: Allah's Messenger a son has been born to me and I have given him the name after the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Give him my name but do not give him my kunya, for I am Qasim in the sense that I distribute (the spoils of war) and the dues of Zakat amongst you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ وُلِدَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَّا غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّاهُ مُحَمَّدًا فَقُلْنَا لاَ نَكْنِيكَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى تَسْتَأْمِرَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ إِنَّهُ وُلِدَ لِي غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّيْتُهُ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَإِنَّ قَوْمِي أَبَوْا أَنْ يَكْنُونِي بِهِ حَتَّى تَسْتَأْذِنَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ سَمُّوا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي فَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hannaadu bnu alssariyyi, haddathanaa 'abtharun, 'an husaynin, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala wulida lirajulin minnaa ghulaamun fasammaahu muhammadana faqulnaa laa nakniyka birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa tastaamirahu ‏.‏ qaala faaataahu faqaala iinnahu wulida liy ghulaamun fasammaytuhu birasuwli alllahi waiinna qawmiy aabawa aan yaknuwniy bihi hattaa tastaadhina alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ sammuwa biasmiy walaa takannawa bikunyatiy faiinnamaa bu'ithtu qaasimana aaqsimu baynakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a child was born to one of the persons amongst us and he decided to give him the name of Muhammad We said:We will not allow you to give the name after the name of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) until you ask him (the Holy Prophet). So he (that person) came and said (to the Holy Prophet): A child was born in my house and I wanted to give him the name (of Muhammad) after the name of Allah's Messenger, whereas my people did not allow me that I should name him after that (sacred) name until I have asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in this connection, whereupon he said: Give him the name after my name, but do not call him by my kunya, for I have been sent as a Qasim as I distribute amongst you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا رِفَاعَةُ بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي الطَّحَّانَ - عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏ "‏ فَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa rifaa'aau bnu alhaythami alwaasitiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy alttahhaana - 'an husaynin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur ‏ "‏ faiinnamaa bu'ithtu qaasimana aaqsimu baynakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Husain With the same chain of transmitters but no mention is made of these words:" (I have been sent as a distributor), so I distribute amongst you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ، الأَشَجُّ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي فَإِنِّي أَنَا أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin, alaashajju haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tasammawa biasmiy walaa takannawa bikunyatiy faiinniy aanaa aabuw alqaasimi aaqsimu baynakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy bakrin ‏"‏ walaa taktanuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Give the name after my name, but do not give (the kunya of Abu'l-Qasim after my) kunya, for I am Abu'l-Qasim (in the sense) that I distribute amongst you (the spoils of war) and disseminate the knowledge (of revelation). This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa ju'iltu qaasimana aaqsimu baynakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but there is a slight variation (of wording) that, instead of the word Bu'ithat (I have been sent), the word ju'ilat (I have been made) has been used
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ وُلِدَ لَهُ غُلاَمٌ فَأَرَادَ أَنْ يُسَمِّيَهُ مُحَمَّدًا فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَحْسَنَتِ الأَنْصَارُ سَمُّوا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكْتَنُوا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, sami'tu qataadaaa, 'an saalimin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rajulaan, mina alaansaari wulida lahu ghulaamun faaaraada aan yusammiyahu muhammadana faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu faqaala ‏ "‏ aahsanati alaansaaru sammuwa biasmiy walaa taktanuwa bikunyatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a child was born to a person from the Ansar and he made up his mind to give him the name of Muhammad. He came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and, asked him (about it), whereupon he said:The Ansar have done well to give the name (to your children) after my name, but do not give them the kunya after my kunya
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ، بْنُ خَالِدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سَالِمِ، بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، وَمَنْصُورٍ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ، وَحُصَيْنِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالُوا سَمِعْنَا سَالِمَ بْنَ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ مَنْ ذَكَرْنَا حَدِيثَهُمْ مِنْ قَبْلُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ النَّضْرِ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ وَزَادَ فِيهِ حُصَيْنٌ وَسُلَيْمَانُ قَالَ حُصَيْنٌ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ قَاسِمًا أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سُلَيْمَانُ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا قَاسِمٌ أَقْسِمُ بَيْنَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, kilaahumaa 'an muhammadi bni ja'farin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an mansuwrin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni jabalaaa, haddathanaa muhammadun ya'niy abna ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, 'an husaynin, h wahaddathaniy bishru, bnu khaalidin aakhbaranaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sulaymaana, kulluhum 'an saalimi, bni aabiy alja'di 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alnnadru, bnu shumaylin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, wamansuwrin, wasulaymaana, wahusayni bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaaluwa sami'naa saalima bna aabiy alja'di, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi man dhakarnaa hadiythahum min qablu ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi alnnadri 'an shu'baaa qaala wazaada fiyhi husaynun wasulaymaanu qaala husaynun qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa bu'ithtu qaasimana aaqsimu baynakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala sulaymaanu ‏"‏ faiinnamaa aanaa qaasimun aaqsimu baynakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through different chains of transmitters on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ وُلِدَ لِرَجُلٍ مِنَّا غُلاَمٌ فَسَمَّاهُ الْقَاسِمَ فَقُلْنَا لاَ نَكْنِيكَ أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ وَلاَ نُنْعِمُكَ عَيْنًا ‏.‏ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَسْمِ ابْنَكَ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, jamiy'ana 'an sufyaana, qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa abnu almunkadiri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu wulida lirajulin minnaa ghulaamun fasammaahu alqaasima faqulnaa laa nakniyka aabaa alqaasimi walaa nun'imuka 'aynana ‏.‏ faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara dhalika lahu faqaala ‏ "‏ aasmi abnaka 'abda alrrahmani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:A child was born in the house of a person amongst us, and he gave him the name of Qasim. We said: We will not allow you (to give the name) to your child as Qasim (and thus adopt the kunya of Abu'l-Qasim) and coal your eyes. He (that person) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: Call your son 'Abd al-Rahman
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ وَلاَ نُنْعِمُكَ عَيْنًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaamin, haddathanaa yaziydu ya'niy abna zuray'in, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - kilaahumaa 'an rawhi bni alqaasimi, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabirin, ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni 'uyaynaaa ghayra aannahu lam yadhkur walaa nun'imuka 'aynana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Uyaina, but there is no mention of this:" We will not allow you to cool your eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَسَمَّوْا بِاسْمِي وَلاَ تَكَنَّوْا بِكُنْيَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَلَمَ يَقُلْ سَمِعْتُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, numayrin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tasammawa biasmiy walaa takannawa bikunyatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw 'an aabiy hurayraaa walama yaqul sami'tu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Abu'l-Qasim (ﷺ) said:Give name (to your children) after my name but do not give the kunya (of Abu'l- Qasim) after my kunya. 'Amr reported from Abu Huraira that he did not say that he had heard it directly from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ وَائِلٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ لَمَّا قَدِمْتُ نَجْرَانَ سَأَلُونِي فَقَالُوا إِنَّكُمْ تَقْرَءُونَ يَا أُخْتَ هَارُونَ وَمُوسَى قَبْلَ عِيسَى بِكَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا قَدِمْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا يُسَمُّونَ بِأَنْبِيَائِهِمْ وَالصَّالِحِينَ قَبْلَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu - waalllafzu laibni numayrin - qaaluwa haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an simaaki bni harbin, 'an 'alqamaaa bni waaiilin, 'ani almughiyraai bni shu'baaa, qaala lammaa qadimtu najraana saaaluwniy faqaaluwa iinnakum taqra'uwna yaa aukhta haaruwna wamuwsaa qabla 'iysaa bikadhaa wakadhaa ‏.‏ falammaa qadimtu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saaaltuhu 'an dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ iinnahum kaanuwa yusammuwna biaanbiyaaiihim waalssaalihiyna qablahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported:When I came to Najran, they (the Christians of Najran) asked me: You read" O sister of Harun" (i. e. Hadrat Maryam) in the Qur'an, whereas Moses was born much before Jesus. When I came back to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) I asked him about that, whereupon he said: The (people of the old age) used to give names (to their persons) after the names of Apostles and pious persons who had gone before them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ، سُلَيْمَانَ عَنِ الرُّكَيْنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، وَقَالَ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الرُّكَيْنَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ نَهَانَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ نُسَمِّيَ رَقِيقَنَا بِأَرْبَعَةِ أَسْمَاءٍ أَفْلَحَ وَرَبَاحٍ وَيَسَارٍ وَنَافِعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa mu'tamiru bnu, sulaymaana 'ani alrrukayni, 'an aabiyhi, 'an samuraaa, waqaala, yahyaa aakhbaranaa almu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu alrrukayna, yuhaddithu 'an aabiyhi, 'an samuraaa bni jundabin, qaala nahaanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan nusammiya raqiyqanaa biaarba'aai aasmaa'in aaflaha warabaahin wayasaarin wanaafi'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: Samura b. Jundub reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade us to give names to our servants as these four names: Aflah (Successful), Rabdh (Profit), Yasar (Wealth), and Nafi' (Beneficial)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الرُّكَيْنِ بْنِ الرَّبِيعِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تُسَمِّ غُلاَمَكَ رَبَاحًا وَلاَ يَسَارًا وَلاَ أَفْلَحَ وَلاَ نَافِعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alrrukayni bni alrrabiy'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an samuraaa, bni jundabin qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tusammi ghulaamaka rabaahana walaa yasaarana walaa aaflaha walaa naafi'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Samura b. Jundub reported AUah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Don't give names to your servants as Rabdh, 'Ya ar, Aflah and Nafi
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنِ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ، عَنْ رَبِيعِ بْنِ عُمَيْلَةَ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "أَحَبُّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَرْبَعٌ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ‏.‏ لاَ يَضُرُّكَ بَأَيِّهِنَّ بَدَأْتَ.‏ وَلاَ تُسَمِّيَنَّ غُلاَمَكَ يَسَارًا وَلاَ رَبَاحًا وَلاَ نَجِيحًا وَلاَ أَفْلَحَ فَإِنَّكَ تَقُولُ أَثَمَّ هُوَ فَلاَ يَكُونُ فَيَقُولُ لاَ‏."‏‏ إِنَّمَا هُنَّ أَرْبَعٌ فَلاَ تَزِيدُنَّ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi allaahi bni yuwnusa, hadaathanaa zuhayrun, hadaathanaa mansuwrun, 'ani hilaali bni yasaafin, 'an rabiy'i bni 'umaylaaa, 'an samuraaa bni jundabin, qaala qaala rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "aahabuu alkalaami iilaa allaahi aarba'un subhaana allaahi waalhamdu lilaahi walaa iilaha iilaaa allaahu waallaahu aakbaru‏.‏ laa yaduruuka baaayiihinaa badaata.‏ walaa tusamiiyanaa ghulaamaka yasaarana walaa rabaahana walaa najiyhana walaa aaflaha faiinaaka taquwlu aathamaa huwa falaa yakuwnu fayaquwlu laa‏."‏‏ iinaamaa hunaa aarba'un falaa taziydunaa 'alaaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Samura b. Jundub reported:The Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him) said "The dearest phrases to Allah are four: Subhan Allah (Hallowed be Allah), Al-Hamdulillah (Praise be to Allah), La ilaha illa-Allah (There is no deity but Allah), Allahu Akbar (Allah is Greater). There is no harm for you in which of them begin with (while remembering Allah). And do not give these names to your servants: Yasar and Rabah and Najih and Aflah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، - وَهْوَ ابْنُ الْقَاسِمِ - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ زُهَيْرٍ ‏.‏ فَأَمَّا حَدِيثُ جَرِيرٍ وَرَوْحٍ فَكَمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ بِقِصَّتِهِ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا حَدِيثُ شُعْبَةَ فَلَيْسَ فِيهِ إِلاَّ ذِكْرُ تَسْمِيَةِ الْغُلاَمِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْكَلاَمَ الأَرْبَعَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaraniy jariyrun, h wahaddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaamin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa rawhun, - wahwa abnu alqaasimi - h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, kulluhum 'an mansuwrin, biiisnaadi zuhayrin ‏.‏ faaammaa hadiythu jariyrin warawhin fakamithli hadiythi zuhayrin biqissatihi ‏.‏ waaammaa hadiythu shu'baaa falaysa fiyhi iilaaa dhikru tasmiyaai alghulaami walam yadhkuri alkalaama alaarba'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba and there is no mention but of the fact about giving the name to the servant and there is no mention of the four expressions (of remembrance) and he did not mention the four words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
