verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَنْهَى عَنْ أَنْ يُسَمَّى بِيَعْلَى وَبِبَرَكَةَ وَبِأَفْلَحَ وَبِيَسَارٍ وَبِنَافِعٍ وَبِنَحْوِ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ رَأَيْتُهُ سَكَتَ بَعْدُ عَنْهَا فَلَمْ يَقُلْ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ يَنْهَ عَنْ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ أَرَادَ عُمَرُ أَنْ يَنْهَى عَنْ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ تَرَكَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aahmada bni aabiy khalafin, haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu aaraada alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yanhaa 'an aan yusammaa biya'laa wabibarakaaa wabiaaflaha wabiyasaarin wabinaafi'in wabinahwi dhalika thumma raaaytuhu sakata ba'du 'anhaa falam yaqul shayiana thumma qubida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walam yanha 'an dhalika thumma aaraada 'umaru aan yanhaa 'an dhalika thumma tarakahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) decided to forbid (his followers) to name persons as Ya'la (Elevated), Baraka (Blessing), Aflah (Successful), Yasar and Nafi', but I saw that he kept silent after that and he did not say anything until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died. And he did not forbid (his followers to do this), then 'Umar decided to prohibit (people) from giving these names, but later on gave up the idea
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيَّرَ اسْمَ عَاصِيَةَ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنْتِ جَمِيلَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَحْمَدُ مَكَانَ أَخْبَرَنِي عَنْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu hanbalin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin qaaluwa haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayyara asma 'aasiyaaa waqaala ‏ "‏ aanti jamiylaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aahmadu makaana aakhbaraniy 'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed the name of 'Asiya (Disobedient) and said:You are Jamila (i. e. good and handsome). Ahmad (one of the narrators) narrated it with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ مُوسَى، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ ابْنَةً لِعُمَرَ، كَانَتْ يُقَالُ لَهَا عَاصِيَةُ فَسَمَّاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جَمِيلَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu muwsaa, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna abnaaan li'umara, kaanat yuqaalu lahaa 'aasiyaau fasammaahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jamiylaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that 'Umar had a daughter who was called 'Asiya. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the name of Jamila
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَوْلَى آلِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَتْ جُوَيْرِيَةُ اسْمُهَا بَرَّةَ فَحَوَّلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْمَهَا جُوَيْرِيَةَ وَكَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ يُقَالَ خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِ بَرَّةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu li'amrinw - qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, mawlaa ali talhaaa 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kaanat juwayriyaau asmuhaa barraaa fahawwala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm asmahaa juwayriyaaa wakaana yakrahu aan yuqaala kharaja min 'indi barraaa ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni aabiy 'umara 'an kuraybin qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that the name of Juwairiya (the wife of the Holy Prophet) was Barra (Pious). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) changed her name to Juwairiya and said:I did not like that it should be said: He had come out from Barra (Pious). The hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abi 'Umar is slightly different from it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا رَافِعٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ، كَانَ اسْمُهَا بَرَّةَ فَقِيلَ تُزَكِّي نَفْسَهَا ‏.‏ فَسَمَّاهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ ‏.‏ وَلَفْظُ الْحَدِيثِ لِهَؤُلاَءِ دُونَ ابْنِ بَشَّارٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaaluwa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy maymuwnaaa, sami'tu aabaa raafi'in, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy, hurayraaa h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy maymuwnaaa, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna zaynaba, kaana asmuhaa barraaa faqiyla tuzakkiy nafsahaa ‏.‏ fasammaahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zaynaba ‏.‏ walafzu alhadiythi lihauulaa'i duwna abni bashhaarin ‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy shaybaaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin 'an shu'baaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the name of Zainab was Barra. It was said of her:She presents herself to be innocent. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave her the name of Zainab
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، حَدَّثَتْنِي زَيْنَبُ، بِنْتُ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَتْ كَانَ اسْمِي بَرَّةَ فَسَمَّانِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَدَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ زَيْنَبُ بِنْتُ جَحْشٍ وَاسْمُهَا بَرَّةُ فَسَمَّاهَا زَيْنَبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaalaa haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu kathiyrin, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni 'ataa'in, haddathatniy zaynabu, bintu aummi salamaaa qaalat kaana asmiy barraaa fasammaaniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zaynaba ‏.‏ qaalat wadakhalat 'alayhi zaynabu bintu jahshin waasmuhaa barraau fasammaahaa zaynaba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zainab, daughter of Umm Salama, reported:My name first was Barra. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave me the name of Zainab. Then there entered (into the house of Allah's Prophet as a wife) Zainab, daughter of Jahsh, and her name was also Barra, and he gave her the name of Zainab
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، قَالَ سَمَّيْتُ ابْنَتِي بَرَّةَ فَقَالَتْ لِي زَيْنَبُ بِنْتُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْ هَذَا الاِسْمِ وَسُمِّيتُ بَرَّةَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تُزَكُّوا أَنْفُسَكُمُ اللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِأَهْلِ الْبِرِّ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا بِمَ نُسَمِّيهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ سَمُّوهَا زَيْنَبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa haashimu bnu alqaasimi, haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni 'ataa'in, qaala sammaytu abnatiy barraaa faqaalat liy zaynabu bintu aabiy salamaaa iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahaa 'an hadhaa alaismi wasummiytu barraaa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tuzakkuwa aanfusakumu alllahu aa'lamu biaahli albirri minkum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa bima nusammiyhaa qaala ‏"‏ sammuwhaa zaynaba ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. 'Amr b. 'Ata' reported:I had given the name Barra to my daughter. Zainab, daughter of Abu Salama, told me that Allah's' Messenger (ﷺ) had forbidden me to give this name. (She said): I was also called Barra, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't hold yourself to be pious. It is God alone who knows the people of piety among you. They (the Companions) said: Then, what name should we give to her? He said: Name her as Zainab
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَحْمَدَ - قَالَ الأَشْعَثِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَخْنَعَ اسْمٍ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ رَجُلٌ تَسَمَّى مَلِكَ الأَمْلاَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ زَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏"‏ لاَ مَالِكَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الأَشْعَثِيُّ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ مِثْلُ شَاهَانْ شَاهْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَمْرٍو عَنْ أَخْنَعَ فَقَالَ أَوْضَعَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, waaahmadu bnu hanbalin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa - waalllafzu laahmada - qaala alaash'athiyyu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna aakhna'a asmin 'inda alllahi rajulun tasammaa malika alaamlaaki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ zaada abnu aabiy shaybaaa fiy riwaayatihi ‏"‏ laa maalika iilaaa alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alaash'athiyyu qaala sufyaanu mithlu shaahaan shaah ‏.‏ waqaala aahmadu bnu hanbalin saaaltu aabaa 'amrinw 'an aakhna'a faqaala aawda'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The vilest name in Allah's sight is Malik al-Amidh (King of Kings). The narration transmitted on the authority of Shaiba (contains these words): There is no king but Allah, the Exalted and Glorious. Sufyan said: Similarly, the word Shahinshah (is also the vilest appellation). Ahmad b. Hanbal said: I asked Abu 'Amr about the meaning of Akhna. He said: The vilest
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَغْيَظُ رَجُلٍ عَلَى اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَأَخْبَثُهُ وَأَغْيَظُهُ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلٌ كَانَ يُسَمَّى مَلِكَ الأَمْلاَكِ لاَ مَلِكَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aaghyazu rajulin 'alaa alllahi yawma alqiyaamaai waaakhbathuhu waaaghyazuhu 'alayhi rajulun kaana yusammaa malika alaamlaaki laa malika iilaaa alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so many ahadith and one of them was this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The most wretched person in the sight of Allah on the Day of Resurrection and the worst person and target of His wrath would of the person who is called Malik al-Amlak (the King of Kings) for there is no king but Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ، بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ ذَهَبْتُ بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ وُلِدَ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي عَبَاءَةٍ يَهْنَأُ بَعِيرًا لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ مَعَكَ تَمْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَنَاوَلْتُهُ تَمَرَاتٍ فَأَلْقَاهُنَّ فِي فِيهِ فَلاَكَهُنَّ ثُمَّ فَغَرَ فَا الصَّبِيِّ فَمَجَّهُ فِي فِيهِ فَجَعَلَ الصَّبِيُّ يَتَلَمَّظُهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ حُبُّ الأَنْصَارِ التَّمْرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَمَّاهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasi, bni maalikin qaala dhahabtu bi'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa alaansaariyyi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna wulida warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy 'abaa'aain yahnaau ba'iyrana lahu faqaala ‏"‏ hal ma'aka tamrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu na'am ‏.‏ fanaawaltuhu tamaraatin faaalqaahunna fiy fiyhi falaakahunna thumma faghara faa alssabiyyi famajjahu fiy fiyhi faja'ala alssabiyyu yatalammazuhu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hubbu alaansaari alttamra ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasammaahu 'abda alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:I took 'Abdullah b. Abi Talha Ansari to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time of his birth. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was at that time wearing a woollen cloak and besmearing the camels with tar. He said: Have you got with you the dates? I said: Yes. He took hold of the dates and put them in his mouth and softened them, then opened the mouth of the infant and put that in it and the child began to lick it. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The Ansar have a liking for the dates, and he (the Holy Prophet) gave him the name of 'Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ ابْنٌ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ يَشْتَكِي فَخَرَجَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ فَقُبِضَ الصَّبِيُّ فَلَمَّا رَجَعَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ قَالَ مَا فَعَلَ ابْنِي قَالَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ هُوَ أَسْكَنُ مِمَّا كَانَ ‏.‏ فَقَرَّبَتْ إِلَيْهِ الْعَشَاءَ فَتَعَشَّى ثُمَّ أَصَابَ مِنْهَا فَلَمَّا فَرَغَ قَالَتْ وَارُوا الصَّبِيَّ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَعْرَسْتُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَوَلَدَتْ غُلاَمًا فَقَالَ لِي أَبُو طَلْحَةَ احْمِلْهُ حَتَّى تَأْتِيَ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَتَى بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَبَعَثَتْ مَعَهُ بِتَمَرَاتٍ فَأَخَذَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَعَهُ شَىْءٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ تَمَرَاتٌ ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَضَغَهَا ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا مِنْ فِيهِ فَجَعَلَهَا فِي فِي الصَّبِيِّ ثُمَّ حَنَّكَهُ وَسَمَّاهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa abnu 'awnin, 'ani abni, siyriyna 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kaana abnun laabiy talhaaa yashtakiy fakharaja aabuw talhaaa faqubida alssabiyyu falammaa raja'a aabuw talhaaa qaala maa fa'ala abniy qaalat aummu sulaymin huwa aaskanu mimmaa kaana ‏.‏ faqarrabat iilayhi al'ashaa'a fata'ashhaa thumma aasaaba minhaa falammaa faragha qaalat waaruwa alssabiyya ‏.‏ falammaa aasbaha aabuw talhaaa aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu faqaala ‏"‏ aa'rastumu alllaylaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma baarik lahumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fawaladat ghulaamana faqaala liy aabuw talhaaa ahmilhu hattaa taatiya bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faaataa bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waba'athat ma'ahu bitamaraatin faaakhadhahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aama'ahu shaa'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'am tamaraatun ‏.‏ faaakhadhahaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm famadaghahaa thumma aakhadhahaa min fiyhi faja'alahaa fiy fiy alssabiyyi thumma hannakahu wasammaahu 'abda alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that the son of Abu Talha had been ailing. Abu Talha set out (on a journey) and his son breathed his last (in his absence). When Abu Talha came back, he said (to his wife):What about my child? Umm Sulaim (the wife of Abu Talha) said: He is now in a more comfortable state than before. She served him the evening meal and he took it. He then came to her (and had sexual intercourse with her) and when it was all over she said: Make arrangements for the burial of the child. When it was morning. Abu Talha came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him, whereupon he said: Did you spend the night with her. He said: Yes. He (the Holy Prophet) then said: O Allah, bless both of them (and as a result of blessing) she gave birth to a child. Abu Talha said to me (Anas b. Malik) to take the child, (so I took him) and came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She (Umm Sulaim) also had sent some dates (along with the child). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) took him (the child) (in his lap) and said: Is there anything with you (for Tahnik). They (the Companions) said: Yes. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) took hold of them (dates and chewed them). He then put them (the chewed dates) in the mouth of the child and then rubbed his palate and gave him the name of 'Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ مَسْعَدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، بِهَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu mas'adaaa, haddathanaa abnu 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aanasin, bihadhihi alqissaai nahwa hadiythi yaziyda ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmit ters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَرَّادٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ وُلِدَ لِي غُلاَمٌ فَأَتَيْتُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَمَّاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَحَنَّكَهُ بِتَمْرَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'abdu alllahi bnu barraadin alaash'ariyyu, waaabuw kuraybin qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala wulida liy ghulaamun faaataytu bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fasammaahu iibraahiyma wahannakahu bitamraain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported:A child was born in my house and I brought him to Allah's Apostle (may peace be upod him) and he gave him the name of Ibrahim and he rubbed his palate with dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْحَاقَ - أَخْبَرَنِي هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، وَفَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ الْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُمَا قَالاَ خَرَجَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ حِينَ هَاجَرَتْ وَهِيَ حُبْلَى بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَدِمَتْ قُبَاءً فَنُفِسَتْ بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بِقُبَاءٍ ثُمَّ خَرَجَتْ حِينَ نُفِسَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُحَنِّكَهُ فَأَخَذَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْهَا فَوَضَعَهُ فِي حَجْرِهِ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِتَمْرَةٍ قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَمَكَثْنَا سَاعَةً نَلْتَمِسُهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ نَجِدَهَا فَمَضَغَهَا ثُمَّ بَصَقَهَا فِي فِيهِ فَإِنَّ أَوَّلَ شَىْءٍ دَخَلَ بَطْنَهُ لَرِيقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ ثُمَّ مَسَحَهُ وَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ وَسَمَّاهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ جَاءَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَبْعِ سِنِينَ أَوْ ثَمَانٍ لِيُبَايِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَمَرَهُ بِذَلِكَ الزُّبَيْرُ فَتَبَسَّمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ رَآهُ مُقْبِلاً إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ بَايَعَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu muwsaa aabuw saalihin, haddathanaa shu'aybun, - ya'niy abna iishaaqa - aakhbaraniy hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, haddathaniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, wafaatimaau bintu almundhiri bni alzzubayri, aannahumaa qaalaa kharajat aasmaa'u bintu aabiy bakrin hiyna haajarat wahiya hublaa bi'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri faqadimat qubaa'an fanufisat bi'abdi alllahi biqubaa'in thumma kharajat hiyna nufisat iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liyuhannikahu faaakhadhahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm minhaa fawada'ahu fiy hajrihi thumma da'aa bitamraain qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau famakathnaa saa'aaan naltamisuhaa qabla aan najidahaa famadaghahaa thumma basaqahaa fiy fiyhi faiinna aawwala shaa'in dakhala batnahu lariyqu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaalat aasmaa'u thumma masahahu wasallaa 'alayhi wasammaahu 'abda alllahi thumma jaa'a wahuwa abnu sab'i siniyna aaw thamaanin liyubaayi'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaamarahu bidhalika alzzubayru fatabassama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna raahu muqbilaan iilayhi thumma baaya'ahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Urwa b. Zubair and Fatima daughter of Mandhir b. Zubair, reported that Asma' daughter of Abu Bakr was at the time of migration in the family way with 'Abdullah b. Zubair (in her womb). She came to Quba' and gave birth to 'Abdullah at that place and then sent him to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) so that he should rub his palate with chewed dates. Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) took hold of him (the child) and he placed him in his lap and then called for dates. 'A'isha said:Some time was spent before we were able to find them. He (the Holy Prophet) chewed them and then put his saliva in his mouth. The first thing that entered his stomach, was the saliva of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Asma' said: He then rubbed him and blessed him and gave him the name of Abdullah. He ('Abdullah) went to him (the Holy Prophet) when he had attained the age of seven or eight years in order to pledge allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as Zubair had commanded him to do. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled when he saw him coming towards him and then accepted his allegiance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، أَنَّهَا حَمَلَتْ بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بِمَكَّةَ قَالَتْ فَخَرَجْتُ وَأَنَا مُتِمٌّ، فَأَتَيْتُ الْمَدِينَةَ فَنَزَلْتُ بِقُبَاءٍ فَوَلَدْتُهُ بِقُبَاءٍ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَضَعَهُ فِي حَجْرِهِ ثُمَّ دَعَا بِتَمْرَةٍ فَمَضَغَهَا ثُمَّ تَفَلَ فِي فِيهِ فَكَانَ أَوَّلَ شَىْءٍ دَخَلَ جَوْفَهُ رِيقُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ حَنَّكَهُ بِالتَّمْرَةِ ثُمَّ دَعَا لَهُ وَبَرَّكَ عَلَيْهِ وَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَوْلُودٍ وُلِدَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aasmaa'a, aannahaa hamalat bi'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri bimakkaaa qaalat fakharajtu waaanaa mutimmun, faaataytu almadiynaaa fanazaltu biqubaa'in fawaladtuhu biqubaa'in thumma aataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawada'ahu fiy hajrihi thumma da'aa bitamraain famadaghahaa thumma tafala fiy fiyhi fakaana aawwala shaa'in dakhala jawfahu riyqu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma hannakahu bialttamraai thumma da'aa lahu wabarraka 'alayhi wakaana aawwala mawluwdin wulida fiy aliislaami ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asma' reported that she had become pregnant at Mecca with Abdullah b. Zubair (in her womt) and she (further) said:I set out (for migration to Medina) as I was in the advanced stage of pregnancy. I came to Medina and got down at the place known as Quba' and gave birth to a child there. Then I came to Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him). He placed him (the child) in his lap and then commanded for the dates to be brought. He chewed them and then put the saliva in his mouth. The first thing which went into his stomach was the saliva of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He then rubbed his palate with dates and then invoked blessings for him and blessed him. He was the first child who was born in Islam (after Migration)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ، بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّهَا هَاجَرَتْ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ حُبْلَى بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, 'an 'aliyyi bni mushirin, 'an hishaami, bni 'urwaaa 'an aabiyhi, 'an aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin, aannahaa haajarat iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya hublaa bi'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr, reported that when she migrated to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in Medina she was in the family way with Abdullah b. Zubair in her womb
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُرْوَةَ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُؤْتَى بِالصِّبْيَانِ فَيُبَرِّكُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَيُحَنِّكُهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, - ya'niy abna 'urwaaa - 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yuutaa bialssibyaani fayubarriku 'alayhim wayuhannikuhum ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that the new-born infants were brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He blessed them and rubbed their palates with dates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ جِئْنَا بِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَنِّكُهُ فَطَلَبْنَا تَمْرَةً فَعَزَّ عَلَيْنَا طَلَبُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat jiinaa bi'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhannikuhu fatalabnaa tamraaan fa'azza 'alaynaa talabuhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:We took 'Abdullah b. Zubair to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) so that he should put saliva in his mouth and we had to make a good deal of effort in order to procure them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سَهْلٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مُطَرِّفٍ أَبُو غَسَّانَ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ بِالْمُنْذِرِ بْنِ أَبِي أُسَيْدٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ وُلِدَ فَوَضَعَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى فَخِذِهِ وَأَبُو أُسَيْدٍ جَالِسٌ فَلَهِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَىْءٍ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ فَأَمَرَ أَبُو أُسَيْدٍ بِابْنِهِ فَاحْتُمِلَ مِنْ عَلَى فَخِذِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَقْلَبُوهُ فَاسْتَفَاقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ الصَّبِيُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو أُسَيْدٍ أَقْلَبْنَاهُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا اسْمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فُلاَنٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ وَلَكِنِ اسْمُهُ الْمُنْذِرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَمَّاهُ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْمُنْذِرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu sahlin alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, haddathanaa muhammadun, - wahuwa abnu mutarrifin aabuw ghassaana - haddathaniy aabuw haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, qaala autiya bialmundhiri bni aabiy ausaydin iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna wulida fawada'ahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa fakhidhihi waaabuw ausaydin jaalisun falahiya alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bishaa'in bayna yadayhi faaamara aabuw ausaydin biabnihi faahtumila min 'alaa fakhidhi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaaqlabuwhu faastafaaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aayna alssabiyyu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw ausaydin aaqlabnaahu yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ maa asmuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fulaanun yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ laa walakini asmuhu almundhiru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasammaahu yawmaiidhin almundhira ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd reported that Mundhir b. Aba Usaid was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time of his birth Allah's. Apostle (ﷺ) placed him on his thigh and Abfi Usaid kept sitting there. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had been occupied with something else before him. Abu Usaid commanded his child to be lifted from the lap of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and so he was lifted. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had finished the work he said:Where is the child? Abd Usaid said: Allah's Messenger, we took him away. He said: What is his name? He said; Allah's Messenger, it is so and so, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Nay, his name is Mundhir, and named him Mundhir on that day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْعَتَكِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو التَّيَّاحِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ خُلُقًا وَكَانَ لِي أَخٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو عُمَيْرٍ - قَالَ أَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ - كَانَ فَطِيمًا - قَالَ - فَكَانَ إِذَا جَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَآهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَبَا عُمَيْرٍ مَا فَعَلَ النُّغَيْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ يَلْعَبُ بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, sulaymaanu bnu daawuda al'atakiyyu haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa aabuw alttayyaahi, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, h wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahsana alnnaasi khuluqana wakaana liy aakhun yuqaalu lahu aabuw 'umayrin - qaala aahsibuhu qaala - kaana fatiymana - qaala - fakaana iidhaa jaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faraahu qaala ‏ "‏ aabaa 'umayrin maa fa'ala alnnughayru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakaana yal'abu bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had the sublimest character among mankind. I had a brother who was called Abu 'Umair. I think he was weaned. When Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) came to our house he saw him, and said:Abu 'Umair, what has the sparrow done? He (Anas) said that he had been playing with that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ، مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا بُنَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'ubaydin alghubariyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an aanasi bni, maalikin qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa bunaaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressed me:O My Son
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، بْنِ شُعْبَةَ قَالَ مَا سَأَلَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحَدٌ عَنِ الدَّجَّالِ أَكْثَرَ مِمَّا سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْهُ فَقَالَ لِي ‏"‏ أَىْ بُنَىَّ وَمَا يُنْصِبُكَ مِنْهُ إِنَّهُ لَنْ يَضُرَّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ إِنَّهُمْ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنَّ مَعَهُ أَنْهَارَ الْمَاءِ وَجِبَالَ الْخُبْزِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هُوَ أَهْوَنُ عَلَى اللَّهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy 'umara - qaalaa haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an qaysi bni aabiy haazimin, 'ani almughiyraai, bni shu'baaa qaala maa saaala rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahadun 'ani alddajjaali aakthara mimmaa saaaltuhu 'anhu faqaala liy ‏"‏ aaa bunaaaa wamaa yunsibuka minhu iinnahu lan yadurraka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu iinnahum yaz'umuwna aanna ma'ahu aanhaara almaa'i wajibaala alkhubzi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ huwa aahwanu 'alaa alllahi min dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that none else had asked more questions from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the Dajjal than I, but he simply said in a slight mood):O, myson, why are you worried because of him? He will not harm you. I said: The people think that he would have with him rivers of water and mountains of bread, whereupon he said: He would be more insignificant in the sight of Allah than all these things (belonging to him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا سُرَيْجُ بْنُ، يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ قَوْلُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلْمُغِيرَةِ ‏ "‏ أَىْ بُنَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ فِي حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ وَحْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa surayju bnu, yuwnusa haddathanaa hushaymun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu, raafi'in haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kulluhum 'an iismaa'iyla, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi aahadin minhum qawlu alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm lilmughiyraai ‏ "‏ aaa bunaaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaaa fiy hadiythi yaziyda wahdahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ismail, with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا - وَاللَّهِ، - يَزِيدُ بْنُ خُصَيْفَةَ عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فِي مَجْلِسِ الأَنْصَارِ فَأَتَانَا أَبُو مُوسَى فَزِعًا أَوْ مَذْعُورًا ‏.‏ قُلْنَا مَا شَأْنُكَ قَالَ إِنَّ عُمَرَ أَرْسَلَ إِلَىَّ أَنْ آتِيَهُ فَأَتَيْتُ بَابَهُ فَسَلَّمْتُ ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يَرُدَّ عَلَىَّ فَرَجَعْتُ فَقَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَأْتِيَنَا فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي أَتَيْتُكَ فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَى بَابِكَ ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يَرُدُّوا عَلَىَّ فَرَجَعْتُ وَقَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا اسْتَأْذَنَ أَحَدُكُمْ ثَلاَثًا فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لَهُ فَلْيَرْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَقِمْ عَلَيْهِ الْبَيِّنَةَ وَإِلاَّ أَوْجَعْتُكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ لاَ يَقُومُ مَعَهُ إِلاَّ أَصْغَرُ الْقَوْمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ قُلْتُ أَنَا أَصْغَرُ الْقَوْمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ بِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu muhammadi bni bukayrin alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathanaa - waalllahi, - yaziydu bnu khusayfaaa 'an busri bni sa'iydin, qaala sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, yaquwlu kuntu jaalisana bialmadiynaai fiy majlisi alaansaari faaataanaa aabuw muwsaa fazi'ana aaw madh'uwrana ‏.‏ qulnaa maa shaanuka qaala iinna 'umara aarsala iilaaaa aan atiyahu faaataytu baabahu fasallamtu thalaathana falam yarudda 'alaaaa faraja'tu faqaala maa mana'aka aan taatiyanaa faqultu iinniy aataytuka fasallamtu 'alaa baabika thalaathana falam yarudduwa 'alaaaa faraja'tu waqad qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa astaadhana aahadukum thalaathana falam yuudhan lahu falyarji' ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru aaqim 'alayhi albayyinaaa waiilaaa aawja'tuka ‏.‏ faqaala aubaaau bnu ka'bin laa yaquwmu ma'ahu iilaaa aasgharu alqawmi ‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin qultu aanaa aasgharu alqawmi ‏.‏ qaala faadhhab bihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported:I was sitting in Medina in the company of the Ansar when Abu Musa came trembling with fear. We said to him: What is the matter? He said: 'Umar (Allah be pleased with him) sent for me. I went to him and paid him salutation thrice at (his) door but he made no response to me and so I came back. Thereupon he ('Umar) said: What stood in your way that you did not turn up? I said: I did come to you and paid you salutations at your door three times but I was not given any response, so I came back as the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) has said: When any one of you seeks permission three times and he is not granted permission, he should come back. Umar said: Bring a witness to support that you say, otherwise I shall take you to task. Ubayy b. Ka'b said: None should stand with him (as a witness) but the youngest amongst the people. Abu Sa'id said: I am the youngest amongst the people, whereupon he said: Then you go with him (to support his contention)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُصَيْفَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَقُمْتُ مَعَهُ فَذَهَبْتُ إِلَى عُمَرَ فَشَهِدْتُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an yaziyda bni khusayfaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wazaada abnu aabiy 'umara fiy hadiythihi qaala aabuw sa'iydin faqumtu ma'ahu fadhahabtu iilaa 'umara fashahidtu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yazid b. Khusaifa with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition:Abu Sa'id said: So I stood up, and went to 'Umar and gave witness (to what Abu Musa had said)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، أَنَّ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ كُنَّا فِي مَجْلِسٍ عِنْدَ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ فَأَتَى أَبُو مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ مُغْضَبًا حَتَّى وَقَفَ فَقَالَ أَنْشُدُكُمُ اللَّهَ هَلْ سَمِعَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الاِسْتِئْذَانُ ثَلاَثٌ فَإِنْ أُذِنَ لَكَ وَإِلاَّ فَارْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُبَىٌّ وَمَا ذَاكَ قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ أَمْسِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ فَلَمْ يُؤْذَنْ لِي فَرَجَعْتُ ثُمَّ جِئْتُهُ الْيَوْمَ فَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ أَنِّي جِئْتُ أَمْسِ فَسَلَّمْتُ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ انْصَرَفْتُ قَالَ قَدْ سَمِعْنَاكَ وَنَحْنُ حِينَئِذٍ عَلَى شُغْلٍ فَلَوْ مَا اسْتَأْذَنْتَ حَتَّى يُؤْذَنَ لَكَ قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ كَمَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَوَاللَّهِ لأُوجِعَنَّ ظَهْرَكَ وَبَطْنَكَ ‏.‏ أَوْ لَتَأْتِيَنَّ بِمَنْ يَشْهَدُ لَكَ عَلَى هَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ يَقُومُ مَعَكَ إِلاَّ أَحْدَثُنَا سِنًّا قُمْ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ حَتَّى أَتَيْتُ عُمَرَ فَقُلْتُ قَدْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ هَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an bukayri bni alaashajji, aanna busra bna sa'iydin, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, yaquwlu kunnaa fiy majlisin 'inda aubaaai bni ka'bin faaataa aabuw muwsaa alaash'ariyyu mughdabana hattaa waqafa faqaala aanshudukumu alllaha hal sami'a aahadun minkum rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alaistiidhaanu thalaathun faiin audhina laka waiilaaa faarji' ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aubaaaun wamaa dhaaka qaala astaadhantu 'alaa 'umara bni alkhattaabi aamsi thalaatha marraatin falam yuudhan liy faraja'tu thumma jiituhu alyawma fadakhaltu 'alayhi faaakhbartuhu aanniy jiitu aamsi fasallamtu thalaathana thumma ansaraftu qaala qad sami'naaka wanahnu hiynaiidhin 'alaa shughlin falaw maa astaadhanta hattaa yuudhana laka qaala astaadhantu kamaa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fawaalllahi lauwji'anna zahraka wabatnaka ‏.‏ aaw lataatiyanna biman yashhadu laka 'alaa hadhaa ‏.‏ faqaala aubaaau bnu ka'bin fawaalllahi laa yaquwmu ma'aka iilaaa aahdathunaa sinnana qum yaa aabaa sa'iydin ‏.‏ faqumtu hattaa aataytu 'umara faqultu qad sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu hadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd Sa'id Khudri reported:We were in the company of Ubayy b. Ka'b that Abu Musa Ash'ari came there in a state of anger. He stood (before us) and said: I ask you to bear witness in the name of Allah whether anyone amongst you heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Permission (for entering the house) should be sought three times and if permission is granted to you (then get in). otherwise go back. Ubayy b. Ka'b said: What is the iiiatter? He said: I sought permission yesterday from 'Umar b. Khattab three times but he did not permit me, so I came back; then I went to him today and visited him and informed him that I had come to him yesterday and greeted him thrice, then came back, whereupon he said: Yes, we did hear you but be were at that time busy, but why did you not seek permission (further and you must have never gone back until you were permitted to do so). He said: I sought permission (in the manner) that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said (in connection 'With the seeking of permission for entering the house of a stranger). Thereupon he (Hadrat Umar) said: By Allah, I shall torture your back and your stomach unless you bring one who may bear witness to what you state. 'Ubayy b. Ka'b said: By Allah, none should stand with you (to bear testimony) but the youngest amongst us. And he therefore, said to Abu Sa'id: Stand up. So I stood up until I came to Umar and said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ، بْنُ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى، أَتَى بَابَ عُمَرَ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ وَاحِدَةٌ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنَ الثَّانِيَةَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ثِنْتَانِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنَ الثَّالِثَةَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ثَلاَثٌ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ فَرَدَّهُ فَقَالَ إِنْ كَانَ هَذَا شَيْئًا حَفِظْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَهَا وَإِلاَّ فَلأَجْعَلَنَّكَ عِظَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَأَتَانَا فَقَالَ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمُوا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الاِسْتِئْذَانُ ثَلاَثٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلُوا يَضْحَكُونَ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ أَتَاكُمْ أَخُوكُمُ الْمُسْلِمُ قَدْ أُفْزِعَ تَضْحَكُونَ انْطَلِقْ فَأَنَا شَرِيكُكَ فِي هَذِهِ الْعُقُوبَةِ ‏.‏ فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ هَذَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna mufaddalin - haddathanaa sa'iydu, bnu yaziyda 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aanna aabaa muwsaa, aataa baaba 'umara faastaadhana faqaala 'umaru waahidaaun ‏.‏ thumma astaadhana althhaaniyaaa faqaala 'umaru thintaani ‏.‏ thumma astaadhana althhaalithaaa faqaala 'umaru thalaathun ‏.‏ thumma ansarafa faaatba'ahu faraddahu faqaala iin kaana hadhaa shayiana hafiztahu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fahaa waiilaaa falaaj'alannaka 'izaaan ‏.‏ qaala aabuw sa'iydin faaataanaa faqaala aalam ta'lamuwa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alaistiidhaanu thalaathun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faja'aluwa yadhakuwna - qaala - faqultu aataakum aakhuwkumu almuslimu qad aufzi'a tadhakuwna antaliq faaanaa shariykuka fiy hadhihi al'uquwbaai ‏.‏ faaataahu faqaala hadhaa aabuw sa'iydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that Abu Musa al-Ash'ari came to the door of 'Umar and sought his permission (to get into his house). Umar said:That is once. He again sought permission for the second time and 'Umar said: It is twice. He again sought permission for the third time and Umar said: It is thrice. He (Abu Musa) then went back. He (Hadrat 'Umar) (sent someone) to pursue him so that he should be brought back. Thereupon he (Hadrat Umar) said: If this act (of yours is in accordance with the command of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) you have preserved in your mind, then it is all right, otherwise (I shall give you such a severe punishment) that it will serve as an example to others. Abu Sa'id said: Then he (Abu Musa) came to us and said: Do you remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:" Permission is for three times"? They (Companions sitting in that cothpany) began to laugh, whereupon he (Abu Musa) said: There comes to you your Muslim brother who had been perturbed and you laugh. Abu Sa'id said: (Well), you go forth. I shall be your participant in this trouble of yours. So he came to him (Hadrat Umar) and said: Here is Abu Sa'id (to support my statement)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خِرَاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، قَالاَ سَمِعْنَاهُ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ بِشْرِ بْنِ مُفَضَّلٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy maslamaaa, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, h wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu alhasani bni khiraashin, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani aljurayriyyi, wasa'iydi bni yaziyda kilaahumaa 'an aabiy nadraaa, qaalaa sami'naahu yuhaddithu, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi bishri bni mufaddalin 'an aabiy maslamaaa, ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith bu been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَطَاءٌ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا مُوسَى، اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى عُمَرَ ثَلاَثًا فَكَأَنَّهُ وَجَدَهُ مَشْغُولاً فَرَجَعَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْ صَوْتَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ ائْذَنُوا لَهُ ‏.‏ فَدُعِيَ لَهُ فَقَالَ مَا حَمَلَكَ عَلَى مَا صَنَعْتَ قَالَ إِنَّا كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ بِهَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ لَتُقِيمَنَّ عَلَى هَذَا بَيِّنَةً أَوْ لأَفْعَلَنَّ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ فَانْطَلَقَ إِلَى مَجْلِسٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالُوا لاَ يَشْهَدُ لَكَ عَلَى هَذَا إِلاَّ أَصْغَرُنَا ‏.‏ فَقَامَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ كُنَّا نُؤْمَرُ بِهَذَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ خَفِيَ عَلَىَّ هَذَا مِنْ أَمْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَلْهَانِي عَنْهُ الصَّفْقُ بِالأَسْوَاقِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin alqattaanu, 'ani abni jurayjin, haddathanaa 'ataa'un, 'an 'ubaydi bni 'umayrin, aanna aabaa muwsaa, astaadhana 'alaa 'umara thalaathana fakaaannahu wajadahu mashghuwlaan faraja'a faqaala 'umaru aalam tasma' sawta 'abdi alllahi bni qaysin aidhanuwa lahu ‏.‏ fadu'iya lahu faqaala maa hamalaka 'alaa maa sana'ta qaala iinnaa kunnaa nuumaru bihadhaa ‏.‏ qaala latuqiymanna 'alaa hadhaa bayyinaaan aaw laaf'alanna ‏.‏ fakharaja faantalaqa iilaa majlisin mina alaansaari faqaaluwa laa yashhadu laka 'alaa hadhaa iilaaa aasgharunaa ‏.‏ faqaama aabuw sa'iydin faqaala kunnaa nuumaru bihadhaa ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru khafiya 'alaaaa hadhaa min aamri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aalhaaniy 'anhu alssafqu bialaaswaaqi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaid b. Umair reported that Abu Musa brought permission from Umar (to enter the house) three times, and finding him busy came back, whereupon Umar said (to the Inmates of his house):Did you not hear the voice of 'Abdullah b. Qais (the Kunya of Abu Musa Ash'ari)? He was called back. and he (Hadrat 'Umar) said: What did prompt you to do it? Thereupon, he said: This is how we have been commanded to act. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Bring evidence (in support of) it, otherwise I shall deal (strictly) with you. So he (Abu Musa) set out and came to the meeting of the Ansar and asked them to bear witness before hadrat Umar about this. They (the Companions present there) said: None but the youngest amongst us would bear out this fact. So Abu Sa'id Khudri (who was the youngest one in that company) said: We have been commanded to do so (while visiting the house of other people). Thereupon 'Umar said: This command of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had remained hidden from me up till now due to (my) business in the market
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ شُمَيْلٍ - قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِ النَّضْرِ أَلْهَانِي عَنْهُ الصَّفْقُ بِالأَسْوَاقِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, h wahaddathanaa husaynu bnu huraythin, haddathanaa alnnadru, - ya'niy abna shumaylin - qaalaa jamiy'ana haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu walam yadhkur fiy hadiythi alnnadri aalhaaniy 'anhu alssafqu bialaaswaaqi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Juraij, but there is no mention of the words" business in the market
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ أَبُو عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ، يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَبُو مُوسَى إِلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ هَذَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ قَيْسٍ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَأْذَنْ لَهُ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ هَذَا أَبُو مُوسَى السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ هَذَا الأَشْعَرِيُّ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ رُدُّوا عَلَىَّ رُدُّوا عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا مُوسَى مَا رَدَّكَ كُنَّا فِي شُغْلٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ الاِسْتِئْذَانُ ثَلاَثٌ فَإِنْ أُذِنَ لَكَ وَإِلاَّ فَارْجِعْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَتَأْتِيَنِّي عَلَى هَذَا بِبَيِّنَةٍ وَإِلاَّ فَعَلْتُ وَفَعَلْتُ ‏.‏ فَذَهَبَ أَبُو مُوسَى قَالَ عُمَرُ إِنْ وَجَدَ بَيِّنَةً تَجِدُوهُ عِنْدَ الْمِنْبَرِ عَشِيَّةً وَإِنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ بَيِّنَةً فَلَمْ تَجِدُوهُ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَنْ جَاءَ بِالْعَشِيِّ وَجَدُوهُ قَالَ يَا أَبَا مُوسَى مَا تَقُولُ أَقَدْ وَجَدْتَ قَالَ نَعَمْ أُبَىَّ بْنَ كَعْبٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَدْلٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ مَا يَقُولُ هَذَا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ يَا ابْنَ الْخَطَّابِ فَلاَ تَكُونَنَّ عَذَابًا عَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ إِنَّمَا سَمِعْتُ شَيْئًا فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَتَثَبَّتَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa husaynu bnu huraythin aabuw 'ammaarin, haddathanaa alfadlu bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa talhaau bnu, yahyaa 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, qaala jaa'a aabuw muwsaa iilaa 'umara bni alkhattaabi faqaala alssalaamu 'alaykum hadhaa 'abdu alllahi bnu qaysin ‏.‏ falam yaadhan lahu faqaala alssalaamu 'alaykum hadhaa aabuw muwsaa alssalaamu 'alaykum hadhaa alaash'ariyyu ‏.‏ thumma ansarafa faqaala rudduwa 'alaaaa rudduwa 'alaaaa ‏.‏ fajaa'a faqaala yaa aabaa muwsaa maa raddaka kunnaa fiy shughlin ‏.‏ qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alaistiidhaanu thalaathun faiin audhina laka waiilaaa faarji' ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala lataatiyanniy 'alaa hadhaa bibayyinaain waiilaaa fa'altu wafa'altu ‏.‏ fadhahaba aabuw muwsaa qaala 'umaru iin wajada bayyinaaan tajiduwhu 'inda alminbari 'ashiyyaaan waiin lam yajid bayyinaaan falam tajiduwhu ‏.‏ falammaa aan jaa'a bial'ashiyyi wajaduwhu qaala yaa aabaa muwsaa maa taquwlu aaqad wajadta qaala na'am aubaaaa bna ka'bin ‏.‏ qaala 'adlun ‏.‏ qaala yaa aabaa alttufayli maa yaquwlu hadhaa qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu dhalika yaa abna alkhattaabi falaa takuwnanna 'adhaabana 'alaa aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala subhaana alllahi iinnamaa sami'tu shayiana faaahbabtu aan aatathabbata ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported that he went to 'Umar b. Khattab and greeted him by saying:As-Salamu-'Alaikum, here is 'Abdullah b. Qais, but he did not permit him (to get in). He (Abu Musa Ash'ari) again greeted him with as-Salamu-'Alaikum and said: Here is Abu Musa, but he (Hadrat 'Umar) did not permit him (to get in). He again said: As-Salam-u-'Alaikum, (and said) here is Ash'ari, (then receiving no response he came back). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Bring him back to me, bring him back to me So he went there (in the presence of Hadrat 'Umar) and he said to him: Abu Musa, what made you go back, while we were busy in some work? He said: I heard Allah's Messenger (may. peace be upon him) as saying: Permission should be sought thrice. And if you are permitted, (then get in), otherwise go back. He said: Bring witness to this fact, otherwise I shall do this and that, i. e. I shall punish you. Abu Musa went away and 'Umar said to him (on his departure): It he (Abu Musa) finds a witness he should meet him by the side of the pulpit in the evening and it he does not find a witness you would not find him there. When it was evening he (Hadrat 'Umar) found him (Abu Musa) there. He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abu Musa, have you been able to find a witness to what you have said? He said: Yes. Here is Ubayy bin Ka'b, whereupon he (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Yes, he is an authentic (witness). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: Abu Tufail (the kunya of Ubayy b. Ka'b), what does he (Abu Musa say? Thereupon he said: Ibn Khattab, I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying so. Do not prove to be a hard (task-master) for the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereupon he Hadrat 'Umar said: Hallowed be Allah. I had heard something (in this connection), but I wished it to be established (as an undeniable fact)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَوْتُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَنَا أَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'an shu'baaa, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala aataytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fada'awtu faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu aanaa ‏.‏ qaala fakharaja wahuwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ aanaa aanaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:I came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and called him (with a view to seeking permission). whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Who is it? I said: It is I. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) came out saying: It is I. it is I
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا - وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَا أَنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala aabuw bakrin, haddathanaa - wakiy'un, 'an shu'baaa, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi, alllahi qaala astaadhantu 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ man hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu aanaa ‏.‏ faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aanaa aanaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:I sought permission from Allah's Messenger (may peace be upoh him) to see him. He said: Who is it? I said: It is I. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It is I. it is I (these words lead me to no conclusion)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، وَأَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمْ كَأَنَّهُ كَرِهَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, waaabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy wahbu bnu jariyrin, h wahaddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin, haddathanaa bahzun, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihim kaaannahu kariha dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording and that is:The Prophet (ﷺ) uttered these words: It is I. it is I." in the manner as if he disapproved of this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً اطَّلَعَ فِي جُحْرٍ فِي بَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِدْرًى يَحُكُّ بِهِ رَأْسَهُ فَلَمَّا رَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَنْظُرُنِي لَطَعَنْتُ بِهِ فِي عَيْنِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا جُعِلَ الإِذْنُ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْبَصَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wamuhammadu bnu rumhin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa alllaythu, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna sahla bna sa'din alssaa'idiyya, aakhbarahu aanna rajulaan attala'a fiy juhrin fiy baabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wama'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm midrana yahukku bihi raasahu falammaa raahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ law aa'lamu aannaka tanzuruniy lata'antu bihi fiy 'aynika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa ju'ila aliidhnu min aajli albasari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'id reported that a person peeped through the hole of the door of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and at that time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had with him a scratching instrument with which he had been scratching his head. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him. he said:If I were to know that you had been peeping through the door, I would have thrust that into your eyes, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Permission is needed as a protection against glance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً اطَّلَعَ مِنْ جُحْرٍ فِي بَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِدْرًى يُرَجِّلُ بِهِ رَأْسَهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَنْظُرُ طَعَنْتُ بِهِ فِي عَيْنِكَ إِنَّمَا جَعَلَ اللَّهُ الإِذْنَ مِنْ أَجْلِ الْبَصَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aannaaakhbarahu aanna rajulaan attala'a min juhrin fiy baabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wama'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm midrana yurajjilu bihi raasahu faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law aa'lamu aannaka tanzuru ta'antu bihi fiy 'aynika iinnamaa ja'ala alllahu aliidhna min aajli albasari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi reported that a person peeped through the hole of the door of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he had with him some pointed thing with which he had been adjusting (the hair of his head). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him:If I were to know that you had been peeping. I would have thrust it in your eyes. Allah has prescribed seeking permission because of protection against glance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ وَيُونُسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, haddathanaa ma'marun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sahli bni sa'din, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwa hadiythi alllaythi wayuwnusa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى وَأَبِي كَامِلٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، اطَّلَعَ مِنْ بَعْضِ حُجَرِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَامَ إِلَيْهِ بِمِشْقَصٍ أَوْ مَشَاقِصَ فَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْتِلُهُ لِيَطْعُنَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw kaamilin fudaylu bnu husaynin waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin - waalllafzu liyahyaa waaabiy kaamilin - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi bni aabiy bakrin 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rajulaan, attala'a min ba'di hujari alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaama iilayhi bimishqasin aaw mashaaqisa fakaaanniy aanzuru iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtiluhu liyat'unahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that a person peeped in some of the holes (in the doors) of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (and he found him) standing up (lifting) an arrow or some arrows. The narrator said:I perceived as if Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was going to pierce (his eyes)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اطَّلَعَ فِي بَيْتِ قَوْمٍ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِمْ فَقَدْ حَلَّ لَهُمْ أَنْ يَفْقَئُوا عَيْنَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mani attala'a fiy bayti qawmin bighayri iidhnihim faqad halla lahum aan yafqaiuwa 'aynahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported having heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say:He who peeped into the house of people without their consent, it is permissible for them to put out his eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً اطَّلَعَ عَلَيْكَ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنٍ فَخَذَفْتَهُ بِحَصَاةٍ فَفَقَأْتَ عَيْنَهُ مَا كَانَ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ جُنَاحٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ law aanna rajulaan attala'a 'alayka bighayri iidhnin fakhadhaftahu bihasaaain fafaqaata 'aynahu maa kaana 'alayka min junaahin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If a person were to cast a glance in your (house) without permission, and you had in your hand a staff and you would have thrust that in his eyes, there is no harm for you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا يُونُسُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ جَرِيرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ نَظَرِ الْفُجَاءَةِ فَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَصْرِفَ بَصَرِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, kilaahumaa 'an yuwnusa, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa hushaymun, aakhbaranaa yuwnusu, 'an 'amriw bni sa'iydin, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an jariyri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an nazari alfujaa'aai faaamaraniy aan aasrifa basariy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jarir b. 'Abdullah reported:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the sudden glance (that is cast) on the face (of a non-Mahram). He commanded me that I should turn away my eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 38 — The Book of Manners and Etiquette
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يُونُسَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alaa'laa, waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'an yuwnusa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، مَرْزُوقٍ حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادٌ، أَنَّ ثَابِتًا، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُسَلِّمُ الرَّاكِبُ عَلَى الْمَاشِي وَالْمَاشِي عَلَى الْقَاعِدِ وَالْقَلِيلُ عَلَى الْكَثِيرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'uqbaau bnu mukramin, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu, marzuwqin haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy ziyaadun, aanna thaabitana, mawlaa 'abdi alrrahmani bni zaydin aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yusallimu alrraakibu 'alaa almaashiy waalmaashiy 'alaa alqaa'idi waalqaliylu 'alaa alkathiyri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The rider should first greet the pedestrian, and the pedestrian the one who is seated and a small group should greet a larger group (with as-Salam-u-'Alaikum)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ كُنَّا قُعُودًا بِالأَفْنِيَةِ نَتَحَدَّثُ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَامَ عَلَيْنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكُمْ وَلِمَجَالِسِ الصُّعُدَاتِ اجْتَنِبُوا مَجَالِسَ الصُّعُدَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا إِنَّمَا قَعَدْنَا لِغَيْرِ مَا بَاسٍ قَعَدْنَا نَتَذَاكَرُ وَنَتَحَدَّثُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِمَّا لاَ فَأَدُّوا حَقَّهَا غَضُّ الْبَصَرِ وَرَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَحُسْنُ الْكَلاَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu hakiymin, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala aabuw talhaaa kunnaa qu'uwdana bialaafniyaai natahaddathu fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaama 'alaynaa faqaala ‏"‏ maa lakum walimajaalisi alssu'udaati ajtanibuwa majaalisa alssu'udaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqulnaa iinnamaa qa'adnaa lighayri maa baasin qa'adnaa natadhaakaru wanatahaddathu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iimmaa laa faaadduwa haqqahaa ghaddu albasari waraddu alssalaami wahusnu alkalaami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Talha reported:While we were sitting in front of the houses and talking amongst ourselves, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to come there. He stood by us and said: What about you and your meetings on the paths? Avoid these meetings on the paths. We said: We were sitting here without (any intention of doing harm to the passers-by) ; we are sitting to discuss matters and to hold conversation amongst ourselves. Thereupon he said: If there is no help (for you but to sit on these paths), then give the paths their rights and these are lowering of the gaze, exchanging of greetings and good conversation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ، بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِيَّاكُمْ وَالْجُلُوسَ بِالطُّرُقَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَنَا بُدٌّ مِنْ مَجَالِسِنَا نَتَحَدَّثُ فِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا أَبَيْتُمْ إِلاَّ الْمَجْلِسَ فَأَعْطُوا الطَّرِيقَ حَقَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا حَقُّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ غَضُّ الْبَصَرِ وَكَفُّ الأَذَى وَرَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَالأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْىُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hafsu bnu maysaraaa, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i, bni yasaarin 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iiyyaakum waaljuluwsa bialtturuqaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi maa lanaa buddun min majaalisinaa natahaddathu fiyhaa ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa aabaytum iilaaa almajlisa faaa'tuwa alttariyqa haqqahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa wamaa haqquhu qaala ‏"‏ ghaddu albasari wakaffu alaadhaa waraddu alssalaami waalaamru bialma'ruwfi waalnnahau 'ani almunkari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Avoid sitting on the paths. They (the Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, we cannot help but holding our meetings (in these paths) and discuss matters (there). Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If you insist on holding meetings, then give the path its due right. They said: What are its due rights? Upon this he said: Lowering the gaze, refraining from doing harm, exchanging of greetings. commanding of good and forbidding from evil
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ الْمَدَنِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin almadaniyyu, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu, raafi'in haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, 'an hishaamin, - ya'niy abna sa'din - kilaahumaa 'an zaydi bni aaslama, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ حَقُّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ خَمْسٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ، الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خَمْسٌ تَجِبُ لِلْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى أَخِيهِ رَدُّ السَّلاَمِ وَتَشْمِيتُ الْعَاطِسِ وَإِجَابَةُ الدَّعْوَةِ وَعِيَادَةُ الْمَرِيضِ وَاتِّبَاعُ الْجَنَائِزِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ كَانَ مَعْمَرٌ يُرْسِلُ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ وَأَسْنَدَهُ مَرَّةً عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani abni almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ haqqu almuslimi 'alaa almuslimi khamsun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'ani abni, almusayyabi 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ khamsun tajibu lilmuslimi 'alaa aakhiyhi raddu alssalaami watashmiytu al'aatisi waiijaabaau aldda'waai wa'iyaadaau almariydi waattibaa'u aljanaaiizi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alrrazzaaqi kaana ma'marun yursilu hadhaa alhadiytha 'ani alzzuhriyyi waaasnadahu marraaan 'ani abni almusayyabi 'an aabiy hurayraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Five are the rights of a Muslim over his brother: responding to salutation, saying Yarhamuk Allah when anybody sneezes and says al-Hamdulillah, visiting the sick. following the bier. ' Abd al-Razzaq said that this hadith has been transmitted as mursal hadith from Zuhri and he then substantiated it on the authority of Ibn Musayyib
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
