verses.translation: A'isha reported:that a Jew from among the Jews of Banu Zuraiq who was called Labid b. al-A'sam cast a spell upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with the result that he (under the influence of the spell) felt that he had been doing something whereas in fact he had not been doing that. (This state of affairs lasted) until one day or during one night Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made supplication (to dispel its effects). He again made a supplication and he again did this and said to 'A'isha: "Do you know that Allah has told me what I had asked Him? There came to me two men and one amongst them sat near my head and the other one near my feet and he who sat near my head said to one who sat near my feet or one who sat near my feet said to one who sat near my head: What is the trouble with the man? He said: The spell has affected him. He said: Who has cast that? He (the other one) said: It was Labid b. A'sam (who has done it). He said: What is the thing by which he transmitted its effect? He said: By the comb and by the hair stuck to the comb and the spathe of the date-palm. He said: Where is that? He replied: In the well of Dhi Arwan." She said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent some of the persons from among his Companions there and then said: "'A'isha, by Allah, its water was yellow like henna and its trees were like heads of the devils." She said that she asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as to why he did not burn that. He said: "No, Allah has cured me and I do not like that I should induce people to commit any high-handedness in regard (to one another), but I only commanded that it should be buried
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سُحِرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ الْحَدِيثَ بِقِصَّتِهِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ وَقَالَ فِيهِ فَذَهَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى الْبِئْرِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا وَعَلَيْهَا نَخْلٌ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَأَخْرِجْهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَفَلاَ أَحْرَقْتَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏ "‏ فَأَمَرْتُ بِهَا فَدُفِنَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat suhira rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wasaaqa aabuw kuraybin alhadiytha biqissatihi nahwa hadiythi abni numayrin waqaala fiyhi fadhahaba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa albiiri fanazara iilayhaa wa'alayhaa nakhlun ‏.‏ waqaalat qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi faaakhrijhu ‏.‏ walam yaqul aafalaa aahraqtahu walam yadhkur ‏ "‏ faaamartu bihaa fadufinat ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was affected with a spell, the rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation of wording:" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to the well and looked towards it and there were trees of date-palm near it. I ('A'isha) said: I asked Allah'& Messenger (ﷺ) to bring it out, and 1 did not say: Why did not you burn it?" And there is no mention of these words:" I commanded (to bury them and they buried)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ، بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ امْرَأَةً، يَهُودِيَّةً أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشَاةٍ مَسْمُومَةٍ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهَا فَجِيءَ بِهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهَا عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَتْ أَرَدْتُ لأَقْتُلَكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا كَانَ اللَّهُ لِيُسَلِّطَكِ عَلَى ذَاكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ عَلَىَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالُوا أَلاَ نَقْتُلُهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا زِلْتُ أَعْرِفُهَا فِي لَهَوَاتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an hishaami, bni zaydin 'an aanasin, aanna amraaaaan, yahuwdiyyaaan aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishaaain masmuwmaain faaakala minhaa fajiy'a bihaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahaa 'an dhalika faqaalat aaradtu laaqtulaka ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ maa kaana alllahu liyusallitaki 'alaa dhaaki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aaw qaala ‏"‏ 'alaaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qaaluwa aalaa naqtuluhaa qaala ‏"‏ laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famaa ziltu aa'rifuhaa fiy lahawaati rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that a Jewess came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with poisoned mutton and he took of that what had been brought to him (Allah's Messenger). (When the effect of this poison were felt by him) he called for her and asked her about that, whereupon she said:I had determined to kill you. Thereupon he said: Allah will never give you the power to do it. He (the narrator) said that they (the Companion's of the Holy Prophet) said: Should we not kill her? Thereupon he said: No. He (Anas) said: I felt (the affects of this poison) on the uvula of Allah's Messenger
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، - سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ، بْنَ زَيْدٍ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ يَهُودِيَّةً، جَعَلَتْ سَمًّا فِي لَحْمٍ ثُمَّ أَتَتْ بِهِ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ خَالِدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, - sami'tu hishaama, bna zaydin sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yuhaddithu aanna yahuwdiyyaaan, ja'alat sammana fiy lahmin thumma aatat bihi rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythi khaalidin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that a Jewess brought poisoned meat and then served it to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، زُهَيْرٌ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا اشْتَكَى مِنَّا إِنْسَانٌ مَسَحَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا مَرِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَثَقُلَ أَخَذْتُ بِيَدِهِ لأَصْنَعَ بِهِ نَحْوَ مَا كَانَ يَصْنَعُ فَانْتَزَعَ يَدَهُ مِنْ يَدِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَاجْعَلْنِي مَعَ الرَّفِيقِ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَذَهَبْتُ أَنْظُرُ فَإِذَا هُوَ قَدْ قَضَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, zuhayrun - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa ashtakaa minnaa iinsaanun masahahu biyamiynihi thumma qaala ‏"‏ aadhhibi albaasa rabba alnnaasi waashfi aanta alshhaafiy laa shifaa'a iilaaa shifaauuka shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqamana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa marida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wathaqula aakhadhtu biyadihi laasna'a bihi nahwa maa kaana yasna'u faantaza'a yadahu min yadiy thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma aghfir liy waaj'alniy ma'a alrrafiyqi alaa'laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat fadhahabtu aanzuru faiidhaa huwa qad qadaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When any person amongst us fell ill, Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) used to rub him with his right band and then say: O Lord of the people, grant him health, heal him, for Thou art a Greet Healer. There is no healere, but with Thy healing Power one is healed and illness is removed. She further added: When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell ill, and his illness took a serious turn I took hold of hie hand to that I should do with it what he ward to do with that (i. e. I would rub his body with his sacred hand). But he withdrew his hand from my hand and then said: O Allah, pardon me and make me join the companion. ship on She said. I was gazing at him constantly whereas he had passed away
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح حَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ خَلاَّدٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِإِسْنَادِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ هُشَيْمٍ وَشُعْبَةَ مَسَحَهُ بِيَدِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ الثَّوْرِيِّ مَسَحَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي عَقِبِ حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى عَنْ سُفْيَانَ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ مَنْصُورًا فَحَدَّثَنِي عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, h haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h haddathaniy bishru bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa abnu, bashhaarin haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw bakri bnu khalaaadin qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an sufyaana, kullu hauulaa'i 'ani alaa'mashi, biiisnaadi jariyrin ‏.‏ fiy hadiythi hushaymin washu'baaa masahahu biyadihi ‏.‏ qaala wafiy hadiythi althhawriyyi masahahu biyamiynihi ‏.‏ waqaala fiy 'aqibi hadiythi yahyaa 'an sufyaana 'ani alaa'mashi qaala fahaddathtu bihi mansuwrana fahaddathaniy 'an iibraahiyma 'an masruwqin 'an 'aaiishaaa binahwihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This. hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba through another chain of transmitters (and the words are):" He rubbed him with his hand" and (in) the hadith transmitted on the authority of Thauri (the words are)." He used to rub with his right hand." This hadith has been reported through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا عَادَ مَرِيضًا يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ اشْفِهِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa 'aada mariydana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aadhhibi albaasa rabba alnnaasi ashfihi aanta alshhaafiy laa shifaa'a iilaaa shifaauuka shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqamana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited the sick he would say: Lord of the people. remove the disease, cure him, for Thou art the great Curer, there is no cure but through Thine healing Power, which leaves nothing of the disease
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَى الْمَرِيضَ يَدْعُو لَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ وَاشْفِ أَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَدَعَا لَهُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aataa almariyda yad'uw lahu qaala ‏"‏ aadhhibi albaasa rabba alnnaasi waashfi aanta alshhaafiy laa shifaa'a iilaaa shifaauuka shifaa'an laa yughaadiru saqamana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy bakrin fada'aa lahu waqaala ‏"‏ waaanta alshhaafiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to visit any sick he supplicated for him and said:Lord of the people, remove the malady, cure him for Thou art a great Curer. There is no cure but through Thine healing Power which leaves no trouble, and in the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr there is a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُسْلِمُ بْنُ صُبَيْحٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي عَوَانَةَ وَجَرِيرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, wamuslimu bnu subayhin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi aabiy 'awaanaaa wajariyrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of 'A'isha through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَرْقِي بِهَذِهِ الرُّقْيَةِ ‏ "‏ أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ بِيَدِكَ الشِّفَاءُ لاَ كَاشِفَ لَهُ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy kuraybin - qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yarqiy bihadhihi alrruqyaai ‏ "‏ aadhhibi albaasa rabba alnnaasi biyadika alshhifaa'u laa kaashifa lahu iilaaa aanta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to recite (this supplication) as the words of incantation:" Lord of the people, remove the trouble for in Thine Hand is the cure; none is there to relieve him (the burden of disease) but only Thou
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kilaahumaa 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبَّادُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ، بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا مَرِضَ أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ نَفَثَ عَلَيْهِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ فَلَمَّا مَرِضَ مَرَضَهُ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ جَعَلْتُ أَنْفُثُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَمْسَحُهُ بِيَدِ نَفْسِهِ لأَنَّهَا كَانَتْ أَعْظَمَ بَرَكَةً مِنْ يَدِي ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَيُّوبَ بِمُعَوِّذَاتٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy surayju bnu yuwnusa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abbaadu bnu 'abbaadin, 'an hishaami, bni 'urwaaa 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa marida aahadun min aahlihi nafatha 'alayhi bialmu'awwidhaati falammaa marida maradahu alladhiy maata fiyhi ja'altu aanfuthu 'alayhi waaamsahuhu biyadi nafsihi laannahaa kaanat aa'zama barakaaan min yadiy ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai yahyaa bni aayyuwba bimu'awwidhaatin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that when any of the members of the household fell ill Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to blow over him by reciting Mu'awwidhatan, and when he suffered from illness of which he died I used to blow over him and rubbed his body with his hand for his hand had greater healing power than my hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى يَقْرَأُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ وَيَنْفُثُ فَلَمَّا اشْتَدَّ وَجَعُهُ كُنْتُ أَقْرَأُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَمْسَحُ عَنْهُ بِيَدِهِ رَجَاءَ بَرَكَتِهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa ashtakaa yaqraau 'alaa nafsihi bialmu'awwidhaati wayanfuthu falammaa ashtadda waja'uhu kuntu aaqraau 'alayhi waaamsahu 'anhu biyadihi rajaa'a barakatihaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) fell ill, he recited over his body Mu'awwidhatan and blew over him and when his sickness was aggravated I used to recite over him and rub him with his band with the hope that it was more blessed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي زِيَادٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ رَجَاءَ بَرَكَتِهَا ‏.‏ إِلاَّ فِي حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَفِي حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَزِيَادٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى نَفَثَ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بَالْمُعَوِّذَاتِ وَمَسَحَ عَنْهُ بِيَدِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa rawhun, h wahaddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu mukramin, waaahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, kilaahumaa 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy ziyaadun, kulluhum 'ani abni shihaabin, biiisnaadi maalikin ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythihi ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi aahadin minhum rajaa'a barakatihaa ‏.‏ iilaaa fiy hadiythi maalikin wafiy hadiythi yuwnusa waziyaadin aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa ashtakaa nafatha 'alaa nafsihi baalmu'awwidhaati wamasaha 'anhu biyadihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through some other chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Yanus and Ziyari (the words are):" When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) fell ill, he blew over his body by reciting Mu'awwidhatan and rubbed him with his hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنِ الرُّقْيَةِ، فَقَالَتْ رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَهْلِ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فِي الرُّقْيَةِ مِنْ كُلِّ ذِي حُمَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni alaaswadi 'an aabiyhi, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa 'ani alrruqyaai, faqaalat rakhhasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laahli baytin mina alaansaari fiy alrruqyaai min kulli dhiy humaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Rahman b. al-Aswad reported on the authority of his father:I asked 'A'isha about incantation. She said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had granted its sanction to the members of a family of the Ansar for incantation in curing every type of poison
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأَهْلِ بَيْتٍ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فِي الرُّقْيَةِ مِنَ الْحُمَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an mughiyraaa, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat rakhhasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laahli baytin mina alaansaari fiy alrruqyaai mina alhumaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted sanction to the members of a family of the Ansar for incantation (for removing the effects) of the poison of the scorpion
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا اشْتَكَى الإِنْسَانُ الشَّىْءَ مِنْهُ أَوْ كَانَتْ بِهِ قَرْحَةٌ أَوْ جَرْحٌ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِإِصْبَعِهِ هَكَذَا وَوَضَعَ سُفْيَانُ سَبَّابَتَهُ بِالأَرْضِ ثُمَّ رَفَعَهَا ‏"‏ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ تُرْبَةُ أَرْضِنَا بِرِيقَةِ بَعْضِنَا لِيُشْفَى بِهِ سَقِيمُنَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ ‏"‏ يُشْفَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ زُهَيْرٌ ‏"‏ لِيُشْفَى سَقِيمُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy 'umara - qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'abdi rabbihi bni sa'iydin, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa ashtakaa aliinsaanu alshhaa'a minhu aaw kaanat bihi qarhaaun aaw jarhun qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biiisba'ihi hakadhaa wawada'a sufyaanu sabbaabatahu bialaardi thumma rafa'ahaa ‏"‏ biasmi alllahi turbaau aardinaa biriyqaai ba'dinaa liyushfaa bihi saqiymunaa biiidhni rabbinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy shaybaaa ‏"‏ yushfaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala zuhayrun ‏"‏ liyushfaa saqiymunaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that when any person fell ill with a disease or he had any ailment or he had any injury, the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) placed his forefinger upon the ground and then lifted it by reciting the name of Allah. (and said):The dust of our ground with the saliva of any one of us would serve as a means whereby our illness would be cured with the sanction of Allah. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abu Shaiba and Zubair with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا - حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْبَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شَدَّادٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْمُرُهَا أَنْ تَسْتَرْقِيَ مِنَ الْعَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala aabuw bakrin, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu lahumaa - haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, 'an mis'arin, haddathanaa ma'badu bnu khaalidin, 'ani abni shaddaadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaamuruhaa aan tastarqiya mina al'ayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded the use of incantation for curing the influence of an evil eye
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مِسْعَرٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, qaala haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa mis'arun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mis'ar with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، شَدَّادٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُنِي أَنْ أَسْتَرْقِيَ مِنَ الْعَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an ma'badi bni khaalidin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, shaddaadin 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamuruniy aan aastarqiya mina al'ayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) commanded me that I should make use of incantation for curing the influence of an evil eye
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، فِي الرُّقَى قَالَ رُخِّصَ فِي الْحُمَةِ وَالنَّمْلَةِ وَالْعَيْنِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'an yuwsufa bni, 'abdi alllahi 'an aanasi bni maalikin, fiy alrruqaa qaala rukhhisa fiy alhumaai waalnnamlaai waal'ayni ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported in connection with incantation that he had been granted sanction (to use incantation as a remedy) for the sting of the scorpion and for curing small pustules and dispelling the influence of an evil eye
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ، بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ صَالِحٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الرُّقْيَةِ مِنَ الْعَيْنِ وَالْحُمَةِ وَالنَّمْلَةِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ يُوسُفُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru, bnu harbin haddathanaa humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, haddathanaa hasanun, - wahuwa abnu saalihin - kilaahumaa 'an 'aasimin, 'an yuwsufa bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aanasin, qaala rakhhasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alrruqyaai mina al'ayni waalhumaai waalnnamlaai ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi sufyaana yuwsufu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted him sanction to use incantation (as a cure) for the, influence of an evil eye, the sting of the scorpion and small pustules
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، الزُّبَيْدِيُّ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِجَارِيَةٍ فِي بَيْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَأَى بِوَجْهِهَا سَفْعَةً فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ بِهَا نَظْرَةٌ فَاسْتَرْقُوا لَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي بِوَجْهِهَا صُفْرَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i, sulaymaanu bnu daawuda haddathanaa muhammadu bnu harbin, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu alwaliydi, alzzubaydiyyu 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an zaynaba binti aummi salamaaa, 'an aummi salamaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lijaariyaain fiy bayti aummi salamaaa zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm raaaa biwajhihaa saf'aaan faqaala ‏ "‏ bihaa nazraaun faastarquwa lahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'niy biwajhihaa sufraaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to a small girl in the house of Umm Salama that he had been seeing on her face black stains and told her that that was due to the infiluence of an evil eye, and he asked that she should be cured with the help of incantation (hoping) that her face should become spotles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ رَخَّصَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لآلِ حَزْمٍ فِي رُقْيَةِ الْحَيَّةِ وَقَالَ لأَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ عُمَيْسٍ ‏"‏ مَا لِي أَرَى أَجْسَامَ بَنِي أَخِي ضَارِعَةً تُصِيبُهُمُ الْحَاجَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ لاَ وَلَكِنِ الْعَيْنُ تُسْرِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ارْقِيهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ارْقِيهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni jurayjin, qaala waaakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu rakhhasa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm lali hazmin fiy ruqyaai alhayyaai waqaala laasmaa'a binti 'umaysin ‏"‏ maa liy aaraa aajsaama baniy aakhiy daari'aaan tusiybuhumu alhaajaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat laa walakini al'aynu tusri'u iilayhim ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ arqiyhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat fa'aradtu 'alayhi faqaala ‏"‏ arqiyhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) granted sanction to the family of Hazm for incantation (in mitigating the effect of the poison of) the snake, and, he said -to Asma' daughter of 'Umais:What is this that I see the children of my brother lean? Are they not fed properly? She said: No, but they fall under the influence of an evil eve. He said: Use incantation She recited (the words of incantation before him), whereupon he (by approving them) said: Yes, use this incantation for them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أَرْخَصَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رُقْيَةِ الْحَيَّةِ لِبَنِي عَمْرٍو ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ وَسَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ لَدَغَتْ رَجُلاً مِنَّا عَقْرَبٌ وَنَحْنُ جُلُوسٌ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرْقِي قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَنْفَعَ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَفْعَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu aarkhasa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ruqyaai alhayyaai libaniy 'amrinw ‏.‏ qaala aabuw alzzubayri wasami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu ladaghat rajulaan minnaa 'aqrabun wanahnu juluwsun ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi aarqiy qaala ‏ "‏ mani astataa'a minkum aan yanfa'a aakhaahu falyaf'al ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) granted a special sanction for incantation in case of the snake poison to a tribe of 'Amr. Abu Zubair said:I heard Jabir b. 'Abdullah as saying that the scorpion stung one of us as we were sitting with Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him). A person said: Allah's Messenger, I use incantation (for curing the effect. of sting), whereupon he said: He who is competent amongst you to benefit his brother should do so
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ أَرْقِيهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَرْقِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy sa'iydu bnu yahyaa alaumawiyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aannahu qaala faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi aarqiyhi yaa rasuwla alllahi walam yaqul aarqiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ لِي خَالٌ يَرْقِي مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ فَنَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الرُّقَى - قَالَ - فَأَتَاهُ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الرُّقَى وَأَنَا أَرْقِي مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَنْفَعَ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَفْعَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala kaana liy khaalun yarqiy mina al'aqrabi fanahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alrruqaa - qaala - faaataahu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaka nahayta 'ani alrruqaa waaanaa aarqiy mina al'aqrabi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ mani astataa'a minkum aan yanfa'a aakhaahu falyaf'al ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported I had a maternal uncle who treated the sting of the scorpion with the help of incantation. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) forbade incantation. He came to him and said:Allah's Messenger, you forbade to practise incantation, whereas I employ it for curing the sting of the scorpion, whereupon he said: He who amongst you is capable of employing it as a means to do good should do that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaala haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الرُّقَى فَجَاءَ آلُ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَزْمٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّهُ كَانَتْ عِنْدَنَا رُقْيَةٌ نَرْقِي بِهَا مِنَ الْعَقْرَبِ وَإِنَّكَ نَهَيْتَ عَنِ الرُّقَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعَرَضُوهَا عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا أَرَى بَأْسًا مَنِ اسْتَطَاعَ مِنْكُمْ أَنْ يَنْفَعَ أَخَاهُ فَلْيَنْفَعْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala nahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alrruqaa fajaa'a alu 'amriw bni hazmin iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnahu kaanat 'indanaa ruqyaaun narqiy bihaa mina al'aqrabi waiinnaka nahayta 'ani alrruqaa ‏.‏ qaala fa'araduwhaa 'alayhi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ maa aaraa baasana mani astataa'a minkum aan yanfa'a aakhaahu falyanfa'hu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) prohibited incantation. Then the people of Amr b. Hazm came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:We know an incantation which we use for curing the sting of the scorpion but you have prohibited it. They recited (the words of incantation) before him, whereupon he said: I do not see any harm (in it), so he who amongst you is competent to do good to his brother should do that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَوْفِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيِّ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَرْقِي فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ تَرَى فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اعْرِضُوا عَلَىَّ رُقَاكُمْ لاَ بَأْسَ بِالرُّقَى مَا لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ شِرْكٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy mu'aawiyaau bnu saalihin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni jubayrin 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'awfi bni maalikin alaashja'iyyi, qaala kunnaa narqiy fiy aljaahiliyyaai faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa taraa fiy dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ a'riduwa 'alaaaa ruqaakum laa baasa bialrruqaa maa lam yakun fiyhi shirkun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Auf b. Malik Ashja'i reported We practised incantation in the pre-Islamic days and we said:Allah's Messenger. what is your opinion about it? He said: Let me know your incantation and said: There is no harm in the incantation which does not smack of polytheism
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ نَاسًا، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانُوا فى سَفَرٍ فَمَرُّوا بِحَىٍّ مِنْ أَحْيَاءِ الْعَرَبِ فَاسْتَضَافُوهُمْ فَلَمْ يُضِيفُوهُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا لَهُمْ هَلْ فِيكُمْ رَاقٍ فَإِنَّ سَيِّدَ الْحَىِّ لَدِيغٌ أَوْ مُصَابٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنْهُمْ نَعَمْ فَأَتَاهُ فَرَقَاهُ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ فَبَرَأَ الرَّجُلُ فَأُعْطِيَ قَطِيعًا مِنْ غَنَمٍ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَقْبَلَهَا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ حَتَّى أَذْكُرَ ذَلِكَ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ ذَلِكَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهِ مَا رَقَيْتُ إِلاَّ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ ‏.‏ فَتَبَسَّمَ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا أَدْرَاكَ أَنَّهَا رُقْيَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ خُذُوا مِنْهُمْ وَاضْرِبُوا لِي بِسَهْمٍ مَعَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an aabiy bishrin, 'an aabiy almutawakkili, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna naasana, min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaanuwa fa safarin famarruwa bihaaain min aahyaa'i al'arabi faastadaafuwhum falam yudiyfuwhum ‏.‏ faqaaluwa lahum hal fiykum raaqin faiinna sayyida alhaaai ladiyghun aaw musaabun ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun minhum na'am faaataahu faraqaahu bifaatihaai alkitaabi fabaraaa alrrajulu faau'tiya qatiy'ana min ghanamin faaabaa aan yaqbalahaa ‏.‏ waqaala hattaa aadhkura dhalika lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara dhalika lahu ‏.‏ faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi waalllahi maa raqaytu iilaaa bifaatihaai alkitaabi ‏.‏ fatabassama waqaala ‏"‏ wamaa aadraaka aannahaa ruqyaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ khudhuwa minhum waadribuwa liy bisahmin ma'akum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that some persons amongst the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out on a journey and they happened to pass by a tribe from the tribes of Arabia. They demanded hospitality from the members of that tribe, but they did not extend any hospitality to them. They said to them:Is there any incantator amongst you, at the chief of the tribe has bgen stung by a scorpion? A person amongst us said: 'Yes. So he came to him and he practised incan- tation with the help of Sura al-Fatiha and the person became all right. He was given a flock of sheep (as recompense), but he refused to accept that, saying: I shall make a mention of it to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and if he approves of it. then I shall accept it. So we came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him and he (that person) said: Allah's Messenger by Allah, I did not practice incantation but with the help of Sura al-Fatiha of the Holy Book. He (the Holy Prophet) smiled and said: How did you come to know that it can be used (as incactation)? - and then said: Take out of that and allocate a share for me along with your share
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ غُنْدَرٍ، مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ فَجَعَلَ يَقْرَأُ أُمَّ الْقُرْآنِ وَيَجْمَعُ بُزَاقَهُ وَيَتْفُلُ فَبَرَأَ الرَّجُلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in kilaahumaa 'an ghundarin, muhammadi bni ja'farin 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy bishrin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala fiy alhadiythi faja'ala yaqraau aumma alqurani wayajma'u buzaaqahu wayatfulu fabaraaa alrrajulu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Bishr with the same the same chain of transmitters (with these words):That he recited Umm-ul-Qur'an (Sura Fatiha), and he collected his spittle and he applied that and the person became all right
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ، مَعْبَدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ نَزَلْنَا مَنْزِلاً فَأَتَتْنَا امْرَأَةٌ فَقَالَتْ إِنَّ سَيِّدَ الْحَىِّ سَلِيمٌ لُدِغَ فَهَلْ فِيكُمْ مِنْ رَاقٍ فَقَامَ مَعَهَا رَجُلٌ مِنَّا مَا كُنَّا نَظُنُّهُ يُحْسِنُ رُقْيَةً فَرَقَاهُ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ فَبَرَأَ فَأَعْطَوْهُ غَنَمًا وَسَقَوْنَا لَبَنًا فَقُلْنَا أَكُنْتَ تُحْسِنُ رُقْيَةً فَقَالَ مَا رَقَيْتُهُ إِلاَّ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لاَ تُحَرِّكُوهَا حَتَّى نَأْتِيَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْنَا النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا كَانَ يُدْرِيهِ أَنَّهَا رُقْيَةٌ اقْسِمُوا وَاضْرِبُوا لِي بِسَهْمٍ مَعَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu hassaana, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aakhiyhi, ma'badi bni siyriyna 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala nazalnaa manzilaan faaatatnaa amraaaaun faqaalat iinna sayyida alhaaai saliymun ludigha fahal fiykum min raaqin faqaama ma'ahaa rajulun minnaa maa kunnaa nazunnuhu yuhsinu ruqyaaan faraqaahu bifaatihaai alkitaabi fabaraaa faaa'tawhu ghanamana wasaqawnaa labanana faqulnaa aakunta tuhsinu ruqyaaan faqaala maa raqaytuhu iilaaa bifaatihaai alkitaabi ‏.‏ qaala faqultu laa tuharrikuwhaa hattaa naatiya alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faaataynaa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakarnaa dhalika lahu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ maa kaana yudriyhi aannahaa ruqyaaun aqsimuwa waadribuwa liy bisahmin ma'akum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:We landed at a place where a woman came to us and said: A scorpion has bitten the chief of the tribe. Is there any incantator amongst you? A person amongst us stood up (and went with her). We had no idea that he had been a good incantator but he practiced incantation with the help of Sura al-Fatiha and the (the chief) was all right. They gave him a flock of sheep and served us milk. We said (to him): Are you a good incantator. Thereupon he said: I did not do it but by the help of Sura al-Fatiha. He said: Do not drive (these goats) until we go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and find out (whether it is permissible to accept (this reward of incantation). So we came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and made a mention of that to him, whereupon he said: How did you come to know that this (Sura al-Fatiha) could be used as an incantation? So distribute them (amongst those who had been present there with him) and allocate a share of mine also
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَقَامَ مَعَهَا رَجُلٌ مِنَّا مَا كُنَّا نَأْبِنُهُ بِرُقْيَةٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu ghayra aannahu qaala faqaama ma'ahaa rajulun minnaa maa kunnaa naabinuhu biruqyaain ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters and he said:There stood up with her a person amongst us whom we did not know before as an incantator
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعُ بْنُ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، أَنَّهُ شَكَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَعًا يَجِدُهُ فِي جَسَدِهِ مُنْذُ أَسْلَمَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى الَّذِي تَأَلَّمَ مِنْ جَسَدِكَ وَقُلْ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ وَقُلْ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy naafi'u bnu jubayri bni mut'imin, 'an 'uthmaana bni aabiy al'aasi althhaqafiyyi, aannahu shakaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waja'ana yajiduhu fiy jasadihi mundhu aaslama ‏.‏ faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ da' yadaka 'alaa alladhiy taaallama min jasadika waqul biasmi alllahi ‏.‏ thalaathana ‏.‏ waqul sab'a marraatin aa'uwdhu bialllahi waqudratihi min sharri maa aajidu waauhaadhiru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uthman b. Abu al-'As Al-Thaqafi reported that he made a complaint of pain to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he felt in his body at the time he had become Muslim. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Place your hand at the place where you feel pain in your body and say Bismillah (in the name of Allah) three times and seven times A'udhu billahi wa qudratihi min sharri ma ajidu wa uhadhiru (I seek refuge with Allah and with His Power from the evil that I find and that I fear)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ خَلَفٍ الْبَاهِلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، الْعَلاَءِ أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي الْعَاصِ، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ حَالَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ صَلاَتِي وَقِرَاءَتِي يَلْبِسُهَا عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ذَاكَ شَيْطَانٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ خِنْزِبٌ فَإِذَا أَحْسَسْتَهُ فَتَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْهُ وَاتْفِلْ عَلَى يَسَارِكَ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ فَأَذْهَبَهُ اللَّهُ عَنِّي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu khalafin albaahiliyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an sa'iydin aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy, al'alaa'i aanna 'uthmaana bna aabiy al'aasi, aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna alshhaytaana qad haala bayniy wabayna salaatiy waqiraa'atiy yalbisuhaa 'alaaaa ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ dhaaka shaytaanun yuqaalu lahu khinzibun faiidhaa aahsastahu fata'awwadh bialllahi minhu waatfil 'alaa yasaarika thalaathana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fafa'altu dhalika faaadhhabahu alllahu 'anniy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uthman b. Abu al-'As reported that he came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:Allah's Messenger, the Satan intervenes between me and my prayer and my reciting of the Qur'an and he confounds me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:, That is (the doing of a) Satan (devil) who is known as Khinzab, and when you perceive its effect, seek refuge with Allah from it and spit three times to your left. I did that and Allah dispelled that from me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ، أَنَّهُ أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِ سَالِمِ بْنِ نُوحٍ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa saalimu bnu nuwhin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kilaahumaa 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy al'alaa'i, 'an 'uthmaana bni aabiy al'aasi, aannahu aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithlihi walam yadhkur fiy hadiythi saalimi bni nuwhin thalaathana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uthman b. Abu al-'As reported that he came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he narrated like this. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Salam b. Nuh there is no mention of three times
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ أَبِي الْعَاصِ الثَّقَفِيِّ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an sa'iydin aljurayriyyi, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alshhikhhiyri, 'an 'uthmaana bni aabiy al'aasi althhaqafiyyi, qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Uthman b. Abu al-'As with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَأَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عِيسَى، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - عَنْ عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لِكُلِّ دَاءٍ دَوَاءٌ فَإِذَا أُصِيبَ دَوَاءُ الدَّاءِ بَرَأَ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, waaabuw alttaahiri, waaahmadu bnu 'iysaa, qaaluwa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - 'an 'abdi rabbihi bni sa'iydin, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ likulli daa'in dawaa'un faiidhaa ausiyba dawaa'u alddaa'i baraaa biiidhni alllahi 'azza wajalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is a remedy for every malady, and when the remedy is applied to the disease it is cured with the permission of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَأَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَاصِمَ بْنَ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَادَ الْمُقَنَّعَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لاَ أَبْرَحُ حَتَّى تَحْتَجِمَ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِيهِ شِفَاءً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, waaabuw alttaahiri, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, aanna bukayrana, haddathahu aanna 'aasima bna 'umara bni qataadaaa haddathahu aanna jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi 'aada almuqanna'a thumma qaala laa aabrahu hattaa tahtajima faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna fiyhi shifaa'an ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that he visited Muqanna' and then said:I will not go away unless you get yourself cupped, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: It is a remedy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فِي أَهْلِنَا وَرَجُلٌ يَشْتَكِي خُرَاجًا بِهِ أَوْ جِرَاحًا فَقَالَ مَا تَشْتَكِي قَالَ خُرَاجٌ بِي قَدْ شَقَّ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا غُلاَمُ ائْتِنِي بِحَجَّامٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ مَا تَصْنَعُ بِالْحَجَّامِ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُعَلِّقَ فِيهِ مِحْجَمًا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّ الذُّبَابَ لَيُصِيبُنِي أَوْ يُصِيبُنِي الثَّوْبُ فَيُؤْذِينِي وَيَشُقُّ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا رَأَى تَبَرُّمَهُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ قَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ مِنْ أَدْوِيَتِكُمْ خَيْرٌ فَفِي شَرْطَةِ مَحْجَمٍ أَوْ شَرْبَةٍ مِنْ عَسَلٍ أَوْ لَذْعَةٍ بِنَارٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَمَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أَكْتَوِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَ بِحَجَّامٍ فَشَرَطَهُ فَذَهَبَ عَنْهُ مَا يَجِدُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu sulaymaana, 'an 'aasimi bni 'umara bni qataadaaa, qaala jaa'anaa jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi fiy aahlinaa warajulun yashtakiy khuraajana bihi aaw jiraahana faqaala maa tashtakiy qaala khuraajun biy qad shaqqa 'alaaaa ‏.‏ faqaala yaa ghulaamu aitiniy bihajjaamin ‏.‏ faqaala lahu maa tasna'u bialhajjaami yaa aabaa 'abdi alllahi qaala auriydu aan au'alliqa fiyhi mihjamana ‏.‏ qaala waalllahi iinna aldhhubaaba layusiybuniy aaw yusiybuniy althhawbu fayuudhiyniy wayashuqqu 'alaaaa ‏.‏ falammaa raaaa tabarrumahu min dhalika qaala iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iin kaana fiy shaa'in min aadwiyatikum khayrun fafiy shartaai mahjamin aaw sharbaain min 'asalin aaw ladh'aain binaarin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ wamaa auhibbu aan aaktawiya ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fajaa'a bihajjaamin fasharatahu fadhahaba 'anhu maa yajidu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asim b. 'Umar b. Qatada reported:There came to our house 'Abdullah and another person from amongst the members of the household who complained of a wound. Jabir said: What ails you? He said: There is a wound which is very painful for me, whereupon he said: Boy, bring to me a cupper. He said: 'Abdullah, what do you intend to do with the cupper? I said: I would get this wound cupped. He said: By Allah. oven the touch of fly or cloth causes me pain (and cupping) would thus cause me (unbearable) pain. And when he saw him feeling pain (at the idea of cupping), he said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If there is any effective remedy amongst your remedies, these are (three): Cupping, drinking of honey and cauterisation with the help of fire. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: As for myself I do not like cauterisation. The cupper was called and he cupped him and he was all right
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ سَلَمَةَ، اسْتَأْذَنَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْحِجَامَةِ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبَا طَيْبَةَ أَنْ يَحْجُمَهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ حَسِبْتُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ أَخَاهَا مِنَ الرَّضَاعَةِ أَوْ غُلاَمًا لَمْ يَحْتَلِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna aumma salamaaa, astaadhanat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alhijaamaai faaamara alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aabaa taybaaa aan yahjumahaa ‏.‏ qaala hasibtu aannahu qaala kaana aakhaahaa mina alrradaa'aai aaw ghulaamana lam yahtalim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Umm Salama sought permission from Allah's messenger (may Allah's peace upon him) tor getting herself cupped. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) asked Abu Taiba to cup her. He (Jabir) said:I think he (Abu Taiba) was her faster brother or a young boy before entering upon the adolescent period
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ طَبِيبًا فَقَطَعَ مِنْهُ عِرْقًا ثُمَّ كَوَاهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin qaala yahyaa - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa aubaaai bni ka'bin tabiybana faqata'a minhu 'irqana thumma kawaahu 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a phystian to Ubayy b. Ka'b. He cut the vein and then cauterised it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرَا فَقَطَعَ مِنْهُ عِرْقًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrahmani, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkuraa faqata'a minhu 'irqana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'mash reported this with the same chain of transmitters and he made no mention of the fact that he cut one of his veins
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ رُمِيَ أُبَىٌّ يَوْمَ الأَحْزَابِ عَلَى أَكْحَلِهِ فَكَوَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy bishru bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - 'an shu'baaa, qaala sami'tu sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu aabaa sufyaana, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, qaala rumiya aubaaaun yawma alaahzaabi 'alaa aakhalihi fakawaahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdillah reported that on the day of Ahzab Ubayy received the wound of an arrow in his medial arm vein. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cauterised it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ رُمِيَ سَعْدُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ فِي أَكْحَلِهِ - قَالَ - فَحَسَمَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ بِمِشْقَصٍ ثُمَّ وَرِمَتْ فَحَسَمَهُ الثَّانِيَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa, bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala rumiya sa'du bnu mu'aadhin fiy aakhalihi - qaala - fahasamahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi bimishqasin thumma warimat fahasamahu althhaaniyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Sa'd b. Mu'adh received a wound of the arrow in his vein. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) cauterised it with a rod and it was swollen, to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) did it for the second time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم احْتَجَمَ وَأَعْطَى الْحَجَّامَ أَجْرَهُ وَاسْتَعَطَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu sa'iydi bni sakhrin alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa habbaanu bnu hilaalin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm ahtajama waaa'taa alhajjaama aajrahu waasta'ata ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) got himself cupped and gave to the cupper his wages and he put the medicine in the nostril
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَقَالَ، أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَامِرٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ احْتَجَمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ لاَ يَظْلِمُ أَحَدًا أَجْرَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa wakiy'un, waqaala, aabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, 'an mis'arin, 'an 'amriw bni 'aamirin alaansaariyyi, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu ahtajama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wakaana laa yazlimu aahadana aajrahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) got himself cupped and never withheld the wages of anyone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَابْرُدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa abnu sa'iydin - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alhummaa min fayhi jahannama faabruduwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The fever from the vehement raging of the (heat of Hell), so cool it with the help of water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ شِدَّةَ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَابْرُدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy wamuhammadu bnu bishrin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, wamuhammadu bnu bishrin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna shiddaaa alhummaa min fayhi jahannama faabruduwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Fever is due to vehemence of the heat of Hell, so cool it with water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُثْمَانَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَأَطْفِئُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy maalikun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu, bnu raafi'in haddathanaa abnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, - ya'niy abna 'uthmaana - kilaahumaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alhummaa min fayhi jahannama faaatfiiuwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Fever is from the vehement raging of the fire of Hell, so extinguish it with water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَأَطْفِئُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alhakami, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'umara bni muhammadi bni zaydin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alhummaa min fayhi jahannama faaatfiiuwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Fever is from the vehement Paging of the Hell-fire, so cool it with water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ فَابْرُدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alhummaa min fayhi jahannama faabruduwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Fever is from the vehement raging of the Hell-fire, so cool it with water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، وَعَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, wa'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, jamiy'ana 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ فَاطِمَةَ، عَنْ أَسْمَاءَ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تُؤْتَى بِالْمَرْأَةِ الْمَوْعُوكَةِ فَتَدْعُو بِالْمَاءِ فَتَصُبُّهُ فِي جَيْبِهَا وَتَقُولُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ ابْرُدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, 'an hishaamin, 'an faatimaaa, 'an aasmaa'a, aannahaa kaanat tuutaa bialmaraaai almaw'uwkaai fatad'uw bialmaa'i fatasubbuhu fiy jaybihaa wataquwlu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ abruduwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ iinnahaa min fayhi jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Asma' reported that a woman running high fever was brought to her. She asked water to be brought and then sprinkled it in the opening of a shirt at the uppermost part of the chest and said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said:Cool (the fever) with water. for it is because of the vehemence of the beat of Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ صَبَّتِ الْمَاءَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ جَيْبِهَا ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ ‏ "‏ أَنَّهَا مِنْ فَيْحِ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu numayrin, waaabuw ausaamaaa 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni numayrin sabbati almaa'a baynahaa wabayna jaybihaa ‏.‏ walam yadhkur fiy hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa ‏ "‏ aannahaa min fayhi jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw aahmada qaala iibraahiymu haddathanaa alhasanu bnu bishrin haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hisham reported this hadith with the same chain of transmitters. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Numair (the words are):" She poured water on her sides and in the opening of the shirt at the uppermost part of the chest." There is no mention of these words:" It is from the vehemence of the heat of the Hell." This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Usama with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَنَّادُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ، بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ جَدِّهِ، رَافِعِ بْنِ خَدِيجٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْحُمَّى فَوْرٌ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ فَابْرُدُوهَا بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hannaadu bnu alssariyyi, haddathanaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an sa'iydi bni masruwqin, 'an 'abaayaaa, bni rifaa'aaa 'an jaddihi, raafi'i bni khadiyjin qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alhummaa fawrun min jahannama faabruduwhaa bialmaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi' b. Khadij reported:I heard Allah's messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The fever is due to the intense heat of the Hell, so cool it with water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبَايَةَ بْنِ رِفَاعَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ الْحُمَّى مِنْ فَوْرِ جَهَنَّمَ فَابْرُدُوهَا عَنْكُمْ بِالْمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ عَنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in qaaluwa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abaayaaa bni rifaa'aaa, haddathaniy raafi'u bnu khadiyjin, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ alhummaa min fawri jahannama faabruduwhaa 'ankum bialmaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur aabuw bakrin ‏"‏ 'ankum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala qaala aakhbaraniy raafi'u bnu khadiyjin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi' b. Khadij reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The fever is due to the intense heat of Hell, so cool it down in your (bodies) with water. Aba Bakr has made no mention of the word" from you" ('ankum), but he said that Rafi' b. Khadij had informed him of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ أَبِي، عَائِشَةَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَدَدْنَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ فَأَشَارَ أَنْ لاَ تَلُدُّونِي ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا كَرَاهِيَةُ الْمَرِيضِ لِلدَّوَاءِ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَفَاقَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَبْقَى أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ إِلاَّ لُدَّ غَيْرُ الْعَبَّاسِ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَشْهَدْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an sufyaana, haddathaniy muwsaa bnu aabiy, 'aaiishaaa 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat ladadnaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maradihi faaashaara aan laa taludduwniy ‏.‏ faqulnaa karaahiyaau almariydi lilddawaa'i ‏.‏ falammaa aafaaqa qaala ‏ "‏ laa yabqaa aahadun minkum iilaaa ludda ghayru al'abbaasi faiinnahu lam yashhadkum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:we (intended to pour) medicine in the mouth of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in his illness, but he pointed out (with the gesture of his hand) that it should not be poured into the mouth against his will. We said: (It was perhaps due to the natural) aversion of the patient against medicine. When he recovered, he said: Medicine should be poured into the mouth of every one of you except Ibn 'Abbas, for he was not present amongst you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتِ مِحْصَنٍ، أُخْتِ عُكَّاشَةَ بْنِ مِحْصَنٍ قَالَتْ دَخَلْتُ بِابْنٍ لِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ فَبَالَ عَلَيْهِ فَدَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَرَشَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَدَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ بِابْنٍ لِي قَدْ أَعْلَقْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ عَلاَمَهْ تَدْغَرْنَ أَوْلاَدَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعِلاَقِ عَلَيْكُنَّ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ مِنْهَا ذَاتُ الْجَنْبِ يُسْعَطُ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ وَيُلَدُّ مِنْ ذَاتِ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin waabnu aabiy 'umara - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa sufyaanu, bnu 'uyaynaaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aummi qaysin binti mihsanin, aukhti 'ukkaashaaa bni mihsanin qaalat dakhaltu biabnin liy 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lam yaakuli altta'aama fabaala 'alayhi fada'aa bimaa'in farashhahu ‏.‏ qaalat wadakhaltu 'alayhi biabnin liy qad aa'laqtu 'alayhi mina al'udhraai faqaala ‏ "‏ 'alaamah tadgharna aawlaadakunna bihadhaa al'ilaaqi 'alaykunna bihadhaa al'uwdi alhindiyyi faiinna fiyhi sab'aaa aashfiyaain minhaa dhaatu aljanbi yus'atu mina al'udhraai wayuladdu min dhaati aljanbi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, the sister of 'Ukasha b. Mihsan said:I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) along with my son who had not, by that time, been weaned and he urinated over his (clothes). He ordered water to be brought and sprinkled (it) over them.
