She (further) said: I visited him (Allah's Apostle) along with my son and I had squeezed the swelling in the uvula, whereupon he said: Why do you afflict your children by compressing like this? Use this Indian aloeswood, for it contains seven types of remedies, one among them being a remedy for pleurisy. It is applied through the nose for a swelling of the uvula and poured into the side of the mouth for pleurisy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ قَيْسٍ بِنْتَ مِحْصَنٍ، - وَكَانَتْ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرَاتِ الأُوَلِ اللاَّتِي بَايَعْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ أُخْتُ عُكَّاشَةَ بْنِ مِحْصَنٍ أَحَدِ بَنِي أَسَدِ بْنِ خُزَيْمَةَ - قَالَ أَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّهَا أَتَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِابْنٍ لَهَا لَمْ يَبْلُغْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الطَّعَامَ وَقَدْ أَعْلَقَتْ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعُذْرَةِ - قَالَ يُونُسُ أَعْلَقَتْ غَمَزَتْ فَهِيَ تَخَافُ أَنْ يَكُونَ بِهِ عُذْرَةٌ - قَالَتْ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ عَلاَمَهْ تَدْغَرْنَ أَوْلاَدَكُنَّ بِهَذَا الإِعْلاَقِ عَلَيْكُمْ بِهَذَا الْعُودِ الْهِنْدِيِّ - يَعْنِي بِهِ الْكُسْتَ - فَإِنَّ فِيهِ سَبْعَةَ أَشْفِيَةٍ مِنْهَا ذَاتُ الْجَنْبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ وَأَخْبَرَتْنِي أَنَّ ابْنَهَا ذَاكَ بَالَ فِي حَجْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَاءٍ فَنَضَحَهُ عَلَى بَوْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَغْسِلْهُ غَسْلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu bnu yaziyda, aanna abna shihaabin, aakhbarahu qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, aanna aumma qaysin binta mihsanin, - wakaanat mina almuhaajiraati alauwali allaaatiy baaya'na rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya aukhtu 'ukkaashaaa bni mihsanin aahadi baniy aasadi bni khuzaymaaa - qaala aakhbaratniy aannahaa aatat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biabnin lahaa lam yablugh aan yaakula altta'aama waqad aa'laqat 'alayhi mina al'udhraai - qaala yuwnusu aa'laqat ghamazat fahiya takhaafu aan yakuwna bihi 'udhraaun - qaalat - faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ 'alaamah tadgharna aawlaadakunna bihadhaa alii'laaqi 'alaykum bihadhaa al'uwdi alhindiyyi - ya'niy bihi alkusta - faiinna fiyhi sab'aaa aashfiyaain minhaa dhaatu aljanbi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'ubaydu alllahi waaakhbaratniy aanna abnahaa dhaaka baala fiy hajri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fada'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimaa'in fanadahahu 'alaa bawlihi walam yaghsilhu ghaslaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Qais, daughter of Mihsan, was one of the earlier female emigrants who had pledged allegiance to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). She was the sister of Ukasha b. Mihsan, one of the posterity of Asad b. Khuzaima. She reported that she came to Allah's messenger (ﷺ) along with her son who had not attained the age of weaning and she had compressed the swelling of his uvula. (Yunus said:She compressed the uvula because she was afraid that there might be swelling of uvula.) Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Why do you afflict your children by compressing in this way? You should use Indian aloeswood, for it has seven remedies in it, one of them being the remedy for pleurisy. Ubaidullah reported that she had told that that was the child who had urinated in the lap of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called for water and sprinkled it on his urine, but he did not wash it well
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحِ بْنِ الْمُهَاجِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُمَا أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ شِفَاءً مِنْ كُلِّ دَاءٍ إِلاَّ السَّامَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَالسَّامُ الْمَوْتُ ‏.‏ وَالْحَبَّةُ السَّوْدَاءُ الشُّونِيزُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhi bni almuhaajiri, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, wasa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, aakhbarahumaa aannahu, sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna fiy alhabbaai alssawdaa'i shifaa'an min kulli daa'in iilaaa alssaama ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waalssaamu almawtu ‏.‏ waalhabbaau alssawdaa'u alshhuwniyzu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Nigella seed is a remedy for every disease except death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عُقَيْلٍ وَفِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ وَيُونُسَ الْحَبَّةُ السَّوْدَاءُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلِ الشُّونِيزُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni, shihaabin 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi 'uqaylin wafiy hadiythi sufyaana wayuwnusa alhabbaau alssawdaa'u ‏.‏ walam yaquli alshhuwniyzu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ دَاءٍ إِلاَّ فِي الْحَبَّةِ السَّوْدَاءِ مِنْهُ شِفَاءٌ إِلاَّ السَّامَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa min daa'in iilaaa fiy alhabbaai alssawdaa'i minhu shifaa'un iilaaa alssaama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no disease for which Nigella seed does not provide remedy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ إِذَا مَاتَ الْمَيِّتُ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا فَاجْتَمَعَ لِذَلِكَ النِّسَاءُ ثُمَّ تَفَرَّقْنَ إِلاَّ أَهْلَهَا وَخَاصَّتَهَا - أَمَرَتْ بِبُرْمَةٍ مِنْ تَلْبِينَةٍ فَطُبِخَتْ ثُمَّ صُنِعَ ثَرِيدٌ فَصُبَّتِ التَّلْبِينَةُ عَلَيْهَا ثُمَّ قَالَتْ كُلْنَ مِنْهَا فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ التَّلْبِينَةُ مَجَمَّةٌ لِفُؤَادِ الْمَرِيضِ تُذْهِبُ بَعْضَ الْحُزْنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa kaanat iidhaa maata almayyitu min aahlihaa faajtama'a lidhalika alnnisaa'u thumma tafarraqna iilaaa aahlahaa wakhaassatahaa - aamarat biburmaain min talbiynaain fatubikhat thumma suni'a thariydun fasubbati alttalbiynaau 'alayhaa thumma qaalat kulna minhaa faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alttalbiynaau majammaaun lifuuaadi almariydi tudhhibu ba'da alhuzni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:When there was any bereavement in her family the women gathered there for condolence and they departed except the members of the family and some selected persons. She asked to prepare talbina in a small couldron and it was cooked and then tharid was prepared and it was poured over talbina, then she said: Eat it, for I heard Allah's Messenger (may peade be upon him) as saying: Talbina gives comfort to the aggrieved heart and it lessens grief
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَخِي اسْتَطْلَقَ بَطْنُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَقَاهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَهُ فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقَيْت��هُ عَسَلاً فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُ إِلاَّ اسْتِطْلاَقًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ثُمَّ جَاءَ الرَّابِعَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَقَدْ سَقَيْتُهُ فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُ إِلاَّ اسْتِطْلاَقًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ صَدَقَ اللَّهُ وَكَذَبَ بَطْنُ أَخِيكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَقَاهُ فَبَرَأَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy almutawakkili, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinna aakhiy astatlaqa batnuhu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ asqihi 'asalaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasaqaahu thumma jaa'ahu faqaala iinniy saqayt��hu 'asalaan falam yazidhu iilaaa astitlaaqana ‏.‏ faqaala lahu thalaatha marraatin thumma jaa'a alrraabi'aaa faqaala ‏"‏ asqihi 'asalaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala laqad saqaytuhu falam yazidhu iilaaa astitlaaqana ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ sadaqa alllahu wakadhaba batnu aakhiyka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasaqaahu fabaraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and told him that his brother's bowels were loose. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Give him honey. So he gave him that and then came and said: I gave him honey but it has only made his bowels more loose. He said this three times; and then he came the fourth time, and he (the Holy Prophet) said: Give him honey. He said: I did give him, but it has only made his bowels more loose, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah has spoken the truth and your brother's bowels are in the wrong. So he made him drink (honey) and he was recovered
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَطَاءٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُتَوَكِّلِ النَّاجِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنَّ أَخِي عَرِبَ بَطْنُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ ‏ "‏ اسْقِهِ عَسَلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - ya'niy abna 'ataa'in - 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy almutawakkili alnnaajiyyi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rajulaan, aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala iinna aakhiy 'ariba batnuhu ‏.‏ faqaala lahu ‏ "‏ asqihi 'asalaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi shu'baaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، وَأَبِي النَّضْرِ، مَوْلَى عُمَرَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَسْأَلُ، أُسَامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ مَاذَا سَمِعْتَ مِنْ، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الطَّاعُونِ فَقَالَ أُسَامَةُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الطَّاعُونُ رِجْزٌ أَوْ عَذَابٌ أُرْسِلَ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَوْ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ فَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِهِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَقْدَمُوا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا فِرَارًا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو النَّضْرِ ‏"‏ لاَ يُخْرِجُكُمْ إِلاَّ فِرَارٌ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, waaabiy alnnadri, mawlaa 'umara bni 'ubaydi alllahi 'an 'aamiri bni sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'ahu yasaalu, ausaamaaa bna zaydin maadhaa sami'ta min, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alttaa'uwni faqaala ausaamaau qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alttaa'uwnu rijzun aaw 'adhaabun aursila 'alaa baniy iisraaiiyla aaw 'alaa man kaana qablakum faiidhaa sami'tum bihi biaardin falaa taqdamuwa 'alayhi waiidhaa waqa'a biaardin waaantum bihaa falaa takhrujuwa firaarana minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw alnnadri ‏"‏ laa yukhrijukum iilaaa firaarun minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported on the authority of his father that he asked Usama b. Zaid:What have you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about plague? Thereupon Usama said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Plague is a calamity which was sent to Bani Isra'il or upon those who were before you. So when you hear that it has broken out in a land, don't go to it, and when it has broken out in the land where you are, don't run out of it. In the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Nadr there is a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - وَنَسَبَهُ ابْنُ قَعْنَبٍ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقُرَشِيُّ - عَنْ أَبِي النَّضْرِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ، بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الطَّاعُونُ آيَةُ الرِّجْزِ ابْتَلَى اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ بِهِ نَاسًا مِنْ عِبَادِهِ فَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِهِ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلاَ تَفِرُّوا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ هَذَا حَدِيثُ الْقَعْنَبِيِّ وَقُتَيْبَةَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa almughiyraau, - wanasabahu abnu qa'nabin faqaala abnu 'abdi alrrahmani alqurashiyyu - 'an aabiy alnnadri, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'di, bni aabiy waqqaasin 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alttaa'uwnu ayaau alrrijzi abtalaa alllahu 'azza wajalla bihi naasana min 'ibaadihi faiidhaa sami'tum bihi falaa tadkhuluwa 'alayhi waiidhaa waqa'a biaardin waaantum bihaa falaa tafirruwa minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ hadhaa hadiythu alqa'nabiyyi waqutaybaaa nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said:Plague is the sign of a calamity with which Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, affects people from His servants. So when you hear about it, don't enter there (where it has broken out), and when it has broken out in a land and you are there, then don't run away from it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذَا الطَّاعُونَ رِجْزٌ سُلِّطَ عَلَى مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ أَوْ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا فِرَارًا مِنْهُ وَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din, 'an ausaamaaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna hadhaa alttaa'uwna rijzun sullita 'alaa man kaana qablakum aaw 'alaa baniy iisraaiiyla faiidhaa kaana biaardin falaa takhrujuwa minhaa firaarana minhu waiidhaa kaana biaardin falaa tadkhuluwhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Plague is a calamity which was inflicted on those who were before you, or upon Bani Isra'il. So when it has broken out in a land, don't run out of it, and when it has spread in a land, then don't enter it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو، بْنُ دِينَارٍ أَنَّ عَامِرَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً سَأَلَ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَنِ الطَّاعُونِ، فَقَالَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ أَنَا أُخْبِرُكَ عَنْهُ، قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ هُوَ عَذَابٌ أَوْ رِجْزٌ أَرْسَلَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى طَائِفَةٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ أَوْ نَاسٍ كَانُوا قَبْلَكُمْ فَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِهِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوهَا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا دَخَلَهَا عَلَيْكُمْ فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا فِرَارًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw, bnu diynaarin aanna 'aamira bna sa'din, aakhbarahu aanna rajulaan saaala sa'da bna aabiy waqqaasin 'ani alttaa'uwni, faqaala ausaamaau bnu zaydin aanaa aukhbiruka 'anhu, qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ huwa 'adhaabun aaw rijzun aarsalahu alllahu 'alaa taaiifaain min baniy iisraaiiyla aaw naasin kaanuwa qablakum faiidhaa sami'tum bihi biaardin falaa tadkhuluwhaa 'alayhi waiidhaa dakhalahaa 'alaykum falaa takhrujuwa minhaa firaarana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd reported that a person asked Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas about the plague, whereupon Usama b. Zaid said:I would inform you about it. The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) said: It is a calamity or a disease which Allah sent to a group of Bani Isra'il, or to the people who were before you; so when you hear of it in land, don't enter it and when it has broken out in your land, don't run away from it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ، دِينَارٍ بِإِسْنَادِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i, sulaymaanu bnu daawuda waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, wahuwa abnu zaydin h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, kilaahumaa 'an 'amriw bni, diynaarin biiisnaadi abni jurayjin nahwa hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ هَذَا الْوَجَعَ أَوِ السَّقَمَ رِجْزٌ عُذِّبَ بِهِ بَعْضُ الأُمَمِ قَبْلَكُمْ ثُمَّ بَقِيَ بَعْدُ بِالأَرْضِ فَيَذْهَبُ الْمَرَّةَ وَيَأْتِي الأُخْرَى فَمَنْ سَمِعَ بِهِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ يَقْدَمَنَّ عَلَيْهِ وَمَنْ وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَهُوَ بِهَا فَلاَ يُخْرِجَنَّهُ الْفِرَارُ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amrinw waharmalaau bnu yahyaa qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'aamiru bnu sa'din, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iinna hadhaa alwaja'a aawi alssaqama rijzun 'udhhiba bihi ba'du alaumami qablakum thumma baqiya ba'du bialaardi fayadhhabu almarraaa wayaatiy alaukhraa faman sami'a bihi biaardin falaa yaqdamanna 'alayhi waman waqa'a biaardin wahuwa bihaa falaa yukhrijannahu alfiraaru minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said this:This calamity or illness was a punishment with which were punished some of the nations before you. Then it was left upon the earth. It goes away once and comes back again. He who heard of its presence in a land should not go towards it, and he who happened to be in a land where it had broken out should not fly from it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ يُونُسَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin - haddathanaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, biiisnaadi yuwnusa nahwa hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَبَلَغَنِي أَنَّ الطَّاعُونَ قَدْ وَقَعَ بِالْكُوفَةِ فَقَالَ لِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ وَغَيْرُهُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا كُنْتَ بِأَرْضٍ فَوَقَعَ بِهَا فَلاَ تَخْرُجْ مِنْهَا وَإِذَا بَلَغَكَ أَنَّهُ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَدْخُلْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ عَمَّنْ قَالُوا عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ يُحَدِّثُ بِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُهُ فَقَالُوا غَائِبٌ - قَالَ - فَلَقِيتُ أَخَاهُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ فَسَأَلْتُهُ فَقَالَ شَهِدْتُ أُسَامَةَ يُحَدِّثُ سَعْدًا قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذَا الْوَجَعَ رِجْزٌ أَوْ عَذَابٌ أَوْ بَقِيَّةُ عَذَابٍ عُذِّبَ بِهِ أُنَاسٌ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ فَإِذَا كَانَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا مِنْهَا وَإِذَا بَلَغَكُمْ أَنَّهُ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَدْخُلُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حَبِيبٌ فَقُلْتُ لإِبْرَاهِيمَ آنْتَ سَمِعْتَ أُسَامَةَ يُحَدِّثُ سَعْدًا وَهُوَ لاَ يُنْكِرُ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an habiybin, qaala kunnaa bialmadiynaai fabalaghaniy aanna alttaa'uwna qad waqa'a bialkuwfaai faqaala liy 'ataa'u bnu yasaarin waghayruhu iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa kunta biaardin fawaqa'a bihaa falaa takhruj minhaa waiidhaa balaghaka aannahu biaardin falaa tadkhulhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu 'amman qaaluwa 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din yuhaddithu bihi ‏.‏ qaala faaataytuhu faqaaluwa ghaaiibun - qaala - falaqiytu aakhaahu iibraahiyma bna sa'din fasaaaltuhu faqaala shahidtu ausaamaaa yuhaddithu sa'dana qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iinna hadhaa alwaja'a rijzun aaw 'adhaabun aaw baqiyyaau 'adhaabin 'udhhiba bihi aunaasun min qablikum faiidhaa kaana biaardin waaantum bihaa falaa takhrujuwa minhaa waiidhaa balaghakum aannahu biaardin falaa tadkhuluwhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala habiybun faqultu liibraahiyma anta sami'ta ausaamaaa yuhaddithu sa'dana wahuwa laa yunkiru qaala na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shu'ba reported from Habib:While we were in Medina we heard of plague having broken out in Kufa. 'Ata b. Yasir and others said to me that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said. If you are in a land where it (this scourge) has broken out, don't get out of it, and if you were to know that it had broken (in another land, then don't enter it. I said to him: From whom (did you hear it)? They said: 'Amir b. Sa'd has narrated it. So I came to him. They said that he was not present there. So I met his brother Ibrahim b. Sa'd and asked him. He said: I bear testimony to the fact that Usama narrated it to Sa'd saying: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that it is a God-sent punishment from the calamity or from the remnant of the calamity with which people were afflicted before you. So when it is in a land and you are there, don't get out of it, and if (this news reaches you) that it has broken out in a land, then don't enter therein. Habib said: I said to Ibrahim: Did you hear Usama narrating it to Sa'd and he was not denying it. He said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ قِصَّةَ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ فِي أَوَّلِ الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu lam yadhkur qissaaa 'ataa'i bni yasaarin fiy aawwali alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters except for the fact that no mention has been made of the account of 'Ata b. Yasir as in the previous hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، وَخُزَيْمَةَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، وَأُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالُوا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an habiybin, 'an iibraahiyma, bni sa'din 'an sa'di bni maalikin, wakhuzaymaaa bni thaabitin, waausaamaaa bni zaydin, qaaluwa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi shu'baaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Sa'd b. Malik, Khuzaima b. Thabit and Usama b. Zaid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ كَانَ أُسَامَةُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ وَسَعْدٌ جَالِسَيْنِ يَتَحَدَّثَانِ فَقَالاَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, kilaahumaa 'an jariyrin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an habiybin, 'an iibraahiyma bni sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, qaala kaana ausaamaau bnu zaydin wasa'dun jaalisayni yatahaddathaani faqaalaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Abu Waqqas reported:Usama b. Zaid and Sa'd had been sitting and they had been conversing and they said this hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ وَهْبُ بْنُ بَقِيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي الطَّحَّانَ - عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ حَبِيبِ، بْنِ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi wahbu bnu baqiyyaaa, aakhbaranaa khaalidun, - ya'niy alttahhaana - 'ani alshhaybaaniyyi, 'an habiybi, bni aabiy thaabitin 'an iibraahiyma bni sa'di bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Ibrahim b. Sa'd b. Malik on the authority of his father
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الْحَمِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، خَرَجَ إِلَى الشَّامِ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ بِسَرْغَ لَقِيَهُ أَهْلُ الأَجْنَادِ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ وَأَصْحَابُهُ فَأَخْبَرُوهُ أَنَّ الْوَبَاءَ قَدْ وَقَعَ بِالشَّامِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ادْعُ لِيَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ الأَوَّلِينَ ‏.‏ فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ فَاسْتَشَارَهُمْ وَأَخْبَرَهُمْ أَنَّ الْوَبَاءَ قَدْ وَقَعَ بِالشَّامِ فَاخْتَلَفُوا فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ قَدْ خَرَجْتَ لأَمْرٍ وَلاَ نَرَى أَنْ تَرْجِعَ عَنْهُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ مَعَكَ بَقِيَّةُ النَّاسِ وَأَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلاَ نَرَى أَنْ تُقْدِمَهُمْ عَلَى هَذَا الْوَبَاءِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ارْتَفِعُوا عَنِّي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ادْعُ لِيَ الأَنْصَارَ فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ لَهُ فَاسْتَشَارَهُمْ فَسَلَكُوا سَبِيلَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَاخْتَلَفُوا كَاخْتِلاَفِهِمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ارْتَفِعُوا عَنِّي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ادْعُ لِي مَنْ كَانَ هَا هُنَا مِنْ مَشْيَخَةِ قُرَيْشٍ مِنْ مُهَاجِرَةِ الْفَتْحِ ‏.‏ فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ فَلَمْ يَخْتَلِفْ عَلَيْهِ رَجُلاَنِ فَقَالُوا نَرَى أَنْ تَرْجِعَ بِالنَّاسِ وَلاَ تُقْدِمْهُمْ عَلَى هَذَا الْوَبَاءِ ‏.‏ فَنَادَى عُمَرُ فِي النَّاسِ إِنِّي مُصْبِحٌ عَلَى ظَهْرٍ فَأَصْبِحُوا عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدَةَ بْنُ الْجَرَّاحِ أَفِرَارًا مِنْ قَدَرِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لَوْ غَيْرُكَ قَالَهَا يَا أَبَا عُبَيْدَةَ - وَكَانَ عُمَرُ يَكْرَهُ خِلاَفَهُ - نَعَمْ نَفِرُّ مِنْ قَدَرِ اللَّهِ إِلَى قَدَرِ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَتْ لَكَ إِبِلٌ فَهَبَطْتَ وَادِيًا لَهُ عِدْوَتَانِ إِحْدَاهُمَا خَصْبَةٌ وَالأُخْرَى جَدْبَةٌ أَلَيْسَ إِنْ رَعَيْتَ الْخَصْبَةَ رَعَيْتَهَا بِقَدَرِ اللَّهِ وَإِنْ رَعَيْتَ الْجَدْبَةَ رَعَيْتَهَا بِقَدَرِ اللَّهِ قَالَ فَجَاءَ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ وَكَانَ مُتَغَيِّبًا فِي بَعْضِ حَاجَتِهِ فَقَالَ إِنَّ عِنْدِي مِنْ هَذَا عِلْمًا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِهِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَقْدَمُوا عَلَيْهِ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا فِرَارًا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi, alhamiydi bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni zaydi bni alkhattaabi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi bni nawfalin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abbaasin, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, kharaja iilaa alshhaami hattaa iidhaa kaana bisargha laqiyahu aahlu alaajnaadi aabuw 'ubaydaaa bnu aljarraahi waaashaabuhu faaakhbaruwhu aanna alwabaa'a qad waqa'a bialshhaami ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'abbaasin faqaala 'umaru ad'u liya almuhaajiriyna alaawwaliyna ‏.‏ fada'awtuhum faastashaarahum waaakhbarahum aanna alwabaa'a qad waqa'a bialshhaami faakhtalafuwa faqaala ba'duhum qad kharajta laamrin walaa naraa aan tarji'a 'anhu ‏.‏ waqaala ba'duhum ma'aka baqiyyaau alnnaasi waaashaabu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaa naraa aan tuqdimahum 'alaa hadhaa alwabaa'i ‏.‏ faqaala artafi'uwa 'anniy ‏.‏ thumma qaala ad'u liya alaansaara fada'awtuhum lahu faastashaarahum fasalakuwa sabiyla almuhaajiriyna waakhtalafuwa kaakhtilaafihim ‏.‏ faqaala artafi'uwa 'anniy ‏.‏ thumma qaala ad'u liy man kaana haa hunaa min mashyakhaai qurayshin min muhaajiraai alfathi ‏.‏ fada'awtuhum falam yakhtalif 'alayhi rajulaani faqaaluwa naraa aan tarji'a bialnnaasi walaa tuqdimhum 'alaa hadhaa alwabaa'i ‏.‏ fanaadaa 'umaru fiy alnnaasi iinniy musbihun 'alaa zahrin faaasbihuwa 'alayhi ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw 'ubaydaaa bnu aljarraahi aafiraarana min qadari alllahi faqaala 'umaru law ghayruka qaalahaa yaa aabaa 'ubaydaaa - wakaana 'umaru yakrahu khilaafahu - na'am nafirru min qadari alllahi iilaa qadari alllahi aaraaayta law kaanat laka iibilun fahabatta waadiyana lahu 'idwataani iihdaahumaa khasbaaun waalaukhraa jadbaaun aalaysa iin ra'ayta alkhasbaaa ra'aytahaa biqadari alllahi waiin ra'ayta aljadbaaa ra'aytahaa biqadari alllahi qaala fajaa'a 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin wakaana mutaghayyibana fiy ba'di haajatihi faqaala iinna 'indiy min hadhaa 'ilmana sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa sami'tum bihi biaardin falaa taqdamuwa 'alayhi waiidhaa waqa'a biaardin waaantum bihaa falaa takhrujuwa firaarana minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fahamida alllaha 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi thumma ansarafa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Abbas reported:Umar b. Khattab set out for Syria. As he came at Sargh (a town by the side of Hijaz on the way to Syria), there met him the commander of the forces, Abu Ubaida b. Jandb, and his companions. They informed him that a scourge had broken out in Syria. Ibn 'Abbas further reported that 'Umar said: Call to me tile earliest emigrants. So I called them. He (Hadrat 'Umar) sought their advice, and they told him that the scourge had broker, out in Syria. There was a difference of opinion (whether they should proceed further or go back to their homes in such a situation). Some of them said: You ('Umar) have set forth for a task, and, therefore, we would not advise you to go back, whereas some of them said: You have along with you the remnants (of the sacred galaxy) of men and (the blessed) Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so we would not advise you to go forth towards this calamity (with such eminent persons and thus expose them deliberately to a danger). He (Hadrat 'Umar) said: You can now go away. He said: Call to me the Ansar. So I called them to him, and he consulted them, and they trod the same path as was trodden by the Muhajirin, and they differed in their opinions as they had differed. He said: Now, you can go. He again said: Call to me the old persons of the Quraish who had migrated before the Victory (that is the Victory of Mecca), so I called them (and Hadrat 'Umar consulted them) and not even two persons differed (from the opinion held by the earlier delegates). They said: Our opinion is that you better go back along with the people and do not make them go to this scourge, So 'Umar made announcement to the people: In the morning I would be on the back of my side. So they (set forth in the morning), whereupon Abu 'Ubaida b. Jarrah said: Are you going to run away from the Divine Decree? Thereupon 'Umar said: Had it been someone else to say this besides you! 'Umar (in fact) did not approve of his opposing (this decision) and he said: Yes, we are running from the Divine Decree (to the) Divine Decree. You should think if there had been camels for you and you happened to get down in a valley having two sides, one of them covered with verdure and the other being barren, would you not (be doing) according to the Divine Decree if you graze them in verdure? And in case you graze them in the barren land (even then you would be grazing them) according to the Divine Decree. There happened to come 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf and he had been absent in connection with some of his needs. He said: I have with me a knowledge of it, that I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If you hear of its presence (the presence of plague) in a land, don't enter it, but if it spreads in the land where you are, don't fly from it. Thereupon 'Umar b. Khattab praised Allah and then went back?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ قَالَ وَقَالَ لَهُ أَيْضًا أَرَأَيْتَ أَنَّهُ لَوْ رَعَى الْجَدْبَةَ وَتَرَكَ الْخَصْبَةَ أَكُنْتَ مُعَجِّزَهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسِرْ إِذًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَارَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَدِينَةَ فَقَالَ هَذَا الْمَحِلُّ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ هَذَا الْمَنْزِلُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala abnu raafi'in haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi maalikin wazaada fiy hadiythi ma'marin qaala waqaala lahu aaydana aaraaayta aannahu law ra'aa aljadbaaa wataraka alkhasbaaa aakunta mu'ajjizahu qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala fasir iidhana ‏.‏ qaala fasaara hattaa aataa almadiynaaa faqaala hadhaa almahillu ‏.‏ aaw qaala hadhaa almanzilu iin shaa'a alllahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ma'mar with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition:" Do you think that he would graze in the barren land but would abandon the green land? Would you not attribute it to be a failing on his part? He said: Yes. He said: Then proceed. And he moved on until he came to Medina. And he said to me: This is the right place, or he said: That is the destination if Allah so wills
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ حَدَّثَهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala iinna 'abda alllahi bna alhaarithi haddathahu ‏.‏ walam yaqul 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Harith with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، عَامِرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ أَنَّ عُمَرَ، خَرَجَ إِلَى الشَّامِ فَلَمَّا جَاءَ سَرْغَ بَلَغَهُ أَنَّ الْوَبَاءَ قَدْ وَقَعَ بِالشَّامِ ‏.‏ فَأَخْبَرَهُ عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ عَوْفٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ بِهِ بِأَرْضٍ فَلاَ تَقْدَمُوا عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ بِأَرْضٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِهَا فَلاَ تَخْرُجُوا فِرَارًا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ مِنْ سَرْغَ ‏.‏ وَعَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ أَنَّ عُمَرَ إِنَّمَا انْصَرَفَ بِالنَّاسِ مِنْ حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, 'aamiri bni rabiy'aaa aanna 'umara, kharaja iilaa alshhaami falammaa jaa'a sargha balaghahu aanna alwabaa'a qad waqa'a bialshhaami ‏.‏ faaakhbarahu 'abdu alrrahmani bnu 'awfin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa sami'tum bihi biaardin falaa taqdamuwa 'alayhi ‏.‏ waiidhaa waqa'a biaardin waaantum bihaa falaa takhrujuwa firaarana minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faraja'a 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi min sargha ‏.‏ wa'ani abni shihaabin 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi aanna 'umara iinnamaa ansarafa bialnnaasi min hadiythi 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Rabi'ah reported:'Umar went to Syria and as he came to Sargh, information was given to him that an epidemic had broken out in Syria. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf narrated to him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said: When you hear of its presence in a land, don't move towards it, and when it breaks out in a land and you are therein, then don't run away from it. So 'Umar b. Khattab came back from Sargh. Salim b. 'Abdullah reported that 'Umar went back, along with people on hearing the hadith reported on the authority of 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي الطَّاهِرِ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ فَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ حِينَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ صَفَرَ وَلاَ هَامَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَمَا بَالُ الإِبِلِ تَكُونُ فِي الرَّمْلِ كَأَنَّهَا الظِّبَاءُ فَيَجِيءُ الْبَعِيرُ الأَجْرَبُ فَيَدْخُلُ فِيهَا فَيُجْرِبُهَا كُلَّهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَنْ أَعْدَى الأَوَّلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, - waalllafzu laabiy alttaahiri - qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, qaala abnu shihaabin fahaddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa hiyna qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa walaa safara walaa haamaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aa'raabiyyun yaa rasuwla alllahi famaa baalu aliibili takuwnu fiy alrramli kaaannahaa alzzibaa'u fayajiy'u alba'iyru alaajrabu fayadkhulu fiyhaa fayujribuhaa kullahaa qaala ‏"‏ faman aa'daa alaawwala ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no infection, no safar, no hama. A desert Arab said: Allah's Messenger, how is it that when the camel is in the sand it is like a deer-then a camel afflicted with scab mixes with it and it is affected by sub? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Who infected the first one? Note: The majority of scholars interpret this to mean that these things in and of themselves do not transmit or cause harm through supernatural or hidden means but that Allah is ultimately in control and any fearful superstition around these is false
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَغَيْرُهُ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ طِيَرَةَ وَلاَ صَفَرَ وَلاَ هَامَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, wahasanun alhulwaaniyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, waghayruhu, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa 'adwaa walaa tiyaraaa walaa safara walaa haamaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aa'raabiyyun yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no evil omen, no safar, no hama. A desert Arab said: Allah's, Messenger.... The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي سِنَانُ بْنُ أَبِي سِنَانٍ الدُّؤَلِيُّ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَصَالِحٍ ‏.‏ وَعَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي السَّائِبُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ ابْنُ أُخْتِ نَمِرٍ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ صَفَرَ وَلاَ هَامَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, 'an shu'aybin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy sinaanu bnu aabiy sinaanin aldduualiyyu, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama aa'raabiyyun ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa wasaalihin ‏.‏ wa'an shu'aybin 'ani alzzuhriyyi qaala haddathaniy alssaaiibu bnu yaziyda abnu aukhti namirin aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa walaa safara walaa haamaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no trahsitive disease. Thereupon a desert Arab stood up. The rest of the hadith is the same and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zuhri' the Prophet (ﷺ) is reported to have said: There is no transitive disease, no safar, no hama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَيُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يُورِدُ مُمْرِضٌ عَلَى مُصِحٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ كَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُهُمَا كِلْتَيْهِمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ صَمَتَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ عَنْ قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَقَامَ عَلَى ‏"‏ أَنْ لاَ يُورِدُ مُمْرِضٌ عَلَى مُصِحٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ أَبِي ذُبَابٍ - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمِّ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ - قَدْ كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُكَ يَا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ تُحَدِّثَنَا مَعَ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ حَدِيثًا آخَرَ قَدْ سَكَتَّ عَنْهُ كُنْتَ تَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَبَى أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَنْ يَعْرِفَ ذَلِكَ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يُورِدُ مُمْرِضٌ عَلَى مُصِحٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَمَا رَآهُ الْحَارِثُ فِي ذَلِكَ حَتَّى غَضِبَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَرَطَنَ بِالْحَبَشِيَّةِ فَقَالَ لِلْحَارِثِ أَتَدْرِي مَاذَا قُلْتُ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَبَيْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَلَمَةَ وَلَعَمْرِي لَقَدْ كَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَنَسِيَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَوْ نَسَخَ أَحَدُ الْقَوْلَيْنِ الآخَرَ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau, - wataqaarabaa fiy alllafzi - qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna aabaa salamaaa bna 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, haddathahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wayuhaddithu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa yuwridu mumridun 'alaa musihhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw salamaaa kaana aabuw hurayraaa yuhaddithuhumaa kiltayhimaa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma samata aabuw hurayraaa ba'da dhalika 'an qawlihi ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaaqaama 'alaa ‏"‏ aan laa yuwridu mumridun 'alaa musihhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala alhaarithu bnu aabiy dhubaabin - wahuwa abnu 'ammi aabiy hurayraaa - qad kuntu aasma'uka yaa aabaa hurayraaa tuhaddithanaa ma'a hadhaa alhadiythi hadiythana akhara qad sakatta 'anhu kunta taquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaabaa aabuw hurayraaa aan ya'rifa dhalika waqaala ‏"‏ laa yuwridu mumridun 'alaa musihhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ famaa raahu alhaarithu fiy dhalika hattaa ghadiba aabuw hurayraaa faratana bialhabashiyyaai faqaala lilhaarithi aatadriy maadhaa qultu qaala laa ‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa ‏.‏ qultu aabaytu ‏.‏ qaala aabuw salamaaa wala'amriy laqad kaana aabuw hurayraaa yuhaddithunaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falaa aadriy aanasiya aabuw hurayraaa aaw nasakha aahadu alqawlayni alakhara
verses.translation: Abu Salama h. 'Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, but he is also reported to have said: A sick person should not be taken to one who is healthy. Abu Salama said that Abu Huraira used to narrate these two (different ahadith) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), but afterwards Abu Huraira became silent on these words:" There is no transitive disease," but he stuck to this that the sick person should not be taken to one who is healthy. Harith b. Abu Dhubab (and he was the first cousin of Abu Huraira) said: Abu Huraira, I used to hear from you that you narrated to us along with this hadith and the other one also (there is no transitive disease), but now you observe silence about it. You used to say that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is no transitive disease. Abu Huraira denied having any knowledge of that, but he said that the sick camel should not be taken to the healthy one. Harith, however, did not agree with him, which irritated Abu Huraira and he said to him some words in the Abyssinian language. He said to Harith: Do you know what I said to you? He said: No. Abu Huraira said: I simply denied having said it. Abu Salama sad: By my life, Abu Huraira in fact used to report Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said: There is no transitive disease. I do not know whether Abu Huraira has forgotten it or he deemed it an abrogated statement in the light of the other one
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ حَدَّثَنِي وَقَالَ، الآخَرَانِ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَيُحَدِّثُ مَعَ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ لاَ يُورِدُ الْمُمْرِضُ عَلَى الْمُصِحِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, wahasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun haddathaniy waqaala, alakharaani haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'nuwna abna iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni, shihaabin aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aannahu sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yuhaddithu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wayuhaddithu ma'a dhalika ‏"‏ laa yuwridu almumridu 'alaa almusihhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease and he also reported along with it: The ill should not be taken to the healthy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, haddathanaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ هَامَةَ وَلاَ نَوْءَ وَلاَ صَفَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa 'adwaa walaa haamaaa walaa naw'a walaa safara ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no huma, no star promising rain, no safar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ طِيَرَةَ وَلاَ غُولَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa 'adwaa walaa tiyaraaa walaa ghuwla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allal's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no ill omen, no ghoul. Note: The majority of scholars interpret this to mean that these things in and of themselves do not transmit or cause harm through supernatural or hidden means but that Allah is ultimately in control and any fearful superstition around these is false
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمِ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - وَهُوَ التُّسْتَرِيُّ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ غُولَ وَلاَ صَفَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu haashimi bni hayyaana, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa yaziydu, - wahuwa alttustariyyu - haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa 'adwaa walaa ghuwla walaa safara ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no ghoul, no safar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ صَفَرَ وَلاَ غُولَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَمِعْتُ أَبَا الزُّبَيْرِ يَذْكُرُ أَنَّ جَابِرًا فَسَّرَ لَهُمْ قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ وَلاَ صَفَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ الصَّفَرُ الْبَطْنُ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ لِجَابِرٍ كَيْفَ قَالَ كَانَ يُقَالُ دَوَابُّ الْبَطْنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَلَمْ يُفَسِّرِ الْغُولَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ هَذِهِ الْغُولُ الَّتِي تَغَوَّلُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa walaa safara walaa ghuwla ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasami'tu aabaa alzzubayri yadhkuru aanna jaabirana fassara lahum qawlahu ‏"‏ walaa safara ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw alzzubayri alssafaru albatnu ‏.‏ faqiyla lijaabirin kayfa qaala kaana yuqaalu dawaabbu albatni ‏.‏ qaala walam yufassiri alghuwla ‏.‏ qaala aabuw alzzubayri hadhihi alghuwlu allatiy taghawwalu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no safar, no ghoul. He (the narrator) said: I heard Abu Zubair say: Jabir explained for them the word safar. Abu Zubair said: safar means belly. It was said to Jabir: Why is it so? He said that it was held that safar implied the worms of the belly, but he gave no explanation of ghoul. Abu Zubair said: Ghoul is that which kills the travellers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ طِيَرَةَ وَخَيْرُهَا الْفَأْلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا الْفَأْلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْكَلِمَةُ الصَّالِحَةُ يَسْمَعُهَا أَحَدُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa tiyaraaa wakhayruhaa alfaalu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi wamaa alfaalu qaala ‏"‏ alkalimaau alssaalihaau yasma'uhaa aahadukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is no divination but the best type is the good omen. It was said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): What is good omen? Thereupon he said: A good word which one of you hears
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عُقَيْلٍ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ سَمِعْتُ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَمَا قَالَ مَعْمَرٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu, khaalidin h wahaddathaniyhi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'uqaylin 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ walam yaqul sami'tu ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi shu'aybin qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kamaa qaala ma'marun ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ طِيَرَةَ وَيُعْجِبُنِي الْفَأْلُ الْكَلِمَةُ الْحَسَنَةُ الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamu bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa 'adwaa walaa tiyaraaa wayu'jibuniy alfaalu alkalimaau alhasanaau alkalimaau alttayyibaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no divination, but good omen pleases me, i. e. the good word or a good word. Note: The majority of scholars interpret this to mean that these things in and of themselves do not transmit or cause harm through supernatural or hidden means but that Allah is ultimately in control and any fearful superstition around these is false
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ طِيَرَةَ وَيُعْجِبُنِي الْفَأْلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قِيلَ وَمَا الْفَأْلُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa 'adwaa walaa tiyaraaa wayu'jibuniy alfaalu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qiyla wamaa alfaalu qaala ‏"‏ alkalimaau alttayyibaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no divination, but good omen pleases me. It was said: What is good omen? He said: Sacred words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُخْتَارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ عَتِيقٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ طِيَرَةَ وَأُحِبُّ الْفَأْلَ الصَّالِحَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathaniy mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu mukhtaarin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu 'atiyqin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa 'adwaa walaa tiyaraaa waauhibbu alfaala alssaaliha ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no divination, but I like good words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ حَسَّانٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ هَامَةَ وَلاَ طِيَرَةَ وَأُحِبُّ الْفَأْلَ الصَّالِحَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hishaamu bnu hassaanin, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa 'adwaa walaa haamaaa walaa tiyaraaa waauhibbu alfaala alssaaliha ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no hama, no divination, but I like good omen
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ يَحْيَى قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ، وَسَالِمٍ، ابْنَىْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الشُّؤْمُ فِي الدَّارِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَالْفَرَسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa maaliku bnu aanasin, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa, bnu yahyaa qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an hamzaaa, wasaalimin, abnaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alshhuumu fiy alddaari waalmaraaai waalfarasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If there be bad luck, it is in the house, and the wife, and the horse
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ، وَسَالِمٍ، ابْنَىْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ عَدْوَى وَلاَ طِيَرَةَ وَإِنَّمَا الشُّؤْمُ فِي ثَلاَثَةٍ الْمَرْأَةِ وَالْفَرَسِ وَالدَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an hamzaaa, wasaalimin, abnaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa 'adwaa walaa tiyaraaa waiinnamaa alshhuumu fiy thalaathaain almaraaai waalfarasi waalddaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is no transitive disease, no ill omen, and bad luck is lound in the house, or wife or horse. Note: The majority of scholars interpret this to mean that these things in and of themselves do not transmit or cause harm through supernatural or hidden means but that Allah is ultimately in control and any fearful superstition around these is false
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، وَحَمْزَةَ، ابْنَىْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِمَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، وَحَمْزَةَ، ابْنَىْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ، إِسْحَاقَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الشُّؤْمِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ لاَ يَذْكُرُ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ فِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ الْعَدْوَى وَالْطِّيَرَةَ غَيْرُ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, wahamzaaa, abnaa 'abdi alllahi 'an aabiyhimaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, 'an sufyaana, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimin, wahamzaaa, abnaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, h wahaddathanaahu yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa bishru bnu almufaddali, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni, iishaaqa h wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alshhuumi ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi maalikin laa yadhkuru aahadun minhum fiy hadiythi abni 'umara al'adwaa waalttiyaraaa ghayru yuwnusa bni yaziyda ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Zuhri with other chains of transmitters but with slight variations of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَاهُ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ يَكُنْ مِنَ الشُّؤْمِ شَىْءٌ حَقٌّ فَفِي الْفَرَسِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ وَالدَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni alhakami, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'umara bni muhammadi bni zaydin, aannahu sami'a aabaahu, yuhaddithu 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iin yakun mina alshhuumi shaa'un haqqun fafiy alfarasi waalmaraaai waalddaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. Muhammad b. Zaid reported that he heard his father narrating from Ibn 'Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said. If bad luck is a fact, then it is in the horse, the woman and the house
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ‏ "‏ حَقٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu walam yaqul ‏ "‏ haqqun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but there is no mention of the word" Haqq"" (fact)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُتْبَةُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ حَمْزَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ الشُّؤْمُ فِي شَىْءٍ فَفِي الْفَرَسِ وَالْمَسْكَنِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy maryama, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, haddathaniy 'utbaau bnu muslimin, 'an hamzaaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iin kaana alshhuumu fiy shaa'in fafiy alfarasi waalmaskani waalmaraaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:If there is bad luck in anything, it is the horse, the abode and the woman
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ، سَعْدٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ فَفِي الْمَرْأَةِ وَالْفَرَسِ وَالْمَسْكَنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الشُّؤْمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni, sa'din qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iin kaana fafiy almaraaai waalfarasi waalmaskani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'niy alshhuuma ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If bad luck were to be in anything, it is found in the woman, the horse and the abode
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ دُكَيْنٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa alfadlu bnu dukaynin, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sahl b. Sa'd with a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنِ ابْنِ، جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، يُخْبِرُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِي شَىْءٍ فَفِي الرَّبْعِ وَالْخَادِمِ وَالْفَرَسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu alhaarithi, 'ani abni, jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabirana, yukhbiru 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iin kaana fiy shaa'in fafiy alrrab'i waalkhaadimi waalfarasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If bad luck were to be in anything, it is found in the land, in the servant and in the horse
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ السُّلَمِيِّ، قَالَ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُمُورًا كُنَّا نَصْنَعُهَا فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ كُنَّا نَأْتِي الْكُهَّانَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ تَأْتُوا الْكُهَّانَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ كُنَّا نَتَطَيَّرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكَ شَىْءٌ يَجِدُهُ أَحَدُكُمْ فِي نَفْسِهِ فَلاَ يَصُدَّنَّكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni alhakami alssulamiyyi, qaala qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aumuwrana kunnaa nasna'uhaa fiy aljaahiliyyaai kunnaa naatiy alkuhhaana ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ falaa taatuwa alkuhhaana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu kunnaa natatayyaru ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ dhaaka shaa'un yajiduhu aahadukum fiy nafsihi falaa yasuddannakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mu'awiya b. al-Hakam as-Sulami reported:I said: Messenger of Allah, there were things we used to do in the pre-Islamic days. We used to visit Kahins, whereupon he said: Don't visit Kahins. I said: We used to take omens. He said: That is a sort of personal whim of yours, so let it not prevent you (from doing a thing)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حُجَيْنٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْمُثَنَّى - حَدَّثَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي ذِئْبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عِيسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ غَيْرَ أَنَّ مَالِكًا فِي حَدِيثِهِ ذَكَرَ الطِّيَرَةَ وَلَيْسَ فِيهِ ذِكْرُ الْكُهَّانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathaniy hujaynun, - ya'niy abna almuthannaa - haddathanaa alllaythu, 'an 'uqaylin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa shabaabaau bnu sawwaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy dhiibin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, aakhbaranaa iishaaqu bnu 'iysaa, aakhbaranaa maalikun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithla ma'naa hadiythi yuwnusa ghayra aanna maalikana fiy hadiythihi dhakara alttiyaraaa walaysa fiyhi dhikru alkuhhaani ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 39 — The Book of Greetings
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ - عَنْ حَجَّاجٍ الصَّوَّافِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ أَبِي مَيْمُونَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ، يَسَارٍ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ السُّلَمِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ وَمِنَّا رِجَالٌ يَخُطُّونَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ كَانَ نَبِيٌّ مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ يَخُطُّ فَمَنْ وَافَقَ خَطُّهُ فَذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu 'ulayyaaa - 'an hajjaajin alssawwaafi, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, kilaahumaa 'an yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin, 'an hilaali bni aabiy maymuwnaaa, 'an 'ataa'i bni, yasaarin 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni alhakami alssulamiyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi alzzuhriyyi 'an aabiy salamaaa 'an mu'aawiyaaa wazaada fiy hadiythi yahyaa bni aabiy kathiyrin qaala qultu waminnaa rijaalun yakhuttuwna qaala ‏ "‏ kaana nabiyyun mina alaanbiyaa'i yakhuttu faman waafaqa khattuhu fadhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
