verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:While I was sleeping, the treasures of the earth were presented to me and I was made to wear in my hands two gold bangles. I felt a sort of burden upon me and I was disturbed and it was suggested to me that I should blow over them, so I blew and both of them disappeared. I interpreted them as two great liars who would appear at any time, one is the inhabitant of San`a' and the other is that of Yamama
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 42 — The Book of Dreams
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ الْعُطَارِدِيِّ، عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِوَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ رَأَى أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمُ الْبَارِحَةَ رُؤْيَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an aabiy rajaa'in al'utaaridiyyi, 'an samuraaa bni jundabin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sallaa alssubha aaqbala 'alayhim biwajhihi faqaala ‏ "‏ hal raaaa aahadun minkumu albaarihaaa ruuyaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Samura b. Jundab reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had performed his dawn prayer he turned his face towards them (that is towards his Companions) and said:Did any one of you see any vision last night?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَهْمٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ، - قَالَ ابْنُ مِهْرَانَ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، - حَدَّثَنَا الأَوْزَاعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، شَدَّادٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ وَاثِلَةَ بْنَ الأَسْقَعِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ اصْطَفَى كِنَانَةَ مِنْ وَلَدِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَاصْطَفَى قُرَيْشًا مِنْ كِنَانَةَ وَاصْطَفَى مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ بَنِي هَاشِمٍ وَاصْطَفَانِي مِنْ بَنِي هَاشِمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni sahmin, jamiy'ana 'ani alwaliydi, - qaala abnu mihraana haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, - haddathanaa alaawzaa'iyyu, 'an aabiy 'ammaarin, shaddaadin aannahu sami'a waathilaaa bna alaasqa'i, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha astafaa kinaanaaa min waladi iismaa'iyla waastafaa qurayshana min kinaanaaa waastafaa min qurayshin baniy haashimin waastafaaniy min baniy haashimin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Wathila b. al-Asqa' reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Verily Allah granted eminence to Kinana from amongst the descendants of Isma'il, and he granted eminence to the Quraish amongst Kinana, and he granted eminence to Banu Hashim amonsgst the Quraish, and he granted me eminence from the tribe of Banu Hashim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ طَهْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنِي سِمَاكُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ حَجَرًا بِمَكَّةَ كَانَ يُسَلِّمُ عَلَىَّ قَبْلَ أَنْ أُبْعَثَ إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُهُ الآنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy bukayrin, 'an iibraahiyma bni tahmaana, haddathaniy simaaku bnu harbin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinniy laa'rifu hajarana bimakkaaa kaana yusallimu 'alaaaa qabla aan aub'atha iinniy laa'rifuhu alana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I recognise the stone in Mecca which used to pay me salutations before my advent as a Prophet and I recognise that even now
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِقْلٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنَا سَيِّدُ وَلَدِ آدَمَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَأَوَّلُ مَنْ يَنْشَقُّ عَنْهُ الْقَبْرُ وَأَوَّلُ شَافِعٍ وَأَوَّلُ مُشَفَّعٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhakamu bnu muwsaa aabuw saalihin, haddathanaa hiqlun, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin - 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, haddathaniy aabuw 'ammaarin, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu farruwkha, haddathaniy aabuw hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanaa sayyidu waladi adama yawma alqiyaamaai waaawwalu man yanshaqqu 'anhu alqabru waaawwalu shaafi'in waaawwalu mushaffa'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I shall be pre-eminent amongst the descendants of Adam on the Day of Resurrection and I will be the first intercessor and the first whose intercession will be accepted (by Allah)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ الْعَتَكِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعَا بِمَاءٍ فَأُتِيَ بِقَدَحٍ رَحْرَاحٍ فَجَعَلَ الْقَوْمُ يَتَوَضَّئُونَ فَحَزَرْتُ مَا بَيْنَ السِّتِّينَ إِلَى الثَّمَانِينَ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلْتُ أَنْظُرُ إِلَى الْمَاءِ يَنْبُعُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i, sulaymaanu bnu daawuda al'atakiyyu haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm da'aa bimaa'in faautiya biqadahin rahraahin faja'ala alqawmu yatawaddaiuwna fahazartu maa bayna alssittiyna iilaa althhamaaniyna - qaala - faja'altu aanzuru iilaa almaa'i yanbu'u min bayni aasaabi'ihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) called for water and he was given a vessel and the people began to perform ablution in that and I counted (the persons) and they were between sixty and eighty and I saw water which was spouting from his fingers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُوسَى الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَحَانَتْ صَلاَةُ الْعَصْرِ فَالْتَمَسَ النَّاسُ الْوَضُوءَ فَلَمْ يَجِدُوهُ فَأُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِوَضُوءٍ فَوَضَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي ذَلِكَ الإِنَاءِ يَدَهُ وَأَمَرَ النَّاسَ أَنْ يَتَوَضَّئُوا مِنْهُ - قَالَ - فَرَأَيْتُ الْمَاءَ يَنْبُعُ مِنْ تَحْتِ أَصَابِعِهِ فَتَوَضَّأَ النَّاسُ حَتَّى تَوَضَّئُوا مِنْ عِنْدِ آخِرِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu muwsaa alaansaariyyu, haddathanaa ma'nun, haddathanaa maalikun, h wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahaanat salaaau al'asri faaltamasa alnnaasu alwaduw'a falam yajiduwhu faautiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biwaduw'in fawada'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy dhalika aliinaa'i yadahu waaamara alnnaasa aan yatawaddaiuwa minhu - qaala - faraaaytu almaa'a yanbu'u min tahti aasaabi'ihi fatawaddaaa alnnaasu hattaa tawaddaiuwa min 'indi akhirihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during the time of the afternoon prayer and the people asking for water for performing ablution which they did not find. (A small quantity) of water was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he placed his hand in that vessel and commanded people to perform ablution. I saw water spouting from his fingers and the people performing ablution until the last amongst them performed it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ هِشَامٍ - حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَصْحَابَهُ بِالزَّوْرَاءِ - قَالَ وَالزَّوْرَاءُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ عِنْدَ السُّوقِ وَالْمَسْجِدِ فِيمَا ثَمَّهْ - دَعَا بِقَدَحٍ فِيهِ مَاءٌ فَوَضَعَ كَفَّهُ فِيهِ فَجَعَلَ يَنْبُعُ مِنْ بَيْنِ أَصَابِعِهِ فَتَوَضَّأَ جَمِيعُ أَصْحَابِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ كَمْ كَانُوا يَا أَبَا حَمْزَةَ قَالَ كَانُوا زُهَاءَ الثَّلاَثِمِائَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa mu'aadhun, - ya'niy abna hishaamin - haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaashaabahu bialzzawraa'i - qaala waalzzawraa'u bialmadiynaai 'inda alssuwqi waalmasjidi fiymaa thammah - da'aa biqadahin fiyhi maa'un fawada'a kaffahu fiyhi faja'ala yanbu'u min bayni aasaabi'ihi fatawaddaaa jamiy'u aashaabihi ‏.‏ qaala qultu kam kaanuwa yaa aabaa hamzaaa qaala kaanuwa zuhaa'a althhalaathimiaiaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and his Companions were at a place known as az-Zaura' (az-Zaurd' is a place in the bazar of Medina near the mosque) that he called for a vessel containing water. He put his hand in that. And there began to spout (water) between his fingers and all the Companions performed ablution. Qatada, one of the narrators in the chain of narrators, said:Abu Hamza (the kunya of Hadrat Anas b. Malik), how many people were they? He said: They were about three hundred
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ بِالزَّوْرَاءِ فَأُتِيَ بِإِنَاءِ مَاءٍ لاَ يَغْمُرُ أَصَابِعَهُ أَوْ قَدْرَ مَا يُوَارِي أَصَابِعَهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ هِشَامٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana bialzzawraa'i faautiya biiinaa'i maa'in laa yaghmuru aasaabi'ahu aaw qadra maa yuwaariy aasaabi'ahu ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi hishaamin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was at az-Zaura' and a vessel containing water was brought to him in which his finger could not be completely dipped or completely covered; the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ أُمَّ مَالِكٍ، كَانَتْ تُهْدِي لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي عُكَّةٍ لَهَا سَمْنًا فَيَأْتِيهَا بَنُوهَا فَيَسْأَلُونَ الأُدْمَ وَلَيْسَ عِنْدَهُمْ شَىْءٌ فَتَعْمِدُ إِلَى الَّذِي كَانَتْ تُهْدِي فِيهِ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَجِدُ فِيهِ سَمْنًا فَمَا زَالَ يُقِيمُ لَهَا أُدْمَ بَيْتِهَا حَتَّى عَصَرَتْهُ فَأَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عَصَرْتِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ تَرَكْتِيهَا مَا زَالَ قَائِمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna aumma maalikin, kaanat tuhdiy lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy 'ukkaain lahaa samnana fayaatiyhaa banuwhaa fayasaaluwna alaudma walaysa 'indahum shaa'un fata'midu iilaa alladhiy kaanat tuhdiy fiyhi lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatajidu fiyhi samnana famaa zaala yuqiymu lahaa audma baytihaa hattaa 'asarathu faaatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ 'asartiyhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ law taraktiyhaa maa zaala qaaiimana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Umm Malik used to send clarified butter in a small skin to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Her sons would come to her and ask for seasoning when they had nothing with them (in the form of condiments) and she would go to that (skin) in which she offered (clarified butter) to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and she would find in that clarified butter and it kept providing her with seasoning for her household until she had (completely) squeezed it. She came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and (informed him about it). Thereupon, he (the Holy Prophet) said:Did you squeeze it? She said: Yes. Thereupon he said: If you had left it in that very state, it would have kept on provid- ing you (the clarified butter) on end
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، أَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَطْعِمُهُ فَأَطْعَمَهُ شَطْرَ وَسْقِ شَعِيرٍ فَمَا زَالَ الرَّجُلُ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ وَامْرَأَتُهُ وَضَيْفُهُمَا حَتَّى كَالَهُ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْ لَمْ تَكِلْهُ لأَكَلْتُمْ مِنْهُ وَلَقَامَ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aanna rajulaan, aataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yastat'imuhu faaat'amahu shatra wasqi sha'iyrin famaa zaala alrrajulu yaakulu minhu waamraaatuhu wadayfuhumaa hattaa kaalahu faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ law lam takilhu laakaltum minhu walaqaama lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked for food. And he gave him half a wasq of barley, and the person and his wife and their guests kept on making use of it (as a food) until he weighed it (in order to find out the actual quantity, and it was no more). He came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) (and informed him about it). He said:Had you not weighed it, you would be eating out of it and it would have remained intact for you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَلِيٍّ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَنَسٍ - عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ الْمَكِّيِّ، أَنَّ أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ، عَامِرَ بْنَ وَاثِلَةَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ مُعَاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ أَخْبَرَهُ قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَامَ غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ فَكَانَ يَجْمَعُ الصَّلاَةَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا وَالْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ يَوْمًا أَخَّرَ الصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَصَلَّى الظُّهْرَ وَالْعَصْرَ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ دَخَلَ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فَصَلَّى الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ سَتَأْتُونَ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ عَيْنَ تَبُوكَ وَإِنَّكُمْ لَنْ تَأْتُوهَا حَتَّى يُضْحِيَ النَّهَارُ فَمَنْ جَاءَهَا مِنْكُمْ فَلاَ يَمَسَّ مِنْ مَائِهَا شَيْئًا حَتَّى آتِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجِئْنَاهَا وَقَدْ سَبَقَنَا إِلَيْهَا رَجُلاَنِ وَالْعَيْنُ مِثْلُ الشِّرَاكِ تَبِضُّ بِشَىْءٍ مِنْ مَاءٍ - قَالَ - فَسَأَلَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هَلْ مَسَسْتُمَا مِنْ مَائِهَا شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالاَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَسَبَّهُمَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ لَهُمَا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَقُولَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ غَرَفُوا بِأَيْدِيهِمْ مِنَ الْعَيْنِ قَلِيلاً قَلِيلاً حَتَّى اجْتَمَعَ فِي شَىْءٍ - قَالَ - وَغَسَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِ يَدَيْهِ وَوَجْهَهُ ثُمَّ أَعَادَهُ فِيهَا فَجَرَتِ الْعَيْنُ بِمَاءٍ مُنْهَمِرٍ أَوْ قَالَ غَزِيرٍ - شَكَّ أَبُو عَلِيٍّ أَيُّهُمَا قَالَ - حَتَّى اسْتَقَى النَّاسُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُوشِكُ يَا مُعَاذُ إِنْ طَالَتْ بِكَ حَيَاةٌ أَنْ تَرَى مَا هَا هُنَا قَدْ مُلِئَ جِنَانًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'aliyyin alhanafiyyu, haddathanaa maalikun, - wahuwa abnu aanasin - 'an aabiy alzzubayri almakkiyyi, aanna aabaa alttufayli, 'aamira bna waathilaaa aakhbarahu aanna mu'aadha bna jabalin aakhbarahu qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aama ghazwaai tabuwka fakaana yajma'u alssalaaaa fasallaa alzzuhra waal'asra jamiy'ana waalmaghriba waal'ishaa'a jamiy'ana hattaa iidhaa kaana yawmana aakhhara alssalaaaa thumma kharaja fasallaa alzzuhra waal'asra jamiy'ana thumma dakhala thumma kharaja ba'da dhalika fasallaa almaghriba waal'ishaa'a jamiy'ana thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinnakum sataatuwna ghadana iin shaa'a alllahu 'ayna tabuwka waiinnakum lan taatuwhaa hattaa yudhiya alnnahaaru faman jaa'ahaa minkum falaa yamassa min maaiihaa shayiana hattaa atiya ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fajiinaahaa waqad sabaqanaa iilayhaa rajulaani waal'aynu mithlu alshhiraaki tabiddu bishaa'in min maa'in - qaala - fasaaalahumaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hal masastumaa min maaiihaa shayiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalaa na'am ‏.‏ fasabbahumaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala lahumaa maa shaa'a alllahu aan yaquwla - qaala - thumma gharafuwa biaaydiyhim mina al'ayni qaliylaan qaliylaan hattaa ajtama'a fiy shaa'in - qaala - waghasala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiyhi yadayhi wawajhahu thumma aa'aadahu fiyhaa fajarati al'aynu bimaa'in munhamirin aaw qaala ghaziyrin - shakka aabuw 'aliyyin aayyuhumaa qaala - hattaa astaqaa alnnaasu thumma qaala ‏"‏ yuwshiku yaa mu'aadhu iin taalat bika hayaaaun aan taraa maa haa hunaa qad muliia jinaanana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mu'adh b. Jabal reported that he went along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in the expedition of Tabuk and he (the Holy Prophet) combined the prayers. He offered the noon and afternoon prayers together and the sunset and night prayers together and on the other day he deferred the prayers; he then came out and offered the noon and afternoon prayers together. He then went in and (later on) came out and then after that offered the sunset and night prayers together and then said:God willing, you would reach by tomorrow the fountain of Tabuk and you should not come to that until it is dawn, and he who amongst you happens to go there should not touch its water until I come. We came to that and two persons (amongst) us reached that fountain ahead of us. It was a thin flow of water like the shoelace. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked them whether they had touched the water. They said: Yes. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) scolded them, and he said to them what he had to say by the will of God. The people then took water of the fountain in their palms until it became somewhat significant and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) washed his hands and his face too in it, and then, took it again in that (fountain) and there gushed forth abundant water from that fountain, until all the people drank to their fill. He then said: Mu'adh, it is likely that if you live long that you see what is here filled with gardens
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ عَبَّاسِ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزْوَةَ تَبُوكَ فَأَتَيْنَا وَادِيَ الْقُرَى عَلَى حَدِيقَةٍ لاِمْرَأَةٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اخْرُصُوهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخَرَصْنَاهَا وَخَرَصَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَشْرَةَ أَوْسُقٍ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحْصِيهَا حَتَّى نَرْجِعَ إِلَيْكِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَانْطَلَقْنَا حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا تَبُوكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَتَهُبُّ عَلَيْكُمُ اللَّيْلَةَ رِيحٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فَلاَ يَقُمْ فِيهَا أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ فَمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ بَعِيرٌ فَلْيَشُدَّ عِقَالَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَهَبَّتْ رِيحٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فَقَامَ رَجُلٌ فَحَمَلَتْهُ الرِّيحُ حَتَّى أَلْقَتْهُ بِجَبَلَىْ طَيِّئٍ وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ ابْنِ الْعَلْمَاءِ صَاحِبِ أَيْلَةَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِكِتَابٍ وَأَهْدَى لَهُ بَغْلَةً بَيْضَاءَ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَهْدَى لَهُ بُرْدًا ثُمَّ أَقْبَلْنَا حَتَّى قَدِمْنَا وَادِيَ الْقُرَى فَسَأَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَرْأَةَ عَنْ حَدِيقَتِهَا ‏"‏ كَمْ بَلَغَ ثَمَرُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ عَشَرَةَ أَوْسُقٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي مُسْرِعٌ فَمَنْ شَاءَ مِنْكُمْ فَلْيُسْرِعْ مَعِيَ وَمَنْ شَاءَ فَلْيَمْكُثْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجْنَا حَتَّى أَشْرَفْنَا عَلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذِهِ طَابَةُ وَهَذَا أُحُدٌ وَهُوَ جَبَلٌ يُحِبُّنَا وَنُحِبُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ خَيْرَ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ دَارُ بَنِي النَّجَّارِ ثُمَّ دَارُ بَنِي عَبْدِ الأَشْهَلِ ثُمَّ دَارُ بَنِي عَبْدِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ الْخَزْرَجِ ثُمَّ دَارُ بَنِي سَاعِدَةَ وَفِي كُلِّ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَحِقَنَا سَعْدُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ فَقَالَ أَبُو أُسَيْدٍ أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَيَّرَ دُورَ الأَنْصَارِ فَجَعَلَنَا آخِرًا ‏.‏ فَأَدْرَكَ سَعْدٌ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خَيَّرْتَ دُورَ الأَنْصَارِ فَجَعَلْتَنَا آخِرًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَوَلَيْسَ بِحَسْبِكُمْ أَنْ تَكُونُوا مِنَ الْخِيَارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa, 'an 'abbaasi bni sahli bni sa'din alssaa'idiyyi, 'an aabiy humaydin, qaala kharajnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghazwaaa tabuwka faaataynaa waadiya alquraa 'alaa hadiyqaain laimraaaain faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ akhrusuwhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakharasnaahaa wakharasahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ashraaa aawsuqin waqaala ‏"‏ aahsiyhaa hattaa narji'a iilayki iin shaa'a alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waantalaqnaa hattaa qadimnaa tabuwka faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ satahubbu 'alaykumu alllaylaaa riyhun shadiydaaun falaa yaqum fiyhaa aahadun minkum faman kaana lahu ba'iyrun falyashudda 'iqaalahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fahabbat riyhun shadiydaaun faqaama rajulun fahamalathu alrriyhu hattaa aalqathu bijabalaa tayyiiin wajaa'a rasuwlu abni al'almaa'i saahibi aaylaaa iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bikitaabin waaahdaa lahu baghlaaan baydaa'a fakataba iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaahdaa lahu burdana thumma aaqbalnaa hattaa qadimnaa waadiya alquraa fasaaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almaraaaa 'an hadiyqatihaa ‏"‏ kam balagha thamaruhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat 'asharaaa aawsuqin ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinniy musri'un faman shaa'a minkum falyusri' ma'iya waman shaa'a falyamkuth ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fakharajnaa hattaa aashrafnaa 'alaa almadiynaai faqaala ‏"‏ hadhihi taabaau wahadhaa auhudun wahuwa jabalun yuhibbunaa wanuhibbuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ iinna khayra duwri alaansaari daaru baniy alnnajjaari thumma daaru baniy 'abdi alaashhali thumma daaru baniy 'abdi alhaarithi bni alkhazraji thumma daaru baniy saa'idaaa wafiy kulli duwri alaansaari khayrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falahiqanaa sa'du bnu 'ubaadaaa faqaala aabuw ausaydin aalam tara aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khayyara duwra alaansaari faja'alanaa akhirana ‏.‏ faaadraka sa'dun rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi khayyarta duwra alaansaari faja'altanaa akhirana ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ aawalaysa bihasbikum aan takuwnuwa mina alkhiyaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Humaid as-Sa'idi reported:We went out with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on the expedition to Tabuk and we came to a wadi where there was a garden belonging to a woman. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said. Make an assessment (of the price of its fruit). And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) also made an assessment and it was ten wasqs. He asked that lady (to calculate the amount) until they would, God willing, come back to her. So we proceeded on until we came to Tabuk and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The violent storm will overtake you during the night, so none amongst you should stand up and he who has a camel with him should hobble it firmly. A violent storm blew and a person who had stood up was carried away by the storm and thrown between the mountains of Tayy. Then the messenger of the son of al 'Alma', the ruler of Aila, came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with a letter and a gift of a white mule. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) wrote him (the reply) and presented him a cloak. We came back until we halted in the Wadi al-Qura. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked that lady about her garden and the price of the fruits in that. She said: Ten wasqs. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I am going to depart, and he who amongst you wishes may depart with me but he who wants to stay may stay. We resumed the journey until we came to the outskirts of Medina. (It was at this time) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: This is Taba, this is Uhud, that is a mountain which loves us and we love it, and then said: The best amongst the houses of the Ansar is the house of Bani Najjar. Then the house of Bani Abd al-Ashhal, then the house of Bani Abd al-Harith b. Khazraj, then the house of Bani Sa'ida, and there is goodness in all the houses of the Ansar. Said b. Ubada came to us and Abu Usaid said to him: Did you not see that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has declared the houses of the Ansar good and he has kept us at the end. Said met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, you have declared the house of the Ansar as good and have kept us at the end, whereupon he said: Is it not enough for you that you have been counted amongst the good
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ يَحْيَى، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏ "‏ وَفِي كُلِّ دُورِ الأَنْصَارِ خَيْرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ مِنْ قِصَّةِ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ وُهَيْبٍ فَكَتَبَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِبَحْرِهِمْ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِ وُهَيْبٍ فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa almughiyraau bnu salamaaa almakhzuwmiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu yahyaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi iilaa qawlihi ‏ "‏ wafiy kulli duwri alaansaari khayrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu min qissaai sa'di bni 'ubaadaaa wazaada fiy hadiythi wuhaybin fakataba lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bibahrihim ‏.‏ walam yadhkur fiy hadiythi wuhaybin fakataba iilayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Amr b. Yahya with the same chain of transmitters up to the words:There is good in all the houses of the Ansar, and there is no mention of the subsequent event pertaining to Sa'd b. 'Ubada
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَلَمَةَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عِمْرَانَ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سِنَانِ بْنِ أَبِي سِنَانٍ الدُّؤَلِيِّ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزْوَةً قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ فَأَدْرَكَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي وَادٍ كَثِيرِ الْعِضَاهِ فَنَزَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَحْتَ شَجَرَةٍ فَعَلَّقَ سَيْفَهُ بِغُصْنٍ مِنْ أَغْصَانِهَا - قَالَ - وَتَفَرَّقَ النَّاسُ فِي الْوَادِي يَسْتَظِلُّونَ بِالشَّجَرِ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ رَجُلاً أَتَانِي وَأَنَا نَائِمٌ فَأَخَذَ السَّيْفَ فَاسْتَيْقَظْتُ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ عَلَى رَأْسِي فَلَمْ أَشْعُرْ إِلاَّ وَالسَّيْفُ صَلْتًا فِي يَدِهِ فَقَالَ لِي مَنْ يَمْنَعُكَ مِنِّي قَالَ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ مَنْ يَمْنَعُكَ مِنِّي قَالَ قُلْتُ اللَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَشَامَ السَّيْفَ فَهَا هُوَ ذَا جَالِسٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَعْرِضْ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aabiy, salamaaa 'an jaabirin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw 'imraana, muhammadu bnu ja'fari bni ziyaadin - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa iibraahiymu, - ya'niy abna sa'din - 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sinaani bni aabiy sinaanin aldduualiyyi, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala ghazawnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghazwaaan qibala najdin faaadrakanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy waadin kathiyri al'idaahi fanazala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tahta shajaraain fa'allaqa sayfahu bighusnin min aaghsaanihaa - qaala - watafarraqa alnnaasu fiy alwaadiy yastazilluwna bialshhajari - qaala - faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna rajulaan aataaniy waaanaa naaiimun faaakhadha alssayfa faastayqaztu wahuwa qaaiimun 'alaa raasiy falam aash'ur iilaaa waalssayfu saltana fiy yadihi faqaala liy man yamna'uka minniy qaala qultu alllahu ‏.‏ thumma qaala fiy althhaaniyaai man yamna'uka minniy qaala qultu alllahu ‏.‏ qaala fashaama alssayfa fahaa huwa dhaa jaalisun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma lam ya'rid lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:We went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) on an expedition towards Najd and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) found us in a valley abounding in thorny trees. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed for rest under a tree and he suspended his sword by one of its branches under which he was taking rest. The persons scattered in the valley and they also began to take rest under the shade of trees, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A person came to me while I was asleep and he took hold of the sword. I woke up and found him standing upon my head and I had hardly become alert (and saw) that the sword was in his hand. And he said: Who can protect you from me? I said: Allah. He again said: Who can protect you from me? I said: Allah. He put his sword in the sheath (and you can see) this man sitting here. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not in any way touch him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي سِنَانُ بْنُ أَبِي سِنَانٍ الدُّؤَلِيُّ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيَّ، وَكَانَ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَهُمَا أَنَّهُ غَزَا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَزْوَةً قِبَلَ نَجْدٍ فَلَمَّا قَفَلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَفَلَ مَعَهُ فَأَدْرَكَتْهُمُ الْقَائِلَةُ يَوْمًا ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ وَمَعْمَرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa qaalaa aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathaniy sinaanu bnu aabiy sinaanin aldduualiyyu, waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani aanna jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyya, wakaana, min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarahumaa aannahu ghazaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghazwaaan qibala najdin falammaa qafala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qafala ma'ahu faaadrakathumu alqaaiilaau yawmana thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi iibraahiyma bni sa'din wama'marin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansiri, who was one amongst the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that he went on an expedition along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) towards Najd and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed there, and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back he also came back along with him. They, for one day, stayed for rest; the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ أَقْبَلْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى إِذَا كُنَّا بِذَاتِ الرِّقَاعِ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَعْرِضْ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa aabaanu bnu yaziyda, haddathanaa yahyaa, bnu aabiy kathiyrin 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an jaabirin, qaala aaqbalnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa iidhaa kunnaa bidhaati alrriqaa'i ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi alzzuhriyyi walam yadhkur thumma lam ya'rid lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:We went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and as we reached the place Dhat-ur-Riqa'; the rest of the hadith is the same, but there is no mention of the word that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not harm him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو عَامِرٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي عَامِرٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مَثَلَ مَا بَعَثَنِي اللَّهُ بِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مِنَ الْهُدَى وَالْعِلْمِ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَصَابَ أَرْضًا فَكَانَتْ مِنْهَا طَائِفَةٌ طَيِّبَةٌ قَبِلَتِ الْمَاءَ فَأَنْبَتَتِ الْكَلأَ وَالْعُشْبَ الْكَثِيرَ وَكَانَ مِنْهَا أَجَادِبُ أَمْسَكَتِ الْمَاءَ فَنَفَعَ اللَّهُ بِهَا النَّاسَ فَشَرِبُوا مِنْهَا وَسَقَوْا وَرَعَوْا وَأَصَابَ طَائِفَةً مِنْهَا أُخْرَى إِنَّمَا هِيَ قِيعَانٌ لاَ تُمْسِكُ مَاءً وَلاَ تُنْبِتُ كَلأً فَذَلِكَ مَثَلُ مَنْ فَقُهَ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ وَنَفَعَهُ بِمَا بَعَثَنِي اللَّهُ بِهِ فَعَلِمَ وَعَلَّمَ وَمَثَلُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرْفَعْ بِذَلِكَ رَأْسًا وَلَمْ يَقْبَلْ هُدَى اللَّهِ الَّذِي أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw 'aamirin alaash'ariyyu wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i - waalllafzu laabiy 'aamirin - qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna mathala maa ba'athaniy alllahu bihi 'azza wajalla mina alhudaa waal'ilmi kamathali ghaythin aasaaba aardana fakaanat minhaa taaiifaaun tayyibaaun qabilati almaa'a faaanbatati alkalaa waal'ushba alkathiyra wakaana minhaa aajaadibu aamsakati almaa'a fanafa'a alllahu bihaa alnnaasa fasharibuwa minhaa wasaqawa wara'awa waaasaaba taaiifaaan minhaa aukhraa iinnamaa hiya qiy'aanun laa tumsiku maa'an walaa tunbitu kalaan fadhalika mathalu man faquha fiy diyni alllahi wanafa'ahu bimaa ba'athaniy alllahu bihi fa'alima wa'allama wamathalu man lam yarfa' bidhalika raasana walam yaqbal hudaa alllahi alladhiy aursiltu bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The similitude of that guidance and knowledge with which Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has sent me is that of rain falling upon the earth. There is a good piece of land which receives the rainfall (eagerly) and as a result of it there is grown in it herbage and grass abundantly. Then there is a land hard and barren which retains water and the people derive benefit from it and they drink it and make the animals drink. Then there is another land which is barren. Neither water is retained in it, nor is the grass grown in it. And that is the similitude of the first one who develops the understanding of the religion of Allah and it becomes a source of benefit to him with which Allah sent me. (The second one is that) who acquires the knowledge of religion and imparts it to others. (Then the other type is) one who does not pay attention to (the revealed knowledge) and thus does not accept guidance of Allah with which I have been sent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَرَّادٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلَ مَا بَعَثَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِهِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ أَتَى قَوْمَهُ فَقَالَ يَا قَوْمِ إِنِّي رَأَيْتُ الْجَيْشَ بِعَيْنَىَّ وَإِنِّي أَنَا النَّذِيرُ الْعُرْيَانُ فَالنَّجَاءَ ‏.‏ فَأَطَاعَهُ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ فَأَدْلَجُوا فَانْطَلَقُوا عَلَى مُهْلَتِهِمْ وَكَذَّبَتْ طَائِفَةٌ مِنْهُمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا مَكَانَهُمْ فَصَبَّحَهُمُ الْجَيْشُ فَأَهْلَكَهُمْ وَاجْتَاحَهُمْ فَذَلِكَ مَثَلُ مَنْ أَطَاعَنِي وَاتَّبَعَ مَا جِئْتُ بِهِ وَمَثَلُ مَنْ عَصَانِي وَكَذَّبَ مَا جِئْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu barraadin alaash'ariyyu, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy kuraybin - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna mathaliy wamathala maa ba'athaniya alllahu bihi kamathali rajulin aataa qawmahu faqaala yaa qawmi iinniy raaaytu aljaysha bi'aynaaaa waiinniy aanaa alnnadhiyru al'uryaanu faalnnajaa'a ‏.‏ faaataa'ahu taaiifaaun min qawmihi faaadlajuwa faantalaquwa 'alaa muhlatihim wakadhhabat taaiifaaun minhum faaasbahuwa makaanahum fasabbahahumu aljayshu faaahlakahum waajtaahahum fadhalika mathalu man aataa'aniy waattaba'a maa jiitu bihi wamathalu man 'asaaniy wakadhhaba maa jiitu bihi mina alhaqqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The similitude of mine and of that with which Allah sent me is that of a person who came to us and said: O people, I have seen an army with my eyes and I am a plain warner (and issue you warning) that you should immediately manage to find an escape. A group of people from amongst them paying heed (to his warning) fled to a place of protection and a group amongst them belied him and the morning overtook them in their houses and the army attacked them and killed them and they were routed. And that is the similitude of the one who obeyed me, followed with which I had been sent and the similitude of the other is of one who disobeyed and belied me and the Truth with which I have been sent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقُرَشِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ أُمَّتِي كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ اسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَجَعَلَتِ الدَّوَابُّ وَالْفَرَاشُ يَقَعْنَ فِيهِ فَأَنَا آخِذٌ بِحُجَزِكُمْ وَأَنْتُمْ تَقَحَّمُونَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alqurashiyyu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa mathaliy wamathalu aummatiy kamathali rajulin astawqada naarana faja'alati alddawaabbu waalfaraashu yaqa'na fiyhi faaanaa akhidhun bihujazikum waaantum taqahhamuwna fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The similitude of mine and that of my Umma is that of a person who lit fire and there began to fall into it insects and moths. And I am there to hold you back, but you plunge into it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith was likewise narrated with another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلِي كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ اسْتَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَلَمَّا أَضَاءَتْ مَا حَوْلَهَا جَعَلَ الْفَرَاشُ وَهَذِهِ الدَّوَابُّ الَّتِي فِي النَّارِ يَقَعْنَ فِيهَا وَجَعَلَ يَحْجُزُهُنَّ وَيَغْلِبْنَهُ فَيَتَقَحَّمْنَ فِيهَا قَالَ فَذَلِكُمْ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُكُمْ أَنَا آخِذٌ بِحُجَزِكُمْ عَنِ النَّارِ هَلُمَّ عَنِ النَّارِ هَلُمَّ عَنِ النَّارِ فَتَغْلِبُونِي تَقَحَّمُونَ فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathaliy kamathali rajulin astawqada naarana falammaa aadaa'at maa hawlahaa ja'ala alfaraashu wahadhihi alddawaabbu allatiy fiy alnnaari yaqa'na fiyhaa waja'ala yahjuzuhunna wayaghlibnahu fayataqahhamna fiyhaa qaala fadhalikum mathaliy wamathalukum aanaa akhidhun bihujazikum 'ani alnnaari halumma 'ani alnnaari halumma 'ani alnnaari fataghlibuwniy taqahhamuwna fiyhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:Abu Huraira reported us some ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) amongst many, (and) one is this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: A person lit fire and when the atmosphere was aglow, moths and insects began to fall into the fire, but I am there to hold them back, but they are plunging into it despite my efforts, and he further added: That is your example and mine. I am there to hold you back from fire and to save you from it, but you are plunging into it despite my efforts
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مِينَاءَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُكُمْ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ أَوْقَدَ نَارًا فَجَعَلَ الْجَنَادِبُ وَالْفَرَاشُ يَقَعْنَ فِيهَا وَهُوَ يَذُبُّهُنَّ عَنْهَا وَأَنَا آخِذٌ بِحُجَزِكُمْ عَنِ النَّارِ وَأَنْتُمْ تَفَلَّتُونَ مِنْ يَدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa saliymun, 'an sa'iydi bni miynaa'a, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathaliy wamathalukum kamathali rajulin aawqada naarana faja'ala aljanaadibu waalfaraashu yaqa'na fiyhaa wahuwa yadhubbuhunna 'anhaa waaanaa akhidhun bihujazikum 'ani alnnaari waaantum tafallatuwna min yadiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. My example and your example is that of a person who lit the fire and insects and moths began to fall in it and he would be making efforts to take them out, and I am going to hold you back from fire, but you are slipping from my hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ بَنَى بُنْيَانًا فَأَحْسَنَهُ وَأَجْمَلَهُ فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يُطِيفُونَ بِهِ يَقُولُونَ مَا رَأَيْنَا بُنْيَانًا أَحْسَنَ مِنْ هَذَا إِلاَّ هَذِهِ اللَّبِنَةَ ‏.‏ فَكُنْتُ أَنَا تِلْكَ اللَّبِنَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amruw bnu muhammadin alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mathaliy wamathalu alaanbiyaa'i kamathali rajulin banaa bunyaanana faaahsanahu waaajmalahu faja'ala alnnaasu yutiyfuwna bihi yaquwluwna maa raaaynaa bunyaanana aahsana min hadhaa iilaaa hadhihi alllabinaaa ‏.‏ fakuntu aanaa tilka alllabinaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles (before me) is that of a person who constructed a building and he built it fine and well and the people went round it saying: Never have we seen a building more imposing than this. but for one brick, and I am that brick (with which you give the finishing touch to the building)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ مِنْ قَبْلِي كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ ابْتَنَى بُيُوتًا فَأَحْسَنَهَا وَأَجْمَلَهَا وَأَكْمَلَهَا إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ لَبِنَةٍ مِنْ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْ زَوَايَاهَا فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَطُوفُونَ وَيُعْجِبُهُمُ الْبُنْيَانُ فَيَقُولُونَ أَلاَّ وَضَعْتَ هَا هُنَا لَبِنَةً فَيَتِمَّ بُنْيَانُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَكُنْتُ أَنَا اللَّبِنَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ mathaliy wamathalu alaanbiyaa'i min qabliy kamathali rajulin abtanaa buyuwtana faaahsanahaa waaajmalahaa waaakmalahaa iilaaa mawdi'a labinaain min zaawiyaain min zawaayaahaa faja'ala alnnaasu yatuwfuwna wayu'jibuhumu albunyaanu fayaquwluwna aalaaa wada'ta haa hunaa labinaaan fayatimma bunyaanuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fakuntu aanaa alllabinaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles before me is that of a person who built a house quite imposing and beautiful and he made it complete but for one brick in one of its corners. People began to walk round it, and the building pleased them and they would say: But for this brick your building would have been perfect. Muhammad (ﷺ) said: And I am that final brick
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ مِنْ قَبْلِي كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ بَنَى بُنْيَانًا فَأَحْسَنَهُ وَأَجْمَلَهُ إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ لَبِنَةٍ مِنْ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْ زَوَايَاهُ فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَطُوفُونَ بِهِ وَيَعْجَبُونَ لَهُ وَيَقُولُونَ هَلاَّ وُضِعَتْ هَذِهِ اللَّبِنَةُ - قَالَ - فَأَنَا اللَّبِنَةُ وَأَنَا خَاتَمُ النَّبِيِّينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ mathaliy wamathalu alaanbiyaa'i min qabliy kamathali rajulin banaa bunyaanana faaahsanahu waaajmalahu iilaaa mawdi'a labinaain min zaawiyaain min zawaayaahu faja'ala alnnaasu yatuwfuwna bihi waya'jabuwna lahu wayaquwluwna halaaa wudi'at hadhihi alllabinaau - qaala - faaanaa alllabinaau waaanaa khaatamu alnnabiyyiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Hurairh reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles before me is that of a person who built a house quite imposing and beautiful, but for one brick in one of its corners. People would go round it, appreciating the building, but saying: Why has the brick not been fixed here? He said: I am that brick and I am the last of the Apostles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ النَّبِيِّينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathaliy wamathalu alnnabiyyiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles; the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ، بْنُ مِينَاءَ عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَثَلِي وَمَثَلُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ كَمَثَلِ رَجُلٍ بَنَى دَارًا فَأَتَمَّهَا وَأَكْمَلَهَا إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ لَبِنَةٍ فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَدْخُلُونَهَا وَيَتَعَجَّبُونَ مِنْهَا وَيَقُولُونَ لَوْلاَ مَوْضِعُ اللَّبِنَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَأَنَا مَوْضِعُ اللَّبِنَةِ جِئْتُ فَخَتَمْتُ الأَنْبِيَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa saliymu bnu hayyaana, haddathanaa sa'iydu, bnu miynaa'a 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ mathaliy wamathalu alaanbiyaa'i kamathali rajulin banaa daarana faaatammahaa waaakmalahaa iilaaa mawdi'a labinaain faja'ala alnnaasu yadkhuluwnahaa wayata'ajjabuwna minhaa wayaquwluwna lawlaa mawdi'u alllabinaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ faaanaa mawdi'u alllabinaai jiitu fakhatamtu alaanbiyaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The similitude of mine and that of the Apostles is like that of a person who built a house and he completed it and made it perfect but for the space of a brick. People entered therein and they were surprised at it and said: Had there been a brick (it would have been complete in all respects). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I am that place where the brick (completing the building is to be placed), and I have come to finalise the chain of Apostles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلِيمٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ بَدَلَ أَتَمَّهَا أَحْسَنَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa saliymun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu waqaala badala aatammahaa aahsanahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ وَحُدِّثْتُ عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، وَمِمَّنْ، رَوَى ذَلِكَ، عَنْهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الْجَوْهَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي بُرَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ إِذَا أَرَادَ رَحْمَةَ أُمَّةٍ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ قَبَضَ نَبِيَّهَا قَبْلَهَا فَجَعَلَهُ لَهَا فَرَطًا وَسَلَفًا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهَا وَإِذَا أَرَادَ هَلَكَةَ أُمَّةٍ عَذَّبَهَا وَنَبِيُّهَا حَىٌّ فَأَهْلَكَهَا وَهُوَ يَنْظُرُ فَأَقَرَّ عَيْنَهُ بِهَلَكَتِهَا حِينَ كَذَّبُوهُ وَعَصَوْا أَمْرَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala muslimun wahuddithtu 'an aabiy ausaamaaa, wamimman, rawaa dhalika, 'anhu iibraahiymu bnu sa'iydin aljawhariyyu haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathaniy buraydu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla iidhaa aaraada rahmaaa aummaain min 'ibaadihi qabada nabiyyahaa qablahaa faja'alahu lahaa faratana wasalafana bayna yadayhaa waiidhaa aaraada halakaaa aummaain 'adhhabahaa wanabiyyuhaa haaaun faaahlakahaa wahuwa yanzuru faaaqarra 'aynahu bihalakatihaa hiyna kadhhabuwhu wa'asawa aamrahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, intends to show mercy to an Umma from amongst His servants He calls back His Apostle to his eternal home and makes him a harbinger and recompense in the world to come; and when He intends to cause destruction to an Umma, He punishes it while its Apostle is alive and He destroys it as he (the Apostle) witnesses it and he cools his eyes by destruction as they had belied him and disobeyed his command
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَائِدَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عُمَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جُنْدَبًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَنَا فَرَطُكُمْ، عَلَى الْحَوْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zaaiidaau, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'umayrin, qaala sami'tu jundabana, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aanaa faratukum, 'alaa alhawdi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jundab reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: I shall be there at the Cistern before you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بِشْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ جُنْدَبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu bishrin, jamiy'ana 'an mis'arin, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an jundabin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jundab through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَهْلاً، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَنَا فَرَطُكُمْ، عَلَى الْحَوْضِ مَنْ وَرَدَ شَرِبَ وَمَنْ شَرِبَ لَمْ يَظْمَأْ أَبَدًا وَلَيَرِدَنَّ عَلَىَّ أَقْوَامٌ أَعْرِفُهُمْ وَيَعْرِفُونِي ثُمَّ يُحَالُ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ فَسَمِعَ النُّعْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ وَأَنَا أُحَدِّثُهُمْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ فَقَالَ هَكَذَا سَمِعْتَ سَهْلاً يَقُولُ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَنَا أَشْهَدُ، عَلَى أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ لَسَمِعْتُهُ يَزِيدُ فَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُمْ مِنِّي ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا عَمِلُوا بَعْدَكَ ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ سُحْقًا سُحْقًا لِمَنْ بَدَّلَ بَعْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'an aabiy haazimin, qaala sami'tu sahlaan, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ aanaa faratukum, 'alaa alhawdi man warada shariba waman shariba lam yazmaa aabadana walayaridanna 'alaaaa aaqwaamun aa'rifuhum waya'rifuwniy thumma yuhaalu bayniy wabaynahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw haazimin fasami'a alnnu'maanu bnu aabiy 'ayyaashin waaanaa auhaddithuhum hadhaa alhadiytha faqaala hakadhaa sami'ta sahlaan yaquwlu qaala faqultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala waaanaa aashhadu, 'alaa aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi lasami'tuhu yaziydu fayaquwlu ‏"‏ iinnahum minniy ‏.‏ fayuqaalu iinnaka laa tadriy maa 'amiluwa ba'daka ‏.‏ faaaquwlu suhqana suhqana liman baddala ba'diy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl (b. Sa'd) reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: I shall go to the Cistern before you and he who comes would drink and he who drinks would never feel thirsty, and there would come to me people whom I would know and who would know me. Then there would be intervention between me and them. Abu Hazim said that Nu'man b. Abu 'Ayyash heard it and I narrated to them this hadith, and said: Is it this that you heard Sahl saying? He said: Yes, and I bear witness to the fact that I heard it from Abu Sa'id Khudri also, but he made this addition that he (the Holy Prophet) would say: They are my followers, and it would be said to him: You do not know what they did after you and I will say to them: Woe to him who changes (his religion) after me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أُسَامَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، الْخُدْرِيِّ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يَعْقُوبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy ausaamaau, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahlin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'ani alnnu'maani bni aabiy 'ayyaashin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, alkhudriyyi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi ya'quwba ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Sa'id Khudri through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الضَّبِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْجُمَحِيُّ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ حَوْضِي مَسِيرَةُ شَهْرٍ وَزَوَايَاهُ سَوَاءٌ وَمَاؤُهُ أَبْيَضُ مِنَ الْوَرِقِ وَرِيحُهُ أَطْيَبُ مِنَ الْمِسْكِ وَكِيزَانُهُ كَنُجُومِ السَّمَاءِ فَمَنْ شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلاَ يَظْمَأُ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقَالَتْ أَسْمَاءُ بِنْتُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي عَلَى الْحَوْضِ حَتَّى أَنْظُرَ مَنْ يَرِدُ عَلَىَّ مِنْكُمْ وَسَيُؤْخَذُ أُنَاسٌ دُونِي فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ مِنِّي وَمِنْ أُمَّتِي ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ أَمَا شَعَرْتَ مَا عَمِلُوا بَعْدَكَ وَاللَّهِ مَا بَرِحُوا بَعْدَكَ يَرْجِعُونَ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ يَقُولُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ نَرْجِعَ عَلَى أَعْقَابِنَا أَوْ أَنْ نُفْتَنَ عَنْ دِينِنَا
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa daawudu bnu 'amrinw alddabbiyyu, haddathanaa naafi'u bnu 'umara aljumahiyyu, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amriw bni al'aasi qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hawdiy masiyraau shahrin wazawaayaahu sawaa'un wamaauuhu aabyadu mina alwariqi wariyhuhu aatyabu mina almiski wakiyzaanuhu kanujuwmi alssamaa'i faman shariba minhu falaa yazmaau ba'dahu aabadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala waqaalat aasmaa'u bintu aabiy bakrin qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinniy 'alaa alhawdi hattaa aanzura man yaridu 'alaaaa minkum wasayuukhadhu aunaasun duwniy faaaquwlu yaa rabbi minniy wamin aummatiy ‏.‏ fayuqaalu aamaa sha'arta maa 'amiluwa ba'daka waalllahi maa barihuwa ba'daka yarji'uwna 'alaa aa'qaabihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakaana abnu aabiy mulaykaaa yaquwlu alllahumma iinnaa na'uwdhu bika aan narji'a 'alaa aa'qaabinaa aaw aan nuftana 'an diyninaa
verses.translation: Abdullah b. `Amr al-`As, reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:My Cistern (is as wide and broad that it requires) a month's journey (to go round it) all, and its sides are equal and its water is whiter than silver, and its odour is more fragrant than the fragrance of musk, and its jugs (placed around it) are like stars in the sky; and he who would drink from it would never feel thirsty after that. Asma', daughter of Abu Bakr said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I would be on the Cistern so that I would be seeing those who would be coming to me from you, but some people would be detained (before reaching me). I would say: My Lord, they are my followers and belong to my Ummah, and it would be said to me: Do you know what they did after you? By Allah, they did not do good after you, and they turned back upon their heels. He (the narrator) said: lbn Abu Mulaika used to say (in supplication): O Allah, I seek refuge with Thee that we should turn back upon our heels or put to any trial about our religion
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ خُثَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَائِشَةَ، تَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ وَهُوَ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَانَىْ أَصْحَابِهِ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي عَلَى الْحَوْضِ أَنْتَظِرُ مَنْ يَرِدُ عَلَىَّ مِنْكُمْ فَوَاللَّهِ لَيُقْتَطَعَنَّ دُونِي رِجَالٌ فَلأَقُولَنَّ أَىْ رَبِّ مِنِّي وَمِنْ أُمَّتِي ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا عَمِلُوا بَعْدَكَ مَا زَالُوا يَرْجِعُونَ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sulaymin, 'ani abni khuthaymin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'ubaydi, alllahi bni aabiy mulaykaaa aannahu sami'a 'aaiishaaa, taquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu wahuwa bayna zahraanaa aashaabihi ‏ "‏ iinniy 'alaa alhawdi aantaziru man yaridu 'alaaaa minkum fawaalllahi layuqtata'anna duwniy rijaalun falaaquwlanna aaa rabbi minniy wamin aummatiy ‏.‏ fayaquwlu iinnaka laa tadriy maa 'amiluwa ba'daka maa zaaluwa yarji'uwna 'alaa aa'qaabihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say in the company of his Companions: I would be on the Cistern waiting for those who would be coming to me from amongst you. By Allah, some persons would be prevented from coming to me, and I would say: My Lord, they are my followers and people of my Umma. And He would say,: You don't know what they did after you; they had been constantly turning back on their heels (from their religion)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يُونُسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الصَّدَفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرٌو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - أَنَّ بُكَيْرًا، حَدَّثَهُ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ الْهَاشِمِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، رَافِعٍ مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ النَّاسَ يَذْكُرُونَ الْحَوْضَ وَلَمْ أَسْمَعْ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمًا مِنْ ذَلِكَ وَالْجَارِيَةُ تَمْشُطُنِي فَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لِلْجَارِيَةِ اسْتَأْخِرِي عَنِّي ‏.‏ قَالَتْ إِنَّمَا دَعَا الرِّجَالَ وَلَمْ يَدْعُ النِّسَاءَ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي مِنَ النَّاسِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي لَكُمْ فَرَطٌ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ فَإِيَّاىَ لاَ يَأْتِيَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ فَيُذَبُّ عَنِّي كَمَا يُذَبُّ الْبَعِيرُ الضَّالُّ فَأَقُولُ فِيمَ هَذَا فَيُقَالُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ سُحْقًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy yuwnusu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa alssadafiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amrunw, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - aanna bukayrana, haddathahu 'ani alqaasimi bni 'abbaasin alhaashimiyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, raafi'in mawlaa aummi salamaaa 'an aummi salamaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa qaalat kuntu aasma'u alnnaasa yadhkuruwna alhawda walam aasma' dhalika min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa kaana yawmana min dhalika waaljaariyaau tamshutuniy fasami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ aayyuhaa alnnaasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu liljaariyaai astaakhiriy 'anniy ‏.‏ qaalat iinnamaa da'aa alrrijaala walam yad'u alnnisaa'a ‏.‏ faqultu iinniy mina alnnaasi ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinniy lakum faratun 'alaa alhawdi faiiyyaaaa laa yaatiyanna aahadukum fayudhabbu 'anniy kamaa yudhabbu alba'iyru alddaallu faaaquwlu fiyma hadhaa fayuqaalu iinnaka laa tadriy maa aahdathuwa ba'daka ‏.‏ faaaquwlu suhqana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said I used to hear from people making a mention of the Cistern, but I did not hear about it from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). One day while a girl was combing me I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say:" O people." I said to that girl: Keep away from me. She said: He (the Holy Prophet) has addressed the men only and he has not invited the attention of the women. I said: I am amongst the people also (and have thus every right to listen to the things pertaining to religion). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I shall be your harbinger on the Cistern; therefore, be cautious lest one of you should come (to me) and may be driven away like a stray camel. I would ask the reasons, and it would be said to me: You don't know what innovations they made after you. And I would then also say: Be away
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ - وَهُوَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو - حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالَ كَانَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ تُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَهِيَ تَمْتَشِطُ ‏ "‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ لِمَاشِطَتِهَا كُفِّي رَأْسِي ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw ma'nin alrraqaashiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in wa'abdu bnu humaydin qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin - wahuwa 'abdu almaliki bnu 'amrinw - haddathanaa aaflahu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu raafi'in, qaala kaanat aummu salamaaa tuhaddithu aannahaa sami'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu 'alaa alminbari wahiya tamtashitu ‏ "‏ aayyuhaa alnnaasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat limaashitatihaa kuffiy raasiy ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi bukayrin 'ani alqaasimi bni 'abbaasin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama reported that she heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) saying this as he was sitting on the pulpit and she was getting her hair combed. (He uttered these words):" O people." And she said to one who was combing: Leave my head; the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ يَوْمًا فَصَلَّى عَلَى أَهْلِ أُحُدٍ صَلاَتَهُ عَلَى الْمَيِّتِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي فَرَطٌ لَكُمْ وَأَنَا شَهِيدٌ عَلَيْكُمْ وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ لأَنْظُرُ إِلَى حَوْضِيَ الآنَ وَإِنِّي قَدْ أُعْطِيتُ مَفَاتِيحَ خَزَائِنِ الأَرْضِ أَوْ مَفَاتِيحَ الأَرْضِ وَإِنِّي وَاللَّهِ مَا أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تُشْرِكُوا بَعْدِي وَلَكِنْ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تَتَنَافَسُوا فِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja yawmana fasallaa 'alaa aahli auhudin salaatahu 'alaa almayyiti thumma ansarafa iilaa alminbari faqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy faratun lakum waaanaa shahiydun 'alaykum waiinniy waalllahi laanzuru iilaa hawdiya alana waiinniy qad au'tiytu mafaatiyha khazaaiini alaardi aaw mafaatiyha alaardi waiinniy waalllahi maa aakhaafu 'alaykum aan tushrikuwa ba'diy walakin aakhaafu 'alaykum aan tatanaafasuwa fiyhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. 'Amir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one day went out and he offered prayer over the martyrs of Uhud just as prayer is offered over the dead. He then came back and sat on pulpit and said:I shall be present there (at the Cistern) before you. I shall be your witness and, by Allah, I perceive as if I am seeing with my own eyes my Cistern at this very state and I have been given the keys of the treasures of the earth or the keys of the earth and, by Allah, I am not afraid concerning you that you would associate anything (with Allah after me), but I am afraid that you would be vying with one another (for the possession of) the treasures of the earth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَرِيرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالَ، سَمِعْتُ يَحْيَى بْنَ أَيُّوبَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ صَلَّى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى قَتْلَى أُحُدٍ ثُمَّ صَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ كَالْمُوَدِّعِ لِلأَحْيَاءِ وَالأَمْوَاتِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي فَرَطُكُمْ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ وَإِنَّ عَرْضَهُ كَمَا بَيْنَ أَيْلَةَ إِلَى الْجُحْفَةِ إِنِّي لَسْتُ أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ تُشْرِكُوا بَعْدِي وَلَكِنِّي أَخْشَى عَلَيْكُمُ الدُّنْيَا أَنْ تَنَافَسُوا فِيهَا وَتَقْتَتِلُوا فَتَهْلِكُوا كَمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُقْبَةُ فَكَانَتْ آخِرَ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa wahbun, - ya'niy abna jariyrin - haddathanaa aabiy qaala, sami'tu yahyaa bna aayyuwba, yuhaddithu 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an marthadin, 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'aamirin, qaala sallaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa qatlaa auhudin thumma sa'ida alminbara kaalmuwaddi'i lilaahyaa'i waalaamwaati faqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy faratukum 'alaa alhawdi waiinna 'ardahu kamaa bayna aaylaaa iilaa aljuhfaai iinniy lastu aakhshaa 'alaykum aan tushrikuwa ba'diy walakinniy aakhshaa 'alaykumu alddunyaa aan tanaafasuwa fiyhaa wataqtatiluwa fatahlikuwa kamaa halaka man kaana qablakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'uqbaau fakaanat akhira maa raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. 'Amir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Allah's Messenger offered prayer over those who had fallen matyrs at Uhud. He then climbed the pulpit as if someone is saying good-bye to the living and the dead, and then said: I shall be there as your predecesor on the Cistern before you, and it is as wide as the distance between Aila and Juhfa (Aila is at the top of the gulf of 'Aqaba). I am not afraid that you would associate anything with Allah after me, but I am afraid that you may be (allured) by the world and (vie) with one another (in possessing material wealth) and begin killing one another, and you would be destroyed as were destroyed those who had gone before you. 'Uqba said that that was the last occasion that he saw Allah's Massenger on the pulpit
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنَا فَرَطُكُمْ عَلَى الْحَوْضِ وَلأُنَازِعَنَّ أَقْوَامًا ثُمَّ لأُغْلَبَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أَصْحَابِي أَصْحَابِي ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waabnu numayrin qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanaa faratukum 'alaa alhawdi walaunaazi'anna aaqwaamana thumma laughlabanna 'alayhim faaaquwlu yaa rabbi aashaabiy aashaabiy ‏.‏ fayuqaalu iinnaka laa tadriy maa aahdathuwa ba'daka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying; I shall be there at the Cistern before you, and I shall have to contend for some people, but I shall have to yield. I would be saying:My Lord, they are my friends, they are my friends, and it would be said: You don't know what innovations they made after you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏ "‏ أَصْحَابِي أَصْحَابِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an jariyrin, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ walam yadhkur ‏ "‏ aashaabiy aashaabiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: The hadith has been narrated on the authority ot al-A'mash with the same chain of transmitters but no mention is made of:" They are my companions; they are my companions
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ الأَعْمَشِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ عَنْ مُغِيرَةَ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا وَائِلٍ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, kilaahumaa 'an jariyrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, jamiy'ana 'an mughiyraaa, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi, alllahi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi alaa'mashi wafiy hadiythi shu'baaa 'an mughiyraaa, sami'tu aabaa waaiilin, ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْثَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ الأَعْمَشِ وَمُغِيرَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abtharun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy, shaybaaa haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, kilaahumaa 'an husaynin, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an hudhayfaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwa hadiythi alaa'mashi wamughiyraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hudhaifa through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ، بْنِ خَالِدٍ عَنْ حَارِثَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ حَوْضُهُ مَا بَيْنَ صَنْعَاءَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ الْمُسْتَوْرِدُ أَلَمْ تَسْمَعْهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ الأَوَانِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الْمُسْتَوْرِدُ ‏"‏ تُرَى فِيهِ الآنِيَةُ مِثْلَ الْكَوَاكِبِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni baziy'in, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an shu'baaa, 'an ma'badi, bni khaalidin 'an haarithaaa, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ hawduhu maa bayna san'aa'a waalmadiynaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala lahu almustawridu aalam tasma'hu qaala ‏"‏ alaawaaniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala laa ‏.‏ faqaala almustawridu ‏"‏ turaa fiyhi alaniyaau mithla alkawaakibi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Haritha reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:His Cistern would be as extensive as the distance between San'a' and Medina. Mustaurid (one of the narrators) said: Did you not hear anything about the utensils? Thereupon he said. No. Mustaurid said: You would find that the utensils would be like stars
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
