verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْقَاسِمِ - حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ - عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ أَنَسٌ مَا شَمِمْتُ عَنْبَرًا قَطُّ وَلاَ مِسْكًا وَلاَ شَيْئًا أَطْيَبَ مِنْ رِيحِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلاَ مَسِسْتُ شَيْئًا قَطُّ دِيبَاجًا وَلاَ حَرِيرًا أَلْيَنَ مَسًّا مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ja'faru bnu sulaymaana, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa haashimun, - ya'niy abna alqaasimi - haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - wahuwa abnu almughiyraai - 'an thaabitin, qaala aanasun maa shamimtu 'anbarana qattu walaa miskana walaa shayiana aatyaba min riyhi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaa masistu shayiana qattu diybaajana walaa hariyrana aalyana massana min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported:I never smelt ambergris or musk as fragrant as the fragrance of the body of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I never touched brocade or silk and found it as soft as the body of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ صَخْرٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَزْهَرَ اللَّوْنِ كَأَنَّ عَرَقَهُ اللُّؤْلُؤُ إِذَا مَشَى تَكَفَّأَ وَلاَ مَسِسْتُ دِيبَاجَةً وَلاَ حَرِيرَةً أَلْيَنَ مِنْ كَفِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلاَ شَمَمْتُ مِسْكَةً وَلاَ عَنْبَرَةً أَطْيَبَ مِنْ رَائِحَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu sa'iydi bni sakhrin alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa habbaanun, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aazhara alllawni kaaanna 'araqahu allluuluuu iidhaa mashaa takaffaaa walaa masistu diybaajaaan walaa hariyraaan aalyana min kaffi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaa shamamtu miskaaan walaa 'anbaraaan aatyaba min raaiihaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a very fair complexion and (the drops) of his perspiration shone like pearls, and when he walked he walked inclining forward, and I never touched brocade and silk (and found it) as soft as the softness of the palm of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I never smelt musk or ambergris and found its fragrance as sweet as the fragrance of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْقَاسِمِ - عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ دَخَلَ عَلَيْنَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عِنْدَنَا فَعَرِقَ وَجَاءَتْ أُمِّي بِقَارُورَةٍ فَجَعَلَتْ تَسْلُتُ الْعَرَقَ فِيهَا فَاسْتَيْقَظَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ مَا هَذَا الَّذِي تَصْنَعِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ هَذَا عَرَقُكَ نَجْعَلُهُ فِي طِيبِنَا وَهُوَ مِنْ أَطْيَبِ الطِّيبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa haashimun, - ya'niy abna alqaasimi - 'an sulaymaana, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala dakhala 'alaynaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala 'indanaa fa'ariqa wajaa'at aummiy biqaaruwraain faja'alat taslutu al'araqa fiyhaa faastayqaza alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa aumma sulaymin maa hadhaa alladhiy tasna'iyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat hadhaa 'araquka naj'aluhu fiy tiybinaa wahuwa min aatyabi alttiybi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to come to our house and there was perspiration upon his body. My mother brought a bottle and began to pour the sweat in that. When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) got up he said:Umm Sulaim, what is this that you are doing? Thereupon she said: That is your sweat which we mix in our perfume and it becomes the most fragrant perfume
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُجَيْنُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ - عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْخُلُ بَيْتَ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ فَيَنَامُ عَلَى فِرَاشِهَا وَلَيْسَتْ فِيهِ - قَالَ - فَجَاءَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فَنَامَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهَا فَأُتِيَتْ فَقِيلَ لَهَا هَذَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَامَ فِي بَيْتِكِ عَلَى فِرَاشِكِ - قَالَ - فَجَاءَتْ وَقَدْ عَرِقَ وَاسْتَنْقَعَ عَرَقُهُ عَلَى قِطْعَةِ أَدِيمٍ عَلَى الْفِرَاشِ فَفَتَحَتْ عَتِيدَتَهَا فَجَعَلَتْ تُنَشِّفُ ذَلِكَ الْعَرَقَ فَتَعْصِرُهُ فِي قَوَارِيرِهَا فَفَزِعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا تَصْنَعِينَ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ نَرْجُو بَرَكَتَهُ لِصِبْيَانِنَا قَالَ ‏"‏ أَصَبْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa hujaynu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - wahuwa abnu aabiy salamaaa - 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy talhaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yadkhulu bayta aummi sulaymin fayanaamu 'alaa firaashihaa walaysat fiyhi - qaala - fajaa'a dhaata yawmin fanaama 'alaa firaashihaa faautiyat faqiyla lahaa hadhaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm naama fiy baytiki 'alaa firaashiki - qaala - fajaa'at waqad 'ariqa waastanqa'a 'araquhu 'alaa qit'aai aadiymin 'alaa alfiraashi fafatahat 'atiydatahaa faja'alat tunashhifu dhalika al'araqa fata'siruhu fiy qawaariyrihaa fafazi'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa tasna'iyna yaa aumma sulaymin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi narjuw barakatahu lisibyaaninaa qaala ‏"‏ aasabti ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came to the house of Umm Sulaim and slept in her bed while she was away from her house. On the other day too he slept in her bed. She came and it was said to her:It is Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) who is having siesta in your house, lying in your bed. She came and found him sweating and his sweat falling on the leather cloth spread on her bed. She opened her scent-bag and began to fill the bottles with it. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was startled and woke up and said: Umm Sulaim, what are you doing? She said: Allah's Messenger, we seek blessings for our children through it. Thereupon he said: You have done something right
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَأْتِيهَا فَيَقِيلُ عِنْدَهَا فَتَبْسُطُ لَهُ نَطْعًا فَيَقِيلُ عَلَيْهِ وَكَانَ كَثِيرَ الْعَرَقِ فَكَانَتْ تَجْمَعُ عَرَقَهُ فَتَجْعَلُهُ فِي الطِّيبِ وَالْقَوَارِيرِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ مَا هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَرَقُكَ أَدُوفُ بِهِ طِيبِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aanasin, 'an aummi sulaymin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaatiyhaa fayaqiylu 'indahaa fatabsutu lahu nat'ana fayaqiylu 'alayhi wakaana kathiyra al'araqi fakaanat tajma'u 'araqahu fataj'aluhu fiy alttiybi waalqawaariyri faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa aumma sulaymin maa hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'araquka aaduwfu bihi tiybiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Sulaim reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) visited her house and (took rest) and she spread a piece of cloth for him and he had had a siesta on it. And he sweated profusely and she collected his sweat and put it in a perfume and in bottles. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:Umm Sulaim, what is this? She said: It is your sweat, which I put in my perfume. Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sweated in cold weather when revelation descended upon him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ إِنْ كَانَ لَيُنْزَلُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْغَدَاةِ الْبَارِدَةِ ثُمَّ تَفِيضُ جَبْهَتُهُ عَرَقًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat iin kaana layunzalu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alghadaaai albaaridaai thumma tafiydu jabhatuhu 'araqana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:When revelation descended upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) even during the cold days, his forehead perspired
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَابْنُ، بِشْرٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ الْحَارِثَ بْنَ هِشَامٍ، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَيْفَ يَأْتِيكَ الْوَحْىُ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَحْيَانًا يَأْتِينِي فِي مِثْلِ صَلْصَلَةِ الْجَرَسِ وَهُوَ أَشَدُّهُ عَلَىَّ ثُمَّ يَفْصِمُ عَنِّي وَقَدْ وَعَيْتُهُ وَأَحْيَانًا مَلَكٌ فِي مِثْلِ صُورَةِ الرَّجُلِ فَأَعِي مَا يَقُولُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, waabnu, bishrin jamiy'ana 'an hishaamin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alhaaritha bna hishaamin, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kayfa yaatiyka alwahau faqaala ‏ "‏ aahyaanana yaatiyniy fiy mithli salsalaai aljarasi wahuwa aashadduhu 'alaaaa thumma yafsimu 'anniy waqad wa'aytuhu waaahyaanana malakun fiy mithli suwraai alrrajuli faaa'iy maa yaquwlu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Harith b. Hisham asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ):How does the the wahi (inspiration) come to you? He said: At times it comes to me like the ringing of a bell and that is most severe for me and when it is over I retain that (what I had received in the form of wahi), and at times an Angel in the form of a human being comes to me (and speaks) and I retain whatever he speaks
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ كُرِبَ لِذَلِكَ وَتَرَبَّدَ وَجْهُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa sa'iydun, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alhasani, 'an hittaana bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, qaala kaana nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aunzila 'alayhi alwahau kuriba lidhalika watarabbada wajhuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubida b. Samit reported that when wahi (inspiration) descended upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), he felt a burden on that account and the colour of his face underwent a change
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ حِطَّانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرَّقَاشِيِّ، عَنْ عُبَادَةَ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أُنْزِلَ عَلَيْهِ الْوَحْىُ نَكَسَ رَأْسَهُ وَنَكَسَ أَصْحَابُهُ رُءُوسَهُمْ فَلَمَّا أُتْلِيَ عَنْهُ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'ani alhasani, 'an hittaana bni 'abdi alllahi alrraqaashiyyi, 'an 'ubaadaaa bni alssaamiti, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aunzila 'alayhi alwahau nakasa raasahu wanakasa aashaabuhu ru'uwsahum falammaa autliya 'anhu rafa'a raasahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubida b. Samit reported that when wahi descended upon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), he lowered his head and so lowered his Companions their heads, and when (this state) was over, he raised his head
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، قَالَ مَنْصُورٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِيَانِ ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ أَهْلُ الْكِتَابِ يَسْدُلُونَ أَشْعَارَهُمْ وَكَانَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ يَفْرُقُونَ رُءُوسَهُمْ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحِبُّ مُوَافَقَةَ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ فِيمَا لَمْ يُؤْمَرْ بِهِ فَسَدَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَاصِيَتَهُ ثُمَّ فَرَقَ بَعْدُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mansuwru bnu aabiy muzaahimin, wamuhammadu bnu ja'fari bni ziyaadin, qaala mansuwrun haddathanaa waqaala, abnu ja'farin aakhbaranaa iibraahiymu, - ya'niyaani abna sa'din - 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi, alllahi 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kaana aahlu alkitaabi yasduluwna aash'aarahum wakaana almushrikuwna yafruquwna ru'uwsahum wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhibbu muwaafaqaaa aahli alkitaabi fiymaa lam yuumar bihi fasadala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm naasiyatahu thumma faraqa ba'du ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that the People of the Book used to let their hair fall (on their foreheads) and the polytheists used to part them on their heads, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) liked to conform his behaviour to the People of the Book in matters in which he received no command (from God) ; so Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) let fall his hair upon his forehead, and then he began to part it after this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً مَرْبُوعًا بَعِيدَ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ عَظِيمَ الْجُمَّةِ إِلَى شَحْمَةِ أُذُنَيْهِ عَلَيْهِ حُلَّةٌ حَمْرَاءُ مَا رَأَيْتُ شَيْئًا قَطُّ أَحْسَنَ مِنْهُ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu aabaa iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan marbuw'ana ba'iyda maa bayna almankibayni 'aziyma aljummaai iilaa shahmaai audhunayhi 'alayhi hullaaun hamraa'u maa raaaytu shayiana qattu aahsana minhu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was of medium height, having broad shoulders, with his hair hanging down on the lobes of his ears. He put on a red mantle over him, and never have I seen anyone more handsome than Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، قَالَ مَا رَأَيْتُ مِنْ ذِي لِمَّةٍ أَحْسَنَ فِي حُلَّةٍ حَمْرَاءَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَعْرُهُ يَضْرِبُ مَنْكِبَيْهِ بَعِيدَ مَا بَيْنَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ وَلاَ بِالْقَصِيرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ لَهُ شَعَرٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i, qaala maa raaaytu min dhiy limmaain aahsana fiy hullaain hamraa'a min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sha'ruhu yadribu mankibayhi ba'iyda maa bayna almankibayni laysa bialttawiyli walaa bialqasiyri ‏.‏ qaala aabuw kuraybin lahu sha'arun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported:Never did I see anyone more handsome than Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) in the red mantle. His hair had been hanging down on the shoulders and his shoulders were very broad, and he was neither very tall nor short-statured. Ibn Kuraib said he had hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ، يُوسُفَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ وَجْهًا وَأَحْسَنَهُمْ خَلْقًا لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ الذَّاهِبِ وَلاَ بِالْقَصِيرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma bni, yuwsufa 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aahsana alnnaasi wajhana waaahsanahum khalqana laysa bialttawiyli aldhhaahibi walaa bialqasiyri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had the most handsome face amongst men and he had the best disposition and he was neither very tall nor short-statured
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ كَيْفَ كَانَ شَعَرُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ كَانَ شَعَرًا رَجِلاً لَيْسَ بِالْجَعْدِ وَلاَ السَّبِطِ بَيْنَ أُذُنَيْهِ وَعَاتِقِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa jariyru bnu haazimin, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala qultu laanasi bni maalikin kayfa kaana sha'aru rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala kaana sha'arana rajilaan laysa bialja'di walaa alssabiti bayna audhunayhi wa'aatiqihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Qatada reported:I asked Anas b. Malik: How was the hair of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Thereupon he said: His hair was neither very curly nor very straight, and they hung over his shoulders and earlobes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَضْرِبُ شَعَرُهُ مَنْكِبَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa habbaanu bnu hilaalin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yadribu sha'aruhu mankibayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that the hair of Allah's Messenger (may. peace be upon him) came upon his shoulders
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ شَعَرُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an humaydin, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana sha'aru rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa aansaafi audhunayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that the hair of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reached half of the earlobe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ بْنِ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ضَلِيعَ الْفَمِ أَشْكَلَ الْعَيْنِ مَنْهُوسَ الْعَقِبَيْنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِسِمَاكٍ مَا ضَلِيعُ الْفَمِ قَالَ عَظِيمُ الْفَمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ مَا أَشْكَلُ الْعَيْنِ قَالَ طَوِيلُ شَقِّ الْعَيْنِ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ مَا مَنْهُوسُ الْعَقِبِ قَالَ قَلِيلُ لَحْمِ الْعَقِبِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaaki bni harbin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna samuraaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm daliy'a alfami aashkala al'ayni manhuwsa al'aqibayni ‏.‏ qaala qultu lisimaakin maa daliy'u alfami qaala 'aziymu alfami ‏.‏ qaala qultu maa aashkalu al'ayni qaala tawiylu shaqqi al'ayni ‏.‏ qaala qultu maa manhuwsu al'aqibi qaala qaliylu lahmi al'aqibi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had a broad face with reddish (wide) eyes, and lean heels. Shu'ba reported:I said to Simak: What does this dali-ul-fam mean? And he said: This means broad face. I said: What does this ashkal mean? He said: Long in the slit of the eye. I said: What is this manhus-ul-aqibain? He said: It implies little flesh at the heels
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَرَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ كَانَ أَبْيَضَ مَلِيحَ الْوَجْهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمُ بْنُ الْحَجَّاجِ مَاتَ أَبُو الطُّفَيْلِ سَنَةَ مِائَةٍ وَكَانَ آخِرَ مَنْ مَاتَ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy alttufayli, qaala qultu lahu aaraaayta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am kaana aabyada maliyha alwajhi ‏.‏ qaala muslimu bnu alhajjaaji maata aabuw alttufayli sanaaa miaiaain wakaana akhira man maata min aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jurairi reported:I said to Abu Tufail: Did you see Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: Yes, he had a white handsome face. Muslim b. Hajjaj said: Abu Tufail who died in 100 Hijra was the last of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَمَا عَلَى وَجْهِ الأَرْضِ رَجُلٌ رَآهُ غَيْرِي ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَكَيْفَ رَأَيْتَهُ قَالَ كَانَ أَبْيَضَ مَلِيحًا مُقَصَّدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy alttufayli, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wamaa 'alaa wajhi alaardi rajulun raahu ghayriy ‏.‏ qaala faqultu lahu fakayfa raaaytahu qaala kaana aabyada maliyhana muqassadana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Tufail reported:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and there is one amongst the people of the earth who (are living at the present time and) had seen him except me. I said to him: How did you find him? He said: He had an elegant white color, and he was of an average height
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ إِدْرِيسَ، - قَالَ عَمْرٌو حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ الأَوْدِيُّ، - عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ هَلْ خَضَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ رَأَى مِنَ الشَّيْبِ إِلاَّ - قَالَ ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ كَأَنَّهُ يُقَلِّلُهُ - وَقَدْ خَضَبَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ بِالْحِنَّاءِ وَالْكَتَمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu jamiy'ana 'ani abni iidriysa, - qaala 'amrunw haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa alaawdiyyu, - 'an hishaamin, 'ani abni siyriyna, qaala suiila aanasu bnu maalikin hal khadaba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala iinnahu lam yakun raaaa mina alshhaybi iilaaa - qaala abnu iidriysa kaaannahu yuqalliluhu - waqad khadaba aabuw bakrin wa'umaru bialhinnaa'i waalkatami ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Sirin reported:Anas b. Malik was asked whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyed his hair. He said: He had not become old enough to have white hair. Ibn Idris said that he had a few white hair. Abu Bakr and Umar, however, dyed hair with hina' (henna)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ هَلْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَضَبَ فَقَالَ لَمْ يَبْلُغِ الْخِضَابَ كَانَ فِي لِحْيَتِهِ شَعَرَاتٌ بِيضٌ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَكَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَخْضِبُ قَالَ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ بِالْحِنَّاءِ وَالْكَتَمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakkaari bni alrrayyaani, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu zakariyyaa'a, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, 'ani abni siyriyna, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin hal kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khadaba faqaala lam yablughi alkhidaaba kaana fiy lihyatihi sha'araatun biydun ‏.‏ qaala qultu lahu aakaana aabuw bakrin yakhdibu qaala faqaala na'am bialhinnaa'i waalkatami ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Sirin reported:I asked Anas b. Malik whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyed his hair. He said: He had not reached the stage when (he needed) dyeing (of his white hair). He had a few white hair in his beard. I said to him: Did Abu Bakr dye his hair? He said: Yes, with hina' (henna)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ أَسَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ أَخَضَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَرَ مِنَ الشَّيْبِ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu aasadin, haddathanaa wuhaybu bnu khaalidin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, qaala saaaltu aanasa bna maalikin aakhadaba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala iinnahu lam yara mina alshhaybi iilaaa qaliylaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Sirin reported:I asked Anas b. Malik whether Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) dyed his hair. He said: He had but little white hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، قَالَ سُئِلَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ عَنْ خِضَابِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَوْ شِئْتُ أَنْ أَعُدَّ شَمَطَاتٍ كُنَّ فِي رَأْسِهِ فَعَلْتُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَمْ يَخْتَضِبْ وَقَدِ اخْتَضَبَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ بِالْحِنَّاءِ وَالْكَتَمِ وَاخْتَضَبَ عُمَرُ بِالْحِنَّاءِ بَحْتًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa thaabitun, qaala suiila aanasu bnu maalikin 'an khidaabi alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala law shiitu aan aa'udda shamataatin kunna fiy raasihi fa'altu ‏.‏ waqaala lam yakhtadib waqadi akhtadaba aabuw bakrin bialhinnaa'i waalkatami waakhtadaba 'umaru bialhinnaa'i bahtana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thabit reported that Anas b. Malik was asked about the dyeing (of the hair of) Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Thereupon he said.:(They were so few) that if I so liked I could count their number in his head, and he further said: (That is) he did not dye. Abu Bakr, however, dyed them and so did 'Umar dye them with pure henna
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ يُكْرَهُ أَنْ يَنْتِفَ الرَّجُلُ، الشَّعْرَةَ الْبَيْضَاءَ مِنْ رَأْسِهِ وَلِحْيَتِهِ - قَالَ - وَلَمْ يَخْتَضِبْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّمَا كَانَ الْبَيَاضُ فِي عَنْفَقَتِهِ وَفِي الصُّدْغَيْنِ وَفِي الرَّأْسِ نَبْذٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa almuthannaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala yukrahu aan yantifa alrrajulu, alshha'raaa albaydaa'a min raasihi walihyatihi - qaala - walam yakhtadib rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iinnamaa kaana albayaadu fiy 'anfaqatihi wafiy alssudghayni wafiy alrraasi nabdhun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik did not like that a person should pick out his white hair from his head or beard, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not dye, and there was some whiteness in his hair at his chin, on his temples and very little on his head
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُثَنَّى، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi, haddathanaa almuthannaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muthanna through the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي دَاوُدَ، قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خُلَيْدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا إِيَاسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّهُ سُئِلَ عَنْ شَيْبِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَا شَانَهُ اللَّهُ بِبَيْضَاءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin waaahmadu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi jamiy'ana 'an aabiy daawuda, qaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu daawuda, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an khulaydi bni ja'farin, sami'a aabaa iiyaasin, 'an aanasin, aannahu suiila 'an shaybi alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala maa shaanahu alllahu bibaydaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas (b. Malik) was asked about the old age of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He said:Allah did not blemish him with white hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ، يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم هَذِهِ مِنْهُ بَيْضَاءَ وَوَضَعَ زُهَيْرٌ بَعْضَ أَصَابِعِهِ عَلَى عَنْفَقَتِهِ قِيلَ لَهُ مِثْلُ مَنْ أَنْتَ يَوْمَئِذٍ قَالَ أَبْرِي النَّبْلَ وَأَرِيشُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw iishaaqa, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu, yahyaa aakhbaranaa aabuw khaythamaaa, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aabiy juhayfaaa, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hadhihi minhu baydaa'a wawada'a zuhayrun ba'da aasaabi'ihi 'alaa 'anfaqatihi qiyla lahu mithlu man aanta yawmaiidhin qaala aabriy alnnabla waaariyshuhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Juhaifa reported:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having some whiteness (in hair) at this place, and Zuhair placed one of his fingers at his chin. Juhaifa was asked how old he had been at that time. He said: I made arrows and put feathers to them (i. e. I had passed my childhood)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَبْيَضَ قَدْ شَابَ كَانَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ يُشْبِهُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa waasilu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an aabiy juhayfaaa, qaala raaaytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aabyada qad shaaba kaana alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin yushbihuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Juhaifa reported:I saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he had white complexion and had some white hair, and Hasan b. 'Ali resembled him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، وَخَالِدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، بِهَذَا وَلَمْ يَقُولُوا أَبْيَضَ قَدْ شَابَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, wakhaalidu bnu 'abdi alllahi, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, kulluhum 'an iismaa'iyla, 'an aabiy juhayfaaa, bihadhaa walam yaquwluwa aabyada qad shaaba ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Juhaifa with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكِ، بْنِ حَرْبٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، سُئِلَ عَنْ شَيْبِ النَّبِيِّ، صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ كَانَ إِذَا دَهَنَ رَأْسَهُ لَمْ يُرَ مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ وَإِذَا لَمْ يَدْهُنْ رُئِيَ مِنْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, sulaymaanu bnu daawuda haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaaki, bni harbin qaala sami'tu jaabira bna samuraaa, suiila 'an shaybi alnnabiyyi, sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala kaana iidhaa dahana raasahu lam yura minhu shaa'un waiidhaa lam yadhun ruiiya minhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura was asked about the old age of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). He said:When he oiled his head nothing was seen (as a mark of old age) and when he did not apply oil something (of the old age) became visible
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِسْرَائِيلَ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ شَمِطَ مُقَدَّمُ رَأْسِهِ وَلِحْيَتِهِ وَكَانَ إِذَا ادَّهَنَ لَمْ يَتَبَيَّنْ وَإِذَا شَعِثَ رَأْسُهُ تَبَيَّنَ وَكَانَ كَثِيرَ شَعْرِ اللِّحْيَةِ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ وَجْهُهُ مِثْلُ السَّيْفِ قَالَ لاَ بَلْ كَانَ مِثْلَ الشَّمْسِ وَالْقَمَرِ وَكَانَ مُسْتَدِيرًا وَرَأَيْتُ الْخَاتَمَ عِنْدَ كَتِفِهِ مِثْلَ بَيْضَةِ الْحَمَامَةِ يُشْبِهُ جَسَدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an iisraaiiyla, 'an simaakin, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna samuraaa, yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad shamita muqaddamu raasihi walihyatihi wakaana iidhaa addahana lam yatabayyan waiidhaa sha'itha raasuhu tabayyana wakaana kathiyra sha'ri alllihyaai faqaala rajulun wajhuhu mithlu alssayfi qaala laa bal kaana mithla alshhamsi waalqamari wakaana mustadiyrana waraaaytu alkhaatama 'inda katifihi mithla baydaai alhamaamaai yushbihu jasadahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Samura reported that there had appeared some whiteness on the front part of the head and beard of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When he applied oil, it did not become visible, but when he did not (apply) oil, it became apparent. And he had a thick beard. A person said:His face was as (bright) as the sword. Thereupon he (Jabir) said: No, it was round and like the sun and the moon. And I saw the seal near his shoulder of the size of a pigeon's egg and its color was the same as that of his body
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ سَمُرَةَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ خَاتِمًا فِي ظَهْرِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَأَنَّهُ بَيْضَةُ حَمَامٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an simaakin, qaala sami'tu jaabira bna samuraaa, qaala raaaytu khaatimana fiy zahri rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaaannahu baydaau hamaamin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir. Samura reported:I saw the seal on his back as if it were a pigeon's egg
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُوسَى، أَخْبَرَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ سِمَاكٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu muwsaa, aakhbaranaa hasanu bnu saalihin, 'an simaakin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Simak with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنِ الْجَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ السَّائِبَ بْنَ يَزِيدَ، يَقُولُ ذَهَبَتْ بِي خَالَتِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ ابْنَ أُخْتِي وَجِعٌ ‏.‏ فَمَسَحَ رَأْسِي وَدَعَا لِي بِالْبَرَكَةِ ثُمَّ تَوَضَّأَ فَشَرِبْتُ مِنْ وَضُوئِهِ ثُمَّ قُمْتُ خَلْفَ ظَهْرِهِ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى خَاتِمِهِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ مِثْلَ زِرِّ الْحَجَلَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, qaalaa haddathanaa haatimun, - wahuwa abnu iismaa'iyla - 'ani alja'di bni 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala sami'tu alssaaiiba bna yaziyda, yaquwlu dhahabat biy khaalatiy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna abna aukhtiy waji'un ‏.‏ famasaha raasiy wada'aa liy bialbarakaai thumma tawaddaaa fasharibtu min waduwiihi thumma qumtu khalfa zahrihi fanazartu iilaa khaatimihi bayna katifayhi mithla zirri alhajalaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: As-Sa'ib b. Yazid reported:My mother's sister took me to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, here is the son of my sister and he is ailing. He touched my head and invoked blessings upon me. He then performed ablution and I drank the water left from his ablution; then I stood behind him and I saw the seal between his shoulders
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَامِدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْبَكْرَاوِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سَرْجِسَ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَكَلْتُ مَعَهُ خُبْزًا وَلَحْمًا - أَوْ قَالَ ثَرِيدًا - قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَسْتَغْفَرَ لَكَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ نَعَمْ وَلَكَ ثُمَّ تَلاَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏ وَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنْبِكَ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَالْمُؤْمِنَاتِ‏}‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ دُرْتُ خَلْفَهُ فَنَظَرْتُ إِلَى خَاتَمِ النُّبُوَّةِ بَيْنَ كَتِفَيْهِ عِنْدَ نَاغِضِ كَتِفِهِ الْيُسْرَى جُمْعًا عَلَيْهِ خِيلاَنٌ كَأَمْثَالِ الثَّآلِيلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin, haddathanaa hammaadun ya'niy abna zaydin, h wahaddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, kilaahumaa 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, h wahaddathaniy haamidu bnu 'umara albakraawiyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin - haddathanaa 'aasimun, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni sarjisa, qaala raaaytu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waaakaltu ma'ahu khubzana walahmana - aaw qaala thariydana - qaala faqultu lahu aastaghfara laka alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala na'am walaka thumma talaa hadhihi alayaaa ‏{‏ waastaghfir lidhanbika walilmuuminiyna waalmuuminaati‏}‏ qaala thumma durtu khalfahu fanazartu iilaa khaatami alnnubuwwaai bayna katifayhi 'inda naaghidi katifihi alyusraa jum'ana 'alayhi khiylaanun kaaamthaali althhaaliyli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Sarjis reported:I saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and ate with him bread and meat, or he said Tharid (bread soaked in soup). I said to him: Did Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) seek forgiveness for you? He said: Yes, and for you, and he then recited this verse:" Ask forgiveness for thy sin and for the believing men and believing women" (xlvii. 19). I then went after him and saw the Seal of Prophethood between his shoulders on the left side of his shoulder having spots on it like moles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَهُ يَقُولُ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيْسَ بِالطَّوِيلِ الْبَائِنِ وَلاَ بِالْقَصِيرِ وَلَيْسَ بِالأَبْيَضِ الأَمْهَقِ وَلاَ بِالآدَمِ وَلاَ بِالْجَعْدِ الْقَطَطِ وَلاَ بِالسَّبِطِ بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ أَرْبَعِينَ سَنَةً فَأَقَامَ بِمَكَّةَ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ وَبِالْمَدِينَةِ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ وَتَوَفَّاهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى رَأْسِ سِتِّينَ سَنَةً وَلَيْسَ فِي رَأْسِهِ وَلِحْيَتِهِ عِشْرُونَ شَعْرَةً بَيْضَاءَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an rabiy'aaa bni aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu sami'ahu yaquwlu kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laysa bialttawiyli albaaiini walaa bialqasiyri walaysa bialaabyadi alaamhaqi walaa bialadami walaa bialja'di alqatati walaa bialssabiti ba'athahu alllahu 'alaa raasi aarba'iyna sanaaan faaaqaama bimakkaaa 'ashra siniyna wabialmadiynaai 'ashra siniyna watawaffaahu alllahu 'alaa raasi sittiyna sanaaan walaysa fiy raasihi walihyatihi 'ishruwna sha'raaan baydaa'a ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was neither very conspicuously tall nor short-statured, and his color was neither glaringly white nor brown; his hair was neither very curly nor very straight; Allah commissioned him (as a Prophet) when he had reached the age of forty years, and he stayed in Mecca for ten years and for ten years in Medina; Allah took him away when he had just reached the age of sixty, and there had not been twenty white hair in his head and beard
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ، بِلاَلٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا كَانَ أَزْهَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, ya'nuwna abna ja'farin h wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu, bilaalin kilaahumaa 'an rabiy'aaa, - ya'niy abna aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an aanasi bni maalikin, ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi maaliki bni aanasin wazaada fiy hadiythihimaa kaana aazhara ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Anas b. Malik with this addition that instead of the word al-Amhaq there is the word Azhar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الرَّازِيُّ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو حَدَّثَنَا حَكَّامُ بْنُ سَلْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، بْنُ زَائِدَةَ عَنِ الزُّبَيْرِ بْنِ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ وَعُمَرُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ghassaana alrraaziyyu, muhammadu bnu 'amrinw haddathanaa hakkaamu bnu salmin, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, bnu zaaiidaaa 'ani alzzubayri bni 'adiyyin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qubida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna waaabuw bakrin wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna wa'umaru wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he was sixty-three years old, and so was the case with Abu Bakr, and so was the case with Umar who was also sixty-three (when he died)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ، بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُوُفِّيَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ سَنَةً ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, qaala haddathaniy 'uqaylu, bnu khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tuwuffiya wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna sanaaan ‏.‏ waqaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi bimithli dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he had attained the age of sixty-three. And a hadith like this had been transmitted on the authority of Sa'id b. Musayyib
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَبَّادُ بْنُ مُوسَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ عُقَيْلٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'abbaadu bnu muwsaa, qaalaa haddathanaa talhaau bnu yahyaa, 'an yuwnusa bni yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana mithla hadiythi 'uqaylin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab through the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْهُذَلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعُرْوَةَ كَمْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَكَّةَ قَالَ عَشْرًا ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw ma'marin, iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma alhudhaliyyu haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, qaala qultu li'urwaaa kam kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bimakkaaa qaala 'ashrana ‏.‏ qaala qultu faiinna abna 'abbaasin yaquwlu thalaatha 'ashraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr reported:I said to 'Urwa: How long did Allah's Apostle - (ﷺ) stay in Mecca? He said: For ten years. I said: Ibn 'Abbas says (that he stayed in Mecca) for thirteen years
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ قُلْتُ لِعُرْوَةَ كَمْ لَبِثَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَكَّةَ قَالَ عَشْرًا ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَإِنَّ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ يَقُولُ بِضْعَ عَشْرَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَفَّرَهُ وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا أَخَذَهُ مِنْ قَوْلِ الشَّاعِرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, qaala qultu li'urwaaa kam labitha alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm bimakkaaa qaala 'ashrana ‏.‏ qultu faiinna abna 'abbaasin yaquwlu bid'a 'ashraaa ‏.‏ qaala faghaffarahu waqaala iinnamaa aakhadhahu min qawli alshhaa'iri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amr reported:I said to 'Urwa: How long did Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) stay in Mecca? He said: For ten years. I said: Ibn Abbas says it is some years above ten. He ('Urwa) sought forgiveness for him and said: His statement is based on the verse of a poet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ رَوْحِ بْنِ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَكَثَ بِمَكَّةَ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ وَتُوُفِّيَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wahaaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, 'an rawhi bni 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu iishaaqa, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm makatha bimakkaaa thalaatha 'ashraaa watuwuffiya wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed in Mecca for thirteen years and he died when he had attained the age of sixty three years
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَبِي جَمْرَةَ الضُّبَعِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَكَّةَ ثَلاَثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ وَبِالْمَدِينَةِ عَشْرًا وَمَاتَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ سَنَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa bishru bnu alssariyyi, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aabiy jamraaa aldduba'iyyi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala aaqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimakkaaa thalaatha 'ashraaa sanaaan yuwhaa iilayhi wabialmadiynaai 'ashrana wamaata wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna sanaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed in Mecca for thirteen years (after he had received revelation) and stayed in Medina for ten years, and he was sixty-three when he died
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبَانَ الْجُعْفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَلاَّمٌ أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ فَذَكَرُوا سِنِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ بَعْضُ الْقَوْمِ كَانَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ أَكْبَرَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ وَمَاتَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ وَقُتِلَ عُمَرُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ يُقَالُ لَهُ عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ قَالَ كُنَّا قُعُودًا عِنْدَ مُعَاوِيَةَ فَذَكَرُوا سِنِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مُعَاوِيَةُ قُبِضَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ سَنَةً وَمَاتَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ وَقُتِلَ عُمَرُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara bni muhammadi bni aabaana alju'fiyyu, haddathanaa salaaamun aabuw alaahwasi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala kuntu jaalisana ma'a 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa fadhakaruwa siniy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ba'du alqawmi kaana aabuw bakrin aakbara min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi qubida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna wamaata aabuw bakrin wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna waqutila 'umaru wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna ‏.‏ qaala faqaala rajulun mina alqawmi yuqaalu lahu 'aamiru bnu sa'din haddathanaa jariyrun qaala kunnaa qu'uwdana 'inda mu'aawiyaaa fadhakaruwa siniy rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala mu'aawiyaau qubida rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna sanaaan wamaata aabuw bakrin wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna waqutila 'umaru wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ishaq reported:I was sitting with 'Abdullah b. 'Utba and there was a discussion about the age of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Some of the persons said: Abu Bakr was older than Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). 'Abdullah said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he was sixty-three, and Abu Bakr died when he was sixty-three and so 'Umar fell as a martyr when he was sixty-three. A person from the people who was called 'Amir b. Sa'd reported that Jabir had said: We were sitting with Mu'awiya that there was a discussion about the age of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Thereupon Mu'awiya said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he had attained the age of sixty-three, and Abu Bakr died when he had attained the age of sixty-three, and Umar fell as a martyr when he had attained the age of sixty-three
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ أَبَا إِسْحَاقَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ الْبَجَلِيِّ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ مُعَاوِيَةَ، يَخْطُبُ فَقَالَ مَاتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَأَنَا ابْنُ ثَلاَثٍ وَسِتِّينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu, ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, sami'tu aabaa iishaaqa, yuhaddithu 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din albajaliyyi, 'an jariyrin, aannahu sami'a mu'aawiyaaa, yakhtubu faqaala maata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna waaabuw bakrin wa'umaru waaanaa abnu thalaathin wasittiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that he heard Mu'awiya say in his address that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died at the age of sixty-three, so was the case with Abu Bakr and 'Umar, and I (am now) sixty-three
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَمَّارٍ، مَوْلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ كَمْ أَتَى لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمَ مَاتَ فَقَالَ مَا كُنْتُ أَحْسِبُ مِثْلَكَ مِنْ قَوْمِهِ يَخْفَى عَلَيْهِ ذَاكَ - قَالَ - قُلْتُ إِنِّي قَدْ سَأَلْتُ النَّاسَ فَاخْتَلَفُوا عَلَىَّ فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أَعْلَمَ قَوْلَكَ فِيهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَتَحْسُبُ قَالَ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمْسِكْ أَرْبَعِينَ بُعِثَ لَهَا خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ بِمَكَّةَ يَأْمَنُ وَيَخَافُ وَعَشْرَ مِنْ مُهَاجَرِهِ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy abnu minhaalin alddariyru, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu 'ubaydin, 'an 'ammaarin, mawlaa baniy haashimin qaala saaaltu abna 'abbaasin kam aataa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawma maata faqaala maa kuntu aahsibu mithlaka min qawmihi yakhfaa 'alayhi dhaaka - qaala - qultu iinniy qad saaaltu alnnaasa faakhtalafuwa 'alaaaa faaahbabtu aan aa'lama qawlaka fiyhi ‏.‏ qaala aatahsubu qaala qultu na'am ‏.‏ qaala aamsik aarba'iyna bu'itha lahaa khamsa 'ashraaa bimakkaaa yaamanu wayakhaafu wa'ashra min muhaajarihi iilaa almadiynaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ammar, the freed slave of Banu Hashim, reported:I asked Ibn 'Abbas how old was he when death overtook the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). He said: I little know that such a thing is not known to a man like you who belong to his people. He said: I asked people about it but they differed with me, and I liked to know your opinion about it. He said: Do you know counting? He said: Yes. He then said: Bear this in mind very well that he was commissioned (as a Prophet) at the age of forty, and he stayed in Mecca for fifteen years; sometime in peace and sometime in dread, and (lived) for ten years after his migration to Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ بْنُ سَوَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ يُونُسَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ زُرَيْعٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa shabaabaau bnu sawwaarin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an yuwnusa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi yaziyda bni zuray'in ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمَّارٌ، مَوْلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تُوُفِّيَ وَهُوَ ابْنُ خَمْسٍ وَسِتِّينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy nasru bnu 'aliyyin, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna mufaddalin - haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, haddathanaa 'ammaarun, mawlaa baniy haashimin haddathanaa abnu 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tuwuffiya wahuwa abnu khamsin wasittiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ammar, the freed slave of Banu Hashim, reported that Ibn 'Abbas said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died when he had attained the age of sixty-five
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an khaalidin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Khalid with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ أَبِي عَمَّارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَكَّةَ خَمْسَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً يَسْمَعُ الصَّوْتَ وَيَرَى الضَّوْءَ سَبْعَ سِنِينَ وَلاَ يَرَى شَيْئًا وَثَمَانَ سِنِينَ يُوحَى إِلَيْهِ وَأَقَامَ بِالْمَدِينَةِ عَشْرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa rawhun, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an 'ammaari bni aabiy 'ammaarin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala aaqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimakkaaa khamsa 'ashraaa sanaaan yasma'u alssawta wayaraa alddaw'a sab'a siniyna walaa yaraa shayiana wathamaana siniyna yuwhaa iilayhi waaaqaama bialmadiynaai 'ashrana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stayed in Mecca for fifteen years (after his advent as a Prophet) and he heard the voice of Gabriel and saw his radiance for seven years but did not see any visible form, and then received revelation for ten years, and he stayed in Medina for ten years
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ، بْنَ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَنَا أَحْمَدُ وَأَنَا الْمَاحِي الَّذِي يُمْحَى بِيَ الْكُفْرُ وَأَنَا الْحَاشِرُ الَّذِي يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ عَلَى عَقِبِي وَأَنَا الْعَاقِبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَالْعَاقِبُ الَّذِي لَيْسَ بَعْدَهُ نَبِيُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, sami'a muhammada, bna jubayri bni mut'imin 'an aabiyhi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aanaa muhammadun waaanaa aahmadu waaanaa almaahiy alladhiy yumhaa biya alkufru waaanaa alhaashiru alladhiy yuhsharu alnnaasu 'alaa 'aqibiy waaanaa al'aaqibu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waal'aaqibu alladhiy laysa ba'dahu nabiyyu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jubair b. Mut'im reported on the authority of his father that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I am Muhammad and I am Ahmad, and I am al-Mahi (the obliterator) by whom unbelief would be obliterated, and I am Hashir (the gatherer) at whose feet mankind will be gathered, and I am 'Aqib (the last to come) after whom there will be no Prophet
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لِي أَسْمَاءً أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَنَا أَحْمَدُ وَأَنَا الْمَاحِي الَّذِي يَمْحُو اللَّهُ بِيَ الْكُفْرَ وَأَنَا الْحَاشِرُ الَّذِي يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ عَلَى قَدَمَىَّ وَأَنَا الْعَاقِبُ الَّذِي لَيْسَ بَعْدَهُ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ سَمَّاهُ اللَّهُ رَءُوفًا رَحِيمًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an muhammadi bni jubayri bni mut'imin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna liy aasmaa'an aanaa muhammadun waaanaa aahmadu waaanaa almaahiy alladhiy yamhuw alllahu biya alkufra waaanaa alhaashiru alladhiy yuhsharu alnnaasu 'alaa qadamaaaa waaanaa al'aaqibu alladhiy laysa ba'dahu aahadun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqad sammaahu alllahu ra'uwfana rahiymana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jubair b. Mut'im reported on the authority of his father that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I have many names: I am Muhammad, I am Ahmad, I am al-Mahi through whom Allah obliterates unbelief, and I am Hashir (the gatherer) at whose feet people will be gathered, and I am 'Aqib (after whom there would be none), and Allah has named him as compassionate and merciful
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شُعَيْبٍ وَمَعْمَرٍ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عُقَيْلٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِلزُّهْرِيِّ وَمَا الْعَاقِبُ قَالَ الَّذِي لَيْسَ بَعْدَهُ نَبِيٌّ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ وَعُقَيْلٍ الْكَفَرَةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شُعَيْبٍ الْكُفْرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, qaala haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylun, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi, alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi shu'aybin wama'marin sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'uqaylin qaala qultu lilzzuhriyyi wamaa al'aaqibu qaala alladhiy laysa ba'dahu nabiyyun ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi ma'marin wa'uqaylin alkafaraaa ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi shu'aybin alkufra ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar (and the words are):I said to Zuhri: What does (the word) al-'Aqib imply? He said: One after whom there is no Prophet, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar and 'Uqail there is a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ عَمْرِو، بْنِ مُرَّةَ عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسَمِّي لَنَا نَفْسَهُ أَسْمَاءً فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ وَأَحْمَدُ وَالْمُقَفِّي وَالْحَاشِرُ وَنَبِيُّ التَّوْبَةِ وَنَبِيُّ الرَّحْمَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an 'amriw, bni murraaa 'an aabiy 'ubaydaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusammiy lanaa nafsahu aasmaa'an faqaala ‏ "‏ aanaa muhammadun waaahmadu waalmuqaffiy waalhaashiru wanabiyyu alttawbaai wanabiyyu alrrahmaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) mentioned many names of his and said:I am Muhammad, Ahmad. Muqaffi (the last in succession), Hashir, the Prophet of repentance, and the Prophet of Mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ صَنَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمْرًا فَتَرَخَّصَ فِيهِ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ نَاسًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فَكَأَنَّهُمْ كَرِهُوهُ وَتَنَزَّهُوا عَنْهُ فَبَلَغَهُ ذَلِكَ فَقَامَ خَطِيبًا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا بَالُ رِجَالٍ بَلَغَهُمْ عَنِّي أَمْرٌ تَرَخَّصْتُ فِيهِ فَكَرِهُوهُ وَتَنَزَّهُوا عَنْهُ فَوَاللَّهِ لأَنَا أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِاللَّهِ وَأَشَدُّهُمْ لَهُ خَشْيَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat sana'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamrana fatarakhhasa fiyhi fabalagha dhalika naasana min aashaabihi fakaaannahum karihuwhu watanazzahuwa 'anhu fabalaghahu dhalika faqaama khatiybana faqaala ‏ "‏ maa baalu rijaalin balaghahum 'anniy aamrun tarakhhastu fiyhi fakarihuwhu watanazzahuwa 'anhu fawaalllahi laanaa aa'lamuhum bialllahi waaashadduhum lahu khashyaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did an act, and held it to be valid. This news reached some persons amongst his Companions (and it was felt) that they did not approve of it and avoided (it). This reaction of theirs was conveyed to him. He stood to deliver an address; and said:What has happened to the people to whom there was conveyed on my behalf a matter for which I granted permission and they disapproved it and avoided it? By Allah, I have the best knowledge of Allah amongst them, and I fear Him most amongst them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ غِيَاثٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِإِسْنَادِ جَرِيرٍ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa hafsun ya'niy abna ghiyaathin, h wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, biiisnaadi jariyrin nahwa hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash through a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ رَخَّصَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَمْرٍ فَتَنَزَّهَ عَنْهُ نَاسٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَغَضِبَ حَتَّى بَانَ الْغَضَبُ فِي وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا بَالُ أَقْوَامٍ يَرْغَبُونَ عَمَّا رُخِّصَ لِي فِيهِ فَوَاللَّهِ لأَنَا أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِاللَّهِ وَأَشَدُّهُمْ لَهُ خَشْيَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an muslimin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat rakhhasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy aamrin fatanazzaha 'anhu naasun mina alnnaasi fabalagha dhalika alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faghadiba hattaa baana alghadabu fiy wajhihi thumma qaala ‏ "‏ maa baalu aaqwaamin yarghabuwna 'ammaa rukhhisa liy fiyhi fawaalllahi laanaa aa'lamuhum bialllahi waaashadduhum lahu khashyaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) granted permission for doing a thing, but some persons amongst the people avoided it. This was conveyed to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and he was so much annoyed that the sign of his anger appeared on his face. He then said:What has happened to the people that they avoid that for which permission has been granted to me? By Allah, I have the best knowledge of Allah amongst them, and fear Him most amongst them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ خَاصَمَ الزُّبَيْرَ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي شِرَاجِ الْحَرَّةِ الَّتِي يَسْقُونَ بِهَا النَّخْلَ فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ سَرِّحِ الْمَاءَ ‏.‏ يَمُرُّ فَأَبَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَاخْتَصَمُوا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِلزُّبَيْرِ ‏"‏ اسْقِ يَا زُبَيْرُ ثُمَّ أَرْسِلِ الْمَاءَ إِلَى جَارِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَغَضِبَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنْ كَانَ ابْنَ عَمَّتِكَ فَتَلَوَّنَ وَجْهُ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا زُبَيْرُ اسْقِ ثُمَّ احْبِسِ الْمَاءَ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ إِلَى الْجَدْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ الزُّبَيْرُ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَحْسِبُ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ نَزَلَتْ فِي ذَلِكَ ‏{‏ فَلاَ وَرَبِّكَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ حَتَّى يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ لاَ يَجِدُوا فِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ حَرَجًا‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, aanna 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri, haddathahu aanna rajulaan mina alaansaari khaasama alzzubayra 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy shiraaji alharraai allatiy yasquwna bihaa alnnakhla faqaala alaansaariyyu sarrihi almaa'a ‏.‏ yamurru faaabaa 'alayhim faakhtasamuwa 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lilzzubayri ‏"‏ asqi yaa zubayru thumma aarsili almaa'a iilaa jaarika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faghadiba alaansaariyyu faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aan kaana abna 'ammatika fatalawwana wajhu nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa zubayru asqi thumma ahbisi almaa'a hattaa yarji'a iilaa aljadri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala alzzubayru waalllahi iinniy laahsibu hadhihi alayaaa nazalat fiy dhalika ‏{‏ falaa warabbika laa yuuminuwna hattaa yuhakkimuwka fiymaa shajara baynahum thumma laa yajiduwa fiy aanfusihim harajana‏}‏
verses.translation: Urwa b. Zubair reported that 'Abdullah b. Zubair had narrated to him that a person from the Ansar disputed with Zubair in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in regard to the watering places of Harra from which they watered the date-palms. The Ansari said:Let the water flow, but he (Zubair) refused to do this and the dispute was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and he said to Zubair: Zubair, water (your date-palms), then let the water flow to your neighbor. The Ansari was enraged and said: Allah's Messenger, (you have given this decision) for he is the son of your father's sister. The face of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) underwent a change, and then said: Zubair, water (your date-palms), then hold it until it rises up to the walls. Zubair said: I think, by Allah, that this verse:" Nay, by the Lord, they will not (really) (believe) until they make thee a judge of what is in dispute among them, and find in this no dislike of what thou decidest and submit with full submission" (iv)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، قَالاَ كَانَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَا نَهَيْتُكُمْ عَنْهُ فَاجْتَنِبُوهُ وَمَا أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِهِ فَافْعَلُوا مِنْهُ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا أَهْلَكَ الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ كَثْرَةُ مَسَائِلِهِمْ وَاخْتِلاَفُهُمْ عَلَى أَنْبِيَائِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, wasa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, qaalaa kaana aabuw hurayraaa yuhaddithu aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ maa nahaytukum 'anhu faajtanibuwhu wamaa aamartukum bihi faaf'aluwa minhu maa astata'tum faiinnamaa aahlaka alladhiyna min qablikum kathraau masaaiilihim waakhtilaafuhum 'alaa aanbiyaaiihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Avoid that which I forbid you to do and do that which I command you to do to the best of your capacity. Verily the people before you went to their doom because they had put too many questions to their Prophets and then disagreed with their teachings
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَلَمَةَ، - وَهُوَ مَنْصُورُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ الْخُزَاعِيُّ - أَخْبَرَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu aahmada bni aabiy khalafin, haddathanaa aabuw salamaaa, - wahuwa mansuwru bnu salamaaa alkhuzaa'iyyu - aakhbaranaa laythun, 'an yaziyda bni alhaadi, 'ani abni shihaabin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu sawaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shihab with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
