verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ يَعْنِي الْحِزَامِيَّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ قَالَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ ذَرُونِي مَا تَرَكْتُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ هَمَّامٍ ‏"‏ مَا تُرِكْتُمْ فَإِنَّمَا هَلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرُوا نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ عَنْ سَعِيدٍ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu, numayrin haddathanaa aabiy kilaahumaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau ya'niy alhizaamiyya, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, h wahaddathanaahu 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, kulluhum qaala 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ dharuwniy maa taraktukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi hammaamin ‏"‏ maa turiktum faiinnamaa halaka man kaana qablakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakaruwa nahwa hadiythi alzzuhriyyi 'an sa'iydin waaabiy salamaaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated by Abu Huraira through a different chain of transmitters (and the words are) that he reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:Abandon that which I have asked you to abandon, for the people before you went to their doom (for asking too many questions)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ، سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَعْظَمَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ جُرْمًا مَنْ سَأَلَ عَنْ شَىْءٍ لَمْ يُحَرَّمْ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَحُرِّمَ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ أَجْلِ مَسْأَلَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'aamiri bni, sa'din 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna aa'zama almuslimiyna fiy almuslimiyna jurmana man saaala 'an shaa'in lam yuharram 'alaa almuslimiyna fahurrima 'alayhim min aajli masaalatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The greatest sinner amongst the Muslims is one who asked about a thing (from Allah's Apostle) which had not been forbidden for the Muslims and it was forbidden for them because of his persistently asking about it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، قَالَ - أَحْفَظُهُ كَمَا أَحْفَظُ بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ - الزُّهْرِيُّ عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَعْظَمُ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فِي الْمُسْلِمِينَ جُرْمًا مَنْ سَأَلَ عَنْ أَمْرٍ لَمْ يُحَرَّمْ فَحُرِّمَ عَلَى النَّاسِ مِنْ أَجْلِ مَسْأَلَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, qaala - aahfazuhu kamaa aahfazu bismi alllahi alrrahmani alrrahiymi - alzzuhriyyu 'an 'aamiri bni sa'din 'an aabiyhi qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aa'zamu almuslimiyna fiy almuslimiyna jurmana man saaala 'an aamrin lam yuharram fahurrima 'alaa alnnaasi min aajli masaalatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Amir b. Sa'd and the words are. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The greatest sinner of the Muslims amongst Muslims is one who asked about a certain thing which had not been prohibited and it was prohibited because of his asking about it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ، حُمَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ مَعْمَرٍ ‏ "‏ رَجُلٌ سَأَلَ عَنْ شَىْءٍ وَنَقَّرَ عَنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ سَعْدًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu, humaydin aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wazaada fiy hadiythi ma'marin ‏ "‏ rajulun saaala 'an shaa'in wanaqqara 'anhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala fiy hadiythi yuwnusa 'aamiri bni sa'din aannahu sami'a sa'dana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters and with this addition:" A person asked about a thing from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and he indulged in hair-splitting
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ السُّلَمِيُّ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ اللُّؤْلُؤِيُّ، - وَأَلْفَاظُهُمْ مُتَقَارِبَةٌ قَالَ مَحْمُودٌ حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ، - أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ بَلَغَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَصْحَابِهِ شَىْءٌ فَخَطَبَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ عُرِضَتْ عَلَىَّ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ فَلَمْ أَرَ كَالْيَوْمِ فِي الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ وَلَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ مَا أَعْلَمُ لَضَحِكْتُمْ قَلِيلاً وَلَبَكَيْتُمْ كَثِيرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا أَتَى عَلَى أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمٌ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُ - قَالَ - غَطَّوْا رُءُوسَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ خَنِينٌ - قَالَ - فَقَامَ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ رَضِينَا بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيًّا - قَالَ - فَقَامَ ذَاكَ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ مَنْ أَبِي قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبُوكَ فُلاَنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَسْأَلُوا عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ إِنْ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mahmuwdu bnu ghaylaana, wamuhammadu bnu qudaamaaa alssulamiyyu, wayahyaa bnu muhammadin allluuluuiyyu, - waaalfaazuhum mutaqaaribaaun qaala mahmuwdun haddathanaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa alnnadru, - aakhbaranaa shu'baau, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu aanasin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala balagha rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aashaabihi shaa'un fakhataba faqaala ‏"‏ 'uridat 'alaaaa aljannaau waalnnaaru falam aara kaalyawmi fiy alkhayri waalshharri walaw ta'lamuwna maa aa'lamu ladahiktum qaliylaan walabakaytum kathiyrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famaa aataa 'alaa aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmun aashaddu minhu - qaala - ghattawa ru'uwsahum walahum khaniynun - qaala - faqaama 'umaru faqaala radiynaa bialllahi rabbana wabialiislaami diynana wabimuhammadin nabiyyana - qaala - faqaama dhaaka alrrajulu faqaala man aabiy qaala ‏"‏ aabuwka fulaanun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fanazalat ‏{‏ yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa laa tasaaluwa 'an aashyaa'a iin tubda lakum tasuukum‏}‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that something was conveyed to him (the Holy prophet) about his Companions, so he addressed them and said:Paradise and Hell were presented to me and I have never seen the good and evil as (I did) today. And if you were to know you would have wept more and laughed less. He (the narrator) said: There was nothing more burdensome for the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) than this. They covered their heads and the sound of weeping was heard from them. Then there stood up 'Umar and he said: We are well pleased with Allah as our Lord, with Islam as our code of life and with Muhammad as our Apostle, and it was at that time that a person stood up and he said: Who is my father? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Your father is so and so; and there was revealed the verse:" O you who believe, do not ask about matters which, if they were to be made manifest to you (in terms of law), might cause to you harm" (v)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ رِبْعِيٍّ الْقَيْسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ أَبِي قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبُوكَ فُلاَنٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَسْأَلُوا عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ إِنْ تُبْدَ لَكُمْ تَسُؤْكُمْ‏}‏ تَمَامَ الآيَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu ma'mari bni rib'iyyin alqaysiyyu, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaraniy muwsaa bnu aanasin, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yaquwlu qaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi man aabiy qaala ‏"‏ aabuwka fulaanun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wanazalat ‏{‏ yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa laa tasaaluwa 'an aashyaa'a iin tubda lakum tasuukum‏}‏ tamaama alayaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that a person said:Allah's Messenger, who is my father? And he said: Your father is so and so, and there was revealed this verse:" Do not ask about matters which, if they were to be made manifest to you, might cause you harm" (v)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ حِينَ زَاغَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَصَلَّى لَهُمْ صَلاَةَ الظُّهْرِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَامَ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ فَذَكَرَ السَّاعَةَ وَذَكَرَ أَنَّ قَبْلَهَا أُمُورًا عِظَامًا ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يَسْأَلَنِي عَنْ شَىْءٍ فَلْيَسْأَلْنِي عَنْهُ فَوَاللَّهِ لاَ تَسْأَلُونَنِي عَنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ أَخْبَرْتُكُمْ بِهِ مَا دُمْتُ فِي مَقَامِي هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ فَأَكْثَرَ النَّاسُ الْبُكَاءَ حِينَ سَمِعُوا ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَكْثَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَقُولَ ‏"‏ سَلُونِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ حُذَافَةَ فَقَالَ مَنْ أَبِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبُوكَ حُذَافَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَكْثَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ أَنْ يَقُولَ ‏"‏ سَلُونِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بَرَكَ عُمَرُ فَقَالَ رَضِينَا بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً - قَالَ - فَسَكَتَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ قَالَ عُمَرُ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوْلَى وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ لَقَدْ عُرِضَتْ عَلَىَّ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ آنِفًا فِي عُرْضِ هَذَا الْحَائِطِ فَلَمْ أَرَ كَالْيَوْمِ فِي الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ قَالَ قَالَتْ أُمُّ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ مَا سَمِعْتُ بِابْنٍ قَطُّ أَعَقَّ مِنْكَ أَأَمِنْتَ أَنْ تَكُونَ أُمُّكَ قَدْ قَارَفَتْ بَعْضَ مَا تُقَارِفُ نِسَاءُ أَهْلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ فَتَفْضَحَهَا عَلَى أَعْيُنِ النَّاسِ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ حُذَافَةَ وَاللَّهِ لَوْ أَلْحَقَنِي بِعَبْدٍ أَسْوَدَ لَلَحِقْتُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni harmalaaa bni 'imraana alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu, wahbin aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja hiyna zaaghati alshhamsu fasallaa lahum salaaaa alzzuhri falammaa sallama qaama 'alaa alminbari fadhakara alssaa'aaa wadhakara aanna qablahaa aumuwrana 'izaamana thumma qaala ‏"‏ man aahabba aan yasaalaniy 'an shaa'in falyasaalniy 'anhu fawaalllahi laa tasaaluwnaniy 'an shaa'in iilaaa aakhbartukum bihi maa dumtu fiy maqaamiy hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aanasu bnu maalikin faaakthara alnnaasu albukaa'a hiyna sami'uwa dhalika min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaakthara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan yaquwla ‏"‏ saluwniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama 'abdu alllahi bnu hudhaafaaa faqaala man aabiy yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ aabuwka hudhaafaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa aakthara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min aan yaquwla ‏"‏ saluwniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ baraka 'umaru faqaala radiynaa bialllahi rabbana wabialiislaami diynana wabimuhammadin rasuwlaan - qaala - fasakata rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna qaala 'umaru dhalika thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aawlaa waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi laqad 'uridat 'alaaaa aljannaau waalnnaaru anifana fiy 'urdi hadhaa alhaaiiti falam aara kaalyawmi fiy alkhayri waalshharri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa qaala qaalat aummu 'abdi alllahi bni hudhaafaaa li'abdi alllahi bni hudhaafaaa maa sami'tu biabnin qattu aa'aqqa minka aaaaminta aan takuwna aummuka qad qaarafat ba'da maa tuqaarifu nisaa'u aahli aljaahiliyyaai fatafdahahaa 'alaa aa'yuni alnnaasi qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu hudhaafaaa waalllahi law aalhaqaniy bi'abdin aaswada lalahiqtuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon him stood when the sun had passed the meridian and he led them noon prayer and after observing salutations (completing the prayer) he stood upon the pulpit and talked about the Last Hour and made a mention of the important facts prior to it and then said:He who desires to ask anything from me let him ask me about it. By Allah, I shall not move from this place so long as I do not inform you about that which you ask. Anas b. Malik said: People began to shed tears profusely when they heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said it repeatedly: You ask me. Thereupon 'Abdullah b. Hudhafa stood up and said: Allah's Messenger, who is my father? He said: Your father is Hudhafa, and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said repeatedly: Ask me, and (it was at this juncture that 'Umar knelt down and said): We are well pleased with Allah as our Lord, with Islam as our code of life and with Muhammad as the Messenger (of Allah). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) kept quiet so long as 'Umar spoke. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: (The Doom) is near; by Him, in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, there was presented to me the Paradise and Hell in the nook of this enclosure, and I did not see good and evil like that of the present day. Ibn Shihab reported: Ubaidullah b. 'Abdullah b. 'Utba told me that the mother of 'Abdullah b. Hudhafa told 'Abdullah b. Hudhafa: I have never heard of a son more disobedient than you. Do you feel yourself immune from the fact that your mother committed a sin which the women in the pre-Islamic period committed and then you disgrace her in the eyes of the people? 'Abdullah b. Hudhafa said: If my fatherhood were to be attributed to a black slave I would have connected myself with him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ وَحَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ مَعَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ شُعَيْبًا قَالَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ أَنَّ أُمَّ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حُذَافَةَ قَالَتْ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu, 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadhaa alhadiythi wahadiythi 'ubaydi alllahi ma'ahu ghayra aanna shu'aybana qaala 'ani alzzuhriyyi qaala aakhbaraniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi qaala haddathaniy rajulun min aahli al'ilmi aanna aumma 'abdi alllahi bni hudhaafaaa qaalat bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمَعْنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّاسَ، سَأَلُوا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى أَحْفَوْهُ بِالْمَسْأَلَةِ فَخَرَجَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فَصَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ سَلُونِي لاَ تَسْأَلُونِي عَنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ بَيَّنْتُهُ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا سَمِعَ ذَلِكَ الْقَوْمُ أَرَمُّوا وَرَهِبُوا أَنْ يَكُونَ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ أَمْرٍ قَدْ حَضَرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنَسٌ فَجَعَلْتُ أَلْتَفِتُ يَمِينًا وَشِمَالاً فَإِذَا كُلُّ رَجُلٍ لاَفٌّ رَأْسَهُ فِي ثَوْبِهِ يَبْكِي فَأَنْشَأَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ كَانَ يُلاَحَى فَيُدْعَى لِغَيْرِ أَبِيهِ فَقَالَ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ مَنْ أَبِي قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبُوكَ حُذَافَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَنْشَأَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ رضى الله عنه فَقَالَ رَضِينَا بِاللَّهِ رَبًّا وَبِالإِسْلاَمِ دِينًا وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولاً عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ سُوءِ الْفِتَنِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَمْ أَرَ كَالْيَوْمِ قَطُّ فِي الْخَيْرِ وَالشَّرِّ إِنِّي صُوِّرَتْ لِيَ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ فَرَأَيْتُهُمَا دُونَ هَذَا الْحَائِطِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yuwsufu bnu hammaadin alma'niyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna alnnaasa, saaaluwa nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa aahfawhu bialmasaalaai fakharaja dhaata yawmin fasa'ida alminbara faqaala ‏"‏ saluwniy laa tasaaluwniy 'an shaa'in iilaaa bayyantuhu lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa sami'a dhalika alqawmu aarammuwa warahibuwa aan yakuwna bayna yadaa aamrin qad hadara ‏.‏ qaala aanasun faja'altu aaltafitu yamiynana washimaalaan faiidhaa kullu rajulin laaffun raasahu fiy thawbihi yabkiy faaanshaaa rajulun mina almasjidi kaana yulaahaa fayud'aa lighayri aabiyhi faqaala yaa nabiyya alllahi man aabiy qaala ‏"‏ aabuwka hudhaafaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aanshaaa 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi rda allh 'nh faqaala radiynaa bialllahi rabbana wabialiislaami diynana wabimuhammadin rasuwlaan 'aaiidhana bialllahi min suw'i alfitani ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ lam aara kaalyawmi qattu fiy alkhayri waalshharri iinniy suwwirat liya aljannaau waalnnaaru faraaaytuhumaa duwna hadhaa alhaaiiti ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that the people asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) until he was hard pressed. He went out one day and he occupied the pulpit and said:Ask me and I shall leave no question of yours unanswered for you, and when the people heard about it they were overawed, as if (something tragic) was going to happen. Anas said: I began to look towards the right and the left and (found) that every person was weeping wrapping his head with the cloth. Then a person in the mosque broke the ice and they used to dispute with him by attributing his fatherhood to another man than his own father. He said: Allah's Apostle, who is my father? He said: Your father is Hudhafa. Then 'Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with him) dared say something and said: We are well pleased with Allah as our Lord, with Islam as our code of life and with Muhammad as our Messenger, seeking refuge with Allah from the evil of Turmoil. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Never did I see the good and evil as today. Paradise and Hell were given a visible shape before me (in this worldly life) and I saw both of them near this well
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ بَشَّارٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالاَ، جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، بِهَذِهِ الْقِصَّةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun ya'niy abna alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu, bnu bashhaarin haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'adiyyin, kilaahumaa 'an hishaamin, h wahaddathanaa 'aasimu bnu alnnadri alttaymiyyu, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu aabiy qaalaa, jamiy'ana haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, bihadhihi alqissaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Qatada
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ بَرَّادٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ سُئِلَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ أَشْيَاءَ كَرِهَهَا فَلَمَّا أُكْثِرَ عَلَيْهِ غَضِبَ ثُمَّ قَالَ لِلنَّاسِ ‏"‏ سَلُونِي عَمَّ شِئْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مَنْ أَبِي قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبُوكَ حُذَافَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ آخَرُ فَقَالَ مَنْ أَبِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبُوكَ سَالِمٌ مَوْلَى شَيْبَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا رَأَى عُمَرُ مَا فِي وَجْهِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْغَضَبِ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا نَتُوبُ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ قَالَ مَنْ أَبِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَبُوكَ سَالِمٌ مَوْلَى شَيْبَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu barraadin alaash'ariyyu, wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala suiila alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an aashyaa'a karihahaa falammaa aukthira 'alayhi ghadiba thumma qaala lilnnaasi ‏"‏ saluwniy 'amma shiitum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun man aabiy qaala ‏"‏ aabuwka hudhaafaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaama akharu faqaala man aabiy yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ aabuwka saalimun mawlaa shaybaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa raaaa 'umaru maa fiy wajhi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mina alghadabi qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaa natuwbu iilaa alllahi ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy kuraybin qaala man aabiy yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ aabuwka saalimun mawlaa shaybaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was asked such things which he disapproved and when they persisted on asking him he felt enraged and then said to the people:Ask me what you wish to ask. Thereupon a person said: Who is my father? He said: Your father is Hudhafa. Then another person stood up and said: Allah's Messenger, who is my father? He said: Your father is Salim, the freed slave of Shaiba. When 'Umar saw the signs of anger upon the face of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), he said: Allah's Messenger, we ask repentance from Allah. And in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Kuraib (the words are):" Allah's Messenger, who is my father? He said: Your father is Salim, the freed slave of Shaiba
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ وَهَذَا حَدِيثُ قُتَيْبَةَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ سِمَاكٍ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ قَالَ مَرَرْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِقَوْمٍ عَلَى رُءُوسِ النَّخْلِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا يَصْنَعُ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا يُلَقِّحُونَهُ يَجْعَلُونَ الذَّكَرَ فِي الأُنْثَى فَيَلْقَحُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا أَظُنُّ يُغْنِي ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأُخْبِرُوا بِذَلِكَ فَتَرَكُوهُ فَأُخْبِرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ كَانَ يَنْفَعُهُمْ ذَلِكَ فَلْيَصْنَعُوهُ فَإِنِّي إِنَّمَا ظَنَنْتُ ظَنًّا فَلاَ تُؤَاخِذُونِي بِالظَّنِّ وَلَكِنْ إِذَا حَدَّثْتُكُمْ عَنِ اللَّهِ شَيْئًا فَخُذُوا بِهِ فَإِنِّي لَنْ أَكْذِبَ عَلَى اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin althhaqafiyyu, waaabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu - wataqaarabaa fiy alllafzi wahadhaa hadiythu qutaybaaa - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa 'an simaakin 'an muwsaa bni talhaaa 'an aabiyhi qaala marartu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biqawmin 'alaa ru'uwsi alnnakhli faqaala ‏"‏ maa yasna'u hauulaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa yulaqqihuwnahu yaj'aluwna aldhhakara fiy alaunthaa fayalqahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa aazunnu yughniy dhalika shayiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaukhbiruwa bidhalika fatarakuwhu faaukhbira rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bidhalika faqaala ‏"‏ iin kaana yanfa'uhum dhalika falyasna'uwhu faiinniy iinnamaa zanantu zannana falaa tuuaakhidhuwniy bialzzanni walakin iidhaa haddathtukum 'ani alllahi shayiana fakhudhuwa bihi faiinniy lan aakdhiba 'alaa alllahi 'azza wajalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Musa b. Talha reported:I and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by people near the date-palm trees. He (the Holy Prophet) said: What are these people doing? They said: They are grafting, i. e. they combine the male with the female (tree) and thus they yield more fruit. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I do not find it to be of any use. The people were informed about it and they abandoned this practice. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (was later) on informed (that the yield had dwindled), whereupon he said: If there is any use of it, then they should do it, for it was just a personal opinion of mine, and do not go after my personal opinion; but when I say to you anything on behalf of Allah, then do accept it, for I do not attribute lie to Allah, the Exalted and Glorious
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الرُّومِيِّ الْيَمَامِيُّ، وَعَبَّاسُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَظِيمِ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ، جَعْفَرٍ الْمَعْقِرِيُّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَمَّارٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّجَاشِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي رَافِعُ بْنُ خَدِيجٍ، قَالَ قَدِمَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ وَهُمْ يَأْبُرُونَ النَّخْلَ يَقُولُونَ يُلَقِّحُونَ النَّخْلَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا تَصْنَعُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا كُنَّا نَصْنَعُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّكُمْ لَوْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا كَانَ خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَتَرَكُوهُ فَنَفَضَتْ أَوْ فَنَقَصَتْ - قَالَ - فَذَكَرُوا ذَلِكَ لَهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ إِذَا أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِشَىْءٍ مِنْ دِينِكُمْ فَخُذُوا بِهِ وَإِذَا أَمَرْتُكُمْ بِشَىْءٍ مِنْ رَأْىٍ فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عِكْرِمَةُ أَوْ نَحْوَ هَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ الْمَعْقِرِيُّ فَنَفَضَتْ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَشُكَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu alrruwmiyyi alyamaamiyyu, wa'abbaasu bnu 'abdi al'aziymi al'anbariyyu, waaahmadu bnu, ja'farin alma'qiriyyu qaaluwa haddathanaa alnnadru bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa 'ikrimaau, - wahuwa abnu 'ammaarin - haddathanaa aabuw alnnajaashiyyi, haddathaniy raafi'u bnu khadiyjin, qaala qadima nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa wahum yaaburuwna alnnakhla yaquwluwna yulaqqihuwna alnnakhla faqaala ‏"‏ maa tasna'uwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa kunnaa nasna'uhu qaala ‏"‏ la'allakum law lam taf'aluwa kaana khayrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fatarakuwhu fanafadat aaw fanaqasat - qaala - fadhakaruwa dhalika lahu faqaala ‏"‏ iinnamaa aanaa basharun iidhaa aamartukum bishaa'in min diynikum fakhudhuwa bihi waiidhaa aamartukum bishaa'in min raaain faiinnamaa aanaa basharun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'ikrimaau aaw nahwa hadhaa ‏.‏ qaala alma'qiriyyu fanafadat ‏.‏ walam yashukka ‏.‏
verses.translation: Rafi' b. Khadij reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to Medina and the people had been grafting the trees. He said:What are you doing? They said: We are grafting them, whereupon he said: It may perhaps be good for you if you do not do that, so they abandoned this practice (and the date-palms) began to yield less fruit. They made a mention of it (to the Holy Prophet), whereupon he said: I am a human being, so when I command you about a thing pertaining to religion, do accept it, and when I command you about a thing out of my personal opinion, keep it in mind that I am a human being. 'Ikrima reported that he said something like this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ عَامِرٍ، - قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، - حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، وَعَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِقَوْمٍ يُلَقِّحُونَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا لَصَلُحَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجَ شِيصًا فَمَرَّ بِهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لِنَخْلِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا قُلْتَ كَذَا وَكَذَا قَالَ ‏"‏ أَنْتُمْ أَعْلَمُ بِأَمْرِ دُنْيَاكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, kilaahumaa 'ani alaaswadi bni 'aamirin, - qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa aaswadu bnu 'aamirin, - haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, wa'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm marra biqawmin yulaqqihuwna faqaala ‏"‏ law lam taf'aluwa lasaluha ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakharaja shiysana famarra bihim faqaala ‏"‏ maa linakhlikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa qulta kadhaa wakadhaa qaala ‏"‏ aantum aa'lamu biaamri dunyaakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by the people who had been busy in grafting the trees. Thereupon he said:If you were not to do it, it might be good for you. (So they abandoned this practice) and there was a decline in the yield. He (the Holy Prophet) happened to pass by them (and said): What has gone wrong with your trees? They said: You said so and so. Thereupon he said: You have better knowledge (of a technical skill) in the affairs of the world
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ فِي يَدِهِ لَيَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَى أَحَدِكُمْ يَوْمٌ وَلاَ يَرَانِي ثُمَّ لأَنْ يَرَانِي أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ مَعَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ الْمَعْنَى فِيهِ عِنْدِي لأَنْ يَرَانِي مَعَهُمْ أَحَبُّ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ وَهُوَ عِنْدِي مُقَدَّمٌ وَمُؤَخَّرٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin fiy yadihi layaatiyanna 'alaa aahadikum yawmun walaa yaraaniy thumma laan yaraaniy aahabbu iilayhi min aahlihi wamaalihi ma'ahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw iishaaqa alma'naa fiyhi 'indiy laan yaraaniy ma'ahum aahabbu iilayhi min aahlihi wamaalihi wahuwa 'indiy muqaddamun wamuuakhharun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported so many 'ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one among them was that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is reported to have said:By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, a day would come to you when you would not be able to see me, and the glimpse of my face would be dearer to one than one's own family, one's property and in fact everything. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ishaq with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّأَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَنَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِابْنِ مَرْيَمَ الأَنْبِيَاءُ أَوْلاَدُ عَلاَّتٍ وَلَيْسَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُ نَبِيٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aannaaakhbarahu aanna aabaa hurayraaa qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aanaa aawlaa alnnaasi biabni maryama alaanbiyaa'u aawlaadu 'alaaatin walaysa bayniy wabaynahu nabiyyun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I am most akin to the son of Mary among the whole of mankind and the Prophets are of different mothers, but of one religion, and no Prophet was raised between me and him (Jesus Christ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، عُمَرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِعِيسَى الأَنْبِيَاءُ أَبْنَاءُ عَلاَّتٍ وَلَيْسَ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ عِيسَى نَبِيٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, 'umaru bnu sa'din 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanaa aawlaa alnnaasi bi'iysaa alaanbiyaa'u aabnaa'u 'alaaatin walaysa bayniy wabayna 'iysaa nabiyyun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I am most akin to Jesus Christ among the whole of mankind, and all the Prophets are of different mothers but belong to one religion and no Prophet was raised between me and Jesus
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَنَا أَوْلَى النَّاسِ بِعِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ فِي الأُولَى وَالآخِرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا كَيْفَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الأَنْبِيَاءُ إِخْوَةٌ مِنْ عَلاَّتٍ وَأُمَّهَاتُهُمْ شَتَّى وَدِينُهُمْ وَاحِدٌ فَلَيْسَ بَيْنَنَا نَبِيٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aanaa aawlaa alnnaasi bi'iysaa abni maryama fiy alauwlaa waalakhiraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa kayfa yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ alaanbiyaa'u iikhwaaun min 'alaaatin waaummahaatuhum shattaa wadiynuhum waahidun falaysa baynanaa nabiyyun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported many ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one is that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:I am most close to Jesus, son of Mary, among the whole of mankind in this worldly life and the next life. They said: Allah's Messenger how is it? Thereupon he said: Prophets are brothers in faith, having different mothers. Their religion is, however, one and there is no Apostle between us (between I and Jesus Christ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مَوْلُودٍ يُولَدُ إِلاَّ نَخَسَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ نَخْسَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِلاَّ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏ وَإِنِّي أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ maa min mawluwdin yuwladu iilaaa nakhasahu alshhaytaanu fayastahillu saarikhana min nakhsaai alshhaytaani iilaaa abna maryama waaummahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala aabuw hurayraaa aqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏ waiinniy au'iydhuhaa bika wadhurriyyatahaa mina alshhaytaani alrrajiymi‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:No child is born but he is pricked by the satan and he begins to weep because of the pricking of the satan except the son of Mary and his mother. Abu Huraira then said: You may recite if you so like (the verse):" I seek Thy protection for her and her offspring against satan the accursed" (iii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالاَ ‏"‏ يَمَسُّهُ حِينَ يُولَدُ فَيَسْتَهِلُّ صَارِخًا مِنْ مَسَّةِ الشَّيْطَانِ إِيَّاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ شُعَيْبٍ ‏"‏ مِنْ مَسِّ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, h wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi, bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu haddathanaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, jamiy'ana 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaalaa ‏"‏ yamassuhu hiyna yuwladu fayastahillu saarikhana min massaai alshhaytaani iiyyaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi shu'aybin ‏"‏ min massi alshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters (and the words are):" The newborn child is touched by the satan (when he comes in the world) and he starts crying because of the touch of satan." In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Shu'aib there is a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ أَبَا يُونُسَ، سُلَيْمًا مَوْلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ بَنِي آدَمَ يَمَسُّهُ الشَّيْطَانُ يَوْمَ وَلَدَتْهُ أُمُّهُ إِلاَّ مَرْيَمَ وَابْنَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, aanna aabaa yuwnusa, sulaymana mawlaa aabiy hurayraaa haddathahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ kullu baniy adama yamassuhu alshhaytaanu yawma waladathu aummuhu iilaaa maryama waabnahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The satan touches every son of Adam on the day when his mother gives birth to him with the exception of Mary and her son
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صِيَاحُ الْمَوْلُودِ حِينَ يَقَعُ نَزْغَةٌ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ siyaahu almawluwdi hiyna yaqa'u nazghaaun mina alshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The crying of the child (starts) when the satan begins to prick him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ رَأَى عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ رَجُلاً يَسْرِقُ فَقَالَ لَهُ عِيسَى سَرَقْتَ قَالَ كَلاَّ وَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عِيسَى آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَكَذَّبْتُ نَفْسِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ raaaa 'iysaa abnu maryama rajulaan yasriqu faqaala lahu 'iysaa saraqta qaala kalaaa waalladhiy laa iilaha iilaaa huwa ‏.‏ faqaala 'iysaa amantu bialllahi wakadhhabtu nafsiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported ahadith from the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) (and one of them was) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said Jesus son of Mary saw a person committing theft; thereupon Jesus said to him:You committed theft. He said: Nay. By Him besides Whom there is no god (I have not committed theft). Thereupon Jesus said: I affirm my faith in Allah It is my ownself that deceived me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، وَابْنُ، فُضَيْلٍ عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُخْتَارُ، بْنُ فُلْفُلٍ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا خَيْرَ الْبَرِيَّةِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ذَاكَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, waabnu, fudaylin 'ani almukhtaari, h wahaddathaniy 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, aakhbaranaa almukhtaaru, bnu fulfulin 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa khayra albariyyaai ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ dhaaka iibraahiymu 'alayhi alssalaamu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:O, the best of creation; thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He is Ibrahim (peace be upon him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُخْتَارَ بْنَ فُلْفُلٍ، مَوْلَى عَمْرِو بْنِ حُرَيْثٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, qaala sami'tu mukhtaara bna fulfulin, mawlaa 'amriw bni huraythin qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu qaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الْمُخْتَارِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, 'ani almukhtaari, qaala sami'tu aanasana, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اخْتَتَنَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ النَّبِيُّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ ثَمَانِينَ سَنَةً بِالْقَدُومِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alhizaamiyya - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ akhtatana iibraahiymu alnnabiyyu 'alayhi alssalaamu wahuwa abnu thamaaniyna sanaaan bialqaduwmi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as having said that Ibrahim (as) circumcised himself with the help of an adze when he was eighty years old
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِنْ، شَاءَ اللَّهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبَا، عُبَيْدٍ أَخْبَرَاهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iin, shaa'a alllahu 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an maalikin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aanna sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, waaabaa, 'ubaydin aakhbaraahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi yuwnusa 'ani alzzuhriyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ لِلُوطٍ إِنَّهُ أَوَى إِلَى رُكْنٍ شَدِيدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathanaa warqaa'u, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaghfiru alllahu liluwtin iinnahu aawaa iilaa ruknin shadiydin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ السَّخْتِيَانِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَمْ يَكْذِبْ إِبْرَاهِيمُ النَّبِيُّ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ قَطُّ إِلاَّ ثَلاَثَ كَذَبَاتٍ ثِنْتَيْنِ فِي ذَاتِ اللَّهِ قَوْلُهُ ‏{‏ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ‏}‏ ‏.‏ وَقَوْلُهُ ‏{‏ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَذَا‏}‏ وَوَاحِدَةً فِي شَأْنِ سَارَةَ فَإِنَّهُ قَدِمَ أَرْضَ جَبَّارٍ وَمَعَهُ سَارَةُ وَكَانَتْ أَحْسَنَ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ لَهَا إِنَّ هَذَا الْجَبَّارَ إِنْ يَعْلَمْ أَنَّكِ امْرَأَتِي يَغْلِبْنِي عَلَيْكِ فَإِنْ سَأَلَكِ فَأَخْبِرِيهِ أَنَّكِ أُخْتِي فَإِنَّكِ أُخْتِي فِي الإِسْلاَمِ فَإِنِّي لاَ أَعْلَمُ فِي الأَرْضِ مُسْلِمًا غَيْرِي وَغَيْرَكِ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ أَرْضَهُ رَآهَا بَعْضُ أَهْلِ الْجَبَّارِ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ لَقَدْ قَدِمَ أَرْضَكَ امْرَأَةٌ لاَ يَنْبَغِي لَهَا أَنْ تَكُونَ إِلاَّ لَكَ ‏.‏ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهَا فَأُتِيَ بِهَا فَقَامَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ إِلَى الصَّلاَةِ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ لَمْ يَتَمَالَكْ أَنْ بَسَطَ يَدَهُ إِلَيْهَا فَقُبِضَتْ يَدُهُ قَبْضَةً شَدِيدَةً فَقَالَ لَهَا ادْعِي اللَّهَ أَنْ يُطْلِقَ يَدِي وَلاَ أَضُرُّكِ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَتْ فَعَادَ فَقُبِضَتْ أَشَدَّ مِنَ الْقَبْضَةِ الأُولَى فَقَالَ لَهَا مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ فَفَعَلَتْ فَعَادَ فَقُبِضَتْ أَشَدَّ مِنَ الْقَبْضَتَيْنِ الأُولَيَيْنِ فَقَالَ ادْعِي اللَّهَ أَنْ يُطْلِقَ يَدِي فَلَكِ اللَّهَ أَنْ لاَ أَضُرَّكِ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلَتْ وَأُطْلِقَتْ يَدُهُ وَدَعَا الَّذِي جَاءَ بِهَا فَقَالَ لَهُ إِنَّكَ إِنَّمَا أَتَيْتَنِي بِشَيْطَانٍ وَلَمْ تَأْتِنِي بِإِنْسَانٍ فَأَخْرِجْهَا مِنْ أَرْضِي وَأَعْطِهَا هَاجَرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَقْبَلَتْ تَمْشِي فَلَمَّا رَآهَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ انْصَرَفَ فَقَالَ لَهَا مَهْيَمْ قَالَتْ خَيْرًا كَفَّ اللَّهُ يَدَ الْفَاجِرِ وَأَخْدَمَ خَادِمًا ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَتِلْكَ أُمُّكُمْ يَا بَنِي مَاءِ السَّمَاءِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy jariyru bnu haazimin, 'an aayyuwba alssakhtiyaaniyyi, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ lam yakdhib iibraahiymu alnnabiyyu 'alayhi alssalaamu qattu iilaaa thalaatha kadhabaatin thintayni fiy dhaati alllahi qawluhu ‏{‏ iinniy saqiymun‏}‏ ‏.‏ waqawluhu ‏{‏ bal fa'alahu kabiyruhum hadhaa‏}‏ wawaahidaaan fiy shaani saaraaa faiinnahu qadima aarda jabbaarin wama'ahu saaraau wakaanat aahsana alnnaasi faqaala lahaa iinna hadhaa aljabbaara iin ya'lam aannaki amraaatiy yaghlibniy 'alayki faiin saaalaki faaakhbiriyhi aannaki aukhtiy faiinnaki aukhtiy fiy aliislaami faiinniy laa aa'lamu fiy alaardi muslimana ghayriy waghayraki falammaa dakhala aardahu raahaa ba'du aahli aljabbaari aataahu faqaala lahu laqad qadima aardaka amraaaaun laa yanbaghiy lahaa aan takuwna iilaaa laka ‏.‏ faaarsala iilayhaa faautiya bihaa faqaama iibraahiymu 'alayhi alssalaamu iilaa alssalaaai falammaa dakhalat 'alayhi lam yatamaalak aan basata yadahu iilayhaa faqubidat yaduhu qabdaaan shadiydaaan faqaala lahaa ad'iy alllaha aan yutliqa yadiy walaa aadurruki ‏.‏ fafa'alat fa'aada faqubidat aashadda mina alqabdaai alauwlaa faqaala lahaa mithla dhalika fafa'alat fa'aada faqubidat aashadda mina alqabdatayni alauwlayayni faqaala ad'iy alllaha aan yutliqa yadiy falaki alllaha aan laa aadurraki ‏.‏ fafa'alat waautliqat yaduhu wada'aa alladhiy jaa'a bihaa faqaala lahu iinnaka iinnamaa aataytaniy bishaytaanin walam taatiniy biiinsaanin faaakhrijhaa min aardiy waaa'tihaa haajara ‏.‏ qaala faaaqbalat tamshiy falammaa raahaa iibraahiymu 'alayhi alssalaamu ansarafa faqaala lahaa mahyam qaalat khayrana kaffa alllahu yada alfaajiri waaakhdama khaadimana ‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa fatilka aummukum yaa baniy maa'i alssamaa'i ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him) never told a lie but only thrice: two times for the sake of Allah (for example, his words): "I am sick," and his words: "But it was the big one amongst them which has done that" and because of Sara (his wife). He had come in a land inhabited by haughty and cruel men along with Sara. She was very good-looking amongst the people, so he said to her: If these people were to know that you are my wife they would snatch you away from me, so if they ask you tell them that you are my sister and in fact you are my sister in Islam, and I do not know of any other Muslim in this land besides I and you. And when they entered that land the tyrants came to see her and said to him (the king): 'There comes to your land a woman, whom you alone deserve to possess', so he (the king) sent someone (towards her) and she was brought to him, and Ibrahim (peace be upon him) stood in prayer. When she visited him (the tyrant king came) he could help but stretch his hand towards her and his hand was tied up. He said: 'Supplicate to Allah so that He may release my hand and I will do no harm to you.' She did that and the man repeated (the same highhandedness) and his hand was again tied up more tightly than on the first occasion. He said the same thing to her again, and she again did that (supplicated), but he repeated (the same highhandedness and his hands were tied up more tightly than on the previous occasion). He then again said: 'Supplicate your Lord so that He may set my hand free; by Allah I shall do no harm to you.' She did and his hand was freed. Then he called the person who had brought her and said to him: 'You have brought to me the satan and you have not brought to me a human being, so turn them out from my land,' and he gave Hajar as a gift to her. She returned (along with Hajar) and when Ibrahim (peace be upon him) saw her, he said: 'How have you returned?' She said: 'With full safety (have I returned). Allah held the hand of that debauch and he gave me a maid-servant.' Abu Huraira said: 'O sons of the rain of the sky, she is your mother
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كَانَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ يَغْتَسِلُونَ عُرَاةً يَنْظُرُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى سَوْأَةِ بَعْضٍ وَكَانَ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ يَغْتَسِلُ وَحْدَهُ فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا يَمْنَعُ مُوسَى أَنْ يَغْتَسِلَ مَعَنَا إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ آدَرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَهَبَ مَرَّةً يَغْتَسِلُ فَوَضَعَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى حَجَرٍ فَفَرَّ الْحَجَرُ بِثَوْبِهِ - قَالَ - فَجَمَحَ مُوسَى بِأَثَرِهِ يَقُولُ ثَوْبِي حَجَرُ ثَوْبِي حَجَرُ ‏.‏ حَتَّى نَظَرَتْ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ إِلَى سَوْأَةِ مُوسَى فَقَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا بِمُوسَى مِنْ بَأْسٍ ‏.‏ فَقَامَ الْحَجَرُ بَعْدُ حَتَّى نُظِرَ إِلَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَأَخَذَ ثَوْبَهُ فَطَفِقَ بِالْحَجَرِ ضَرْبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ بِالْحَجَرِ نَدَبٌ سِتَّةٌ أَوْ سَبْعَةٌ ضَرْبُ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ بِالْحَجَرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kaanat banuw iisraaiiyla yaghtasiluwna 'uraaaan yanzuru ba'duhum iilaa sawaaai ba'din wakaana muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu yaghtasilu wahdahu faqaaluwa waalllahi maa yamna'u muwsaa aan yaghtasila ma'anaa iilaaa aannahu adaru ‏.‏ qaala fadhahaba marraaan yaghtasilu fawada'a thawbahu 'alaa hajarin fafarra alhajaru bithawbihi - qaala - fajamaha muwsaa biaatharihi yaquwlu thawbiy hajaru thawbiy hajaru ‏.‏ hattaa nazarat banuw iisraaiiyla iilaa sawaaai muwsaa faqaaluwa waalllahi maa bimuwsaa min baasin ‏.‏ faqaama alhajaru ba'du hattaa nuzira iilayhi - qaala - faaakhadha thawbahu fatafiqa bialhajari darbana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa waalllahi iinnahu bialhajari nadabun sittaaun aaw sab'aaun darbu muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu bialhajari ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported that Abu Huraira reported many ahadith from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one, of them speaks that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is reported to have said:Banu Isra'il used to take bath (together) naked and thus saw private parts of one another, but Moses (peace be upon him) used to take bath alone (in privacy), and they said: By Allah, nothing prevents Moses to take bath along with us; but scrotal hernia. One day when he (Moses) was taking bath (alone) he placed his clothes upon a stone, but the stone began to move along with his clothes. Moses raced after it saying: My garment, stone; until (some of the people) of Banu Isra'il looked at the private parts of Moses, and they said: By Allah, there is no trouble with Moses. The stone stopped after he (Moses) had been seen. He took hold of his garments and struck the stone. Abu Huraira said: I swear by Allah that there were six or seven scars on the stone because of the striking of stone by Moses (peace be upon him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ أَنْبَأَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ رَجُلاً حَيِيًّا - قَالَ - فَكَانَ لاَ يُرَى مُتَجَرِّدًا - قَالَ - فَقَالَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ إِنَّهُ آدَرُ - قَالَ - فَاغْتَسَلَ عِنْدَ مُوَيْهٍ فَوَضَعَ ثَوْبَهُ عَلَى حَجَرٍ فَانْطَلَقَ الْحَجَرُ يَسْعَى وَاتَّبَعَهُ بِعَصَاهُ يَضْرِبُهُ ثَوْبِي حَجَرُ ثَوْبِي حَجَرُ ‏.‏ حَتَّى وَقَفَ عَلَى مَلإٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ وَنَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لاَ تَكُونُوا كَالَّذِينَ آذَوْا مُوسَى فَبَرَّأَهُ اللَّهُ مِمَّا قَالُوا وَكَانَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَجِيهًا‏}‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni shaqiyqin, qaala aanbaaanaa aabuw hurayraaa, qaala kaana muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu rajulaan hayiyyana - qaala - fakaana laa yuraa mutajarridana - qaala - faqaala banuw iisraaiiyla iinnahu adaru - qaala - faaghtasala 'inda muwayhin fawada'a thawbahu 'alaa hajarin faantalaqa alhajaru yas'aa waattaba'ahu bi'asaahu yadribuhu thawbiy hajaru thawbiy hajaru ‏.‏ hattaa waqafa 'alaa maliin min baniy iisraaiiyla wanazalat ‏{‏ yaa aayyuhaa alladhiyna amanuwa laa takuwnuwa kaalladhiyna adhawa muwsaa fabarraaahu alllahu mimmaa qaaluwa wakaana 'inda alllahi wajiyhana‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Moses was a modest person. He was never seen naked and Banu Isra'iI said:(He was afraid to expose his private part) because he had been suffering from scrotal hernia. He (one day) took bath in water and placed his garments upon a stone. The stone began to move on quickly. He followed that and struck it with the help of a stone (saying): O stone, my garment; O stone, my garments, O stone; until it stopped near the big gathering of Isrii'll, and this verse was revealed (pertaining to the incident):" O you who believe, be not Iike those who maligned Moses, but Allah cleared him of what they said, and he was worthy of regard with Allah" (xxxiii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أُرْسِلَ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ إِلَى مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَلَمَّا جَاءَهُ صَكَّهُ فَفَقَأَ عَيْنَهُ فَرَجَعَ إِلَى رَبِّهِ فَقَالَ أَرْسَلْتَنِي إِلَى عَبْدٍ لاَ يُرِيدُ الْمَوْتَ - قَالَ - فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ عَيْنَهُ وَقَالَ ارْجِعْ إِلَيْهِ فَقُلْ لَهُ يَضَعُ يَدَهُ عَلَى مَتْنِ ثَوْرٍ فَلَهُ بِمَا غَطَّتْ يَدُهُ بِكُلِّ شَعْرَةٍ سَنَةٌ قَالَ أَىْ رَبِّ ثُمَّ مَهْ قَالَ ثُمَّ الْمَوْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَالآنَ فَسَأَلَ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُدْنِيَهُ مِنَ الأَرْضِ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ رَمْيَةً بِحَجَرٍ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ فَلَوْ كُنْتُ ثَمَّ لأَرَيْتُكُمْ قَبْرَهُ إِلَى جَانِبِ الطَّرِيقِ تَحْتَ الْكَثِيبِ الأَحْمَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani abni taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala aursila malaku almawti iilaa muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu falammaa jaa'ahu sakkahu fafaqaaa 'aynahu faraja'a iilaa rabbihi faqaala aarsaltaniy iilaa 'abdin laa yuriydu almawta - qaala - faradda alllahu iilayhi 'aynahu waqaala arji' iilayhi faqul lahu yada'u yadahu 'alaa matni thawrin falahu bimaa ghattat yaduhu bikulli sha'raain sanaaun qaala aaa rabbi thumma mah qaala thumma almawtu ‏.‏ qaala faalana fasaaala alllaha aan yudniyahu mina alaardi almuqaddasaai ramyaaan bihajarin faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ falaw kuntu thamma laaraytukum qabrahu iilaa jaanibi alttariyqi tahta alkathiybi alaahmari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that the Angel of Death was sent to Moses (peace be upon him) to inform of his Lord's summons. When he came, he (Moses) boxed him and his eye was knocked out. He (the Angel of Death) came back to the Lord and said:You sent me to a servant. who did not want to die. Allah restored his eye to its proper place (and revived his eyesight), and then said: Go back to him and tell him that if he wants life he must place his hand on the back of an ox, and he would be granted as many years of life as the number of hair covered by his hand. He (Moses) said: My Lord what would happen then He said: Then you must court death. He said: Let it be now. And he supplicated Allah to bring him close to the sacred land. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If I were there, I would have shown you his grave beside the road at the red mound
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ جَاءَ مَلَكُ الْمَوْتِ إِلَى مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَجِبْ رَبَّكَ - قَالَ - فَلَطَمَ مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَيْنَ مَلَكِ الْمَوْتِ فَفَقَأَهَا - قَالَ - فَرَجَعَ الْمَلَكُ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى فَقَالَ إِنَّكَ أَرْسَلْتَنِي إِلَى عَبْدٍ لَكَ لاَ يُرِيدُ الْمَوْتَ وَقَدْ فَقَأَ عَيْنِي - قَالَ - فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ عَيْنَهُ وَقَالَ ارْجِعْ إِلَى عَبْدِي فَقُلِ الْحَيَاةَ تُرِيدُ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تُرِيدُ الْحَيَاةَ فَضَعْ يَدَكَ عَلَى مَتْنِ ثَوْرٍ فَمَا تَوَارَتْ يَدُكَ مِنْ شَعْرَةٍ فَإِنَّكَ تَعِيشُ بِهَا سَنَةً قَالَ ثُمَّ مَهْ قَالَ ثُمَّ تَمُوتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَالآنَ مِنْ قَرِيبٍ رَبِّ أَمِتْنِي مِنَ الأَرْضِ الْمُقَدَّسَةِ رَمْيَةً بِحَجَرٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَاللَّهِ لَوْ أَنِّي عِنْدَهُ لأَرَيْتُكُمْ قَبْرَهُ إِلَى جَانِبِ الطَّرِيقِ عِنْدَ الْكَثِيبِ الأَحْمَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ jaa'a malaku almawti iilaa muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu faqaala lahu aajib rabbaka - qaala - falatama muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu 'ayna malaki almawti fafaqaaahaa - qaala - faraja'a almalaku iilaa alllahi ta'aalaa faqaala iinnaka aarsaltaniy iilaa 'abdin laka laa yuriydu almawta waqad faqaaa 'ayniy - qaala - faradda alllahu iilayhi 'aynahu waqaala arji' iilaa 'abdiy faquli alhayaaaa turiydu faiin kunta turiydu alhayaaaa fada' yadaka 'alaa matni thawrin famaa tawaarat yaduka min sha'raain faiinnaka ta'iyshu bihaa sanaaan qaala thumma mah qaala thumma tamuwtu ‏.‏ qaala faalana min qariybin rabbi aamitniy mina alaardi almuqaddasaai ramyaaan bihajarin ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waalllahi law aanniy 'indahu laaraytukum qabrahu iilaa jaanibi alttariyqi 'inda alkathiybi alaahmari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said that the Angel of Death came to Moses and said:Respond (to the call) of Allah (i. e. be prepared for death). Moses (peace be upon him) gave a blow at the eye of the Angel of Death and knocked it out. The Angel went back to Allah (the Exalted) and said: You sent me to your servant who does not like to die and he knocked out my eye. Allah restored his eye to its proper place (and revived his eyesight) and said: Go to My servant and say: Do you want life? And in case you want life, keep your hand on the body of the ox and you would live such number of years as the (number of) hair your hand covers. He (Moses) said: What, then? He said: Then you would die, whereupon he (Moses) said: Then why not now? (He then prayed): Allah, cause me to die close to the sacred land. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Had I been near that place I would have shown his grave by the side of the path at the red mound
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، بِمِثْلِ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aabuw iishaaqa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu yahyaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, bimithli hadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ma'mar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُجَيْنُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْفَضْلِ الْهَاشِمِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا يَهُودِيٌّ يَعْرِضُ سِلْعَةً لَهُ أُعْطِيَ بِهَا شَيْئًا كَرِهَهُ أَوْ لَمْ يَرْضَهُ - شَكَّ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ - قَالَ لاَ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَى الْبَشَرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَمِعَهُ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَلَطَمَ وَجْهَهُ - قَالَ - تَقُولُ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَى الْبَشَرِ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا قَالَ فَذَهَبَ الْيَهُودِيُّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ إِنَّ لِي ذِمَّةً وَعَهْدًا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فُلاَنٌ لَطَمَ وَجْهِي ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لِمَ لَطَمْتَ وَجْهَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَى الْبَشَرِ وَأَنْتَ بَيْنَ أَظْهُرِنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَضِبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى عُرِفَ الْغَضَبُ فِي وَجْهِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تُفَضِّلُوا بَيْنَ أَنْبِيَاءِ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّهُ يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ فَيَصْعَقُ مَنْ فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَنْ فِي الأَرْضِ إِلاَّ مَنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ يُنْفَخُ فِيهِ أُخْرَى فَأَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ بُعِثَ أَوْ فِي أَوَّلِ مَنْ بُعِثَ فَإِذَا مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ آخِذٌ بِالْعَرْشِ فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَحُوسِبَ بِصَعْقَتِهِ يَوْمَ الطُّورِ أَوْ بُعِثَ قَبْلِي وَلاَ أَقُولُ إِنَّ أَحَدًا أَفْضَلُ مِنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ مَتَّى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa hujaynu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu 'abdi alllahi, bni aabiy salamaaa 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alfadli alhaashimiyyi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala baynamaa yahuwdiyyun ya'ridu sil'aaan lahu au'tiya bihaa shayiana karihahu aaw lam yardahu - shakka 'abdu al'aziyzi - qaala laa waalladhiy astafaa muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu 'alaa albashari ‏.‏ qaala fasami'ahu rajulun mina alaansaari falatama wajhahu - qaala - taquwlu waalladhiy astafaa muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu 'alaa albashari warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bayna aazhurinaa qaala fadhahaba alyahuwdiyyu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa aabaa alqaasimi iinna liy dhimmaaan wa'ahdana ‏.‏ waqaala fulaanun latama wajhiy ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ lima latamta wajhahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ‏.‏ qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi waalladhiy astafaa muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu 'alaa albashari waaanta bayna aazhurinaa ‏.‏ qaala faghadiba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa 'urifa alghadabu fiy wajhihi thumma qaala ‏"‏ laa tufaddiluwa bayna aanbiyaa'i alllahi faiinnahu yunfakhu fiy alssuwri fayas'aqu man fiy alssamawaati waman fiy alaardi iilaaa man shaa'a alllahu - qaala - thumma yunfakhu fiyhi aukhraa faaakuwnu aawwala man bu'itha aaw fiy aawwali man bu'itha faiidhaa muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu akhidhun bial'arshi falaa aadriy aahuwsiba bisa'qatihi yawma alttuwri aaw bu'itha qabliy walaa aaquwlu iinna aahadana aafdalu min yuwnusa bni mattaa 'alayhi alssalaamu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:While a Jew was selling goods, he was given something which he did not accept or he did not agree (to accept) that 'Abdul 'Azlz (one of the narrators) is doubtful about it. He (the Jew) said: By Allah, Who chose Moses (peace be upon him) among mankind. A person from the Ansar heard it and gave a blow at his face saying: (You have the audacity) to say: By Him Who chose Moses amongst mankind, whereas Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is living amongst us. The Jew went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said: Abu'l-Qasim, I am a Dhimmi and (thus need your protection) by a covenant, and added: Such and such person has given a blow upon my face. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Why did you give a blow on his face? He said: Allah's Messenger, this man said: By Him Who chose Moses (peace be upon him) amongst mankind, whereas you are living amongst us. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) became angry and signs of anger could be seen on his face, and then said: Don't make distinction amongst the Prophets of Allah. When the horn will be blown and whatever is in the heavens and the earth would swoon but he whom Allah grants exception, then another horn will be blown and I would be the first amongst those who would recover and Moses (peace be upon him) would be catching hold of the Throne and I do not know whether it is a compensation for that when he swooned on the Day of Tur or he would be resurrected before me and I do not say that anyone is more excellent than Yunus son of Matta (peace he upon him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ سَوَاءً ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu aabiy salamaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi sawaa'an ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Salama with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ اسْتَبَّ رَجُلاَنِ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ وَرَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ فَقَالَ الْمُسْلِمُ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُحَمَّدًا صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الْيَهُودِيُّ وَالَّذِي اصْطَفَى مُوسَى عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ عَلَى الْعَالَمِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَفَعَ الْمُسْلِمُ يَدَهُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ فَلَطَمَ وَجْهَ الْيَهُودِيِّ فَذَهَبَ الْيَهُودِيُّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِمَا كَانَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ وَأَمْرِ الْمُسْلِمِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تُخَيِّرُونِي عَلَى مُوسَى فَإِنَّ النَّاسَ يَصْعَقُونَ فَأَكُونُ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يُفِيقُ فَإِذَا مُوسَى بَاطِشٌ بِجَانِبِ الْعَرْشِ فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَكَانَ فِيمَنْ صَعِقَ فَأَفَاقَ قَبْلِي أَمْ كَانَ مِمَّنِ اسْتَثْنَى اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw bakri bnu alnnadri qaalaa haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani, wa'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala astabba rajulaani rajulun mina alyahuwdi warajulun mina almuslimiyna faqaala almuslimu waalladhiy astafaa muhammadana sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa al'aalamiyna ‏.‏ waqaala alyahuwdiyyu waalladhiy astafaa muwsaa 'alayhi alssalaamu 'alaa al'aalamiyna ‏.‏ qaala farafa'a almuslimu yadahu 'inda dhalika falatama wajha alyahuwdiyyi fadhahaba alyahuwdiyyu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu bimaa kaana min aamrihi waaamri almuslimi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tukhayyiruwniy 'alaa muwsaa faiinna alnnaasa yas'aquwna faaakuwnu aawwala man yufiyqu faiidhaa muwsaa baatishun bijaanibi al'arshi falaa aadriy aakaana fiyman sa'iqa faaafaaqa qabliy aam kaana mimmani astathnaa alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that two persons, one from amongst the Jews and the other from amongst the Muslims, fell into dispute and began to abuse one another. The Muslim said:By Him Who chose Muhammad (ﷺ) in the worlds. And the Jew said: By Him Who chose Moses in the worlds. Thereupon the Muslim lifted his hand and slapped at the face of the Jew. The Jew went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and told him about his affair and the affair of the Muslim. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Don't make me superior to Moses for mankind will swoon and I would be the first to recover from it and Moses would be at that time seizing the side of the Throne and I do not know (whether) he would swoon and would recover before me or Allah would make an exception for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ اسْتَبَّ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَرَجُلٌ مِنَ الْيَهُودِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa qaalaa aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, wasa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala astabba rajulun mina almuslimiyna warajulun mina alyahuwdi ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi iibraahiyma bni sa'din 'ani abni shihaabin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A person from amongst the Muslims and a person from amongst the Jews fell into dispute and reviled each other. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أَحْمَدَ الزُّبَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ، يَحْيَى عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ جَاءَ يَهُودِيٌّ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ لُطِمَ وَجْهُهُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَكَانَ مِمَّنْ صَعِقَ فَأَفَاقَ قَبْلِي أَوِ اكْتَفَى بِصَعْقَةِ الطُّورِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa aabuw aahmada alzzubayriyyu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amriw bni, yahyaa 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala jaa'a yahuwdiyyun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad lutima wajhuhu ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi alzzuhriyyi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ falaa aadriy aakaana mimman sa'iqa faaafaaqa qabliy aawi aktafaa bisa'qaai alttuwri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that a Jew who had received a blow at his face came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) ; the rest of the hadith is the same, up to the hand (where the words are):That he (the Holy Prophet) said: I do not know whether he would be one who would fall into swoon and would recover before me or he would be compensated for his swooning at Tur (and thus he would not swoon on this occasion) of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تُخَيِّرُوا بَيْنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ عَمْرِو بْنِ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amriw bni yahyaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tukhayyiruwa bayna alaanbiyaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni numayrin 'amriw bni yahyaa haddathaniy aabiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Kudari reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having, said this:Don't make distinction amongst the Apostles. This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters also
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 43 — The Book of Virtues
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، وَشَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، الْبُنَانِيِّ وَسُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَتَيْتُ - وَفِي رِوَايَةِ هَدَّابٍ مَرَرْتُ - عَلَى مُوسَى لَيْلَةَ أُسْرِيَ بِي عِنْدَ الْكَثِيبِ الأَحْمَرِ وَهُوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي فِي قَبْرِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
