verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ، الْمُسَيَّبِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ رَأَيْتُنِي عَلَى قَلِيبٍ عَلَيْهَا دَلْوٌ فَنَزَعْتُ مِنْهَا مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ أَخَذَهَا ابْنُ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ فَنَزَعَ بِهَا ذَنُوبًا أَوْ ذَنُوبَيْنِ وَفِي نَزْعِهِ وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَهُ ضَعْفٌ ثُمَّ اسْتَحَالَتْ غَرْبًا فَأَخَذَهَا ابْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَلَمْ أَرَ عَبْقَرِيًّا مِنَ النَّاسِ يَنْزِعُ نَزْعَ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ حَتَّى ضَرَبَ النَّاسُ بِعَطَنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa harmalaau, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna sa'iyda bna, almusayyabi aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ baynaa aanaa naaiimun raaaytuniy 'alaa qaliybin 'alayhaa dalwun fanaza'tu minhaa maa shaa'a alllahu thumma aakhadhahaa abnu aabiy quhaafaaa fanaza'a bihaa dhanuwbana aaw dhanuwbayni wafiy naz'ihi waalllahu yaghfiru lahu da'fun thumma astahaalat gharbana faaakhadhahaa abnu alkhattaabi falam aara 'abqariyyana mina alnnaasi yanzi'u naz'a 'umara bni alkhattaabi hattaa daraba alnnaasu bi'atanin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:While I was asleep I saw myself on a well with a leathern bucket on a pulley. I drew (water) out of that as Allah wished me (to draw). Then the son of Abu Quhafa (Abu Bakr) drew from it one bucketful or two and there was some weakness in drawing that (may Allah forgive him). Then that bucket (changed into a large bucket) and Ibn Khattab drew it. I did not see any strongest man drawing it like 'Umar b. Khattab. He brought out so much water that the camels of the people had enough to drink and then laid down (for rest)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَالْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ يُونُسَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu, khaalidin h wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waalhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an ya'quwba bni iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, biiisnaadi yuwnusa nahwa hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Yunus through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، قَالَ قَالَ الأَعْرَجُ وَغَيْرُهُ إِنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ رَأَيْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ يَنْزِعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa haddathanaa ya'quwbu, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, qaala qaala alaa'raju waghayruhu iinna aabaa hurayraaa qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ raaaytu abna aabiy quhaafaaa yanzi'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi alzzuhriyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I saw Ibn Abu Quhafa drawing (water) ; the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، أَنَّ أَبَا يُونُسَ، مَوْلَى أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ بَيْنَا أَنَا نَائِمٌ أُرِيتُ أَنِّي أَنْزِعُ عَلَى حَوْضِي أَسْقِي النَّاسَ فَجَاءَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَأَخَذَ الدَّلْوَ مِنْ يَدِي لِيُرَوِّحَنِي فَنَزَعَ دَلْوَيْنِ وَفِي نَزْعِهِ ضُعْفٌ وَاللَّهُ يَغْفِرُ لَهُ فَجَاءَ ابْنُ الْخَطَّابِ فَأَخَذَ مِنْهُ فَلَمْ أَرَ نَزْعَ رَجُلٍ قَطُّ أَقْوَى مِنْهُ حَتَّى تَوَلَّى النَّاسُ وَالْحَوْضُ مَلآنُ يَتَفَجَّرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni wahbin, haddathanaa 'ammiy 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, aanna aabaa yuwnusa, mawlaa aabiy hurayraaa haddathahu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ baynaa aanaa naaiimun auriytu aanniy aanzi'u 'alaa hawdiy aasqiy alnnaasa fajaa'aniy aabuw bakrin faaakhadha alddalwa min yadiy liyurawwihaniy fanaza'a dalwayni wafiy naz'ihi du'fun waalllahu yaghfiru lahu fajaa'a abnu alkhattaabi faaakhadha minhu falam aara naz'a rajulin qattu aaqwaa minhu hattaa tawallaa alnnaasu waalhawdu malanu yatafajjaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:While I was asleep I saw myself drawing water from my tank in order to quench the thirst of the people that there came to me Abu Bakr. He took hold of the leathern bucket from my hand so that he should serve water to the people. He drew two bucketfuls and there was some weakness in his drawing (Allah may forgive him). Then there came Ibn Khattab and he took hold of that, and I did not see a person stronger than he (drawing water) until the people went away with their thirst quenched and the tank filled with water
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُرِيتُ كَأَنِّي أَنْزِعُ بِدَلْوِ بَكْرَةٍ عَلَى قَلِيبٍ فَجَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَنَزَعَ ذَنُوبًا أَوْ ذَنُوبَيْنِ فَنَزَعَ نَزْعًا ضَعِيفًا وَاللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى يَغْفِرُ لَهُ ثُمَّ جَاءَ عُمَرُ فَاسْتَقَى فَاسْتَحَالَتْ غَرْبًا فَلَمْ أَرَ عَبْقَرِيًّا مِنَ النَّاسِ يَفْرِي فَرْيَهُ حَتَّى رَوِيَ النَّاسُ وَضَرَبُوا الْعَطَنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, haddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu saalimin, 'an saalimi, bni 'abdi alllahi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ auriytu kaaanniy aanzi'u bidalwi bakraain 'alaa qaliybin fajaa'a aabuw bakrin fanaza'a dhanuwbana aaw dhanuwbayni fanaza'a naz'ana da'iyfana waalllahu tabaaraka wata'aalaa yaghfiru lahu thumma jaa'a 'umaru faastaqaa faastahaalat gharbana falam aara 'abqariyyana mina alnnaasi yafriy faryahu hattaa rawiya alnnaasu wadarabuwa al'atana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I saw (in a dream) as if I was drawing water with a leathern bucket on a wooden pulley. There came Abu Bakr and he drew out a bucketful or two and as he drew out, some weakness (was perceived in it) (may Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, forgive him). Then Umar came in order to serve water -and the bucket was changed into a large leather bucket and I did not see such a wonderful man amongst persons (drawing water) and he went on serving water to the people until they were fully satisfied and then went to their resting places
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ رُؤْيَا، رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي أَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رضى الله عنهما بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathaniy muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an ruuyaa, rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy aabiy bakrin wa'umara bni alkhattaabi rda allh 'nhma binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. 'Abdullah reported on the authority of his father some of the dreams of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pertaining to Abu Bakr and Umar b. Khattab (Allah be pleased with them) and a hadith like this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، وَابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، سَمِعَا جَابِرًا، يُخْبِرُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، وَعَمْرٍو، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ دَخَلْتُ الْجَنَّةَ فَرَأَيْتُ فِيهَا دَارًا أَوْ قَصْرًا فَقُلْتُ لِمَنْ هَذَا فَقَالُوا لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ ‏.‏ فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَدْخُلَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرْتُ غَيْرَتَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبَكَى عُمَرُ وَقَالَ أَىْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوَعَلَيْكَ يُغَارُ
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, waabni almunkadiri, sami'aa jaabirana, yukhbiru 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani abni almunkadiri, wa'amrinw, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ dakhaltu aljannaaa faraaaytu fiyhaa daarana aaw qasrana faqultu liman hadhaa faqaaluwa li'umara bni alkhattaabi ‏.‏ faaaradtu aan aadkhula ‏.‏ fadhakartu ghayrataka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fabakaa 'umaru waqaala aaa rasuwla alllahi aawa'alayka yughaaru
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I entered Paradise and saw in it a house or a palace. I said: For whom is it resersred? They (the Angels) said: It is for 'Umar b. Khattab. (The Prophet said to 'Umar b. Khattab): I intenied to get into it but I thought of your feelings. Thereupon 'Umar wept and said: Apostle of Allah, could I feel any jealousy in your case?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، وَابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، سَمِعَ جَابِرًا، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ وَزُهَيْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, waabni almunkadiri, 'an jaabirin, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, sami'a jaabirana, h wahaddathanaahu 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni almunkadiri, sami'tu jaabirana, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi abni numayrin wazuhayrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ، الْحُلْوَانِيُّ وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ، حَسَنٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ زَيْدٍ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ سَعْدًا قَالَ اسْتَأْذَنَ عُمَرُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ نِسَاءٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ يُكَلِّمْنَهُ وَيَسْتَكْثِرْنَهُ عَالِيَةً أَصْوَاتُهُنَّ فَلَمَّا اسْتَأْذَنَ عُمَرُ قُمْنَ يَبْتَدِرْنَ الْحِجَابَ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَضْحَكُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ أَضْحَكَ اللَّهُ سِنَّكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَجِبْتُ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ اللاَّتِي كُنَّ عِنْدِي فَلَمَّا سَمِعْنَ صَوْتَكَ ابْتَدَرْنَ الْحِجَابَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ فَأَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَحَقُّ أَنْ يَهَبْنَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ عُمَرُ أَىْ عَدُوَّاتِ أَنْفُسِهِنَّ أَتَهَبْنَنِي وَلاَ تَهَبْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْنَ نَعَمْ أَنْتَ أَغْلَظُ وَأَفَظُّ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا لَقِيَكَ الشَّيْطَانُ قَطُّ سَالِكًا فَجًّا إِلاَّ سَلَكَ فَجًّا غَيْرَ فَجِّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mansuwru bnu aabiy muzaahimin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu ya'niy abna sa'din, h wahaddathanaa hasanun, alhulwaaniyyu wa'abdu bnu humaydin qaala 'abdun aakhbaraniy waqaala, hasanun haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alhamiydi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, bni zaydin aanna muhammada bna sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, aakhbarahu aanna aabaahu sa'dana qaala astaadhana 'umaru 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indahu nisaa'un min qurayshin yukallimnahu wayastakthirnahu 'aaliyaaan aaswaatuhunna falammaa astaadhana 'umaru qumna yabtadirna alhijaaba faaadhina lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yadhaku faqaala 'umaru aadhaka alllahu sinnaka yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ 'ajibtu min hauulaa'i allaaatiy kunna 'indiy falammaa sami'na sawtaka abtadarna alhijaaba ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'umaru faaanta yaa rasuwla alllahi aahaqqu aan yahabna ‏.‏ thumma qaala 'umaru aaa 'aduwwaati aanfusihinna aatahabnaniy walaa tahabna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qulna na'am aanta aaghlazu waaafazzu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi maa laqiyaka alshhaytaanu qattu saalikana fajjana iilaaa salaka fajjana ghayra fajjika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd b. Waqqas reported that Umar sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to visit him when some women of the Quraish were busy in talking with him and raising their voices above his Voiee. When'Umar sought permission they stood up and went hurriedly behind the curtain. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave him permission smilingly. Thereupon 'Umar said:Allah's Messenger, may Allah keep you happy all your life. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I wonder at these women who were with me and no sooner did they hear your voice, they immediately went behind the curtain. Thereupon 'Umar said: Allah's Messenger, you have more right that they should fear you. Then Umar (addressing the women) said: O ye enemies of yourselves, do you fear me and fear not the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ)? They said: Yes, you are harsh and strict as compared to the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ). Thereupon, Allah's Messenger (maypeace be upon him) said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, if satan would encounter you in the way he would certainly take a different way from that of yours
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ، جَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ نِسْوَةٌ قَدْ رَفَعْنَ أَصْوَاتَهُنَّ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا اسْتَأْذَنَ عُمَرُ ابْتَدَرْنَ الْحِجَابَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, haddathanaa bihi 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, aakhbaraniy suhaylun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi, jaa'a iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indahu niswaaun qad rafa'na aaswaatahunna 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa astaadhana 'umaru abtadarna alhijaaba ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi alzzuhriyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Umar b. Khattab came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) while there were some women with him and they were raising their voices above the voice of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when Umar sought permission to get into the house they went behind the curtain hurriedly. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ سَعْدٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ قَدْ كَانَ يَكُونُ فِي الأُمَمِ قَبْلَكُمْ مُحَدَّثُونَ فَإِنْ يَكُنْ فِي أُمَّتِي مِنْهُمْ أَحَدٌ فَإِنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ وَهْبٍ تَفْسِيرُ مُحَدَّثُونَ مُلْهَمُونَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, 'an iibraahiyma, bni sa'din 'an aabiyhi, sa'di bni iibraahiyma 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ qad kaana yakuwnu fiy alaumami qablakum muhaddathuwna faiin yakun fiy aummatiy minhum aahadun faiinna 'umara bna alkhattaabi minhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu wahbin tafsiyru muhaddathuwna mulhamuwna ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There had been among the people before you inspired persons and if there were any such among my Umma Umar b. Khattab would be one of them. Ibn Wahb explained the word Muhaddathun as those who receive hint from the High (Mulhamun)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عَجْلاَنَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu 'uyaynaaa, kilaahumaa 'ani abni 'ajlaana, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'd b. Ibrahim with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، قَالَ جُوَيْرِيَةُ بْنُ أَسْمَاءَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ وَافَقْتُ رَبِّي فِي ثَلاَثٍ فِي مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَفِي الْحِجَابِ وَفِي أُسَارَى بَدْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'aamirin, qaala juwayriyaau bnu aasmaa'a aakhbaranaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala 'umaru waafaqtu rabbiy fiy thalaathin fiy maqaami iibraahiyma wafiy alhijaabi wafiy ausaaraa badrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported Umar as saying:My lord concorded with (my judgments) on three occasions. In case of the Station of Ibrahim, in case of the observance of veil and in case of the prisoners of Badr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ لَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ ابْنُ سَلُولَ جَاءَ ابْنُهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ أَنْ يُعْطِيَهُ قَمِيصَهُ أَنْ يُكَفِّنَ فِيهِ أَبَاهُ فَأَعْطَاهُ ثُمَّ سَأَلَهُ أَنْ يُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِيُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَامَ عُمَرُ فَأَخَذَ بِثَوْبِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتُصَلِّي عَلَيْهِ وَقَدْ نَهَاكَ اللَّهُ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّمَا خَيَّرَنِيَ اللَّهُ فَقَالَ ‏{‏ اسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ أَوْ لاَ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ إِنْ تَسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةً‏}‏ وَسَأَزِيدُ عَلَى سَبْعِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّهُ مُنَافِقٌ ‏.‏ فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَلاَ تُصَلِّ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنْهُمْ مَاتَ أَبَدًا وَلاَ تَقُمْ عَلَى قَبْرِهِ‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala lammaa tuwuffiya 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain abnu saluwla jaa'a abnuhu 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alllahi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu aan yu'tiyahu qamiysahu aan yukaffina fiyhi aabaahu faaa'taahu thumma saaalahu aan yusalliya 'alayhi faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm liyusalliya 'alayhi faqaama 'umaru faaakhadha bithawbi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi aatusalliy 'alayhi waqad nahaaka alllahu aan tusalliya 'alayhi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnamaa khayyaraniya alllahu faqaala ‏{‏ astaghfir lahum aaw laa tastaghfir lahum iin tastaghfir lahum sab'iyna marraaan‏}‏ wasaaaziydu 'alaa sab'iyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala iinnahu munaafiqun ‏.‏ fasallaa 'alayhi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ walaa tusalli 'alaa aahadin minhum maata aabadana walaa taqum 'alaa qabrihi‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that when 'Abdullah b. Ubayy b. Salul (the hypocrite) died, his son Abdullah b. Abdullah came to Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon -him) and asked him to give his shirt which should be used for the coffin of his father. He gave that to him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to say prayer over him Thereupon I Umar caught hold of the clothe of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:Allah's Messenger, are you going to offer prayer, whereas Allah has forbidden to offer prayer for him, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Allah has given me a choice saying: Ask forgiveness for them or you may not ask for them; even if you ask for them seventy times, I will make an addition to the seventy. He was a hypocrite and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said prayer over him that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed the verse:" And never pray over any one of them that has died and never should you stand by his grave" (ix)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فِي مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ وَزَادَ قَالَ فَتَرَكَ الصَّلاَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi fiy ma'naa hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa wazaada qaala fataraka alssalaaaa 'alayhim ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Ubaidullah with the same chain of transmitter but with the addition of the words:" He abandoned saying prayer over the hypocrites who had died
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالَ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَرْمَلَةَ، عَنْ عَطَاءٍ، وَسُلَيْمَانَ، ابْنَىْ يَسَارٍ وَأَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مُضْطَجِعًا فِي بَيْتِي كَاشِفًا عَنْ فَخِذَيْهِ أَوْ سَاقَيْهِ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ وَهُوَ عَلَى تِلْكَ الْحَالِ فَتَحَدَّثَ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنَ عُمَرُ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ فَتَحَدَّثَ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنَ عُثْمَانُ فَجَلَسَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَوَّى ثِيَابَهُ - قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ وَلاَ أَقُولُ ذَلِكَ فِي يَوْمٍ وَاحِدٍ - فَدَخَلَ فَتَحَدَّثَ فَلَمَّا خَرَجَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ دَخَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَلَمْ تَهْتَشَّ لَهُ وَلَمْ تُبَالِهِ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عُمَرُ فَلَمْ تَهْتَشَّ لَهُ وَلَمْ تُبَالِهِ ثُمَّ دَخَلَ عُثْمَانُ فَجَلَسْتَ وَسَوَّيْتَ ثِيَابَكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ أَسْتَحِي مِنْ رَجُلٍ تَسْتَحِي مِنْهُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, wayahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaala yahyaa bnu yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - 'an muhammadi bni aabiy harmalaaa, 'an 'ataa'in, wasulaymaana, abnaa yasaarin waaabiy salamaaa bni 'abdi alrrahmani aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm mudtaji'ana fiy baytiy kaashifana 'an fakhidhayhi aaw saaqayhi faastaadhana aabuw bakrin faaadhina lahu wahuwa 'alaa tilka alhaali fatahaddatha thumma astaadhana 'umaru faaadhina lahu wahuwa kadhalika fatahaddatha thumma astaadhana 'uthmaanu fajalasa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasawwaa thiyaabahu - qaala muhammadun walaa aaquwlu dhalika fiy yawmin waahidin - fadakhala fatahaddatha falammaa kharaja qaalat 'aaiishaau dakhala aabuw bakrin falam tahtashha lahu walam tubaalihi thumma dakhala 'umaru falam tahtashha lahu walam tubaalihi thumma dakhala 'uthmaanu fajalasta wasawwayta thiyaabaka faqaala ‏ "‏ aalaa aastahiy min rajulin tastahiy minhu almalaaiikaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aisha reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was lying in the bed in my apartment with his thigh uncovered and Abu Bakr sought permission to enter. It was given to him and he conversed in the same very state (the Prophet's thigh or shank uncovered). Then `Umar sought permission for entering and it was given to him and he conversed in that very state. Then `Uthman sought permission to enter; Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sat down and he set right his clothes. Muhammad (one of the narrators) said: I do not say that it happened on the same day. He (`Uthman) then entered and conversed and as he went out, `Aisha said: Abu Bakr entered and you did not stir and did not observe much care (in arranging your clothes), then `Umar entered and you did not stir and did not arrange your clothes, then `Uthman entered and you got up and set your clothes right, so he (ﷺ) said: Should I not show modesty to one whom even the Angels show modesty
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ، بْنُ خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ، أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْعَاصِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعُثْمَانَ حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ لاَبِسٌ مِرْطَ عَائِشَةَ فَأَذِنَ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَهُوَ كَذَلِكَ فَقَضَى إِلَيْهِ حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنَ عُمَرُ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ وَهُوَ عَلَى تِلْكَ الْحَالِ فَقَضَى إِلَيْهِ حَاجَتَهُ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُثْمَانُ ثُمَّ اسْتَأْذَنْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَجَلَسَ وَقَالَ لِعَائِشَةَ ‏"‏ اجْمَعِي عَلَيْكِ ثِيَابَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَضَيْتُ إِلَيْهِ حَاجَتِي ثُمَّ انْصَرَفْتُ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لِي لَمْ أَرَكَ فَزِعْتَ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمَا كَمَا فَزِعْتَ لِعُثْمَانَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ عُثْمَانَ رَجُلٌ حَيِيٌّ وَإِنِّي خَشِيتُ إِنْ أَذِنْتُ لَهُ عَلَى تِلْكَ الْحَالِ أَنْ لاَ يَبْلُغَ إِلَىَّ فِي حَاجَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu, bnu khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an yahyaa bni sa'iydi bni al'aasi, aanna sa'iyda bna al'aasi, aakhbarahu aanna 'aaiishaaa zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'uthmaana haddathaahu aanna aabaa bakrin astaadhana 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa mudtaji'un 'alaa firaashihi laabisun mirta 'aaiishaaa faaadhina laabiy bakrin wahuwa kadhalika faqadaa iilayhi haajatahu thumma ansarafa thumma astaadhana 'umaru faaadhina lahu wahuwa 'alaa tilka alhaali faqadaa iilayhi haajatahu thumma ansarafa ‏.‏ qaala 'uthmaanu thumma astaadhantu 'alayhi fajalasa waqaala li'aaiishaaa ‏"‏ ajma'iy 'alayki thiyaabaki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqadaytu iilayhi haajatiy thumma ansaraftu faqaalat 'aaiishaau yaa rasuwla alllahi maa liy lam aaraka fazi'ta laabiy bakrin wa'umara radiya alllahu 'anhumaa kamaa fazi'ta li'uthmaana qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna 'uthmaana rajulun hayiyyun waiinniy khashiytu iin aadhintu lahu 'alaa tilka alhaali aan laa yablugha iilaaaa fiy haajatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (mav peace be upon him), and Uthman both reported that Abu Bakr sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for entrance (in his apartment) as he had been lying on his bed covered with the bed-sheet of A'isha, and he gave permission to Abu Bakr in that very state and he, having his need fulfilled, went back. Then Umar sought permission and it was given to him in that very state and, after having his need fulfilled, he went back. And 'Uthman reported:Then I sought permission from him and he got up and raid to A'isha: Wrap yourself well with your cloth, then I got my need fulfilled and came back. And A'isha said: Allah's Messenger, why is it that I did not see you feeling any anxiety in case of dressing properly in the presence of Abu Bakr and 'Umar (Allah be pleased with them) as you showed in case of 'Uthman. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Verily Uthman is a person who is very modest and I was afraid that if I permitted him to enter in this very state he would not inform me of his need
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَالْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ، بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي يَحْيَى، بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْعَاصِ أَنَّ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْعَاصِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُثْمَانَ وَعَائِشَةَ حَدَّثَاهُ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عُقَيْلٍ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waalhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, kulluhum 'an ya'quwba, bni iibraahiyma bni sa'din haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, 'ani abni shihaabin, qaala aakhbaraniy yahyaa, bnu sa'iydi bni al'aasi aanna sa'iyda bna al'aasi, aakhbarahu aanna 'uthmaana wa'aaiishaaa haddathaahu aanna aabaa bakrin alssiddiyqa astaadhana 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi 'uqaylin 'ani alzzuhriyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Uthman and A'isha with the same wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَائِطٍ مِنْ حَائِطِ الْمَدِينَةِ وَهُوَ مُتَّكِئٌ يَرْكُزُ بِعُودٍ مَعَهُ بَيْنَ الْمَاءِ وَالطِّينِ إِذَا اسْتَفْتَحَ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ افْتَحْ وَبَشِّرْهُ بِالْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِذَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَفَتَحْتُ لَهُ وَبَشَّرْتُهُ بِالْجَنَّةِ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ اسْتَفْتَحَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ افْتَحْ وَبَشِّرْهُ بِالْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَهَبْتُ فَإِذَا هُوَ عُمَرُ فَفَتَحْتُ لَهُ وَبَشَّرْتُهُ بِالْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ اسْتَفْتَحَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ - قَالَ - فَجَلَسَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ افْتَحْ وَبَشِّرْهُ بِالْجَنَّةِ عَلَى بَلْوَى تَكُونُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَهَبْتُ فَإِذَا هُوَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ - قَالَ - فَفَتَحْتُ وَبَشَّرْتُهُ بِالْجَنَّةِ - قَالَ - وَقُلْتُ الَّذِي قَالَ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ صَبْرًا أَوِ اللَّهُ الْمُسْتَعَانُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an 'uthmaana bni ghiyaathin, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana alnnahdiyyi, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, qaala baynamaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy haaiitin min haaiiti almadiynaai wahuwa muttakiiun yarkuzu bi'uwdin ma'ahu bayna almaa'i waalttiyni iidhaa astaftaha rajulun faqaala ‏"‏ aftah wabashhirhu bialjannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faiidhaa aabuw bakrin fafatahtu lahu wabashhartuhu bialjannaai - qaala - thumma astaftaha rajulun akharu faqaala ‏"‏ aftah wabashhirhu bialjannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fadhahabtu faiidhaa huwa 'umaru fafatahtu lahu wabashhartuhu bialjannaai thumma astaftaha rajulun akharu - qaala - fajalasa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aftah wabashhirhu bialjannaai 'alaa balwaa takuwnu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fadhahabtu faiidhaa huwa 'uthmaanu bnu 'affaana - qaala - fafatahtu wabashhartuhu bialjannaai - qaala - waqultu alladhiy qaala faqaala alllahumma sabrana aawi alllahu almusta'aanu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa al-Ash'ari reported that while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in one of the gardens of Medina, reclining against a pillow and fixing a stick in a mud, that a person came asking for the gate to be opened, whereupon he said:Open it for him and give him glad tidings of Paradise and, lo, it was Abu Bakr. I opened (the gate) for him and gave him the glad tidings of Paradise. Then another person asked for the door to be opened, whereupon he said: Open it and give him the glad tidings of Piradise. He said: I went away and, lo, it was 'Umar. I opened it for him and gave him the glad tidings of Paradise. Then still another man asked for the door to be opened, and thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Open it and give him the glad tidings of Paradise after a trial would afflict him. I went and, lo, it was 'Uthman b. 'Affan. 1 opened the door and gave him the glad tidings of Paradise and informed him (what the Prophet had said). Thereupon he said: O Allah, grant me steadfastness. Allah is one Whose help is to be sought
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ حَائِطًا وَأَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَحْفَظَ الْبَابَ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana alnnahdiyyi, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala haaiitana waaamaraniy aan aahfaza albaaba ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi 'uthmaana bni ghiyaathin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Musa al-Ash'ari with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِسْكِينٍ الْيَمَامِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَسَّانَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ شَرِيكِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ، أَنَّهُ تَوَضَّأَ فِي بَيْتِهِ ثُمَّ خَرَجَ فَقَالَ لأَلْزَمَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلأَكُونَنَّ مَعَهُ يَوْمِي هَذَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءَ الْمَسْجِدَ فَسَأَلَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالُوا خَرَجَ ‏.‏ وَجَّهَ هَا هُنَا - قَالَ - فَخَرَجْتُ عَلَى أَثَرِهِ أَسْأَلُ عَنْهُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ بِئْرَ أَرِيسٍ - قَالَ - فَجَلَسْتُ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ وَبَابُهَا مِنْ جَرِيدٍ حَتَّى قَضَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَاجَتَهُ وَتَوَضَّأَ فَقُمْتُ إِلَيْهِ فَإِذَا هُوَ قَدْ جَلَسَ عَلَى بِئْرِ أَرِيسٍ وَتَوَسَّطَ قُفَّهَا وَكَشَفَ عَنْ سَاقَيْهِ وَدَلاَّهُمَا فِي الْبِئْرِ - قَالَ - فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ انْصَرَفْتُ فَجَلَسْتُ عِنْدَ الْبَابِ فَقُلْتُ لأَكُونَنَّ بَوَّابَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْيَوْمَ ‏.‏ فَجَاءَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَدَفَعَ الْبَابَ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ عَلَى رِسْلِكَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ ذَهَبْتُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لَهُ وَبَشِّرْهُ بِالْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَقْبَلْتُ حَتَّى قُلْتُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ ادْخُلْ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُبَشِّرُكَ بِالْجَنَّةِ - قَالَ - فَدَخَلَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فَجَلَسَ عَنْ يَمِينِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَهُ فِي الْقُفِّ وَدَلَّى رِجْلَيْهِ فِي الْبِئْرِ كَمَا صَنَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَشَفَ عَنْ سَاقَيْهِ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ فَجَلَسْتُ وَقَدْ تَرَكْتُ أَخِي يَتَوَضَّأُ وَيَلْحَقُنِي فَقُلْتُ إِنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِفُلاَنٍ - يُرِيدُ أَخَاهُ - خَيْرًا يَأْتِ بِهِ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا إِنْسَانٌ يُحَرِّكُ الْبَابَ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ عَلَى رِسْلِكَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ جِئْتُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَقُلْتُ هَذَا عُمَرُ يَسْتَأْذِنُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لَهُ وَبَشِّرْهُ بِالْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجِئْتُ عُمَرَ فَقُلْتُ أَذِنَ وَيُبَشِّرُكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْجَنَّةِ - قَالَ - فَدَخَلَ فَجَلَسَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْقُفِّ عَنْ يَسَارِهِ وَدَلَّى رِجْلَيْهِ فِي الْبِئْرِ ثُمَّ رَجَعْتُ فَجَلَسْتُ فَقُلْتُ إِنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِفُلاَنٍ خَيْرًا - يَعْنِي أَخَاهُ - يَأْتِ بِهِ فَجَاءَ إِنْسَانٌ فَحَرَّكَ الْبَابَ فَقُلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا فَقَالَ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ عَلَى رِسْلِكَ - قَالَ - وَجِئْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنْ لَهُ وَبَشِّرْهُ بِالْجَنَّةِ مَعَ بَلْوَى تُصِيبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجِئْتُ فَقُلْتُ ادْخُلْ وَيُبَشِّرُكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْجَنَّةِ مَعَ بَلْوَى تُصِيبُكَ - قَالَ - فَدَخَلَ فَوَجَدَ الْقُفَّ قَدْ مُلِئَ فَجَلَسَ وُجَاهَهُمْ مِنَ الشِّقِّ الآخَرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ شَرِيكٌ فَقَالَ سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ فَأَوَّلْتُهَا قُبُورَهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu miskiynin alyamaamiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hassaana, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - wahuwa abnu bilaalin - 'an shariyki bni aabiy namirin, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, aakhbaraniy aabuw muwsaa alaash'ariyyu, aannahu tawaddaaa fiy baytihi thumma kharaja faqaala laalzamanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walaakuwnanna ma'ahu yawmiy hadhaa ‏.‏ qaala fajaa'a almasjida fasaaala 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaaluwa kharaja ‏.‏ wajjaha haa hunaa - qaala - fakharajtu 'alaa aatharihi aasaalu 'anhu hattaa dakhala biira aariysin - qaala - fajalastu 'inda albaabi wabaabuhaa min jariydin hattaa qadaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm haajatahu watawaddaaa faqumtu iilayhi faiidhaa huwa qad jalasa 'alaa biiri aariysin watawassata quffahaa wakashafa 'an saaqayhi wadalaaahumaa fiy albiiri - qaala - fasallamtu 'alayhi thumma ansaraftu fajalastu 'inda albaabi faqultu laakuwnanna bawwaaba rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alyawma ‏.‏ fajaa'a aabuw bakrin fadafa'a albaaba faqultu man hadhaa faqaala aabuw bakrin ‏.‏ faqultu 'alaa rislika - qaala - thumma dhahabtu faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa aabuw bakrin yastaadhinu faqaala ‏"‏ aidhan lahu wabashhirhu bialjannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaaqbaltu hattaa qultu laabiy bakrin adkhul warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yubashhiruka bialjannaai - qaala - fadakhala aabuw bakrin fajalasa 'an yamiyni rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'ahu fiy alquffi wadallaa rijlayhi fiy albiiri kamaa sana'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm wakashafa 'an saaqayhi thumma raja'tu fajalastu waqad taraktu aakhiy yatawaddaau wayalhaquniy faqultu iin yuridi alllahu bifulaanin - yuriydu aakhaahu - khayrana yaati bihi ‏.‏ faiidhaa iinsaanun yuharriku albaaba faqultu man hadhaa faqaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi ‏.‏ faqultu 'alaa rislika ‏.‏ thumma jiitu iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fasallamtu 'alayhi waqultu hadhaa 'umaru yastaadhinu faqaala ‏"‏ aidhan lahu wabashhirhu bialjannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fajiitu 'umara faqultu aadhina wayubashhiruka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialjannaai - qaala - fadakhala fajalasa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alquffi 'an yasaarihi wadallaa rijlayhi fiy albiiri thumma raja'tu fajalastu faqultu iin yuridi alllahu bifulaanin khayrana - ya'niy aakhaahu - yaati bihi fajaa'a iinsaanun faharraka albaaba faqultu man hadhaa faqaala 'uthmaanu bnu 'affaana ‏.‏ faqultu 'alaa rislika - qaala - wajiitu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbartuhu faqaala ‏"‏ aidhan lahu wabashhirhu bialjannaai ma'a balwaa tusiybuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fajiitu faqultu adkhul wayubashhiruka rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialjannaai ma'a balwaa tusiybuka - qaala - fadakhala fawajada alquffa qad muliia fajalasa wujaahahum mina alshhiqqi alakhari ‏.‏ qaala shariykun faqaala sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi faaawwaltuhaa qubuwrahum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported that he performed ablution in his house and then came out saying:I would remain with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the whole day long. He came to the mosque, and asked about Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). They (his Companions) said: He has gone in this direction. He (Abu Musa Ash'ari) said: I followed his steps asking about him until I came to Bi'r Aris (it is a well in the suburb of Medina). I sat by its wooden door until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had relieved himself and then performed ablution. I went to him and he was sitting with his shanks uncovered hp to the knees and his legs dangl- ing in that well. I offered him salutations. I then came back and sat at the door as if I had been a chamberlain at the door of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that day. There came Abu Bakr and knocked the door and I said: Who is it? He said: This is Abu Bakr. I said: Wait, please. I went and said: Allah's Messenger, here is Abu Bakr seeking permission. Thereupon he said: Admit him and give him glad tidings of Paradise. I came and I said to Abu Bakr to get in (and also told him) that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was giving him the glad tidings of Paradise. Abu Bakr got in and sat on the right side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and dangled his feet in the well as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had done, and he uncovered his shanks. I then returned and sat there and I had left my brother as he had been performing ablution and he was to meet me and I said: If Allah would intend goodness for such and such he would intend goodness for his brother and He would bring him. I was thinking this that a person stirred the door. I said: Who is it. He said: This is Umar b., Khattab. I said: Wait. Then I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), greeted him and said: Here is 'Umar seeking your. permission to get in. Thereupon he said: Let him come in and give him glad tid- ings of Paradise. I came to Umar and said: There is permission for you and glad tidings for you from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for Paradise. He got in and sat on the left side of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) with his feet dangling in the well. I then returned and sat and said: If Allah would intend goodness for such and such (that is for his brother), He would bring him. And I was contemplat- ing over it that a man stirred the door and I said: Who is it? He said: This is Uthman b. Affan. I said: Wait, please. I then came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him. and he said: Admit him and give him glad tidings (and inform) him of the turmoil which he shall have to face. I came and said: Get in, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gives you the glad tidings of Paradise along with the trial which you shall have to face. He got in and saw the elevated plan round the well fully occupied. He sat on the other side. Sharik said that Sa'id b. al-Musayyib reported: I drew a conclusion from it that their groves would be (in this very state, the graves of Hadrat Abu Bakr, 'Umar Faruq by the tide of the Prophet [may peace be upon him] and the grave of Hadrat 'Uthman away from their graves
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عُفَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيُّ، هَا هُنَا - وَأَشَارَ لِي سُلَيْمَانُ إِلَى مَجْلِسِ سَعِيدٍ نَاحِيَةَ الْمَقْصُورَةِ - قَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى خَرَجْتُ أُرِيدُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَجَدْتُهُ قَدْ سَلَكَ فِي الأَمْوَالِ فَتَبِعْتُهُ فَوَجَدْتُهُ قَدْ دَخَلَ مَالاً فَجَلَسَ فِي الْقُفِّ وَكَشَفَ عَنْ سَاقَيْهِ وَدَلاَّهُمَا فِي الْبِئْرِ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بْنِ حَسَّانَ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَوْلَ سَعِيدٍ فَأَوَّلْتُهَا قُبُورَهُمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'ufayrin, haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, haddathaniy shariyku bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy namirin, sami'tu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yaquwlu haddathaniy aabuw muwsaa alaash'ariyyu, haa hunaa - waaashaara liy sulaymaanu iilaa majlisi sa'iydin naahiyaaa almaqsuwraai - qaala aabuw muwsaa kharajtu auriydu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fawajadtuhu qad salaka fiy alaamwaali fatabi'tuhu fawajadtuhu qad dakhala maalaan fajalasa fiy alquffi wakashafa 'an saaqayhi wadalaaahumaa fiy albiiri ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi yahyaa bni hassaana walam yadhkur qawla sa'iydin faaawwaltuhaa qubuwrahum ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa. reported:I set out with the intention (of meeting) Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and came to know that he had gone to the gardens (in the suburb of Medina). I followed him and found him in a garden sitting upon an elevated place round the well with his shanks uncovered which had been dangling in the well. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that there is no mention of the words of Sa'id: all drew a conclusion from it pertaining to their graves
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي، مَرْيَمَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ أَبِي كَثِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي شَرِيكُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي نَمِرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ، بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا إِلَى حَائِطٍ بِالْمَدِينَةِ لِحَاجَتِهِ فَخَرَجْتُ فِي إِثْرِهِ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ وَذَكَرَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ ‏.‏ فَتَأَوَّلْتُ ذَلِكَ قُبُورَهُمُ اجْتَمَعَتْ هَا هُنَا وَانْفَرَدَ عُثْمَانُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa qaalaa haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy, maryama haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'fari bni aabiy kathiyrin, aakhbaraniy shariyku bnu 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy namirin, 'an sa'iydi, bni almusayyabi 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana iilaa haaiitin bialmadiynaai lihaajatihi fakharajtu fiy iithrihi ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi sulaymaana bni bilaalin wadhakara fiy alhadiythi qaala abnu almusayyabi ‏.‏ fataaawwaltu dhalika qubuwrahumu ajtama'at haa hunaa waanfarada 'uthmaanu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. al-Musayyib reported Abu Musa Ash'ari having said that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out one day to the suburbs of Medina for reliev- ing himself. I followed his steps. The rest of the hadith is the same. Ibn Musayyib said:I concluded (from the manner of their sitting) the (order) of their graves. (The three) would be together (the graves of the Holy Prophet, Hadrat Abu Bakr and Hadrat Umar) and that of 'Uthman would be separate (from them)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ وَسُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يُوسُفَ الْمَاجِشُونِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الصَّبَّاحِ - حَدَّثَنَا يُوسُفُ، أَبُو سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونُ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ، بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعَلِيٍّ ‏ "‏ أَنْتَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ لاَ نَبِيَّ بَعْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعِيدٌ فَأَحْبَبْتُ أَنْ أُشَافِهَ بِهَا سَعْدًا فَلَقِيتُ سَعْدًا فَحَدَّثْتُهُ بِمَا حَدَّثَنِي عَامِرٌ فَقَالَ أَنَا سَمِعْتُهُ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ آنْتَ سَمِعْتَهُ فَوَضَعَ إِصْبَعَيْهِ عَلَى أُذُنَيْهِ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِلاَّ فَاسْتَكَّتَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw ja'farin muhammadu bnu alssabbaahi wa'ubaydu alllahi alqawaariyriyyu wasurayju bnu yuwnusa kulluhum 'an yuwsufa almaajishuwni, - waalllafzu laibni alssabbaahi - haddathanaa yuwsufu, aabuw salamaaa almaajishuwnu haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almunkadiri, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'di, bni aabiy waqqaasin 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm li'aliyyin ‏ "‏ aanta minniy bimanzilaai haaruwna min muwsaa iilaaa aannahu laa nabiyya ba'diy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sa'iydun faaahbabtu aan aushaafiha bihaa sa'dana falaqiytu sa'dana fahaddathtuhu bimaa haddathaniy 'aamirun faqaala aanaa sami'tuhu ‏.‏ faqultu anta sami'tahu fawada'a iisba'ayhi 'alaa audhunayhi faqaala na'am waiilaaa faastakkataa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas reported (on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) addressing 'Ali said:You are in the same position with relation to me as Aaron (Harun) was in relation to Moses but with (this explicit difference) that there is no prophet after me. Sa'd said: I had an earnest desire to hear it directly from Sa'd, so I met him and narrated to him what (his son) Amir had narrated to me, whereupon he said: Yes, I did hear it. I said: Did you hear it yourself? Thereupon he placed his fingers upon his ears and said: Yes, and if not, let both my ears become deaf
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ، أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، قَالَ خَلَّفَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تُخَلِّفُنِي فِي النِّسَاءِ وَالْصِّبْيَانِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لاَ نَبِيَّ بَعْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, 'an mus'abi bni sa'di bni, aabiy waqqaasin 'an sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, qaala khallafa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin fiy ghazwaai tabuwka faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi tukhallifuniy fiy alnnisaa'i waalssibyaani faqaala ‏ "‏ aamaa tardaa aan takuwna minniy bimanzilaai haaruwna min muwsaa ghayra aannahu laa nabiyya ba'diy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) left 'Ali b. Abi Talib behind him (as he proceeded) to the expedition of Tabuk, whereupon he ('Ali) said:Allah's Messenger, are you leaving me behind amongst women and children? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Aren't you satisfied with being unto me what Aaron was unto Moses but with this exception that there would be no prophet after me?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ بُكَيْرِ بْنِ مِسْمَارٍ، عَنْ عَامِرِ بْنِ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ أَمَرَ مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ سَعْدًا فَقَالَ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَنْ تَسُبَّ أَبَا التُّرَابِ فَقَالَ أَمَّا مَا ذَكَرْتُ ثَلاَثًا قَالَهُنَّ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَنْ أَسُبَّهُ لأَنْ تَكُونَ لِي وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْهُنَّ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ حُمْرِ النَّعَمِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ لَهُ خَلَّفَهُ فِي بَعْضِ مَغَازِيهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَلِيٌّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ خَلَّفْتَنِي مَعَ النِّسَاءِ وَالصِّبْيَانِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ لاَ نُبُوَّةَ بَعْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ الرَّايَةَ رَجُلاً يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَطَاوَلْنَا لَهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ادْعُوا لِي عَلِيًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ أَرْمَدَ فَبَصَقَ فِي عَيْنِهِ وَدَفَعَ الرَّايَةَ إِلَيْهِ فَفَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا نَدْعُ أَبْنَاءَنَا وَأَبْنَاءَكُمْ‏}‏ دَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلِيًّا وَفَاطِمَةَ وَحَسَنًا وَحُسَيْنًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ هَؤُلاَءِ أَهْلِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, - wataqaarabaa fiy alllafzi - qaalaa haddathanaa haatimun, - wahuwa abnu iismaa'iyla - 'an bukayri bni mismaarin, 'an 'aamiri bni sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala aamara mu'aawiyaau bnu aabiy sufyaana sa'dana faqaala maa mana'aka aan tasubba aabaa altturaabi faqaala aammaa maa dhakartu thalaathana qaalahunna lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falan aasubbahu laan takuwna liy waahidaaun minhunna aahabbu iilaaaa min humri alnna'ami sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu lahu khallafahu fiy ba'di maghaaziyhi faqaala lahu 'aliyyun yaa rasuwla alllahi khallaftaniy ma'a alnnisaa'i waalssibyaani faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aamaa tardaa aan takuwna minniy bimanzilaai haaruwna min muwsaa iilaaa aannahu laa nubuwwaaa ba'diy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasami'tuhu yaquwlu yawma khaybara ‏"‏ lau'tiyanna alrraayaaa rajulaan yuhibbu alllaha warasuwlahu wayuhibbuhu alllahu warasuwluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fatataawalnaa lahaa faqaala ‏"‏ ad'uwa liy 'aliyyana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faautiya bihi aarmada fabasaqa fiy 'aynihi wadafa'a alrraayaaa iilayhi fafataha alllahu 'alayhi walammaa nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ faqul ta'aalawa nad'u aabnaa'anaa waaabnaa'akum‏}‏ da'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aliyyana wafaatimaaa wahasanana wahusaynana faqaala ‏"‏ alllahumma hauulaa'i aahliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd b. Abi Waqqas reported on the authority of his father that Muawiya b. Abi Sufyan appointed Sa'd as the Governor and said:What prevents you from rebuking Abu Turab (Hadrat 'Ali), whereupon be said: It is because of three things which I remember Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said about him that I would not rebuke him and even if I find one of those three things for me, it would be more dear to me than the red camels. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say about 'Ali as he left him behind in one of his campaigns (that was Tabuk). 'Ali said to him: Allah's Messenger, you leave me behind along with women and children. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Aren't you satisfied with being unto me what Aaron was unto Moses but with this exception that there is no prophethood after me. And I (also) heard him say on the Day of Khaibar: I would certainly give this standard to a person who loves Allah and his Messenger, and Allah and his Messenger love him too. He (the narrator) said: We had been anxiously waiting for it, when he (the Holy Prophet) said: Call 'Ali. He was called and his eyes were inflamed. He applied saliva to his eyes and handed over the standard to him, and Allah gave him victory. (The third occasion is this) when the (following) verse was revealed: "Let us summon our children and your children." Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called 'Ali, Fatima, Hasan and Husain and said: O Allah, they are my family
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، سَمِعْتُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنَ سَعْدٍ عَنْ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِعَلِيٍّ ‏ "‏ أَمَا تَرْضَى أَنْ تَكُونَ مِنِّي بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ مِنْ مُوسَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, sami'tu iibraahiyma, bna sa'din 'an sa'din, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala li'aliyyin ‏ "‏ aamaa tardaa aan takuwna minniy bimanzilaai haaruwna min muwsaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'd reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying to 'Ali:Aren't you satisfied with being unto me what Aaron was unto Moses?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ هَذِهِ الرَّايَةَ رَجُلاً يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ مَا أَحْبَبْتُ الإِمَارَةَ إِلاَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ - قَالَ - فَتَسَاوَرْتُ لَهَا رَجَاءَ أَنْ أُدْعَى لَهَا - قَالَ - فَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَأَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهَا وَقَالَ ‏"‏ امْشِ وَلاَ تَلْتَفِتْ حَتَّى يَفْتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَارَ عَلِيٌّ شَيْئًا ثُمَّ وَقَفَ وَلَمْ يَلْتَفِتْ فَصَرَخَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ عَلَى مَاذَا أُقَاتِلُ النَّاسَ قَالَ ‏"‏ قَاتِلْهُمْ حَتَّى يَشْهَدُوا أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَإِذَا فَعَلُوا ذَلِكَ فَقَدْ مَنَعُوا مِنْكَ دِمَاءَهُمْ وَأَمْوَالَهُمْ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهَا وَحِسَابُهُمْ عَلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala yawma khaybara ‏"‏ lau'tiyanna hadhihi alrraayaaa rajulaan yuhibbu alllaha warasuwlahu yaftahu alllahu 'alaa yadayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi maa aahbabtu aliimaaraaa iilaaa yawmaiidhin - qaala - fatasaawartu lahaa rajaa'a aan aud'aa lahaa - qaala - fada'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin faaa'taahu iiyyaahaa waqaala ‏"‏ amshi walaa taltafit hattaa yaftaha alllahu 'alayka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fasaara 'aliyyun shayiana thumma waqafa walam yaltafit fasarakha yaa rasuwla alllahi 'alaa maadhaa auqaatilu alnnaasa qaala ‏"‏ qaatilhum hattaa yashhaduwa aan laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waaanna muhammadana rasuwlu alllahi faiidhaa fa'aluwa dhalika faqad mana'uwa minka dimaa'ahum waaamwaalahum iilaaa bihaqqihaa wahisaabuhum 'alaa alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Suhail reported on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the Day of Khaibar:I shall certainly give this standard in the hand of one who loves Allah and his Messenger and Allah will grant victory at his hand. Umar b. Khattab said: Never did I cherish for leadership but on that day. I came before him with the hope that I may be called for this, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called 'Ali b. Abu Talib and he conferred (this honour) upon him and said: Proceed on and do not look about until Allah grants you victory, and 'Ali went a bit and then halted and did not look about and then said in a loud voice: Allah's Messenger, on what issue should I fight with the people? Thereupon he (the Prophet) said: Fight with them until they bear testimony to the fact that there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is his Messenger, and when they do that then their blood and their riches are inviolable from your hands but what is justified by law and their reckoning is with Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ أَبِي حَازِمٍ - عَنْ أَبِي، حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ هَذَا - حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَهْلُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمَ خَيْبَرَ ‏"‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ هَذِهِ الرَّايَةَ رَجُلاً يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَى يَدَيْهِ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ وَيُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَبَاتَ النَّاسُ يَدُوكُونَ لَيْلَتَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يُعْطَاهَا - قَالَ - فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ النَّاسُ غَدَوْا عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كُلُّهُمْ يَرْجُونَ أَنْ يُعْطَاهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيْنَ عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ يَشْتَكِي عَيْنَيْهِ - قَالَ - فَأَرْسَلُوا إِلَيْهِ فَأُتِيَ بِهِ فَبَصَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي عَيْنَيْهِ وَدَعَا لَهُ فَبَرَأَ حَتَّى كَأَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِهِ وَجَعٌ فَأَعْطَاهُ الرَّايَةَ فَقَالَ عَلِيٌّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أُقَاتِلُهُمْ حَتَّى يَكُونُوا مِثْلَنَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ انْفُذْ عَلَى رِسْلِكَ حَتَّى تَنْزِلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ ثُمَّ ادْعُهُمْ إِلَى الإِسْلاَمِ وَأَخْبِرْهُمْ بِمَا يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنْ حَقِّ اللَّهِ فِيهِ فَوَاللَّهِ لأَنْ يَهْدِيَ اللَّهُ بِكَ رَجُلاً وَاحِدًا خَيْرٌ لَكَ مِنْ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَكَ حُمْرُ النَّعَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna aabiy haazimin - 'an aabiy, haazimin 'an sahlin, h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, - waalllafzu hadhaa - haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an aabiy haazimin, aakhbaraniy sahlu bnu sa'din, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala yawma khaybara ‏"‏ lau'tiyanna hadhihi alrraayaaa rajulaan yaftahu alllahu 'alaa yadayhi yuhibbu alllaha warasuwlahu wayuhibbuhu alllahu warasuwluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fabaata alnnaasu yaduwkuwna laylatahum aayyuhum yu'taahaa - qaala - falammaa aasbaha alnnaasu ghadawa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kulluhum yarjuwna aan yu'taahaa faqaala ‏"‏ aayna 'aliyyu bnu aabiy taalibin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa huwa yaa rasuwla alllahi yashtakiy 'aynayhi - qaala - faaarsaluwa iilayhi faautiya bihi fabasaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy 'aynayhi wada'aa lahu fabaraaa hattaa kaaan lam yakun bihi waja'un faaa'taahu alrraayaaa faqaala 'aliyyun yaa rasuwla alllahi auqaatiluhum hattaa yakuwnuwa mithlanaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ anfudh 'alaa rislika hattaa tanzila bisaahatihim thumma ad'uhum iilaa aliislaami waaakhbirhum bimaa yajibu 'alayhim min haqqi alllahi fiyhi fawaalllahi laan yahdiya alllahu bika rajulaan waahidana khayrun laka min aan yakuwna laka humru alnna'ami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said on the Day of Khaibar:I would certainly give this standard to a person at whose hand Allah would grant victory and who loves Allah and His Messenger and Allah and His Messenger love him also. The people spent the night thinking as to whom it would be given. When it was morning the people hastened to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) all of them hoping that that would be given to him. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Where is 'Ali b. Abu Talib? They said: Allah's Messenger, his eyes are sore. He then sent for him and he was brought and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) applied saliva to his eyes and invoked blessings and he was all right, as if he had no ailment at all, and conferred upon him the standard. 'Ali said: Allah's Messenger, I will fight them until they are like us. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Advance cautiously until you reach their open places, thereafter invite them to Islam and inform them what is obligatory for them from the rights of Allah, for, by Allah, if Allah guides aright even one person through you that is better for you than to possess the most valuable of the camels
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي، عُبَيْدٍ عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ الأَكْوَعِ، قَالَ كَانَ عَلِيٌّ قَدْ تَخَلَّفَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي خَيْبَرَ وَكَانَ رَمِدًا فَقَالَ أَنَا أَتَخَلَّفُ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ عَلِيٌّ فَلَحِقَ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا كَانَ مَسَاءُ اللَّيْلَةِ الَّتِي فَتَحَهَا اللَّهُ فِي صَبَاحِهَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لأُعْطِيَنَّ الرَّايَةَ - أَوْ لَيَأْخُذَنَّ بِالرَّايَةِ - غَدًا رَجُلٌ يُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَوْ قَالَ يُحِبُّ اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ يَفْتَحُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَإِذَا نَحْنُ بِعَلِيٍّ وَمَا نَرْجُوهُ فَقَالُوا هَذَا عَلِيٌّ ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الرَّايَةَ فَفَتَحَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa haatimun, - ya'niy abna iismaa'iyla - 'an yaziyda bni aabiy, 'ubaydin 'an salamaaa bni alaakwa'i, qaala kaana 'aliyyun qad takhallafa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy khaybara wakaana ramidana faqaala aanaa aatakhallafu 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fakharaja 'aliyyun falahiqa bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa kaana masaa'u alllaylaai allatiy fatahahaa alllahu fiy sabaahihaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ lau'tiyanna alrraayaaa - aaw layaakhudhanna bialrraayaai - ghadana rajulun yuhibbuhu alllahu warasuwluhu aaw qaala yuhibbu alllaha warasuwlahu yaftahu alllahu 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faiidhaa nahnu bi'aliyyin wamaa narjuwhu faqaaluwa hadhaa 'aliyyun ‏.‏ faaa'taahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alrraayaaa fafataha alllahu 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salama b. Akwa' reported that it was 'Ali whom Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) left behind him (in the charge of his family and the Islamic State) on the occasion of the campaign of Khaibar, and his eyes were inflamed and he said:Is it for me to remain behind Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? So he went forth and rejoined Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and on the evening of that night (after which) next morning Allah granted victory. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I will certainly give this standard to a man whom Allah and His Messenger love. or he said: Who loves Allah or His Messenger and Allah will grant him victory through him, and, lo, we saw 'Ali whom we least expected (to be present on that occasion). They (the Companions) said: Here is 'Ali. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (may peace be upon hin) gave him the standard. Allah granted victory at his hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَشُجَاعُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو حَيَّانَ، حَدَّثَنِي يَزِيدُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَحُصَيْنُ، بْنُ سَبْرَةَ وَعُمَرُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ إِلَى زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ فَلَمَّا جَلَسْنَا إِلَيْهِ قَالَ لَهُ حُصَيْنٌ لَقَدْ لَقِيتَ يَا زَيْدُ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا رَأَيْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَسَمِعْتَ حَدِيثَهُ وَغَزَوْتَ مَعَهُ وَصَلَّيْتَ خَلْفَهُ لَقَدْ لَقِيتَ يَا زَيْدُ خَيْرًا كَثِيرًا حَدِّثْنَا يَا زَيْدُ مَا سَمِعْتَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - يَا ابْنَ أَخِي وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كَبِرَتْ سِنِّي وَقَدُمَ عَهْدِي وَنَسِيتُ بَعْضَ الَّذِي كُنْتُ أَعِي مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا حَدَّثْتُكُمْ فَاقْبَلُوا وَمَا لاَ فَلاَ تُكَلِّفُونِيهِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فِينَا خَطِيبًا بِمَاءٍ يُدْعَى خُمًّا بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ فَحَمِدَ اللَّهَ وَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ وَوَعَظَ وَذَكَّرَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ أَلاَ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ يُوشِكُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ رَسُولُ رَبِّي فَأُجِيبَ وَأَنَا تَارِكٌ فِيكُمْ ثَقَلَيْنِ أَوَّلُهُمَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فِيهِ الْهُدَى وَالنُّورُ فَخُذُوا بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَاسْتَمْسِكُوا بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَحَثَّ عَلَى كِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَرَغَّبَ فِيهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَأَهْلُ بَيْتِي أُذَكِّرُكُمُ اللَّهَ فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِي أُذَكِّرُكُمُ اللَّهَ فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِي أُذَكِّرُكُمُ اللَّهَ فِي أَهْلِ بَيْتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ حُصَيْنٌ وَمَنْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ يَا زَيْدُ أَلَيْسَ نِسَاؤُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ قَالَ نِسَاؤُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَلَكِنْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ مَنْ حُرِمَ الصَّدَقَةَ بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَنْ هُمْ قَالَ هُمْ آلُ عَلِيٍّ وَآلُ عَقِيلٍ وَآلُ جَعْفَرٍ وَآلُ عَبَّاسٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ حُرِمَ الصَّدَقَةَ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, washujaa'u bnu makhladin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathaniy aabuw hayyaana, haddathaniy yaziydu bnu hayyaana, qaala antalaqtu aanaa wahusaynu, bnu sabraaa wa'umaru bnu muslimin iilaa zaydi bni aarqama falammaa jalasnaa iilayhi qaala lahu husaynun laqad laqiyta yaa zaydu khayrana kathiyrana raaayta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasami'ta hadiythahu waghazawta ma'ahu wasallayta khalfahu laqad laqiyta yaa zaydu khayrana kathiyrana haddithnaa yaa zaydu maa sami'ta min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - yaa abna aakhiy waalllahi laqad kabirat sinniy waqaduma 'ahdiy wanasiytu ba'da alladhiy kuntu aa'iy min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm famaa haddathtukum faaqbaluwa wamaa laa falaa tukallifuwniyhi ‏.‏ thumma qaala qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana fiynaa khatiybana bimaa'in yud'aa khummana bayna makkaaa waalmadiynaai fahamida alllaha waaathnaa 'alayhi wawa'aza wadhakkara thumma qaala ‏"‏ aammaa ba'du aalaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu faiinnamaa aanaa basharun yuwshiku aan yaatiya rasuwlu rabbiy faaujiyba waaanaa taarikun fiykum thaqalayni aawwaluhumaa kitaabu alllahi fiyhi alhudaa waalnnuwru fakhudhuwa bikitaabi alllahi waastamsikuwa bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fahathha 'alaa kitaabi alllahi waraghhaba fiyhi thumma qaala ‏"‏ waaahlu baytiy audhakkirukumu alllaha fiy aahli baytiy audhakkirukumu alllaha fiy aahli baytiy audhakkirukumu alllaha fiy aahli baytiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala lahu husaynun waman aahlu baytihi yaa zaydu aalaysa nisaauuhu min aahli baytihi qaala nisaauuhu min aahli baytihi walakin aahlu baytihi man hurima alssadaqaaa ba'dahu ‏.‏ qaala waman hum qaala hum alu 'aliyyin waalu 'aqiylin waalu ja'farin waalu 'abbaasin ‏.‏ qaala kullu hauulaa'i hurima alssadaqaaa qaala na'am ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yazid b. Hayyan reported, I went along with Husain b. Sabra and 'Umar b. Muslim to Zaid b. Arqam and, as we sat by his side, Husain said to him:Zaid. you have been able to acquire a great virtue that you saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) listened to his talk, fought by his side in (different) battles, offered prayer behind me. Zaid, you have in fact earned a great virtue. Zaid, narrate to us what you heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said: I have grown old and have almost spent my age and I have forgotten some of the things which I remembered in connection with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), so accept whatever I narrate to you, and which I do not narrate do not compel me to do that. He then said: One day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to deliver sermon at a watering place known as Khumm situated between Mecca and Medina. He praised Allah, extolled Him and delivered the sermon and. exhorted (us) and said: Now to our purpose. O people, I am a human being. I am about to receive a messenger (the angel of death) from my Lord and I, in response to Allah's call, (would bid good-bye to you), but I am leaving among you two weighty things: the one being the Book of Allah in which there is right guidance and light, so hold fast to the Book of Allah and adhere to it. He exhorted (us) (to hold fast) to the Book of Allah and then said: The second are the members of my household I remind you (of your duties) to the members of my family. He (Husain) said to Zaid: Who are the members of his household? Aren't his wives the members of his family? Thereupon he said: His wives are the members of his family (but here) the members of his family are those for whom acceptance of Zakat is forbidden. And he said: Who are they? Thereupon he said: 'Ali and the offspring of 'Ali, 'Aqil and the offspring of 'Aqil and the offspring of Ja'far and the offspring of 'Abbas. Husain said: These are those for whom the acceptance of Zakat is forbidden. Zaid said: Yes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِهِ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakkaari bni alrrayyaani, haddathanaa hassaanu, - ya'niy abna iibraahiyma - 'an sa'iydi bni masruwqin, 'an yaziyda bni hayyaana, 'an zaydi bni aarqama, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwihi bima'naa hadiythi zuhayrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Arqam through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏ "‏ كِتَابُ اللَّهِ فِيهِ الْهُدَى وَالنُّورُ مَنِ اسْتَمْسَكَ بِهِ وَأَخَذَ بِهِ كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَى وَمَنْ أَخْطَأَهُ ضَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy hayyaana, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi iismaa'iyla wazaada fiy hadiythi jariyrin ‏ "‏ kitaabu alllahi fiyhi alhudaa waalnnuwru mani astamsaka bihi waaakhadha bihi kaana 'alaa alhudaa waman aakhtaaahu dalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Hayyan but with this addition:" The Book of Allah contains right guidance, the light, and whoever adheres to it and holds it fast, he is upon right guidance and whosoever deviates from it goes astray
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكَّارِ بْنِ الرَّيَّانِ، حَدَّثَنَا حَسَّانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ مَسْرُوقٍ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ دَخَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ لَقَدْ رَأَيْتَ خَيْرًا ‏.‏ لَقَدْ صَاحَبْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَصَلَّيْتَ خَلْفَهُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي حَيَّانَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ وَإِنِّي تَارِكٌ فِيكُمْ ثَقَلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَا كِتَابُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ هُوَ حَبْلُ اللَّهِ مَنِ اتَّبَعَهُ كَانَ عَلَى الْهُدَى وَمَنْ تَرَكَهُ كَانَ عَلَى ضَلاَلَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِيهِ فَقُلْنَا مَنْ أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ نِسَاؤُهُ قَالَ لاَ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الْمَرْأَةَ تَكُونُ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ الْعَصْرَ مِنَ الدَّهْرِ ثُمَّ يُطَلِّقُهَا فَتَرْجِعُ إِلَى أَبِيهَا وَقَوْمِهَا أَهْلُ بَيْتِهِ أَصْلُهُ وَعَصَبَتُهُ الَّذِينَ حُرِمُوا الصَّدَقَةَ بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakkaari bni alrrayyaani, haddathanaa hassaanu, - ya'niy abna iibraahiyma - 'an sa'iydin, - wahuwa abnu masruwqin - 'an yaziyda bni hayyaana, 'an zaydi bni aarqama, qaala dakhalnaa 'alayhi faqulnaa lahu laqad raaayta khayrana ‏.‏ laqad saahabta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wasallayta khalfahu ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwi hadiythi aabiy hayyaana ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ aalaa waiinniy taarikun fiykum thaqalayni aahaduhumaa kitaabu alllahi 'azza wajalla huwa hablu alllahi mani attaba'ahu kaana 'alaa alhudaa waman tarakahu kaana 'alaa dalaalaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiyhi faqulnaa man aahlu baytihi nisaauuhu qaala laa waaymu alllahi iinna almaraaaa takuwnu ma'a alrrajuli al'asra mina alddahri thumma yutalliquhaa fatarji'u iilaa aabiyhaa waqawmihaa aahlu baytihi aasluhu wa'asabatuhu alladhiyna hurimuwa alssadaqaaa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yazid b. Hayyan reported:We went to him (Zaid b. Arqam) and said to him.
