verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ إِلَى قِصَّةِ الشَّاةِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الزِّيَادَةَ بَعْدَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw kuraybin jamiy'ana 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa iilaa qissaai alshhaaai walam yadhkuri alzziyaadaaa ba'dahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Usama up to the slaughtering of a sheep, but he. did not make mention of the subsequent words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ مَا غِرْتُ لِلنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى امْرَأَةٍ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ مَا غِرْتُ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ لِكَثْرَةِ ذِكْرِهِ إِيَّاهَا وَمَا رَأَيْتُهَا قَطُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat maa ghirtu lilnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa amraaaain min nisaaiihi maa ghirtu 'alaa khadiyjaaa likathraai dhikrihi iiyyaahaa wamaa raaaytuhaa qattu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Never did I feel jealous of any wife amongst the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as I feel in case of Khadija (though I had never seen her), for he praised her very often
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ لَمْ يَتَزَوَّجِ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ حَتَّى مَاتَتْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat lam yatazawwaji alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa khadiyjaaa hattaa maatat ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not marry any other woman till her (Khadija's) death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتِ اسْتَأْذَنَتْ هَالَةُ بِنْتُ خُوَيْلِدٍ أُخْتُ خَدِيجَةَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَعَرَفَ اسْتِئْذَانَ خَدِيجَةَ فَارْتَاحَ لِذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ هَالَةُ بِنْتُ خُوَيْلِدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَغِرْتُ فَقُلْتُ وَمَا تَذْكُرُ مِنْ عَجُوزٍ مِنْ عَجَائِزِ قُرَيْشٍ حَمْرَاءِ الشِّدْقَيْنِ هَلَكَتْ فِي الدَّهْرِ فَأَبْدَلَكَ اللَّهُ خَيْرًا مِنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalati astaadhanat haalaau bintu khuwaylidin aukhtu khadiyjaaa 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fa'arafa astiidhaana khadiyjaaa faartaaha lidhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma haalaau bintu khuwaylidin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faghirtu faqultu wamaa tadhkuru min 'ajuwzin min 'ajaaiizi qurayshin hamraa'i alshhidqayni halakat fiy alddahri faaabdalaka alllahu khayrana minhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Hala b. Khuwailid (sister of Khadija) sought permission from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) to see him and he was reminded of Khadija's (manner of) asking leave to enter and (was overwhelmed) with emotions thereby and said:O Allah, it is Hala, daughter of Khuwailid, and I felt jealous and said: Why do you remember one of those old women of the Quraish with gums red and who is long dead-while Allah has given you a better one in her stead?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي الرَّبِيعِ - حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أُرِيتُكِ فِي الْمَنَامِ ثَلاَثَ لَيَالٍ جَاءَنِي بِكِ الْمَلَكُ فِي سَرَقَةٍ مِنْ حَرِيرٍ فَيَقُولُ هَذِهِ امْرَأَتُكَ ‏.‏ فَأَكْشِفُ عَنْ وَجْهِكِ فَإِذَا أَنْتِ هِيَ فَأَقُولُ إِنْ يَكُ هَذَا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ يُمْضِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i, jamiy'ana 'an hammaadi bni zaydin, - waalllafzu laabiy alrrabiy'i - haddathanaa hammaadun, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ auriytuki fiy almanaami thalaatha layaalin jaa'aniy biki almalaku fiy saraqaain min hariyrin fayaquwlu hadhihi amraaatuka ‏.‏ faaakshifu 'an wajhiki faiidhaa aanti hiya faaaquwlu iin yaku hadhaa min 'indi alllahi yumdihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said:I saw you in a dream for three nights when an angel brought you to me in a silk cloth and he said: Here is your wife, and when I removed (the cloth) from your face, lo, it was yourself, so I said: If this is from Allah, let Him carry it out
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, jamiy'ana 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ وَجَدْتُ فِي كِتَابِي عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ إِذَا كُنْتِ عَنِّي رَاضِيَةً وَإِذَا كُنْتِ عَلَىَّ غَضْبَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ وَمِنْ أَيْنَ تَعْرِفُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَّا إِذَا كُنْتِ عَنِّي رَاضِيَةً فَإِنَّكِ تَقُولِينَ لاَ وَرَبِّ مُحَمَّدٍ وَإِذَا كُنْتِ غَضْبَى قُلْتِ لاَ وَرَبِّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ أَجَلْ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا أَهْجُرُ إِلاَّ اسْمَكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaala wajadtu fiy kitaabiy 'an aabiy ausaamaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinniy laa'lamu iidhaa kunti 'anniy raadiyaaan waiidhaa kunti 'alaaaa ghadbaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu wamin aayna ta'rifu dhalika qaala ‏"‏ aammaa iidhaa kunti 'anniy raadiyaaan faiinnaki taquwliyna laa warabbi muhammadin waiidhaa kunti ghadbaa qulti laa warabbi iibraahiyma ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat qultu aajal waalllahi yaa rasuwla alllahi maa aahjuru iilaaa asmaka ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: I can well discern when you are pleased with me and when you are annoyed with me. I said: How do you discern it? Thereupon be said: When you are pleased with me you say;" No, by the Lord of Muhammad," and when you are annoyed with me, you say:" No, by the Lord of Ibrahim." I said: Allah's Messenger, by Allah, I in fact leave your name (when I am annoyed with you)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ لاَ وَرَبِّ إِبْرَاهِيمَ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu numayrin, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi iilaa qawlihi laa warabbi iibraahiyma ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Hishim b. 'Urwa with the same chain of transmitters up to the words:" No, by the Lord of Ibrahim," and he did not make mention of what follows subsequently
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَلْعَبُ بِالْبَنَاتِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ وَكَانَتْ تَأْتِينِي صَوَاحِبِي فَكُنَّ يَنْقَمِعْنَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُسَرِّبُهُنَّ إِلَىَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa kaanat tal'abu bialbanaati 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat wakaanat taatiyniy sawaahibiy fakunna yanqami'na min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat fakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yusarribuhunna iilaaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that she used to play with dolls in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when her playmates came to her they left (the house) because they felt shy of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), whereas Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent them to her
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ بِالْبَنَاتِ فِي بَيْتِهِ وَهُنَّ اللُّعَبُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, kulluhum 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala fiy hadiythi jariyrin kuntu aal'abu bialbanaati fiy baytihi wahunna alllu'abu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّاسَ، كَانُوا يَتَحَرَّوْنَ بِهَدَايَاهُمْ يَوْمَ عَائِشَةَ يَبْتَغُونَ بِذَلِكَ مَرْضَاةَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnaasa, kaanuwa yataharrawna bihadaayaahum yawma 'aaiishaaa yabtaghuwna bidhalika mardaaaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that people sent their gifts when it was the turn of 'A'isha seeking thereby the pleasure of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ قَالَ عَبْدٌ حَدَّثَنِي وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ أَرْسَلَ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاسْتَأْذَنَتْ عَلَيْهِ وَهُوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ مَعِي فِي مِرْطِي فَأَذِنَ لَهَا فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَزْوَاجَكَ أَرْسَلْنَنِي إِلَيْكَ يَسْأَلْنَكَ الْعَدْلَ فِي ابْنَةِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ وَأَنَا سَاكِتَةٌ - قَالَتْ - فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَىْ بُنَيَّةُ أَلَسْتِ تُحِبِّينَ مَا أُحِبُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَحِبِّي هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقَامَتْ فَاطِمَةُ حِينَ سَمِعَتْ ذَلِكَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَرَجَعَتْ إِلَى أَزْوَاجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَتْهُنَّ بِالَّذِي قَالَتْ وَبِالَّذِي قَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُلْنَ لَهَا مَا نُرَاكِ أَغْنَيْتِ عَنَّا مِنْ شَىْءٍ فَارْجِعِي إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقُولِي لَهُ إِنَّ أَزْوَاجَكَ يَنْشُدْنَكَ الْعَدْلَ فِي ابْنَةِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ فَاطِمَةُ وَاللَّهِ لاَ أُكَلِّمُهُ فِيهَا أَبَدًا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَأَرْسَلَ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ الَّتِي كَانَتْ تُسَامِينِي مِنْهُنَّ فِي الْمَنْزِلَةِ عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ أَرَ امْرَأَةً قَطُّ خَيْرًا فِي الدِّينِ مِنْ زَيْنَبَ وَأَتْقَى لِلَّهِ وَأَصْدَقَ حَدِيثًا وَأَوْصَلَ لِلرَّحِمِ وَأَعْظَمَ صَدَقَةً وَأَشَدَّ ابْتِذَالاً لِنَفْسِهَا فِي الْعَمَلِ الَّذِي تَصَدَّقُ بِهِ وَتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ إِلَى اللَّهِ تَعَالَى مَا عَدَا سَوْرَةً مِنْ حَدٍّ كَانَتْ فِيهَا تُسْرِعُ مِنْهَا الْفَيْئَةَ قَالَتْ فَاسْتَأْذَنَتْ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ عَائِشَةَ فِي مِرْطِهَا عَلَى الْحَالَةِ الَّتِي دَخَلَتْ فَاطِمَةُ عَلَيْهَا وَهُوَ بِهَا فَأَذِنَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَزْوَاجَكَ أَرْسَلْنَنِي إِلَيْكَ يَسْأَلْنَكَ الْعَدْلَ فِي ابْنَةِ أَبِي قُحَافَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ ثُمَّ وَقَعَتْ بِي فَاسْتَطَالَتْ عَلَىَّ وَأَنَا أَرْقُبُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَرْقُبُ طَرْفَهُ هَلْ يَأْذَنُ لِي فِيهَا - قَالَتْ - فَلَمْ تَبْرَحْ زَيْنَبُ حَتَّى عَرَفْتُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَنْتَصِرَ - قَالَتْ - فَلَمَّا وَقَعْتُ بِهَا لَمْ أَنْشَبْهَا حِينَ أَنْحَيْتُ عَلَيْهَا - قَالَتْ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَبَسَّمَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا ابْنَةُ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu alnnadri wa'abdu bnu humaydin qaala 'abdun haddathaniy waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni, shihaabin aakhbaraniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni alhaarithi bni hishaamin, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat aarsala aazwaaju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faatimaaa binta rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faastaadhanat 'alayhi wahuwa mudtaji'un ma'iy fiy mirtiy faaadhina lahaa faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aazwaajaka aarsalnaniy iilayka yasaalnaka al'adla fiy abnaai aabiy quhaafaaa waaanaa saakitaaun - qaalat - faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaa bunayyaau aalasti tuhibbiyna maa auhibbu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat balaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaahibbiy hadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqaamat faatimaau hiyna sami'at dhalika min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faraja'at iilaa aazwaaji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarathunna bialladhiy qaalat wabialladhiy qaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqulna lahaa maa nuraaki aaghnayti 'annaa min shaa'in faarji'iy iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faquwliy lahu iinna aazwaajaka yanshudnaka al'adla fiy abnaai aabiy quhaafaaa ‏.‏ faqaalat faatimaau waalllahi laa aukallimuhu fiyhaa aabadana ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau faaarsala aazwaaju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm zaynaba binta jahshin zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahiya allatiy kaanat tusaamiyniy minhunna fiy almanzilaai 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm walam aara amraaaaan qattu khayrana fiy alddiyni min zaynaba waaatqaa lillahi waaasdaqa hadiythana waaawsala lilrrahimi waaa'zama sadaqaaan waaashadda abtidhaalaan linafsihaa fiy al'amali alladhiy tasaddaqu bihi wataqarrabu bihi iilaa alllahi ta'aalaa maa 'adaa sawraaan min haddin kaanat fiyhaa tusri'u minhaa alfayiaaa qaalat faastaadhanat 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'a 'aaiishaaa fiy mirtihaa 'alaa alhaalaai allatiy dakhalat faatimaau 'alayhaa wahuwa bihaa faaadhina lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna aazwaajaka aarsalnaniy iilayka yasaalnaka al'adla fiy abnaai aabiy quhaafaaa ‏.‏ qaalat thumma waqa'at biy faastataalat 'alaaaa waaanaa aarqubu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaarqubu tarfahu hal yaadhanu liy fiyhaa - qaalat - falam tabrah zaynabu hattaa 'araftu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yakrahu aan aantasira - qaalat - falammaa waqa'tu bihaa lam aanshabhaa hiyna aanhaytu 'alayhaa - qaalat - faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm watabassama ‏"‏ iinnahaa abnaau aabiy bakrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), said:The wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) sent Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). She sought permission to get in as he had been lying with me in my mantle. He gave her permission and she said: Allah's Messenger, verily, your wives have sent me to you in order to ask you to observe equity in case of the daughter of Abu Quhafa. She (`A'isha) said: I kept quiet. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her (Fatima): O daughter, don't you love whom I love? She said: Yes, (I do). Thereupon he said: I love this one. Fatima then stood up as she heard this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and went to the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and informed them of what she had said to him and what Allah's messenger (ﷺ) had said to her. Thereupon they said to her: We think that you have been of no avail to us. You may again go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and tell him that his wives seek equity in case of the daughter of Abu Quhafa. Fatima said: By Allah, I will never talk to him about this matter. `A'isha (further) reported: The wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) then sent Zainab b. Jahsh, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), and she was one who was somewhat equal in rank with me in the eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and I have never seen a woman more advanced in religious piety than Zainab, more God-conscious, more truthful, more alive to the ties of blood, more generous and having more sense of self-sacrifice in practical life and having more charitable disposition and thus more close to God, the Exalted, than her. She, however, lost temper very soon but was soon calm. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) permitted her to enter as she (`A'isha) was along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in her mantle, in the same very state when Fatima had entered. She said: Allah's Messenger, your wives have sent me to you seeking equity in case of the daughter of Abu Quhafa. She then came to me and showed harshness to me and I was seeing the eyes of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whether he would permit me. Zainab went on until I came to know that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) would not disapprove if I retorted. Then I exchanged hot words until I made her quiet. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and said: She is the daughter of Abu Bakr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قُهْزَاذَ، قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ حَدَّثَنِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُبَارَكِ عَنْ يُونُسَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ فِي الْمَعْنَى غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فَلَمَّا وَقَعْتُ بِهَا لَمْ أَنْشَبْهَا أَنْ أَثْخَنْتُهَا غَلَبَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni quhzaadha, qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'uthmaana haddathaniyhi 'an 'abdi, alllahi bni almubaaraki 'an yuwnusa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu fiy alma'naa ghayra aannahu qaala falammaa waqa'tu bihaa lam aanshabhaa aan aathkhantuhaa ghalabaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالَ وَجَدْتُ فِي كِتَابِي عَنْ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ إِنْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَيَتَفَقَّدُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَيْنَ أَنَا الْيَوْمَ أَيْنَ أَنَا غَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ اسْتِبْطَاءً لِيَوْمِ عَائِشَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمِي قَبَضَهُ اللَّهُ بَيْنَ سَحْرِي وَنَحْرِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaala wajadtu fiy kitaabiy 'an aabiy ausaamaaa, 'an hishaamin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat iin kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm layatafaqqadu yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aayna aanaa alyawma aayna aanaa ghadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ astibtaa'an liyawmi 'aaiishaaa ‏.‏ qaalat falammaa kaana yawmiy qabadahu alllahu bayna sahriy wanahriy ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) during his last illness) inquired:Where I would be tomorrow, where I would be tomorrow (thinking, that the turn of 'A'isha was not very near) and when it was my turn, Allah called him to his Heavenly Home and his head was between my neck and chest
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّهَا، سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمُوتَ وَهُوَ مُسْنِدٌ إِلَى صَدْرِهَا وَأَصْغَتْ إِلَيْهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالرَّفِيقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, 'an 'abbaadi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa aakhbarathu aannahaa, sami'at rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu qabla aan yamuwta wahuwa musnidun iilaa sadrihaa waaasghat iilayhi wahuwa yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma aghfir liy waarhamniy waaalhiqniy bialrrafiyqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at the time of breathing his last was reclining against her chest and she was leaning over him and listening to him as he was saying:O Allah, grant me pardon, show mercy to me, enjoin me to companions (on High)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu, numayrin haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, kulluhum 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنْتُ أَسْمَعُ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يَمُوتَ نَبِيٌّ حَتَّى يُخَيَّرَ بَيْنَ الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ - قَالَتْ - فَسَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَرَضِهِ الَّذِي مَاتَ فِيهِ وَأَخَذَتْهُ بُحَّةٌ يَقُولُ ‏{‏ مَعَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِيِّينَ وَالصِّدِّيقِينَ وَالشُّهَدَاءِ وَالصَّالِحِينَ وَحَسُنَ أُولَئِكَ رَفِيقًا‏}‏ قَالَتْ فَظَنَنْتُهُ خُيِّرَ حِينَئِذٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kuntu aasma'u aannahu lan yamuwta nabiyyun hattaa yukhayyara bayna alddunyaa waalakhiraai - qaalat - fasami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy maradihi alladhiy maata fiyhi waaakhadhathu buhhaaun yaquwlu ‏{‏ ma'a alladhiyna aan'ama alllahu 'alayhim mina alnnabiyyiyna waalssiddiyqiyna waalshhuhadaa'i waalssaalihiyna wahasuna auwlaiika rafiyqana‏}‏ qaalat fazanantuhu khuyyira hiynaiidhin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:I heard that never a prophet dies until he is given an option to opt the life of (this) world or that of the Hereafter. She further said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say in his last illness in which he' died. I heard him saying in gruffness of the voice: Along with those persons upon whom Allah bestowed favours from amongst the Apostles, the testifiers of truth, the martyrs, the pious and goodly company are they (iv. 69). (It was on bearing these words) that I thought that he had been given choice (and he opted to live with these pious persons in the Paradise)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي قَالاَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy qaalaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'din, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'd with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَعُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، فِي رِجَالٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ وَهُوَ صَحِيحٌ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يُقْبَضْ نَبِيٌّ قَطُّ حَتَّى يَرَى مَقْعَدَهُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ يُخَيَّرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَ بِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَرَأْسُهُ عَلَى فَخِذِي غُشِيَ عَلَيْهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ فَأَشْخَصَ بَصَرَهُ إِلَى السَّقْفِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الرَّفِيقَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ قُلْتُ إِذًا لاَ يَخْتَارُنَا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ وَعَرَفْتُ الْحَدِيثَ الَّذِي كَانَ يُحَدِّثُنَا بِهِ وَهُوَ صَحِيحٌ فِي قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يُقْبَضْ نَبِيٌّ قَطُّ حَتَّى يَرَى مَقْعَدَهُ مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ يُخَيَّرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَكَانَتْ تِلْكَ آخِرُ كَلِمَةٍ تَكَلَّمَ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ الرَّفِيقَ الأَعْلَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, qaala qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, wa'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, fiy rijaalin min aahli al'ilmi aanna 'aaiishaaa zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu wahuwa sahiyhun ‏"‏ iinnahu lam yuqbad nabiyyun qattu hattaa yaraa maq'adahu fiy aljannaai thumma yukhayyaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau falammaa nazala birasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waraasuhu 'alaa fakhidhiy ghushiya 'alayhi saa'aaan thumma aafaaqa faaashkhasa basarahu iilaa alssaqfi thumma qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma alrrafiyqa alaa'laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau qultu iidhana laa yakhtaarunaa ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau wa'araftu alhadiytha alladhiy kaana yuhaddithunaa bihi wahuwa sahiyhun fiy qawlihi ‏"‏ iinnahu lam yuqbad nabiyyun qattu hattaa yaraa maq'adahu mina aljannaai thumma yukhayyaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau fakaanat tilka akhiru kalimaain takallama bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qawlahu ‏"‏ alllahumma alrrafiyqa alaa'laa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that he used to say:Never a prophet dies in a state that he is not made to see his abode in Paradise, and then given a choice. 'A'isha said that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was about to leave the world, his head was over her thigh and he had fallen into swoon three times. When he felt relief his eyes were fixed at the ceiling. He then said: O Allah, along with the high companions (i. e. along with the Apostles who live in the most elevated place of the Paradise). (On hearing these words), I then said (to myself) He is not going to opt us and I remembered a hadith which he had narrated to us as he was healthy and in which he said: No prophet dies until he sees his abode in Paradise, he is then given a choice. 'A'isha said: These were the last words which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) spoke (the words are): O Allah, with companions on High
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي نُعَيْمٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نُعَيْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ أَيْمَنَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا خَرَجَ أَقْرَعَ بَيْنَ نِسَائِهِ فَطَارَتِ الْقُرْعَةُ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ وَحَفْصَةَ فَخَرَجَتَا مَعَهُ جَمِيعًا وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا كَانَ بِاللَّيْلِ سَارَ مَعَ عَائِشَةَ يَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَهَا فَقَالَتْ حَفْصَةُ لِعَائِشَةَ أَلاَ تَرْكَبِينَ اللَّيْلَةَ بَعِيرِي وَأَرْكَبُ بَعِيرَكِ فَتَنْظُرِينَ وَأَنْظُرُ قَالَتْ بَلَى ‏.‏ فَرَكِبَتْ عَائِشَةُ عَلَى بَعِيرِ حَفْصَةَ وَرَكِبَتْ حَفْصَةُ عَلَى بَعِيرِ عَائِشَةَ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى جَمَلِ عَائِشَةَ وَعَلَيْهِ حَفْصَةُ فَسَلَّمَ ثُمَّ صَارَ مَعَهَا حَتَّى نَزَلُوا فَافْتَقَدَتْهُ عَائِشَةُ فَغَارَتْ فَلَمَّا نَزَلُوا جَعَلَتْ تَجْعَلُ رِجْلَهَا بَيْنَ الإِذْخِرِ وَتَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ سَلِّطْ عَلَىَّ عَقْرَبًا أَوْ حَيَّةً تَلْدَغُنِي رَسُولُكَ وَلاَ أَسْتَطِيعُ أَنْ أَقُولَ لَهُ شَيْئًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy nu'aymin, qaala 'abdun haddathanaa aabuw nu'aymin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu aaymana, haddathaniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani alqaasimi, bni muhammadin 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa kharaja aaqra'a bayna nisaaiihi fataarati alqur'aau 'alaa 'aaiishaaa wahafsaaa fakharajataa ma'ahu jamiy'ana wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa kaana bialllayli saara ma'a 'aaiishaaa yatahaddathu ma'ahaa faqaalat hafsaau li'aaiishaaa aalaa tarkabiyna alllaylaaa ba'iyriy waaarkabu ba'iyraki fatanzuriyna waaanzuru qaalat balaa ‏.‏ farakibat 'aaiishaau 'alaa ba'iyri hafsaaa warakibat hafsaau 'alaa ba'iyri 'aaiishaaa fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa jamali 'aaiishaaa wa'alayhi hafsaau fasallama thumma saara ma'ahaa hattaa nazaluwa faaftaqadathu 'aaiishaau faghaarat falammaa nazaluwa ja'alat taj'alu rijlahaa bayna aliidhkhiri wataquwlu yaa rabbi sallit 'alaaaa 'aqrabana aaw hayyaaan taldaghuniy rasuwluka walaa aastatiy'u aan aaquwla lahu shayiana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set ont on a journey, he used to cast lots amongst his wives. Once this lot came out in my favour and that of Hafsa. They (Hafsi, and 'A'isha) both went along with him and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to travel (on camel) when it was night along with 'A'isha and talked with her. Hafsa said to 'A'isha:Would you like to ride upon my camel tonight and allow me to ride upon your camel and you would see (what you do not generally see) and I would see (what I do not see) generally? She said: Yes. So 'A'isha rode upon the camel of Hafsa and Hafsa rode upon the camel of 'A'isha and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came near the camel of 'A'isha. (whereas) Hafsa had been riding over that. He greeted her and then rode with her until they came down. She ('A'isha) thus missed (the company of the Holy Prophet) and when they sat down, 'A'isha felt jealous. She put her foot in the grass and said: O Allah, let the scorpion sting me or the serpent bite me. And so far as thy Messenger is concerned, I cannot say anything about him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ بِلاَلٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ فَضْلُ عَائِشَةَ عَلَى النِّسَاءِ كَفَضْلِ الثَّرِيدِ عَلَى سَائِرِ الطَّعَامِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna bilaalin - 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ fadlu 'aaiishaaa 'alaa alnnisaa'i kafadli althhariydi 'alaa saaiiri altta'aami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The excellence of 'A'isha over women is like the excellence of Tharid over all other foods
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, ya'nuwna abna ja'farin h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, 'abdi alrrahmani 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi walaysa fiy hadiythihimaa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi iismaa'iyla aannahu sami'a aanasa bna maalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through other chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحِيمِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، وَيَعْلَى بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ إِنَّ جِبْرِيلَ يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكِ السَّلاَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahiymi bnu sulaymaana, waya'laa bnu 'ubaydin, 'an zakariyyaa'a, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa haddathathu aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahaa ‏ "‏ iinna jibriyla yaqraau 'alayki alssalaama ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu wa'alayhi alssalaamu warahmaau alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to her:Gabriel offered you greetings and I said: So there should be peace and mercy of Allah upon him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمُلاَئِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَامِرًا، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَهَا ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa almulaaiiyyu, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, qaala sami'tu 'aamirana, yaquwlu haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa, haddathathu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala lahaa ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'A'isha through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَسْبَاطُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa aasbaatu bnu muhammadin, 'an zakariyyaa'a, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zakriyya' through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشُ هَذَا جِبْرِيلُ يَقْرَأُ عَلَيْكِ السَّلاَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ وَعَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ وَهُوَ يَرَى مَا لاَ أَرَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, haddathaniy aabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, aanna 'aaiishaaa, zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa 'aaiishu hadhaa jibriylu yaqraau 'alayki alssalaama ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu wa'alayhi alssalaamu warahmaau alllahi ‏.‏ qaalat wahuwa yaraa maa laa aaraa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:'A'isha, here is Gabriel offering you greetings. She said: 1 made a reply: Let there be peace and blessings of Allah upon him, and added: He sees what I do not see
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ جَنَابٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عِيسَى، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ حُجْرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامُ بْنُ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّهَا قَالَتْ جَلَسَ إِحْدَى عَشْرَةَ امْرَأَةً فَتَعَاهَدْنَ وَتَعَاقَدْنَ أَنْ لاَ يَكْتُمْنَ مِنْ أَخْبَارِ أَزْوَاجِهِنَّ شَيْئًا قَالَتِ الأُولَى زَوْجِي لَحْمُ جَمَلٍ غَثٌّ عَلَى رَأْسِ جَبَلٍ وَعْرٍ لاَ سَهْلٌ فَيُرْتَقَى وَلاَ سَمِينٌ فَيُنْتَقَلَ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ الثَّانِيَةُ زَوْجِي لاَ أَبُثُّ خَبَرَهُ إِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ لاَ أَذَرَهُ إِنْ أَذْكُرْهُ أَذْكُرْ عُجَرَهُ وَبُجَرَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ الثَّالِثَةُ زَوْجِي الْعَشَنَّقُ إِنْ أَنْطِقْ أُطَلَّقْ وَإِنْ أَسْكُتْ أُعَلَّقْ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ الرَّابِعَةُ زَوْجِي كَلَيْلِ تِهَامَةَ لاَ حَرٌّ وَلاَ قُرٌّ وَلاَ مَخَافَةَ وَلاَ سَآمَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ الْخَامِسَةُ زَوْجِي إِنْ دَخَلَ فَهِدَ وَإِنْ خَرَجَ أَسِدَ وَلاَ يَسْأَلُ عَمَّا عَهِدَ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ السَّادِسَةُ زَوْجِي إِنْ أَكَلَ لَفَّ وَإِنْ شَرِبَ اشْتَفَّ وَإِنِ اضْطَجَعَ الْتَفَّ وَلاَ يُولِجُ الْكَفَّ لِيَعْلَمَ الْبَثَّ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ السَّابِعَةُ زَوْجِي غَيَايَاءُ أَوْ عَيَايَاءُ طَبَاقَاءُ كُلُّ دَاءٍ لَهُ دَاءٌ شَجَّكِ أَوْ فَلَّكِ أَوْ جَمَعَ كُلاًّ لَكِ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ الثَّامِنَةُ زَوْجِي الرِّيحُ رِيحُ زَرْنَبٍ وَالْمَسُّ مَسُّ أَرْنَبٍ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ التَّاسِعَةُ زَوْجِي رَفِيعُ الْعِمَادِ طَوِيلُ النِّجَادِ عَظِيمُ الرَّمَادِ قَرِيبُ الْبَيْتِ مِنَ النَّادِي ‏.‏ قَالَتِ الْعَاشِرَةُ زَوْجِي مَالِكٌ وَمَا مَالِكٌ مَالِكٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ ذَلِكِ لَهُ إِبِلٌ كَثِيرَاتُ الْمَبَارِكِ قَلِيلاَتُ الْمَسَارِحِ إِذَا سَمِعْنَ صَوْتَ الْمِزْهَرِ أَيْقَنَّ أَنَّهُنَّ هَوَالِكُ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ الْحَادِيَةَ عَشْرَةَ زَوْجِي أَبُو زَرْعٍ فَمَا أَبُو زَرْعٍ أَنَاسَ مِنْ حُلِيٍّ أُذُنَىَّ وَمَلأَ مِنْ شَحْمٍ عَضُدَىَّ وَبَجَّحَنِي فَبَجِحَتْ إِلَىَّ نَفْسِي وَجَدَنِي فِي أَهْلِ غُنَيْمَةٍ بِشَقٍّ فَجَعَلَنِي فِي أَهْلِ صَهِيلٍ وَأَطِيطٍ وَدَائِسٍ وَمُنَقٍّ فَعِنْدَهُ أَقُولُ فَلاَ أُقَبَّحُ وَأَرْقُدُ فَأَتَصَبَّحُ وَأَشْرَبُ فَأَتَقَنَّحُ ‏.‏ أُمُّ أَبِي زَرْعٍ فَمَا أُمُّ أَبِي زَرْعٍ عُكُومُهَا رَدَاحٌ وَبَيْتُهَا فَسَاحٌ ‏.‏ ابْنُ أَبِي زَرْعٍ فَمَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَرْعٍ مَضْجِعُهُ كَمَسَلِّ شَطْبَةٍ وَيُشْبِعُهُ ذِرَاعُ الْجَفْرَةِ ‏.‏ بِنْتُ أَبِي زَرْعٍ فَمَا بِنْتُ أَبِي زَرْعٍ طَوْعُ أَبِيهَا وَطَوْعُ أُمِّهَا وَمِلْءُ كِسَائِهَا وَغَيْظُ جَارَتِهَا ‏.‏ جَارِيَةُ أَبِي زَرْعٍ فَمَا جَارِيَةُ أَبِي زَرْعٍ لاَ تَبُثُّ حَدِيثَنَا تَبْثِيثًا وَلاَ تُنَقِّثُ مِيرَتَنَا تَنْقِيثًا وَلاَ تَمْلأُ بَيْتَنَا تَعْشِيشًا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ خَرَجَ أَبُو زَرْعٍ وَالأَوْطَابُ تُمْخَضُ فَلَقِيَ امْرَأَةً مَعَهَا وَلَدَانِ لَهَا كَالْفَهْدَيْنِ يَلْعَبَانِ مِنْ تَحْتِ خَصْرِهَا بِرُمَّانَتَيْنِ فَطَلَّقَنِي وَنَكَحَهَا فَنَكَحْتُ بَعْدَهُ رَجُلاً سَرِيًّا رَكِبَ شَرِيًّا وَأَخَذَ خَطِّيًّا وَأَرَاحَ عَلَىَّ نَعَمًا ثَرِيًّا وَأَعْطَانِي مِنْ كُلِّ رَائِحَةٍ زَوْجًا ‏.‏ قَالَ كُلِي أُمَّ زَرْعٍ وَمِيرِي أَهْلَكِ فَلَوْ جَمَعْتُ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَعْطَانِي مَا بَلَغَ أَصْغَرَ آنِيَةِ أَبِي زَرْعٍ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ كُنْتُ لَكِ كَأَبِي زَرْعٍ لأُمِّ زَرْعٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, waaahmadu bnu janaabin, kilaahumaa 'an 'iysaa, - waalllafzu laibni hujrin - haddathanaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa hishaamu bnu 'urwaaa, 'an aakhiyhi 'abdi alllahi bni 'urwaaa, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aannahaa qaalat jalasa iihdaa 'ashraaa amraaaaan fata'aahadna wata'aaqadna aan laa yaktumna min aakhbaari aazwaajihinna shayiana qaalati alauwlaa zawjiy lahmu jamalin ghathhun 'alaa raasi jabalin wa'rin laa sahlun fayurtaqaa walaa samiynun fayuntaqala ‏.‏ qaalati althhaaniyaau zawjiy laa aabuthhu khabarahu iinniy aakhaafu aan laa aadharahu iin aadhkurhu aadhkur 'ujarahu wabujarahu ‏.‏ qaalati althhaalithaau zawjiy al'ashannaqu iin aantiq autallaq waiin aaskut au'allaq ‏.‏ qaalati alrraabi'aau zawjiy kalayli tihaamaaa laa harrun walaa qurrun walaa makhaafaaa walaa saamaaa ‏.‏ qaalati alkhaamisaau zawjiy iin dakhala fahida waiin kharaja aasida walaa yasaalu 'ammaa 'ahida ‏.‏ qaalati alssaadisaau zawjiy iin aakala laffa waiin shariba ashtaffa waiini adtaja'a altaffa walaa yuwliju alkaffa liya'lama albathha ‏.‏ qaalati alssaabi'aau zawjiy ghayaayaa'u aaw 'ayaayaa'u tabaaqaa'u kullu daa'in lahu daa'un shajjaki aaw fallaki aaw jama'a kulaaan laki ‏.‏ qaalati althhaaminaau zawjiy alrriyhu riyhu zarnabin waalmassu massu aarnabin ‏.‏ qaalati alttaasi'aau zawjiy rafiy'u al'imaadi tawiylu alnnijaadi 'aziymu alrramaadi qariybu albayti mina alnnaadiy ‏.‏ qaalati al'aashiraau zawjiy maalikun wamaa maalikun maalikun khayrun min dhaliki lahu iibilun kathiyraatu almabaariki qaliylaatu almasaarihi iidhaa sami'na sawta almizhari aayqanna aannahunna hawaaliku ‏.‏ qaalati alhaadiyaaa 'ashraaa zawjiy aabuw zar'in famaa aabuw zar'in aanaasa min huliyyin audhunaaaa wamalaa min shahmin 'adudaaaa wabajjahaniy fabajihat iilaaaa nafsiy wajadaniy fiy aahli ghunaymaain bishaqqin faja'alaniy fiy aahli sahiylin waaatiytin wadaaiisin wamunaqqin fa'indahu aaquwlu falaa auqabbahu waaarqudu faaatasabbahu waaashrabu faaataqannahu ‏.‏ aummu aabiy zar'in famaa aummu aabiy zar'in 'ukuwmuhaa radaahun wabaytuhaa fasaahun ‏.‏ abnu aabiy zar'in famaa abnu aabiy zar'in madji'uhu kamasalli shatbaain wayushbi'uhu dhiraa'u aljafraai ‏.‏ bintu aabiy zar'in famaa bintu aabiy zar'in taw'u aabiyhaa wataw'u aummihaa wamil'u kisaaiihaa waghayzu jaaratihaa ‏.‏ jaariyaau aabiy zar'in famaa jaariyaau aabiy zar'in laa tabuthhu hadiythanaa tabthiythana walaa tunaqqithu miyratanaa tanqiythana walaa tamlau baytanaa ta'shiyshana ‏.‏ qaalat kharaja aabuw zar'in waalaawtaabu tumkhadu falaqiya amraaaaan ma'ahaa waladaani lahaa kaalfahdayni yal'abaani min tahti khasrihaa birummaanatayni fatallaqaniy wanakahahaa fanakahtu ba'dahu rajulaan sariyyana rakiba shariyyana waaakhadha khattiyyana waaaraaha 'alaaaa na'amana thariyyana waaa'taaniy min kulli raaiihaain zawjana ‏.‏ qaala kuliy aumma zar'in wamiyriy aahlaki falaw jama'tu kulla shaa'in aa'taaniy maa balagha aasghara aniyaai aabiy zar'in ‏.‏ qaalat 'aaiishaau qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ kuntu laki kaaabiy zar'in laummi zar'in ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that (one day) there sat together eleven women making an explicit promise amongst themselves that they would conceal nothing about their spouses. The first one said:My husband is a sort of the meat of a lean camel placed at the top of a hill, which it is difficult to climb up, nor (the meat) is good enough that one finds in oneself the urge to take it away (from the top of that mountain). The second one said: My husband (is so bad) that I am afraid I would not be able to describe his faults-both visible and invisible completely. The third one said: My husband is a long-statured fellow (i. e. he lacks intelligence). If I give vent to my feelings about him, he would divorce me, and if I keep quiet I would be made to live in a state of suspense (neither completely abandoned by him nor entertained as wife). The fourth one said: My husband is like the night of Tihama (the night of Hijaz and Mecca), neither too cold nor hot, neither there is any fear of him nor grief. The fifth one said: My husband is (like) a leopard as he enters the house, and behaves like a lion when he gets out, and he does not ask about that which he leaves in the house. The sixth one said: So far as my husband is concerned, he eats so much that nothing is left back and when he drinks he drinks that no drop is left behind. And when he lies down he wraps his body and does not touch me so that he may know my grief. The seventh one said: My husband is heavy in spirit, having no brightness in him, impotent, suffering from all kinds of conceivable diseases, heaving such rough manners that he may break my head or wound my body, or may do both. The eighth one said: My husband is as sweet as the sweet-smelling plant, and as soft as the softness of the hare. The ninth one said: My husband is the master of a lofty building, long-statured, having heaps of ashes (at his door) and his house is near the meeting place and the inn. The tenth one said: My husband is Malik, and how fine Malik is, much above appreciation and praise (of mine). He has many folds of his camel, more in number than the pastures for them. When they (the camels) hear the sound of music they become sure that they are going to be slaughtered. The eleventh one said: My husband is Abu Zara'. How fine Abu Zara' is! He has suspended in my ears heavy ornaments and (fed me liberally) that my sinews and bones are covered with fat. So he made me happy. He found me among the shepherds living in the side of the mountain, and he made me the owner of the horses, camels and lands and heaps of grain and he finds no fault with me. I sleep and get up in the morning (at my own sweet will) and drink to my heart's content. The mother of Abu Zara', how fine is the mother of Abu Zara'! Her bundles are heavily packed (or receptacles in her house are filled to the brim) and the house quite spacious. So far as the son of Abu Zara' is concerned, his bed is as soft as a green palm-stick drawn forth from its bark, or like a sword drawn forth from its scabbard, and whom just an arm of a lamb is enough to satiate. So far as the daughter of Abu Zara' is concerned, how fine is the daughter of Abu Zara', obedient to her father, obedient to her mother, wearing sufficient flesh and a source of jealousy for her co-wife. As for the slave-girl of Abu Zara', how fine is she; she does not disclose our affairs to others (outside the four walls of the house). She does not remove our wheat, or provision, or take it forth, or squander it, but she preserves it faithfully (as a sacred trust). And she does not let the house fill with rubbish. One day Abu Zara' went out (of his house) when the milk was churned in the vessels, that he met a woman, having two children like leopards playing with her pomegranates (chest) under her vest. He divorced me (Umm Zara') and married that woman (whom Abu Zara') met on the way. I (Umm Zara') later on married another person, a chief, who was an expert rider, and a fine archer: he bestowed upon me many gifts and gave me one pair of every kind of animal and said: Umm Zara', make use of everything (you need) and send forth to your parents (but the fact) is that even if I combine all the gifts that he bestowed upon me, they stand no comparison to the least gift of Abu Zara'. 'A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: I am for you as Abu Zara' was for Umm Zara
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ، بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ عَيَايَاءُ طَبَاقَاءُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَشُكَّ وَقَالَ قَلِيلاَتُ الْمَسَارِحِ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَصِفْرُ رِدَائِهَا وَخَيْرُ نِسَائِهَا وَعَقْرُ جَارَتِهَا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَلاَ تَنْقُثُ مِيرَتَنَا تَنْقِيثًا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ وَأَعْطَانِي مِنْ كُلِّ ذَابِحَةٍ زَوْجًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu iismaa'iyla, haddathanaa sa'iydu, bnu salamaaa 'an hishaami bni 'urwaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aannahu qaala 'ayaayaa'u tabaaqaa'u ‏.‏ walam yashukka waqaala qaliylaatu almasaarihi ‏.‏ waqaala wasifru ridaaiihaa wakhayru nisaaiihaa wa'aqru jaaratihaa ‏.‏ waqaala walaa tanquthu miyratanaa tanqiythana ‏.‏ waqaala waaa'taaniy min kulli dhaabihaain zawjana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Hisham b. 'Urwa but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ اللَّيْثِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ الْقُرَشِيُّ التَّيْمِيُّ، أَنَّحَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ بَنِي هِشَامِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ اسْتَأْذَنُونِي أَنْ يُنْكِحُوا ابْنَتَهُمْ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ فَلاَ آذَنُ لَهُمْ ثُمَّ لاَ آذَنُ لَهُمْ ثُمَّ لاَ آذَنُ لَهُمْ إِلاَّ أَنْ يُحِبَّ ابْنُ أَبِي طَالِبٍ أَنْ يُطَلِّقَ ابْنَتِي وَيَنْكِحَ ابْنَتَهُمْ فَإِنَّمَا ابْنَتِي بَضْعَةٌ مِنِّي يَرِيبُنِي مَا رَابَهَا وَيُؤْذِينِي مَا آذَاهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, kilaahumaa 'ani alllaythi bni sa'din, qaala abnu yuwnusa haddathanaa laythun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy mulaykaaa alqurashiyyu alttaymiyyu, aannahaddathahu aannahu, sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaa alminbari wahuwa yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna baniy hishaami bni almughiyraai astaadhanuwniy aan yunkihuwa abnatahum 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin falaa adhanu lahum thumma laa adhanu lahum thumma laa adhanu lahum iilaaa aan yuhibba abnu aabiy taalibin aan yutalliqa abnatiy wayankiha abnatahum faiinnamaa abnatiy bad'aaun minniy yariybuniy maa raabahaa wayuudhiyniy maa adhaahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Miswar b. Makhramali reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say, as he sat on the pulpit:The sons of Hisham b. Mughira have asked my permission to marry their daughter with 'Ali b. Abi Talib (that refers to the daughter of Abu Jahl for whom 'All had sent a proposal for marriage). But I would not allow them, I would not allow them, I would not allow them (and the only alternative possible is) that 'Ali should divorce my daughter (and then marry their daughter), for my daughter is part of me. He who disturbs her in fact disturbs me and he who offends her offends me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْهُذَلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْمِسْوَرِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا فَاطِمَةُ بَضْعَةٌ مِنِّي يُؤْذِينِي مَا آذَاهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ma'marin, iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma alhudhaliyyu haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an 'amrinw, 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani almiswari bni makhramaaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnamaa faatimaau bad'aaun minniy yuudhiyniy maa adhaahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Miswar b. Makhramah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Fatima is a part of me. He in fact tortures me who tortures her
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ حَنْبَلٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ حَلْحَلَةَ الدُّؤَلِيُّ، أَنَّ ابْنَ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ الْحُسَيْنِ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُمْ، حِينَ قَدِمُوا الْمَدِينَةَ مِنْ عِنْدِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ مَقْتَلَ الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ رضى الله عنهما لَقِيَهُ الْمِسْوَرُ بْنُ مَخْرَمَةَ فَقَالَ لَهُ هَلْ لَكَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ حَاجَةٍ تَأْمُرُنِي بِهَا قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَهُ هَلْ أَنْتَ مُعْطِيَّ سَيْفَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَإِنِّي أَخَافُ أَنْ يَغْلِبَكَ الْقَوْمُ عَلَيْهِ وَايْمُ اللَّهِ لَئِنْ أَعْطَيْتَنِيهِ لاَ يُخْلَصُ إِلَيْهِ أَبَدًا حَتَّى تَبْلُغَ نَفْسِي إِنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ خَطَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي جَهْلٍ عَلَى فَاطِمَةَ فَسَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَخْطُبُ النَّاسَ فِي ذَلِكَ عَلَى مِنْبَرِهِ هَذَا وَأَنَا يَوْمَئِذٍ مُحْتَلِمٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ مِنِّي وَإِنِّي أَتَخَوَّفُ أَنْ تُفْتَنَ فِي دِينِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ صِهْرًا لَهُ مِنْ بَنِي عَبْدِ شَمْسٍ فَأَثْنَى عَلَيْهِ فِي مُصَاهَرَتِهِ إِيَّاهُ فَأَحْسَنَ قَالَ ‏"‏ حَدَّثَنِي فَصَدَقَنِي وَوَعَدَنِي فَأَوْفَى لِي وَإِنِّي لَسْتُ أُحَرِّمُ حَلاَلاً وَلاَ أُحِلُّ حَرَامًا وَلَكِنْ وَاللَّهِ لاَ تَجْتَمِعُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَبِنْتُ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ مَكَانًا وَاحِدًا أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu hanbalin, aakhbaranaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani alwaliydi bni kathiyrin, haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni halhalaaa aldduualiyyu, aanna abna shihaabin, haddathahu aanna 'aliyya bna alhusayni haddathahu aannahum, hiyna qadimuwa almadiynaaa min 'indi yaziyda bni mu'aawiyaaa maqtala alhusayni bni 'aliyyin rda allh 'nhma laqiyahu almiswaru bnu makhramaaa faqaala lahu hal laka iilaaaa min haajaain taamuruniy bihaa qaala faqultu lahu laa ‏.‏ qaala lahu hal aanta mu'tiyya sayfa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faiinniy aakhaafu aan yaghlibaka alqawmu 'alayhi waaymu alllahi laiin aa'taytaniyhi laa yukhlasu iilayhi aabadana hattaa tablugha nafsiy iinna 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin khataba binta aabiy jahlin 'alaa faatimaaa fasami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yakhtubu alnnaasa fiy dhalika 'alaa minbarihi hadhaa waaanaa yawmaiidhin muhtalimun faqaala ‏"‏ iinna faatimaaa minniy waiinniy aatakhawwafu aan tuftana fiy diynihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma dhakara sihrana lahu min baniy 'abdi shamsin faaathnaa 'alayhi fiy musaaharatihi iiyyaahu faaahsana qaala ‏"‏ haddathaniy fasadaqaniy wawa'adaniy faaawfaa liy waiinniy lastu auharrimu halaalaan walaa auhillu haraamana walakin waalllahi laa tajtami'u bintu rasuwli alllahi wabintu 'aduwwi alllahi makaanana waahidana aabadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: (Imam Zain-ul-'Abidin) 'Ali b. Husain reported that when they came to Medina from Yazid b. Mu'awiya after the martyrdom of Husain b. 'Ali (Allah be pleased with him) Miswar b. Makhramah met him and said to him:Is there any work for me which you ask me to do? I said to him: No. He again said to me: Would you not give me the sword of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for I fear that the people may snatch it from you? By Allah, if you give that to me, no one would be able to take it away, so long as there is life in me. Verily 'Ali b. Abi Talib sent a proposal of marriage to the daughter of Abu Jahl in spite of (the fact that his wife) Fatima (had been living in his house). Thereupon I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say while addressing the people on the pulpit. I was adolescing in those days. He said: Fatima is a part of me and I fear that she may be put to trial in regard to religion. He then made a mention of his son-in law who had been from the tribe of 'Abd Shams and praised his behaviour as a son-in-law and said: Whatever he said to me he told the truth and whatever he promised he fulfilled it for me. I am not going to declare forbidden what is lawful and make lawful what is forbidden, but, by Allah, the daaghter of Allah's Messenger and the daughter of the enemy of Allah can never be combined at one place
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ، أَنَّ الْمِسْوَرَ بْنَ مَخْرَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَلِيَّ بْنَ أَبِي طَالِبٍ خَطَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي جَهْلٍ وَعِنْدَهُ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتْ بِذَلِكَ فَاطِمَةُ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ لَهُ إِنَّ قَوْمَكَ يَتَحَدَّثُونَ أَنَّكَ لاَ تَغْضَبُ لِبَنَاتِكَ وَهَذَا عَلِيٌّ نَاكِحًا ابْنَةَ أَبِي جَهْلٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْمِسْوَرُ فَقَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَمِعْتُهُ حِينَ تَشَهَّدَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَإِنِّي أَنْكَحْتُ أَبَا الْعَاصِ بْنَ الرَّبِيعِ فَحَدَّثَنِي فَصَدَقَنِي وَإِنَّ فَاطِمَةَ بِنْتَ مُحَمَّدٍ مُضْغَةٌ مِنِّي وَإِنَّمَا أَكْرَهُ أَنْ يَفْتِنُوهَا وَإِنَّهَا وَاللَّهِ لاَ تَجْتَمِعُ بِنْتُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ وَبِنْتُ عَدُوِّ اللَّهِ عِنْدَ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَتَرَكَ عَلِيٌّ الْخِطْبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy 'aliyyu bnu husaynin, aanna almiswara bna makhramaaa, aakhbarahu aanna 'aliyya bna aabiy taalibin khataba binta aabiy jahlin wa'indahu faatimaau bintu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falammaa sami'at bidhalika faatimaau aatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat lahu iinna qawmaka yatahaddathuwna aannaka laa taghdabu libanaatika wahadhaa 'aliyyun naakihana abnaaa aabiy jahlin ‏.‏ qaala almiswaru faqaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fasami'tuhu hiyna tashahhada thumma qaala ‏ "‏ aammaa ba'du faiinniy aankahtu aabaa al'aasi bna alrrabiy'i fahaddathaniy fasadaqaniy waiinna faatimaaa binta muhammadin mudghaaun minniy waiinnamaa aakrahu aan yaftinuwhaa waiinnahaa waalllahi laa tajtami'u bintu rasuwli alllahi wabintu 'aduwwi alllahi 'inda rajulin waahidin aabadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fataraka 'aliyyun alkhitbaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali b. Husain reported that Miswar b. Makhramah informed him that 'Ali b. Abi Talib sent the proposal of marriage to the daughter of Abu Jahl as he had Fatima, the daughter of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), (as his wife). When Fatima heard about it, she came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said:The people say that you never feel angry on account of your daughters and now 'Ali is going to marry the daughter of Abu Jahl. Makhramah said: Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rose up and I heard him reciting Tashahhud and say: Now to the point. I gave a daughter of mine (Zainab) to Abu'l-'As b. Rabi, and he spoke to me and spoke the truth. Verily Fatima, the daughter of Muhammad, is a part of me and I do not approve that she may be put to any trial and by Allah, the daughter of Allah's Messenger cannot be combined with the daughter of God's enemy (as the co-wives) of one person. Thereupon 'Ali gave up (the idea of his intended) marriage
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَرِيرٍ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النُّعْمَانَ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ رَاشِدٍ - يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw ma'nin alrraqaashiyyu, haddathanaa wahbun, - ya'niy abna jariyrin - 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu alnnu'maana, - ya'niy abna raashidin - yuhaddithu 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورُ بْنُ أَبِي مُزَاحِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَعَا فَاطِمَةَ ابْنَتَهُ فَسَارَّهَا فَبَكَتْ ثُمَّ سَارَّهَا فَضَحِكَتْ فَقَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ لِفَاطِمَةَ مَا هَذَا الَّذِي سَارَّكِ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَبَكَيْتِ ثُمَّ سَارَّكِ فَضَحِكْتِ قَالَتْ سَارَّنِي فَأَخْبَرَنِي بِمَوْتِهِ فَبَكَيْتُ ثُمَّ سَارَّنِي فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنِّي أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَتْبَعُهُ مِنْ أَهْلِهِ فَضَحِكْتُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mansuwru bnu aabiy muzaahimin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu, - ya'niy abna sa'din - 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an aabiyhi, aanna 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri, haddathahu aanna 'aaiishaaa haddathathu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm da'aa faatimaaa abnatahu fasaarrahaa fabakat thumma saarrahaa fadahikat faqaalat 'aaiishaau faqultu lifaatimaaa maa hadhaa alladhiy saarraki bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fabakayti thumma saarraki fadahikti qaalat saarraniy faaakhbaraniy bimawtihi fabakaytu thumma saarraniy faaakhbaraniy aanniy aawwalu man yatba'uhu min aahlihi fadahiktu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) called his daughter Fatima (during his last illness). He said. to her something secretly and she wept. He again said to her something secretly and she laughed. 'A'isha further reported that she said to Fatima:What is that which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to you secretly and you wept and then said to you something secretly and you laughed? Thereupon she said: He informed me secretly of his death and so I wept. He then again informed me secretly that I would be the first amongst the members of his family to follow him and so I laughed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كُنَّ أَزْوَاجُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَهُ لَمْ يُغَادِرْ مِنْهُنَّ وَاحِدَةً فَأَقْبَلَتْ فَاطِمَةُ تَمْشِي مَا تُخْطِئُ مِشْيَتُهَا مِنْ مِشْيَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم شَيْئًا فَلَمَّا رَآهَا رَحَّبَ بِهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَرْحَبًا بِابْنَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَجْلَسَهَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَوْ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ ثُمَّ سَارَّهَا فَبَكَتْ بُكَاءً شَدِيدًا فَلَمَّا رَأَى جَزَعَهَا سَارَّهَا الثَّانِيَةَ فَضَحِكَتْ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا خَصَّكِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ بَيْنِ نِسَائِهِ بِالسِّرَارِ ثُمَّ أَنْتِ تَبْكِينَ فَلَمَّا قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَأَلْتُهَا مَا قَالَ لَكِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ مَا كُنْتُ أُفْشِي عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سِرَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَلَمَّا تُوُفِّيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قُلْتُ عَزَمْتُ عَلَيْكِ بِمَا لِي عَلَيْكِ مِنَ الْحَقِّ لَمَا حَدَّثْتِنِي مَا قَالَ لَكِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ أَمَّا الآنَ فَنَعَمْ أَمَّا حِينَ سَارَّنِي فِي الْمَرَّةِ الأُولَى فَأَخْبَرَنِي ‏"‏ أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ كَانَ يُعَارِضُهُ الْقُرْآنَ فِي كُلِّ سَنَةٍ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَإِنَّهُ عَارَضَهُ الآنَ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَإِنِّي لاَ أُرَى الأَجَلَ إِلاَّ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ فَاتَّقِي اللَّهَ وَاصْبِرِي فَإِنَّهُ نِعْمَ السَّلَفُ أَنَا لَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَبَكَيْتُ بُكَائِي الَّذِي رَأَيْتِ فَلَمَّا رَأَى جَزَعِي سَارَّنِي الثَّانِيَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا فَاطِمَةُ أَمَا تَرْضَىْ أَنْ تَكُونِي سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَوْ سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَضَحِكْتُ ضَحِكِي الَّذِي رَأَيْتِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, fudaylu bnu husaynin haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an firaasin, 'an 'aamirin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kunna aazwaaju alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'indahu lam yughaadir minhunna waahidaaan faaaqbalat faatimaau tamshiy maa tukhtiiu mishyatuhaa min mishyaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm shayiana falammaa raahaa rahhaba bihaa faqaala ‏"‏ marhabana biabnatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aajlasahaa 'an yamiynihi aaw 'an shimaalihi thumma saarrahaa fabakat bukaa'an shadiydana falammaa raaaa jaza'ahaa saarrahaa althhaaniyaaa fadahikat ‏.‏ faqultu lahaa khassaki rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min bayni nisaaiihi bialssiraari thumma aanti tabkiyna falammaa qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm saaaltuhaa maa qaala laki rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat maa kuntu aufshiy 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sirrahu ‏.‏ qaalat falammaa tuwuffiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qultu 'azamtu 'alayki bimaa liy 'alayki mina alhaqqi lamaa haddathtiniy maa qaala laki rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat aammaa alana fana'am aammaa hiyna saarraniy fiy almarraai alauwlaa faaakhbaraniy ‏"‏ aanna jibriyla kaana yu'aariduhu alqurana fiy kulli sanaain marraaan aaw marratayni waiinnahu 'aaradahu alana marratayni waiinniy laa auraa alaajala iilaaa qadi aqtaraba faattaqiy alllaha waasbiriy faiinnahu ni'ma alssalafu aanaa laki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat fabakaytu bukaaiiy alladhiy raaayti falammaa raaaa jaza'iy saarraniy althhaaniyaaa faqaala ‏"‏ yaa faatimaau aamaa tardaa aan takuwniy sayyidaaa nisaa'i almuuminiyna aaw sayyidaaa nisaa'i hadhihi alaummaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat fadahiktu dahikiy alladhiy raaayti ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:We, the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), were with him (during his last illness) and none was absent therefrom that Fatima, who walked after the style of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), came there, and when he saw her he welcomed her saying: You are welcome, my daughter. He their made her sit on his right side or on his left side. Then he said something secretly to her and she wept bitterly and when he found her (plunged) in grief he said to her something secretly for the second time and she laughed. I ('A'isha) said to her: Allah's Messenger has singled you amongst the women (of the family) for talking (to you something secretly) and you wept. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) recovered from illness, I said to her. What did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say to you? Thereupon she said: I am not going to disclose the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) died, I said to her: I adjure you by the right that I have upon you that you should narrate to me what Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to you. She said: Yes, now I can do that (so listen to it). When he talked to me secretly for the first time he informed me that Gabirel was in the habit of reciting the Qur'an along with him once or twice every year, but this year it had been twice and so he perceived his death quite near, so fear Allah and be patient (and he told me) that he would be a befitting forerunner for me and so I wept as you saw me. And when he saw me in grief he talked to me secretly for the second time and said: Fatima, are you not pleased that you should be at the head of the believing women or the head of this Umma? I laughed and it was that laughter which you saw
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنْ فِرَاسٍ، عَنْ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتِ اجْتَمَعَ نِسَاءُ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يُغَادِرْ مِنْهُنَّ امْرَأَةً فَجَاءَتْ فَاطِمَةُ تَمْشِي كَأَنَّ مِشْيَتَهَا مِشْيَةُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَرْحَبًا بِابْنَتِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَجْلَسَهَا عَنْ يَمِينِهِ أَوْ عَنْ شِمَالِهِ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ أَسَرَّ إِلَيْهَا حَدِيثًا فَبَكَتْ فَاطِمَةُ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ سَارَّهَا فَضَحِكَتْ أَيْضًا فَقُلْتُ لَهَا مَا يُبْكِيكِ فَقَالَتْ مَا كُنْتُ لأُفْشِيَ سِرَّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ مَا رَأَيْتُ كَالْيَوْمِ فَرَحًا أَقْرَبَ مِنْ حُزْنٍ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا حِينَ بَكَتْ أَخَصَّكِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِحَدِيثِهِ دُونَنَا ثُمَّ تَبْكِينَ وَسَأَلْتُهَا عَمَّا قَالَ فَقَالَتْ مَا كُنْتُ لأُفْشِيَ سِرَّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ حَتَّى إِذَا قُبِضَ سَأَلْتُهَا فَقَالَتْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ حَدَّثَنِي ‏"‏ أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ كَانَ يُعَارِضُهُ بِالْقُرْآنِ كُلَّ عَامٍ مَرَّةً وَإِنَّهُ عَارَضَهُ بِهِ فِي الْعَامِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَلاَ أُرَانِي إِلاَّ قَدْ حَضَرَ أَجَلِي وَإِنَّكِ أَوَّلُ أَهْلِي لُحُوقًا بِي وَنِعْمَ السَّلَفُ أَنَا لَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبَكَيْتُ لِذَلِكِ ثُمَّ إِنَّهُ سَارَّنِي فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ تَكُونِي سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَوْ سَيِّدَةَ نِسَاءِ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَضَحِكْتُ لِذَلِكِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, 'an zakariyyaa'a, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'an firaasin, 'an 'aamirin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalati ajtama'a nisaa'u alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yughaadir minhunna amraaaaan fajaa'at faatimaau tamshiy kaaanna mishyatahaa mishyaau rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ marhabana biabnatiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaajlasahaa 'an yamiynihi aaw 'an shimaalihi thumma iinnahu aasarra iilayhaa hadiythana fabakat faatimaau thumma iinnahu saarrahaa fadahikat aaydana faqultu lahaa maa yubkiyki faqaalat maa kuntu laufshiya sirra rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqultu maa raaaytu kaalyawmi farahana aaqraba min huznin ‏.‏ faqultu lahaa hiyna bakat aakhassaki rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bihadiythihi duwnanaa thumma tabkiyna wasaaaltuhaa 'ammaa qaala faqaalat maa kuntu laufshiya sirra rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ hattaa iidhaa qubida saaaltuhaa faqaalat iinnahu kaana haddathaniy ‏"‏ aanna jibriyla kaana yu'aariduhu bialqurani kulla 'aamin marraaan waiinnahu 'aaradahu bihi fiy al'aami marratayni walaa auraaniy iilaaa qad hadara aajaliy waiinnaki aawwalu aahliy luhuwqana biy wani'ma alssalafu aanaa laki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fabakaytu lidhaliki thumma iinnahu saarraniy faqaala ‏"‏ aalaa tardayna aan takuwniy sayyidaaa nisaa'i almuuminiyna aaw sayyidaaa nisaa'i hadhihi alaummaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadahiktu lidhaliki ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that all the wives of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had gathered (in her apartment) during the days of his (Prophet's) last illness and no woman was left behind that Fatima, who walked after the style of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), came there. He welcomed her by saying:You are welcome, my daughter, and made her sit on his right side or on his left side, and then talked something secretly to her and Fatima wept. Then he talked something secretly to her and she laughed. I said to her: What makes you weep? She said: I am not going to divulge the secret of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I (`A'isha) said: I have not seen (anything happening) like today, the happiness being more close to grief (as I see today) when she wept. I said to her: Has Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) singled you out for saying something leaving us aside? She then wept and I asked her what he said, and she said: I am not going to divulge the secrets of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). And when he died I again asked her and she said that he (the Holy Prophet) told her: Gabriel used to recite the Qur'an to me once a year and for this year it was twice and so I perceived that my death had drawn near, and that I (Fatima) would be the first amongst the members of his family who would meet him (in the Hereafter). He shall be my good forerunner and it made me weep. He again talked to me secretly (saying): Aren't you pleased that you should be the sovereign amongst the believing women or the head of women of this Ummah? And this made me laugh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى الْقَيْسِيُّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ، - قَالَ ابْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ سَلْمَانَ، قَالَ لاَ تَكُونَنَّ إِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ السُّوقَ وَلاَ آخِرَ مَنْ يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّهَا مَعْرَكَةُ الشَّيْطَانِ وَبِهَا يَنْصِبُ رَايَتَهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأُنْبِئْتُ أَنَّ جِبْرِيلَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَتَى نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَعِنْدَهُ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلَ يَتَحَدَّثُ ثُمَّ قَامَ فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأُمِّ سَلَمَةَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ قَالَتْ هَذَا دِحْيَةُ - قَالَ - فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ ايْمُ اللَّهِ مَا حَسِبْتُهُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ حَتَّى سَمِعْتُ خُطْبَةَ نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُخْبِرُ خَبَرَنَا أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ لأَبِي عُثْمَانَ مِمَّنْ سَمِعْتَ هَذَا قَالَ مِنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa alqaysiyyu, kilaahumaa 'ani almu'tamiri, - qaala abnu hammaadin haddathanaa mu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, - qaala sami'tu aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, 'an salmaana, qaala laa takuwnanna iini astata'ta aawwala man yadkhulu alssuwqa walaa akhira man yakhruju minhaa faiinnahaa ma'rakaau alshhaytaani wabihaa yansibu raayatahu ‏.‏ qaala waaunbiitu aanna jibriyla 'alayhi alssalaamu aataa nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wa'indahu aummu salamaaa - qaala - faja'ala yatahaddathu thumma qaama faqaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laummi salamaaa ‏ "‏ man hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala qaalat hadhaa dihyaau - qaala - faqaalat aummu salamaaa aymu alllahi maa hasibtuhu iilaaa iiyyaahu hattaa sami'tu khutbaaa nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yukhbiru khabaranaa aaw kamaa qaala qaala faqultu laabiy 'uthmaana mimman sami'ta hadhaa qaala min ausaamaaa bni zaydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salman reported:In case it lies in your power don't be one to enter the bazar first and the last to get out of that because there is a bustle and the standard of Satan is set there. He said: I was informed that Gabriel (Allah be pleased with him) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and there was with him Umin Salama and he began to talk with him. He then stood up, whereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said to Umm Salama: (Do you know) who was he and what did he say? She said: He was Dihya (Kalbi). He reported Umm Salama having said: By Allah, I did not deem him but only he (Dihya) until I heard the address of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) informing him about us. He (the narrator) said: I said to Uthman: From whom did you hear it? He said: From Usima b. Zaid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ، حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى السِّيْنَانِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا طَلْحَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ بِنْتِ طَلْحَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَسْرَعُكُنَّ لَحَاقًا بِي أَطْوَلُكُنَّ يَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَكُنَّ يَتَطَاوَلْنَ أَيَّتُهُنَّ أَطْوَلُ يَدًا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَكَانَتْ أَطْوَلَنَا يَدًا زَيْنَبُ لأَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَعْمَلُ بِيَدِهَا وَتَصَدَّقُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa mahmuwdu bnu ghaylaana aabuw aahmada, haddathanaa alfadlu bnu muwsaa alssiynaaniyyu, aakhbaranaa talhaau bnu yahyaa bni talhaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa binti talhaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa aummi almuuminiyna, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aasra'ukunna lahaaqana biy aatwalukunna yadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat fakunna yatataawalna aayyatuhunna aatwalu yadana ‏.‏ qaalat fakaanat aatwalanaa yadana zaynabu laannahaa kaanat ta'malu biyadihaa watasaddaqu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the Mother of the Faithful, reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:One who has the longest hands amongst you would meet me most immediately.
