She farther said: They (the wives of Allah's Apostle) used to measure the hands as to whose hand was the longest and it was the hand of Zainab that was the longest amongst them, as she used to work with her hand and Spend (that income) on charity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ انْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَى أُمِّ أَيْمَنَ فَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ فَنَاوَلَتْهُ إِنَاءً فِيهِ شَرَابٌ - قَالَ - فَلاَ أَدْرِي أَصَادَفَتْهُ صَائِمًا أَوْ لَمْ يُرِدْهُ فَجَعَلَتْ تَصْخَبُ عَلَيْهِ وَتَذَمَّرُ عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an sulaymaana bni almughiyraai, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala antalaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaa aummi aaymana faantalaqtu ma'ahu fanaawalathu iinaa'an fiyhi sharaabun - qaala - falaa aadriy aasaadafathu saaiimana aaw lam yuridhu faja'alat taskhabu 'alayhi watadhammaru 'alayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to Umm Aiman and I went along with him and she served him a drink in a vessel and he reported that the narrator said:I do not know whether it was because of the fasting (or for any other reason) that he (the Holy Prophet) refused to accept that. She raised her voice and showed annoyance to him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ الْكِلاَبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ رضى الله عنه بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِعُمَرَ انْطَلِقْ بِنَا إِلَى أُمِّ أَيْمَنَ نَزُورُهَا كَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَزُورُهَا ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا انْتَهَيْنَا إِلَيْهَا بَكَتْ فَقَالاَ لَهَا مَا يُبْكِيكِ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِرَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ مَا أَبْكِي أَنْ لاَ أَكُونَ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِرَسُولِهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَكِنْ أَبْكِي أَنَّ الْوَحْىَ قَدِ انْقَطَعَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ ‏.‏ فَهَيَّجَتْهُمَا عَلَى الْبُكَاءِ فَجَعَلاَ يَبْكِيَانِ مَعَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu 'aasimin alkilaabiyyu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala qaala aabuw bakrin rda allh 'nh ba'da wafaaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm li'umara antaliq binaa iilaa aummi aaymana nazuwruhaa kamaa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yazuwruhaa ‏.‏ falammaa antahaynaa iilayhaa bakat faqaalaa lahaa maa yubkiyki maa 'inda alllahi khayrun lirasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ faqaalat maa aabkiy aan laa aakuwna aa'lamu aanna maa 'inda alllahi khayrun lirasuwlihi sla allh 'lyh wslm walakin aabkiy aanna alwahaa qadi anqata'a mina alssamaa'i ‏.‏ fahayyajathumaa 'alaa albukaa'i faja'alaa yabkiyaani ma'ahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that after the death of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Abu Bakr said to 'Umar:Let us visit Umm Aiman as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to visit her. As we came to her, she wept. They (Abu Bakr and Umar) said to her: What makes you weep? What is in store (in the next world) for Allah's-Messenger (ﷺ) is better than (this worldly life). She said: I weep not because I am ignorant of the fact that what is in store for Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (in the next world) is better than (this world), but I weep because the revelation which came from the Heaven has ceased to come. This moved both of them to tears and they began to weep along with her
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَى أَحَدٍ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ إِلاَّ عَلَى أَزْوَاجِهِ إِلاَّ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ فَإِنَّهُ كَانَ يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهَا فَقِيلَ لَهُ فِي ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي أَرْحَمُهَا قُتِلَ أَخُوهَا مَعِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aasimin, haddathanaa hammaamun, 'an iishaaqa bni 'abdi, alllahi 'an aanasin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yadkhulu 'alaa aahadin mina alnnisaa'i iilaaa 'alaa aazwaajihi iilaaa aummi sulaymin faiinnahu kaana yadkhulu 'alayhaa faqiyla lahu fiy dhalika faqaala ‏ "‏ iinniy aarhamuhaa qutila aakhuwhaa ma'iy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not enter the house of any woman except that of his wives and that of Umm Sulaim. He used to visit her. It was said to him why it was so, whereupon he said:I feel great compassion for her. Her brother was killed while he was with me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ السَّرِيِّ - حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ دَخَلْتُ الْجَنَّةَ فَسَمِعْتُ خَشْفَةً فَقُلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا قَالُوا هَذِهِ الْغُمَيْصَاءُ بِنْتُ مِلْحَانَ أُمُّ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna alssariyyi - haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ dakhaltu aljannaaa fasami'tu khashfaaan faqultu man hadhaa qaaluwa hadhihi alghumaysaa'u bintu milhaana aummu aanasi bni maalikin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:I entered Paradise and heard the noise of steps. I said: Who is it? They said: She is Ghumaisa, daughter of Milhan, the mother of Anas b. Malik
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْفَرَجِ حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ الْحُبَابِ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، بْنُ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُرِيتُ الْجَنَّةَ فَرَأَيْتُ امْرَأَةَ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ ثُمَّ سَمِعْتُ خَشْخَشَةً أَمَامِي فَإِذَا بِلاَلٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ja'farin, muhammadu bnu alfaraji haddathanaa zaydu bnu alhubaabi, aakhbaraniy 'abdu al'aziyzi, bnu aabiy salamaaa aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu almunkadiri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ auriytu aljannaaa faraaaytu amraaaaa aabiy talhaaa thumma sami'tu khashkhashaaan aamaamiy faiidhaa bilaalun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:I was shown Paradise and I saw the wife of Abu Talha (i.e. Umm Sulaim) and I heard the noise of steps before me and, lo, it was that of Bilal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ مَاتَ ابْنٌ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ مِنْ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ فَقَالَتْ لأَهْلِهَا لاَ تُحَدِّثُوا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ بِابْنِهِ حَتَّى أَكُونَ أَنَا أُحَدِّثُهُ - قَالَ - فَجَاءَ فَقَرَّبَتْ إِلَيْهِ عَشَاءً فَأَكَلَ وَشَرِبَ - فَقَالَ - ثُمَّ تَصَنَّعَتْ لَهُ أَحْسَنَ مَا كَانَ تَصَنَّعُ قَبْلَ ذَلِكَ فَوَقَعَ بِهَا فَلَمَّا رَأَتْ أَنَّهُ قَدْ شَبِعَ وَأَصَابَ مِنْهَا قَالَتْ يَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ أَنَّ قَوْمًا أَعَارُوا عَارِيَتَهُمْ أَهْلَ بَيْتٍ فَطَلَبُوا عَارِيَتَهُمْ أَلَهُمْ أَنْ يَمْنَعُوهُمْ قَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَاحْتَسِبِ ابْنَكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَغَضِبَ وَقَالَ تَرَكْتِنِي حَتَّى تَلَطَّخْتُ ثُمَّ أَخْبَرْتِنِي بِابْنِي ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ حَتَّى أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ بِمَا كَانَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكُمَا فِي غَابِرِ لَيْلَتِكُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَمَلَتْ - قَالَ - فَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ وَهِيَ مَعَهُ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَى الْمَدِينَةَ مِنْ سَفَرٍ لاَ يَطْرُقُهَا طُرُوقًا فَدَنَوْا مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ فَضَرَبَهَا الْمَخَاضُ فَاحْتُبِسَ عَلَيْهَا أَبُو طَلْحَةَ وَانْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - يَقُولُ أَبُو طَلْحَةَ إِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ يَا رَبِّ إِنَّهُ يُعْجِبُنِي أَنْ أَخْرُجَ مَعَ رَسُولِكَ إِذَا خَرَجَ وَأَدْخُلَ مَعَهُ إِذَا دَخَلَ وَقَدِ احْتُبِسْتُ بِمَا تَرَى - قَالَ - تَقُولُ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ يَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ مَا أَجِدُ الَّذِي كُنْتُ أَجِدُ انْطَلِقْ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقْنَا - قَالَ - وَضَرَبَهَا الْمَخَاضُ حِينَ قَدِمَا فَوَلَدَتْ غُلاَمًا فَقَالَتْ لِي أُمِّي يَا أَنَسُ لاَ يُرْضِعُهُ أَحَدٌ حَتَّى تَغْدُوَ بِهِ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ احْتَمَلْتُهُ فَانْطَلَقْتُ بِهِ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَصَادَفْتُهُ وَمَعَهُ مِيسَمٌ فَلَمَّا رَآنِي قَالَ ‏"‏ لَعَلَّ أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ وَلَدَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَوَضَعَ الْمِيسَمَ - قَالَ - وَجِئْتُ بِهِ فَوَضَعْتُهُ فِي حَجْرِهِ وَدَعَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِعَجْوَةٍ مِنْ عَجْوَةِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَلاَكَهَا فِي فِيهِ حَتَّى ذَابَتْ ثُمَّ قَذَفَهَا فِي فِي الصَّبِيِّ فَجَعَلَ الصَّبِيُّ يَتَلَمَّظُهَا - قَالَ - فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ انْظُرُوا إِلَى حُبِّ الأَنْصَارِ التَّمْرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَسَحَ وَجْهَهُ وَسَمَّاهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimi bni maymuwnin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, qaala maata abnun laabiy talhaaa min aummi sulaymin faqaalat laahlihaa laa tuhaddithuwa aabaa talhaaa biabnihi hattaa aakuwna aanaa auhaddithuhu - qaala - fajaa'a faqarrabat iilayhi 'ashaa'an faaakala washariba - faqaala - thumma tasanna'at lahu aahsana maa kaana tasanna'u qabla dhalika fawaqa'a bihaa falammaa raaat aannahu qad shabi'a waaasaaba minhaa qaalat yaa aabaa talhaaa aaraaayta law aanna qawmana aa'aaruwa 'aariyatahum aahla baytin fatalabuwa 'aariyatahum aalahum aan yamna'uwhum qaala laa ‏.‏ qaalat faahtasibi abnaka ‏.‏ qaala faghadiba waqaala taraktiniy hattaa talattakhtu thumma aakhbartiniy biabniy ‏.‏ faantalaqa hattaa aataa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu bimaa kaana faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ baaraka alllahu lakumaa fiy ghaabiri laylatikumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fahamalat - qaala - fakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin wahiya ma'ahu wakaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aataa almadiynaaa min safarin laa yatruquhaa turuwqana fadanawa mina almadiynaai fadarabahaa almakhaadu faahtubisa 'alayhaa aabuw talhaaa waantalaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - yaquwlu aabuw talhaaa iinnaka lata'lamu yaa rabbi iinnahu yu'jibuniy aan aakhruja ma'a rasuwlika iidhaa kharaja waaadkhula ma'ahu iidhaa dakhala waqadi ahtubistu bimaa taraa - qaala - taquwlu aummu sulaymin yaa aabaa talhaaa maa aajidu alladhiy kuntu aajidu antaliq ‏.‏ faantalaqnaa - qaala - wadarabahaa almakhaadu hiyna qadimaa fawaladat ghulaamana faqaalat liy aummiy yaa aanasu laa yurdi'uhu aahadun hattaa taghduwa bihi 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ falammaa aasbaha ahtamaltuhu faantalaqtu bihi iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - fasaadaftuhu wama'ahu miysamun falammaa raaniy qaala ‏"‏ la'alla aumma sulaymin waladat ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu na'am ‏.‏ fawada'a almiysama - qaala - wajiitu bihi fawada'tuhu fiy hajrihi wada'aa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bi'ajwaain min 'ajwaai almadiynaai falaakahaa fiy fiyhi hattaa dhaabat thumma qadhafahaa fiy fiy alssabiyyi faja'ala alssabiyyu yatalammazuhaa - qaala - faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ anzuruwa iilaa hubbi alaansaari alttamra ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famasaha wajhahu wasammaahu 'abda alllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that the son of Abu Talba who was born of Umm Sulaim died. She (Umm Sulaim) said to the members of her family:Do not narrate to Abu Talha about his son until I narrate it to him. Abu Talha came (home) ; she presented to him the supper. He took it and drank water. She then embellished herself which she did not do before. He (Abu Talha) had a sexual intercourse with her and when she saw that he was satisfied after sexual intercourse with her, she said: Abu Talha, if some people borrow something from another family and then (the members of the family) ask for its return, would they resist its return? He said: No. She said: I inform you about the death of your son. He was annoyed, and said: You did not inform me until I had a sexual intercourse with you and you later on gave me information about my son. He went to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and informed him what had happened. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: May Allah bless both of you in the night spent by you! He (the narrator) said: She became pregnant. Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) was in the course of a journey and she was along with him and when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came back to Medina from the journey he did not enter (his house) (during the night). When the people came near Medina, she felt the pangs of delivery. He (Abu Talha) remained with her and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) proceeded on. Abu Talha said: O Lord, you know that I love to go along with Allah's Messenger when he goes out and enter along with him when he enters and I have been detained as Thou seest. Umm Sulaim said: Abu Talha, I do not feel (so much pain) as I was feeling formerly, so better proceed on. So we proceeded on and she felt the pangs of delivery as they reached (Medina) and a child was born and my mother said to me: Anas, none should suckle him until you go to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) tomorrow morning. And when it was morning I carried him (the child) and went along with him to Allah's Messenger (may peace beupon him). He said: I saw that he had in his hand the instrument for the cauterisation of the camels. When he saw me. he said: This is, perhaps, what Umm Sulaim has given birth to. I said: Yes. He laid down that instrument on the ground. I brought that child to him and placed it in his lap and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Ajwa dates of Medina to be brought and softened them in his month. When these had become palatable he placed them in the mouth of that child. The child began to taste them. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: See what love the Ansar have for dates. He then wiped his face and named him 'Abdullah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ خِرَاشٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ، الْمُغِيرَةِ حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَاتَ ابْنٌ لأَبِي طَلْحَةَ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu alhasani bni khiraashin, haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aasimin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu, almughiyraai haddathanaa thaabitun, haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala maata abnun laabiy talhaaa ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَيَّانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو حَيَّانَ التَّيْمِيُّ يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِبِلاَلٍ عِنْدَ صَلاَةِ الْغَدَاةِ ‏ "‏ يَا بِلاَلُ حَدِّثْنِي بِأَرْجَى عَمَلٍ عَمِلْتَهُ عِنْدَكَ فِي الإِسْلاَمِ مَنْفَعَةً فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ اللَّيْلَةَ خَشْفَ نَعْلَيْكَ بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ بِلاَلٌ مَا عَمِلْتُ عَمَلاً فِي الإِسْلاَمِ أَرْجَى عِنْدِي مَنْفَعَةً مِنْ أَنِّي لاَ أَتَطَهَّرُ طُهُورًا تَامًّا فِي سَاعَةٍ مِنْ لَيْلٍ وَلاَ نَهَارٍ إِلاَّ صَلَّيْتُ بِذَلِكَ الطُّهُورِ مَا كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لِي أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu ya'iysha, wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an aabiy hayyaana, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw hayyaana alttaymiyyu yahyaa bnu sa'iydin 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm libilaalin 'inda salaaai alghadaaai ‏ "‏ yaa bilaalu haddithniy biaarjaa 'amalin 'amiltahu 'indaka fiy aliislaami manfa'aaan faiinniy sami'tu alllaylaaa khashfa na'layka bayna yadaaaa fiy aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala bilaalun maa 'amiltu 'amalaan fiy aliislaami aarjaa 'indiy manfa'aaan min aanniy laa aatatahharu tuhuwrana taammana fiy saa'aain min laylin walaa nahaarin iilaaa sallaytu bidhalika alttuhuwri maa kataba alllahu liy aan ausalliya ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Bilal:Bilal, narrate to me which act at the time of morning prayer you did in Islam for which you hope to receive good reward, for I heard during the night the sound of your steps before me in Paradise. Bilal said: I did not do any act in Islam for which I hope to get any benefit but this that when I perform complete ablution during the night or day I observe prayer with that purification what Allah has ordained for me to pray
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَسَهْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَامِرِ بْنِ، زُرَارَةَ الْحَضْرَمِيُّ وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ وَالْوَلِيدُ بْنُ شُجَاعٍ قَالَ سَهْلٌ وَمِنْجَابٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، الآخَرُونَ حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ ‏{‏ لَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَعَمِلُوا الصَّالِحَاتِ جُنَاحٌ فِيمَا طَعِمُوا إِذَا مَا اتَّقَوْا وَآمَنُوا‏}‏ إِلَى آخِرِ الآيَةِ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قِيلَ لِي أَنْتَ مِنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, wasahlu bnu 'uthmaana, wa'abdu alllahi bnu 'aamiri bni, zuraaraaa alhadramiyyu wasuwaydu bnu sa'iydin waalwaliydu bnu shujaa'in qaala sahlun waminjaabun aakhbaranaa waqaala, alakharuwna haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an 'alqamaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala lammaa nazalat hadhihi alayaau ‏{‏ laysa 'alaa alladhiyna amanuwa wa'amiluwa alssaalihaati junaahun fiymaa ta'imuwa iidhaa maa attaqawa waamanuwa‏}‏ iilaa akhiri alayaai qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ qiyla liy aanta minhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported that when this verse was revealed:" There is no harm on persons who believe and perform good acts, what they had eaten (formerly) when they avoided it (now) and they affirmed their faith" (v. 93) up to the end. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me: You are one amongst them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ رَافِعٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَدِمْتُ أَنَا وَأَخِي، مِنَ الْيَمَنِ فَكُنَّا حِينًا وَمَا نُرَى ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ وَأُمَّهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَيْتِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ كَثْرَةِ دُخُولِهِمْ وَلُزُومِهِمْ لَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, - waalllafzu laibni raafi'in - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa abnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi bni yaziyda, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala qadimtu aanaa waaakhiy, mina alyamani fakunnaa hiynana wamaa nuraa abna mas'uwdin waaummahu iilaaa min aahli bayti rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min kathraai dukhuwlihim waluzuwmihim lahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported:When I and my brother came from Yemen we used to consider Ibn Mas'ud and his mother amongst the members of the household. of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) because of their visiting them frequently and staying there for long (periods of) time
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الأَسْوَدَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا مُوسَى، يَقُولُ لَقَدْ قَدِمْتُ أَنَا وَأَخِي، مِنَ الْيَمَنِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu yuwsufa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, aannahu sami'a alaaswada, yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa muwsaa, yaquwlu laqad qadimtu aanaa waaakhiy, mina alyamani ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith is narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَنَا أُرَى أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْبَيْتِ ‏.‏ أَوْ مَا ذَكَرَ مِنْ نَحْوِ هَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaaluwa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala aataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaanaa auraa aanna 'abda alllahi min aahli albayti ‏.‏ aaw maa dhakara min nahwi hadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa. reported:I came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and thought that 'Abdullah was amongst the members of the family, or like that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الأَحْوَصِ، قَالَ شَهِدْتُ أَبَا مُوسَى وَأَبَا مَسْعُودٍ حِينَ مَاتَ ابْنُ مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا لِصَاحِبِهِ أَتُرَاهُ تَرَكَ بَعْدَهُ مِثْلَهُ فَقَالَ إِنْ قُلْتَ ذَاكَ إِنْ كَانَ لَيُؤْذَنُ لَهُ إِذَا حُجِبْنَا وَيَشْهَدُ إِذَا غِبْنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu aabaa alaahwasi, qaala shahidtu aabaa muwsaa waaabaa mas'uwdin hiyna maata abnu mas'uwdin faqaala aahaduhumaa lisaahibihi aaturaahu taraka ba'dahu mithlahu faqaala iin qulta dhaaka iin kaana layuudhanu lahu iidhaa hujibnaa wayashhadu iidhaa ghibnaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ishaq reported that he heard Abu'l-Ahwas say:I was along with Abu Musa and Abu Mas'ud as Ibn Mas'ud died and one of them said to the other: Do you find one like him besides him? Thereupon he said: Do you say this (no one can be his rival)? He was admitted (to the company of the Holy Prophet) whereas we were detained and he had been present in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) whereas we had been absent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا قُطْبَةُ، هُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، قَالَ كُنَّا فِي دَارِ أَبِي مُوسَى مَعَ نَفَرٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ فِي مُصْحَفٍ فَقَامَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ مَا أَعْلَمُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَرَكَ بَعْدَهُ أَعْلَمَ بِمَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنْ هَذَا الْقَائِمِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو مُوسَى أَمَا لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَاكَ لَقَدْ كَانَ يَشْهَدُ إِذَا غِبْنَا وَيُؤْذَنُ لَهُ إِذَا حُجِبْنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa qutbaau, huwa abnu 'abdi al'aziyzi 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an maaliki bni alhaarithi, 'an aabiy alaahwasi, qaala kunnaa fiy daari aabiy muwsaa ma'a nafarin min aashaabi 'abdi alllahi wahum yanzuruwna fiy mushafin faqaama 'abdu alllahi faqaala aabuw mas'uwdin maa aa'lamu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm taraka ba'dahu aa'lama bimaa aanzala alllahu min hadhaa alqaaiimi ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw muwsaa aamaa laiin qulta dhaaka laqad kaana yashhadu iidhaa ghibnaa wayuudhanu lahu iidhaa hujibnaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ahwas reported:We were in the house of Abu Musa along with some of the companions of 'Abdullah and they were looking at the Holy Book. 'Abdullah stood up, whereupon Abu Mas'ud said: I do not know whether Allah's Messenger, (ﷺ) has left after him one having a better knowledge (of Islam) than the man who is standing. Abu Musa said: If you say this, that is correct, because he had been present when we had been absent and he was permitted when we were detained
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، - هُوَ ابْنُ مُوسَى - عَنْ شَيْبَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، قَالَ أَتَيْتُ أَبَا مُوسَى فَوَجَدْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ وَأَبَا مُوسَى ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ جَالِسًا مَعَ حُذَيْفَةَ وَأَبِي مُوسَى وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَحَدِيثُ قُطْبَةَ أَتَمُّ وَأَكْثَرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alqaasimu bnu zakariyyaa'a, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, - huwa abnu muwsaa - 'an shaybaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an maaliki bni alhaarithi, 'an aabiy alaahwasi, qaala aataytu aabaa muwsaa fawajadtu 'abda alllahi waaabaa muwsaa h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'ubaydaaa, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an zaydi bni wahbin, qaala kuntu jaalisana ma'a hudhayfaaa waaabiy muwsaa wasaaqa alhadiytha wahadiythu qutbaaa aatammu waaaktharu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Wahab reported:I was sitting along with Hudhaifa and Abu Musa, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدَةُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏{‏ وَمَنْ يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ‏}‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ عَلَى قِرَاءَةِ مَنْ تَأْمُرُونِي أَنْ أَقْرَأَ فَلَقَدْ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِضْعًا وَسَبْعِينَ سُورَةً وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنِّي أَعْلَمُهُمْ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ وَلَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ أَحَدًا أَعْلَمُ مِنِّي لَرَحَلْتُ إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ شَقِيقٌ فَجَلَسْتُ فِي حَلَقِ أَصْحَابِ مُحَمَّدٍ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَا سَمِعْتُ أَحَدًا يَرُدُّ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ وَلاَ يَعِيبُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdaau bnu sulaymaana, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, aannahu qaala ‏{‏ waman yaghlul yaati bimaa ghalla yawma alqiyaamaai‏}‏ thumma qaala 'alaa qiraa'aai man taamuruwniy aan aaqraaa falaqad qaraatu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bid'ana wasab'iyna suwraaan walaqad 'alima aashaabu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanniy aa'lamuhum bikitaabi alllahi walaw aa'lamu aanna aahadana aa'lamu minniy larahaltu iilayhi ‏.‏ qaala shaqiyqun fajalastu fiy halaqi aashaabi muhammadin sla allh 'lyh wslm famaa sami'tu aahadana yaruddu dhalika 'alayhi walaa ya'iybuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) reported that he (said to his companions to conceal their copies of the Qur'an) and further said:He who conceals anything he shall have to bring that which he had concealed on the Day of judgment, and then said: After whose mode of recitation you command me to recite? I in fact recited before AIlah's Messenger (ﷺ) more than seventy chapters of the Qur'an and the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) know it that I have better understanding of the Book of Allah (than they do), and if I were to know that someone had better understanding than I, I would have gone to him. Shaqiq said: I sat in the company of the Companions of Mubkmmad (ﷺ) but I did not hear anyone having rejected that (that is, his recitation) or finding fault with it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، حَدَّثَنَا قُطْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ وَالَّذِي لاَ إِلَهَ غَيْرُهُ مَا مِنْ كِتَابِ اللَّهِ سُورَةٌ إِلاَّ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ حَيْثُ نَزَلَتْ وَمَا مِنْ آيَةٍ إِلاَّ أَنَا أَعْلَمُ فِيمَا أُنْزِلَتْ وَلَوْ أَعْلَمُ أَحَدًا هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكِتَابِ اللَّهِ مِنِّي تَبْلُغُهُ الإِبِلُ لَرَكِبْتُ إِلَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, haddathanaa qutbaau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an muslimin, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala waalladhiy laa iilaha ghayruhu maa min kitaabi alllahi suwraaun iilaaa aanaa aa'lamu haythu nazalat wamaa min ayaain iilaaa aanaa aa'lamu fiymaa aunzilat walaw aa'lamu aahadana huwa aa'lamu bikitaabi alllahi minniy tablughuhu aliibilu larakibtu iilayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported:By Him besides Whom there is no god, there is no chapter in the Book of Allah about which I do not know as to where it was revealed and there is no verse about which I do not know in what context it was revealed, and if I were to know of one having a better understanding of the Book of Allah than I (and I could reach him) on the back of the mule, I would have definitely gone to him on camel's back
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَأْتِي عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرٍو فَنَتَحَدَّثُ إِلَيْهِ - وَقَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ عِنْدَهُ - فَذَكَرْنَا يَوْمًا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ لَقَدْ ذَكَرْتُمْ رَجُلاً لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّهُ بَعْدَ شَىْءٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ خُذُوا الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنِ ابْنِ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ - فَبَدَأَ بِهِ - وَمُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ وَأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ وَسَالِمٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an masruwqin, qaala kunnaa naatiy 'abda alllahi bna 'amrinw fanatahaddathu iilayhi - waqaala abnu numayrin 'indahu - fadhakarnaa yawmana 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin faqaala laqad dhakartum rajulaan laa aazaalu auhibbuhu ba'da shaa'in sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ khudhuwa alqurana min aarba'aain mini abni aummi 'abdin - fabadaaa bihi - wamu'aadhi bni jabalin waaubaaai bni ka'bin wasaalimin mawlaa aabiy hudhayfaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Masruq reported:We used to go to Abdullah b. 'Amr and talk to him, Ibn Numair said: One day we made a mention of Abdullah b. Mas'ud, whereupon he said: You have made mention of a person whom I love more than anything else. I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Learn Qur'an from four persons: Ibn Umm 'Abd (i. e. 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud) he started from him-then Mu'adh b. Jabal and Ubayya b. Ka'b, then Salim the ally of Abu Hudhaifa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فَذَكَرْنَا حَدِيثًا عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، فَقَالَ إِنَّ ذَاكَ الرَّجُلَ لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّهُ بَعْدَ شَىْءٍ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُهُ سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اقْرَءُوا الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةِ نَفَرٍ مِنِ ابْنِ أُمِّ عَبْدٍ - فَبَدَأَ بِهِ - وَمِنْ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ وَمِنْ سَالِمٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ وَمِنْ مُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَرْفٌ لَمْ يَذْكُرْهُ زُهَيْرٌ قَوْلُهُ يَقُولُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaaluwa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an masruwqin, qaala kunnaa 'inda 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw fadhakarnaa hadiythana 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, faqaala iinna dhaaka alrrajula laa aazaalu auhibbuhu ba'da shaa'in sami'tuhu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwluhu sami'tuhu yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aqra'uwa alqurana min aarba'aai nafarin mini abni aummi 'abdin - fabadaaa bihi - wamin aubaaai bni ka'bin wamin saalimin mawlaa aabiy hudhayfaaa wamin mu'aadhi bni jabalin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waharfun lam yadhkurhu zuhayrun qawluhu yaquwluhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Masruq reported:We were in the company of Abdullah b 'Amr that we made a mention of a hadith from Abdullah b. Mas'ud; thereupon he said: That is a person whose love ever remains (fresh in my heart) after I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Learn Qur'an from four persons: Ibn Umm 'Abd, i e. Abdullah b. Mas'ud and he started from his name-then Ubayy b. Ka'b and Mu'adh b Jabal. Zuhri did not make a mention of the words yaquluhu in his narration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِإِسْنَادِ جَرِيرٍ وَوَكِيعٍ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ، قَدَّمَ مُعَاذًا قَبْلَ أُبَىٍّ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ أُبَىٌّ قَبْلَ مُعَاذٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, biiisnaadi jariyrin wawakiy'in fiy riwaayaai aabiy bakrin 'an aabiy mu'aawiyaaa, qaddama mu'aadhana qabla aubaaain ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy kuraybin aubaaaun qabla mu'aadhin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Abu Bakr b. Abu Shaiba and Abu Kuraib, and both of them said:Abu Mu'awiya narrated to us from A'mash on the authority of Jarir and Waki', and in a narration of Abu Bakr transmitted on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya the mention of Mu'adh has preceded Ubayy's, and in the narration transmitted on the authority of Abu Kuraib, the name of Ubayy preceded Mu'ddh's
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِإِسْنَادِهِمْ وَاخْتَلَفَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، فِي تَنْسِيقِ الأَرْبَعَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathaniy bishru bnu, khaalidin aakhbaranaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, biiisnaadihim waakhtalafaa 'an shu'baaa, fiy tansiyqi alaarba'aai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This tradition has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba through A'mash, but there is a difference of order of the four
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ ذَكَرُوا ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ عِنْدَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو فَقَالَ ذَاكَ رَجُلٌ لاَ أَزَالُ أُحِبُّهُ بَعْدَ مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اسْتَقْرِئُوا الْقُرْآنَ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةٍ مِنِ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَسَالِمٍ مَوْلَى أَبِي حُذَيْفَةَ وَأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ وَمُعَاذِ بْنِ جَبَلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an masruwqin, qaala dhakaruwa abna mas'uwdin 'inda 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw faqaala dhaaka rajulun laa aazaalu auhibbuhu ba'da maa sami'tu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ astaqriiuwa alqurana min aarba'aain mini abni mas'uwdin wasaalimin mawlaa aabiy hudhayfaaa waaubaaai bni ka'bin wamu'aadhi bni jabalin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Masruq reported:They made a mention of Ibn Mas'ud before 'Abdullah b. Amr, whereupon he said: He is a person whose love is always fresh in my heart after I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Learn the recita- tion of the Qur'an from four persons: from Ibn Mas'ud, Salim, the ally of Abu Hudhaifa, Ubayy b. Ka'b, Mu'adh b. Jabal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ بَدَأَ بِهَذَيْنِ لاَ أَدْرِي بِأَيِّهِمَا بَدَأَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada qaala shu'baau badaaa bihadhayni laa aadriy biaayyihimaa badaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubaidullah b. Mu'adh reported it on the authority of his father Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters and he made this addition. He made a mention of these two names but I do not know whose name he mentioned first
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ جَمَعَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَرْبَعَةٌ كُلُّهُمْ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ مُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ وَأُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ وَأَبُو زَيْدٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ قُلْتُ لأَنَسٍ مَنْ أَبُو زَيْدٍ قَالَ أَحَدُ عُمُومَتِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu jama'a alqurana 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aarba'aaun kulluhum mina alaansaari mu'aadhu bnu jabalin waaubaaau bnu ka'bin wazaydu bnu thaabitin waaabuw zaydin ‏.‏ qaala qataadaau qultu laanasin man aabuw zaydin qaala aahadu 'umuwmatiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas is reported to have said:Four persons collected the Qur'an during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and all of them were Ansar: Mu'adh b. Jabal, Ubayy b. Ka'b, Zaid b. Thabit, Abu Zaid. Qatada said: Anas, who was Abu Zaid? He said: He was one of my uncles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو دَاوُدَ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرُو بْنُ عَاصِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ مَنْ جَمَعَ الْقُرْآنَ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ أَرْبَعَةٌ كُلُّهُمْ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ أُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ وَمُعَاذُ بْنُ جَبَلٍ وَزَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ وَرَجُلٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ يُكْنَى أَبَا زَيْدٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw daawuda, sulaymaanu bnu ma'badin haddathanaa 'amruw bnu 'aasimin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, qaala qultu laanasi bni maalikin man jama'a alqurana 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala aarba'aaun kulluhum mina alaansaari aubaaau bnu ka'bin wamu'aadhu bnu jabalin wazaydu bnu thaabitin warajulun mina alaansaari yuknaa aabaa zaydin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam said:I said to Anas b. Malik: Who collected the Qur'an during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? He said: Four (persons), all of them belonging to Ansir: Ubayy b. Ka'b, Mu'adh b. Jabal, Zaid b. Thabit and a person from the Ansar whose Kunya was Abu Zaid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لأُبَىٍّ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَقْرَأَ عَلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ آللَّهُ سَمَّانِي لَكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُ سَمَّاكَ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَعَلَ أُبَىٌّ يَبْكِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala laubaaain ‏"‏ iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla aamaraniy aan aaqraaa 'alayka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alllahu sammaaniy laka qaala ‏"‏ alllahu sammaaka liy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faja'ala aubaaaun yabkiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Ubayy:Verily Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, has commanded me to recite the Qur'an to you, whereupon he said: (Has) Allah mentioned my name to you? He said: Allah has mentioned your name to me. Thereupon he began to shed tears (of joy)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ قَتَادَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أَقْرَأَ عَلَيْكَ ‏{‏ لَمْ يَكُنِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَسَمَّانِي قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَبَكَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu qataadaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laubaaai bni ka'bin ‏"‏ iinna alllaha aamaraniy aan aaqraaa 'alayka ‏{‏ lam yakuni alladhiyna kafaruwa‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wasammaaniy qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fabakaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to Ubayy b. Ka'b:I have been commanded to recite to you the Sura (al- Bayyinah) which opens with these words (Lam Yakunil-ladhiyna Kafaruu) He said: Has he mentioned to you my name? He said: Yes; thereupon he shed tears of joy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِيهِ يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسًا، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لأُبَىٍّ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniyhi yahyaa bnu habiybin, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy abna alhaarithi - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu aanasana, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laubaaain bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَجَنَازَةُ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ ‏ "‏ اهْتَزَّ لَهَا عَرْشُ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wajanaazaau sa'di bni mu'aadhin bayna aaydiyhim ‏ "‏ ahtazza lahaa 'arshu alrrahmani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying while the bier of Sa'd b. Mu'adh was placed before them:The Throne of the most Gracious shook at the death of Sa'd b. Mu'adh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ الأَوْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي، سُفْيَانُ عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اهْتَزَّ عَرْشُ الرَّحْمَنِ لِمَوْتِ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa alaawdiyyu, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy, sufyaanu 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ahtazza 'arshu alrrahmani limawti sa'di bni mu'aadhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that the Throne of the most Compassionate shook because of the death of Sa'd b. Mu'adh
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرُّزِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ الْخَفَّافُ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَجِنَازَتُهُ مَوْضُوعَةٌ - يَعْنِي سَعْدًا - ‏ "‏ اهْتَزَّ لَهَا عَرْشُ الرَّحْمَنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alrruzziyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi bnu 'ataa'in alkhaffaafu, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala wajinaazatuhu mawduw'aaun - ya'niy sa'dana - ‏ "‏ ahtazza lahaa 'arshu alrrahmani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing:That his bier (that of Sa'd) was placed (before them) and the Throne of the most Compassionate shook
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ، يَقُولُ أُهْدِيَتْ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حُلَّةُ حَرِيرٍ فَجَعَلَ أَصْحَابُهُ يَلْمُسُونَهَا وَيَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ لِينِهَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَتَعْجَبُونَ مِنْ لِينِ هَذِهِ لَمَنَادِيلُ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْرٌ مِنْهَا وَأَلْيَنُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a, yaquwlu auhdiyat lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hullaau hariyrin faja'ala aashaabuhu yalmusuwnahaa waya'jabuwna min liynihaa faqaala ‏ "‏ aata'jabuwna min liyni hadhihi lamanaadiylu sa'di bni mu'aadhin fiy aljannaai khayrun minhaa waaalyanu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported that a garment of silk was presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). His Companions touched it and admired its softness; there- upon he said:Do you admire the softness of this (cloth)? The handkerchiefs of Sa'd b. Mu'adh in Paradise are better than this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَنْبَأَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثَوْبِ حَرِيرٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدَةَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ حَدَّثَنِي قَتَادَةُ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ هَذَا أَوْ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdaaa alddabbiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa shu'baau, aanbaaaniy aabuw iishaaqa, qaala sami'tu albaraa'a bna 'aazibin, yaquwlu autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bithawbi hariyrin ‏.‏ fadhakara alhadiytha thumma qaala abnu 'abdaaa aakhbaranaa aabuw daawuda haddathanaa shu'baau haddathaniy qataadaau 'an aanasi bni maalikin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadhaa aaw bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا كَرِوَايَةِ أَبِي دَاوُدَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni jabalaaa, haddathanaa aumayyaau bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa alhadiythi bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana kariwaayaai aabiy daawuda ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Shu'ba combining the two chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ أُهْدِيَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم جُبَّةٌ مِنْ سُنْدُسٍ وَكَانَ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ فَعَجِبَ النَّاسُ مِنْهَا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ بِيَدِهِ إِنَّ مَنَادِيلَ سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَحْسَنُ مِنْ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aannahu auhdiya lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm jubbaaun min sundusin wakaana yanhaa 'ani alhariyri fa'ajiba alnnaasu minhaa faqaala ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsu muhammadin biyadihi iinna manaadiyla sa'di bni mu'aadhin fiy aljannaai aahsanu min hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was presented a garment of sundus and he prohibited the use of silk. The persons admired it, whereupon he said:By Him in Whose Hand is the life of Muhammad, the kerchiefs of Sa'd b. Mu'adh in Paradise are better than this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ أُكَيْدِرَ، دُومَةِ الْجَنْدَلِ أَهْدَى لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ حُلَّةً فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِيهِ وَكَانَ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْحَرِيرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa saalimu bnu nuwhin, haddathanaa 'umaru bnu 'aamirin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna aukaydira, duwmaai aljandali aahdaa lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ hullaaan fadhakara nahwahu walam yadhkur fiyhi wakaana yanhaa 'ani alhariyri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported the king of Dumat al-Jandal presented to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the garment and lie made no mention (of the fact) that he prohibited the use of silk
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ثَابِتٌ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخَذَ سَيْفًا يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَأْخُذُ مِنِّي هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَبَسَطُوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ كُلُّ إِنْسَانٍ مِنْهُمْ يَقُولُ أَنَا أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَنْ يَأْخُذُهُ بِحَقِّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَحْجَمَ الْقَوْمُ فَقَالَ سِمَاكُ بْنُ خَرَشَةَ أَبُو دُجَانَةَ أَنَا آخُذُهُ بِحَقِّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَخَذَهُ فَفَلَقَ بِهِ هَامَ الْمُشْرِكِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, haddathanaa thaabitun, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhadha sayfana yawma auhudin faqaala ‏"‏ man yaakhudhu minniy hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fabasatuwa aaydiyahum kullu iinsaanin minhum yaquwlu aanaa aanaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faman yaakhudhuhu bihaqqihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faaahjama alqawmu faqaala simaaku bnu kharashaaa aabuw dujaanaaa aanaa akhudhuhu bihaqqihi ‏.‏ qaala faaakhadhahu fafalaqa bihi haama almushrikiyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) took hold of his sword on the Day of Uhud and said:Who would take it from me? All the persons stretched their hands saying: I would do it, I would do it. He (Allah's Apostle) said: Who would take it in order to fulfil its rights? Then the people withdrew their hands. Simak b. Kharasha Abu Dujana said: I am here to take it and fulfil its rights. He took it and struck the heads of the polytheists
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، قَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ أُحُدٍ جِيءَ بِأَبِي مُسَجًّى وَقَدْ مُثِلَ بِهِ - قَالَ - فَأَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَرْفَعَ الثَّوْبَ فَنَهَانِي قَوْمِي ثُمَّ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أَرْفَعَ الثَّوْبَ فَنَهَانِي قَوْمِي فَرَفَعَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَوْ أَمَرَ بِهِ فَرُفِعَ فَسَمِعَ صَوْتَ بَاكِيَةٍ أَوْ صَائِحَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالُوا بِنْتُ عَمْرٍو أَوْ أُخْتُ عَمْرٍو فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَلِمَ تَبْكِي فَمَا زَالَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ تُظِلُّهُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا حَتَّى رُفِعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, kilaahumaa 'an sufyaana, qaala 'ubaydu alllahi haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, qaala sami'tu abna almunkadiri, yaquwlu sami'tu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu lammaa kaana yawmu auhudin jiy'a biaabiy musajjana waqad muthila bihi - qaala - faaaradtu aan aarfa'a althhawba fanahaaniy qawmiy thumma aaradtu aan aarfa'a althhawba fanahaaniy qawmiy farafa'ahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaw aamara bihi farufi'a fasami'a sawta baakiyaain aaw saaiihaain faqaala ‏"‏ man hadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaaluwa bintu 'amrinw aaw aukhtu 'amrinw faqaala ‏"‏ walima tabkiy famaa zaalati almalaaiikaau tuzilluhu biaajnihatihaa hattaa rufi'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:The dead body of my father was brought and he was covered (with cloth) and it had been mutilated. I made an attempt to lift the cloth, but my people prohibited me to do so. I again made an attempt to lift the cloth, but my people prohibited me. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) lifted it or he commanded it to be lifted. He heard the noise (of a loud) weeping, or the noise of a woman mourner. He inquired who she was. They said: The daughter of 'Amr or the sister of Amr, whereupon he said: Why does she weep? The Angels provide him shade with the help of their Wings until he would be lifted (to his heavenly abode)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ أُصِيبَ أَبِي يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ فَجَعَلْتُ أَكْشِفُ الثَّوْبَ عَنْ وَجْهِهِ، وَأَبْكِي، وَجَعَلُوا يَنْهَوْنَنِي وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَنْهَانِي - قَالَ - وَجَعَلَتْ فَاطِمَةُ بِنْتُ عَمْرٍو تَبْكِيهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَبْكِيهِ أَوْ لاَ تَبْكِيهِ مَا زَالَتِ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ تُظِلُّهُ بِأَجْنِحَتِهَا حَتَّى رَفَعْتُمُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala ausiyba aabiy yawma auhudin faja'altu aakshifu althhawba 'an wajhihi, waaabkiy, waja'aluwa yanhawnaniy warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yanhaaniy - qaala - waja'alat faatimaau bintu 'amrinw tabkiyhi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tabkiyhi aaw laa tabkiyhi maa zaalati almalaaiikaau tuzilluhu biaajnihatihaa hattaa rafa'tumuwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:My father fell as a martyr on the Day of Uhud and I attempted to uncover his face and weep, but they (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) forbade me to do this, whereas Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not forbid me and Fatima bint Amr, the sister of my father, was also weeping There- upon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You may weep or you may not weep; the Angels provide him shade with the help of their wings until you lift him (to be buried in the grave)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، ‏.‏ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ ابْنَ جُرَيْجٍ، لَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ذِكْرُ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ وَبُكَاءُ الْبَاكِيَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, kilaahumaa 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabirin, ‏.‏ bihadhaa alhadiythi ghayra aanna abna jurayjin, laysa fiy hadiythihi dhikru almalaaiikaai wabukaa'u albaakiyaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters, but with this difference that there is no mention of the Angels and the weeping of a female mourner
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ عَدِيٍّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، بْنُ عَمْرٍو عَنْ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ جِيءَ بِأَبِي يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ مُجَدَّعًا فَوُضِعَ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aahmada bni aabiy khalafin, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu 'adiyyin, aakhbaranaa 'ubaydu alllahi, bnu 'amrinw 'an 'abdi alkariymi, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, 'an jaabirin, qaala jiy'a biaabiy yawma auhudin mujadda'ana fawudi'a bayna yadaai alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:My father was brought in a state that his ears had been cut off and (his dead body) was placed before Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَلِيطٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ كِنَانَةَ، بْنِ نُعَيْمٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ فِي مَغْزًى لَهُ فَأَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ لأَصْحَابِهِ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَفْقِدُونَ مِنْ أَحَدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَفْقِدُونَ مِنْ أَحَدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعَمْ فُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا وَفُلاَنًا ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَلْ تَفْقِدُونَ مِنْ أَحَدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَكِنِّي أَفْقِدُ جُلَيْبِيبًا فَاطْلُبُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَطُلِبَ فِي الْقَتْلَى فَوَجَدُوهُ إِلَى جَنْبِ سَبْعَةٍ قَدْ قَتَلَهُمْ ثُمَّ قَتَلُوهُ فَأَتَى النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَوَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ قَتَلَ سَبْعَةً ثُمَّ قَتَلُوهُ هَذَا مِنِّي وَأَنَا مِنْهُ هَذَا مِنِّي وَأَنَا مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَوَضَعَهُ عَلَى سَاعِدَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُ إِلاَّ سَاعِدَا النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَحُفِرَ لَهُ وَوُضِعَ فِي قَبْرِهِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ غَسْلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu 'umara bni saliytin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an kinaanaaa, bni nu'aymin 'an aabiy barzaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana fiy maghzana lahu faaafaa'a alllahu 'alayhi faqaala laashaabihi ‏"‏ hal tafqiduwna min aahadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'am fulaanana wafulaanana wafulaanana ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ hal tafqiduwna min aahadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'am fulaanana wafulaanana wafulaanana ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ hal tafqiduwna min aahadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ lakinniy aafqidu julaybiybana faatlubuwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fatuliba fiy alqatlaa fawajaduwhu iilaa janbi sab'aain qad qatalahum thumma qataluwhu faaataa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fawaqafa 'alayhi faqaala ‏"‏ qatala sab'aaan thumma qataluwhu hadhaa minniy waaanaa minhu hadhaa minniy waaanaa minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fawada'ahu 'alaa saa'idayhi laysa lahu iilaaa saa'idaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala fahufira lahu wawudi'a fiy qabrihi ‏.‏ walam yadhkur ghaslaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Barza reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was there in a battlefield that Allah conferred upon him the spoils of war. He said to his Companions:Is anyone missing amongst you? They said: So and so and so. He again said: Is there anyone missing amongst you? They said: So and so and so. He then said: Is there anyone missing amongst you? They said: No. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: But I am missing Julaibib. They (his Companions) searched him amongst those who had been killed and they found him by the side of seven (dead bodies) whom he had killed and he had been killed (by the oppoments). Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came there and stood (by his side) and said: He killed seven (persons). Then (his opponents) killed him. He is mine and I am his. He then placed him upon his hands and there was none else to lift but Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). Then the grave was dug for him and he was placed in the grave and no mention is made of a bath
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ الأَزْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، أَخْبَرَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ خَرَجْنَا مِنْ قَوْمِنَا غِفَارٍ وَكَانُوا يُحِلُّونَ الشَّهْرَ الْحَرَامَ فَخَرَجْتُ أَنَا وَأَخِي أُنَيْسٌ وَأُمُّنَا فَنَزَلْنَا عَلَى خَالٍ لَنَا فَأَكْرَمَنَا خَالُنَا وَأَحْسَنَ إِلَيْنَا فَحَسَدَنَا قَوْمُهُ فَقَالُوا إِنَّكَ إِذَا خَرَجْتَ عَنْ أَهْلِكَ خَالَفَ إِلَيْهِمْ أُنَيْسٌ فَجَاءَ خَالُنَا فَنَثَا عَلَيْنَا الَّذِي قِيلَ لَهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ أَمَّا مَا مَضَى مِنْ مَعْرُوفِكَ فَقَدْ كَدَّرْتَهُ وَلاَ جِمَاعَ لَكَ فِيمَا بَعْدُ ‏.‏ فَقَرَّبْنَا صِرْمَتَنَا فَاحْتَمَلْنَا عَلَيْهَا وَتَغَطَّى خَالُنَا ثَوْبَهُ فَجَعَلَ يَبْكِي فَانْطَلَقْنَا حَتَّى نَزَلْنَا بِحَضْرَةِ مَكَّةَ فَنَافَرَ أُنَيْسٌ عَنْ صِرْمَتِنَا وَعَنْ مِثْلِهَا فَأَتَيَا الْكَاهِنَ فَخَيَّرَ أُنَيْسًا فَأَتَانَا أُنَيْسٌ بِصِرْمَتِنَا وَمِثْلِهَا مَعَهَا - قَالَ - وَقَدْ صَلَّيْتُ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي قَبْلَ أَنْ أَلْقَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِثَلاَثِ سِنِينَ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ لِمَنْ قَالَ لِلَّهِ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَأَيْنَ تَوَجَّهُ قَالَ أَتَوَجَّهُ حَيْثُ يُوَجِّهُنِي رَبِّي أُصَلِّي عِشَاءً حَتَّى إِذَا كَانَ مِنْ آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ أُلْقِيتُ كَأَنِّي خِفَاءٌ حَتَّى تَعْلُوَنِي الشَّمْسُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُنَيْسٌ إِنَّ لِي حَاجَةً بِمَكَّةَ فَاكْفِنِي ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ أُنَيْسٌ حَتَّى أَتَى مَكَّةَ فَرَاثَ عَلَىَّ ثُمَّ جَاءَ فَقُلْتُ مَا صَنَعْتَ قَالَ لَقِيتُ رَجُلاً بِمَكَّةَ عَلَى دِينِكَ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَرْسَلَهُ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ فَمَا يَقُولُ النَّاسُ قَالَ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ كَاهِنٌ سَاحِرٌ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ أُنَيْسٌ أَحَدَ الشُّعَرَاءِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُنَيْسٌ لَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ قَوْلَ الْكَهَنَةِ فَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِهِمْ وَلَقَدْ وَضَعْتُ قَوْلَهُ عَلَى أَقْرَاءِ الشِّعْرِ فَمَا يَلْتَئِمُ عَلَى لِسَانِ أَحَدٍ بَعْدِي أَنَّهُ شِعْرٌ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَصَادِقٌ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ فَاكْفِنِي حَتَّى أَذْهَبَ فَأَنْظُرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَأَتَيْتُ مَكَّةَ فَتَضَعَّفْتُ رَجُلاً مِنْهُمْ فَقُلْتُ أَيْنَ هَذَا الَّذِي تَدْعُونَهُ الصَّابِئَ فَأَشَارَ إِلَىَّ فَقَالَ الصَّابِئَ ‏.‏ فَمَالَ عَلَىَّ أَهْلُ الْوَادِي بِكُلِّ مَدَرَةٍ وَعَظْمٍ حَتَّى خَرَرْتُ مَغْشِيًّا عَلَىَّ - قَالَ - فَارْتَفَعْتُ حِينَ ارْتَفَعْتُ كَأَنِّي نُصُبٌ أَحْمَرُ - قَالَ - فَأَتَيْتُ زَمْزَمَ فَغَسَلْتُ عَنِّي الدِّمَاءَ وَشَرِبْتُ مِنْ مَائِهَا وَلَقَدْ لَبِثْتُ يَا ابْنَ أَخِي ثَلاَثِينَ بَيْنَ لَيْلَةٍ وَيَوْمٍ مَا كَانَ لِي طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ مَاءُ زَمْزَمَ فَسَمِنْتُ حَتَّى تَكَسَّرَتْ عُكَنُ بَطْنِي وَمَا وَجَدْتُ عَلَى كَبِدِي سُخْفَةَ جُوعٍ - قَالَ - فَبَيْنَا أَهْلُ مَكَّةَ فِي لَيْلَةٍ قَمْرَاءَ إِضْحِيَانَ إِذْ ضُرِبَ عَلَى أَسْمِخَتِهِمْ فَمَا يَطُوفُ بِالْبَيْتِ أَحَدٌ وَامْرَأَتَيْنِ مِنْهُمْ تَدْعُوَانِ إِسَافًا وَنَائِلَةَ - قَالَ - فَأَتَتَا عَلَىَّ فِي طَوَافِهِمَا فَقُلْتُ أَنْكِحَا أَحَدَهُمَا الأُخْرَى - قَالَ - فَمَا تَنَاهَتَا عَنْ قَوْلِهِمَا - قَالَ - فَأَتَتَا عَلَىَّ فَقُلْتُ هَنٌ مِثْلُ الْخَشَبَةِ غَيْرَ أَنِّي لاَ أَكْنِي ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَتَا تُوَلْوِلاَنِ وَتَقُولاَنِ لَوْ كَانَ هَا هُنَا أَحَدٌ مِنْ أَنْفَارِنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَهُمَا هَابِطَانِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتَا الصَّابِئُ بَيْنَ الْكَعْبَةِ وَأَسْتَارِهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا قَالَ لَكُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتَا إِنَّهُ قَالَ لَنَا كَلِمَةً تَمْلأُ الْفَمَ ‏.‏ وَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى اسْتَلَمَ الْحَجَرَ وَطَافَ بِالْبَيْتِ هُوَ وَصَاحِبُهُ ثُمَّ صَلَّى فَلَمَّا قَضَى صَلاَتَهُ قَالَ أَبُو ذَرٍّ ‏.‏ فَكُنْتُ أَنَا أَوَّلُ مَنْ حَيَّاهُ بِتَحِيَّةِ الإِسْلاَمِ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ وَعَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ مِنْ غِفَارٍ - قَالَ - فَأَهْوَى بِيَدِهِ فَوَضَعَ أَصَابِعَهُ عَلَى جَبْهَتِهِ فَقُلْتُ فِي نَفْسِي كَرِهَ أَنِ انْتَمَيْتُ إِلَى غِفَارٍ ‏.‏ فَذَهَبْتُ آخُذُ بِيَدِهِ فَقَدَعَنِي صَاحِبُهُ وَكَانَ أَعْلَمَ بِهِ مِنِّي ثُمَّ رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَتَى كُنْتَ هَا هُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ قَدْ كُنْتُ هَا هُنَا مُنْذُ ثَلاَثِينَ بَيْنَ لَيْلَةٍ وَيَوْمٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَنْ كَانَ يُطْعِمُكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ مَا كَانَ لِي طَعَامٌ إِلاَّ مَاءُ زَمْزَمَ ‏.‏ فَسَمِنْتُ حَتَّى تَكَسَّرَتْ عُكَنُ بَطْنِي وَمَا أَجِدُ عَلَى كَبِدِي سُخْفَةَ جُوعٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا مُبَارَكَةٌ إِنَّهَا طَعَامُ طُعْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ائْذَنْ لِي فِي طَعَامِهِ اللَّيْلَةَ ‏.‏ فَانْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَانْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُمَا فَفَتَحَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ بَابًا فَجَعَلَ يَقْبِضُ لَنَا مِنْ زَبِيبِ الطَّائِفِ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ أَوَّلَ طَعَامٍ أَكَلْتُهُ بِهَا ثُمَّ غَبَرْتُ مَا غَبَرْتُ ثُمَّ أَتَيْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ قَدْ وُجِّهَتْ لِي أَرْضٌ ذَاتُ نَخْلٍ لاَ أُرَاهَا إِلاَّ يَثْرِبَ فَهَلْ أَنْتَ مُبَلِّغٌ عَنِّي قَوْمَكَ عَسَى اللَّهُ أَنْ يَنْفَعَهُمْ بِكَ وَيَأْجُرَكَ فِيهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُ أُنَيْسًا فَقَالَ مَا صَنَعْتَ قُلْتُ صَنَعْتُ أَنِّي قَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَصَدَّقْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَا بِي رَغْبَةٌ عَنْ دِينِكَ فَإِنِّي قَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَصَدَّقْتُ ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْنَا أُمَّنَا فَقَالَتْ مَا بِي رَغْبَةٌ عَنْ دِينِكُمَا فَإِنِّي قَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَصَدَّقْتُ ‏.‏ فَاحْتَمَلْنَا حَتَّى أَتَيْنَا قَوْمَنَا غِفَارًا فَأَسْلَمَ نِصْفُهُمْ وَكَانَ يَؤُمُّهُمْ إِيمَاءُ بْنُ رَحَضَةَ الْغِفَارِيُّ وَكَانَ سَيِّدَهُمْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ نِصْفُهُمْ إِذَا قَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ أَسْلَمْنَا ‏.‏ فَقَدِمَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْمَدِينَةَ فَأَسْلَمَ نِصْفُهُمُ الْبَاقِي وَجَاءَتْ أَسْلَمُ فَقَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَتُنَا نُسْلِمُ عَلَى الَّذِي أَسْلَمُوا عَلَيْهِ ‏.‏ فَأَسْلَمُوا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ غِفَارُ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهَا وَأَسْلَمُ سَالَمَهَا اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin alaazdiyyu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, aakhbaranaa humaydu bnu hilaalin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaamiti, qaala qaala aabuw dharrin kharajnaa min qawminaa ghifaarin wakaanuwa yuhilluwna alshhahra alharaama fakharajtu aanaa waaakhiy aunaysun waaummunaa fanazalnaa 'alaa khaalin lanaa faaakramanaa khaalunaa waaahsana iilaynaa fahasadanaa qawmuhu faqaaluwa iinnaka iidhaa kharajta 'an aahlika khaalafa iilayhim aunaysun fajaa'a khaalunaa fanathaa 'alaynaa alladhiy qiyla lahu faqultu lahu aammaa maa madaa min ma'ruwfika faqad kaddartahu walaa jimaa'a laka fiymaa ba'du ‏.‏ faqarrabnaa sirmatanaa faahtamalnaa 'alayhaa wataghattaa khaalunaa thawbahu faja'ala yabkiy faantalaqnaa hattaa nazalnaa bihadraai makkaaa fanaafara aunaysun 'an sirmatinaa wa'an mithlihaa faaatayaa alkaahina fakhayyara aunaysana faaataanaa aunaysun bisirmatinaa wamithlihaa ma'ahaa - qaala - waqad sallaytu yaa abna aakhiy qabla aan aalqaa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bithalaathi siniyna ‏.‏ qultu liman qaala lillahi ‏.‏ qultu faaayna tawajjahu qaala aatawajjahu haythu yuwajjihuniy rabbiy ausalliy 'ishaa'an hattaa iidhaa kaana min akhiri alllayli aulqiytu kaaanniy khifaa'un hattaa ta'luwaniy alshhamsu ‏.‏ faqaala aunaysun iinna liy haajaaan bimakkaaa faakfiniy ‏.‏ faantalaqa aunaysun hattaa aataa makkaaa faraatha 'alaaaa thumma jaa'a faqultu maa sana'ta qaala laqiytu rajulaan bimakkaaa 'alaa diynika yaz'umu aanna alllaha aarsalahu ‏.‏ qultu famaa yaquwlu alnnaasu qaala yaquwluwna shaa'irun kaahinun saahirun ‏.‏ wakaana aunaysun aahada alshhu'araa'i ‏.‏ qaala aunaysun laqad sami'tu qawla alkahanaai famaa huwa biqawlihim walaqad wada'tu qawlahu 'alaa aaqraa'i alshhi'ri famaa yaltaiimu 'alaa lisaani aahadin ba'diy aannahu shi'run waalllahi iinnahu lasaadiqun waiinnahum lakaadhibuwna ‏.‏ qaala qultu faakfiniy hattaa aadhhaba faaanzura ‏.‏ qaala faaataytu makkaaa fatada''aftu rajulaan minhum faqultu aayna hadhaa alladhiy tad'uwnahu alssaabiia faaashaara iilaaaa faqaala alssaabiia ‏.‏ famaala 'alaaaa aahlu alwaadiy bikulli madaraain wa'azmin hattaa kharartu maghshiyyana 'alaaaa - qaala - faartafa'tu hiyna artafa'tu kaaanniy nusubun aahmaru - qaala - faaataytu zamzama faghasaltu 'anniy alddimaa'a washaribtu min maaiihaa walaqad labithtu yaa abna aakhiy thalaathiyna bayna laylaain wayawmin maa kaana liy ta'aamun iilaaa maa'u zamzama fasamintu hattaa takassarat 'ukanu batniy wamaa wajadtu 'alaa kabidiy sukhfaaa juw'in - qaala - fabaynaa aahlu makkaaa fiy laylaain qamraa'a iidhiyaana iidh duriba 'alaa aasmikhatihim famaa yatuwfu bialbayti aahadun waamraaatayni minhum tad'uwaani iisaafana wanaaiilaaa - qaala - faaatataa 'alaaaa fiy tawaafihimaa faqultu aankihaa aahadahumaa alaukhraa - qaala - famaa tanaahataa 'an qawlihimaa - qaala - faaatataa 'alaaaa faqultu hanun mithlu alkhashabaai ghayra aanniy laa aakniy ‏.‏ faantalaqataa tuwalwilaani wataquwlaani law kaana haa hunaa aahadun min aanfaarinaa ‏.‏ qaala faastaqbalahumaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin wahumaa haabitaani qaala ‏"‏ maa lakumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalataa alssaabiiu bayna alka'baai waaastaarihaa qaala ‏"‏ maa qaala lakumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalataa iinnahu qaala lanaa kalimaaan tamlau alfama ‏.‏ wajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa astalama alhajara wataafa bialbayti huwa wasaahibuhu thumma sallaa falammaa qadaa salaatahu qaala aabuw dharrin ‏.‏ fakuntu aanaa aawwalu man hayyaahu bitahiyyaai aliislaami - qaala - faqultu alssalaamu 'alayka yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ wa'alayka warahmaau alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ man aanta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu min ghifaarin - qaala - faaahwaa biyadihi fawada'a aasaabi'ahu 'alaa jabhatihi faqultu fiy nafsiy kariha aani antamaytu iilaa ghifaarin ‏.‏ fadhahabtu akhudhu biyadihi faqada'aniy saahibuhu wakaana aa'lama bihi minniy thumma rafa'a raasahu thumma qaala ‏"‏ mataa kunta haa hunaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu qad kuntu haa hunaa mundhu thalaathiyna bayna laylaain wayawmin qaala ‏"‏ faman kaana yut'imuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu maa kaana liy ta'aamun iilaaa maa'u zamzama ‏.‏ fasamintu hattaa takassarat 'ukanu batniy wamaa aajidu 'alaa kabidiy sukhfaaa juw'in qaala ‏"‏ iinnahaa mubaarakaaun iinnahaa ta'aamu tu'min ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala aabuw bakrin yaa rasuwla alllahi aidhan liy fiy ta'aamihi alllaylaaa ‏.‏ faantalaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin waantalaqtu ma'ahumaa fafataha aabuw bakrin baabana faja'ala yaqbidu lanaa min zabiybi alttaaiifi wakaana dhalika aawwala ta'aamin aakaltuhu bihaa thumma ghabartu maa ghabartu thumma aataytu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ iinnahu qad wujjihat liy aardun dhaatu nakhlin laa auraahaa iilaaa yathriba fahal aanta muballighun 'anniy qawmaka 'asaa alllahu aan yanfa'ahum bika wayaajuraka fiyhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaataytu aunaysana faqaala maa sana'ta qultu sana'tu aanniy qad aaslamtu wasaddaqtu ‏.‏ qaala maa biy raghbaaun 'an diynika faiinniy qad aaslamtu wasaddaqtu ‏.‏ faaataynaa aummanaa faqaalat maa biy raghbaaun 'an diynikumaa faiinniy qad aaslamtu wasaddaqtu ‏.‏ faahtamalnaa hattaa aataynaa qawmanaa ghifaarana faaaslama nisfuhum wakaana yauummuhum iiymaa'u bnu rahadaaa alghifaariyyu wakaana sayyidahum ‏.‏ waqaala nisfuhum iidhaa qadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa aaslamnaa ‏.‏ faqadima rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm almadiynaaa faaaslama nisfuhumu albaaqiy wajaa'at aaslamu faqaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi iikhwatunaa nuslimu 'alaa alladhiy aaslamuwa 'alayhi ‏.‏ faaaslamuwa faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ghifaaru ghafara alllahu lahaa waaaslamu saalamahaa alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Samit reported that Abu Dharr said:We set out from our tribe Ghafir who look upon the prohibited months as permissible months. I and my brother Unais and our mother stayed with our maternal uncle who treated us well. The men of his tribe fell jealous and they said: When you are anay from your house, Unais commits adultery with your wife. Our -naternal uncle came and he accused us of the sin which was conveyed to him. I said: You have undone the good you did to us. We cannot stay with you after this. We came to our camels and loaded (our) luggage. Our maternal uncle began to weep covering himself with (a piece of) cloth. We proceeded on until we encamped by the side of Mecca. Unais cast lot on the camels (we had) and an equal number (above that). They both went to a Kahin and he made Unais win and Unais came with our camels and an equal number along with them. He (Abu Dharr) said: My nephew, I used to observe prayer three years before my meeting with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). I said: For whom did you say prayer? He said: For Allah. I said: To which direction did you turn your face (for observing prayer)? He said: I used to turn my face as Allah has directed me to turn my face. I used to observe the night prayer at the time of the end of night and I fell down in prostration like the mantle until the sun rose over me. Unais said: I have a work in Mecca, so you better stay here. Unais went until he came to Mecca and he came to me late. I said: What did you do? He said: I met a person in Mecca who is on your religion and he claims that verily it is Allah Who has sent him. I said: What do the people say about him? He said: They say that he is a poet or a Kahin or a magician. Unais who was himself one of the poets said. I have heard the words of a Kahin but his words in no way resemble his (words). And 1 also compared his words to the verses of poets but such words cannot be uttered by any poet. By Allah, he is truthful and they are liars. Then I said: you stay here, until I go, so that I should see him. He said: I came to Mecca and I selected an insignificant person from amongst them and said to him: Where is he whom you call as-Sabi? He pointed out towards me saying: He is Sabi. Thereupon the people of the valley attacked me with sods and bows until I fell down unconscious. I stood up after havin. regained my consciousness and I found as if I was a red idol. I came to Zamzarn and washed blood from me and drank water from it and listen, O son of my brother, I stayed there for thirty nights or days and there was no food for me but the water of Zamzarn. And I became so bulky that there appeared wrinkles upon my stomach, and I did not feel any hunger in my stomach. It was during this time that the people of Mecca slept in the moonlit night and none was there to eircumambulate the House but only two women who had been invoking the name of Isafa, and Na'ila (the two idols). They came to me while in their circuit and I said: Marry one with the other, but they did not dissuade from their invoking.
