verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَشُجَاعُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجُعْفِيُّ - عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ السُّدِّيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْبَهِيِّ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَىُّ النَّاسِ خَيْرٌ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْقَرْنُ الَّذِي أَنَا فِيهِ ثُمَّ الثَّانِي ثُمَّ الثَّالِثُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, washujaa'u bnu makhladin, - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa husaynun, - wahuwa abnu 'aliyyin alju'fiyyu - 'an zaaiidaaa, 'ani alssuddiyyi, 'an 'abdi alllahi albahiyyi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat saaala rajulun alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aaaau alnnaasi khayrun qaala ‏ "‏ alqarnu alladhiy aanaa fiyhi thumma althhaaniy thumma althhaalithu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that a person asked Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as to who amongst the people were the best. He said:Of the generation to which I belong, then of the second generation (generation adjacent to my generation), then of the third generation (generation adjacent to the second generation)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ عَبْدٌ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ صَلاَةَ الْعِشَاءِ فِي آخِرِ حَيَاتِهِ فَلَمَّا سَلَّمَ قَامَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَرَأَيْتَكُمْ لَيْلَتَكُمْ هَذِهِ فَإِنَّ عَلَى رَأْسِ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ مِنْهَا لاَ يَبْقَى مِمَّنْ هُوَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ أَحَدٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَوَهَلَ النَّاسُ فِي مَقَالَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تِلْكَ فِيمَا يَتَحَدَّثُونَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الأَحَادِيثِ عَنْ مِائَةِ سَنَةٍ وَإِنَّمَا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَبْقَى مِمَّنْ هُوَ الْيَوْمَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏ أَحَدٌ يُرِيدُ بِذَلِكَ أَنْ يَنْخَرِمَ ذَلِكَ الْقَرْنُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala muhammadu bnu raafi'in haddathanaa waqaala 'abdun, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, waaabuw bakri bnu sulaymaana aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata laylaain salaaaa al'ishaa'i fiy akhiri hayaatihi falammaa sallama qaama faqaala ‏ "‏ aaraaaytakum laylatakum hadhihi faiinna 'alaa raasi miaiaai sanaain minhaa laa yabqaa mimman huwa 'alaa zahri alaardi aahadun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara fawahala alnnaasu fiy maqaalaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm tilka fiymaa yatahaddathuwna min hadhihi alaahaadiythi 'an miaiaai sanaain waiinnamaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laa yabqaa mimman huwa alyawma 'alaa zahri alaardi ‏.‏ aahadun yuriydu bidhalika aan yankharima dhalika alqarnu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us 'Isha' prayer at the latter part of the night and when he had concluded it by salutations he stood up and said:Have you seen this night of yours? At the end of one hundred years after this none would survive on the surface of the earth (from amount my Companions). Ibn Umar said: People were (not understanding) these words of the Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) which had been uttered pertaining to one hundred years. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in fact meant (by these words) that on that day none from amongst those who had been living upon the earth (from amongst his Companions) would survive (after one hundred years) and that would be the end of this generation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْيَمَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعَيْبٌ، وَرَوَاهُ، اللَّيْثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ خَالِدِ بْنِ مُسَافِرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ مَعْمَرٍ كَمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani alddaarimiyyu, aakhbaranaa aabuw alyamaani, aakhbaranaa shu'aybun, warawaahu, alllaythu 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni khaalidi bni musaafirin, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, biiisnaadi ma'marin kamithli hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted by Zuhri on the authority of Ma'mar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَمُوتَ بِشَهْرٍ ‏ "‏ تَسْأَلُونِي عَنِ السَّاعَةِ وَإِنَّمَا عِلْمُهَا عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَأُقْسِمُ بِاللَّهِ مَا عَلَى الأَرْضِ مِنْ نَفْسٍ مَنْفُوسَةٍ تَأْتِي عَلَيْهَا مِائَةُ سَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu 'abdi alllahi, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, qaalaa haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu muhammadin, qaala qaala abnu jurayjin aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu qabla aan yamuwta bishahrin ‏ "‏ tasaaluwniy 'ani alssaa'aai waiinnamaa 'ilmuhaa 'inda alllahi waauqsimu bialllahi maa 'alaa alaardi min nafsin manfuwsaain taatiy 'alayhaa miaiaau sanaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying this one month before his death: You asked me about the Last Hour whereas its knowledge is with Allah. I, however, take an oath and say that none upon the earth, the created beings (from amongst my Companions), would survive at the end of one hundred years
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ بِشَهْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bakrin, aakhbaranaa abnu jurayjin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur qabla mawtihi bishahrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Juraij with the same chain of transmitters, but there is no mention of the words:" one month before his death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ، قَالَ ابْنُ حَبِيبٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ذَلِكَ قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ بِشَهْرٍ أَوْ نَحْوِ ذَلِكَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ مَنْفُوسَةٍ الْيَوْمَ تَأْتِي عَلَيْهَا مِائَةُ سَنَةٍ وَهْىَ حَيَّةٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَعَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، صَاحِبِ السِّقَايَةِ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ ذَلِكَ وَفَسَّرَهَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ قَالَ نَقْصُ الْعُمُرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yahyaa bnu habiybin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, kilaahumaa 'ani almu'tamiri, qaala abnu habiybin haddathanaa mu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, qaala sami'tu aabiy, haddathanaa aabuw nadraaa, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala dhalika qabla mawtihi bishahrin aaw nahwi dhalika ‏ "‏ maa min nafsin manfuwsaain alyawma taatiy 'alayhaa miaiaau sanaain wahaa hayyaaun yawmaiidhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wa'an 'abdi alrrahmani, saahibi alssiqaayaai 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli dhalika wafassarahaa 'abdu alrrahmani qaala naqsu al'umuri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying one mouth before his death (or something like it):None amongst the created beings who had been living by that time (during the lifetime of Allah's Apostle).... 'Abd al-Rahman has interpreted these words of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as: The ages (of the people) would be diminished
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa sulaymaanu alttaymiyyu, bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana ‏.‏ mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi through other chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، وَاللَّفْظُ، لَهُ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَيَّانَ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ لَمَا رَجَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ تَبُوكَ سَأَلُوهُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَأْتِي مِائَةُ سَنَةٍ وَعَلَى الأَرْضِ نَفْسٌ مَنْفُوسَةٌ الْيَوْمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin, 'an daawuda, waalllafzu, lahu h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy, shaybaaa haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu hayyaana, 'an daawuda, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala lamaa raja'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm min tabuwka saaaluwhu 'ani alssaa'aai faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taatiy miaiaau sanaain wa'alaa alaardi nafsun manfuwsaaun alyawma ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that when Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came back from Tabuk they (his Companions) asked about the Last Hour. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:There would be none amongst the created beings living on the earth (who would survive this century)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الْوَلِيدِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ نَفْسٍ مَنْفُوسَةٍ تَبْلُغُ مِائَةَ سَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ سَالِمٌ تَذَاكَرْنَا ذَلِكَ عِنْدَهُ إِنَّمَا هِيَ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَخْلُوقَةٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw alwaliydi, aakhbaranaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an husaynin, 'an saalimin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa min nafsin manfuwsaain tablughu miaiaaa sanaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala saalimun tadhaakarnaa dhalika 'indahu iinnamaa hiya kullu nafsin makhluwqaain yawmaiidhin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:None amongst the created beings (from my Companions) would survive after one hundred years. Salim said: We made a mention of it to him (Jabir), whereupon he said: It means those who had been living on that day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَسُبُّوا أَصْحَابِي لاَ تَسُبُّوا أَصْحَابِي فَوَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ أَنْفَقَ مِثْلَ أُحُدٍ ذَهَبًا مَا أَدْرَكَ مُدَّ أَحَدِهِمْ وَلاَ نَصِيفَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tasubbuwa aashaabiy laa tasubbuwa aashaabiy fawaalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi law aanna aahadakum aanfaqa mithla auhudin dhahabana maa aadraka mudda aahadihim walaa nasiyfahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do not revile my Companions, do not revile my Companions. By Him in Whose Hand is my life, if one amongst you would have spent as much gold as Uhud it would not amount to as much as one much on behalf of one of them or half of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَعِيدٍ قَالَ كَانَ بَيْنَ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ وَبَيْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ شَىْءٌ فَسَبَّهُ خَالِدٌ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَسُبُّوا أَحَدًا مِنْ أَصْحَابِي فَإِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ لَوْ أَنْفَقَ مِثْلَ أُحُدٍ ذَهَبًا مَا أَدْرَكَ مُدَّ أَحَدِهِمْ وَلاَ نَصِيفَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy, sa'iydin qaala kaana bayna khaalidi bni alwaliydi wabayna 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin shaa'un fasabbahu khaalidun faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tasubbuwa aahadana min aashaabiy faiinna aahadakum law aanfaqa mithla auhudin dhahabana maa aadraka mudda aahadihim walaa nasiyfahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported there was some altercation between Khalid b. Walid and Abd al-Rahman b. 'Auf and Khalid reviled him. Thereupon Allah's Messwger (ﷺ) said:None should revile my Companions. for if one amongst you were to spend as much gold as Uhud, it would not amount to as much as one mudd of one of them or half of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِإِسْنَادِ جَرِيرٍ وَأَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمَا وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ شُعْبَةَ وَوَكِيعٍ ذِكْرُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَخَالِدِ بْنِ الْوَلِيدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, jamiy'ana 'an shu'baaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, biiisnaadi jariyrin waaabiy mu'aawiyaaa ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythihimaa walaysa fiy hadiythi shu'baaa wawakiy'in dhikru 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin wakhaalidi bni alwaliydi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of al-A'mash and there is no mention by Shu'ba and Waki' of 'Abd al-Rahman b. Auf and Khalid
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدٌ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أُسَيْرِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّ أَهْلَ الْكُوفَةِ، وَفَدُوا، إِلَى عُمَرَ وَفِيهِمْ رَجُلٌ مِمَّنْ كَانَ يَسْخَرُ بِأُوَيْسٍ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ هَلْ هَا هُنَا أَحَدٌ مِنَ الْقَرَنِيِّينَ فَجَاءَ ذَلِكَ الرَّجُلُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَدْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ رَجُلاً يَأْتِيكُمْ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ يُقَالُ لَهُ أُوَيْسٌ لاَ يَدَعُ بِالْيَمَنِ غَيْرَ أُمٍّ لَهُ قَدْ كَانَ بِهِ بَيَاضٌ فَدَعَا اللَّهَ فَأَذْهَبَهُ عَنْهُ إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ الدِّينَارِ أَوِ الدِّرْهَمِ فَمَنْ لَقِيَهُ مِنْكُمْ فَلْيَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa haashimu bnu alqaasimi, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, haddathaniy sa'iydun aljurayriyyu, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an ausayri bni jaabirin, aanna aahla alkuwfaai, wafaduwa, iilaa 'umara wafiyhim rajulun mimman kaana yaskharu biauwaysin faqaala 'umaru hal haa hunaa aahadun mina alqaraniyyiyna fajaa'a dhalika alrrajulu faqaala 'umaru iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qad qaala ‏ "‏ iinna rajulaan yaatiykum mina alyamani yuqaalu lahu auwaysun laa yada'u bialyamani ghayra aummin lahu qad kaana bihi bayaadun fada'aa alllaha faaadhhabahu 'anhu iilaaa mawdi'a alddiynaari aawi alddirhami faman laqiyahu minkum falyastaghfir lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usair b. Jabir reported that a delegation from Kufa came to 'Umar and there was a person amongst them who jeered at Uwais. Thereupon Umar said:Is there amongst us one from Qaran? That person came and Umar said: Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) has said: There would come to you a person from Yemen who would be called Uwais and he would leave none in Yemen (behind him) except his mother, and he would have the whiteness (due to leprosy) and he supplicated Allah and it was cured except for the size of a dinar or dirham. He who amongst you meets him should ask him to supplicate for forgiveness (from Allah) for you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ سَلَمَةَ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، قَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ خَيْرَ التَّابِعِينَ رَجُلٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ أُوَيْسٌ وَلَهُ وَالِدَةٌ وَكَانَ بِهِ بَيَاضٌ فَمُرُوهُ فَلْيَسْتَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa 'affaanu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa hammaadun, - wahuwa abnu salamaaa - 'an sa'iydin aljurayriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi 'an 'umara bni alkhattaabi, qaala iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna khayra alttaabi'iyna rajulun yuqaalu lahu auwaysun walahu waalidaaun wakaana bihi bayaadun famuruwhu falyastaghfir lakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. Khattab reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: Worthy amongst the successors would be a person who would be called Uwais. He would have his mother (living with him) and he would have (a small) sign of leprosy. Ask him to beg pardon for you (from Allah)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا - وَاللَّفْظُ، لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ زُرَارَةَ بْنِ أَوْفَى، عَنْ أُسَيْرِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كَانَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِذَا أَتَى عَلَيْهِ أَمْدَادُ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ سَأَلَهُمْ أَفِيكُمْ أُوَيْسُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ حَتَّى أَتَى عَلَى أُوَيْسٍ فَقَالَ أَنْتَ أُوَيْسُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ مِنْ مُرَادٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ قَرَنٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَانَ بِكَ بَرَصٌ فَبَرَأْتَ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ دِرْهَمٍ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ لَكَ وَالِدَةٌ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَأْتِي عَلَيْكُمْ أُوَيْسُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ مَعَ أَمْدَادِ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ مِنْ مُرَادٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ قَرَنٍ كَانَ بِهِ بَرَصٌ فَبَرَأَ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ دِرْهَمٍ لَهُ وَالِدَةٌ هُوَ بِهَا بَرٌّ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرَ لَكَ فَافْعَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِي ‏.‏ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُمَرُ أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ قَالَ الْكُوفَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَلاَ أَكْتُبُ لَكَ إِلَى عَامِلِهَا قَالَ أَكُونُ فِي غَبْرَاءِ النَّاسِ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنَ الْعَامِ الْمُقْبِلِ حَجَّ رَجُلٌ مِنْ أَشْرَافِهِمْ فَوَافَقَ عُمَرَ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنْ أُوَيْسٍ قَالَ تَرَكْتُهُ رَثَّ الْبَيْتِ قَلِيلَ الْمَتَاعِ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَأْتِي عَلَيْكُمْ أُوَيْسُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ مَعَ أَمْدَادِ أَهْلِ الْيَمَنِ مِنْ مُرَادٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ قَرَنٍ كَانَ بِهِ بَرَصٌ فَبَرَأَ مِنْهُ إِلاَّ مَوْضِعَ دِرْهَمٍ لَهُ وَالِدَةٌ هُوَ بِهَا بَرٌّ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ فَإِنِ اسْتَطَعْتَ أَنْ يَسْتَغْفِرَ لَكَ فَافْعَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَتَى أُوَيْسًا فَقَالَ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنْتَ أَحْدَثُ عَهْدًا بِسَفَرٍ صَالِحٍ فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِي ‏.‏ قَالَ اسْتَغْفِرْ لِي ‏.‏ قَالَ أَنْتَ أَحْدَثُ عَهْدًا بِسَفَرٍ صَالِحٍ فَاسْتَغْفِرْ لِي ‏.‏ قَالَ لَقِيتَ عُمَرَ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَاسْتَغْفَرَ لَهُ ‏.‏ فَفَطِنَ لَهُ النَّاسُ فَانْطَلَقَ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُسَيْرٌ وَكَسَوْتُهُ بُرْدَةً فَكَانَ كُلَّمَا رَآهُ إِنْسَانٌ قَالَ مِنْ أَيْنَ لأُوَيْسٍ هَذِهِ الْبُرْدَةُ
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa - waalllafzu, laibni almuthannaa - haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an zuraaraaa bni aawfaa, 'an ausayri bni jaabirin, qaala kaana 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi iidhaa aataa 'alayhi aamdaadu aahli alyamani saaalahum aafiykum auwaysu bnu 'aamirin hattaa aataa 'alaa auwaysin faqaala aanta auwaysu bnu 'aamirin qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala min muraadin thumma min qaranin qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala fakaana bika barasun fabaraata minhu iilaaa mawdi'a dirhamin qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala laka waalidaaun qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ yaatiy 'alaykum auwaysu bnu 'aamirin ma'a aamdaadi aahli alyamani min muraadin thumma min qaranin kaana bihi barasun fabaraaa minhu iilaaa mawdi'a dirhamin lahu waalidaaun huwa bihaa barrun law aaqsama 'alaa alllahi laabarrahu faiini astata'ta aan yastaghfira laka faaf'al ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faastaghfir liy ‏.‏ faastaghfara lahu ‏.‏ faqaala lahu 'umaru aayna turiydu qaala alkuwfaaa ‏.‏ qaala aalaa aaktubu laka iilaa 'aamilihaa qaala aakuwnu fiy ghabraa'i alnnaasi aahabbu iilaaaa ‏.‏ qaala falammaa kaana mina al'aami almuqbili hajja rajulun min aashraafihim fawaafaqa 'umara fasaaalahu 'an auwaysin qaala taraktuhu rathha albayti qaliyla almataa'i ‏.‏ qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ yaatiy 'alaykum auwaysu bnu 'aamirin ma'a aamdaadi aahli alyamani min muraadin thumma min qaranin kaana bihi barasun fabaraaa minhu iilaaa mawdi'a dirhamin lahu waalidaaun huwa bihaa barrun law aaqsama 'alaa alllahi laabarrahu faiini astata'ta aan yastaghfira laka faaf'al ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaataa auwaysana faqaala astaghfir liy ‏.‏ qaala aanta aahdathu 'ahdana bisafarin saalihin faastaghfir liy ‏.‏ qaala astaghfir liy ‏.‏ qaala aanta aahdathu 'ahdana bisafarin saalihin faastaghfir liy ‏.‏ qaala laqiyta 'umara qaala na'am ‏.‏ faastaghfara lahu ‏.‏ fafatina lahu alnnaasu faantalaqa 'alaa wajhihi ‏.‏ qaala ausayrun wakasawtuhu burdaaan fakaana kullamaa raahu iinsaanun qaala min aayna lauwaysin hadhihi alburdaau
verses.translation: Usair b. Jabir reported that when people from Yemen came to help (the Muslim army at the time of jihad) he asked them:Is there amongst you Uwais b. 'Amir? (He continued finding him out) until he met Uwais. He said: Are you Uwais b., Amir? He said: Yes. He said: Are you from the tribe of Qaran? He said: Yes. He (Hadrat) 'Umar (again) said: Did you suffer from leprosy and then you were cured from it but for the space of a dirham? He said: Yes. He ('Umar) said: Is your mother (living)? He said: Yes. He ('Umar) said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say: There would come to you Uwais b. Amir with the reinforcement from the people of Yemen. (He would be) from Qaran, (the branch) of Murid. He had been suffering from leprosy from which he was cured but for a spot of a dirham. His treatment with his mother would have been excellent. If he were to take an oath in the name of Allah, He would honour that. And if it is possible for you, then do ask him to beg forgiveness for you (from your Lord). So he (Uwais) begged forgiveness for him. Umar said: Where do you intend to go? He said: To Kufa. He ('Umar) said: Let me write a letter for you to its governor, whereupon he (Uwais) said: I love to live amongst the poor people. When it was the next year, a person from among the elite (of Kufa) performed Hajj and he met Umar. He asked him about Uwais. He said: I left him in a state with meagre means of sustenance. (Thereupon) Umar said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would come to you Uwais b. 'Amir, of Qaran, a branch (of the tribe) of Murid, along with the reinforcement of the people of Yemen. He had been suffering from leprosy which would have been cured but for the space of a dirham. His treatment with his mother would have been very kind. If he would take an oath in the name of Allah (for something) He would honour it. Ask him to beg forgiveness for you (from Allah) in case it is possible for you. So he came to Uwais and said.: Beg forgiveness (from Allah) for me. He (Uwais) said: You have just come from a sacred journey (Hajj) ; you, therefore, ask forgiveness for me. He (the person who had performed Hajj) said: Ask forgiveness for me (from Allah). He (Uwais again) said: You have just come from the sacred journey, so you ask forgiveness for me. (Uwais further) said: Did you meet Umar? He said: Yes. He (Uwais) then begged forgiveness for him (from Allah). So the people came to know about (the status of religious piety) of Uwais. He went away (from that place). Usair said: His clothing consisted of a mantle, and whosoever saw him said: From where did Uwais get this mantle?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ، سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عِمْرَانَ التُّجِيبِيُّ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنِ شُمَاسَةَ الْمَهْرِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا ذَرٍّ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّكُمْ سَتَفْتَحُونَ أَرْضًا يُذْكَرُ فِيهَا الْقِيرَاطُ فَاسْتَوْصُوا بِأَهْلِهَا خَيْرًا فَإِنَّ لَهُمْ ذِمَّةً وَرَحِمًا فَإِذَا رَأَيْتُمْ رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلاَنِ فِي مَوْضِعِ لَبِنَةٍ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَرَّ بِرَبِيعَةَ وَعَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ ابْنَىْ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ حَسَنَةَ يَتَنَازَعَانِ فِي مَوْضِعِ لَبِنَةٍ فَخَرَجَ مِنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy harmalaau, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu, sa'iydin alaayliyyu haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy harmalaau, - wahuwa abnu 'imraana alttujiybiyyu - 'an 'abdi alrrahmani, bni shumaasaaa almahriyyi qaala sami'tu aabaa dharrin, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinnakum sataftahuwna aardana yudhkaru fiyhaa alqiyraatu faastawsuwa biaahlihaa khayrana faiinna lahum dhimmaaan warahimana faiidhaa raaaytum rajulayni yaqtatilaani fiy mawdi'i labinaain faakhruj minhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala famarra birabiy'aaa wa'abdi alrrahmani abnaa shurahbiyla bni hasanaaa yatanaaza'aani fiy mawdi'i labinaain fakharaja minhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:You would soon conquer a land where people are in the habit of using foul language. They have a right of kinship upon you. And when you see two persons fighting for the space of a brick, then get out of that. He (Abu Dharr) then happened to pass by Rabila and 'Abd al-Rahman, the two sons of Shurahbil b. Hasana, and they had been disputing for the space of a brick. So he left the land
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، سَمِعْتُ حَرْمَلَةَ الْمِصْرِيَّ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ شُمَاسَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَصْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي، ذَرٍّ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ سَتَفْتَحُونَ مِصْرَ وَهِيَ أَرْضٌ يُسَمَّى فِيهَا الْقِيرَاطُ فَإِذَا فَتَحْتُمُوهَا فَأَحْسِنُوا إِلَى أَهْلِهَا فَإِنَّ لَهُمْ ذِمَّةً وَرَحِمًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذِمَّةً وَصِهْرًا فَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ رَجُلَيْنِ يَخْتَصِمَانِ فِيهَا فِي مَوْضِعِ لَبِنَةٍ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَأَيْتُ عَبْدَ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنَ شُرَحْبِيلَ بْنِ حَسَنَةَ وَأَخَاهُ رَبِيعَةَ يَخْتَصِمَانِ فِي مَوْضِعِ لَبِنَةٍ فَخَرَجْتُ مِنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaalaa haddathanaa wahbu bnu jariyrin, haddathanaa aabiy, sami'tu harmalaaa almisriyya, yuhaddithu 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni shumaasaaa, 'an aabiy basraaa, 'an aabiy, dharrin qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnakum sataftahuwna misra wahiya aardun yusammaa fiyhaa alqiyraatu faiidhaa fatahtumuwhaa faaahsinuwa iilaa aahlihaa faiinna lahum dhimmaaan warahimana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw qaala ‏"‏ dhimmaaan wasihrana faiidhaa raaayta rajulayni yakhtasimaani fiyhaa fiy mawdi'i labinaain faakhruj minhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faraaaytu 'abda alrrahmani bna shurahbiyla bni hasanaaa waaakhaahu rabiy'aaa yakhtasimaani fiy mawdi'i labinaain fakharajtu minhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:You would soon conquer Egypt and that is a land which is known (as the land of al-qirat). So when you conquer it, treat its inhabitants well. For there lies upon you the responsibility because of blood-tie or relationship of marriage (with them). And when you see two persons falling into dispute amongst themselves for the space of a brick, than get out of that. He (Abu Dharr) said: I saw Abd al-Rahman b. Shurahbil b. Hasana and his brother Rabi'a disputing with one another for the space of a brick. So I left that (land)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ مَيْمُونٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْوَازِعِ، جَابِرِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو الرَّاسِبِيِّ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا بَرْزَةَ، يَقُولُ بَعَثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً إِلَى حَىٍّ مِنْ أَحْيَاءِ الْعَرَبِ فَسَبُّوهُ وَضَرَبُوهُ فَجَاءَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَخْبَرَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ أَنَّ أَهْلَ عُمَانَ أَتَيْتَ مَا سَبُّوكَ وَلاَ ضَرَبُوكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa mahdiyyu bnu maymuwnin, 'an aabiy alwaazi'i, jaabiri bni 'amrinw alrraasibiyyi sami'tu aabaa barzaaa, yaquwlu ba'atha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan iilaa haaain min aahyaa'i al'arabi fasabbuwhu wadarabuwhu fajaa'a iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faaakhbarahu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law aanna aahla 'umaana aatayta maa sabbuwka walaa darabuwka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Barza reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) sent a person to a tribe amongst the tribes of Arabia. They reviled him and beat him. He came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and narrated to him (the story of atrocities perpetrated upon him by the people of the tribe). Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said:If you were to come to the people of 'Uman, they would have neither reviled you nor beaten you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْحَاقَ الْحَضْرَمِيَّ - أَخْبَرَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ شَيْبَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَوْفَلٍ، رَأَيْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ عَلَى عَقَبَةِ الْمَدِينَةِ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلَتْ قُرَيْشٌ تَمُرُّ عَلَيْهِ وَالنَّاسُ حَتَّى مَرَّ عَلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ فَوَقَفَ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَبَا خُبَيْبٍ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَبَا خُبَيْبٍ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ أَبَا خُبَيْبٍ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَنْهَاكَ عَنْ هَذَا أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَنْهَاكَ عَنْ هَذَا أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ كُنْتُ أَنْهَاكَ عَنْ هَذَا أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتَ مَا عَلِمْتُ صَوَّامًا قَوَّامًا وَصُولاً لِلرَّحِمِ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ لأُمَّةٌ أَنْتَ أَشَرُّهَا لأُمَّةٌ خَيْرٌ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ نَفَذَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ فَبَلَغَ الْحَجَّاجَ مَوْقِفُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ وَقَوْلُهُ فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ فَأُنْزِلَ عَنْ جِذْعِهِ فَأُلْقِيَ فِي قُبُورِ الْيَهُودِ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَى أُمِّهِ أَسْمَاءَ بِنْتِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَأَبَتْ أَنْ تَأْتِيَهُ فَأَعَادَ عَلَيْهَا الرَّسُولَ لَتَأْتِيَنِّي أَوْ لأَبْعَثَنَّ إِلَيْكِ مِنْ يَسْحَبُكِ بِقُرُونِكِ - قَالَ - فَأَبَتْ وَقَالَتْ وَاللَّهِ لاَ آتِيكَ حَتَّى تَبْعَثَ إِلَىَّ مَنْ يَسْحَبُنِي بِقُرُونِي - قَالَ - فَقَالَ أَرُونِي سِبْتَىَّ ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَ نَعْلَيْهِ ثُمَّ انْطَلَقَ يَتَوَذَّفُ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا فَقَالَ كَيْفَ رَأَيْتِنِي صَنَعْتُ بِعَدُوِّ اللَّهِ قَالَتْ رَأَيْتُكَ أَفْسَدْتَ عَلَيْهِ دُنْيَاهُ وَأَفْسَدَ عَلَيْكَ آخِرَتَكَ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّكَ تَقُولُ لَهُ يَا ابْنَ ذَاتِ النِّطَاقَيْنِ أَنَا وَاللَّهِ ذَاتُ النِّطَاقَيْنِ أَمَّا أَحَدُهُمَا فَكُنْتُ أَرْفَعُ بِهِ طَعَامَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَطَعَامَ أَبِي بَكْرٍ مِنَ الدَّوَابِّ وَأَمَّا الآخَرُ فَنِطَاقُ الْمَرْأَةِ الَّتِي لاَ تَسْتَغْنِي عَنْهُ أَمَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَنَا ‏ "‏ أَنَّ فِي ثَقِيفٍ كَذَّابًا وَمُبِيرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَمَّا الْكَذَّابُ فَرَأَيْنَاهُ وَأَمَّا الْمُبِيرُ فَلاَ إِخَالُكَ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ - قَالَ - فَقَامَ عَنْهَا وَلَمْ يُرَاجِعْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna iishaaqa alhadramiyya - aakhbaranaa alaaswadu bnu shaybaana, 'an aabiy nawfalin, raaaytu 'abda alllahi bna alzzubayri 'alaa 'aqabaai almadiynaai - qaala - faja'alat qurayshun tamurru 'alayhi waalnnaasu hattaa marra 'alayhi 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara fawaqafa 'alayhi faqaala alssalaamu 'alayka aabaa khubaybin alssalaamu 'alayka aabaa khubaybin alssalaamu 'alayka aabaa khubaybin aamaa waalllahi laqad kuntu aanhaaka 'an hadhaa aamaa waalllahi laqad kuntu aanhaaka 'an hadhaa aamaa waalllahi laqad kuntu aanhaaka 'an hadhaa aamaa waalllahi iin kunta maa 'alimtu sawwaamana qawwaamana wasuwlaan lilrrahimi aamaa waalllahi laummaaun aanta aasharruhaa laummaaun khayrun ‏.‏ thumma nafadha 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara fabalagha alhajjaaja mawqifu 'abdi alllahi waqawluhu faaarsala iilayhi faaunzila 'an jidh'ihi faaulqiya fiy qubuwri alyahuwdi thumma aarsala iilaa aummihi aasmaa'a binti aabiy bakrin faaabat aan taatiyahu faaa'aada 'alayhaa alrrasuwla lataatiyanniy aaw laab'athanna iilayki min yashabuki biquruwniki - qaala - faaabat waqaalat waalllahi laa atiyka hattaa tab'atha iilaaaa man yashabuniy biquruwniy - qaala - faqaala aaruwniy sibtaaaa ‏.‏ faaakhadha na'layhi thumma antalaqa yatawadhhafu hattaa dakhala 'alayhaa faqaala kayfa raaaytiniy sana'tu bi'aduwwi alllahi qaalat raaaytuka aafsadta 'alayhi dunyaahu waaafsada 'alayka akhirataka balaghaniy aannaka taquwlu lahu yaa abna dhaati alnnitaaqayni aanaa waalllahi dhaatu alnnitaaqayni aammaa aahaduhumaa fakuntu aarfa'u bihi ta'aama rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wata'aama aabiy bakrin mina alddawaabbi waaammaa alakharu fanitaaqu almaraaai allatiy laa tastaghniy 'anhu aamaa iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm haddathanaa ‏ "‏ aanna fiy thaqiyfin kadhhaabana wamubiyrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faaammaa alkadhhaabu faraaaynaahu waaammaa almubiyru falaa iikhaaluka iilaaa iiyyaahu - qaala - faqaama 'anhaa walam yuraaji'haa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Naufal reported:I saw (the dead body) of Abdullah b. Zubair hanging on the road of Medina (leading to Mecca). The Quraish passed by it and other people too, that Abdullah b. Umar happened to pass by it. He stood up there and said: May there be peace upon you, Abu Khubaib (the Kunya of Hadrat 'Abdullah b. Zubair), may there be peace upon you Abu Khubaib, may there be peace upon you, Abu Khubaib! By Allah, I used to forbid you from this; by Allah, I used to forbid you from this, by Allah I used to forbid you from this. By Allah, so far as I know, you had been very much devoted to fasting and prayer and you had been paying very much care to cementing the ties of blood. By Allah, the group to which you belong (are labelled) as (a) wicked (person) is indeed a fine group. Then 'Abdullah b. 'Umar went away. The stand 'Abdullah (b. 'Umar) took in regard to the inhuman treatment (meted out to 'Abdullah b. Zubair) and his words (in that connection) were conveyed to Hajjaj (b. Yusuf) and (as a consequence of that) he (the body of Abdullah b. Zubair) was brought down from the stump (the scaffold) by which it was hanging and thrown into the graves of the Jews. He (Hajjaj) sent (his messenger) to Asma' (bint Abu Bakr, 'Abdullah's mother). But she refused to come. He again sent the messenger to her with the message that she must come, otherwise he would bring her forcibly catching hold of her hair. But she again refused and said: By Allah, I will not come to you until you send one to me who would drag me by pulling my hair. Thereupon he said: Bring me my shoes. He put on his shoes and walked on quickly swollen with vanity and pride until he came to her and said: How do you find what I have done with the enemy of Allah? She said: I find that you wronged him in this world, whereas he has spoiled your next life. It has been conveyed to me that you used to call him ('Abdullah b. Zubair) as the son of one having two belts. By Allah, I am indeed (a woman) of two belts. One is that with the help of which I used to suspend high the food of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and that of Abu Bakr (making it out of the reach) of animals and, so far as the second belt is concerned, that is the belt which no woman can dispense with. Verily Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told us that in Thaqif, there would be born a great liar and great murderer. The liar we have seen, and as far as the murderer is concerned, I do not find anyone else besides you. 'Thereupon he (Hajjaj) stood up and did not give any reply to her
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ الْجَزَرِيِّ، عَنِ يَزِيدَ بْنِ الأَصَمِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لَوْ كَانَ الدِّينُ عِنْدَ الثُّرَيَّا لَذَهَبَ بِهِ رَجُلٌ مِنْ فَارِسَ - أَوْ قَالَ مِنْ أَبْنَاءِ فَارِسَ - حَتَّى يَتَنَاوَلَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an ja'farin aljazariyyi, 'ani yaziyda bni alaasammi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ law kaana alddiynu 'inda althhurayyaa ladhahaba bihi rajulun min faarisa - aaw qaala min aabnaa'i faarisa - hattaa yatanaawalahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If the din were at the Pleiades, even then a person from Persia would have taken hold of it, or one amongst the Persian descent would have surely found it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِ سُورَةُ الْجُمُعَةِ فَلَمَّا قَرَأَ ‏{‏ وَآخَرِينَ مِنْهُمْ لَمَّا يَلْحَقُوا بِهِمْ‏}‏ قَالَ رَجُلٌ مَنْ هَؤُلاَءِ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَلَمْ يُرَاجِعْهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى سَأَلَهُ مَرَّةً أَوْ مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا - قَالَ - وَفِينَا سَلْمَانُ الْفَارِسِيُّ - قَالَ - فَوَضَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ عَلَى سَلْمَانَ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ كَانَ الإِيمَانُ عِنْدَ الثُّرَيَّا لَنَالَهُ رِجَالٌ مِنْ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - 'an thawrin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kunnaa juluwsana 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh nazalat 'alayhi suwraau aljumu'aai falammaa qaraaa ‏{‏ waakhariyna minhum lammaa yalhaquwa bihim‏}‏ qaala rajulun man hauulaa'i yaa rasuwla alllahi falam yuraaji'hu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa saaalahu marraaan aaw marratayni aaw thalaathana - qaala - wafiynaa salmaanu alfaarisiyyu - qaala - fawada'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yadahu 'alaa salmaana thumma qaala ‏"‏ law kaana aliiymaanu 'inda althhurayyaa lanaalahu rijaalun min hauulaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:We were sitting in the company of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) that Sura al-Jumu'a was revealed to him and when he recited (these words):" Others from amongst them who have not yet joined them," a person amongst them (those who were sitting there) said: Allah's Messenger! But Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) made no reply, until he questioned him once, twice or thrice. And there was amongst us Salman the Persian. The Apostle of Allah (ﷺ) placed his hand on Salman and then said: Even if faith were near the Pleiades, a man from amongst these would surely find it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 44 — The Book of the Merits of the Companions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِمُحَمَّدٍ - قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَجِدُونَ النَّاسَ كَإِبِلٍ مِائَةٍ لاَ يَجِدُ الرَّجُلُ فِيهَا رَاحِلَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - waalllafzu limuhammadin - qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala, abnu raafi'in haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tajiduwna alnnaasa kaiibilin miaiaain laa yajidu alrrajulu fiyhaa raahilaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:You would find people like one hundred camels and you would not find even one (camel) fit for riding
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جَمِيلِ بْنِ طَرِيفٍ الثَّقَفِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ مَنْ أَحَقُّ النَّاسِ بِحُسْنِ صَحَابَتِي قَالَ ‏"‏ أُمُّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أُمُّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أُمُّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ مَنْ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ أَبُوكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ قُتَيْبَةَ مَنْ أَحَقُّ بِحُسْنِ صَحَابَتِي وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ النَّاسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydi bni jamiyli bni tariyfin althhaqafiyyu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'umaaraaa bni alqa'qaa'i, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala man aahaqqu alnnaasi bihusni sahaabatiy qaala ‏"‏ aummuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma man qaala ‏"‏ thumma aummuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma man qaala ‏"‏ thumma aummuka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma man qaala ‏"‏ thumma aabuwka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi qutaybaaa man aahaqqu bihusni sahaabatiy walam yadhkuri alnnaasa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that a person came to Allah, 's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:Who among the people is most deserving of a fine treatment from my hand? He said: Your mother. He again said: Then who (is the next one)? He said: Again it is your mother (who deserves the best treatment from you). He said: Then who (is the next one)? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Again, it is your mother. He (again) said: Then who? Thereupon he said: Then it is your father. In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Qutalba, there is no mention of the word" the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، بْنِ الْقَعْقَاعِ عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ أَحَقُّ بِحُسْنِ الصُّحْبَةِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أُمُّكَ ثُمَّ أُمُّكَ ثُمَّ أُمُّكَ ثُمَّ أَبُوكَ ثُمَّ أَدْنَاكَ أَدْنَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'umaaraaa, bni alqa'qaa'i 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi man aahaqqu bihusni alssuhbaai qaala ‏ "‏ aummuka thumma aummuka thumma aummuka thumma aabuwka thumma aadnaaka aadnaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that a person said:Allah's Messenger, who amongst the people is most deserving of my good treatment? He said: Your mother, again your mother, again your mother, then your father, then your nearest relatives according to the order (of nearness)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شَرِيكٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، وَابْنِ، شُبْرُمَةَ عَنْ أَبِي، زُرْعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ وَزَادَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ وَأَبِيكَ لَتُنَبَّأَنَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa shariykun, 'an 'umaaraaa, waabni, shubrumaaa 'an aabiy, zur'aaa 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi jariyrin wazaada faqaala ‏ "‏ na'am waaabiyka latunabbaaanna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:A person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by jarir but with this addition: By your father, you would get the information
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَلْحَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ، بْنُ خِرَاشٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ شُبْرُمَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فِي حَدِيثِ وُهَيْبٍ مَنْ أَبَرُّ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ طَلْحَةَ أَىُّ النَّاسِ أَحَقُّ مِنِّي بِحُسْنِ الصُّحْبَةِ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu talhaaa, h wahaddathaniy aahmadu, bnu khiraashin haddathanaa habbaanu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, kilaahumaa 'ani abni shubrumaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi fiy hadiythi wuhaybin man aabarru wafiy hadiythi muhammadi bni talhaaa aaaau alnnaasi aahaqqu minniy bihusni alssuhbaai thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi jariyrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Shubruma with the same chain of transmitters and the hadith transmitted on the authority of Wuhaib there is a slight variation of wording. Same is the case with the hadith transmitted on the authority of Muhammad b. Talha (and the words are):" Who amongst the people deserves the best treatment from me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ حَبِيبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانَ - عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، وَشُعْبَةَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَبِيبٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَسْتَأْذِنُهُ فِي الْجِهَادِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَحَىٌّ وَالِدَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَفِيهِمَا فَجَاهِدْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'an habiybin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin alqattaana - 'an sufyaana, washu'baaa qaalaa haddathanaa habiybun, 'an aabiy al'abbaasi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yastaadhinuhu fiy aljihaadi faqaala ‏"‏ aahaaaun waalidaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fafiyhimaa fajaahid ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Amr reported that a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and sought permission (to participate) in Jihad, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said:Are your parents living? He said: Yes. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You should put in your best efforts (in their) service
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، أَنَّ نَاعِمًا، مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ قَالَ أَقْبَلَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى نَبِيِّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ أُبَايِعُكَ عَلَى الْهِجْرَةِ وَالْجِهَادِ أَبْتَغِي الأَجْرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَهَلْ مِنْ وَالِدَيْكَ أَحَدٌ حَىٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ بَلْ كِلاَهُمَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَتَبْتَغِي الأَجْرَ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَارْجِعْ إِلَى وَالِدَيْكَ فَأَحْسِنْ صُحْبَتَهُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy 'amruw bnu alhaarithi, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, aanna naa'imana, mawlaa aummi salamaaa haddathahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'amriw bni al'aasi qaala aaqbala rajulun iilaa nabiyyi alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala aubaayi'uka 'alaa alhijraai waaljihaadi aabtaghiy alaajra mina alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fahal min waalidayka aahadun haaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am bal kilaahumaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fatabtaghiy alaajra mina alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala na'am ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faarji' iilaa waalidayka faaahsin suhbatahumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yazid b. Abu Habib reported that Na'im, the freed slave of Umm Salama, reported to him that 'Abdullah b. 'Amr b. 'As said:There came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a person and said: I owe allegiance to you for migration and Jihad seeking reward only from Allah. He (the Holy Prophet) said: Is one from amongst your parents living? He said: Yes, of course, both are living. He further asked: Do you want to seek reward from Allah? He said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Go back to your parents and accord them benevolent treatment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ كَانَ جُرَيْجٌ يَتَعَبَّدُ فِي صَوْمَعَةٍ فَجَاءَتْ أُمُّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ حُمَيْدٌ فَوَصَفَ لَنَا أَبُو رَافِعٍ صِفَةَ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ لِصِفَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أُمَّهُ حِينَ دَعَتْهُ كَيْفَ جَعَلَتْ كَفَّهَا فَوْقَ حَاجِبِهَا ثُمَّ رَفَعَتْ رَأْسَهَا إِلَيْهِ تَدْعُوهُ فَقَالَتْ يَا جُرَيْجُ أَنَا أُمُّكَ كَلِّمْنِي ‏.‏ فَصَادَفَتْهُ يُصَلِّي فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أُمِّي وَصَلاَتِي ‏.‏ فَاخْتَارَ صَلاَتَهُ فَرَجَعَتْ ثُمَّ عَادَتْ فِي الثَّانِيَةِ فَقَالَتْ يَا جُرَيْجُ أَنَا أُمُّكَ فَكَلِّمْنِي ‏.‏ قَالَ اللَّهُمَّ أُمِّي وَصَلاَتِي ‏.‏ فَاخْتَارَ صَلاَتَهُ فَقَالَتِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ هَذَا جُرَيْجٌ وَهُوَ ابْنِي وَإِنِّي كَلَّمْتُهُ فَأَبَى أَنْ يُكَلِّمَنِي اللَّهُمَّ فَلاَ تُمِتْهُ حَتَّى تُرِيَهُ الْمُومِسَاتِ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَلَوْ دَعَتْ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يُفْتَنَ لَفُتِنَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَكَانَ رَاعِي ضَأْنٍ يَأْوِي إِلَى دَيْرِهِ - قَالَ - فَخَرَجَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الْقَرْيَةِ فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهَا الرَّاعِي فَحَمَلَتْ فَوَلَدَتْ غُلاَمًا فَقِيلَ لَهَا مَا هَذَا قَالَتْ مِنْ صَاحِبِ هَذَا الدَّيْرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجَاءُوا بِفُئُوسِهِمْ وَمَسَاحِيهِمْ فَنَادَوْهُ فَصَادَفُوهُ يُصَلِّي فَلَمْ يُكَلِّمْهُمْ - قَالَ - فَأَخَذُوا يَهْدِمُونَ دَيْرَهُ فَلَمَّا رَأَى ذَلِكَ نَزَلَ إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالُوا لَهُ سَلْ هَذِهِ - قَالَ - فَتَبَسَّمَ ثُمَّ مَسَحَ رَأْسَ الصَّبِيِّ فَقَالَ مَنْ أَبُوكَ قَالَ أَبِي رَاعِي الضَّأْنِ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا سَمِعُوا ذَلِكَ مِنْهُ قَالُوا نَبْنِي مَا هَدَمْنَا مِنْ دَيْرِكَ بِالذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ وَلَكِنْ أَعِيدُوهُ تُرَابًا كَمَا كَانَ ثُمَّ عَلاَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, haddathanaa humaydu bnu hilaalin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala kaana jurayjun yata'abbadu fiy sawma'aain fajaa'at aummuhu ‏.‏ qaala humaydun fawasafa lanaa aabuw raafi'in sifaaa aabiy hurayraaa lisifaai rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aummahu hiyna da'athu kayfa ja'alat kaffahaa fawqa haajibihaa thumma rafa'at raasahaa iilayhi tad'uwhu faqaalat yaa jurayju aanaa aummuka kallimniy ‏.‏ fasaadafathu yusalliy faqaala alllahumma aummiy wasalaatiy ‏.‏ faakhtaara salaatahu faraja'at thumma 'aadat fiy althhaaniyaai faqaalat yaa jurayju aanaa aummuka fakallimniy ‏.‏ qaala alllahumma aummiy wasalaatiy ‏.‏ faakhtaara salaatahu faqaalati alllahumma iinna hadhaa jurayjun wahuwa abniy waiinniy kallamtuhu faaabaa aan yukallimaniy alllahumma falaa tumithu hattaa turiyahu almuwmisaati ‏.‏ qaala walaw da'at 'alayhi aan yuftana lafutina ‏.‏ qaala wakaana raa'iy daanin yaawiy iilaa dayrihi - qaala - fakharajati amraaaaun mina alqaryaai fawaqa'a 'alayhaa alrraa'iy fahamalat fawaladat ghulaamana faqiyla lahaa maa hadhaa qaalat min saahibi hadhaa alddayri ‏.‏ qaala fajaa'uwa bifuiuwsihim wamasaahiyhim fanaadawhu fasaadafuwhu yusalliy falam yukallimhum - qaala - faaakhadhuwa yahdimuwna dayrahu falammaa raaaa dhalika nazala iilayhim faqaaluwa lahu sal hadhihi - qaala - fatabassama thumma masaha raasa alssabiyyi faqaala man aabuwka qaala aabiy raa'iy alddaani ‏.‏ falammaa sami'uwa dhalika minhu qaaluwa nabniy maa hadamnaa min dayrika bialdhhahabi waalfiddaai ‏.‏ qaala laa walakin aa'iyduwhu turaabana kamaa kaana thumma 'alaahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Juraij was one who was devoted to (prayer) in the temple. His mother came to him. Humaid said that Abu Rafi' demonstrated before us like the demonstration made by abu Huraira to whom Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had demonstrated as his mother called him placing her palms upon the eyebrows and lifting her head for calling him and said:Juraij, it is your mother, so talk to her. She found him at that time absorbed in prayer, so he said (to himself): O Lord, my mother (is calling me) (whereas I am absorbed) in my prayer. He opted for prayer. She (his mother) went back, then came again for the second time and said: O Juraij, it is your mother (calling you), so talk to me. He said: O Allah. there is my mother also and my prayer, and he opted for prayer. She said: O Allah, this Juraij is my son. I pray to talk to him but he refuses to talk to me. O Allah, don't bring death to him unless he has seen the prostitutes, and had she invoked the curse upon him (from the heart of her heart) he would have been involved in some turmoil. There was a shepherd living near by his temple (the temple where Juraij was engaged in prayer). It so happened that a woman of that village came there and that shepherd committed fornication with her and she became pregnant and gave birth to a child. It was said to her: Whose child is this? She said: He is the child of one who is living in this temple. So there came persons with hatchets and spades. They called Juraij. He was absorbed in prayer and he did not talk to them and they were about to demolish that temple that he saw them and then came to them and they said: Ask her (this woman) what she says. He smiled and then touched the head of the child and said: Who is your father? He (the child) said: My father is the shepherd of the sheep, and when they heard this, they said: We are prepared to rebuild with gold and silver what we have demolished from your temple. He said: No, rebuild it with clay as it had been before. He then went up (to his room and absorbed himself in prayer)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرُ بْنُ حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ فِي الْمَهْدِ إِلاَّ ثَلاَثَةٌ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَصَاحِبُ جُرَيْجٍ وَكَانَ جُرَيْجٌ رَجُلاً عَابِدًا فَاتَّخَذَ صَوْمَعَةً فَكَانَ فِيهَا فَأَتَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَقَالَتْ يَا جُرَيْجُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ يَا رَبِّ أُمِّي وَصَلاَتِي ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ فَانْصَرَفَتْ فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنَ الْغَدِ أَتَتْهُ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَقَالَتْ يَا جُرَيْجُ فَقَالَ يَا رَبِّ أُمِّي وَصَلاَتِي فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ فَانْصَرَفَتْ فَلَمَّا كَانَ مِنَ الْغَدِ أَتَتْهُ وَهُوَ يُصَلِّي فَقَالَتْ يَا جُرَيْجُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَىْ رَبِّ أُمِّي وَصَلاَتِي ‏.‏ فَأَقْبَلَ عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ فَقَالَتِ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تُمِتْهُ حَتَّى يَنْظُرَ إِلَى وُجُوهِ الْمُومِسَاتِ ‏.‏ فَتَذَاكَرَ بَنُو إِسْرَائِيلَ جُرَيْجًا وَعِبَادَتَهُ وَكَانَتِ امْرَأَةٌ بَغِيٌّ يُتَمَثَّلُ بِحُسْنِهَا فَقَالَتْ إِنْ شِئْتُمْ لأَفْتِنَنَّهُ لَكُمْ - قَالَ - فَتَعَرَّضَتْ لَهُ فَلَمْ يَلْتَفِتْ إِلَيْهَا فَأَتَتْ رَاعِيًا كَانَ يَأْوِي إِلَى صَوْمَعَتِهِ فَأَمْكَنَتْهُ مِنْ نَفْسِهَا فَوَقَعَ عَلَيْهَا فَحَمَلَتْ فَلَمَّا وَلَدَتْ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ جُرَيْجٍ ‏.‏ فَأَتَوْهُ فَاسْتَنْزَلُوهُ وَهَدَمُوا صَوْمَعَتَهُ وَجَعَلُوا يَضْرِبُونَهُ فَقَالَ مَا شَأْنُكُمْ قَالُوا زَنَيْتَ بِهَذِهِ الْبَغِيِّ فَوَلَدَتْ مِنْكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَيْنَ الصَّبِيُّ فَجَاءُوا بِهِ فَقَالَ دَعُونِي حَتَّى أُصَلِّيَ فَصَلَّى فَلَمَّا انْصَرَفَ أَتَى الصَّبِيَّ فَطَعَنَ فِي بَطْنِهِ وَقَالَ يَا غُلاَمُ مَنْ أَبُوكَ قَالَ فُلاَنٌ الرَّاعِي - قَالَ - فَأَقْبَلُوا عَلَى جُرَيْجٍ يُقَبِّلُونَهُ وَيَتَمَسَّحُونَ بِهِ وَقَالُوا نَبْنِي لَكَ صَوْمَعَتَكَ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ لاَ أَعِيدُوهَا مِنْ طِينٍ كَمَا كَانَتْ ‏.‏ فَفَعَلُوا ‏.‏ وَبَيْنَا صَبِيٌّ يَرْضَعُ مِنْ أُمِّهِ فَمَرَّ رَجُلٌ رَاكِبٌ عَلَى دَابَّةٍ فَارِهَةٍ وَشَارَةٍ حَسَنَةٍ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّهُ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ ابْنِي مِثْلَ هَذَا ‏.‏ فَتَرَكَ الثَّدْىَ وَأَقْبَلَ إِلَيْهِ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْنِي مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَى ثَدْيِهِ فَجَعَلَ يَرْتَضِعُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَحْكِي ارْتِضَاعَهُ بِإِصْبَعِهِ السَّبَّابَةِ فِي فَمِهِ فَجَعَلَ يَمُصُّهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ وَمَرُّوا بِجَارِيَةٍ وَهُمْ يَضْرِبُونَهَا وَيَقُولُونَ زَنَيْتِ سَرَقْتِ ‏.‏ وَهِيَ تَقُولُ حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ الْوَكِيلُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّهُ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلِ ابْنِي مِثْلَهَا ‏.‏ فَتَرَكَ الرَّضَاعَ وَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهَا فَقَالَ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِثْلَهَا ‏.‏ فَهُنَاكَ تَرَاجَعَا الْحَدِيثَ فَقَالَتْ حَلْقَى مَرَّ رَجُلٌ حَسَنُ الْهَيْئَةِ فَقُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلِ ابْنِي مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتَ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْنِي مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَمَرُّوا بِهَذِهِ الأَمَةِ وَهُمْ يَضْرِبُونَهَا وَيَقُولُونَ زَنَيْتِ سَرَقْتِ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلِ ابْنِي مِثْلَهَا ‏.‏ فَقُلْتَ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِثْلَهَا قَالَ إِنَّ ذَاكَ الرَّجُلَ كَانَ جَبَّارًا فَقُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ لاَ تَجْعَلْنِي مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏ وَإِنَّ هَذِهِ يَقُولُونَ لَهَا زَنَيْتِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ تَزْنِ وَسَرَقْتِ وَلَمْ تَسْرِقْ فَقُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِثْلَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa jariyru bnu haazimin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ lam yatakallam fiy almahdi iilaaa thalaathaaun 'iysaa abnu maryama wasaahibu jurayjin wakaana jurayjun rajulaan 'aabidana faattakhadha sawma'aaan fakaana fiyhaa faaatathu aummuhu wahuwa yusalliy faqaalat yaa jurayju ‏.‏ faqaala yaa rabbi aummiy wasalaatiy ‏.‏ faaaqbala 'alaa salaatihi faansarafat falammaa kaana mina alghadi aatathu wahuwa yusalliy faqaalat yaa jurayju faqaala yaa rabbi aummiy wasalaatiy faaaqbala 'alaa salaatihi faansarafat falammaa kaana mina alghadi aatathu wahuwa yusalliy faqaalat yaa jurayju ‏.‏ faqaala aaa rabbi aummiy wasalaatiy ‏.‏ faaaqbala 'alaa salaatihi faqaalati alllahumma laa tumithu hattaa yanzura iilaa wujuwhi almuwmisaati ‏.‏ fatadhaakara banuw iisraaiiyla jurayjana wa'ibaadatahu wakaanati amraaaaun baghiyyun yutamathhalu bihusnihaa faqaalat iin shiitum laaftinannahu lakum - qaala - fata'arradat lahu falam yaltafit iilayhaa faaatat raa'iyana kaana yaawiy iilaa sawma'atihi faaamkanathu min nafsihaa fawaqa'a 'alayhaa fahamalat falammaa waladat qaalat huwa min jurayjin ‏.‏ faaatawhu faastanzaluwhu wahadamuwa sawma'atahu waja'aluwa yadribuwnahu faqaala maa shaanukum qaaluwa zanayta bihadhihi albaghiyyi fawaladat minka ‏.‏ faqaala aayna alssabiyyu fajaa'uwa bihi faqaala da'uwniy hattaa ausalliya fasallaa falammaa ansarafa aataa alssabiyya fata'ana fiy batnihi waqaala yaa ghulaamu man aabuwka qaala fulaanun alrraa'iy - qaala - faaaqbaluwa 'alaa jurayjin yuqabbiluwnahu wayatamassahuwna bihi waqaaluwa nabniy laka sawma'ataka min dhahabin ‏.‏ qaala laa aa'iyduwhaa min tiynin kamaa kaanat ‏.‏ fafa'aluwa ‏.‏ wabaynaa sabiyyun yarda'u min aummihi famarra rajulun raakibun 'alaa daabbaain faarihaain washaaraain hasanaain faqaalat aummuhu alllahumma aj'ali abniy mithla hadhaa ‏.‏ fataraka althhadaa waaaqbala iilayhi fanazara iilayhi faqaala alllahumma laa taj'alniy mithlahu ‏.‏ thumma aaqbala 'alaa thadyihi faja'ala yartadi'u ‏.‏ qaala fakaaanniy aanzuru iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yahkiy artidaa'ahu biiisba'ihi alssabbaabaai fiy famihi faja'ala yamussuhaa ‏.‏ qaala wamarruwa bijaariyaain wahum yadribuwnahaa wayaquwluwna zanayti saraqti ‏.‏ wahiya taquwlu hasbiya alllahu wani'ma alwakiylu ‏.‏ faqaalat aummuhu alllahumma laa taj'ali abniy mithlahaa ‏.‏ fataraka alrradaa'a wanazara iilayhaa faqaala alllahumma aj'alniy mithlahaa ‏.‏ fahunaaka taraaja'aa alhadiytha faqaalat halqaa marra rajulun hasanu alhayiaai faqultu alllahumma aj'ali abniy mithlahu ‏.‏ faqulta alllahumma laa taj'alniy mithlahu ‏.‏ wamarruwa bihadhihi alaamaai wahum yadribuwnahaa wayaquwluwna zanayti saraqti ‏.‏ faqultu alllahumma laa taj'ali abniy mithlahaa ‏.‏ faqulta alllahumma aj'alniy mithlahaa qaala iinna dhaaka alrrajula kaana jabbaarana faqultu alllahumma laa taj'alniy mithlahu ‏.‏ waiinna hadhihi yaquwluwna lahaa zanayti ‏.‏ walam tazni wasaraqti walam tasriq faqultu alllahumma aj'alniy mithlahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:None spoke in the cradle but only three (persons), Christ son of Mary, the second one the companion of Juraij. Juraij had got constructed a temple and confined himself in that. His mother came to him as he was busy in prayer and she said: Juraij. He said: My Lord, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged in) my prayer. He continued with the prayer. She returned and she came on the next day and he was busy in prayer, and she said: Juraij. And he said: My Lord, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged) in prayer, and he continued with the prayer and she went back, and then on the next day she again came and he was busy in prayer and she said: Juraij. And he said: My Lord, my mother (is calling me while I am engaged in my prayer, and he continued with the prayer, and she said: My Lord, don't give him death unless he has seen the fate of the prostitutes. The story of Juraij and that of his meditation and prayer gained currency amongst Bani Isra'il. There was a prostitute who had been a beauty incarnate. She said (to the people): If you like I can allure him to evil. She presented herself to him but he paid no heed (to her). She came to a shepherd who lived near the temple and she offered herself to him and he had a sexual intercourse with her and so she became pregnant arid when she gave birth to a child she said: This is from Juraij. So they came and asked him to get down and demolished the temple and began to beat him. He said: What is the matter? They said: You have committed fornication with this prostitute and she has given birth to a child from your loins. He said: Where is the child? They brought him (the child) and he said: just leave me so that I should observe prayer. And he observed prayer and when he finished, he came to the child. He struck his stomach and said: O boy, who is your father? lie said: He is such shepherd. So they turned towards Juraij, kissed him and touched him (for seeking blessing) and said: We are prepared to construct your temple with gold. He said. No, just rebuild it with mud as it had been, and they did that. Then there was a babe who was sucking his mother that a person dressed in fine garment came riding upon a beast. His mother said: O Allah, make my child like this one. He (the babe) left sucking and began to see towards him, and said: O Allah, don't make me like him. He then returned to the chest and began to suck the milk of his mother. He (Abu Huraira) said: I perceived as if I am seeing Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he is explaining the scene of his sucking milk with his forefinger in his mouth and sucking that. He (Abu Huraira) further reported Allah's Apostle (may be peace upon him) as saying: There happened to pass by him a girl who was being beaten and they were saying: You have committed adultery and you have committed theft and she was saying: Allah is enough for me and He is my good Protector, and his mother said: O Allah, don't make my child like her and he left sucking the milk, and looked towards her and said: O Allah, make me like her, and there was a talk between them. She said: O with shaven head, a good-looking person happened to pass by and I said: O Allah, make my child like him, and you said: O Allah, don't make me like him, and they passed by a girl while they were beating her and saying: You committed fornication and you committed theft, and I said: O Allah, don't make my child like her, and you said: O Allah, make me like her. Thereupon he said: That person was a tyrant, and I said: O Allah, don't make me like him, and they were saying about her: You committed fornication whereas in fact she had not committed that and they were saying: You have committed theft whereas she had not committed theft, so I said: O Allah, make me like her
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ ثُمَّ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ ثُمَّ رَغِمَ أَنْفُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ مَنْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ أَبَوَيْهِ عِنْدَ الْكِبَرِ أَحَدَهُمَا أَوْ كِلَيْهِمَا فَلَمْ يَدْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ raghima aanfu thumma raghima aanfu thumma raghima aanfu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qiyla man yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ man aadraka aabawayhi 'inda alkibari aahadahumaa aaw kilayhimaa falam yadkhuli aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Let him be humbled into dust; let him be humbled into dust. It was said: Allah's Messenger, who is he? He said: He who sees either of his parents during their old age or he sees both of them, but he does not enter Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ ثُمَّ رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ ثُمَّ رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ مَنْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ أَدْرَكَ وَالِدَيْهِ عِنْدَ الْكِبَرِ أَحَدَهُمَا أَوْ كِلَيْهِمَا ثُمَّ لَمْ يَدْخُلِ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ raghima aanfuhu thumma raghima aanfuhu thumma raghima aanfuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qiyla man yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ man aadraka waalidayhi 'inda alkibari aahadahumaa aaw kilayhimaa thumma lam yadkhuli aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Let him be humbled, let him be humbled. It was said: Allah's Messenger, who is he? He said. He who finds his parents in old age, either one or both of them, and does not enter Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ رَغِمَ أَنْفُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, 'an sulaymaana bni bilaalin, haddathaniy suhaylun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ raghima aanfuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thalaathana thumma dhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Let him be humbled thrice, and the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْوَلِيدِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، مِنَ الأَعْرَابِ لَقِيَهُ بِطَرِيقِ مَكَّةَ فَسَلَّمَ عَلَيْهِ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَحَمَلَهُ عَلَى حِمَارٍ كَانَ يَرْكَبُهُ وَأَعْطَاهُ عِمَامَةً كَانَتْ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ فَقَالَ ابْنُ دِينَارٍ فَقُلْنَا لَهُ أَصْلَحَكَ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُمُ الأَعْرَابُ وَإِنَّهُمْ يَرْضَوْنَ بِالْيَسِيرِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ إِنَّ أَبَا هَذَا كَانَ وُدًّا لِعُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ وَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَبَرَّ الْبِرِّ صِلَةُ الْوَلَدِ أَهْلَ وُدِّ أَبِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy aayyuwba, 'ani alwaliydi bni aabiy alwaliydi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rajulaan, mina alaa'raabi laqiyahu bitariyqi makkaaa fasallama 'alayhi 'abdu alllahi wahamalahu 'alaa himaarin kaana yarkabuhu waaa'taahu 'imaamaaan kaanat 'alaa raasihi faqaala abnu diynaarin faqulnaa lahu aaslahaka alllahu iinnahumu alaa'raabu waiinnahum yardawna bialyasiyri ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi iinna aabaa hadhaa kaana wuddana li'umara bni alkhattaabi waiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna aabarra albirri silaau alwaladi aahla wuddi aabiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Dinar reported that a desert Arab met Abdullah b. 'Umar on the way to Mecca. 'Abdullah greeted him and mounted him upon the donkey on which he had been riding and gave him the turban that he had on his head. Ibn Dinar (further) reported:We said to him ('Abdullah b. 'Umar): May Allah do good to you, these are desert Arabs and they are satisfied even with meagre (things). Thereupon Abdullah said: His father was loved dearly by 'Umar b. Khattib and I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The finest act of goodness on the part of a son is to treat kindly the loved ones of his father
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ بْنُ شُرَيْحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، الْهَادِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَبَرُّ الْبِرِّ أَنْ يَصِلَ الرَّجُلُ وُدَّ أَبِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy haywaau bnu shurayhin, 'ani abni, alhaadi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ aabarru albirri aan yasila alrrajulu wudda aabiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The finest act of goodness is that a person should treat kindly the loved ones of his father
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، وَاللَّيْثُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ الْهَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ كَانَ إِذَا خَرَجَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ كَانَ لَهُ حِمَارٌ يَتَرَوَّحُ عَلَيْهِ إِذَا مَلَّ رُكُوبَ الرَّاحِلَةِ وَعِمَامَةٌ يَشُدُّ بِهَا رَأْسَهُ فَبَيْنَا هُوَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ذَلِكَ الْحِمَارِ إِذْ مَرَّ بِهِ أَعْرَابِيٌّ فَقَالَ أَلَسْتَ ابْنَ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ قَالَ بَلَى ‏.‏ فَأَعْطَاهُ الْحِمَارَ وَقَالَ ارْكَبْ هَذَا وَالْعِمَامَةَ - قَالَ - اشْدُدْ بِهَا رَأْسَكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِهِ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ أَعْطَيْتَ هَذَا الأَعْرَابِيَّ حِمَارًا كُنْتَ تَرَوَّحُ عَلَيْهِ وَعِمَامَةً كُنْتَ تَشُدُّ بِهَا رَأْسَكَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مِنْ أَبَرِّ الْبِرِّ صِلَةَ الرَّجُلِ أَهْلَ وُدِّ أَبِيهِ بَعْدَ أَنْ يُوَلِّيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِنَّ أَبَاهُ كَانَ صَدِيقًا لِعُمَرَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, waalllaythu bnu sa'din jamiy'ana 'an yaziyda bni 'abdi alllahi bni ausaamaaa bni alhaadi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu kaana iidhaa kharaja iilaa makkaaa kaana lahu himaarun yatarawwahu 'alayhi iidhaa malla rukuwba alrraahilaai wa'imaamaaun yashuddu bihaa raasahu fabaynaa huwa yawmana 'alaa dhalika alhimaari iidh marra bihi aa'raabiyyun faqaala aalasta abna fulaani bni fulaanin qaala balaa ‏.‏ faaa'taahu alhimaara waqaala arkab hadhaa waal'imaamaaa - qaala - ashdud bihaa raasaka ‏.‏ faqaala lahu ba'du aashaabihi ghafara alllahu laka aa'tayta hadhaa alaa'raabiyya himaarana kunta tarawwahu 'alayhi wa'imaamaaan kunta tashuddu bihaa raasaka ‏.‏ faqaala iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna min aabarri albirri silaaa alrrajuli aahla wuddi aabiyhi ba'da aan yuwalliya ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waiinna aabaahu kaana sadiyqana li'umara ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Dinar reported that when 'Abdullah b. 'Umar set out to Mecea, 'he kept a donkey with him which he used as a diversion from the tedium of journey on the camel's back and had a turban which he tied round his head. One day, as he was riding the donkey a desert Arab happened to pass by him. He ('Abdullah b. 'Umar) said:Arn't you so and so? He said: Yes He gave him his donkey and said: Ride it, and tie the turban round your head. Some of his companions said: May Allah pardon you, you gave to this desert Arab the donkey on which you enjoyed ride for diversion and the turban which you tied round your. head. Thereupon he said: Verily I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The finest act of goodness is the kind treatment of a person to the loved ones of his father after his death and the father of this person was a friend of 'Umar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْبِرِّ وَالإِثْمِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ الْبِرُّ حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ وَالإِثْمُ مَا حَاكَ فِي صَدْرِكَ وَكَرِهْتَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِ النَّاسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
