verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimi bni maymuwnin, haddathanaa abnu mahdiyyin, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni saalihin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayri bni nufayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnawwaasi bni sam'aana alaansaariyyi, qaala saaaltu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani albirri waaliithmi faqaala ‏ "‏ albirru husnu alkhuluqi waaliithmu maa haaka fiy sadrika wakarihta aan yattali'a 'alayhi alnnaasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nawwas b. Sam'an al-Ansari reported:I asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about virtue and vice. He said: Virtue is a kind disposition and vice is what rankles in your heart and that you disapprove that people should come to know of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ صَالِحٍ - عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ نَوَّاسِ بْنِ سِمْعَانَ، قَالَ أَقَمْتُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِالْمَدِينَةِ سَنَةً مَا يَمْنَعُنِي مِنَ الْهِجْرَةِ إِلاَّ الْمَسْأَلَةُ كَانَ أَحَدُنَا إِذَا هَاجَرَ لَمْ يَسْأَلْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ شَىْءٍ - قَالَ - فَسَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الْبِرِّ وَالإِثْمِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْبِرُّ حُسْنُ الْخُلُقِ وَالإِثْمُ مَا حَاكَ فِي نَفْسِكَ وَكَرِهْتَ أَنْ يَطَّلِعَ عَلَيْهِ النَّاسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy mu'aawiyaau, - ya'niy abna saalihin - 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayri bni nufayrin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an nawwaasi bni sim'aana, qaala aaqamtu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bialmadiynaai sanaaan maa yamna'uniy mina alhijraai iilaaa almasaalaau kaana aahadunaa iidhaa haajara lam yasaal rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an shaa'in - qaala - fasaaaltuhu 'ani albirri waaliithmi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ albirru husnu alkhuluqi waaliithmu maa haaka fiy nafsika wakarihta aan yattali'a 'alayhi alnnaasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nawwas b. Sam'an reported:I stayed with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) for one year. What obstructed me to migrate was (nothing) but (persistent) inquiries from him (about Islam). (It was a common observation) that when anyone of us migrated (to Medina) he ceased to ask (too many questions) from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). So I asked him about virtue and vice. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Virtue is a kind disposition and vice is what rankles in your mind and that you disapprove of its being known to the people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جَمِيلِ بْنِ طَرِيفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ مَوْلَى بَنِي هَاشِمٍ - حَدَّثَنِي عَمِّي أَبُو الْحُبَابِ، سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الْخَلْقَ حَتَّى إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْهُمْ قَامَتِ الرَّحِمُ فَقَالَتْ هَذَا مَقَامُ الْعَائِذِ مِنَ الْقَطِيعَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَعَمْ أَمَا تَرْضَيْنَ أَنْ أَصِلَ مَنْ وَصَلَكِ وَأَقْطَعَ مَنْ قَطَعَكِ قَالَتْ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَاكَ لَكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اقْرَءُوا إِنْ شِئْتُمْ ‏{‏ فَهَلْ عَسَيْتُمْ إِنْ تَوَلَّيْتُمْ أَنْ تُفْسِدُوا فِي الأَرْضِ وَتُقَطِّعُوا أَرْحَامَكُمْ * أُولَئِكَ الَّذِينَ لَعَنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فَأَصَمَّهُمْ وَأَعْمَى أَبْصَارَهُمْ * أَفَلاَ يَتَدَبَّرُونَ الْقُرْآنَ أَمْ عَلَى قُلُوبٍ أَقْفَالُهَا‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydi bni jamiyli bni tariyfi bni 'abdi alllahi althhaqafiyyu, wamuhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, qaalaa haddathanaa haatimun, - wahuwa abnu iismaa'iyla - 'an mu'aawiyaaa, - wahuwa abnu aabiy muzarridin mawlaa baniy haashimin - haddathaniy 'ammiy aabuw alhubaabi, sa'iydu bnu yasaarin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna alllaha khalaqa alkhalqa hattaa iidhaa faragha minhum qaamati alrrahimu faqaalat hadhaa maqaamu al'aaiidhi mina alqatiy'aai ‏.‏ qaala na'am aamaa tardayna aan aasila man wasalaki waaaqta'a man qata'aki qaalat balaa ‏.‏ qaala fadhaaka laki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aqra'uwa iin shiitum ‏{‏ fahal 'asaytum iin tawallaytum aan tufsiduwa fiy alaardi watuqatti'uwa aarhaamakum * auwlaiika alladhiyna la'anahumu alllahu faaasammahum waaa'maa aabsaarahum * aafalaa yatadabbaruwna alqurana aam 'alaa quluwbin aaqfaaluhaa‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Verily Allah created the universe and when He had finished that, ties of relationship came forward and said This is the place for him who seeks refuge from severing (of blood-relationship). He said: Yes. Are you not satisfied that I should keep relationship with one who joins your ties of relationship and sever it with one who severs your (ties of relationship)? They (the ties of blood) said: Certainly so. Thereupon He said: Well, that is how things are for you. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then said: Recite if you like:" But if you turn away you are sure to make mischief in the land and cut off the ties of kinship. Those it is whom Allah has cursed, so He has made them deaf and blinded their eyes. Do they not reflect on the Qur'an? Or, are there locks on their hearts?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُزَرِّدٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ رُومَانَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الرَّحِمُ مُعَلَّقَةٌ بِالْعَرْشِ تَقُولُ مَنْ وَصَلَنِي وَصَلَهُ اللَّهُ وَمَنْ قَطَعَنِي قَطَعَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an mu'aawiyaaa bni aabiy muzarridin, 'an yaziyda bni ruwmaana, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alrrahimu mu'allaqaaun bial'arshi taquwlu man wasalaniy wasalahu alllahu waman qata'aniy qata'ahu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The tie of kinship is suspended to the Throne and says: He who unites me Allah would unite him and he who severed me Allah would sever him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَاطِعٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ يَعْنِي قَاطِعَ رَحِمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an muhammadi, bni jubayri bni mut'imin 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulu aljannaaa qaati'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy 'umara qaala sufyaanu ya'niy qaati'a rahimin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jubair b. Mut'im reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The severer would not enter Paradise. Ibn Umar said that Sufyan (explained it as): One who severs the tie of kinship would not enter Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَسْمَاءَ الضُّبَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا جُوَيْرِيَةُ، عَنْ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَنَّ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ مُطْعِمٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ أَبَاهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ قَاطِعُ رَحِمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu muhammadi bni aasmaa'a aldduba'iyyu, haddathanaa juwayriyaau, 'an maalikin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aanna muhammada bna jubayri bni mut'imin, aakhbarahu aanna aabaahu aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yadkhulu aljannaaa qaati'u rahimin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jubair b. Mutlim reported that his father narrated to him that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The severer of the tie of kinship would not get into Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu waqaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ سَرَّهُ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقُهُ أَوْ يُنْسَأَ فِي أَثَرِهِ فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man sarrahu aan yubsata 'alayhi rizquhu aaw yunsaaa fiy aatharihi falyasil rahimahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He who is desirous that his means of sustenance should be expanded for him or his age may be lengthened, should join the tie of relationship
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ أَحَبَّ أَنْ يُبْسَطَ لَهُ فِي رِزْقِهِ وَيُنْسَأَ لَهُ فِي أَثَرِهِ فَلْيَصِلْ رَحِمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu, khaalidin qaala qaala abnu shihaabin aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man aahabba aan yubsata lahu fiy rizqihi wayunsaaa lahu fiy aatharihi falyasil rahimahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:He who likes that his sustenance should be expanded and his age may be lengthened should join the tie of kinship
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الْعَلاَءَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ لِي قَرَابَةً أَصِلُهُمْ وَيَقْطَعُونِي وَأُحْسِنُ إِلَيْهِمْ وَيُسِيئُونَ إِلَىَّ وَأَحْلُمُ عَنْهُمْ وَيَجْهَلُونَ عَلَىَّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ لَئِنْ كُنْتَ كَمَا قُلْتَ فَكَأَنَّمَا تُسِفُّهُمُ الْمَلَّ وَلاَ يَزَالُ مَعَكَ مِنَ اللَّهِ ظَهِيرٌ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا دُمْتَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu al'alaa'a bna 'abdi alrrahmani, yuhaddithu 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa aanna rajulaan, qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna liy qaraabaaan aasiluhum wayaqta'uwniy waauhsinu iilayhim wayusiyiuwna iilaaaa waaahlumu 'anhum wayajhaluwna 'alaaaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏ "‏ laiin kunta kamaa qulta fakaaannamaa tusiffuhumu almalla walaa yazaalu ma'aka mina alllahi zahiyrun 'alayhim maa dumta 'alaa dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that a person said:Allah's Messenger, I have relatives with whom I try, to have close relationship, but they sever (this relation). I treat them well, but they treat me ill. I am sweet to them but they are harsh towards me. Upon this he (the Holy Prophet) said: If it is so as you say, then you in fact throw hot ashes (upon their faces) and there would always remain with you on behalf of Allah (an Angel to support you) who would keep you dominant over them so long as you adhere to this (path of righteousness)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبَاغَضُوا وَلاَ تَحَاسَدُوا وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا وَلاَ يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tabaaghaduwa walaa tahaasaduwa walaa tadaabaruwa wakuwnuwa 'ibaada alllahi iikhwaanana walaa yahillu limuslimin aan yahjura aakhaahu fawqa thalaathin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Neither nurse mutual hatred, nor jealousy, nor enmity, and become as fellow brothers and servants of Allah. It is not lawful for a Muslim that he should keep his relations estranged with his brother beyond three days
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَاجِبُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ الزُّبَيْدِيُّ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مَالِكٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haajibu bnu alwaliydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu harbin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu alwaliydi alzzubaydiyyu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, aakhbaraniy aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala h wahaddathaniyhi harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi maalikin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying like this. This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ ‏ "‏ وَلاَ تَقَاطَعُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada abnu 'uyaynaaa ‏ "‏ walaa taqaata'uwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters with the addition of Ibn Uyaina (and the words are):" Do not cut off (mutual relations)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، اللَّيْثِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لِمُسْلِمٍ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثِ لَيَالٍ يَلْتَقِيَانِ فَيُعْرِضُ هَذَا وَيُعْرِضُ هَذَا وَخَيْرُهُمَا الَّذِي يَبْدَأُ بِالسَّلاَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yaziyda, alllaythiyyi 'an aabiy aayyuwba alaansaariyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yahillu limuslimin aan yahjura aakhaahu fawqa thalaathi layaalin yaltaqiyaani fayu'ridu hadhaa wayu'ridu hadhaa wakhayruhumaa alladhiy yabdaau bialssalaami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ayyub Ansiri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It is not permissible for a Muslim to have estranged relations with his brother beyond three nights, the one turning one way and the other turning the other way when they meet; the better of the two is one who is the first to give a greeting
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا حَاجِبُ، بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، عَنِ الزُّبَيْدِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ رَافِعٍ وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ مَالِكٍ وَمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِ إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ ‏"‏ فَيُعْرِضُ هَذَا وَيُعْرِضُ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُمْ جَمِيعًا قَالُوا فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ غَيْرَ مَالِكٍ ‏"‏ فَيَصُدُّ هَذَا وَيَصُدُّ هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wazuhayru bnu harbin qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathanaa haajibu, bnu alwaliydi haddathanaa muhammadu bnu harbin, 'ani alzzubaydiyyi, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, wamuhammadu, bnu raafi'in wa'abdu bnu humaydin 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, 'an ma'marin, kulluhum 'ani alzzuhriyyi, biiisnaadi maalikin wamithli hadiythihi iilaaa qawlahu ‏"‏ fayu'ridu hadhaa wayu'ridu hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faiinnahum jamiy'ana qaaluwa fiy hadiythihim ghayra maalikin ‏"‏ fayasuddu hadhaa wayasuddu hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri with a slight variation of wording (and the words are):" The one turning away and the other turning away when they meet and one avoids the other and the other also avoids him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي فُدَيْكٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا الضَّحَّاكُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُثْمَانَ - عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَحِلُّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ أَنْ يَهْجُرَ أَخَاهُ فَوْقَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy fudaykin, aakhbaranaa alddahhaaku, - wahuwa abnu 'uthmaana - 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yahillu lilmuumini aan yahjura aakhaahu fawqa thalaathaai aayyaamin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It is not permissible for a Muslim to have estranged relations with his brother beyond three days
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ هِجْرَةَ بَعْدَ ثَلاَثٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa hijraaa ba'da thalaathin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There should be no estranged relations beyond three days
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِيَّاكُمْ وَالظَّنَّ فَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ أَكْذَبُ الْحَدِيثِ وَلاَ تَحَسَّسُوا وَلاَ تَجَسَّسُوا وَلاَ تَنَافَسُوا وَلاَ تَحَاسَدُوا وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iiyyaakum waalzzanna faiinna alzzanna aakdhabu alhadiythi walaa tahassasuwa walaa tajassasuwa walaa tanaafasuwa walaa tahaasaduwa walaa tabaaghaduwa walaa tadaabaruwa wakuwnuwa 'ibaada alllahi iikhwaanana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Avoid suspicion, for suspicion is the gravest lie in talk and do not be inquisitive about one another and do not spy upon one another and do not feel envy with the other, and nurse no malice, and nurse no aversion and hostility against one another. And be fellow-brothers and servants of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَهَجَّرُوا وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا وَلاَ تَحَسَّسُوا وَلاَ يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tahajjaruwa walaa tadaabaruwa walaa tahassasuwa walaa yabi' ba'dukum 'alaa bay'i ba'din wakuwnuwa 'ibaada alllahi iikhwaanana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Don't have estranged relations (with the others) and don't nurse enmity and don't enter into a transaction when the other (has already entered) and be fellow-brothers and servants of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَحَاسَدُوا وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا وَلاَ تَجَسَّسُوا وَلاَ تَحَسَّسُوا وَلاَ تَنَاجَشُوا وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tahaasaduwa walaa tabaaghaduwa walaa tajassasuwa walaa tahassasuwa walaa tanaajashuwa wakuwnuwa 'ibaada alllahi iikhwaanana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying. Don't nurse malice against one another, don't nurse aversion against one another and don't be inquisitive about one another and don't outbid one another (with a view to raising the price) and be fellow-brothers and servants of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ نَصْرٍ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَهْبُ، بْنُ جَرِيرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقَاطَعُوا وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا وَلاَ تَحَاسَدُوا وَكُونُوا إِخْوَانًا كَمَا أَمَرَكُمُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wa'aliyyu bnu nasrin aljahdamiyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa wahbu, bnu jariyrin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏ "‏ laa taqaata'uwa walaa tadaabaruwa walaa tabaaghaduwa walaa tahaasaduwa wakuwnuwa iikhwaanana kamaa aamarakumu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmit ters (and the words are):" Don't sever relations of kinship, don't bear enmity against one another, don't bear aversion against one another and don't feel envy against the other and live as fellow-brothers as Allah has commanded you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَبَاغَضُوا وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا وَلاَ تَنَافَسُوا وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aahmadu bnu sa'iydin alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa habbaanu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa suhaylun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tabaaghaduwa walaa tadaabaruwa walaa tanaafasuwa wakuwnuwa 'ibaada alllahi iikhwaanana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Don't bear aversion against one another and don't be jealous of one another and be servants of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ قَيْسٍ - عَنْ أَبِي، سَعِيدٍ مَوْلَى عَامِرِ بْنِ كُرَيْزٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ تَحَاسَدُوا وَلاَ تَنَاجَشُوا وَلاَ تَبَاغَضُوا وَلاَ تَدَابَرُوا وَلاَ يَبِعْ بَعْضُكُمْ عَلَى بَيْعِ بَعْضٍ وَكُونُوا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ إِخْوَانًا ‏.‏ الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَظْلِمُهُ وَلاَ يَخْذُلُهُ وَلاَ يَحْقِرُهُ ‏.‏ التَّقْوَى هَا هُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَيُشِيرُ إِلَى صَدْرِهِ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ ‏"‏ بِحَسْبِ امْرِئٍ مِنَ الشَّرِّ أَنْ يَحْقِرَ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ كُلُّ الْمُسْلِمِ عَلَى الْمُسْلِمِ حَرَامٌ دَمُهُ وَمَالُهُ وَعِرْضُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa daawudu, - ya'niy abna qaysin - 'an aabiy, sa'iydin mawlaa 'aamiri bni kurayzin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa tahaasaduwa walaa tanaajashuwa walaa tabaaghaduwa walaa tadaabaruwa walaa yabi' ba'dukum 'alaa bay'i ba'din wakuwnuwa 'ibaada alllahi iikhwaanana ‏.‏ almuslimu aakhuw almuslimi laa yazlimuhu walaa yakhdhuluhu walaa yahqiruhu ‏.‏ alttaqwaa haa hunaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wayushiyru iilaa sadrihi thalaatha marraatin ‏"‏ bihasbi amriiin mina alshharri aan yahqira aakhaahu almuslima kullu almuslimi 'alaa almuslimi haraamun damuhu wamaaluhu wa'irduhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Don't nurse grudge and don't bid him out for raising the price and don't nurse aversion or enmity and don't enter into a transaction when the others have entered into that transaction and be as fellow-brothers and servants of Allah. A Muslim is the brother of a Muslim. He neither oppresses him nor humiliates him nor looks down upon him. The piety is here, (and while saying so) he pointed towards his chest thrice. It is a serious evil for a Muslim that he should look down upon his brother Muslim. All things of a Muslim are inviolable for his brother in faith: his blood, his wealth and his honour
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَرْحٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَامِرِ بْنِ كُرَيْزٍ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا، هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ دَاوُدَ وَزَادَ وَنَقَصَ وَمِمَّا زَادَ فِيهِ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى أَجْسَادِكُمْ وَلاَ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَشَارَ بِأَصَابِعِهِ إِلَى صَدْرِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aahmadu bnu 'amriw bni sarhin haddathanaa abnu wahbin, 'an ausaamaaa, - wahuwa abnu zaydin - aannahu sami'a aabaa sa'iydin, mawlaa 'abdi alllahi bni 'aamiri bni kurayzin yaquwlu sami'tu aabaa, hurayraaa yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi daawuda wazaada wanaqasa wamimmaa zaada fiyhi ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha laa yanzuru iilaa aajsaadikum walaa iilaa suwarikum walakin yanzuru iilaa quluwbikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaashaara biaasaabi'ihi iilaa sadrihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with some addition (and it is this):" Verily Allah does not look to your bodies nor to your faces but He looks to your hearts," and he pointed towards the heart with his fingers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا كَثِيرُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ بُرْقَانَ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ، الأَصَمِّ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa kathiyru bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa ja'faru bnu burqaana, 'an yaziyda bni, alaasammi 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha laa yanzuru iilaa suwarikum waaamwaalikum walakin yanzuru iilaa quluwbikum waaa'maalikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Verily Allah does not look to your faces and your wealth but He looks to your heart and to your deeds
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، رَفَعَهُ مَرَّةً قَالَ ‏ "‏ تُعْرَضُ الأَعْمَالُ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمِ خَمِيسٍ وَاثْنَيْنِ فَيَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ فِي ذَلِكَ الْيَوْمِ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ لاَ يُشْرِكُ بِاللَّهِ شَيْئًا إِلاَّ امْرَأً كَانَتْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ أَخِيهِ شَحْنَاءُ فَيُقَالُ ارْكُوا هَذَيْنِ حَتَّى يَصْطَلِحَا ارْكُوا هَذَيْنِ حَتَّى يَصْطَلِحَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muslimi bni aabiy maryama, 'an aabiy saalihin, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, rafa'ahu marraaan qaala ‏ "‏ tu'radu alaa'maalu fiy kulli yawmi khamiysin waathnayni fayaghfiru alllahu 'azza wajalla fiy dhalika alyawmi likulli amriiin laa yushriku bialllahi shayiana iilaaa amraaan kaanat baynahu wabayna aakhiyhi shahnaa'u fayuqaalu arkuwa hadhayni hattaa yastalihaa arkuwa hadhayni hattaa yastalihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported it as a marfu' hadith (and the words are):The deeds are presented on every Thursday and Monday and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious. grants pardon to every person who does not associate anything with Allah except the person in whose (heart) there is rancour against his brother. It would be said: Put both of them off until they are reconciled
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَعَمْرُو بْنُ سَوَّادٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ بْنُ، أَنَسٍ عَنْ مُسْلِمِ بْنِ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ تُعْرَضُ أَعْمَالُ النَّاسِ فِي كُلِّ جُمُعَةٍ مَرَّتَيْنِ يَوْمَ الاِثْنَيْنِ وَيَوْمَ الْخَمِيسِ فَيُغْفَرُ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ إِلاَّ عَبْدًا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ أَخِيهِ شَحْنَاءُ فَيُقَالُ اتْرُكُوا - أَوِ ارْكُوا - هَذَيْنِ حَتَّى يَفِيئَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, wa'amruw bnu sawwaadin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa maaliku bnu, aanasin 'an muslimi bni aabiy maryama, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ tu'radu aa'maalu alnnaasi fiy kulli jumu'aain marratayni yawma alaithnayni wayawma alkhamiysi fayughfaru likulli 'abdin muuminin iilaaa 'abdana baynahu wabayna aakhiyhi shahnaa'u fayuqaalu atrukuwa - aawi arkuwa - hadhayni hattaa yafiyiaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraim reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying The deeds of people would be presented every week on two days, viz. Monday and Thursday, and every believing servant would be granted pardon except the one in whose (heart) there is rancour against his brother and it would he said:Leave them and put them off until they are turned to reconciliation
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ مَالِكِ بْنِ أَنَسٍ، فِيمَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مَعْمَرٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْحُبَابِ، سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَيْنَ الْمُتَحَابُّونَ بِجَلاَلِي الْيَوْمَ أُظِلُّهُمْ فِي ظِلِّي يَوْمَ لاَ ظِلَّ إِلاَّ ظِلِّي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, 'an maaliki bni aanasin, fiymaa quriia 'alayhi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'abdi, alrrahmani bni ma'marin 'an aabiy alhubaabi, sa'iydi bni yasaarin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha yaquwlu yawma alqiyaamaai aayna almutahaabbuwna bijalaaliy alyawma auzilluhum fiy zilliy yawma laa zilla iilaaa zilliy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Verily. Allah would say on the Day of Resurrection: Where are those who have mutual love for My Glory's sake? Today I shall shelter them in My shadow when there is no other shadow but the shadow of Mine
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَنَّ رَجُلاً زَارَ أَخًا لَهُ فِي قَرْيَةٍ أُخْرَى فَأَرْصَدَ اللَّهُ لَهُ عَلَى مَدْرَجَتِهِ مَلَكًا فَلَمَّا أَتَى عَلَيْهِ قَالَ أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ قَالَ أُرِيدُ أَخًا لِي فِي هَذِهِ الْقَرْيَةِ ‏.‏ قَالَ هَلْ لَكَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ تَرُبُّهَا قَالَ لاَ غَيْرَ أَنِّي أَحْبَبْتُهُ فِي اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَإِنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَيْكَ بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ أَحَبَّكَ كَمَا أَحْبَبْتَهُ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alaa'laa bnu hammaadin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aanna rajulaan zaara aakhana lahu fiy qaryaain aukhraa faaarsada alllahu lahu 'alaa madrajatihi malakana falammaa aataa 'alayhi qaala aayna turiydu qaala auriydu aakhana liy fiy hadhihi alqaryaai ‏.‏ qaala hal laka 'alayhi min ni'maain tarubbuhaa qaala laa ghayra aanniy aahbabtuhu fiy alllahi 'azza wajalla ‏.‏ qaala faiinniy rasuwlu alllahi iilayka biaanna alllaha qad aahabbaka kamaa aahbabtahu fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:A person visited his brother in another town and Allah deputed an Angel to wait for him on his way and when he came to him he said: Where do you intend to go? He said: I intend to go to my brother in this town. He said: Have you done any favour to him (the repayment of which you intend to get)? He said: No, excepting this that I love Mm for the sake of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious. Thereupon he said: I am a meesenger to you from, Allah: (to inform you) that Allah loves you as you love him (for His sake)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: قَالَ الشَّيْخُ أَبُو أَحْمَدَ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو بَكْرٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ زَنْجُويَهْ الْقُشَيْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، الأَعْلَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala alshhaykhu aabuw aahmada aakhbaraniy aabuw bakrin, muhammadu bnu zanjuwyah alqushayriyyu haddathanaa 'abdu, alaa'laa bnu hammaadin haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hammid b. Salama with the same of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الزَّهْرَانِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِيَانِ ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، قَالَ أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ رَفَعَهُ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَفِي حَدِيثِ سَعِيدٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ عَائِدُ الْمَرِيضِ فِي مَخْرَفَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i alzzahraaniyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niyaani abna zaydin - 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy aasmaa'a, 'an thawbaana, qaala aabuw alrrabiy'i rafa'ahu iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm wafiy hadiythi sa'iydin qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ 'aaiidu almariydi fiy makhrafaai aljannaai hattaa yarji'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Rabi' reported directly from Allah's Apostle (may peace upon him) as saying:The one who visits the sick is in fact like one who is in the fruit garden of Paradise so long as he does not return
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي، أَسْمَاءَ عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ عَادَ مَرِيضًا لَمْ يَزَلْ فِي خُرْفَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, 'an khaalidin, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy, aasmaa'a 'an thawbaana, mawlaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man 'aada mariydana lam yazal fiy khurfaai aljannaai hattaa yarji'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:He who visits the sick continues to remain in the fruit garden of Paradise until he returns
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ الْحَارِثِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيِّ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمُسْلِمَ إِذَا عَادَ أَخَاهُ الْمُسْلِمَ لَمْ يَزَلْ فِي خُرْفَةِ الْجَنَّةِ حَتَّى يَرْجِعَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin alhaarithiyyu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa khaalidun, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy aasmaa'a alrrahabiyyi, 'an thawbaana, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna almuslima iidhaa 'aada aakhaahu almuslima lam yazal fiy khurfaai aljannaai hattaa yarji'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Verily, when a Muslim visits his brother in Islam he is supposed to remain in the fruit garden of Paradise until he returns
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمٌ الأَحْوَلُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، - وَهُوَ أَبُو قِلاَبَةَ - عَنْ أَبِي الأَشْعَثِ الصَّنْعَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيِّ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، مَوْلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ عَادَ مَرِيضًا لَمْ يَزَلْ فِي خُرْفَةِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا خُرْفَةُ الْجَنَّةِ قَالَ ‏"‏ جَنَاهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'an yaziyda, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa 'aasimun alaahwalu, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni zaydin, - wahuwa aabuw qilaabaaa - 'an aabiy alaash'athi alssan'aaniyyi, 'an aabiy aasmaa'a alrrahabiyyi, 'an thawbaana, mawlaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ man 'aada mariydana lam yazal fiy khurfaai aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi wamaa khurfaau aljannaai qaala ‏"‏ janaahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban, the freed slave of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who visits the sick is supposed to remain in the fruit garden of Paradise. It was said: Allah's Messenger, what is this Khurfat-ul-jannah? He said: It is a place abounding in fruits
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ الأَحْوَلِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa, 'an 'aasimin alaahwali, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Asim al-Ahwal with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَقُولُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ مَرِضْتُ فَلَمْ تَعُدْنِي ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَبِّ كَيْفَ أَعُودُكَ وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ عَبْدِي فُلاَنًا مَرِضَ فَلَمْ تَعُدْهُ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّكَ لَوْ عُدْتَهُ لَوَجَدْتَنِي عِنْدَهُ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ اسْتَطْعَمْتُكَ فَلَمْ تُطْعِمْنِي ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَبِّ وَكَيْفَ أُطْعِمُكَ وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّهُ اسْتَطْعَمَكَ عَبْدِي فُلاَنٌ فَلَمْ تُطْعِمْهُ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّكَ لَوْ أَطْعَمْتَهُ لَوَجَدْتَ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ اسْتَسْقَيْتُكَ فَلَمْ تَسْقِنِي ‏.‏ قَالَ يَا رَبِّ كَيْفَ أَسْقِيكَ وَأَنْتَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِينَ قَالَ اسْتَسْقَاكَ عَبْدِي فُلاَنٌ فَلَمْ تَسْقِهِ أَمَا إِنَّكَ لَوْ سَقَيْتَهُ وَجَدْتَ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimi bni maymuwnin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla yaquwlu yawma alqiyaamaai yaa abna adama maridtu falam ta'udniy ‏.‏ qaala yaa rabbi kayfa aa'uwduka waaanta rabbu al'aalamiyna ‏.‏ qaala aamaa 'alimta aanna 'abdiy fulaanana marida falam ta'udhu aamaa 'alimta aannaka law 'udtahu lawajadtaniy 'indahu yaa abna adama astat'amtuka falam tut'imniy ‏.‏ qaala yaa rabbi wakayfa aut'imuka waaanta rabbu al'aalamiyna ‏.‏ qaala aamaa 'alimta aannahu astat'amaka 'abdiy fulaanun falam tut'imhu aamaa 'alimta aannaka law aat'amtahu lawajadta dhalika 'indiy yaa abna adama astasqaytuka falam tasqiniy ‏.‏ qaala yaa rabbi kayfa aasqiyka waaanta rabbu al'aalamiyna qaala astasqaaka 'abdiy fulaanun falam tasqihi aamaa iinnaka law saqaytahu wajadta dhalika 'indiy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Verily, Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, would say on the Day of Resurrection: O son of Adam, I was sick but you did not visit Me. He would say: O my Lord; how could I visit Thee whereas Thou art the Lord of the worlds? Thereupon He would say: Didn't you know that such and such servant of Mine was sick but you did not visit him and were you not aware of this that if you had visited him, you would have found Me by him? O son of Adam, I asked food from you but you did not feed Me. He would say: My Lord, how could I feed Thee whereas Thou art the Lord of the worlds? He said: Didn't you know that such and such servant of Mine asked food from you but you did not feed him, and were you not aware that if you had fed him you would have found him by My side? (The Lord would again say: ) O son of Adam, I asked drink from you but you did not provide Me. He would say: My Lord, how could I provide Thee whereas Thou art the Lord of the worlds? Thereupon He would say: Such and such of servant of Mine asked you for a drink but you did not provide him, and had you provided him drink you would have found him near Me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، قَالَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ مَا رَأَيْتُ رَجُلاً أَشَدَّ عَلَيْهِ الْوَجَعُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ عُثْمَانَ مَكَانَ الْوَجَعِ وَجَعًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an masruwqin, qaala qaalat 'aaiishaau maa raaaytu rajulaan aashadda 'alayhi alwaja'u min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai 'uthmaana makaana alwaja'i waja'ana ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported, I did not see anyone else being afflicted with more severe illness than Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). In the narration transmitted by 'Uthman there is a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا مُصْعَبُ بْنُ الْمِقْدَامِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِإِسْنَادِ جَرِيرٍ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, aakhbaraniy aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathaniy bishru bnu khaalidin, aakhbaranaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, h wahaddathanaa abnu, numayrin haddathanaa mus'abu bnu almiqdaami, kilaahumaa 'an sufyaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, biiisnaadi jariyrin mithla hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash through other chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يُوعَكُ فَمَسِسْتُهُ بِيَدِي فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّكَ لَتُوعَكُ وَعْكًا شَدِيدًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَجَلْ إِنِّي أُوعَكُ كَمَا يُوعَكُ رَجُلاَنِ مِنْكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ ذَلِكَ أَنَّ لَكَ أَجْرَيْنِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَجَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُصِيبُهُ أَذًى مِنْ مَرَضٍ فَمَا سِوَاهُ إِلاَّ حَطَّ اللَّهُ بِهِ سَيِّئَاتِهِ كَمَا تَحُطُّ الشَّجَرَةُ وَرَقَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِ زُهَيْرٍ فَمَسِسْتُهُ بِيَدِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma alttaymiyyi, 'ani alhaarithi bni suwaydin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala dakhaltu 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yuw'aku famasistuhu biyadiy faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iinnaka latuw'aku wa'kana shadiydana ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aajal iinniy auw'aku kamaa yuw'aku rajulaani minkum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu dhalika aanna laka aajrayni faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aajal ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa min muslimin yusiybuhu aadhana min maradin famaa siwaahu iilaaa hatta alllahu bihi sayyiiaatihi kamaa tahuttu alshhajaraau waraqahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythi zuhayrin famasistuhu biyadiy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported:I visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as he was running a high temperature. I touched his body with my hand and said to him: Allah's Messenger, you are running a high temperature, whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Yes, it is so. I comparatively have a more severe fever than any one of you. I said: Is it because there is a double reward in store for you? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Yes, it is so. And Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) again said: When a Muslim falls ill, his compensation is that his minor sins are obliterated just as leaves fall (in autumn). In the hadith transmitted on the authority of Zubair there is (no mention of these words):" I touched his body with my hands
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَيَحْيَى بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي غَنِيَّةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِإِسْنَادِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ نَعَمْ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا عَلَى الأَرْضِ مُسْلِمٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, wayahyaa bnu 'abdi almaliki bni aabiy ghaniyyaaa, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, biiisnaadi jariyrin ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythihi wazaada fiy hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa qaala ‏ "‏ na'am waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi maa 'alaa alaardi muslimun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of jarir and the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Mu'awiya there is an addition of these words:He said: Yes, by Him in Whose Hand is my life, there is no Muslim upon the earth." The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ دَخَلَ شَبَابٌ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ وَهِيَ بِمِنًى وَهُمْ يَضْحَكُونَ فَقَالَتْ مَا يُضْحِكُكُمْ قَالُوا فُلاَنٌ خَرَّ عَلَى طُنُبِ فُسْطَاطٍ فَكَادَتْ عُنُقُهُ أَوْ عَيْنُهُ أَنْ تَذْهَبَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ لاَ تَضْحَكُوا فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ مُسْلِمٍ يُشَاكُ شَوْكَةً فَمَا فَوْقَهَا إِلاَّ كُتِبَتْ لَهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةٌ وَمُحِيَتْ عَنْهُ بِهَا خَطِيئَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, jamiy'ana 'an jariyrin, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, qaala dakhala shabaabun min qurayshin 'alaa 'aaiishaaa wahiya biminana wahum yadhakuwna faqaalat maa yudhikukum qaaluwa fulaanun kharra 'alaa tunubi fustaatin fakaadat 'unuquhu aaw 'aynuhu aan tadhhaba ‏.‏ faqaalat laa tadhakuwa faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa min muslimin yushaaku shawkaaan famaa fawqahaa iilaaa kutibat lahu bihaa darajaaun wamuhiyat 'anhu bihaa khatiyiaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aswad reported that some young men from the Quraish visited 'A'isha as she was in Mina and they were laughing. She said:What makes you laugh? They said: Such and such person stumbled against the rope of the tent and he was about to break his neck or lose his eyes. She said: Don't laugh for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: If a Muslim runs a thorn or (gets into trouble) severe than this, there is assured for him (a higher) rank and his sins are obliterated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُؤْمِنَ مِنْ شَوْكَةٍ فَمَا فَوْقَهَا إِلاَّ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ بِهَا دَرَجَةً أَوْ حَطَّ عَنْهُ بِهَا خَطِيئَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waalllafzu lahumaa h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu alhanzaliyyu, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'ani alaaswadi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa yusiybu almuumina min shawkaain famaa fawqahaa iilaaa rafa'ahu alllahu bihaa darajaaan aaw hatta 'anhu bihaa khatiyiaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A believer does not receive (the trouble) of running a thorn or more than that but Allah elevates him in rank or effaces his sins because of that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تُصِيبُ الْمُؤْمِنَ شَوْكَةٌ فَمَا فَوْقَهَا إِلاَّ قَصَّ اللَّهُ بِهَا مِنْ خَطِيئَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tusiybu almuumina shawkaaun famaa fawqahaa iilaaa qassa alllahu bihaa min khatiyiatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A believer does not undergo (the trouble) of running a thorn or more than that when Allah effaces his sins
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: The above hadith has been transmitted by Hisham with the same chain
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، وَيُونُسُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ يُصَابُ بِهَا الْمُسْلِمُ إِلاَّ كُفِّرَ بِهَا عَنْهُ حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aanasin, wayuwnusu bnu yaziyda, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa min musiybaain yusaabu bihaa almuslimu iilaaa kuffira bihaa 'anhu hattaa alshhawkaai yushaakuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: There is no trouble that comes to a believer except that it obliterates from his sins, even if it is the pricking of a thorn
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ خُصَيْفَةَ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُصِيبُ الْمُؤْمِنَ مِنْ مُصِيبَةٍ حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ إِلاَّ قُصَّ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ أَوْ كُفِّرَ بِهَا مِنْ خَطَايَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لاَ يَدْرِي يَزِيدُ أَيَّتُهُمَا قَالَ عُرْوَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an yaziyda bni khusayfaaa, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yusiybu almuumina min musiybaain hattaa alshhawkaai iilaaa qussa bihaa min khataayaahu aaw kuffira bihaa min khataayaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ laa yadriy yaziydu aayyatuhumaa qaala 'urwaau ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha said:No trouble comes to a believer even if it is the pricking of a thorn that it becomes (the means) whereby his sins are effaced or his sins are obliterated. Yazid says: He does not know which word 'Urwa said (whether he said Qussa or Kuffira)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَيْوَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْهَادِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ شَىْءٍ يُصِيبُ الْمُؤْمِنَ حَتَّى الشَّوْكَةِ تُصِيبُهُ إِلاَّ كَتَبَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهَا حَسَنَةً أَوْ حُطَّتْ عَنْهُ بِهَا خَطِيئَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaranaa haywaau, haddathanaa abnu alhaadi, 'an aabiy bakri bni hazmin, 'an 'amraaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ maa min shaa'in yusiybu almuumina hattaa alshhawkaai tusiybuhu iilaaa kataba alllahu lahu bihaa hasanaaan aaw huttat 'anhu bihaa khatiyiaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There is nothing (in the form of trouble) that comes to a believer even if it is the pricking of a thorn that there is decreed for him by Allah good or his sins are obliterated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ، كَثِيرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّهُمَا سَمِعَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَا يُصِيبُ الْمُؤْمِنَ مِنْ وَصَبٍ وَلاَ نَصَبٍ وَلاَ سَقَمٍ وَلاَ حَزَنٍ حَتَّى الْهَمِّ يُهَمُّهُ إِلاَّ كُفِّرَ بِهِ مِنْ سَيِّئَاتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alwaliydi bni, kathiyrin 'an muhammadi bni 'amriw bni 'ataa'in, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, waaabiy, hurayraaa aannahumaa sami'aa rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ maa yusiybu almuumina min wasabin walaa nasabin walaa saqamin walaa hazanin hattaa alhammi yuhammuhu iilaaa kuffira bihi min sayyiiaatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id and abu Huraira reported that they heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Never a believer is stricken with discomfort, hardship or illness, grief or even with mental worry that his sins are not expiated for him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ ابْنِ مُحَيْصِنٍ، شَيْخٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ سَمِعَ مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ قَيْسِ بْنِ مَخْرَمَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ ‏{‏ مَنْ يَعْمَلْ سُوءًا يُجْزَ بِهِ‏}‏ بَلَغَتْ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ مَبْلَغًا شَدِيدًا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَارِبُوا وَسَدِّدُوا فَفِي كُلِّ مَا يُصَابُ بِهِ الْمُسْلِمُ كَفَّارَةٌ حَتَّى النَّكْبَةِ يُنْكَبُهَا أَوِ الشَّوْكَةِ يُشَاكُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ هُوَ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُحَيْصِنٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَكَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa kilaahumaa 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - waalllafzu liqutaybaaa - haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani abni muhaysinin, shaykhin min qurayshin sami'a muhammada bna qaysi bni makhramaaa, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala lammaa nazalat ‏{‏ man ya'mal suw'ana yujza bihi‏}‏ balaghat mina almuslimiyna mablaghana shadiydana faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ qaaribuwa wasaddiduwa fafiy kulli maa yusaabu bihi almuslimu kaffaaraaun hattaa alnnakbaai yunkabuhaa aawi alshhawkaai yushaakuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala muslimun huwa 'umaru bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni muhaysinin min aahli makkaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that when this verse was revealed:"Whoever does evil will be requited for it", and when this was conveyed to the Muslims they were greatly perturbed. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Be moderate and stand firm in trouble that falls to the lot of a Muslim (as that) is an expiation for him; even stumbling on the path or the pricking of a thorn (are an expiation for him). Muslim said that 'Umar b. Abd al-Rahman Muhaisin was from amongst the people of Mecca
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَجَّاجُ الصَّوَّافُ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَابِرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم دَخَلَ عَلَى أُمِّ السَّائِبِ أَوْ أُمِّ الْمُسَيَّبِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكِ يَا أُمَّ السَّائِبِ أَوْ يَا أُمَّ الْمُسَيَّبِ تُزَفْزِفِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتِ الْحُمَّى لاَ بَارَكَ اللَّهُ فِيهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَسُبِّي الْحُمَّى فَإِنَّهَا تُذْهِبُ خَطَايَا بَنِي آدَمَ كَمَا يُذْهِبُ الْكِيرُ خَبَثَ الْحَدِيدِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa alhajjaaju alssawwaafu, haddathaniy aabuw alzzubayri, haddathanaa jaabiru bnu 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dakhala 'alaa aummi alssaaiibi aaw aummi almusayyabi faqaala ‏"‏ maa laki yaa aumma alssaaiibi aaw yaa aumma almusayyabi tuzafzifiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalati alhummaa laa baaraka alllahu fiyhaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa tasubbiy alhummaa faiinnahaa tudhhibu khataayaa baniy adama kamaa yudhhibu alkiyru khabatha alhadiydi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) visited Umm Sa'ib or Umm Musayyib and said:Umm Sa'ib or Umm Musayyib. why is it that you are shivering? She said:" It is fever and may it not be blessed by Allah, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Don't curse fever for it expiates the sin of the children of Adam just as furnace removes the alloy of iron
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَبِشْرُ بْنُ الْمُفَضَّلِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عِمْرَانُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَطَاءُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ أَلاَ أُرِيكَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ قُلْتُ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ هَذِهِ الْمَرْأَةُ السَّوْدَاءُ أَتَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ إِنِّي أُصْرَعُ وَإِنِّي أَتَكَشَّفُ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ شِئْتِ صَبَرْتِ وَلَكِ الْجَنَّةُ وَإِنْ شِئْتِ دَعَوْتُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُعَافِيَكِ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ أَصْبِرُ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَإِنِّي أَتَكَشَّفُ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ لاَ أَتَكَشَّفَ ‏.‏ فَدَعَا لَهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, wabishru bnu almufaddali, qaalaa haddathanaa 'imraanu aabuw bakrin, haddathaniy 'ataa'u bnu aabiy rabaahin, qaala qaala liy abnu 'abbaasin aalaa auriyka amraaaaan min aahli aljannaai qultu balaa ‏.‏ qaala hadhihi almaraaau alssawdaa'u aatati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat iinniy ausra'u waiinniy aatakashhafu faad'u alllaha liy ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iin shiiti sabarti walaki aljannaau waiin shiiti da'awtu alllaha aan yu'aafiyaki ‏.‏ qaalat aasbiru ‏.‏ qaalat faiinniy aatakashhafu faad'u alllaha aan laa aatakashhafa ‏.‏ fada'aa lahaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ata' b. Abi Rabih said:Ibn Abbas said to me: May I show you a woman of Paradise? I said: Yes. He said: Here is this dark-complexioned woman. She came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: I am suffering from falling sickness and I become naked; supplicate Allah for me, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Show endurance as you can do and there would be Paradise for you and, if you desire, I supplicate Allah that He may cure you. She said: I am prepared to show endurance (but the unbearable trouble is) that I become naked, so supplicate Allah that He should not let me become naked, so he supplicated for her
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ بَهْرَامَ الدَّارِمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ الدِّمَشْقِيَّ - حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا رَوَى عَنِ اللَّهِ، تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا عِبَادِي إِنِّي حَرَّمْتُ الظُّلْمَ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَجَعَلْتُهُ بَيْنَكُمْ مُحَرَّمًا فَلاَ تَظَالَمُوا يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ ضَالٌّ إِلاَّ مَنْ هَدَيْتُهُ فَاسْتَهْدُونِي أَهْدِكُمْ يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ جَائِعٌ إِلاَّ مَنْ أَطْعَمْتُهُ فَاسْتَطْعِمُونِي أُطْعِمْكُمْ يَا عِبَادِي كُلُّكُمْ عَارٍ إِلاَّ مَنْ كَسَوْتُهُ فَاسْتَكْسُونِي أَكْسُكُمْ يَا عِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ تُخْطِئُونَ بِاللَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَأَنَا أَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا فَاسْتَغْفِرُونِي أَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ يَا عِبَادِي إِنَّكُمْ لَنْ تَبْلُغُوا ضَرِّي فَتَضُرُّونِي وَلَنْ تَبْلُغُوا نَفْعِي فَتَنْفَعُونِي يَا عِبَادِي لَوْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وَإِنْسَكُمْ وَجِنَّكُمْ كَانُوا عَلَى أَتْقَى قَلْبِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ مِنْكُمْ مَا زَادَ ذَلِكَ فِي مُلْكِي شَيْئًا يَا عِبَادِي لَوْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وَإِنْسَكُمْ وَجِنَّكُمْ كَانُوا عَلَى أَفْجَرِ قَلْبِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ مَا نَقَصَ ذَلِكَ مِنْ مُلْكِي شَيْئًا يَا عِبَادِي لَوْ أَنَّ أَوَّلَكُمْ وَآخِرَكُمْ وَإِنْسَكُمْ وَجِنَّكُمْ قَامُوا فِي صَعِيدٍ وَاحِدٍ فَسَأَلُونِي فَأَعْطَيْتُ كُلَّ إِنْسَانٍ مَسْأَلَتَهُ مَا نَقَصَ ذَلِكَ مِمَّا عِنْدِي إِلاَّ كَمَا يَنْقُصُ الْمِخْيَطُ إِذَا أُدْخِلَ الْبَحْرَ يَا عِبَادِي إِنَّمَا هِيَ أَعْمَالُكُمْ أُحْصِيهَا لَكُمْ ثُمَّ أُوَفِّيكُمْ إِيَّاهَا فَمَنْ وَجَدَ خَيْرًا فَلْيَحْمَدِ اللَّهَ وَمَنْ وَجَدَ غَيْرَ ذَلِكَ فَلاَ يَلُومَنَّ إِلاَّ نَفْسَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَعِيدٌ كَانَ أَبُو إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيُّ إِذَا حَدَّثَ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ جَثَا عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni bahraama alddaarimiyyu, haddathanaa marwaanu, - ya'niy abna muhammadin alddimashqiyya - haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an rabiy'aaa bni yaziyda, 'an aabiy iidriysa alkhawlaaniyyi, 'an aabiy dharrin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiymaa rawaa 'ani alllahi, tabaaraka wata'aalaa aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ yaa 'ibaadiy iinniy harramtu alzzulma 'alaa nafsiy waja'altuhu baynakum muharramana falaa tazaalamuwa yaa 'ibaadiy kullukum daallun iilaaa man hadaytuhu faastahduwniy aahdikum yaa 'ibaadiy kullukum jaaii'un iilaaa man aat'amtuhu faastat'imuwniy aut'imkum yaa 'ibaadiy kullukum 'aarin iilaaa man kasawtuhu faastaksuwniy aaksukum yaa 'ibaadiy iinnakum tukhtiiuwna bialllayli waalnnahaari waaanaa aaghfiru aldhhunuwba jamiy'ana faastaghfiruwniy aaghfir lakum yaa 'ibaadiy iinnakum lan tablughuwa darriy fatadurruwniy walan tablughuwa naf'iy fatanfa'uwniy yaa 'ibaadiy law aanna aawwalakum waakhirakum waiinsakum wajinnakum kaanuwa 'alaa aatqaa qalbi rajulin waahidin minkum maa zaada dhalika fiy mulkiy shayiana yaa 'ibaadiy law aanna aawwalakum waakhirakum waiinsakum wajinnakum kaanuwa 'alaa aafjari qalbi rajulin waahidin maa naqasa dhalika min mulkiy shayiana yaa 'ibaadiy law aanna aawwalakum waakhirakum waiinsakum wajinnakum qaamuwa fiy sa'iydin waahidin fasaaaluwniy faaa'taytu kulla iinsaanin masaalatahu maa naqasa dhalika mimmaa 'indiy iilaaa kamaa yanqusu almikhyatu iidhaa audkhila albahra yaa 'ibaadiy iinnamaa hiya aa'maalukum auhsiyhaa lakum thumma auwaffiykum iiyyaahaa faman wajada khayrana falyahmadi alllaha waman wajada ghayra dhalika falaa yaluwmanna iilaaa nafsahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sa'iydun kaana aabuw iidriysa alkhawlaaniyyu iidhaa haddatha bihadhaa alhadiythi jathaa 'alaa rukbatayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said:"O My servants, I have forbidden oppression for Myself and have made it forbidden amongst you, so do not oppress one another. O My servants, all of you are astray except for those I have guided, so seek guidance of Me and I shall guide you, O My servants, all of you are hungry except for those I have fed, so seek food of Me and I shall feed you. O My servants, all of you are naked except for those I have clothed, so seek clothing of Me and I shall clothe you. O My servants, you sin by night and by day, and I forgive all sins, so seek forgiveness of Me and I shall forgive you. O My servants, you will not attain harming Me so as to harm Me, and will not attain benefitting Me so as to benefit Me. O My servants, were the first of you and the last of you, the human of you and the jinn of you to be as pious as the most pious heart of any one man of you, that would not increase My dominion in anything. O My servants, were the first of you and the last of you, the human of you and the jinn of you to be as wicked as the most wicked heart of any one man of you, that would not decrease My dominion in anything. O My servants, were the first of you and the last of you, the human of you and the jinn of you to rise up in one place and make a request of Me, and were I to give everyone what he requested, that would not decrease what I have, any more that a needle decreases the sea if put into it. O My servants, it is but your deeds that I record for you and then recompense you for. So let him who finds good, praise Allah, and let him who finds other than that blame no one but himself." Sa'id said that when Abu Idris Khaulini narrated this hadith he knelt upon his knees
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُسْهِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ مَرْوَانَ أَتَمُّهُمَا حَدِيثًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniyhi aabuw bakri bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa aabuw mushirin, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aanna marwaana aatammuhumaa hadiythana ‏.‏
verses.translation: The hadith is narrated through Abu Mushir from Sa'id bin 'Abdil'Aziz except that the previous hadith through Marwan was the more complete of the two
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: قَالَ أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ حَدَّثَنَا بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ الْحَسَنُ، وَالْحُسَيْنُ، ابْنَا بِشْرٍ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُسْهِرٍ، ‏.‏ فَذَكَرُوا الْحَدِيثَ بِطُولِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: qaala aabuw iishaaqa haddathanaa bihadhaa alhadiythi alhasanu, waalhusaynu, abnaa bishrin wamuhammadu bnu yahyaa qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw mushirin, ‏.‏ fadhakaruwa alhadiytha bituwlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is also transmitted through Ibna Bashr and Muhammad bin Muhammad through Abu Mashur through the same chain, narrated to its (full) extent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، الْوَارِثِ حَدَّثَنَا هَمَّامٌ، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيمَا يَرْوِي عَنْ رَبِّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى ‏ "‏ إِنِّي حَرَّمْتُ عَلَى نَفْسِي الظُّلْمَ وَعَلَى عِبَادِي فَلاَ تَظَالَمُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِهِ وَحَدِيثُ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الَّذِي ذَكَرْنَاهُ أَتَمُّ مِنْ هَذَا ‏.‏
