verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alssamadi bni 'abdi, alwaarithi haddathanaa hammaamun, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy aasmaa'a, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiymaa yarwiy 'an rabbihi tabaaraka wata'aalaa ‏ "‏ iinniy harramtu 'alaa nafsiy alzzulma wa'alaa 'ibaadiy falaa tazaalamuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwihi wahadiythu aabiy iidriysa alladhiy dhakarnaahu aatammu min hadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying that he reported it from his Lord, the Exalted and Glorious:Verily I have made oppression unlawful for Me and for My servants too, so do not commit oppression. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ قَيْسٍ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ مِقْسَمٍ عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اتَّقُوا الظُّلْمَ فَإِنَّ الظُّلْمَ ظُلُمَاتٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ وَاتَّقُوا الشُّحَّ فَإِنَّ الشُّحَّ أَهْلَكَ مَنْ كَانَ قَبْلَكُمْ حَمَلَهُمْ عَلَى أَنْ سَفَكُوا دِمَاءَهُمْ وَاسْتَحَلُّوا مَحَارِمَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa daawudu, - ya'niy abna qaysin - 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi bni miqsamin 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ attaquwa alzzulma faiinna alzzulma zulumaatun yawma alqiyaamaai waattaquwa alshhuhha faiinna alshhuhha aahlaka man kaana qablakum hamalahum 'alaa aan safakuwa dimaa'ahum waastahalluwa mahaarimahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Be on your guard against committing oppression, for oppression is a darkness on the Day of Resurrection, and be on your guard against stinginess for stinginess destroyed those who were before you, as it incited them to shed blood and make lawful what was unlawful for them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ الْمَاجِشُونُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ دِينَارٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الظُّلْمَ ظُلُمَاتٌ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi almaajishuwnu, 'an 'abdi alllahi, bni diynaarin 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alzzulma zulumaatun yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibu 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Oppression is the darkness on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ عُقَيْلٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَظْلِمُهُ وَلاَ يُسْلِمُهُ مَنْ كَانَ فِي حَاجَةِ أَخِيهِ كَانَ اللَّهُ فِي حَاجَتِهِ وَمَنْ فَرَّجَ عَنْ مُسْلِمٍ كُرْبَةً فَرَّجَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ بِهَا كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِمًا سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an 'uqaylin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almuslimu aakhuw almuslimi laa yazlimuhu walaa yuslimuhu man kaana fiy haajaai aakhiyhi kaana alllahu fiy haajatihi waman farraja 'an muslimin kurbaaan farraja alllahu 'anhu bihaa kurbaaan min kurabi yawmi alqiyaamaai waman satara muslimana satarahu alllahu yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:A Muslim is the brother of a fellow-Muslim. He should neither commit oppression upon him nor ruin him, and he who meets the need of a brot'ier, Allah would meet big needs, and he who relieved a Muslim from hardship Allah would relieve him from the hardships to which he would be put on the Day of Resurrection, and he who did not expose (the follies of a Muslim) Allah would conceal his follies on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْمُفْلِسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا الْمُفْلِسُ فِينَا مَنْ لاَ دِرْهَمَ لَهُ وَلاَ مَتَاعَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْمُفْلِسَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَأْتِي يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ بِصَلاَةٍ وَصِيَامٍ وَزَكَاةٍ وَيَأْتِي قَدْ شَتَمَ هَذَا وَقَذَفَ هَذَا وَأَكَلَ مَالَ هَذَا وَسَفَكَ دَمَ هَذَا وَضَرَبَ هَذَا فَيُعْطَى هَذَا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ وَهَذَا مِنْ حَسَنَاتِهِ فَإِنْ فَنِيَتْ حَسَنَاتُهُ قَبْلَ أَنْ يُقْضَى مَا عَلَيْهِ أُخِذَ مِنْ خَطَايَاهُمْ فَطُرِحَتْ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ طُرِحَ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aatadruwna maa almuflisu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa almuflisu fiynaa man laa dirhama lahu walaa mataa'a ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinna almuflisa min aummatiy yaatiy yawma alqiyaamaai bisalaaain wasiyaamin wazakaaain wayaatiy qad shatama hadhaa waqadhafa hadhaa waaakala maala hadhaa wasafaka dama hadhaa wadaraba hadhaa fayu'taa hadhaa min hasanaatihi wahadhaa min hasanaatihi faiin faniyat hasanaatuhu qabla aan yuqdaa maa 'alayhi aukhidha min khataayaahum faturihat 'alayhi thumma turiha fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do you know who is poor? They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: A poor man amongst us is one who has neither dirham with him nor wealth. He (the Holy Prophet) said: The poor of my Umma would be he who would come on the Day of Resurrection with prayers and fasts and Zakat but (he would find himself bankrupt on that day as he would have exhausted his funds of virtues) since he hurled abuses upon others, brought calumny against others and unlawfully consumed the wealth of others and shed the blood of others and beat others, and his virtues would be credited to the account of one (who suffered at his hand). And if his good deeds fall short to clear the account, then his sins would be entered in (his account) and he would be thrown in the Hell-Fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَتُؤَدُّنَّ الْحُقُوقَ إِلَى أَهْلِهَا يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حَتَّى يُقَادَ لِلشَّاةِ الْجَلْحَاءِ مِنَ الشَّاةِ الْقَرْنَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ latuuaddunna alhuquwqa iilaa aahlihaa yawma alqiyaamaai hattaa yuqaada lilshhaaai aljalhaa'i mina alshhaaai alqarnaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:“Rights will certainly be restored to those entitled to them on the Day of Resurrection, (to the point that) even the hornless sheep will lay claim upon the horned one.”
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا بُرَيْدُ بْنُ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يُمْلِي لِلظَّالِمِ فَإِذَا أَخَذَهُ لَمْ يُفْلِتْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏ وَكَذَلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَا أَخَذَ الْقُرَى وَهِيَ ظَالِمَةٌ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُ أَلِيمٌ شَدِيدٌ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa buraydu bnu aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna alllaha 'azza wajalla yumliy lilzzaalimi faiidhaa aakhadhahu lam yuflithu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaraaa ‏{‏ wakadhalika aakhdhu rabbika iidhaa aakhadha alquraa wahiya zaalimaaun iinna aakhdhahu aaliymun shadiydun‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, grants respite to the oppessor. But when He lays Hand upon him, He does not then let him off. Re (the Holy Prophet) then recited this verse:" Such is the chastisement of thy Lord when He chastises the towns (inhabited by) wrongdoing persons. Surely, His punishment is painful, severe" (xi)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ اقْتَتَلَ غُلاَمَانِ غُلاَمٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ وَغُلاَمٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَنَادَى الْمُهَاجِرُ أَوِ الْمُهَاجِرُونَ يَا لَلْمُهَاجِرِينَ ‏.‏ وَنَادَى الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا لَلأَنْصَارِ ‏.‏ فَخَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا هَذَا دَعْوَى أَهْلِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا لاَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِلاَّ أَنَّ غُلاَمَيْنِ اقْتَتَلاَ فَكَسَعَ أَحَدُهُمَا الآخَرَ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَلاَ بَأْسَ وَلْيَنْصُرِ الرَّجُلُ أَخَاهُ ظَالِمًا أَوْ مَظْلُومًا إِنْ كَانَ ظَالِمًا فَلْيَنْهَهُ فَإِنَّهُ لَهُ نَصْرٌ وَإِنْ كَانَ مَظْلُومًا فَلْيَنْصُرْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aahmadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala aqtatala ghulaamaani ghulaamun mina almuhaajiriyna waghulaamun mina alaansaari fanaadaa almuhaajiru aawi almuhaajiruwna yaa lalmuhaajiriyna ‏.‏ wanaadaa alaansaariyyu yaa lalaansaari ‏.‏ fakharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ maa hadhaa da'waa aahli aljaahiliyyaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa laa yaa rasuwla alllahi iilaaa aanna ghulaamayni aqtatalaa fakasa'a aahaduhumaa alakhara qaala ‏"‏ falaa baasa walyansuri alrrajulu aakhaahu zaalimana aaw mazluwmana iin kaana zaalimana falyanhahu faiinnahu lahu nasrun waiin kaana mazluwmana falyansurhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that two young men, one from the Muhajirin (emigrants) and the other one from the Angr (helpers) fell into dispute and the Muhajir called his fellow Muhajirin, and the Ansari (the helper) called the Ansar (for help). In the meanwhile, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came there and said:What is this, the proclamation of the days of jahiliya (ignorance)? They said: Allah's Messenger, there is nothing serious. The two young men fell into dispute and the one struck at the back of the other. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Well, a person should help his brother whether he is an oppressor or an oppressed. If he is the oppressor he should prevent him from doing it, for that is his help; and if he is the oppressed he should be helped (against oppression)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، وَابْنُ أَبِي، عُمَرَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالَ ابْنُ عَبْدَةَ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ، عُيَيْنَةَ قَالَ سَمِعَ عَمْرٌو، جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ فَكَسَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَقَالَ الأَنْصَارِيُّ يَا لَلأَنْصَارِ وَقَالَ الْمُهَاجِرِيُّ يَا لَلْمُهَاجِرِينَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا بَالُ دَعْوَى الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَسَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعُوهَا فَإِنَّهَا مُنْتِنَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَمِعَهَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ أُبَىٍّ فَقَالَ قَدْ فَعَلُوهَا وَاللَّهِ لَئِنْ رَجَعْنَا إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ لَيُخْرِجَنَّ الأَعَزُّ مِنْهَا الأَذَلَّ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ دَعْنِي أَضْرِبْ عُنُقَ هَذَا الْمُنَافِقِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ دَعْهُ لاَ يَتَحَدَّثُ النَّاسُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا يَقْتُلُ أَصْحَابَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waaahmadu bnu 'abdaaa alddabbiyyu, waabnu aabiy, 'umara - waalllafzu laibni aabiy shaybaaa - qaala abnu 'abdaaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu, 'uyaynaaa qaala sami'a 'amrunw, jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi yaquwlu kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazaaain fakasa'a rajulun mina almuhaajiriyna rajulaan mina alaansaari faqaala alaansaariyyu yaa lalaansaari waqaala almuhaajiriyyu yaa lalmuhaajiriyna ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa baalu da'waa aljaahiliyyaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi kasa'a rajulun mina almuhaajiriyna rajulaan mina alaansaari ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ da'uwhaa faiinnahaa muntinaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasami'ahaa 'abdu alllahi bnu aubaaain faqaala qad fa'aluwhaa waalllahi laiin raja'naa iilaa almadiynaai layukhrijanna alaa'azzu minhaa alaadhalla ‏.‏ qaala 'umaru da'niy aadrib 'unuqa hadhaa almunaafiqi faqaala ‏"‏ da'hu laa yatahaddathu alnnaasu aanna muhammadana yaqtulu aashaabahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported:We were along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in an expedition that a person from amongst the emigrants struck at the back of a person from the Ansir. The Ansiri said: O Ansar! And the Muhijir said: O Emigrants! Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: What are these proclamations of the Days of Ignorance? They said: Allah's Messenger, a person from the emigrants struck at the back of an Ansari, whereupon he said: It is something disgusting. 'Abdullah b. Ubayy heard it and said: They have indeed done it. By Allah, when we would return to Medina the respectable amongst them (the Ansar) would turn away the mean (the emigrants). Thereupon 'Umar said: Permit me so that I should strike the neck of this hypocrite. But he (the Holy Prophet) said: Leave him, the people may not say that Muhammad kills his companions
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، قَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَسَعَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ رَجُلاً مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَسَأَلَهُ الْقَوَدَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ دَعُوهَا فَإِنَّهَا مُنْتِنَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ مَنْصُورٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَمْرٌو قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَابِرًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, wamuhammadu bnu raafi'in, qaala abnu raafi'in haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'amriw bni diynaarin, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala kasa'a rajulun mina almuhaajiriyna rajulaan mina alaansaari faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm fasaaalahu alqawada faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ da'uwhaa faiinnahaa muntinaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu mansuwrin fiy riwaayatihi 'amrunw qaala sami'tu jaabirana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah reported that a person from the emigrants struck the back of an Ansari. He came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked for compensation. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:Leave it. for it is something disgusting. Ibn Mansur said that in the narration transmitted on the authority of Amr (these words are also found):" I heard Jabir
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو عَامِرٍ الأَشْعَرِيُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، وَابْنُ، إِدْرِيسَ وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ بُرَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُؤْمِنُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ كَالْبُنْيَانِ يَشُدُّ بَعْضُهُ بَعْضًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw 'aamirin alaash'ariyyu qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, waaabuw ausaamaaa h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa abnu almubaaraki, waabnu, iidriysa waaabuw ausaamaaa kulluhum 'an buraydin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ almuuminu lilmuumini kaalbunyaani yashuddu ba'duhu ba'dana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:A believer is like a brick for another believer, the one supporting the other
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ مَثَلُ الْجَسَدِ إِذَا اشْتَكَى مِنْهُ عُضْوٌ تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ الْجَسَدِ بِالسَّهَرِ وَالْحُمَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathalu almuuminiyna fiy tawaaddihim wataraahumihim wata'aatufihim mathalu aljasadi iidhaa ashtakaa minhu 'udwun tadaa'aa lahu saaiiru aljasadi bialssahari waalhummaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The similitude of believers in regard to mutual love, affection, fellow-feeling is that of one body; when any limb of it aches, the whole body aches, because of sleeplessness and fever
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ، بَشِيرٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mutarrifin, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni, bashiyrin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported a hadith like this from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ كَرَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ إِنِ اشْتَكَى رَأْسُهُ تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ الْجَسَدِ بِالْحُمَّى وَالسَّهَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ almuuminuwna karajulin waahidin iini ashtakaa raasuhu tadaa'aa lahu saaiiru aljasadi bialhummaa waalssahari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The believers are like one person; if his head aches, the whole body aches with fever and sleeplessness
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الْمُسْلِمُونَ كَرَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ إِنِ اشْتَكَى عَيْنُهُ اشْتَكَى كُلُّهُ وَإِنِ اشْتَكَى رَأْسُهُ اشْتَكَى كُلُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an khaythamaaa, 'ani alnnu'maani bni bashiyrin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ almuslimuwna karajulin waahidin iini ashtakaa 'aynuhu ashtakaa kulluhu waiini ashtakaa raasuhu ashtakaa kulluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nu'man b. Bashir reported that Muslims are like one body of a person; if the eye is sore, the whole body aches, and if the head aches, the whole body aches
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنِ الشَّعْبِيِّ، عَنِ النُّعْمَانِ، بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'ani alshha'biyyi, 'ani alnnu'maani, bni bashiyrin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of Nu'man b. Bashir through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْمُسْتَبَّانِ مَا قَالاَ فَعَلَى الْبَادِئِ مَا لَمْ يَعْتَدِ الْمَظْلُومُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ almustabbaani maa qaalaa fa'alaa albaadiii maa lam ya'tadi almazluwmu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When two persons indulge in hurling (abuses) upon one another, it would be the first one who would be the sinner so long as the oppressed does not transgress the limits
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا وَمَا تَوَاضَعَ أَحَدٌ لِلَّهِ إِلاَّ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - wahuwa abnu ja'farin - 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ maa naqasat sadaqaaun min maalin wamaa zaada alllahu 'abdana bi'afwin iilaaa 'izzana wamaa tawaada'a aahadun lillahi iilaaa rafa'ahu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Charity does not decrease wealth, no one forgives another except that Allah increases his honor, and no one humbles himself for the sake of Allah except that Allah raises his status
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ، وَابْنُ، حُجْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَتَدْرُونَ مَا الْغِيبَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ذِكْرُكَ أَخَاكَ بِمَا يَكْرَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي أَخِي مَا أَقُولُ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنْ كَانَ فِيهِ مَا تَقُولُ فَقَدِ اغْتَبْتَهُ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ فِيهِ فَقَدْ بَهَتَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau, waabnu, hujrin qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, 'ani al'alaa'i, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aatadruwna maa alghiybaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ dhikruka aakhaaka bimaa yakrahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qiyla aafaraaayta iin kaana fiy aakhiy maa aaquwlu qaala ‏"‏ iin kaana fiyhi maa taquwlu faqadi aghtabtahu waiin lam yakun fiyhi faqad bahattahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Do you know what is backbiting? They (the Companions) said: Allah and His Messenger know best. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Backbiting implies your talking about your brother in a manner which he does not like. It was said to him: What is your opinion about this that if I actually find (that failing) in my brother which I made a mention of? He said: If (that failing) is actually found (in him) what you assert, you in fact backbited him, and if that is not in him it is a slander
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامٍ الْعَيْشِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَسْتُرُ اللَّهُ عَلَى عَبْدٍ فِي الدُّنْيَا إِلاَّ سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaamin al'ayshiyyu, haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa rawhun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yasturu alllahu 'alaa 'abdin fiy alddunyaa iilaaa satarahu alllahu yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The servant (whose fault) Allah conceals in this world, Allah would also conceal (his faults) on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَسْتُرُ عَبْدٌ عَبْدًا فِي الدُّنْيَا إِلاَّ سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa suhaylun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yasturu 'abdun 'abdana fiy alddunyaa iilaaa satarahu alllahu yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The servant (who conceals) the faults of others in this world, Allah would conceal his faults on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ - عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، سَمِعَ عُرْوَةَ بْنَ الزُّبَيْرِ، يَقُولُ حَدَّثَتْنِي عَائِشَةُ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، اسْتَأْذَنَ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ ائْذَنُوا لَهُ فَلَبِئْسَ ابْنُ الْعَشِيرَةِ أَوْ بِئْسَ رَجُلُ الْعَشِيرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ أَلاَنَ لَهُ الْقَوْلَ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قُلْتَ لَهُ الَّذِي قُلْتَ ثُمَّ أَلَنْتَ لَهُ الْقَوْلَ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ شَرَّ النَّاسِ مَنْزِلَةً عِنْدَ اللَّهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مَنْ وَدَعَهُ أَوْ تَرَكَهُ النَّاسُ اتِّقَاءَ فُحْشِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu wazuhayru bnu harbin waabnu numayrin kulluhum 'ani abni 'uyaynaaa, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaala haddathanaa sufyaanu, - wahuwa abnu 'uyaynaaa - 'ani abni almunkadiri, sami'a 'urwaaa bna alzzubayri, yaquwlu haddathatniy 'aaiishaau, aanna rajulaan, astaadhana 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aidhanuwa lahu falabiisa abnu al'ashiyraai aaw biisa rajulu al'ashiyraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ falammaa dakhala 'alayhi aalaana lahu alqawla qaalat 'aaiishaau faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi qulta lahu alladhiy qulta thumma aalanta lahu alqawla qaala ‏"‏ yaa 'aaiishaau iinna sharra alnnaasi manzilaaan 'inda alllahi yawma alqiyaamaai man wada'ahu aaw tarakahu alnnaasu attiqaa'a fuhshihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that a person sought permission from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to see him. He said:Grant him permission. (and also added: ) He is a bad son of his tribe or he is a bad person of his tribe. When he came in he used kind words for him. 'A'isha reported that she said: Allah's Messenger, you said about him what you had to say and then you treated him with kindness. He said: A'isha, verily in the eye of Allah, worst amongst the person in rank on the Day of Resurrection is one whom the people abandon or desert out of the fear of indecency
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ مَعْنَاهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ بِئْسَ أَخُو الْقَوْمِ وَابْنُ الْعَشِيرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, kilaahumaa 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani abni almunkadiri, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithla ma'naahu ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ biisa aakhuw alqawmi waabnu al'ashiyraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of Ibn Munkadir with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَنْصُورٌ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ جَرِيرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يُحْرَمِ الرِّفْقَ يُحْرَمِ الْخَيْرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an sufyaana, haddathanaa mansuwrun, 'an tamiymi bni salamaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni hilaalin, 'an jariyrin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man yuhrami alrrifqa yuhrami alkhayra ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jarir reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ):He who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ غِيَاثٍ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُمَا - قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ تَمِيمِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ الْعَبْسِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَرِيرًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يُحْرَمِ الرِّفْقَ يُحْرَمِ الْخَيْرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin qaaluwa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa hafsun, - ya'niy abna ghiyaathin - kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma - waalllafzu lahumaa - qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an tamiymi bni salamaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni hilaalin al'absiyyi, qaala sami'tu jariyrana, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man yuhrami alrrifqa yuhrami alkhayra ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jarir reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ جَرِيرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ حُرِمَ الرِّفْقَ حُرِمَ الْخَيْرَ أَوْ مَنْ يُحْرَمِ الرِّفْقَ يُحْرَمِ الْخَيْرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, 'an muhammadi bni aabiy iismaa'iyla, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni hilaalin, qaala sami'tu jariyra bna 'abdi alllahi, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man hurima alrrifqa hurima alkhayra aaw man yuhrami alrrifqa yuhrami alkhayra ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jarir b. 'Abdullah reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good and he who is deprived of tenderly feelings is in fact deprived of good
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي حَيْوَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ الْهَادِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ حَزْمٍ، عَنْ عَمْرَةَ، - يَعْنِي بِنْتَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ رَفِيقٌ يُحِبُّ الرِّفْقَ وَيُعْطِي عَلَى الرِّفْقِ مَا لاَ يُعْطِي عَلَى الْعُنْفِ وَمَا لاَ يُعْطِي عَلَى مَا سِوَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy haywaau, haddathaniy abnu alhaadi, 'an aabiy bakri bni hazmin, 'an 'amraaa, - ya'niy binta 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaa 'aaiishaau iinna alllaha rafiyqun yuhibbu alrrifqa wayu'tiy 'alaa alrrifqi maa laa yu'tiy 'alaa al'unfi wamaa laa yu'tiy 'alaa maa siwaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:'A'isha, verily Allah is kind and He loves kindness and confers upon kindness which he does not confer upon severity and does not confer upon anything else besides it (kindness)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْمِقْدَامِ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ هَانِئٍ - عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الرِّفْقَ لاَ يَكُونُ فِي شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ زَانَهُ وَلاَ يُنْزَعُ مِنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ شَانَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani almiqdaami, - wahuwa abnu shurayhi bni haaniiin - 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alrrifqa laa yakuwnu fiy shaa'in iilaaa zaanahu walaa yunza'u min shaa'in iilaaa shaanahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Kindness is not to be found in anything but that it adds to its beauty and it is not withdrawn from anything but it makes it defective
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، سَمِعْتُ الْمِقْدَامَ بْنَ شُرَيْحِ بْنِ هَانِئٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فِي الْحَدِيثِ رَكِبَتْ عَائِشَةُ بَعِيرًا فَكَانَتْ فِيهِ صُعُوبَةٌ فَجَعَلَتْ تُرَدِّدُهُ فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ عَلَيْكِ بِالرِّفْقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, sami'tu almiqdaama bna shurayhi bni haaniiin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada fiy alhadiythi rakibat 'aaiishaau ba'iyrana fakaanat fiyhi su'uwbaaun faja'alat turaddiduhu faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ 'alayki bialrrifqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported by Miqdam b. Shuraih b. Hani with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition:" 'A'isha mounted upon a wild camel and she began to make that go round and round. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You should show kindness, and then he made a mention of this hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْمُهَلَّبِ، عَنْ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ، حُصَيْنٍ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي بَعْضِ أَسْفَارِهِ وَامْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ فَضَجِرَتْ فَلَعَنَتْهَا فَسَمِعَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ خُذُوا مَا عَلَيْهَا وَدَعُوهَا فَإِنَّهَا مَلْعُونَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عِمْرَانُ فَكَأَنِّي أَرَاهَا الآنَ تَمْشِي فِي النَّاسِ مَا يَعْرِضُ لَهَا أَحَدٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy almuhallabi, 'an 'imraana bni, husaynin qaala baynamaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ba'di aasfaarihi waamraaaaun mina alaansaari 'alaa naaqaain fadajirat fala'anathaa fasami'a dhalika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ khudhuwa maa 'alayhaa wada'uwhaa faiinnahaa mal'uwnaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'imraanu fakaaanniy aaraahaa alana tamshiy fiy alnnaasi maa ya'ridu lahaa aahadun ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in some of his journeys and there was a woman from the Ansar riding a she-camel that it shied and she invoked curse upon that. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) heard it and said: Unload that and set it free for it is accursed. 'Imran said: I still perceive that (dromedary) walking amongst people and none taking any notice of that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِإِسْنَادِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ إِلاَّ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ قَالَ عِمْرَانُ فَكَأَنِّي أَنْظُرُ إِلَيْهَا نَاقَةً وَرْقَاءَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ الثَّقَفِيِّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ خُذُوا مَا عَلَيْهَا وَأَعْرُوهَا فَإِنَّهَا مَلْعُونَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, wahuwa abnu zaydin h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa althhaqafiyyu, kilaahumaa 'an aayyuwba, biiisnaadi iismaa'iyla ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythihi iilaaa aanna fiy hadiythi hammaadin qaala 'imraanu fakaaanniy aanzuru iilayhaa naaqaaan warqaa'a wafiy hadiythi althhaqafiyyi faqaala ‏ "‏ khudhuwa maa 'alayhaa waaa'ruwhaa faiinnahaa mal'uwnaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran reported:I perceive as if I am looking towards that dromedary, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Thaqafi (the words are):" Unload it and make its back bare for it is accursed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي بَرْزَةَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا جَارِيَةٌ عَلَى نَاقَةٍ عَلَيْهَا بَعْضُ مَتَاعِ الْقَوْمِ إِذْ بَصُرَتْ بِالنَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَتَضَايَقَ بِهِمُ الْجَبَلُ فَقَالَتْ حَلْ اللَّهُمَّ الْعَنْهَا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تُصَاحِبُنَا نَاقَةٌ عَلَيْهَا لَعْنَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, fudaylu bnu husaynin haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa alttaymiyyu, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an aabiy barzaaa alaaslamiyyi, qaala baynamaa jaariyaaun 'alaa naaqaain 'alayhaa ba'du mataa'i alqawmi iidh basurat bialnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm watadaayaqa bihimu aljabalu faqaalat hal alllahumma al'anhaa ‏.‏ qaala faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa tusaahibunaa naaqaaun 'alayhaa la'naaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Burza al-Aslami reported that a slave-girl was riding a dromedary and there was also the luggage of people upon it. that she suddenly saw Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). The way of the mountain was narrow and she said (to that dromedary):Go ahead (but that dromedary did not move). She (that slave-girl), out of anger, said: O Allah, let that (dromedary) be damned. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Let the dromedary on which the curse has been invoked not proceed with us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - جَمِيعًا عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ ‏ "‏ لاَ ايْمُ اللَّهِ لاَ تُصَاحِبُنَا رَاحِلَةٌ عَلَيْهَا لَعْنَةٌ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ كَمَا قَالَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, h wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin - jamiy'ana 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wazaada fiy hadiythi almu'tamiri ‏ "‏ laa aymu alllahi laa tusaahibunaa raahilaaun 'alayhaa la'naaun mina alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw kamaa qaala ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi with the same chain of transmitters but with a variation of words (and that is):" By Allah, let that accompany us not which has been damned, or he said like it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ بِلاَلٍ - عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَنْبَغِي لِصِدِّيقٍ أَنْ يَكُونَ لَعَّانًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy sulaymaanu, - wahuwa abnu bilaalin - 'ani al'alaa'i bni 'abdi alrrahmani, haddathahu 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa yanbaghiy lisiddiyqin aan yakuwna la''aanana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It does not seem proper for a Siddiq that he should be an invoker of curse
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ مَخْلَدٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ، الرَّحْمَنِ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniyhi aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa khaalidu bnu makhladin, 'an muhammadi bni ja'farin, 'ani al'alaa'i bni 'abdi, alrrahmani bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Kuraib with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الْمَلِكِ، بْنَ مَرْوَانَ بَعَثَ إِلَى أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ بِأَنْجَادٍ مِنْ عِنْدِهِ فَلَمَّا أَنْ كَانَ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ قَامَ عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَدَعَا خَادِمَهُ فَكَأَنَّهُ أَبْطَأَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَعَنَهُ فَلَمَّا أَصْبَحَ قَالَتْ لَهُ أُمُّ الدَّرْدَاءِ سَمِعْتُكَ اللَّيْلَةَ لَعَنْتَ خَادِمَكَ حِينَ دَعَوْتَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ يَكُونُ اللَّعَّانُونَ شُفَعَاءَ وَلاَ شُهَدَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathaniy hafsu bnu maysaraaa, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, aanna 'abda almaliki, bna marwaana ba'atha iilaa aummi alddardaa'i biaanjaadin min 'indihi falammaa aan kaana dhaata laylaain qaama 'abdu almaliki mina alllayli fada'aa khaadimahu fakaaannahu aabtaaa 'alayhi fala'anahu falammaa aasbaha qaalat lahu aummu alddardaa'i sami'tuka alllaylaaa la'anta khaadimaka hiyna da'awtahu ‏.‏ faqaalat sami'tu aabaa alddardaa'i yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa yakuwnu allla''aanuwna shufa'aa'a walaa shuhadaa'a yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Aslam reported that 'Abd al-Malik b. Marwan sent some domestic goods for decoration to Umm Darda' on his own behalf, and when it was night 'Abd al-Malik got up and called for the servant. It seemed as if he (the servant) was late (in responding to his call), so he ('Abd al-Malik) invoked curse upon him, and when it was morning Umm Darda' said to him:I heard you cursing your servant during the night when you called him, and she said: I heard Abu Darda' as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: The invoker of curse would neither be intercessor nor witness on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ وَعَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ التَّيْمِيُّ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِ مَعْنَى حَدِيثِ حَفْصِ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu wa'aasimu bnu alnnadri alttaymiyyu qaaluwa haddathanaa mu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, kilaahumaa 'an ma'marin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi bimithli ma'naa hadiythi hafsi bni maysaraaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zaid b. Aslam with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاوِيَةُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، وَأَبِي، حَازِمٍ عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّعَّانِينَ لاَ يَكُونُونَ شُهَدَاءَ وَلاَ شُفَعَاءَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa mu'aawiyaau bnu hishaamin, 'an hishaami bni sa'din, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, waaabiy, haazimin 'an aummi alddardaa'i, 'an aabiy alddardaa'i, sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna allla''aaniyna laa yakuwnuwna shuhadaa'a walaa shufa'aa'a yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Darda' reported on the authority of Abu Darda' as saying:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The invoker of curse would neither be witness nor intercessor on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، - يَعْنِيَانِ الْفَزَارِيَّ - عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ كَيْسَانَ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ادْعُ عَلَى الْمُشْرِكِينَ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لَمْ أُبْعَثْ لَعَّانًا وَإِنَّمَا بُعِثْتُ رَحْمَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa marwaanu, - ya'niyaani alfazaariyya - 'an yaziyda, - wahuwa abnu kaysaana - 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi ad'u 'alaa almushrikiyna qaala ‏ "‏ iinniy lam aub'ath la''aanana waiinnamaa bu'ithtu rahmaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported it was said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ):Invoke curse upon the polytheists, whereupon he said: I have not been sent as the invoker of curse, but I have been sent as mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ دَخَلَ عَلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاَنِ فَكَلَّمَاهُ بِشَىْءٍ لاَ أَدْرِي مَا هُوَ فَأَغْضَبَاهُ فَلَعَنَهُمَا وَسَبَّهُمَا فَلَمَّا خَرَجَا قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَنْ أَصَابَ مِنَ الْخَيْرِ شَيْئًا مَا أَصَابَهُ هَذَانِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ قُلْتُ لَعَنْتَهُمَا وَسَبَبْتَهُمَا قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوَمَا عَلِمْتِ مَا شَارَطْتُ عَلَيْهِ رَبِّي قُلْتُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ فَأَىُّ الْمُسْلِمِينَ لَعَنْتُهُ أَوْ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْهُ لَهُ زَكَاةً وَأَجْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat dakhala 'alaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaani fakallamaahu bishaa'in laa aadriy maa huwa faaaghdabaahu fala'anahumaa wasabbahumaa falammaa kharajaa qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi man aasaaba mina alkhayri shayiana maa aasaabahu hadhaani qaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat qultu la'antahumaa wasababtahumaa qaala ‏"‏ aawamaa 'alimti maa shaarattu 'alayhi rabbiy qultu alllahumma iinnamaa aanaa basharun faaaaau almuslimiyna la'antuhu aaw sababtuhu faaj'alhu lahu zakaaaan waaajrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that two persons visited Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and both of them talked about a thing, of which I am not aware, but that annoyed him and he invoked curse upon both of them and hurled malediction, and when they went out I said:Allah's Messenger, the good would reach everyone but it would not reach these two. He said: Why so? I said: Because you have invoked curse and hurled malediction upon both of them. He said: Don't you know that I have made condition with my Lord saying thus: O Allah, I am a human being and that for a Muslim upon whom I invoke curse or hurl malediction make it a source of purity and reward
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِ عِيسَى فَخَلَوَا بِهِ فَسَبَّهُمَا وَلَعَنَهُمَا وَأَخْرَجَهُمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaahu 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, jamiy'ana 'an 'iysaa bni yuwnusa, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi jariyrin waqaala fiy hadiythi 'iysaa fakhalawaa bihi fasabbahumaa wala'anahumaa waaakhrajahumaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been reported on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters and the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Isa (the words are):" He had a private meeting with them and hurled malediction upon them and cursed them and sent them out
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ فَأَيُّمَا رَجُلٍ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ سَبَبْتُهُ أَوْ لَعَنْتُهُ أَوْ جَلَدْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْهَا لَهُ زَكَاةً وَرَحْمَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinnamaa aanaa basharun faaayyumaa rajulin mina almuslimiyna sababtuhu aaw la'antuhu aaw jaladtuhu faaj'alhaa lahu zakaaaan warahmaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:O Allah, I am a human being and for any person amongst Muslims upon whom I hurl malediction or invoke curse or give him whipping make it a source of purity and mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ إِلاَّ أَنَّ فِيهِ ‏ "‏ زَكَاةً وَأَجْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu iilaaa aanna fiyhi ‏ "‏ zakaaaan waaajrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) a hadith like it but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِإِسْنَادِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ عِيسَى جَعَلَ ‏"‏ وَأَجْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَجَعَلَ ‏"‏ وَرَحْمَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِي حَدِيثِ جَابِرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, biiisnaadi 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin ‏.‏ mithla hadiythihi ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythi 'iysaa ja'ala ‏"‏ waaajrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fiy hadiythi aabiy hurayraaa waja'ala ‏"‏ warahmaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fiy hadiythi jaabirin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of A'mash and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of 'Isa the words are:Make it a source of reward, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira (the words are):" Make it a source of mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَّخِذُ عِنْدَكَ عَهْدًا لَنْ تُخْلِفَنِيهِ فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ فَأَىُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ آذَيْتُهُ شَتَمْتُهُ لَعَنْتُهُ جَلَدْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْهَا لَهُ صَلاَةً وَزَكَاةً وَقُرْبَةً تُقَرِّبُهُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alhizaamiyya - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aattakhidhu 'indaka 'ahdana lan tukhlifaniyhi faiinnamaa aanaa basharun faaaaau almuuminiyna adhaytuhu shatamtuhu la'antuhu jaladtuhu faaj'alhaa lahu salaaaan wazakaaaan waqurbaaan tuqarribuhu bihaa iilayka yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:O Allah, I make a covenant with Thee against which Thou wouldst never go. I am a human being and thus for a Muslim whom I give any harm or whom I scold or upon whom I invoke curse or whom I beat, make this a source of blessing, purification and nearness to Thee on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الزِّنَادِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ إِلاَّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَوْ جَلَدُّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو الزِّنَادِ وَهِيَ لُغَةُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَإِنَّمَا هِيَ ‏"‏ جَلَدْتُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, haddathanaa aabuw alzzinaadi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu iilaaa aannahu qaala ‏"‏ aaw jaladduhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw alzzinaadi wahiya lughaau aabiy hurayraaa waiinnamaa hiya ‏"‏ jaladtuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Zinad with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy sulaymaanu bnu ma'badin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu harbin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been reported on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، مَوْلَى النَّصْرِيِّينَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّمَا مُحَمَّدٌ بَشَرٌ يَغْضَبُ كَمَا يَغْضَبُ الْبَشَرُ وَإِنِّي قَدِ اتَّخَذْتُ عِنْدَكَ عَهْدًا لَنْ تُخْلِفَنِيهِ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ آذَيْتُهُ أَوْ سَبَبْتُهُ أَوْ جَلَدْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْهَا لَهُ كَفَّارَةً وَقُرْبَةً تُقَرِّبُهُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an saalimin, mawlaa alnnasriyyiyna qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinnamaa muhammadun basharun yaghdabu kamaa yaghdabu albasharu waiinniy qadi attakhadhtu 'indaka 'ahdana lan tukhlifaniyhi faaayyumaa muuminin adhaytuhu aaw sababtuhu aaw jaladtuhu faaj'alhaa lahu kaffaaraaan waqurbaaan tuqarribuhu bihaa iilayka yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim, the freed slave of Nasriyyin, said:I heard Abu Huraira as saying that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: O Allah, Muhammad is a human being. I lose my temper just as human beings lose temper, and I have held a covenant with Thee which Thou wouldst not break: For a believer whom I give any trouble or invoke curse or beat, make that an expiation (of his sins and a source of) his nearness to Thee on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ فَأَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ لَهُ قُرْبَةً إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma faaayyumaa 'abdin muuminin sababtuhu faaj'al dhalika lahu qurbaaan iilayka yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:O Allah, for any believing servant whom I curse make that as a source of nearness to Thee on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَخِي ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ عَمِّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي اتَّخَذْتُ عِنْدَكَ عَهْدًا لَنْ تُخْلِفَنِيهِ فَأَيُّمَا مُؤْمِنٍ سَبَبْتُهُ أَوْ جَلَدْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْ ذَلِكَ كَفَّارَةً لَهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa abnu aakhiy abni shihaabin, 'an 'ammihi, haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy attakhadhtu 'indaka 'ahdana lan tukhlifaniyhi faaayyumaa muuminin sababtuhu aaw jaladtuhu faaj'al dhalika kaffaaraaan lahu yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I have held covenant with Thee which Thou wouldst not break, so for any believer whom I curse or beat, make that an expiation on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَأَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ، بْنُ يُونُسَ حَدَّثَنَا عِكْرِمَةُ بْنُ عَمَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كَانَتْ عِنْدَ أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ يَتِيمَةٌ وَهِيَ أُمُّ أَنَسٍ فَرَأَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْيَتِيمَةَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ آنْتِ هِيَهْ لَقَدْ كَبِرْتِ لاَ كَبِرَ سِنُّكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَرَجَعَتِ الْيَتِيمَةُ إِلَى أُمِّ سُلَيْمٍ تَبْكِي فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ مَا لَكِ يَا بُنَيَّةُ قَالَتِ الْجَارِيَةُ دَعَا عَلَىَّ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ لاَ يَكْبَرَ سِنِّي فَالآنَ لاَ يَكْبَرُ سِنِّي أَبَدًا - أَوْ قَالَتْ قَرْنِي - فَخَرَجَتْ أُمُّ سُلَيْمٍ مُسْتَعْجِلَةً تَلُوثُ خِمَارَهَا حَتَّى لَقِيَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا لَكِ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَتْ يَا نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ أَدَعَوْتَ عَلَى يَتِيمَتِي قَالَ ‏"‏ وَمَا ذَاكِ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ زَعَمَتْ أَنَّكَ دَعَوْتَ أَنْ لاَ يَكْبَرَ سِنُّهَا وَلاَ يَكْبَرَ قَرْنُهَا - قَالَ - فَضَحِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أُمَّ سُلَيْمٍ أَمَا تَعْلَمِينَ أَنَّ شَرْطِي عَلَى رَبِّي أَنِّي اشْتَرَطْتُ عَلَى رَبِّي فَقُلْتُ إِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ أَرْضَى كَمَا يَرْضَى الْبَشَرُ وَأَغْضَبُ كَمَا يَغْضَبُ الْبَشَرُ فَأَيُّمَا أَحَدٍ دَعَوْتُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أُمَّتِي بِدَعْوَةٍ لَيْسَ لَهَا بِأَهْلٍ أَنْ تَجْعَلَهَا لَهُ طَهُورًا وَزَكَاةً وَقُرْبَةً يُقَرِّبُهُ بِهَا مِنْهُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو مَعْنٍ يُتَيِّمَةٌ ‏.‏ بِالتَّصْغِيرِ فِي الْمَوَاضِعِ الثَّلاَثَةِ مِنَ الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waaabuw ma'nin alrraqaashiyyu - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa 'umaru, bnu yuwnusa haddathanaa 'ikrimaau bnu 'ammaarin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu aabiy talhaaa, haddathaniy aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala kaanat 'inda aummi sulaymin yatiymaaun wahiya aummu aanasin faraaaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alyatiymaaa faqaala ‏"‏ anti hiyah laqad kabirti laa kabira sinnuki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faraja'ati alyatiymaau iilaa aummi sulaymin tabkiy faqaalat aummu sulaymin maa laki yaa bunayyaau qaalati aljaariyaau da'aa 'alaaaa nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aan laa yakbara sinniy faalana laa yakbaru sinniy aabadana - aaw qaalat qarniy - fakharajat aummu sulaymin musta'jilaaan taluwthu khimaarahaa hattaa laqiyat rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lahaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa laki yaa aumma sulaymin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaalat yaa nabiyya alllahi aada'awta 'alaa yatiymatiy qaala ‏"‏ wamaa dhaaki yaa aumma sulaymin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat za'amat aannaka da'awta aan laa yakbara sinnuhaa walaa yakbara qarnuhaa - qaala - fadahika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm thumma qaala ‏"‏ yaa aumma sulaymin aamaa ta'lamiyna aanna shartiy 'alaa rabbiy aanniy ashtarattu 'alaa rabbiy faqultu iinnamaa aanaa basharun aardaa kamaa yardaa albasharu waaaghdabu kamaa yaghdabu albasharu faaayyumaa aahadin da'awtu 'alayhi min aummatiy bida'waain laysa lahaa biaahlin aan taj'alahaa lahu tahuwrana wazakaaaan waqurbaaan yuqarribuhu bihaa minhu yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw ma'nin yutayyimaaun ‏.‏ bialttasghiyri fiy almawaadi'i althhalaathaai mina alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that there was an orphan girl with Umm Sulaim (who was the mother of Anas). Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw that orphan girl and said:O, it is you; you have grown young. May you not advance in years! That slave-girl returned to Umm Sulaim weeping. Umm Sulaim said: O daughter, what is the matter with you? She said: Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) has invoked curse upon me that I should not grow in age and thus I would never grow in age, or she said, in my (length) of life. Umm Sulaim went out wrapping her head-dress hurriedly until she met Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). He said to her: Umm Sulaim, what is the matter with you? She said: Allah's Apostle, you invoked curse upon my orphan girl. He said: Umm Sulaim, what is that? She said: She (the orphan girl) states you have cursed her saying that she might not grow in age or grow in life. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) smiled and then said: Umm Sulaim, don't you know that I have made this term with my Lord. And the term with my Lord is that I said to Him: 1 am a human being and I am pleased just as a human being is pleased and I lose temper just as a human being loses temper, so for any person from amongst my Ummah whom I curse and he in no way deserves it, let that, O Lord, be made a source of purification and purity and nearness to (Allah) on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ الْقَصَّابِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ مَعَ الصِّبْيَانِ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَتَوَارَيْتُ خَلْفَ بَابٍ - قَالَ - فَجَاءَ فَحَطَأَنِي حَطْأَةً وَقَالَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ وَادْعُ لِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجِئْتُ فَقُلْتُ هُوَ يَأْكُلُ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ قَالَ لِيَ ‏"‏ اذْهَبْ وَادْعُ لِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَجِئْتُ فَقُلْتُ هُوَ يَأْكُلُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ أَشْبَعَ اللَّهُ بَطْنَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى قُلْتُ لأُمَيَّةَ مَا حَطَأَنِي قَالَ قَفَدَنِي قَفْدَةً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, h wahaddathanaa abnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa aumayyaau bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy hamzaaa alqassaabi, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala kuntu aal'abu ma'a alssibyaani fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fatawaaraytu khalfa baabin - qaala - fajaa'a fahataaaniy hataaaan waqaala ‏"‏ adhhab waad'u liy mu'aawiyaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fajiitu faqultu huwa yaakulu - qaala - thumma qaala liya ‏"‏ adhhab waad'u liy mu'aawiyaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fajiitu faqultu huwa yaakulu faqaala ‏"‏ laa aashba'a alllahu batnahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu almuthannaa qultu laumayyaaa maa hataaaniy qaala qafadaniy qafdaaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported:I was playing with children that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by (us). I hid myself behind the door. He (the Prophet) came and patted my shoulders and said: Go and call Mu'awiya. I returned and said: He is busy in taking food. He again asked me to go and call Mu'awiya to him. I went (and came back) and said that he was busy in taking food, whereupon he said: May Allah not fill his belly! Ibn Muthanna, said: I asked Umm Umayya what he meant by the word Hatani. He said: It means "he patted my shoulders
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو حَمْزَةَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ كُنْتُ أَلْعَبُ مَعَ الصِّبْيَانِ فَجَاءَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَاخْتَبَأْتُ مِنْهُ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, haddathanaa shu'baau, aakhbaranaa aabuw hamzaaa sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu kuntu aal'abu ma'a alssibyaani fajaa'a rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faakhtabaatu minhu ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abbas with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّاسِ ذَا الْوَجْهَيْنِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي هَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ وَهَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna min sharri alnnaasi dhaa alwajhayni alladhiy yaatiy hauulaa'i biwajhin wahauulaa'i biwajhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The worst amongst the people is the double-faced one; he comes to some people with one face and to others with the other face
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ شَرَّ النَّاسِ ذُو الْوَجْهَيْنِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي هَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ وَهَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an 'iraaki bni maalikin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna sharra alnnaasi dhuw alwajhayni alladhiy yaatiy hauulaa'i biwajhin wahauulaa'i biwajhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The worst amongst people is one with the double face. He comes to some people with one face and to others with the other face
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَجِدُونَ مِنْ شَرِّ النَّاسِ ذَا الْوَجْهَيْنِ الَّذِي يَأْتِي هَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ وَهَؤُلاَءِ بِوَجْهٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaraniy abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'umaaraaa, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tajiduwna min sharri alnnaasi dhaa alwajhayni alladhiy yaatiy hauulaa'i biwajhin wahauulaa'i biwajhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:You will find the worst amongst the people one having double face. He comes to some people with one face and to the others with the other face
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 45 — The Book of Virtue, Enjoining Good Manners, and Joining of the Ties of Kinship
