verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laan aaquwla subhaana alllahi waalhamdu lillahi walaa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waalllahu aakbaru aahabbu iilaaaa mimmaa tala'at 'alayhi alshhamsu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The uttering of (these words):" Hallowed be Allah; all praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah and Allah is the Greatest," is dearer to me than anything over which the sun rises
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ عَنْ مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيُّ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ جَاءَ أَعْرَابِيٌّ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ عَلِّمْنِي كَلاَمًا أَقُولُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُلْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ كَبِيرًا وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ كَثِيرًا سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ الْعَزِيزِ الْحَكِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهَؤُلاَءِ لِرَبِّي فَمَا لِي قَالَ ‏"‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُوسَى أَمَّا عَافِنِي فَأَنَا أَتَوَهَّمُ وَمَا أَدْرِي ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَوْلَ مُوسَى ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, waabnu, numayrin 'an muwsaa aljuhaniyyi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa muwsaa aljuhaniyyu, 'an mus'abi bni sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, qaala jaa'a aa'raabiyyun iilaa rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala 'allimniy kalaamana aaquwluhu qaala ‏"‏ qul laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu alllahu aakbaru kabiyrana waalhamdu lillahi kathiyrana subhaana alllahi rabbi al'aalamiyna laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi al'aziyzi alhakiymi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fahauulaa'i lirabbiy famaa liy qaala ‏"‏ quli alllahumma aghfir liy waarhamniy waahdiniy waarzuqniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala muwsaa aammaa 'aafiniy faaanaa aatawahhamu wamaa aadriy ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri abnu aabiy shaybaaa fiy hadiythihi qawla muwsaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mu'sab b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that a desert Arab came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said to him:Teach me the words which I should (often) utter. He said: Utter," There is no god but Allah, the One, having no partner with Him. Allah is the Greatest of the great and all praise is due to Him. Hallowed be Allah, the Lord of the worlds, there is no Might and Power but that of Allah, the All-Powerful and the Wise." He (that desert Arab) said: These all (glorify) my Lord. But what about me? Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: You should say:" O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to righteousness and provide me sustenance." Musa (one of the narrators) said: I think he also said:" Grant me safety." But I cannot say for certain whether he said this or not. Ibn Abi Shaiba has not made a mention of the words of Musa in his narration
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُعَلِّمُ مَنْ أَسْلَمَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin - haddathanaa aabuw maalikin alaashja'iyyu 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yu'allimu man aaslama yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma aghfir liy waarhamniy waahdiniy waarzuqniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Malik Ashaja'i reported on the authority of his father that whenever a person embraced Islam, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) instructed him to recilte:" O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to the path of righteousness and provide me sustenance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَزْهَرَ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ إِذَا أَسْلَمَ عَلَّمَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم الصَّلاَةَ ثُمَّ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ يَدْعُوَ بِهَؤُلاَءِ الْكَلِمَاتِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَاهْدِنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aazhara alwaasitiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa aabuw maalikin alaashja'iyyu, 'an aabiyhi, qaala kaana alrrajulu iidhaa aaslama 'allamahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm alssalaaaa thumma aamarahu aan yad'uwa bihauulaa'i alkalimaati ‏ "‏ alllahumma aghfir liy waarhamniy waahdiniy wa'aafiniy waarzuqniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Malik reported on the authority of his father that when a person embraced Islam, Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to teach him how to observe prayer and then commanded him to supplicate in these words:" O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, direct me to the path of righteousness, grant me protection and provide me sustenance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ أَقُولُ حِينَ أَسْأَلُ رَبِّي قَالَ ‏"‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي وَارْحَمْنِي وَعَافِنِي وَارْزُقْنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَيَجْمَعُ أَصَابِعَهُ إِلاَّ الإِبْهَامَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّ هَؤُلاَءِ تَجْمَعُ لَكَ دُنْيَاكَ وَآخِرَتَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa aabuw maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waaataahu rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa aaquwlu hiyna aasaalu rabbiy qaala ‏"‏ quli alllahumma aghfir liy waarhamniy wa'aafiniy waarzuqniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wayajma'u aasaabi'ahu iilaaa aliibhaama ‏"‏ faiinna hauulaa'i tajma'u laka dunyaaka waakhirataka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Malik reported on the authority Of his father that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying to the person who bad come to him and asked him as to how he should beg his Lord, that he should utter these words:" O Allah, grant me pardon, have mercy upon me, protect me, provide me sustenance," and he collected his fingers together except his thumb and said: It is in these words (that there is supplication) which sums up for you (the good) of this world and that of the Hereafter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى الْجُهَنِيُّ، عَنْ مُصْعَبِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي قَالَ، كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏"‏ أَيَعْجِزُ أَحَدُكُمْ أَنْ يَكْسِبَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَأَلَهُ سَائِلٌ مِنْ جُلَسَائِهِ كَيْفَ يَكْسِبُ أَحَدُنَا أَلْفَ حَسَنَةٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ يُسَبِّحُ مِائَةَ تَسْبِيحَةٍ فَيُكْتَبُ لَهُ أَلْفُ حَسَنَةٍ أَوْ يُحَطُّ عَنْهُ أَلْفُ خَطِيئَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa marwaanu, wa'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an muwsaa aljuhaniyyi, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa muwsaa aljuhaniyyu, 'an mus'abi bni sa'din, haddathaniy aabiy qaala, kunnaa 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏"‏ aaya'jizu aahadukum aan yaksiba kulla yawmin aalfa hasanaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasaaalahu saaiilun min julasaaiihi kayfa yaksibu aahadunaa aalfa hasanaain qaala ‏"‏ yusabbihu miaiaaa tasbiyhaain fayuktabu lahu aalfu hasanaain aaw yuhattu 'anhu aalfu khatiyiaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mus'ab b. Sa'd reported that his father told him that he had been in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said:Is one amongst you powerless to get one thousand virtues every day. Amongst those who had been sitting there, one asked: How one amongst us can get one thousand virtues every day? He said: Recite:" Hallowed be Allah" one hundred times for (by reciting them) one thousand virtues are recorded (to your credit) and one tbousand vices are blotted out
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى التَّمِيمِيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ وَمَنْ يَسَّرَ عَلَى مُعْسِرٍ يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ وَمَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِمًا سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ وَمَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلاَّ نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّكِينَةُ وَغَشِيَتْهُمُ الرَّحْمَةُ وَحَفَّتْهُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةُ وَذَكَرَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِيمَنْ عِنْدَهُ وَمَنْ بَطَّأَ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa alttamiymiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i alhamdaaniyyu - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man naffasa 'an muuminin kurbaaan min kurabi alddunyaa naffasa alllahu 'anhu kurbaaan min kurabi yawmi alqiyaamaai waman yassara 'alaa mu'sirin yassara alllahu 'alayhi fiy alddunyaa waalakhiraai waman satara muslimana satarahu alllahu fiy alddunyaa waalakhiraai waalllahu fiy 'awni al'abdi maa kaana al'abdu fiy 'awni aakhiyhi waman salaka tariyqana yaltamisu fiyhi 'ilmana sahhala alllahu lahu bihi tariyqana iilaa aljannaai wamaa ajtama'a qawmun fiy baytin min buyuwti alllahi yatluwna kitaaba alllahi wayatadaarasuwnahu baynahum iilaaa nazalat 'alayhimu alssakiynaau waghashiyathumu alrrahmaau wahaffathumu almalaaiikaau wadhakarahumu alllahu fiyman 'indahu waman battaaa bihi 'amaluhu lam yusri' bihi nasabuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:He who alleviates the suffering of a brother out of the sufferings of the world, Allah would alleviate his suffering from the sufferings of the Day of Resurrection, and he who finds relief for one who is hard-pressed, Allah would make things easy for him in the Hereafter, and he who conceals (the faults) of a Muslim, Allah would conceal his faults in the world and in the Hereafter. Allah is at the back of a servant so long as the servant is at the back of his brother, and he who treads the path in search of knowledge, Allah would make that path easy, leading to Paradise for him and those persons who assemble in the house among the houses of Allah (mosques) and recite the Book of Allah and they learn and teach the Qur'an (among themselves) there would descend upon them tranquility and mercy would cover them and the angels would surround them and Allah mentions them in the presence of those near Him, and he who is slow-paced in doing good deeds, his (high) lineage does not make him go ahead
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّ حَدِيثَ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ لَيْسَ فِيهِ ذِكْرُ التَّيْسِيرِ عَلَى الْمُعْسِرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaahu nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, qaalaa haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy saalihin, wafiy hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa haddathanaa aabuw saalihin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa ghayra aanna hadiytha aabiy ausaamaaa laysa fiyhi dhikru alttaysiyri 'alaa almu'siri ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْحُومُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، عَنْ أَبِي نَعَامَةَ السَّعْدِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ خَرَجَ مُعَاوِيَةُ عَلَى حَلْقَةٍ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ فَقَالَ مَا أَجْلَسَكُمْ قَالُوا جَلَسْنَا نَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ ‏.‏ قَالَ آللَّهِ مَا أَجْلَسَكُمْ إِلاَّ ذَاكَ قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا أَجْلَسَنَا إِلاَّ ذَاكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَمَا إِنِّي لَمْ أَسْتَحْلِفْكُمْ تُهْمَةً لَكُمْ وَمَا كَانَ أَحَدٌ بِمَنْزِلَتِي مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقَلَّ عَنْهُ حَدِيثًا مِنِّي وَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ عَلَى حَلْقَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَجْلَسَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا جَلَسْنَا نَذْكُرُ اللَّهَ وَنَحْمَدُهُ عَلَى مَا هَدَانَا لِلإِسْلاَمِ وَمَنَّ بِهِ عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ آللَّهِ مَا أَجْلَسَكُمْ إِلاَّ ذَاكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ مَا أَجْلَسَنَا إِلاَّ ذَاكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا إِنِّي لَمْ أَسْتَحْلِفْكُمْ تُهْمَةً لَكُمْ وَلَكِنَّهُ أَتَانِي جِبْرِيلُ فَأَخْبَرَنِي أَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يُبَاهِي بِكُمُ الْمَلاَئِكَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa marhuwmu bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi, 'an aabiy na'aamaaa alssa'diyyi, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala kharaja mu'aawiyaau 'alaa halqaain fiy almasjidi faqaala maa aajlasakum qaaluwa jalasnaa nadhkuru alllaha ‏.‏ qaala alllahi maa aajlasakum iilaaa dhaaka qaaluwa waalllahi maa aajlasanaa iilaaa dhaaka ‏.‏ qaala aamaa iinniy lam aastahlifkum tuhmaaan lakum wamaa kaana aahadun bimanzilatiy min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqalla 'anhu hadiythana minniy waiinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja 'alaa halqaain min aashaabihi faqaala ‏"‏ maa aajlasakum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa jalasnaa nadhkuru alllaha wanahmaduhu 'alaa maa hadaanaa liliislaami wamanna bihi 'alaynaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ alllahi maa aajlasakum iilaaa dhaaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa waalllahi maa aajlasanaa iilaaa dhaaka ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ aamaa iinniy lam aastahlifkum tuhmaaan lakum walakinnahu aataaniy jibriylu faaakhbaraniy aanna alllaha 'azza wajalla yubaahiy bikumu almalaaiikaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Mu'awiya went to a circle in the mosque and said:What makes you sit here? They said: We are sitting here in order to remember Allah. He said: I adjure you by Allah (to tell me whether you are sitting here for this very purpose)? They said: By Allah, we are sitting here for this very purpose. Thereupon, he said: I have not demanded you to take an oath, because of any allegation against you and none of my rank in the eye of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) is the narrator of so few ahadith as I am. The fact is that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out to the circle of his Companions and said: What makes you sit? They said: We are sitting here in order to remember Allah and to praise Him for He guided us to the path of Islam and He conferred favours upon us. Thereupon he adjured by Allah and asked if that only was the purpose of their sitting there. They said: By Allah, we are not sitting here but for this very purpose, whereupon he (the Messenger) said: I am not asking you to take an oath because of any allegation against you but for the fact that Gabriel came to me and he informed me that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, was talking to the angels about your magnificence
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، قَالَ يَحْيَى أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنِ الأَغَرِّ الْمُزَنِيِّ، - وَكَانَتْ لَهُ صُحْبَةٌ - أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّهُ لَيُغَانُ عَلَى قَلْبِي وَإِنِّي لأَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, jamiy'ana 'an hammaadin, qaala yahyaa aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an thaabitin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'ani alaagharri almuzaniyyi, - wakaanat lahu suhbaaun - aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinnahu layughaanu 'alaa qalbiy waiinniy laastaghfiru alllaha fiy alyawmi miaiaaa marraain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Agharr al-Muzani, who was one amongst the Companions (of the Holy Prophet) reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:There is (at times) some sort of shade upon my heart, and I seek forgiveness from Allah a hundred times a day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، عَنْ أَبِي، بُرْدَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ الأَغَرَّ، وَكَانَ، مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُحَدِّثُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ تُوبُوا إِلَى اللَّهِ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ فِي الْيَوْمِ إِلَيْهِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, 'an aabiy, burdaaa qaala sami'tu alaagharra, wakaana, min aashaabi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm yuhaddithu abna 'umara qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu tuwbuwa iilaa alllahi faiinniy aatuwbu fiy alyawmi iilayhi miaiaaa marraain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Agharr al-Muzani who was from amongst the Companions of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) reported that Ibn 'Umar stated to him that Allah's Messenger (may peace 'be upon him) said:O people, seek repentance from Allah. Verily, I seek repentance from Him a hundred times a day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ يَعْنِي سُلَيْمَانَ بْنَ حَيَّانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ غِيَاثٍ - كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ هِشَامٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ حَسَّانَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنْ تَابَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin ya'niy sulaymaana bna hayyaana, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa hafsun, - ya'niy abna ghiyaathin - kulluhum 'an hishaamin, h wahaddathaniy aabuw khaythamaaa, zuhayru bnu harbin - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, bnu iibraahiyma 'an hishaami bni hassaana, 'an muhammadi bni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ man taaba qabla aan tatlu'a alshhamsu min maghribihaa taaba alllahu 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing:He who seeks repentance (from the Lord) before the rising of the sun from the west (before the Day of Resurrection), Allah turns to him with Mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ فَجَعَلَ النَّاسُ يَجْهَرُونَ بِالتَّكْبِيرِ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ ارْبَعُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ لَيْسَ تَدْعُونَ أَصَمَّ وَلاَ غَائِبًا إِنَّكُمْ تَدْعُونَ سَمِيعًا قَرِيبًا وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَنَا خَلْفَهُ وَأَنَا أَقُولُ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ بَلَى يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُلْ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa 'an 'aasimin, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin faja'ala alnnaasu yajharuwna bialttakbiyri faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aayyuhaa alnnaasu arba'uwa 'alaa aanfusikum iinnakum laysa tad'uwna aasamma walaa ghaaiibana iinnakum tad'uwna samiy'ana qariybana wahuwa ma'akum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala waaanaa khalfahu waaanaa aaquwlu laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi faqaala ‏"‏ yaa 'abda alllahi bna qaysin aalaa aadulluka 'alaa kanzin min kunuwzi aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu balaa yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ qul laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported:We were along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) on a journey when the people began to pronounce "Allahu Akbar" in a loud voice. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: O people, show mercy to yourselves for you are not calling One who is deaf or absent. Verily, you are calling One who is All-Hearing (and) Near to you and is with you. Abu Musa said that he had been behind him (the Prophet) and reciting: "There is neither might nor power but that of Allah." He (the Prophet), while addressing 'Abdullah b. Qais, said: Should I not direct you to a treasure from amongst the treasures of Paradise? I ('Abdullah b. Qais) said: Allah's Messenger, do it, of course. Thereupon he (the Prophet) said: Then recite: "There is no might and no power but that of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ جَمِيعًا عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ، غِيَاثٍ عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju jamiy'ana 'an hafsi bni, ghiyaathin 'an 'aasimin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زُرَيْعٍ - حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُمْ يَصْعَدُونَ فِي ثَنِيَّةٍ - قَالَ - فَجَعَلَ رَجُلٌ كُلَّمَا عَلاَ ثَنِيَّةً نَادَى لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَ اللَّهُ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ - قَالَ - فَقَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّكُمْ لاَ تُنَادُونَ أَصَمَّ وَلاَ غَائِبًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا مُوسَى - أَوْ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ قَيْسٍ - أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَلِمَةٍ مِنْ كَنْزِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ مَا هِيَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin haddathanaa yaziydu, - ya'niy abna zuray'in - haddathanaa alttaymiyyu, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an aabiy muwsaa, aannahum kaanuwa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahum yas'aduwna fiy thaniyyaain - qaala - faja'ala rajulun kullamaa 'alaa thaniyyaaan naadaa laa iilaha iilaa alllahu waalllahu aakbaru - qaala - faqaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnakum laa tunaaduwna aasamma walaa ghaaiibana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa muwsaa - aaw yaa 'abda alllahi bna qaysin - aalaa aadulluka 'alaa kalimaain min kanzi aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu maa hiya yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported that he (and his other companions) were climbing upon the hillock along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and when any person climbed up, he pronounced (loudly):" There is no god but Allah, Allah is the Greatest." Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Verily, you are not supplicating One Who is deaf or absent. He said: Abu Musa or Abdullah b Qais, should I not direct you to the words (which form) the treasure of Paradise? I said: Allah's Messenger, what are these? He said:" There is no might and no power but that of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, 'an aabiyhi, haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala baynamaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Musa with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، وَأَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي، عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي سَفَرٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ عَاصِمٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa khalafu bnu hishaamin, waaabuw alrrabiy'i, qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy, 'uthmaana 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala kunnaa ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy safarin ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi 'aasimin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa reported:We were along with Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) on a journey; the rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by A'sim
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزَاةٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِيهِ ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي تَدْعُونَهُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مِنْ عُنُقِ رَاحِلَةِ أَحَدِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ذِكْرُ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa althhaqafiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an aabiy muwsaa, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazaaain ‏.‏ fadhakara alhadiytha waqaala fiyhi ‏ "‏ waalladhiy tad'uwnahu aaqrabu iilaa aahadikum min 'unuqi raahilaai aahadikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walaysa fiy hadiythihi dhikru laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa, reported. We were along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in an expedition. The rest of the hadith is the same (and there is an addi- tion of these words in that):" He (the Holy Prophet) said: He Whom you are sup- plicating is nearer to every one of you than the neck of his camel." And there is no mention of these words:" There is no might and no power but that of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ غِيَاثٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَى كَلِمَةٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ - أَوْ قَالَ - عَلَى كَنْزٍ مِنْ كُنُوزِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ بَلَى ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, - wahuwa abnu ghiyaathin - haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, 'an aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalaa aadulluka 'alaa kalimaain min kunuwzi aljannaai - aaw qaala - 'alaa kanzin min kunuwzi aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu balaa ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laa hawla walaa quwwaaa iilaaa bialllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him:Should I not direct you to the words from the treasures of Paradise, or he said: Like a treasure from the treasures of Paradise? I said: Of course, do that. Thereupon he said:" There is no might and no power but that of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلِّمْنِي دُعَاءً أَدْعُو بِهِ فِي صَلاَتِي قَالَ ‏ "‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِي ظُلْمًا كَبِيرًا - وَقَالَ قُتَيْبَةُ كَثِيرًا - وَلاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَغْفِرَةً مِنْ عِنْدِكَ وَارْحَمْنِي إِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْغَفُورُ الرَّحِيمُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'amrinw, 'an aabiy bakrin, aannahu qaala lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'allimniy du'aa'an aad'uw bihi fiy salaatiy qaala ‏ "‏ quli alllahumma iinniy zalamtu nafsiy zulmana kabiyrana - waqaala qutaybaau kathiyrana - walaa yaghfiru aldhhunuwba iilaaa aanta faaghfir liy maghfiraaan min 'indika waarhamniy iinnaka aanta alghafuwru alrrahiymu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakr reported that he said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ):Teach me a supplication which I should recite in my prayer. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: Recite:" O Allah, I have done great wrong to myself." According to Qutaiba (the words were: ) much (wrong) -there is none to forgive the sins but Thou only, say:" Grant me pardon from Thyself, have mercy upon me for Thou art much Forgiving and Compassionate
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي رَجُلٌ، سَمَّاهُ وَعَمْرُو بْنُ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ الصِّدِّيقَ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلِّمْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ دُعَاءً أَدْعُو بِهِ فِي صَلاَتِي وَفِي بَيْتِي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ اللَّيْثِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ ظُلْمًا كَثِيرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy rajulun, sammaahu wa'amruw bnu alhaarithi 'an yaziyda bna aabiy habiybin, 'an aabiy alkhayri, aannahu sami'a 'abda alllahi bni 'amriw bni al'aasi, yaquwlu iinna aabaa bakrin alssiddiyqa qaala lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'allimniy yaa rasuwla alllahi du'aa'an aad'uw bihi fiy salaatiy wafiy baytiy ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi alllaythi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ zulmana kathiyrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Amr b. al-'As that Abu Bakr Siddiq said to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) Allah's Messenger, teach me a supplication which I should make in my prayer and in my house. The rest of the hadith is the same except with this variation that he said:Much wrong (Zulman Kathira)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَدْعُو بِهَؤُلاَءِ الدَّعَوَاتِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ النَّارِ وَعَذَابِ النَّارِ وَفِتْنَةِ الْقَبْرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْغِنَى وَمِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْفَقْرِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ فِتْنَةِ الْمَسِيحِ الدَّجَّالِ اللَّهُمَّ اغْسِلْ خَطَايَاىَ بِمَاءِ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ وَنَقِّ قَلْبِي مِنَ الْخَطَايَا كَمَا نَقَّيْتَ الثَّوْبَ الأَبْيَضَ مِنَ الدَّنَسِ وَبَاعِدْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ خَطَايَاىَ كَمَا بَاعَدْتَ بَيْنَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَالْمَغْرِبِ اللَّهُمَّ فَإِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْمَأْثَمِ وَالْمَغْرَمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa abnu, numayrin haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yad'uw bihauulaa'i aldda'awaati ‏ "‏ alllahumma faiinniy aa'uwdhu bika min fitnaai alnnaari wa'adhaabi alnnaari wafitnaai alqabri wa'adhaabi alqabri wamin sharri fitnaai alghinaa wamin sharri fitnaai alfaqri waaa'uwdhu bika min sharri fitnaai almasiyhi alddajjaali alllahumma aghsil khataayaaaa bimaa'i althhalji waalbaradi wanaqqi qalbiy mina alkhataayaa kamaa naqqayta althhawba alaabyada mina alddanasi wabaa'id bayniy wabayna khataayaaaa kamaa baa'adta bayna almashriqi waalmaghribi alllahumma faiinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina alkasali waalharami waalmaathami waalmaghrami ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to make these supplications:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the trial of Hell-Fire; and from the torment of Hell-Fire; and from the trial of the grave and torment of the grave; and from the evil of the trial of the affluence and from the evil of the trial of poverty and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of the turmoil of the Dajjal. O Allah, wash away my sins with snow and hail water, purify my heart from the sins as is purified the white garment from the dirt, and keep away at a distance the sins from me as yawns the distance between the East and the West; O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from senility, from sin, and from debt
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، وَوَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, wawakiy'un, 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ، بْنُ مَالِكٍ قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, qaala waaakhbaranaa sulaymaanu alttaymiyyu, haddathanaa aanasu, bnu maalikin qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina al'ajzi waalkasali waaljubni waalharami waalbukhli waaa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabi alqabri wamin fitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from incapacity, from indolence, from cowardice, from senility, from miserliness, and I seek refuge in Thee from the torment of the grave and from trial of the life and death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ يَزِيدَ لَيْسَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَوْلُهُ ‏ "‏ وَمِنْ فِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, kilaahumaa 'ani alttaymiyyi, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aanna yaziyda laysa fiy hadiythihi qawluhu ‏ "‏ wamin fitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (this suppli- cation) but with this variation that these words are not found in that supplication:" From the trial of life and death
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُبَارَكٍ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ تَعَوَّذَ مِنْ أَشْيَاءَ ذَكَرَهَا وَالْبُخْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i aakhbaranaa abnu mubaarakin, 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu ta'awwadha min aashyaa'a dhakarahaa waalbukhli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to seek refuge in Allah from such things as mentioned in the above-mentioned hadith and from 'miserliness" too
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزُ بْنُ أَسَدٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ الأَعْوَرُ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ الْحَبْحَابِ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْعُو بِهَؤُلاَءِ الدَّعَوَاتِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْبُخْلِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَرْذَلِ الْعُمُرِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ وَفِتْنَةِ الْمَحْيَا وَالْمَمَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa bahzu bnu aasadin al'ammiyyu, haddathanaa haaruwnu alaa'waru, haddathanaa shu'aybu bnu alhabhaabi, 'an aanasin, qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm yad'uw bihauulaa'i aldda'awaati ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina albukhli waalkasali waaardhali al'umuri wa'adhaabi alqabri wafitnaai almahyaa waalmamaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) wed to make this supplication:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from miserliness, from sloth and from decrepitude
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي سُمَىٌّ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَعَوَّذُ مِنْ سُوءِ الْقَضَاءِ وَمِنْ دَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ وَمِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاءِ وَمِنْ جَهْدِ الْبَلاَءِ ‏.‏ قَالَ عَمْرٌو فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ سُفْيَانُ أَشُكُّ أَنِّي زِدْتُ وَاحِدَةً مِنْهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, haddathaniy sumaaaun, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yata'awwadhu min suw'i alqadaa'i wamin daraki alshhaqaa'i wamin shamaataai alaa'daa'i wamin jahdi albalaa'i ‏.‏ qaala 'amrunw fiy hadiythihi qaala sufyaanu aashukku aanniy zidtu waahidaaan minhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: It was narrated from Abu Huraira that:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to seek refuge (in Allah) from the evil of what has been decreed, from misery, from the mockery of (triumphant) enemies, and from severe calamity. `Amr (one of the narrators) said in his narration: "Sufyan said: 'I fear I may have added one of them (the phrases)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، وَاللَّفْظُ، لَهُ أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ يَعْقُوبَ، أَنَّ يَعْقُوبَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ بُسْرَ بْنَ سَعِيدٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتَ حَكِيمٍ السُّلَمِيَّةَ، تَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ نَزَلَ مَنْزِلاً ثُمَّ قَالَ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَضُرُّهُ شَىْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْ مَنْزِلِهِ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu rumhin, waalllafzu, lahu aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'ani alhaarithi bni ya'quwba, aanna ya'quwba bna 'abdi alllahi, haddathahu aannahu, sami'a busra bna sa'iydin, yaquwlu sami'tu sa'da bna aabiy waqqaasin, yaquwlu sami'tu khawlaaa binta hakiymin alssulamiyyaaa, taquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man nazala manzilaan thumma qaala aa'uwdhu bikalimaati alllahi alttaammaati min sharri maa khalaqa ‏.‏ lam yadurruhu shaa'un hattaa yartahila min manzilihi dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Khaula bint Hakim Sulamiyya reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When anyone lands at a place, and then says:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He has created," nothing would harm him until he marches from that stopping place
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَأَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِهَارُونَ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا عَمْرٌو، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ الْحَارِثِ - أَنَّ يَزِيدَ بْنَ أَبِي، حَبِيبٍ وَالْحَارِثَ بْنَ يَعْقُوبَ حَدَّثَاهُ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الأَشَجِّ، عَنْ بُسْرِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي وَقَّاصٍ، عَنْ خَوْلَةَ بِنْتِ حَكِيمٍ السُّلَمِيَّةِ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتْ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِذَا نَزَلَ أَحَدُكُمْ مَنْزِلاً فَلْيَقُلْ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَضُرُّهُ شَىْءٌ حَتَّى يَرْتَحِلَ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يَعْقُوبُ وَقَالَ الْقَعْقَاعُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ عَنْ ذَكْوَانَ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا لَقِيتُ مِنْ عَقْرَبٍ لَدَغَتْنِي الْبَارِحَةَ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمَا لَوْ قُلْتَ حِينَ أَمْسَيْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ لَمْ تَضُرُّكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, waaabuw alttaahiri, kilaahumaa 'ani abni wahbin, - waalllafzu lihaaruwna - haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, qaala waaakhbaranaa 'amrunw, - wahuwa abnu alhaarithi - aanna yaziyda bna aabiy, habiybin waalhaaritha bna ya'quwba haddathaahu 'an ya'quwba bni 'abdi alllahi bni alaashajji, 'an busri bni sa'iydin, 'an sa'di bni aabiy waqqaasin, 'an khawlaaa binti hakiymin alssulamiyyaai, aannahaa sami'at rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iidhaa nazala aahadukum manzilaan falyaqul aa'uwdhu bikalimaati alllahi alttaammaati min sharri maa khalaqa ‏.‏ faiinnahu laa yadurruhu shaa'un hattaa yartahila minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ya'quwbu waqaala alqa'qaa'u bnu hakiymin 'an dhakwaana aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aannahu qaala jaa'a rajulun iilaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi maa laqiytu min 'aqrabin ladaghatniy albaarihaaa qaala ‏"‏ aamaa law qulta hiyna aamsayta aa'uwdhu bikalimaati alllahi alttaammaati min sharri maa khalaqa lam tadurruka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Khaula bint Hakim Sulamiyya reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When any one of you stays at a place, he should say:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of that He created." Nothing would then do him any harm until he moves from that place. Abu Huraira reported that a person came to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and said:" Allah's Messenger, I was stung by a scorpion during the night. Thereupon he said: Had you recited these words in the evening:" I seek refuge in the Perfect Word of Allah from the evil of what He created," it would not have done any harm to you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عِيسَى بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمِصْرِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ أَبِي حَبِيبٍ، عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ، أَنَّهُ ذَكَرَ لَهُ أَنَّ أَبَا صَالِحٍ، مَوْلَى غَطَفَانَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ لَدَغَتْنِي عَقْرَبٌ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'iysaa bnu hammaadin almisriyyu, aakhbaraniy alllaythu, 'an yaziyda bni aabiy habiybin, 'an ja'farin, 'an ya'quwba, aannahu dhakara lahu aanna aabaa saalihin, mawlaa ghatafaana aakhbarahu aannahu, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi ladaghatniy 'aqrabun ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni wahbin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي الْبَرَاءُ بْنُ عَازِبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا أَخَذْتَ مَضْجَعَكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وُضُوءَكَ لِلصَّلاَةِ ثُمَّ اضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّكَ الأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ وَاجْعَلْهُنَّ مِنْ آخِرِ كَلاَمِكَ فَإِنْ مُتَّ مِنْ لَيْلَتِكَ مُتَّ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَرَدَّدْتُهُنَّ لأَسْتَذْكِرَهُنَّ فَقُلْتُ آمَنْتُ بِرَسُولِكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ قُلْ آمَنْتُ بِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu li'uthmaana - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, haddathaniy albaraa'u bnu 'aazibin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa aakhadhta madja'aka fatawaddaa wuduw'aka lilssalaaai thumma adtaji' 'alaa shiqqika alaaymani thumma quli alllahumma iinniy aaslamtu wajhiy iilayka wafawwadtu aamriy iilayka waaaljaatu zahriy iilayka raghbaaan warahbaaan iilayka laa maljaaa walaa manjaa minka iilaaa iilayka amantu bikitaabika alladhiy aanzalta wabinabiyyika alladhiy aarsalta waaj'alhunna min akhiri kalaamika faiin mutta min laylatika mutta waaanta 'alaa alfitraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faraddadtuhunna laastadhkirahunna faqultu amantu birasuwlika alladhiy aarsalta qaala ‏"‏ qul amantu binabiyyika alladhiy aarsalta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that Allah's, Messenger (may peace be upon said:When you go to bed, perform ablution as is done for prayer; then lie down pn the right side and recite:" O Allah, I turn my face towards Thee and entrust my affair to Thee. I retreat unto Thee for protection with hope in Thee and fear of Thee. There is no resort and no deliverer (from hardship) but Thou only. I affirm my faith in Thine books which Thou revealed and in Thine Apostles whom Thou sent." Make this as the last word of yours (when you go to sleep) and in case you die during that night, you would die upon Fitra (upon Islam). And as I repeated these words in order to commit them to memory, I said:" I affirm my faith in Thy Messenger (Rasul) whom Thou sent." He said: Say:" I affirm my faith in the Apostle (Nabi) whom Thou sent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِدْرِيسَ - قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حُصَيْنًا، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِهَذَا الْحَدِيثِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ مَنْصُورًا أَتَمُّ حَدِيثًا وَزَادَ فِي حَدِيثِ حُصَيْنٍ ‏ "‏ وَإِنْ أَصْبَحَ أَصَابَ خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, - ya'niy abna iidriysa - qaala sami'tu husaynana, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bihadhaa alhadiythi ghayra aanna mansuwrana aatammu hadiythana wazaada fiy hadiythi husaynin ‏ "‏ waiin aasbaha aasaaba khayrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib with a slight variation of wording and there is this addition in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Husain:" In case you get up in the morning, you will get up with bliss
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعْدَ بْنَ عُبَيْدَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ رَجُلاً إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ أَنْ يَقُولَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْكَ وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْكَ وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْكَ وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْكَ رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْكَ لاَ مَلْجَأَ وَلاَ مَنْجَا مِنْكَ إِلاَّ إِلَيْكَ آمَنْتُ بِكِتَابِكَ الَّذِي أَنْزَلْتَ وَبِرَسُولِكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ ‏.‏ فَإِنْ مَاتَ مَاتَ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ مِنَ اللَّيْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw daawuda, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathanaa abnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, waaabuw daawuda qaalaa haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'amriw bni murraaa, qaala sami'tu sa'da bna 'ubaydaaa, yuhaddithu 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara rajulaan iidhaa aakhadha madja'ahu mina alllayli aan yaquwla ‏ "‏ alllahumma aaslamtu nafsiy iilayka wawajjahtu wajhiy iilayka waaaljaatu zahriy iilayka wafawwadtu aamriy iilayka raghbaaan warahbaaan iilayka laa maljaaa walaa manjaa minka iilaaa iilayka amantu bikitaabika alladhiy aanzalta wabirasuwlika alladhiy aarsalta ‏.‏ faiin maata maata 'alaa alfitraai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri abnu bashhaarin fiy hadiythihi mina alllayli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that Allah's Messenger (in may peace be upon him) commanded a person (in these words):When you go to bed during night, you should say:" O Allah, I surrender myself to Thee and entrust my affair to Thee, with hope in Thee and fear of Thee. There is no resort and no deliverer (from hardship but Thou). I affirm my faith in the Book which Thou revealed and in the Messengers whom Thou sent." If you die in this state you would die on Fitra, and Ibn Bashshdr did not make a mention of" night" in this hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ، عَازِبٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لِرَجُلٍ ‏"‏ يَا فُلاَنُ إِذَا أَوَيْتَ إِلَى فِرَاشِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ عَمْرِو بْنِ مُرَّةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَبِنَبِيِّكَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلْتَ ‏.‏ فَإِنْ مُتَّ مِنْ لَيْلَتِكَ مُتَّ عَلَى الْفِطْرَةِ وَإِنْ أَصْبَحْتَ أَصَبْتَ خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa aabuw alaahwasi, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'ani albaraa'i bni, 'aazibin qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm lirajulin ‏"‏ yaa fulaanu iidhaa aawayta iilaa firaashika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi 'amriw bni murraaa ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ wabinabiyyika alladhiy aarsalta ‏.‏ faiin mutta min laylatika mutta 'alaa alfitraai waiin aasbahta aasabta khayrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to a person:O, so and so, as you go to your bed; the rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation of wording that he said:" Thine Apostle whom Thou sent." If you die that night you would die on Fitra and if you get up in the morning you would get up with a bliss
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي، إِسْحَاقَ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ الْبَرَاءَ بْنَ عَازِبٍ، يَقُولُ أَمَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَجُلاً ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏ "‏ وَإِنْ أَصْبَحْتَ أَصَبْتَ خَيْرًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy, iishaaqa aannahu sami'a albaraa'a bna 'aazibin, yaquwlu aamara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulaan ‏.‏ bimithlihi walam yadhkur ‏ "‏ waiin aasbahta aasabta khayrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of al-Bara' b. 'Azib that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) commanded a person (in these words) and there is no mention of this:" if you get up in the morning you would get up with a bliss
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي السَّفَرِ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ اللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ أَحْيَا وَبِاسْمِكَ أَمُوتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا اسْتَيْقَظَ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy alssafari, 'an aabiy bakri bni aabiy muwsaa, 'ani albaraa'i, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aakhadha madja'ahu qaala ‏"‏ alllahumma biasmika aahyaa wabiasmika aamuwtu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waiidhaa astayqaza qaala ‏"‏ alhamdu lillahi alladhiy aahyaanaa ba'da maa aamaatanaa waiilayhi alnnushuwru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' reported that whenever Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went to bed, he said:" O Allah, it is with Thine Name that I live and it is with Thine Name that I die." And when he got up he used to say:" Praise is due to Allah, Who gave us life after our death (sleep) and unto Thee is resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ أَمَرَ رَجُلاً إِذَا أَخَذَ مَضْجَعَهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ خَلَقْتَ نَفْسِي وَأَنْتَ تَوَفَّاهَا لَكَ مَمَاتُهَا وَمَحْيَاهَا إِنْ أَحْيَيْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا وَإِنْ أَمَتَّهَا فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَافِيَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ أَسَمِعْتَ هَذَا مِنْ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مِنْ عُمَرَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ نَافِعٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ سَمِعْتُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu mukramin al'ammiyyu, waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in qaalaa haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an khaalidin, qaala sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna alhaarithi, yuhaddithu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aannahu aamara rajulaan iidhaa aakhadha madja'ahu qaala ‏ "‏ alllahumma khalaqta nafsiy waaanta tawaffaahaa laka mamaatuhaa wamahyaahaa iin aahyaytahaa faahfazhaa waiin aamattahaa faaghfir lahaa alllahumma iinniy aasaaluka al'aafiyaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala lahu rajulun aasami'ta hadhaa min 'umara faqaala min khayrin min 'umara min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qaala abnu naafi'in fiy riwaayatihi 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi ‏.‏ walam yadhkur sami'tu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar commanded a person that as he went to bed, he should say:" O Allah, Thou created my being and it is for Thee to take it to its ultimate goal. And its death and life is due to Thee, and if Thou givest it life, safeguard it; and if Thou bringst death, grant it pardon. O Allah, I beg of Thee safety." A person said to him: Did you hear it from Umar? Thereupon he said: (I have heard from one) who is better than Umar, viz. from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Ibn Nafi, reported this on the authority of Abdullah b. Harith but he did not make mention of this" that he heard it himself
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، قَالَ كَانَ أَبُو صَالِحٍ يَأْمُرُنَا إِذَا أَرَادَ أَحَدُنَا أَنْ يَنَامَ أَنْ يَضْطَجِعَ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبَّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ رَبَّنَا وَرَبَّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَالِقَ الْحَبِّ وَالنَّوَى وَمُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَالإِنْجِيلِ وَالْفُرْقَانِ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهِ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الأَوَّلُ فَلَيْسَ قَبْلَكَ شَىْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الآخِرُ فَلَيْسَ بَعْدَكَ شَىْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الظَّاهِرُ فَلَيْسَ فَوْقَكَ شَىْءٌ وَأَنْتَ الْبَاطِنُ فَلَيْسَ دُونَكَ شَىْءٌ اقْضِ عَنَّا الدَّيْنَ وَأَغْنِنَا مِنَ الْفَقْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَ يَرْوِي ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, qaala kaana aabuw saalihin yaamurunaa iidhaa aaraada aahadunaa aan yanaama aan yadtaji'a 'alaa shiqqihi alaaymani thumma yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma rabba alssamawaati warabba alaardi warabba al'arshi al'aziymi rabbanaa warabba kulli shaa'in faaliqa alhabbi waalnnawaa wamunzila alttawraaai waaliinjiyli waalfurqaani aa'uwdhu bika min sharri kulli shaa'in aanta akhidhun binaasiyatihi alllahumma aanta alaawwalu falaysa qablaka shaa'un waaanta alakhiru falaysa ba'daka shaa'un waaanta alzzaahiru falaysa fawqaka shaa'un waaanta albaatinu falaysa duwnaka shaa'un aqdi 'annaa alddayna waaaghninaa mina alfaqri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakaana yarwiy dhalika 'an aabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Suhail reported that Abu Salih used to command us (in these words):When any one of you intends to go to sleep, he should lie on the bed on his right side and then say:" O Allah. the Lord of the Heavens and the Lord of the Earth and Lord of the Magnificent Throne, our Lord, and the Lord of evervthina, the Splitter of the grain of corn and the datestone (or fruit kernal), the Revealer of Torah and Injil (Bible) and Criterion (the Holy Qur'an), I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of every- thing Thou art to sieze by the forelock (Thou hast perfect control over it). O Allah, Thou art the First, there is naught before Thee, and Thou art the Last and there is naught after Thee, and Thou art Evident and there is nothing above Thee, and Thou art Innermost and there is nothing beyond Thee. Remove the burden of debt from us and relieve us from want." Abu Salih used to narrate it from Abu Huraira who narrated it from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ بَيَانٍ الْوَاسِطِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي الطَّحَّانَ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَأْمُرُنَا إِذَا أَخَذْنَا مَضْجَعَنَا أَنْ نَقُولَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ جَرِيرٍ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ دَابَّةٍ أَنْتَ آخِذٌ بِنَاصِيَتِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alhamiydi bnu bayaanin alwaasitiyyu, haddathanaa khaalidun, - ya'niy alttahhaana - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaamurunaa iidhaa aakhadhnaa madja'anaa aan naquwla ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi jariyrin waqaala ‏ "‏ min sharri kulli daabbaain aanta akhidhun binaasiyatihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to command us that as we go to our bedo, we should utter the words (as mention- ed above) and he also said (these words):" From the evil of every animal, Thou hast hold upon its forelock (Thou bast full control over it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي، شَيْبَةَ وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُبَيْدَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي، صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ أَتَتْ فَاطِمَةُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَسْأَلُهُ خَادِمًا فَقَالَ لَهَا ‏ "‏ قُولِي اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ سُهَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy, shaybaaa waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'ubaydaaa, haddathanaa aabiy kilaahumaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy, saalihin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala aatat faatimaau alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm tasaaluhu khaadimana faqaala lahaa ‏ "‏ quwliy alllahumma rabba alssamawaati alssab'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi suhaylin 'an aabiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Fatima (the daughter of the Holy Prophet) came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and asked for a servant. He said to her:Say:" O Allah, the Lord of the seven heavens" ; the rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مُوسَى الأَنْصَارِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَوَى أَحَدُكُمْ إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَلْيَأْخُذْ دَاخِلَةَ إِزَارِهِ فَلْيَنْفُضْ بِهَا فِرَاشَهُ وَلْيُسَمِّ اللَّهَ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَعْلَمُ مَا خَلَفَهُ بَعْدَهُ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ فَإِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَضْطَجِعَ فَلْيَضْطَجِعْ عَلَى شِقِّهِ الأَيْمَنِ وَلْيَقُلْ سُبْحَانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ رَبِّي بِكَ وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي وَبِكَ أَرْفَعُهُ إِنْ أَمْسَكْتَ نَفْسِي فَاغْفِرْ لَهَا وَإِنْ أَرْسَلْتَهَا فَاحْفَظْهَا بِمَا تَحْفَظُ بِهِ عِبَادَكَ الصَّالِحِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu muwsaa alaansaariyyu, haddathanaa aanasu bnu 'iyaadin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, haddathaniy sa'iydu bnu aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyu, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa aawaa aahadukum iilaa firaashihi falyaakhudh daakhilaaa iizaarihi falyanfud bihaa firaashahu walyusammi alllaha faiinnahu laa ya'lamu maa khalafahu ba'dahu 'alaa firaashihi faiidhaa aaraada aan yadtaji'a falyadtaji' 'alaa shiqqihi alaaymani walyaqul subhaanaka alllahumma rabbiy bika wada'tu janbiy wabika aarfa'uhu iin aamsakta nafsiy faaghfir lahaa waiin aarsaltahaa faahfazhaa bimaa tahfazu bihi 'ibaadaka alssaalihiyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing:When any one of you goes to bed, he should take hold of the hem of his lower garment and then should clean (his bed) with the help of that and then should recite the name of Allah for he himself does tiot know what he left behind him on his bed, and when he intends to lie on bed, he should lie on his right side and utter these words:" Hallowed be Allah, my Lord. It is with Thine (grace) that I place my side (upon the bed) and it is with Thee that I take it up (after sleep), and in case Thou withholdst my being (if thou causest me to die), then grant pardon to my being, and if Thou keepst (this process of breathing on), then protect it with that with which Thou protected Thine pious servants
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدَةُ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ ثُمَّ لْيَقُلْ بِاسْمِكَ رَبِّي وَضَعْتُ جَنْبِي فَإِنْ أَحْيَيْتَ نَفْسِي فَارْحَمْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa 'abdaau, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ thumma lyaqul biasmika rabbiy wada'tu janbiy faiin aahyayta nafsiy faarhamhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ubaidullah b. Umar with the same chain of transmitters and he said:Then utter:" My Lord. with Thine name I place my side and if Thou keepest me alive have mercy upon myself
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا أَوَى إِلَى فِرَاشِهِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَكَفَانَا وَآوَانَا فَكَمْ مِمَّنْ لاَ كَافِيَ لَهُ وَلاَ مُئْوِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, 'an hammaadi bni salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa aawaa iilaa firaashihi qaala ‏ "‏ alhamdu lillahi alladhiy aat'amanaa wasaqaanaa wakafaanaa waawaanaa fakam mimman laa kaafiya lahu walaa muiwiya ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When you go to bed, say:" Praise is due to Allah Who fed us, provided us drink, sufficed us and provided us with shelter, for many a people there is none to suffice and none to provide shelter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ فَرْوَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ الأَشْجَعِيِّ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَمَّا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدْعُو بِهِ اللَّهَ قَالَتْ كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaalaa aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an hilaalin, 'an farwaaa bni nawfalin alaashja'iyyi, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa 'ammaa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yad'uw bihi alllaha qaalat kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min sharri maa 'amiltu wamin sharri maa lam aa'mal ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Farwa' b. Naufal Ashja'i reported:I asked: 'A'isha, in what words did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) supplicate Allah? She said that he used to utter:" I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I did and from the evil of what I did not
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، عَنْ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ فَرْوَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ عَائِشَةَ عَنْ دُعَاءٍ، كَانَ يَدْعُو بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَتْ كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَشَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, 'an husaynin, 'an hilaalin, 'an farwaaa bni nawfalin, qaala saaaltu 'aaiishaaa 'an du'aa'in, kaana yad'uw bihi rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaalat kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min sharri maa 'amiltu washarri maa lam aa'mal ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Farwa' b. Naufal reported:I asked 'A'isha about the supplication that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) made. She said that he used to say:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I have done and from the evil of what I have not done
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ حُصَيْنٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ‏ "‏ وَمِنْ شَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu, bnu 'amriw bni jabalaaa haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, 'an husaynin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi muhammadi bni ja'farin ‏ "‏ wamin sharri maa lam aa'mal ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Muhammad b. ja'far through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنِ الأَوْزَاعِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي لُبَابَةَ، عَنْ هِلاَلِ بْنِ يَسَافٍ، عَنْ فَرْوَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ فِي دُعَائِهِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا عَمِلْتُ وَشَرِّ مَا لَمْ أَعْمَلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu haashimin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'ani alaawzaa'iyyi, 'an 'abdaaa bni aabiy lubaabaaa, 'an hilaali bni yasaafin, 'an farwaaa bni nawfalin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu fiy du'aaiihi ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min sharri maa 'amiltu washarri maa lam aa'mal ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Farwa' b. Naufal reported on the authority of 'A'isha that Allah's Mes- senger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words):" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of what I did and from the evil of what I did not
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَمْرٍو أَبُو مَعْمَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحُسَيْنُ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ بُرَيْدَةَ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ يَعْمُرَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ أَسْلَمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَيْكَ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْكَ أَنَبْتُ وَبِكَ خَاصَمْتُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِعِزَّتِكَ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَنْ تُضِلَّنِي أَنْتَ الْحَىُّ الَّذِي لاَ يَمُوتُ وَالْجِنُّ وَالإِنْسُ يَمُوتُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
