verses.translit: haddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'amrinw aabuw ma'marin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, haddathanaa alhusaynu, haddathaniy abnu buraydaaa, 'an yahyaa bni ya'mura, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma laka aaslamtu wabika amantu wa'alayka tawakkaltu waiilayka aanabtu wabika khaasamtu alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bi'izzatika laa iilaha iilaaa aanta aan tudillaniy aanta alhaaau alladhiy laa yamuwtu waaljinnu waaliinsu yamuwtuwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say:" O Allah, it is unto Thee that I surrender myself. I affirm my faith in Thee and repose my trust in Thee and turn to Thee in repentance and with Thy help fought my adversaries. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee with Thine Power; there is no god but Thou, lest Thou leadest me astray. Thou art ever-living that dieth not, while the Jinn and mankind die
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ، بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا كَانَ فِي سَفَرٍ وَأَسْحَرَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ سَمَّعَ سَامِعٌ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَحُسْنِ بَلاَئِهِ عَلَيْنَا رَبَّنَا صَاحِبْنَا وَأَفْضِلْ عَلَيْنَا عَائِذًا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, 'an suhayli, bni aabiy saalihin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa kaana fiy safarin waaashara yaquwlu ‏ "‏ samma'a saami'un bihamdi alllahi wahusni balaaiihi 'alaynaa rabbanaa saahibnaa waaafdil 'alaynaa 'aaiidhana bialllahi mina alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) set out on a journey in the morning, he used to say:" A listener listened to our praising Allah (for) His goodly trial of us. Our Lord! acompany us, guard us and bestow upon us Thy grace. I am seeker of refuge in Allah from the Fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى الأَشْعَرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَدْعُو بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي خَطِيئَتِي وَجَهْلِي وَإِسْرَافِي فِي أَمْرِي وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي جِدِّي وَهَزْلِي وَخَطَئِي وَعَمْدِي وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ عِنْدِي اللَّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ وَمَا أَسْرَرْتُ وَمَا أَعْلَنْتُ وَمَا أَنْتَ أَعْلَمُ بِهِ مِنِّي أَنْتَ الْمُقَدِّمُ وَأَنْتَ الْمُؤَخِّرُ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aabiy burdaaa bni aabiy muwsaa alaash'ariyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yad'uw bihadhaa alddu'aa'i ‏ "‏ alllahumma aghfir liy khatiyiatiy wajahliy waiisraafiy fiy aamriy wamaa aanta aa'lamu bihi minniy alllahumma aghfir liy jiddiy wahazliy wakhataiiy wa'amdiy wakullu dhalika 'indiy alllahumma aghfir liy maa qaddamtu wamaa aakhhartu wamaa aasrartu wamaa aa'lantu wamaa aanta aa'lamu bihi minniy aanta almuqaddimu waaanta almuuakhhiru waaanta 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Musa Ash'ari reported on the authority of his father that Allahs Apostle (ﷺ) used to supplicate in these words:" O Allah, forgive me my faults, my ignorance, my immoderation in my concerns. And Thou art better aware (of my affairs) than myself. O Allah, grant me forgiveness (of the faults which I committed) seriously or otherwise (and which I committed inadvertently and de- liberately. All these (failings) are in me. O Allah, grant me forgiveness from the fault which I did in haste or deferred, which I committed in privacy or in public and Thou art better aware of (them) than myself. Thou art the First and the Last and over all things Thou art Omnipotent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ الصَّبَّاحِ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu alssabbaahi almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa shu'baau, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو قَطَنٍ، عَمْرُو بْنُ الْهَيْثَمِ الْقُطَعِيُّ عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ، بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ الْمَاجِشُونِ عَنْ قُدَامَةَ بْنِ مُوسَى، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ السَّمَّانِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ أَصْلِحْ لِي دِينِيَ الَّذِي هُوَ عِصْمَةُ أَمْرِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي دُنْيَاىَ الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَاشِي وَأَصْلِحْ لِي آخِرَتِي الَّتِي فِيهَا مَعَادِي وَاجْعَلِ الْحَيَاةَ زِيَادَةً لِي فِي كُلِّ خَيْرٍ وَاجْعَلِ الْمَوْتَ رَاحَةً لِي مِنْ كُلِّ شَرٍّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu diynaarin, haddathanaa aabuw qatanin, 'amruw bnu alhaythami alquta'iyyu 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi, bni 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy salamaaa almaajishuwni 'an qudaamaaa bni muwsaa, 'an aabiy saalihin alssammaani, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma aaslih liy diyniya alladhiy huwa 'ismaau aamriy waaaslih liy dunyaaaa allatiy fiyhaa ma'aashiy waaaslih liy akhiratiy allatiy fiyhaa ma'aadiy waaj'ali alhayaaaa ziyaadaaan liy fiy kulli khayrin waaj'ali almawta raahaaan liy min kulli sharrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words):" O Allah, set right for me my religion which is the safeguard of my affairs. And set right for me the affairs of my world wherein is my living. And set right for me my Hereafter on which depends my after-life. And make the life for me (a source) of abundance for every good and make my death a source of comfort for me protecting me against every evil
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَحْوَصِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالتُّقَى وَالْعَفَافَ وَالْغِنَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy iishaaqa, 'an aabiy alaahwasi, 'an 'abdi alllahi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aasaaluka alhudaa waalttuqaa waal'afaafa waalghinaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (in these words):" O Allah. I beg of Thee the right guidance, safeguard against evils, chastity and freedom from want
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي، إِسْحَاقَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ ابْنَ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ ‏ "‏ وَالْعِفَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiy, iishaaqa bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu ghayra aanna abna almuthannaa, qaala fiy riwaayatihi ‏ "‏ waal'iffaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ishaq with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآَخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنْ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ، وَعَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَرْقَمَ، قَالَ لاَ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ إِلاَّ كَمَا كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَالْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ اللَّهُمَّ آتِ نَفْسِي تَقْوَاهَا وَزَكِّهَا أَنْتَ خَيْرُ مَنْ زَكَّاهَا أَنْتَ وَلِيُّهَا وَمَوْلاَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ لاَ يَنْفَعُ وَمِنْ قَلْبٍ لاَ يَخْشَعُ وَمِنْ نَفْسٍ لاَ تَشْبَعُ وَمِنْ دَعْوَةٍ لاَ يُسْتَجَابُ لَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, - waalllafzu laibni numayrin - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alaakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'an 'aasimin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi, wa'an aabiy 'uthmaana alnnahdiyyi, 'an zaydi bni aarqama, qaala laa aaquwlu lakum iilaaa kamaa kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina al'ajzi waalkasali waaljubni waalbukhli waalharami wa'adhaabi alqabri alllahumma ati nafsiy taqwaahaa wazakkihaa aanta khayru man zakkaahaa aanta waliyyuhaa wamawlaahaa alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min 'ilmin laa yanfa'u wamin qalbin laa yakhsha'u wamin nafsin laa tashba'u wamin da'waain laa yustajaabu lahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zaid b. Alqam reported:I am not going to say anything but only that which Allah's Messenger (may peace be upgn him) used to say. He used to supplicate:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from incapacity, from sloth, from cowardice, from miserliness, decrepitude and from torment of the grave. O Allah, grant to my soul the sense of righteousness and purify it, for Thou art the Best Purifier thereof. Thou art the Protecting Friend thereof, and Guardian thereof. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the knowledge which does not benefit, from the heart that does not entertain the fear (of Allah), from the soul that does not feel contented and the supplication that is not responded
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ بْنُ زِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سُوَيْدٍ النَّخَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ فَحَدَّثَنِي الزُّبَيْدُ أَنَّهُ حَفِظَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ فِي هَذَا ‏"‏ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ اللَّهُمَّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi bnu ziyaadin, 'ani alhasani bni 'ubaydi alllahi, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu suwaydin alnnakha'iyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu yaziyda, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aamsaa qaala ‏"‏ aamsaynaa waaamsaa almulku lillahi waalhamdu lillahi laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alhasanu fahaddathaniy alzzubaydu aannahu hafiza 'an iibraahiyma fiy hadhaa ‏"‏ lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun alllahumma aasaaluka khayra hadhihi alllaylaai waaa'uwdhu bika min sharri hadhihi alllaylaai washarri maa ba'dahaa alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina alkasali wasuw'i alkibari alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabin fiy alnnaari wa'adhaabin fiy alqabri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate:" We entered upon evening and the whole Kingdom of Allah also entered upon evening and praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, the One Who has no partner with Him." Hasan said that Zubaid reported to him that he memorised it from Ibrahim in these very words." His is the Sovereignty and Praise is due to Him, and He is Potent over everything. O Allah, I beg of Thee the good of this night and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of this night and the evil which follows it. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from the evil of vanity. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from torment in the Hell-Fire and from torment in the grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أُرَاهُ قَالَ فِيهِنَّ ‏"‏ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرَ مَا بَعْدَهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهَا رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَإِذَا أَصْبَحَ قَالَ ذَلِكَ أَيْضًا ‏"‏ أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alhasani bni 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an iibraahiyma, bni suwaydin 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala kaana nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aamsaa qaala ‏"‏ aamsaynaa waaamsaa almulku lillahi waalhamdu lillahi laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala auraahu qaala fiyhinna ‏"‏ lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun rabbi aasaaluka khayra maa fiy hadhihi alllaylaai wakhayra maa ba'dahaa waaa'uwdhu bika min sharri maa fiy hadhihi alllaylaai washarri maa ba'dahaa rabbi aa'uwdhu bika mina alkasali wasuw'i alkibari rabbi aa'uwdhu bika min 'adhaabin fiy alnnaari wa'adhaabin fiy alqabri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waiidhaa aasbaha qaala dhalika aaydana ‏"‏ aasbahnaa waaasbaha almulku lillahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported that when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate:" We have entered upon evening and so, too, the whole Kingdom of Allah has entered upon evening. Praise is due to Allah. There is no god but Allah, the One having no partner with Him." He (the narrator) said: I think that he also uttered (in this supplication these words):" His is tne Sovercignty and to Him is praise due and He is Potent over everything. My Lord, I beg of Thee good that lies in this night and good that follows it and I seek refuge in Thee from the evil that lies in this night and from the evil of that which follows it. My Lord, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from the evil of vanity. My Lord, I seek refuge in Thee from torment of the Hell-Fire and from torment of the grave." And when it was morning he said like this:" We entered upon morning and the whole Kingdom of Allah enter ed upon morning
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ، عَنْ زَائِدَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ، عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَمْسَى قَالَ ‏"‏ أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِ هَذِهِ اللَّيْلَةِ وَخَيْرِ مَا فِيهَا وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا وَشَرِّ مَا فِيهَا اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَالْهَرَمِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ وَفِتْنَةِ الدُّنْيَا وَعَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ وَزَادَنِي فِيهِ زُبَيْدٌ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سُوَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ رَفَعَهُ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa husaynu bnu 'aliyyin, 'an zaaiidaaa, 'ani alhasani bni, 'ubaydi alllahi 'an iibraahiyma bni suwaydin, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa aamsaa qaala ‏"‏ aamsaynaa waaamsaa almulku lillahi waalhamdu lillahi laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu alllahumma iinniy aasaaluka min khayri hadhihi alllaylaai wakhayri maa fiyhaa waaa'uwdhu bika min sharrihaa washarri maa fiyhaa alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika mina alkasali waalharami wasuw'i alkibari wafitnaai alddunyaa wa'adhaabi alqabri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alhasanu bnu 'ubaydi alllahi wazaadaniy fiyhi zubaydun 'an iibraahiyma bni suwaydin 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni yaziyda 'an 'abdi alllahi rafa'ahu aannahu qaala ‏"‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu laa shariyka lahu lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa 'alaa kulli shaa'in qadiyrun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported that when it was evening Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate:" We have entered upon evening and so has the Kingdom of Allah entere d upon evening; praise is due to Allah, there is no god but Allah the One, and there is no partner with Him. O Allah, I beg of Thee the blessing of this night and the blessing of that which lies in it. I seek refuge in Thee from the evil of it and what lies in it. O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from sloth, from decrepitude, from the evil of vanity, from trial of the world, and from torment of the grave." Zubaid, through another chain of transmitters, has narrated on the authority of Abdullah directly this addition:" There is no god but Allah, the One, there is no partner with Him, His is the Sovereignty and to Him is praise due and He is Potent over everything
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ أَعَزَّ جُنْدَهُ وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ وَغَلَبَ الأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ فَلاَ شَىْءَ بَعْدَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu wahdahu aa'azza jundahu wanasara 'abdahu waghalaba alaahzaaba wahdahu falaa shaa'a ba'dahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenge; (ﷺ) used to supplicate thus:" There is no god but Allah, the One Who conferred upon His armies the honour of victory and helped His servant rout the clans; there is nothing after that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عَاصِمَ بْنَ كُلَيْبٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ اهْدِنِي وَسَدِّدْنِي وَاذْكُرْ بِالْهُدَى هِدَايَتَكَ الطَّرِيقَ وَالسَّدَادِ سَدَادَ السَّهْمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, qaala sami'tu 'aasima bna kulaybin, 'an aabiy burdaaa, 'an 'aliyyin, qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ quli alllahumma ahdiniy wasaddidniy waadhkur bialhudaa hidaayataka alttariyqa waalssadaadi sadaada alssahmi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ali reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him:Say," O Allah, direct me to the right path and make me adhere to the straight path," and when you make a mention of right guidance, keep in mind the right path and when you consider of the straight (path), keep in mind the straightness of the arrow
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِدْرِيسَ - أَخْبَرَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ كُلَيْبٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ قَالَ قَالَ لِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قُلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْهُدَى وَالسَّدَادَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi, - ya'niy abna iidriysa - aakhbaranaa 'aasimu bnu kulaybin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi qaala qaala liy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ quli alllahumma iinniy aasaaluka alhudaa waalssadaada ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Asim b. Kulaib with the same chain of transmitters that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to me:Say:" O Allah, I beg of Thee righteousness and adhering to the straight path
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، مَوْلَى آلِ طَلْحَةَ عَنْ كُرَيْبٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِهَا بُكْرَةً حِينَ صَلَّى الصُّبْحَ وَهِيَ فِي مَسْجِدِهَا ثُمَّ رَجَعَ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَضْحَى وَهِيَ جَالِسَةٌ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا زِلْتِ عَلَى الْحَالِ الَّتِي فَارَقْتُكِ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَقَدْ قُلْتُ بَعْدَكِ أَرْبَعَ كَلِمَاتٍ ثَلاَثَ مَرَّاتٍ لَوْ وُزِنَتْ بِمَا قُلْتِ مُنْذُ الْيَوْمِ لَوَزَنَتْهُنَّ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy 'umara - qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, mawlaa ali talhaaa 'an kuraybin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an juwayriyaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja min 'indihaa bukraaan hiyna sallaa alssubha wahiya fiy masjidihaa thumma raja'a ba'da aan aadhaa wahiya jaalisaaun faqaala ‏"‏ maa zilti 'alaa alhaali allatiy faaraqtuki 'alayhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat na'am ‏.‏ qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laqad qultu ba'daki aarba'a kalimaatin thalaatha marraatin law wuzinat bimaa qulti mundhu alyawmi lawazanathunna subhaana alllahi wabihamdihi 'adada khalqihi waridaa nafsihi wazinaaa 'arshihi wamidaada kalimaatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Juwairiya reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out from (her apartment) in the morning as she was busy in observing her dawn prayer in her place of worship. He came back in the forenoon and she was still sitting there. He (the Holy Prophet) said to her:You have been in the same seat since I left you. She said: Yes. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: I recited four words three times after I left you and if these are to be weighed against what you have recited since morning these would outweigh them and (these words) are:" Hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him according to the number of His creation and according to the pleasure of His Self and according to the weight of His Throne and according to the ink (used in recording) words (for His Praise)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ بِشْرٍ، عَنْ مِسْعَرٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِي رِشْدِينَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، عَنْ جُوَيْرِيَةَ، قَالَتْ مَرَّ بِهَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حِينَ صَلَّى صَلاَةَ الْغَدَاةِ أَوْ بَعْدَ مَا صَلَّى الْغَدَاةَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ رِضَا نَفْسِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ زِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ مِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu 'an muhammadi bni bishrin, 'an mis'arin, 'an muhammadi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiy rishdiyna, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, 'an juwayriyaaa, qaalat marra bihaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hiyna sallaa salaaaa alghadaaai aaw ba'da maa sallaa alghadaaaa ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwahu ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ subhaana alllahi 'adada khalqihi subhaana alllahi ridaa nafsihi subhaana alllahi zinaaa 'arshihi subhaana alllahi midaada kalimaatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Juwairiya reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by her as she was observing her dawn prayer; or after she had observed her dawn prayer. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation that he said:" Hallowed be Allah according to the number of His creation, hallowed be Allah according to the pleasure of His Self, hallowed be Allah according to the weight of His Throne, hallowed be Allah according to the ink used in recording His words
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْحَكَمِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ أَبِي لَيْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيٌّ، أَنَّ فَاطِمَةَ، اشْتَكَتْ مَا تَلْقَى مِنَ الرَّحَى فِي يَدِهَا وَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبْىٌ فَانْطَلَقَتْ فَلَمْ تَجِدْهُ وَلَقِيَتْ عَائِشَةَ فَأَخْبَرَتْهَا فَلَمَّا جَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَخْبَرَتْهُ عَائِشَةُ بِمَجِيءِ فَاطِمَةَ إِلَيْهَا فَجَاءَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلَيْنَا وَقَدْ أَخَذْنَا مَضَاجِعَنَا فَذَهَبْنَا نَقُومُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ عَلَى مَكَانِكُمَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَعَدَ بَيْنَنَا حَتَّى وَجَدْتُ بَرْدَ قَدَمِهِ عَلَى صَدْرِي ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُعَلِّمُكُمَا خَيْرًا مِمَّا سَأَلْتُمَا إِذَا أَخَذْتُمَا مَضَاجِعَكُمَا أَنْ تُكَبِّرَا اللَّهَ أَرْبَعًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَتُسَبِّحَاهُ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ وَتَحْمَدَاهُ ثَلاَثًا وَثَلاَثِينَ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَكُمَا مِنْ خَادِمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alhakami, qaala sami'tu abna aabiy laylaa, haddathanaa 'aliyyun, aanna faatimaaa, ashtakat maa talqaa mina alrrahaa fiy yadihaa waaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sabaun faantalaqat falam tajidhu walaqiyat 'aaiishaaa faaakhbarathaa falammaa jaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm aakhbarathu 'aaiishaau bimajiy'i faatimaaa iilayhaa fajaa'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaynaa waqad aakhadhnaa madaaji'anaa fadhahabnaa naquwmu faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ 'alaa makaanikumaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqa'ada baynanaa hattaa wajadtu barda qadamihi 'alaa sadriy thumma qaala ‏"‏ aalaa au'allimukumaa khayrana mimmaa saaaltumaa iidhaa aakhadhtumaa madaaji'akumaa aan tukabbiraa alllaha aarba'ana wathalaathiyna watusabbihaahu thalaathana wathalaathiyna watahmadaahu thalaathana wathalaathiyna fahuwa khayrun lakumaa min khaadimin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is reported on the authority of Ali that Fatima had corns in her hand because of working at the hand-mill. There had fallen to the lot of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) some prisoners of war. She (Fatima) came to the Prophet (ﷺ) but she did not find him (in the house). She met A'isha and informed her (about her hardship). When Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) came, she (A'isha) informed him about the visit of Fatima. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to them (Fatima and her family). They had gone to their beds. 'Ali further (reported):We tried to stand up (as a mark of respect) but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Keep to your beds, and he sat amongst us and I felt the coldness of his feet upon my chest. He then said: May I not direct you to something better than what you have asked for? When you go to your bed, you should recite Takbir (Allah-o-Akbar) thirty-four times and Tasbih (Subhan Allah) thirty-three times and Tahmid (al-Hamdu li-Allah) thirty-three times, and that is better than the servant for you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ ‏ "‏ أَخَذْتُمَا مَضْجَعَكُمَا مِنَ اللَّيْلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythi mu'aadhin ‏ "‏ aakhadhtumaa madja'akumaa mina alllayli ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but. with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي يَزِيدَ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي طَالِبٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَعُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ الْحَكَمِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، وَزَادَ، فِي الْحَدِيثِ قَالَ عَلِيٌّ مَا تَرَكْتُهُ مُنْذُ سَمِعْتُهُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ قِيلَ لَهُ وَلاَ لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ قَالَ وَلاَ لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عَطَاءٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ وَلاَ لَيْلَةَ صِفِّينَ
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni aabiy yaziyda, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'an 'aliyyi bni aabiy taalibin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, wa'ubaydu bnu ya'iysha, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki, 'an 'ataa'i bni aabiy rabaahin, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, 'an 'aliyyin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi alhakami 'ani abni aabiy laylaa, wazaada, fiy alhadiythi qaala 'aliyyun maa taraktuhu mundhu sami'tuhu mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ qiyla lahu walaa laylaaa siffiyna qaala walaa laylaaa siffiyni ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi 'ataa'in 'an mujaahidin 'ani abni aabiy laylaa qaala qultu lahu walaa laylaaa siffiyna
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abi Laili but with this addition:" Ali said: Ever since I heard this (supplication) from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), I never abandoned it. It was said to him, Not even in the night of Siffin (battle of Siffin)? He sad: Yes, not even in the night of Siffin
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ صِيَاحَ الدِّيَكَةِ فَاسْأَلُوا اللَّهَ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ مَلَكًا وَإِذَا سَمِعْتُمْ نَهِيقَ الْحِمَارِ فَتَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ فَإِنَّهَا رَأَتْ شَيْطَانًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an ja'fari bni rabiy'aaa, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa sami'tum siyaaha alddiyakaai faasaaluwa alllaha min fadlihi faiinnahaa raaat malakana waiidhaa sami'tum nahiyqa alhimaari fata'awwadhuwa bialllahi mina alshhaytaani faiinnahaa raaat shaytaanana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing. When you listen to the crowing of the cock, ask Allah for His favour as it sees Angels and when you listen to the braying of the donkey, seek refuge in Allah from the Satan for it sees Satan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ سَعِيدٍ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ عِنْدَ الْكَرْبِ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ الْعَظِيمُ الْحَلِيمُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَرَبُّ الأَرْضِ وَرَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin - waalllafzu laibni sa'iydin - qaaluwa haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy al'aaliyaai, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu 'inda alkarbi ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu al'aziymu alhaliymu laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu rabbu al'arshi al'aziymi laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu rabbu alssamawaati warabbu alaardi warabbu al'arshi alkariymi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) used to supplicate during the time of trouble (in these words):" There is no god but Allah, the Great, the Tolerant, there is no god but Allah, the Lord of the Magnificent Throne There is no god but Allah, the Lord of the Heaven and the earth, the Lord of the Edifying Throne
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَحَدِيثُ مُعَاذِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ أَتَمُّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an hishaamin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wahadiythu mu'aadhi bni hishaamin aatammu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hisham with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، أَنَّ أَبَا الْعَالِيَةِ الرِّيَاحِيَّ، حَدَّثَهُمْ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَدْعُو بِهِنَّ وَيَقُولُهُنَّ عِنْدَ الْكَرْبِ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ رَبُّ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu bishrin al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, aanna aabaa al'aaliyaai alrriyaahiyya, haddathahum 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yad'uw bihinna wayaquwluhunna 'inda alkarbi fadhakara bimithli hadiythi mu'aadhi bni hishaamin 'an aabiyhi 'an qataadaaa ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ rabbu alssamawaati waalaardi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to supplicate (with these words) and he (uttered these words) at the time of trouble; the rest of the hadith is the same except with this difference that insted of saying:" The Lord of heaven and the earth," he said:" The Lord of the heaven and that of the earth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَالِيَةِ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ إِذَا حَزَبَهُ أَمْرٌ قَالَ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ وَزَادَ مَعَهُنَّ ‏ "‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْكَرِيمِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, aakhbaraniy yuwsufu bnu, 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi 'an aabiy al'aaliyaai, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana iidhaa hazabahu aamrun qaala ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi mu'aadhin 'an aabiyhi wazaada ma'ahunna ‏ "‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu rabbu al'arshi alkariymi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported this hadith through another chain of transmitters with a sliglit variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَبَّانُ بْنُ هِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجِسْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سُئِلَ أَىُّ الْكَلاَمِ أَفْضَلُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا اصْطَفَى اللَّهُ لِمَلاَئِكَتِهِ أَوْ لِعِبَادِهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa habbaanu bnu hilaalin, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa sa'iydun aljurayriyyu, 'an aabiy 'abdi alllahi aljisriyyi, 'ani abni alssaamiti, 'an aabiy dharrin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm suiila aaaau alkalaami aafdalu qaala ‏ "‏ maa astafaa alllahu limalaaiikatihi aaw li'ibaadihi subhaana alllahi wabihamdihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was asked as to which words were the best. He said:Those for which Allah made a choice for His Angels and His servants (and the words are):" Hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَبِي بُكَيْرٍ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْجَسْرِيِّ، مِنْ عَنَزَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الصَّامِتِ، عَنْ أَبِي ذَرٍّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكَ بِأَحَبِّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي بِأَحَبِّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَحَبَّ الْكَلاَمِ إِلَى اللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aabiy bukayrin, 'an shu'baaa, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy 'abdi alllahi aljasriyyi, min 'anazaaa 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alssaamiti, 'an aabiy dharrin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aalaa aukhbiruka biaahabbi alkalaami iilaa alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aakhbirniy biaahabbi alkalaami iilaa alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinna aahabba alkalaami iilaa alllahi subhaana alllahi wabihamdihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Should I not inform you about the words liked most by Allah? I said: Allah's Mes- senger, do inform me about the words liked most by Allah. He said: Verily, the words liked most by Allah are:" hallowed be Allah and praise is due to Him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ حَفْصٍ الْوَكِيعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَرِيزٍ، عَنْ أُمِّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ مُسْلِمٍ يَدْعُو لأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ إِلاَّ قَالَ الْمَلَكُ وَلَكَ بِمِثْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aahmadu bnu 'umara bni hafsin alwakiy'iyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu fudaylin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an talhaaa bni 'ubaydi alllahi bni kariyzin, 'an aummi alddardaa'i, 'an aabiy alddardaa'i, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa min 'abdin muslimin yad'uw laakhiyhi bizahri alghaybi iilaaa qaala almalaku walaka bimithlin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Dharr reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:There is no believing servant who supplicates for his brother behind his back (in his absence) that the Angels do not say: The same be for you too
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ سَرْوَانَ، الْمُعَلِّمُ حَدَّثَنِي طَلْحَةُ بْنُ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَرِيزٍ، قَالَ حَدَّثَتْنِي أُمُّ الدَّرْدَاءِ، قَالَتْ حَدَّثَنِي سَيِّدِي، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ مَنْ دَعَا لأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ قَالَ الْمَلَكُ الْمُوَكَّلُ بِهِ آمِينَ وَلَكَ بِمِثْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, haddathanaa muwsaa bnu sarwaana, almu'allimu haddathaniy talhaau bnu 'ubaydi alllahi bni kariyzin, qaala haddathatniy aummu alddardaa'i, qaalat haddathaniy sayyidiy, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ man da'aa laakhiyhi bizahri alghaybi qaala almalaku almuwakkalu bihi amiyna walaka bimithlin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Darda' reported:My husband reported that he heard Allah's Mes- senger (ﷺ) as saying: He who supplicates for his brother behind his back (in his absence), the Angel commissioned (for carrying supplication to his Lord) says: Amen, and it is for you also
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ أَبِي، سُلَيْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ - وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَهُ الدَّرْدَاءُ قَالَ قَدِمْتُ الشَّامَ فَأَتَيْتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ فِي مَنْزِلِهِ فَلَمْ أَجِدْهُ وَوَجَدْتُ أُمَّ الدَّرْدَاءِ فَقَالَتْ أَتُرِيدُ الْحَجَّ الْعَامَ فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا بِخَيْرٍ فَإِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ دَعْوَةُ الْمَرْءِ الْمُسْلِمِ لأَخِيهِ بِظَهْرِ الْغَيْبِ مُسْتَجَابَةٌ عِنْدَ رَأْسِهِ مَلَكٌ مُوَكَّلٌ كُلَّمَا دَعَا لأَخِيهِ بِخَيْرٍ قَالَ الْمَلَكُ الْمُوَكَّلُ بِهِ آمِينَ وَلَكَ بِمِثْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَخَرَجْتُ إِلَى السُّوقِ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا الدَّرْدَاءِ فَقَالَ لِي مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ يَرْوِيهِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu aabiy, sulaymaana 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an safwaana, - wahuwa abnu 'abdi alllahi bni safwaana - wakaanat tahtahu alddardaa'u qaala qadimtu alshhaama faaataytu aabaa alddardaa'i fiy manzilihi falam aajidhu wawajadtu aumma alddardaa'i faqaalat aaturiydu alhajja al'aama faqultu na'am ‏.‏ qaalat faad'u alllaha lanaa bikhayrin faiinna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yaquwlu ‏ "‏ da'waau almar'i almuslimi laakhiyhi bizahri alghaybi mustajaabaaun 'inda raasihi malakun muwakkalun kullamaa da'aa laakhiyhi bikhayrin qaala almalaku almuwakkalu bihi amiyna walaka bimithlin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fakharajtu iilaa alssuwqi falaqiytu aabaa alddardaa'i faqaala liy mithla dhalika yarwiyhi 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Safwan (and he was Ibn 'Abdullah b. Safwan, and he had been married to Umm Darda') reported:I visited Abu Darda's house in Syria. I did not find him there but Umm Darda' (was present at the house). She said: Do you intend to perform Hajj during this year? I said: Yes. She said: Do supplicate Allah for blessings upon us, for Allah's Apostle (may peace be upon hiin) used to say: The supplication of a Muslim for his brother at his back (in his absence) is responded so long as he makes a supplica- tion for blessings for his brother and the commissioned Angel says: Amen, and says: May it be for you too I I went to the bazar and met Abfi Dardi' and he narrated like this from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ أَبِي، سُلَيْمَانَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni aabiy, sulaymaana bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu waqaala 'an safwaana bni 'abdi alllahi bni safwaana, ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Safwan b. 'Abdullah b. Safwan with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ نُمَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ عَنْ زَكَرِيَّاءَ بْنِ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي بُرْدَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ، مَالِكٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَيَرْضَى عَنِ الْعَبْدِ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ الأَكْلَةَ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا أَوْ يَشْرَبَ الشَّرْبَةَ فَيَحْمَدَهُ عَلَيْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin - waalllafzu laibni numayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa wamuhammadu bnu bishrin 'an zakariyyaa'a bni aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy burdaaa, 'an aanasi bni, maalikin qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha layardaa 'ani al'abdi aan yaakula alaaklaaa fayahmadahu 'alayhaa aaw yashraba alshharbaaa fayahmadahu 'alayhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Allah is pleased with His servant who says: Al-Hamdu lillah while taking a morsel of food and while drinking
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ الأَزْرَقُ، حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu yuwsufa alaazraqu, haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is reported through Ishaaq bin Yusuf Al-Azraq from Zakariyya bin Abi Za'ida through the same chain
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى ابْنِ أَزْهَرَ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يُسْتَجَابُ لأَحَدِكُمْ مَا لَمْ يَعْجَلْ فَيَقُولُ قَدْ دَعَوْتُ فَلاَ أَوْ فَلَمْ يُسْتَجَبْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an aabiy 'ubaydin, mawlaa abni aazhara 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yustajaabu laahadikum maa lam ya'jal fayaquwlu qad da'awtu falaa aaw falam yustajab liy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The supplication of every one of you is granted if he does not grow impatient and says: I supplicated but it was not granted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ لَيْثٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ وَكَانَ مِنَ الْقُرَّاءِ وَأَهْلِ الْفِقْهِ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُسْتَجَابُ لأَحَدِكُمْ مَا لَمْ يَعْجَلْ فَيَقُولُ قَدْ دَعَوْتُ رَبِّي فَلَمْ يَسْتَجِبْ لِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni laythin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu khaalidin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aannahu qaala haddathaniy aabuw 'ubaydin, mawlaa 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin wakaana mina alqurraa'i waaahli alfiqhi qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yustajaabu laahadikum maa lam ya'jal fayaquwlu qad da'awtu rabbiy falam yastajib liy ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The supplication of one of you is granted if he does not grow impatient and say- I supplicated my Lord but it was not granted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 48 — The Book Pertaining to the Remembrance of Allah, Supplication, Repentance and Seeking Forgiveness
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مُعَاوِيَةُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ صَالِحٍ - عَنْ رَبِيعَةَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ يَزَالُ يُسْتَجَابُ لِلْعَبْدِ مَا لَمْ يَدْعُ بِإِثْمٍ أَوْ قَطِيعَةِ رَحِمٍ مَا لَمْ يَسْتَعْجِلْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ مَا الاِسْتِعْجَالُ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَقُولُ قَدْ دَعَوْتُ وَقَدْ دَعَوْتُ فَلَمْ أَرَ يَسْتَجِيبُ لِي فَيَسْتَحْسِرُ عِنْدَ ذَلِكَ وَيَدَعُ الدُّعَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alttaahiri, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy mu'aawiyaau, - wahuwa abnu saalihin - 'an rabiy'aaa bni yaziyda, 'an aabiy iidriysa alkhawlaaniyyi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ laa yazaalu yustajaabu lil'abdi maa lam yad'u biiithmin aaw qatiy'aai rahimin maa lam yasta'jil ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi maa alaisti'jaalu qaala ‏"‏ yaquwlu qad da'awtu waqad da'awtu falam aara yastajiybu liy fayastahsiru 'inda dhalika wayada'u alddu'aa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The supplication of the servant is granted in case he does not supplicate for sin or for severing the ties of blood, or he does not become impatient. It was said: Allah's Messenger, what does:" If he does not grow impatient" imply? He said: That he should say like this: I supplicated and I supplicated but I did not find it being responded. and theu he becomes frustrated and abandons supplication
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا التَّيْمِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قُمْتُ عَلَى بَابِ الْجَنَّةِ فَإِذَا عَامَّةُ مَنْ دَخَلَهَا الْمَسَاكِينُ وَإِذَا أَصْحَابُ الْجَدِّ مَحْبُوسُونَ إِلاَّ أَصْحَابَ النَّارِ فَقَدْ أُمِرَ بِهِمْ إِلَى النَّارِ وَقُمْتُ عَلَى بَابِ النَّارِ فَإِذَا عَامَّةُ مَنْ دَخَلَهَا النِّسَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, haddathanaa almu'tamiru, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu, bnu iibraahiyma aakhbaranaa jariyrun, kulluhum 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa alttaymiyyu, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ qumtu 'alaa baabi aljannaai faiidhaa 'aammaau man dakhalahaa almasaakiynu waiidhaa aashaabu aljaddi mahbuwsuwna iilaaa aashaaba alnnaari faqad aumira bihim iilaa alnnaari waqumtu 'alaa baabi alnnaari faiidhaa 'aammaau man dakhalahaa alnnisaa'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid reported that Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) said:I stood at the door of Paradise and I found that the overwhelming majority of those who entered therein was that of poor persons and the wealthy persons were detained to get into that. The denizens of Hell were commanded to get into Hell, and I stood upon the door of Fire and the majority amongst them who entered there was that of women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي رَجَاءٍ، الْعُطَارِدِيِّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ قَالَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اطَّلَعْتُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا الْفُقَرَاءَ وَاطَّلَعْتُ فِي النَّارِ فَرَأَيْتُ أَكْثَرَ أَهْلِهَا النِّسَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy rajaa'in, al'utaaridiyyi qaala sami'tu abna 'abbaasin, yaquwlu qaala muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ attala'tu fiy aljannaai faraaaytu aakthara aahlihaa alfuqaraa'a waattala'tu fiy alnnaari faraaaytu aakthara aahlihaa alnnisaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:I had a chance to look into the Paradise and I found that majority of the people was poor and I looked into the Fire and there I found the majority constituted by women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa althhaqafiyyu, aakhbaranaa aayyuwbu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الأَشْهَبِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو رَجَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اطَّلَعَ فِي النَّارِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَيُّوبَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa aabuw alaashhabi, haddathanaa aabuw rajaa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm attala'a fiy alnnaari ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi aayyuwba ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stated like this:He looked into the Fire of Hell. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، سَمِعَ أَبَا رَجَاءٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, sami'a aabaa rajaa'in, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith is narrated likewise through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ كَانَ لِمُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ امْرَأَتَانِ فَجَاءَ مِنْ عِنْدِ إِحْدَاهُمَا فَقَالَتِ الأُخْرَى جِئْتَ مِنْ عِنْدِ فُلاَنَةَ فَقَالَ جِئْتُ مِنْ عِنْدِ عِمْرَانَ بْنِ حُصَيْنٍ فَحَدَّثَنَا أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَقَلَّ سَاكِنِي الْجَنَّةِ النِّسَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, qaala kaana limutarrifi bni 'abdi alllahi amraaataani fajaa'a min 'indi iihdaahumaa faqaalati alaukhraa jiita min 'indi fulaanaaa faqaala jiitu min 'indi 'imraana bni husaynin fahaddathanaa aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aaqalla saakiniy aljannaai alnnisaa'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Imran b. Husain reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Amongst the inmates of Paradise the women would form a minority
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْحَمِيدِ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُطَرِّفًا، يُحَدِّثُ أَنَّهُ كَانَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَتَانِ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu alwaliydi bni 'abdi alhamiydi, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, qaala sami'tu mutarrifana, yuhaddithu aannahu kaanat lahu amraaataani bima'naa hadiythi mu'aadhin ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mutarrif through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْكَرِيمِ أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بُكَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ، عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ دِينَارٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كَانَ مِنْ دُعَاءِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'abdi alkariymi aabuw zur'aaa, haddathanaa abnu bukayrin, haddathaniy ya'quwbu bnu, 'abdi alrrahmani 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni diynaarin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, qaala kaana min du'aa'i rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma iinniy aa'uwdhu bika min zawaali ni'matika watahawwuli 'aafiyatika wafujaa'aai niqmatika wajamiy'i sakhatika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) supplicated in these words:" O Allah, I seek refuge in Thee from the withdrawal of Thine blessing and the change of Thine protection (from me) and from the sudden wrath of Thine, and from every displeasure of Thine
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، وَمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي عُثْمَانَ النَّهْدِيِّ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِتْنَةً هِيَ أَضَرُّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa sufyaanu, wamu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, 'an aabiy 'uthmaana alnnahdiyyi, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa taraktu ba'diy fitnaaan hiya aadarru 'alaa alrrijaali mina alnnisaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I have not left after me any (chance) of turmoil more injurious to men than the harm done to the men because of women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، وَسُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، جَمِيعًا عَنِ الْمُعْتَمِرِ، قَالَ ابْنُ مُعَاذٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْمُعْتَمِرُ بْنُ سُلَيْمَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ أَبِي حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ حَارِثَةَ، وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَمْرِو بْنِ نُفَيْلٍ، أَنَّهُمَا حَدَّثَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَا تَرَكْتُ بَعْدِي فِي النَّاسِ فِتْنَةً أَضَرَّ عَلَى الرِّجَالِ مِنَ النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, wasuwaydu bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, jamiy'ana 'ani almu'tamiri, qaala abnu mu'aadhin haddathanaa almu'tamiru bnu sulaymaana, qaala qaala aabiy haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, 'an ausaamaaa bni zaydi bni haarithaaa, wasa'iydi bni zaydi bni 'amriw bni nufaylin, aannahumaa haddathaa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ maa taraktu ba'diy fiy alnnaasi fitnaaan aadarra 'alaa alrrijaali mina alnnisaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama b. Zaid b. Harith and Sa'id b. Zaid b. 'Amr b. Naufal both reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:I have not left after me turmoil for the people but the harm done to men by women
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ التَّيْمِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa hushaymun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, kulluhum 'an sulaymaana alttaymiyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sulaiman Taimi with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا نَضْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الدُّنْيَا حُلْوَةٌ خَضِرَةٌ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ مُسْتَخْلِفُكُمْ فِيهَا فَيَنْظُرُ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ فَاتَّقُوا الدُّنْيَا وَاتَّقُوا النِّسَاءَ فَإِنَّ أَوَّلَ فِتْنَةِ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ كَانَتْ فِي النِّسَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ ابْنِ بَشَّارٍ ‏"‏ لِيَنْظُرَ كَيْفَ تَعْمَلُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy maslamaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa nadraaa, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna alddunyaa hulwaaun khadiraaun waiinna alllaha mustakhlifukum fiyhaa fayanzuru kayfa ta'maluwna faattaquwa alddunyaa waattaquwa alnnisaa'a faiinna aawwala fitnaai baniy iisraaiiyla kaanat fiy alnnisaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi abni bashhaarin ‏"‏ liyanzura kayfa ta'maluwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The world is sweet and green (alluring) and verily Allah is going to install you as vicegerent in it in order to see how you act. So avoid the allurement of women: verily, the first trial for the people of Isra'il was caused by women. And in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Bashshar the words are:" So that He should see how you act
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْمُسَيَّبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَنَسٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عِيَاضٍ أَبَا ضَمْرَةَ - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَيْنَمَا ثَلاَثَةُ نَفَرٍ يَتَمَشَّوْنَ أَخَذَهُمُ الْمَطَرُ فَأَوَوْا إِلَى غَارٍ فِي جَبَلٍ فَانْحَطَّتْ عَلَى فَمِ غَارِهِمْ صَخْرَةٌ مِنَ الْجَبَلِ فَانْطَبَقَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ انْظُرُوا أَعْمَالاً عَمِلْتُمُوهَا صَالِحَةً لِلَّهِ فَادْعُوا اللَّهَ تَعَالَى بِهَا لَعَلَّ اللَّهَ يَفْرُجُهَا عَنْكُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَ لِي وَالِدَانِ شَيْخَانِ كَبِيرَانِ وَامْرَأَتِي وَلِيَ صِبْيَةٌ صِغَارٌ أَرْعَى عَلَيْهِمْ فَإِذَا أَرَحْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ حَلَبْتُ فَبَدَأْتُ بِوَالِدَىَّ فَسَقَيْتُهُمَا قَبْلَ بَنِيَّ وَأَنَّهُ نَأَى بِي ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ الشَّجَرُ فَلَمْ آتِ حَتَّى أَمْسَيْتُ فَوَجَدْتُهُمَا قَدْ نَامَا فَحَلَبْتُ كَمَا كُنْتُ أَحْلُبُ فَجِئْتُ بِالْحِلاَبِ فَقُمْتُ عِنْدَ رُءُوسِهِمَا أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أُوقِظَهُمَا مِنْ نَوْمِهِمَا وَأَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَسْقِيَ الصِّبْيَةَ قَبْلَهُمَا وَالصِّبْيَةُ يَتَضَاغَوْنَ عِنْدَ قَدَمَىَّ فَلَمْ يَزَلْ ذَلِكَ دَأْبِي وَدَأْبَهُمْ حَتَّى طَلَعَ الْفَجْرُ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً نَرَى مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً فَرَأَوْا مِنْهَا السَّمَاءَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّهُ كَانَتْ لِيَ ابْنَةُ عَمٍّ أَحْبَبْتُهَا كَأَشَدِّ مَا يُحِبُّ الرِّجَالُ النِّسَاءَ وَطَلَبْتُ إِلَيْهَا نَفْسَهَا فَأَبَتْ حَتَّى آتِيَهَا بِمِائَةِ دِينَارٍ فَتَعِبْتُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِائَةَ دِينَارٍ فَجِئْتُهَا بِهَا فَلَمَّا وَقَعْتُ بَيْنَ رِجْلَيْهَا قَالَتْ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَفْتَحِ الْخَاتَمَ إِلاَّ بِحَقِّهِ ‏.‏ فَقُمْتُ عَنْهَا فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مِنْهَا فُرْجَةً ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ لَهُمْ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي كُنْتُ اسْتَأْجَرْتُ أَجِيرًا بِفَرَقِ أَرُزٍّ فَلَمَّا قَضَى عَمَلَهُ قَالَ أَعْطِنِي حَقِّي ‏.‏ فَعَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَرَقَهُ فَرَغِبَ عَنْهُ فَلَمْ أَزَلْ أَزْرَعُهُ حَتَّى جَمَعْتُ مِنْهُ بَقَرًا وَرِعَاءَهَا فَجَاءَنِي فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَظْلِمْنِي حَقِّي ‏.‏ قُلْتُ اذْهَبْ إِلَى تِلْكَ الْبَقَرِ وَرِعَائِهَا فَخُذْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اتَّقِ اللَّهَ وَلاَ تَسْتَهْزِئْ بِي ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنِّي لاَ أَسْتَهْزِئُ بِكَ خُذْ ذَلِكَ الْبَقَرَ وَرِعَاءَهَا ‏.‏ فَأَخَذَهُ فَذَهَبَ بِهِ فَإِنْ كُنْتَ تَعْلَمُ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ ابْتِغَاءَ وَجْهِكَ فَافْرُجْ لَنَا مَا بَقِيَ ‏.‏ فَفَرَجَ اللَّهُ مَا بَقِيَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu iishaaqa almusayyabiyyu, haddathaniy aanasun, - ya'niy abna 'iyaadin aabaa damraaa - 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, 'an naafi'in, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ baynamaa thalaathaau nafarin yatamashhawna aakhadhahumu almataru faaawawa iilaa ghaarin fiy jabalin faanhattat 'alaa fami ghaarihim sakhraaun mina aljabali faantabaqat 'alayhim faqaala ba'duhum liba'din anzuruwa aa'maalaan 'amiltumuwhaa saalihaaan lillahi faad'uwa alllaha ta'aalaa bihaa la'alla alllaha yafrujuhaa 'ankum ‏.‏ faqaala aahaduhumu alllahumma iinnahu kaana liy waalidaani shaykhaani kabiyraani waamraaatiy waliya sibyaaun sighaarun aar'aa 'alayhim faiidhaa aarahtu 'alayhim halabtu fabadaatu biwaalidaaaa fasaqaytuhumaa qabla baniyya waaannahu naaaa biy dhaata yawmin alshhajaru falam ati hattaa aamsaytu fawajadtuhumaa qad naamaa fahalabtu kamaa kuntu aahlubu fajiitu bialhilaabi faqumtu 'inda ru'uwsihimaa aakrahu aan auwqizahumaa min nawmihimaa waaakrahu aan aasqiya alssibyaaa qablahumaa waalssibyaau yatadaaghawna 'inda qadamaaaa falam yazal dhalika daabiy wadaabahum hattaa tala'a alfajru faiin kunta ta'lamu aanniy fa'altu dhalika abtighaa'a wajhika faafruj lanaa minhaa furjaaan naraa minhaa alssamaa'a ‏.‏ fafaraja alllahu minhaa furjaaan faraaawa minhaa alssamaa'a ‏.‏ waqaala alakharu alllahumma iinnahu kaanat liya abnaau 'ammin aahbabtuhaa kaaashaddi maa yuhibbu alrrijaalu alnnisaa'a watalabtu iilayhaa nafsahaa faaabat hattaa atiyahaa bimiaiaai diynaarin fata'ibtu hattaa jama'tu miaiaaa diynaarin fajiituhaa bihaa falammaa waqa'tu bayna rijlayhaa qaalat yaa 'abda alllahi attaqi alllaha walaa taftahi alkhaatama iilaaa bihaqqihi ‏.‏ faqumtu 'anhaa faiin kunta ta'lamu aanniy fa'altu dhalika abtighaa'a wajhika faafruj lanaa minhaa furjaaan ‏.‏ fafaraja lahum ‏.‏ waqaala alakharu alllahumma iinniy kuntu astaajartu aajiyrana bifaraqi aaruzzin falammaa qadaa 'amalahu qaala aa'tiniy haqqiy ‏.‏ fa'aradtu 'alayhi faraqahu faraghiba 'anhu falam aazal aazra'uhu hattaa jama'tu minhu baqarana wari'aa'ahaa fajaa'aniy faqaala attaqi alllaha walaa tazlimniy haqqiy ‏.‏ qultu adhhab iilaa tilka albaqari wari'aaiihaa fakhudhhaa ‏.‏ faqaala attaqi alllaha walaa tastahzii biy ‏.‏ faqultu iinniy laa aastahziiu bika khudh dhalika albaqara wari'aa'ahaa ‏.‏ faaakhadhahu fadhahaba bihi faiin kunta ta'lamu aanniy fa'altu dhalika abtighaa'a wajhika faafruj lanaa maa baqiya ‏.‏ fafaraja alllahu maa baqiya ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Three persons set out on a journey. They were overtaken by rain and they had to find protection in a mountain cave where at its mouth there fell a rock of that mountain and thus blocked them altogether. One of them said to the others: Look to your good deeds that you performed for the sake of Allah and then supplicate Allah, the Exalted, that He might rescue you (from this trouble). One of them said: 0 Allah, I had my parents who were old and my wife and my small children also. I tended the flock and when I came back to them in the evening, I milked them (the sheep, goats, cows, etc.) and first served that milk to my parents. One day I was obliged to go out to a distant place in search of fodder and I could not come back before evening and found them (the parents) asleep. I milked the animals as I used to milk and brought milk to them and stood by their heads avoiding to disturb them from sleep and I did not deem it advisable to serve milk to my children before serving them. My children wept near my feet. I remained there in that very state and my parents too until it was morning. And (0 Allah) if Thou art aware that I did this in order to seek Thine pleasure, grant us riddance from this trouble. (The rock slipped a bit) that they could see the sky. The second one said: 0 Allah, I had a female cousin whom I loved more than the men love the women. I wanted to have sexual intercourse with her; she refused but on the condition of getting one hundred dinirs. It was with very great difficulty that I could collect one hundred dinirs and then paid them to her and when I was going to have a sexual intercourse with her, that she said: Servant of Allah, fear Allah and do not break the seal (of chastity) but by lawful means. I got up. 0 Allah, if Thou art aware that I did this in order to seek Thine pleasure, rid us from this trouble. The situation was somewhat eased for them. The third one said: Allah, I employed a workman for a measure of rice. After he had finished his work I gave him his dues (in the form of) a measure of rice, but he did not accept them. I used these rice as seeds, and that gave a bumper crop and I became rich enough to have cows and flocks (in my possession). He came to me and said: Fear Allah, and commit no crueltv upon me in regard to my dues. I said to him: Takeaway this flock of cows and sheep. He said: Fear Allah and do not make a fun of me. I said: I am not making a fun of you. You take the cows and the flocks. So he took them. 0 Allah, if Thou art aware that I did it for Thine pleasure, case the situation for us. And Allah relieved them from the rest of the trouble
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ طَرِيفٍ الْبَجَلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَرَقَبَةُ بْنُ مَسْقَلَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي ضَمْرَةَ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ وَزَادُوا فِي حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏"‏ وَخَرَجُوا يَمْشُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ صَالِحٍ ‏"‏ يَتَمَاشَوْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ إِلاَّ عُبَيْدَ اللَّهِ فَإِنَّ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ وَخَرَجُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ بَعْدَهَا شَيْئًا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa aabuw 'aasimin, 'ani abni, jurayjin aakhbaraniy muwsaa bnu 'uqbaaa, h wahaddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, h wahaddathaniy aabuw kuraybin, wamuhammadu bnu tariyfin albajaliyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, haddathanaa aabiy waraqabaau bnu masqalaaa, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wahasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaaluwa haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'nuwna abna iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihi bni kaysaana, kulluhum 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi aabiy damraaa 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa wazaaduwa fiy hadiythihim ‏"‏ wakharajuwa yamshuwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi saalihin ‏"‏ yatamaashawna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ iilaaa 'ubayda alllahi faiinna fiy hadiythihi ‏"‏ wakharajuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur ba'dahaa shayiana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Musa b. 'Uqba but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 49 — The Book of Heart-Melting Traditions
