verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, wawakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin, alaashajju aakhbaranaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an muslimi bni subayhin, 'an masruwqin, qaala jaa'a iilaa 'abdi alllahi rajulun faqaala taraktu fiy almasjidi rajulaan yufassiru alqurana biraayihi yufassiru hadhihi alayaaa ‏{‏ yawma taatiy alssamaa'u bidukhaanin mubiynin‏}‏ qaala yaatiy alnnaasa yawma alqiyaamaai dukhaanun fayaakhudhu biaanfaasihim hattaa yaakhudhahum minhu kahayiaai alzzukaami ‏.‏ faqaala 'abdu alllahi man 'alima 'ilmana falyaqul bihi waman lam ya'lam falyaquli alllahu aa'lamu faiinna min fiqhi alrrajuli aan yaquwla limaa laa 'ilma lahu bihi alllahu aa'lamu ‏.‏ iinnamaa kaana hadhaa aanna qurayshana lammaa asta'sat 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm da'aa 'alayhim bisiniyna kasiniy yuwsufa faaasaabahum qahtun wajahdun hattaa ja'ala alrrajulu yanzuru iilaa alssamaa'i fayaraa baynahu wabaynahaa kahayiaai alddukhaani mina aljahdi wahattaa aakaluwa al'izaama faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm rajulun faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi astaghfiri alllaha limudara faiinnahum qad halakuwa faqaala ‏"‏ limudara iinnaka lajariy'un ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fada'aa alllaha lahum faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ iinnaa kaashifuw al'adhaabi qaliylaan iinnakum 'aaiiduwna‏}‏ qaala famutiruwa falammaa aasaabathumu alrrafaahiyaau - qaala - 'aaduwa iilaa maa kaanuwa 'alayhi - qaala - faaanzala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ faartaqib yawma taatiy alssamaa'u bidukhaanin mubiynin * yaghshaa alnnaasa hadhaa 'adhaabun aaliymun‏}‏ ‏{‏ yawma nabtishu albatshaaa alkubraa iinnaa muntaqimuwna‏}‏ qaala ya'niy yawma badrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Masruq reported that there came to Abdullah a person and said:I have left behind in the mosque a man who explains the Qur'an according to his personal discretion and he explained this verse:" So wait for the day when the Heaven brings a clear smoke." He says that a smoke would come to the people on the Day of Resurrection anl it will withhold breath and they would be inflicted with cold. 'Abdullah said: He who has knowledge should say something and he who has no knowledge should simply say: Allah is best aware. This reflects the understanding of a person that he should say about that which he does not know that it is Allah who knows best. The fact is that when the Quraish disobeyed Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) he supplicated Allah that they should be afflicted with famine and starvation as was done in case of Yusuf. And they were so much hard pressed that a person would ace the sky and he would see between him and the sky something like smoke and they were so much hard pressed that they began to cat the bones, and a person came to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger. seek forgiveness for the tribe of Mudar for (its people) have been undone. The Messenger (ﷺ) said: For Mudar? You are overbold, but he supplicated Allah for them. It was upon this that this verse was revealed:" We shall remove the chastisement a little, but they will surely return to evil" (xliv. 15). lie (the narrator) said: There was a downpoor of rain upon them. When there was some relief for them they returned to the same position as they had been before, and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, revealed this verse:" So wait for the day when the heaven brings a clear smoke enveloping people. This is a grievous torment on the day when We seize them with the most violent seizing; surely, We shall exact retribution." And this (seizing) implied (Battle) of Badr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى، عَنْ مَسْرُوقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ خَمْسٌ قَدْ مَضَيْنَ الدُّخَانُ وَاللِّزَامُ وَالرُّومُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ وَالْقَمَرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy aldduhaa, 'an masruwqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala khamsun qad madayna alddukhaanu waalllizaamu waalrruwmu waalbatshaau waalqamaru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah said that five signs have (become things) of the past (and have proved the truth of the Holy Prophet):(Enveloping) by the smoke, inevitable (punishment to the Meccans at Badr), (the victory of) Rome, (violent) seizing (of the Meccans at Badr) and (the splitting up of) the Moon
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عَزْرَةَ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ الْعُرَنِيِّ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ الْجَزَّارِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي لَيْلَى، عَنْ أُبَىِّ، بْنِ كَعْبٍ فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُمْ مِنَ الْعَذَابِ الأَدْنَى دُونَ الْعَذَابِ الأَكْبَرِ‏}‏ قَالَ مَصَائِبُ الدُّنْيَا وَالرُّومُ وَالْبَطْشَةُ أَوِ الدُّخَانُ ‏.‏ شُعْبَةُ الشَّاكُّ فِي الْبَطْشَةِ أَوِ الدُّخَانِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an 'azraaa, 'ani alhasani al'uraniyyi, 'an yahyaa bni aljazzaari, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni aabiy laylaa, 'an aubaaai, bni ka'bin fiy qawlihi 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ walanudhiyqannahum mina al'adhaabi alaadnaa duwna al'adhaabi alaakbari‏}‏ qaala masaaiibu alddunyaa waalrruwmu waalbatshaau aawi alddukhaanu ‏.‏ shu'baau alshhaakku fiy albatshaai aawi alddukhaani ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ubayy b. Ka'b reported that the words of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious:" We will, surely, make them taste the lesser punishment before the severer punishment (that haply they may return)" (xxxii. 21) imply the torments of the world. (victory of) Rome, seizing (of the Meccans), or smoke. And Shalba was in doubt about seizing or smoke
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي، نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِشِقَّتَيْنِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اشْهَدُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani abni aabiy, najiyhin 'an mujaahidin, 'an aabiy ma'marin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala anshaqqa alqamaru 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bishiqqatayni faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ashhaduwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Ma'mar reported on the authority of Abdullah that the moon was split up during lifetime by Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in two parts and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Bear testimony to this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي، مُعَاوِيَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ بَيْنَمَا نَحْنُ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِنًى إِذَا انْفَلَقَ الْقَمَرُ فِلْقَتَيْنِ فَكَانَتْ فِلْقَةٌ وَرَاءَ الْجَبَلِ وَفِلْقَةٌ دُونَهُ فَقَالَ لَنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اشْهَدُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma jamiy'ana 'an aabiy, mu'aawiyaaa h wahaddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy kilaahumaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, h wahaddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - aakhbaranaa abnu mushirin, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy ma'marin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, qaala baynamaa nahnu ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biminana iidhaa anfalaqa alqamaru filqatayni fakaanat filqaaun waraa'a aljabali wafilqaaun duwnahu faqaala lanaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ashhaduwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abdullah b. Mas'ud (who said):We were along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) at Mina, that moon was split up into two. One of its parts was behind the mountain and the other one was on this side of the mountain. Allah's Messenger (may peace be upbn him) said to us: Bear witness to this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِلْقَتَيْنِ فَسَتَرَ الْجَبَلُ فِلْقَةً وَكَانَتْ فِلْقَةٌ فَوْقَ الْجَبَلِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ اللَّهُمَّ اشْهَدْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an iibraahiyma, 'an aabiy ma'marin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, qaala anshaqqa alqamaru 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm filqatayni fasatara aljabalu filqaaan wakaanat filqaaun fawqa aljabali faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alllahumma ashhad ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that the moon was split up in two parts during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). The mountain covered one of its parts and one part of it was above the mountain and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Bear witness to this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithla dhalika ‏.‏
verses.translation: Another chain of transmitters reported the like of this hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ بِشْرُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِإِسْنَادِ ابْنِ مُعَاذٍ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ ابْنِ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ اشْهَدُوا اشْهَدُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi bishru bnu khaalidin, aakhbaranaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, biiisnaadi abni mu'aadhin 'an shu'baaa, nahwa hadiythihi ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythi abni aabiy 'adiyyin faqaala ‏ "‏ ashhaduwa ashhaduwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Shu'ba with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَأَبُو دَاوُدَ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، قَالَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ فِرْقَتَيْنِ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي دَاوُدَ انْشَقَّ الْقَمَرُ عَلَى عَهْدِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, waaabuw daawuda h wahaddathanaa abnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, wamuhammadu bnu ja'farin, waaabuw daawuda kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, qaala anshaqqa alqamaru firqatayni ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi aabiy daawuda anshaqqa alqamaru 'alaa 'ahdi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported that the moon was split up in two parts and in the hadith recorded in Abu Dawud, the words are:" The moon was split up into two parts during the life of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ قُرَيْشٍ التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ بَكْرِ بْنِ مُضَرَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا جَعْفَرُ بْنُ رَبِيعَةَ، عَنْ عِرَاكِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ إِنَّ الْقَمَرَ انْشَقَّ عَلَى زَمَانِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muwsaa bnu qurayshin alttamiymiyyu, haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu bakri bni mudara, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa ja'faru bnu rabiy'aaa, 'an 'iraaki bni maalikin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'utbaaa bni mas'uwdin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala iinna alqamara anshaqqa 'alaa zamaani rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Abbas reported that the moon was split up during the lifetime of Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ، جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ السُّلَمِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ قَيْسٍ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا أَحَدٌ أَصْبَرَ عَلَى أَذًى يَسْمَعُهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَى إِنَّهُمْ يَجْعَلُونَ لَهُ نِدًّا وَيَجْعَلُونَ لَهُ وَلَدًا وَهُوَ مَعَ ذَلِكَ يَرْزُقُهُمْ وَيُعَافِيهِمْ وَيُعْطِيهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu, jubayrin 'an aabiy 'abdi alrrahmani alssulamiyyi, qaala qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu qaysin qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa aahadun aasbara 'alaa aadhana yasma'uhu mina alllahi ta'aalaa iinnahum yaj'aluwna lahu niddana wayaj'aluwna lahu waladana wahuwa ma'a dhalika yarzuquhum wayu'aafiyhim wayu'tiyhim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Qais reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that none is more forbearing in listening to the most irksome things than Allah, the Exalted. They associate rivals with him, attribute sonhood to Him, but in spite of this He provides them sustenance, grants them safety, confers upon them so many things
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى لأَهْوَنِ أَهْلِ النَّارِ عَذَابًا لَوْ كَانَتْ لَكَ الدُّنْيَا وَمَا فِيهَا أَكُنْتَ مُفْتَدِيًا بِهَا فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ فَيَقُولُ قَدْ أَرَدْتُ مِنْكَ أَهْوَنَ مِنْ هَذَا وَأَنْتَ فِي صُلْبِ آدَمَ أَنْ لاَ تُشْرِكَ - أَحْسَبُهُ قَالَ - وَلاَ أُدْخِلَكَ النَّارَ فَأَبَيْتَ إِلاَّ الشِّرْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy 'imraana aljawniyyi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yaquwlu alllahu tabaaraka wata'aalaa laahwani aahli alnnaari 'adhaabana law kaanat laka alddunyaa wamaa fiyhaa aakunta muftadiyana bihaa fayaquwlu na'am fayaquwlu qad aaradtu minka aahwana min hadhaa waaanta fiy sulbi adama aan laa tushrika - aahsabuhu qaala - walaa audkhilaka alnnaara faaabayta iilaaa alshhirka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Allah, the Exalted and High, would say to one who shall have to undergo the least torture (on the Day of Resurrection): Would you like to go as ransom if you had all worldly riches; he would say: Yes. Allah would say to him: When you were in the loins of Adam, I demanded from you something easier than this that you should not associate anything with Me. (The narrator says): I think He also said: I would not cause you to enter Hell-Fire but you defied and attributed Divinity (to others besides Me)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي عِمْرَانَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ إِلاَّ قَوْلَهُ ‏ "‏ وَلاَ أُدْخِلَكَ النَّارَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَإِنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy 'imraana, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, yuhaddithu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi iilaaa qawlahu ‏ "‏ walaa audkhilaka alnnaara ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faiinnahu lam yadhkurhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording (and the words are):I shall cause him to enter Hell." (The words subsequent to these) have not been mentioned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يُقَالُ لِلْكَافِرِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ أَرَأَيْتَ لَوْ كَانَ لَكَ مِلْءُ الأَرْضِ ذَهَبًا أَكُنْتَ تَفْتَدِي بِهِ فَيَقُولُ نَعَمْ ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ قَدْ سُئِلْتَ أَيْسَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yuqaalu lilkaafiri yawma alqiyaamaai aaraaayta law kaana laka mil'u alaardi dhahabana aakunta taftadiy bihi fayaquwlu na'am ‏.‏ fayuqaalu lahu qad suiilta aaysara min dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace be u n him) said:It would be said to the non-believers on the Day of Resurrection: If you were to possess gold, filling the whole earth, would you like to secure your freedom by paying that? He would say: Yes. Thereupon it would be said to him: Something easier (than this) was demanded from you (but you paid no heed to it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَطَاءٍ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ كَذَبْتَ قَدْ سُئِلْتَ مَا هُوَ أَيْسَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, h wahaddathaniy 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - ya'niy abna 'ataa'in - kilaahumaa 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ fayuqaalu lahu kadhabta qad suiilta maa huwa aaysaru min dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported this hadlth through another chain of transmitters and the words are:" It would be said to him: You have told a lie; what had been demanded from you was quite easier than this (the belief in the Oneness of Allah)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ، بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَجُلاً، قَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ يُحْشَرُ الْكَافِرُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلَيْسَ الَّذِي أَمْشَاهُ عَلَى رِجْلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا قَادِرًا عَلَى أَنْ يُمْشِيَهُ عَلَى وَجْهِهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ بَلَى وَعِزَّةِ رَبِّنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa yuwnusu, bnu muhammadin haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna rajulaan, qaala yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa yuhsharu alkaafiru 'alaa wajhihi yawma alqiyaamaai qaala ‏ "‏ aalaysa alladhiy aamshaahu 'alaa rijlayhi fiy alddunyaa qaadirana 'alaa aan yumshiyahu 'alaa wajhihi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qataadaau balaa wa'izzaai rabbinaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that a person said:Allah's Messenger, how the non-believers be made to assemble on the Day of Resurrection (by crawling) on their faces? Thereupon he said: Is He Who is powerful to make them walk on their feet not powerful enough to make them (crawl) upon their faces on the Day of Resurrection? Qatada said: Of course, it is so. (He adjured): By the might of our Lord
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، الْبُنَانِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُؤْتَى بِأَنْعَمِ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ فَيُصْبَغُ فِي النَّارِ صَبْغَةً ثُمَّ يُقَالُ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ هَلْ رَأَيْتَ خَيْرًا قَطُّ هَلْ مَرَّ بِكَ نَعِيمٌ قَطُّ فَيَقُولُ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَبِّ ‏.‏ وَيُؤْتَى بِأَشَدِّ النَّاسِ بُؤْسًا فِي الدُّنْيَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَيُصْبَغُ صَبْغَةً فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ يَا ابْنَ آدَمَ هَلْ رَأَيْتَ بُؤْسًا قَطُّ هَلْ مَرَّ بِكَ شِدَّةٌ قَطُّ فَيَقُولُ لاَ وَاللَّهِ يَا رَبِّ مَا مَرَّ بِي بُؤُسٌ قَطُّ وَلاَ رَأَيْتُ شِدَّةً قَطُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, albunaaniyyi 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yuutaa biaan'ami aahli alddunyaa min aahli alnnaari yawma alqiyaamaai fayusbaghu fiy alnnaari sabghaaan thumma yuqaalu yaa abna adama hal raaayta khayrana qattu hal marra bika na'iymun qattu fayaquwlu laa waalllahi yaa rabbi ‏.‏ wayuutaa biaashaddi alnnaasi buusana fiy alddunyaa min aahli aljannaai fayusbaghu sabghaaan fiy aljannaai fayuqaalu lahu yaa abna adama hal raaayta buusana qattu hal marra bika shiddaaun qattu fayaquwlu laa waalllahi yaa rabbi maa marra biy buuusun qattu walaa raaaytu shiddaaan qattu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that one amongst the denizens of Hell who had led a life of ease and plenty amongst the people of the world would be made to dip in Fire only once on the Day of Resurrection and then it would be said to him:O, son of Adam, did you find any comfort, did you happen to get any material blessing? He would say: By Allah, no, my Lord. And then that person from amongst the persons of the world be brought who had led the most miserable life (in the world) from amongst the inmates of Paradise. and he would be made to dip once in Paradise and it would be said to him. 0, son of Adam, did you face, any hardship? Or had any distress fallen to your lot? And he would say: By Allah, no,0 my Lord, never did I face any hardship or experience any distress
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَظْلِمُ مُؤْمِنًا حَسَنَةً يُعْطَى بِهَا فِي الدُّنْيَا وَيُجْزَى بِهَا فِي الآخِرَةِ وَأَمَّا الْكَافِرُ فَيُطْعَمُ بِحَسَنَاتِ مَا عَمِلَ بِهَا لِلَّهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا حَتَّى إِذَا أَفْضَى إِلَى الآخِرَةِ لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ حَسَنَةٌ يُجْزَى بِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hammaamu bnu yahyaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha laa yazlimu muuminana hasanaaan yu'taa bihaa fiy alddunyaa wayujzaa bihaa fiy alakhiraai waaammaa alkaafiru fayut'amu bihasanaati maa 'amila bihaa lillahi fiy alddunyaa hattaa iidhaa aafdaa iilaa alakhiraai lam takun lahu hasanaaun yujzaa bihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Verily, Allah does not treat a believer unjustly in regard to his virtues. He would confer upon him (His blessing) in this world and would give him reward in the Hereafter. And as regards a non-believer, he would be made to taste the reward (of virtue in this world) what he has done for himself so much that when it would be the Hereafter, he would find no virtue for which he should be rewarded
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَاصِمُ بْنُ النَّضْرِ التَّيْمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّهُ حَدَّثَ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْكَافِرَ إِذَا عَمِلَ حَسَنَةً أُطْعِمَ بِهَا طُعْمَةً مِنَ الدُّنْيَا وَأَمَّا الْمُؤْمِنُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يَدَّخِرُ لَهُ حَسَنَاتِهِ فِي الآخِرَةِ وَيُعْقِبُهُ رِزْقًا فِي الدُّنْيَا عَلَى طَاعَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aasimu bnu alnnadri alttaymiyyu, haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu aabiy, haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aannahu haddatha 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alkaafira iidhaa 'amila hasanaaan aut'ima bihaa tu'maaan mina alddunyaa waaammaa almuuminu faiinna alllaha yaddakhiru lahu hasanaatihi fiy alakhiraai wayu'qibuhu rizqana fiy alddunyaa 'alaa taa'atihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) thus told him:When a non-believer does good he is made to taste Its reward in this world. And so far as the believer is concerned, Allah stores (the reward) of his virtues for the Hereafter and provides him sustenance in accordance with his obedience to Him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرُّزِّيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alrruzziyyu, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi bnu 'ataa'in, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythihimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas b. Malik through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ الزَّرْعِ لاَ تَزَالُ الرِّيحُ تُمِيلُهُ وَلاَ يَزَالُ الْمُؤْمِنُ يُصِيبُهُ الْبَلاَءُ وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ كَمَثَلِ شَجَرَةِ الأَرْزِ لاَ تَهْتَزُّ حَتَّى تَسْتَحْصِدَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an ma'marin, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathalu almuumini kamathali alzzar'i laa tazaalu alrriyhu tumiyluhu walaa yazaalu almuuminu yusiybuhu albalaa'u wamathalu almunaafiqi kamathali shajaraai alaarzi laa tahtazzu hattaa tastahsida ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Similitude of a believer is that of (a standing) crop which the air continues to toss from one side to another; in the same way a believer always (receives the strokes) of misfortune. The similitude of a hypocrite is that of a cypress tree which does not move until it is uprooted
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي، حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ مَكَانَ قَوْلِهِ تُمِيلُهُ ‏ "‏ تُفِيئُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ghayra aanna fiy, hadiythi 'abdi alrrazzaaqi makaana qawlihi tumiyluhu ‏ "‏ tufiyiuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters, but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا زَكَرِيَّاءُ بْنُ أَبِي زَائِدَةَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، كَعْبٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ الْخَامَةِ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ تُفِيئُهَا الرِّيحُ وَتَصْرَعُهَا مَرَّةً وَتَعْدِلُهَا أُخْرَى حَتَّى تَهِيجَ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَمَثَلِ الأَرْزَةِ الْمُجْذِيَةِ عَلَى أَصْلِهَا لاَ يُفِيئُهَا شَىْءٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ انْجِعَافُهَا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, wamuhammadu bnu bishrin, qaalaa haddathanaa zakariyyaa'u bnu aabiy zaaiidaaa, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, haddathaniy abnu ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, ka'bin qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathalu almuumini kamathali alkhaamaai mina alzzar'i tufiyiuhaa alrriyhu watasra'uhaa marraaan wata'diluhaa aukhraa hattaa tahiyja wamathalu alkaafiri kamathali alaarzaai almujdhiyaai 'alaa aaslihaa laa yufiyiuhaa shaa'un hattaa yakuwna anji'aafuhaa marraaan waahidaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ka'b reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that the similitude of a believer is that of a standing crop in a field which is shaken by wind and then it comes to its original position but it stands at its roots. The similitude of a non-believer is that of a cypress tree which stands on its roots and nothing shakes it but it is uprooted (with) one (violent stroke)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ كَمَثَلِ الْخَامَةِ مِنَ الزَّرْعِ تُفِيئُهَا الرِّيَاحُ تَصْرَعُهَا مَرَّةً وَتَعْدِلُهَا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَهُ أَجَلُهُ وَمَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ مَثَلُ الأَرْزَةِ الْمُجْذِيَةِ الَّتِي لاَ يُصِيبُهَا شَىْءٌ حَتَّى يَكُونَ انْجِعَافُهَا مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa bishru bnu alssariyyi, wa'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mathalu almuumini kamathali alkhaamaai mina alzzar'i tufiyiuhaa alrriyaahu tasra'uhaa marraaan wata'diluhaa hattaa yaatiyahu aajaluhu wamathalu almunaafiqi mathalu alaarzaai almujdhiyaai allatiy laa yusiybuhaa shaa'un hattaa yakuwna anji'aafuhaa marraaan waahidaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ka'b b. Malik reported on the authority of his father that the similitude of a believer is that of a standing crop. The wind sometimes shakes it and sometimes raises it up and then it comes to its destined end. And the similitude of a hypocrite is that of a cypress tree which is not affected by anything but is uprooted once for all
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، وَمَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرُ بْنُ السَّرِيِّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرَ أَنَّ مَحْمُودًا قَالَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ بِشْرٍ ‏"‏ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ كَمَثَلِ الأَرْزَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَمَّا ابْنُ حَاتِمٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَثَلُ الْمُنَافِقِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ كَمَا قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, wamahmuwdu bnu ghaylaana, qaalaa haddathanaa bishru bnu alssariyyi, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ghayra aanna mahmuwdana qaala fiy riwaayatihi 'an bishrin ‏"‏ wamathalu alkaafiri kamathali alaarzaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaammaa abnu haatimin faqaala ‏"‏ mathalu almunaafiqi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ kamaa qaala zuhayrun ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through a couple of other chains of transmitters, one which says "the similitude of the disbeliever" instead and another which agrees with the wording of the previous hadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ هَاشِمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - قَالَ ابْنُ هَاشِمٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، وَقَالَ ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ كَعْبِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، - عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَقَالاَ جَمِيعًا فِي حَدِيثِهِمَا عَنْ يَحْيَى، ‏ "‏ وَمَثَلُ الْكَافِرِ مَثَلُ الأَرْزَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, wa'abdu alllahi bnu haashimin, qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an sufyaana, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, - qaala abnu haashimin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, waqaala abnu bashhaarin, 'ani abni ka'bi bni maalikin, 'an aabiyhi, - 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm binahwi hadiythihim waqaalaa jamiy'ana fiy hadiythihimaa 'an yahyaa, ‏ "‏ wamathalu alkaafiri mathalu alaarzaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Ka'b through another chain of transmitters but with " "the similitude of the disbeliever is that of a cypress tree
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَحْيَى - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ دِينَارٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ عَبْدَ، اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ مِنَ الشَّجَرِ شَجَرَةً لاَ يَسْقُطُ وَرَقُهَا وَإِنَّهَا مَثَلُ الْمُسْلِمِ فَحَدِّثُونِي مَا هِيَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَوَقَعَ النَّاسُ فِي شَجَرِ الْبَوَادِي ‏.‏ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ فَاسْتَحْيَيْتُ ثُمَّ قَالُوا حَدِّثْنَا مَا هِيَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَذَكَرْتُ ذَلِكَ لِعُمَرَ قَالَ لأَنْ تَكُونَ قُلْتَ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, - waalllafzu liyahyaa - qaaluwa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'nuwna abna ja'farin - aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu diynaarin, aannahu sami'a 'abda, alllahi bna 'umara yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna mina alshhajari shajaraaan laa yasqutu waraquhaa waiinnahaa mathalu almuslimi fahaddithuwniy maa hiya ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fawaqa'a alnnaasu fiy shajari albawaadiy ‏.‏ qaala 'abdu alllahi wawaqa'a fiy nafsiy aannahaa alnnakhlaau faastahyaytu thumma qaaluwa haddithnaa maa hiya yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala faqaala ‏"‏ hiya alnnakhlaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fadhakartu dhalika li'umara qaala laan takuwna qulta hiya alnnakhlaau aahabbu iilaaaa min kadhaa wakadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:There is a tree amongst trees, the leaves of which do not wither and that is like a Muslim; tell me which that (tree) can be? The people began to think of the trees of the forest. Abdullah said: I thought that it could be the date-palm tree, but I felt hesitant (to say that). They (the Companions) then said: Allah's Messenger, (kindly) tell us which that can be? Thereupon he said: It is the date-palm tree. I made a mention of that to 'Umar, whereupon he said: Had you said that it meant the date-palin tree, this statement of yours (would have been dearer to me) than such and such things
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ أَبِي الْخَلِيلِ، الضُّبَعِيِّ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا لأَصْحَابِهِ ‏"‏ أَخْبِرُونِي عَنْ شَجَرَةٍ مَثَلُهَا مَثَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَجَعَلَ الْقَوْمُ يَذْكُرُونَ شَجَرًا مِنْ شَجَرِ الْبَوَادِي ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ وَأُلْقِيَ فِي نَفْسِي أَوْ رُوعِيَ أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ فَجَعَلْتُ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أَقُولَهَا فَإِذَا أَسْنَانُ الْقَوْمِ فَأَهَابُ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ فَلَمَّا سَكَتُوا قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هِيَ النَّخْلَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'ubaydin alghubariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, 'an aabiy alkhaliyli, aldduba'iyyi 'an mujaahidin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana laashaabihi ‏"‏ aakhbiruwniy 'an shajaraain mathaluhaa mathalu almuumini ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faja'ala alqawmu yadhkuruwna shajarana min shajari albawaadiy ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara waaulqiya fiy nafsiy aaw ruw'iya aannahaa alnnakhlaau faja'altu auriydu aan aaquwlahaa faiidhaa aasnaanu alqawmi faaahaabu aan aatakallama falammaa sakatuwa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ hiya alnnakhlaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) one day said to his Companions:Tell me about a tree which has resemblance with a believer. The people began to mention (different) trees of the forest. Ibn 'Umar said: It was instilled in my mind or in my heart and it stuck therein that it implied the date- palm tree. I made up my mind to make a mention of that but could not do that because of the presence of the elderly people there. When there was a hush amongst them (after they had expressed their views), Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It Is the date-palm tree
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي نَجِيحٍ، عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ، قَالَ صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ فَمَا سَمِعْتُهُ يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ حَدِيثًا وَاحِدًا قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأُتِيَ بِجُمَّارٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani abni aabiy najiyhin, 'an mujaahidin, qaala sahibtu abna 'umara iilaa almadiynaai famaa sami'tuhu yuhaddithu, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iilaaa hadiythana waahidana qaala kunnaa 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faautiya bijummaarin ‏.‏ fadhakara binahwi hadiythihimaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mujahid said:(I have had the privilege) of accompanying Ibn 'Umar up to Medina but I did not hear him narrate anything from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) except one hadith. And he said: We were in the presence of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that there was brought to him the kernel of a date. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا سَيْفٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُجَاهِدًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ، عُمَرَ يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِجُمَّارٍ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa sayfun, qaala sami'tu mujaahidana, yaquwlu sami'tu abna, 'umara yaquwlu autiya rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bijummaarin ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mujahid reported:I heard Ibn 'Umar as saying: There was brought to Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) the kernel. The rest of the hadith is tile same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَخْبِرُونِي بِشَجَرَةٍ شِبْهِ أَوْ كَالرَّجُلِ الْمُسْلِمِ لاَ يَتَحَاتُّ وَرَقُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ لَعَلَّ مُسْلِمًا قَالَ وَتُؤْتِي أُكُلَهَا ‏.‏ وَكَذَا وَجَدْتُ عِنْدَ غَيْرِي أَيْضًا وَلاَ تُؤْتِي أُكُلَهَا كُلَّ حِينٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ فَوَقَعَ فِي نَفْسِي أَنَّهَا النَّخْلَةُ وَرَأَيْتُ أَبَا بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرَ لاَ يَتَكَلَّمَانِ فَكَرِهْتُ أَنْ أَتَكَلَّمَ أَوْ أَقُولَ شَيْئًا فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لأَنْ تَكُونَ قُلْتَهَا أَحَبُّ إِلَىَّ مِنْ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala kunnaa 'inda rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala ‏ "‏ aakhbiruwniy bishajaraain shibhi aaw kaalrrajuli almuslimi laa yatahaattu waraquhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala iibraahiymu la'alla muslimana qaala watuutiy aukulahaa ‏.‏ wakadhaa wajadtu 'inda ghayriy aaydana walaa tuutiy aukulahaa kulla hiynin ‏.‏ qaala abnu 'umara fawaqa'a fiy nafsiy aannahaa alnnakhlaau waraaaytu aabaa bakrin wa'umara laa yatakallamaani fakarihtu aan aatakallama aaw aaquwla shayiana faqaala 'umaru laan takuwna qultahaa aahabbu iilaaaa min kadhaa wakadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:We were'in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said: Tell me of a tree which has resemblance to a Muslim and the leaves of which do not wither. Ibrahim said that perhaps Imam Muslim had stated like this: It constantly bears fruit but I have, however, seen [It does not bear fruit constantly]. Ibn Umar said: It crossed my mind that it could be the date-palm tree, but as I saw Aba Bakr and Umar observe silence, I did not deem it fit that I should speak or I should say something. 'Umar said: Had you said so, it would have been dearer to me than such and such thing
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الشَّيْطَانَ قَدْ أَيِسَ أَنْ يَعْبُدَهُ الْمُصَلُّونَ فِي جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَلَكِنْ فِي التَّحْرِيشِ بَيْنَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna alshhaytaana qad aayisa aan ya'budahu almusalluwna fiy jaziyraai al'arabi walakin fiy alttahriyshi baynahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: Verily, the Satan has lost all hopes that the worshippers would ever worship (him) in the peninsula of Arabia, but he (is hopeful) that he would sow the seed of dissension amongst them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa kilaahumaa 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ عَرْشَ إِبْلِيسَ عَلَى الْبَحْرِ فَيَبْعَثُ سَرَايَاهُ فَيَفْتِنُونَ النَّاسَ فَأَعْظَمُهُمْ عِنْدَهُ أَعْظَمُهُمْ فِتْنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna 'arsha iibliysa 'alaa albahri fayab'athu saraayaahu fayaftinuwna alnnaasa faaa'zamuhum 'indahu aa'zamuhum fitnaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (way peace be upon him) as saying: The throne of Iblis is upon the ocean and he sends detachments (to different parts) inorder to put people to trial and the most important figure in his eyes is one who is most notorious in sowing the seed of dissension
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ إِبْلِيسَ يَضَعُ عَرْشَهُ عَلَى الْمَاءِ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ سَرَايَاهُ فَأَدْنَاهُمْ مِنْهُ مَنْزِلَةً أَعْظَمُهُمْ فِتْنَةً يَجِيءُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَقُولُ فَعَلْتُ كَذَا وَكَذَا فَيَقُولُ مَا صَنَعْتَ شَيْئًا قَالَ ثُمَّ يَجِيءُ أَحَدُهُمْ فَيَقُولُ مَا تَرَكْتُهُ حَتَّى فَرَّقْتُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ امْرَأَتِهِ - قَالَ - فَيُدْنِيهِ مِنْهُ وَيَقُولُ نِعْمَ أَنْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ أُرَاهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَيَلْتَزِمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, muhammadu bnu al'alaa'i waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma - waalllafzu laabiy kuraybin - qaalaa aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna iibliysa yada'u 'arshahu 'alaa almaa'i thumma yab'athu saraayaahu faaadnaahum minhu manzilaaan aa'zamuhum fitnaaan yajiy'u aahaduhum fayaquwlu fa'altu kadhaa wakadhaa fayaquwlu maa sana'ta shayiana qaala thumma yajiy'u aahaduhum fayaquwlu maa taraktuhu hattaa farraqtu baynahu wabayna amraaatihi - qaala - fayudniyhi minhu wayaquwlu ni'ma aanta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala alaa'mashu auraahu qaala ‏"‏ fayaltazimuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Iblis places his throne upon water; he then sends detachments (for creating dissension) ; the nearer to him in rank are those who are most notorious in creating dissension. One of them comes and says: "I did so and so." And he says: "You have done nothing." Then one amongst them comes and says: "I did not spare so and so until I sowed the seed of discord between a husband and a wife." The Satan goes near him and says: "You have done well." A'mash said: He then embraces him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يَبْعَثُ الشَّيْطَانُ سَرَايَاهُ فَيَفْتِنُونَ النَّاسَ فَأَعْظَمُهُمْ عِنْدَهُ مَنْزِلَةً أَعْظَمُهُمْ فِتْنَةً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yab'athu alshhaytaanu saraayaahu fayaftinuwna alnnaasa faaa'zamuhum 'indahu manzilaaan aa'zamuhum fitnaaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported that Allah's Apostle (may peace be upqn him) said:The Satan sends detachments of his own in order to put people to trial and the highest in rank, in his eyes, is one who is most notorious in sowing the seed of dissension
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ أَبِي الْجَعْدِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَا مِنْكُمْ مِنْ أَحَدٍ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ وُكِّلَ بِهِ قَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَإِيَّاكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِيَّاىَ إِلاَّ أَنَّ اللَّهَ أَعَانَنِي عَلَيْهِ فَأَسْلَمَ فَلاَ يَأْمُرُنِي إِلاَّ بِخَيْرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, 'an saalimi bni aabiy alja'di, 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maa minkum min aahadin iilaaa waqad wukkila bihi qariynuhu mina aljinni ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa waiiyyaaka yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ waiiyyaaaa iilaaa aanna alllaha aa'aananiy 'alayhi faaaslama falaa yaamuruniy iilaaa bikhayrin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas'ud reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:There is none amongst you with whom is not an attache from amongst the jinn (devil). They (the Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, with you too? Thereupon he said: Yes, but Allah helps me against him and so I am safe from his hand and he does not command me but for good
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنِيَانِ ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ آدَمَ، عَنْ عَمَّارِ بْنِ رُزَيْقٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، بِإِسْنَادِ جَرِيرٍ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ سُفْيَانَ ‏ "‏ وَقَدْ وُكِّلَ بِهِ قَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَقَرِينُهُ مِنَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'niyaani abna mahdiyyin - 'an sufyaana, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu adama, 'an 'ammaari bni ruzayqin, kilaahumaa 'an mansuwrin, biiisnaadi jariyrin ‏.‏ mithla hadiythihi ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi sufyaana ‏ "‏ waqad wukkila bihi qariynuhu mina aljinni waqariynuhu mina almalaaiikaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Mansiir with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، قُسَيْطٍ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عُرْوَةَ حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَتْهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَرَجَ مِنْ عِنْدِهَا لَيْلاً ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَغِرْتُ عَلَيْهِ فَجَاءَ فَرَأَى مَا أَصْنَعُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا لَكِ يَا عَائِشَةُ أَغِرْتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ وَمَا لِي لاَ يَغَارُ مِثْلِي عَلَى مِثْلِكَ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَقَدْ جَاءَكِ شَيْطَانُكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَتْ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَوَمَعِيَ شَيْطَانٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَعَ كُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ وَمَعَكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ وَلَكِنْ رَبِّي أَعَانَنِي عَلَيْهِ حَتَّى أَسْلَمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy aabuw sakhrin, 'ani abni, qusaytin haddathahu aanna 'urwaaa haddathahu aanna 'aaiishaaa zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm haddathathu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kharaja min 'indihaa laylaan ‏.‏ qaalat faghirtu 'alayhi fajaa'a faraaaa maa aasna'u faqaala ‏"‏ maa laki yaa 'aaiishaau aaghirti ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu wamaa liy laa yaghaaru mithliy 'alaa mithlika faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aaqad jaa'aki shaytaanuki ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalat yaa rasuwla alllahi aawama'iya shaytaanun qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu wama'a kulli iinsaanin qaala ‏"‏ na'am ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu wama'aka yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ na'am walakin rabbiy aa'aananiy 'alayhi hattaa aaslama ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out of her (apartment) during the night and she felt jealous. Then he came and he saw me (in what agitated state of mind) I was. He said:A'isha, what has happened to you? Do you feel jealous? Thereupon she said: How can it be (that a woman like me) should not feel jealous in regard to a husband like you. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: It was your devil who had come to you, and she said: Allah's Messenger, is there along with me a devil? He said: Yes. I said: Is a devil attached to everyone? He said: Yes. I (Aisha) again said: Allah's Messenger, is it with you also? He said: Yes, but my Lord has helped me against him and as such I am absolutely safe from his mischief
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا مِنْ أَحَدٍ يُدْخِلُهُ عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِي رَبِّي بِرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna zaydin - 'an aayyuwba, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ maa min aahadin yudkhiluhu 'amaluhu aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqiyla walaa aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ walaa aanaa iilaaa aan yataghammadaniy rabbiy birahmaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is none whose deeds alone would entitle him to get into Paradise. It was said to him: And, Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that my Lord wraps me in Mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ يُنْجِيهِ عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ عَوْنٍ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا وَأَشَارَ عَلَى رَأْسِهِ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'an muhammadin, 'an aabiy, hurayraaa qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laysa aahadun minkum yunjiyhi 'amaluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa walaa aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ walaa aanaa iilaaa aan yataghammadaniya alllahu minhu bimaghfiraain warahmaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala abnu 'awnin biyadihi hakadhaa waaashaara 'alaa raasihi ‏"‏ walaa aanaa iilaaa aan yataghammadaniya alllahu minhu bimaghfiraain warahmaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is none amongst you whose deeds alone would attain salvation for him. They (the Companions) said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? He (the Holy Prophet) said: Not even I, but that Allah wraps me in Mercy and He grants me pardon. Ibn 'Aun pointed towards his head with his hand saying: Not even I, but that Allah wraps me in His Forgiveness and Mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يُنْجِيهِ عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَدَارَكَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laysa aahadun yunjiyhi 'amaluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa walaa aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ walaa aanaa iilaaa aan yatadaarakaniya alllahu minhu birahmaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There is none whose deeds alone can'secure salvation for him. They said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that, the Mercy of Allah should take hold of me
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبَّادٍ، يَحْيَى بْنُ عَبَّادٍ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي عُبَيْدٍ، مَوْلَى عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَنْ يُدْخِلَ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِفَضْلٍ وَرَحْمَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa aabuw 'abbaadin, yahyaa bnu 'abbaadin haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, haddathanaa abnu shihaabin, 'an aabiy 'ubaydin, mawlaa 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ lan yudkhila aahadana minkum 'amaluhu aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa walaa aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ walaa aanaa iilaaa aan yataghammadaniya alllahu minhu bifadlin warahmaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:None amongst you can get. into Paradise by virtue of his deeds alone. They said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that Allah should wrap me in His Grace and Mercy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَارِبُوا وَسَدِّدُوا وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّهُ لَنْ يَنْجُوَ أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ بِعَمَلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَلاَ أَنْتَ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنْهُ وَفَضْلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ qaaribuwa wasaddiduwa waa'lamuwa aannahu lan yanjuwa aahadun minkum bi'amalihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi walaa aanta qaala ‏"‏ walaa aanaa iilaaa aan yataghammadaniya alllahu birahmaain minhu wafadlin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Observe moderation in deeds (and if it is not possible, try to be near moderation) and understand that none amongst you can attain salvation because of his deeds alone. They said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that Allah should wrap me in His Mercy and Grace
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Jabir through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِالإِسْنَادَيْنِ جَمِيعًا كَرِوَايَةِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, bialiisnaadayni jamiy'ana kariwaayaai abni numayrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: A hadith like this has been narrated on the authority of A'mash through two other chains of transmitters. The wording is, however, the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَزَادَ ‏ "‏ وَأَبْشِرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi wazaada ‏ "‏ waaabshiruwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters with this addition:" Give them glad tidings
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يُدْخِلُ أَحَدًا مِنْكُمْ عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَلاَ يُجِيرُهُ مِنَ النَّارِ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ بِرَحْمَةٍ مِنَ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy salamaau bnu shabiybin, haddathanaa alhasanu bnu aa'yana, haddathanaa ma'qilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yudkhilu aahadana minkum 'amaluhu aljannaaa walaa yujiyruhu mina alnnaari walaa aanaa iilaaa birahmaain mina alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying: None of you would get into Paradise because of his good deeds alone, and he would not be rescued from Fire, not even I, but because of the Mercy of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ، عُقْبَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مُوسَى، بْنُ عُقْبَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَلَمَةَ بْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ عَوْفٍ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهَا كَانَتْ تَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا وَأَبْشِرُوا فَإِنَّهُ لَنْ يُدْخِلَ الْجَنَّةَ أَحَدًا عَمَلُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَلاَ أَنْتَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ أَنَا إِلاَّ أَنْ يَتَغَمَّدَنِيَ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ بِرَحْمَةٍ وَاعْلَمُوا أَنَّ أَحَبَّ الْعَمَلِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهُ وَإِنْ قَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu muhammadin, aakhbaranaa muwsaa bnu, 'uqbaaa h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa bahzun, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa muwsaa, bnu 'uqbaaa qaala sami'tu aabaa salamaaa bna 'abdi alrrahmani bni 'awfin, yuhaddithu 'an 'aaiishaaa, zawji alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahaa kaanat taquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ saddiduwa waqaaribuwa waaabshiruwa faiinnahu lan yudkhila aljannaaa aahadana 'amaluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa walaa aanta yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ walaa aanaa iilaaa aan yataghammadaniya alllahu minhu birahmaain waa'lamuwa aanna aahabba al'amali iilaa alllahi aadwamuhu waiin qalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) used to say:Observe moderation (in doing deeds), and if you fail to observe it perfectly, try to do as much as you can do (to live up to this ideal of moderation) and be happy for none would be able to get into Paradise because of his deeds alone. They (the Companions of the Holy Prophet) said: Allah's Messenger, not even you? Thereupon he said: Not even I, but that Allah wraps me in His Mercy, and bear this in mind that the deed loved most by Allah is one which is done constantly even though it is small
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ حَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، بْنُ الْمُطَّلِبِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ ‏ "‏ وَأَبْشِرُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu hasanun alhulwaaniyyu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, bnu almuttalibi 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur ‏ "‏ waaabshiruwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Musa b. `Uqba with the same chain of transmitters and he did not make a mention of:"Be happy
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلاَقَةَ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ، شُعْبَةَ أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم صَلَّى حَتَّى انْتَفَخَتْ قَدَمَاهُ فَقِيلَ لَهُ أَتَكَلَّفُ هَذَا وَقَدْ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ أَفَلاَ أَكُونُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa aabuw 'awaanaaa, 'an ziyaadi bni 'ilaaqaaa, 'ani almughiyraai bni, shu'baaa aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm sallaa hattaa antafakhat qadamaahu faqiyla lahu aatakallafu hadhaa waqad ghafara alllahu laka maa taqaddama min dhanbika wamaa taaakhhara faqaala ‏ "‏ aafalaa aakuwnu 'abdana shakuwrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mughira b. Shu'ba reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) worshipped so much that his feet were swollen. It was said to him:(Why do you undergo so much hardship despite the fact that) Allah has pardoned for you your earlier and later sins? Thereupon he said: May I not (prove myself) to be a grateful servant (of Allah)?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ عِلاَقَةَ، سَمِعَ الْمُغِيرَةَ بْنَ شُعْبَةَ، يَقُولُ قَامَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى وَرِمَتْ قَدَمَاهُ قَالُوا قَدْ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَفَلاَ أَكُونُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an ziyaadi bni 'ilaaqaaa, sami'a almughiyraaa bna shu'baaa, yaquwlu qaama alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa warimat qadamaahu qaaluwa qad ghafara alllahu laka maa taqaddama min dhanbika wamaa taaakhhara ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ aafalaa aakuwnu 'abdana shakuwrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Mughira b. Shu'ba and the words are:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) kept standing in prayer (for such long hours) that his feet were swollen. They (his Companions) said: Verily, Allah has pardoned for thee the earlier and the later of thine sins. Thereupon he said: Should I not prove myself to be a grateful servant (of Allah)?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ قُسَيْطٍ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا صَلَّى قَامَ حَتَّى تَفَطَّرَ رِجْلاَهُ قَالَتْ عَائِشَةُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَتَصْنَعُ هَذَا وَقَدْ غُفِرَ لَكَ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِكَ وَمَا تَأَخَّرَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ أَفَلاَ أَكُونُ عَبْدًا شَكُورًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, wahaaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy aabuw sakhrin, 'ani abni qusaytin, 'an 'urwaaa bni alzzubayri, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidhaa sallaa qaama hattaa tafattara rijlaahu qaalat 'aaiishaau yaa rasuwla alllahi aatasna'u hadhaa waqad ghufira laka maa taqaddama min dhanbika wamaa taaakhhara faqaala ‏ "‏ yaa 'aaiishaau aafalaa aakuwnu 'abdana shakuwrana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) occupied himself in prayer, he observed such a (long) qiyam (posture of standing in prayer) that his feet were swollen. A'isha said:Allah's Messenger you do this (in spite of the fact) that your earlier and later sins have been pardoned for you? Thereupon, he said. A'isha should I not prove myself to be a thanksgiving servant (of Allah)?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا جُلُوسًا عِنْدَ بَابِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ نَنْتَظِرُهُ فَمَرَّ بِنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ النَّخَعِيُّ فَقُلْنَا أَعْلِمْهُ بِمَكَانِنَا ‏.‏ فَدَخَلَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَمْ يَلْبَثْ أَنْ خَرَجَ عَلَيْنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ إِنِّي أُخْبَرُ بِمَكَانِكُمْ فَمَا يَمْنَعُنِي أَنْ أَخْرُجَ إِلَيْكُمْ إِلاَّ كَرَاهِيَةُ أَنْ أُمِلَّكُمْ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَخَوَّلُنَا بِالْمَوْعِظَةِ فِي الأَيَّامِ مَخَافَةَ السَّآمَةِ عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, qaala kunnaa juluwsana 'inda baabi 'abdi alllahi nantaziruhu famarra binaa yaziydu bnu mu'aawiyaaa alnnakha'iyyu faqulnaa aa'limhu bimakaaninaa ‏.‏ fadakhala 'alayhi falam yalbath aan kharaja 'alaynaa 'abdu alllahi faqaala iinniy aukhbaru bimakaanikum famaa yamna'uniy aan aakhruja iilaykum iilaaa karaahiyaau aan aumillakum iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yatakhawwalunaa bialmaw'izaai fiy alaayyaami makhaafaaa alssaamaai 'alaynaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shaqiq reported:We were sitting at the door of Abdullah (b. Mas'ud) waiting for him (to come out and deliver a sermon to us). It was at this time that there happened to pass by us Yazid b. Mu'awiya an-Nakha'i. We said: Inform him ('Abdullah b. Mas'ud) of our presence here. He went in and Abdullah b. Mas'ud lost no time in coming out to us and said: I was informed of your presence here but nothing hindered me to come out to you but the fact that I did not like to bore you (by stuffing your minds with sermons) as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not deliver us sermon on certain days fearing that it might prove to be boring for us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مِنْجَابُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ التَّمِيمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ خَشْرَمٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى، بْنُ يُونُسَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏ وَزَادَ مِنْجَابٌ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنِ ابْنِ مُسْهِرٍ قَالَ الأَعْمَشُ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ مُرَّةَ عَنْ شَقِيقٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
