verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw sa'iydin alaashajju, haddathanaa abnu iidriysa, h wahaddathanaa minjaabu bnu alhaarithi alttamiymiyyu, haddathanaa abnu mushirin, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'aliyyu bnu khashramin, qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'iysaa, bnu yuwnusa h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu ‏.‏ wazaada minjaabun fiy riwaayatihi 'ani abni mushirin qaala alaa'mashu wahaddathaniy 'amruw bnu murraaa 'an shaqiyqin 'an 'abdi alllahi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah through other chains of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 52 — Characteristics of the Day of Judgment, Paradise, and Hell
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا فُضَيْلُ بْنُ عِيَاضٍ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، قَالَ كَانَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ يُذَكِّرُنَا كُلَّ يَوْمِ خَمِيسٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَجُلٌ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ إِنَّا نُحِبُّ حَدِيثَكَ وَنَشْتَهِيهِ وَلَوَدِدْنَا أَنَّكَ حَدَّثْتَنَا كُلَّ يَوْمٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ مَا يَمْنَعُنِي أَنْ أُحَدِّثَكُمْ إِلاَّ كَرَاهِيَةُ أَنْ أُمِلَّكُمْ ‏.‏ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَتَخَوَّلُنَا بِالْمَوْعِظَةِ فِي الأَيَّامِ كَرَاهِيَةَ السَّآمَةِ عَلَيْنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'an mansuwrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa fudaylu bnu 'iyaadin, 'an mansuwrin, 'an shaqiyqin aabiy waaiilin, qaala kaana 'abdu alllahi yudhakkirunaa kulla yawmi khamiysin faqaala lahu rajulun yaa aabaa 'abdi alrrahmani iinnaa nuhibbu hadiythaka wanashtahiyhi walawadidnaa aannaka haddathtanaa kulla yawmin ‏.‏ faqaala maa yamna'uniy aan auhaddithakum iilaaa karaahiyaau aan aumillakum ‏.‏ iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yatakhawwalunaa bialmaw'izaai fiy alaayyaami karaahiyaaa alssaamaai 'alaynaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Shaqiq b. Wi'il reported that 'Abdullah used to give us sermon on every Thursday. A person said:Abu 'Abd al-Rahman, we love your talk and so we yearn (to listen to you) and earnestly desire that you should deliver us lecture every day. Thereupon he said: There is nothing to hinder me in giving you talk (every day) but the fact that you may be bored. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not deliver sermons on certain days (fearing that we might be bored)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مَسْلَمَةَ بْنِ قَعْنَبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، وَحُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ حُفَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ بِالْمَكَارِهِ وَحُفَّتِ النَّارُ بِالشَّهَوَاتِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu maslamaaa bni qa'nabin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, wahumaydin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ huffati aljannaau bialmakaarihi wahuffati alnnaaru bialshhahawaati ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:The Paradise is surrounded by hardships and the Hell-Fire is surrounded by temptations
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathaniy warqaa'u, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، سَعِيدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ مِصْدَاقُ ذَلِكَ فِي كِتَابِ اللَّهِ ‏{‏ فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, qaala zuhayrun haddathanaa waqaala, sa'iydun aakhbaranaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ qaala alllahu 'azza wajalla aa'dadtu li'ibaadiya alssaalihiyna maa laa 'aynun raaat walaa audhunun sami'at walaa khatara 'alaa qalbi basharin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ misdaaqu dhalika fiy kitaabi alllahi ‏{‏ falaa ta'lamu nafsun maa aukhfiya lahum min qurraai aa'yunin jazaa'an bimaa kaanuwa ya'maluwna‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying that:Allah the Exalted and Glorious, said: I have prepared for My pious servants which no eye has ever seen, and no ear has ever heard, and no human heart has ever perceived but it is testified by the Book of Allah. He then recited:" No soul knows what comfort has been concealed from them, as a reward for what they did". (xxxii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ذُخْرًا بَلْهَ مَا أَطْلَعَكُمُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathanaa maalikun, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ qaala alllahu 'azza wajalla aa'dadtu li'ibaadiya alssaalihiyna maa laa 'aynun raaat walaa audhunun sami'at walaa khatara 'alaa qalbi basharin dhukhrana balha maa aatla'akumu alllahu 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: I have prepared for My pious servants which no eye (has ever) seen, no ear has (ever) heard and no human heart has ever perceived those bounties leaving apart (those bounties) about which Allah has informed you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ أَعْدَدْتُ لِعِبَادِيَ الصَّالِحِينَ مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ‏.‏ ذُخْرًا بَلْهَ مَا أَطْلَعَكُمُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ ‏{‏ فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa abnu, numayrin - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaquwlu alllahu 'azza wajalla aa'dadtu li'ibaadiya alssaalihiyna maa laa 'aynun raaat walaa audhunun sami'at walaa khatara 'alaa qalbi basharin ‏.‏ dhukhrana balha maa aatla'akumu alllahu 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaraaa ‏{‏ falaa ta'lamu nafsun maa aukhfiya lahum min qurraai aa'yunin‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said:I have prepared for My pious servants which the eye has seen not, and the ear has heard not and no human heart has ever perceived such bounties leaving aside those about which Allah has informed you. He then recited:" No soul knows what comfort has been hidden for thein
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَارُونُ بْنُ مَعْرُوفٍ، وَهَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو صَخْرٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا حَازِمٍ، حَدَّثَهُ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَهْلَ بْنَ سَعْدٍ السَّاعِدِيَّ، يَقُولُ شَهِدْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَجْلِسًا وَصَفَ فِيهِ الْجَنَّةَ حَتَّى انْتَهَى ثُمَّ قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي آخِرِ حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ فِيهَا مَا لاَ عَيْنٌ رَأَتْ وَلاَ أُذُنٌ سَمِعَتْ وَلاَ خَطَرَ عَلَى قَلْبِ بَشَرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ اقْتَرَأَ هَذِهِ الآيَةَ ‏{‏ تَتَجَافَى جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَاهُمْ يُنْفِقُونَ * فَلاَ تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَا أُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِنْ قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَاءً بِمَا كَانُوا يَعْمَلُونَ‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haaruwnu bnu ma'ruwfin, wahaaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy aabuw sakhrin, aanna aabaa haazimin, haddathahu qaala sami'tu sahla bna sa'din alssaa'idiyya, yaquwlu shahidtu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm majlisana wasafa fiyhi aljannaaa hattaa antahaa thumma qaala sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy akhiri hadiythihi ‏"‏ fiyhaa maa laa 'aynun raaat walaa audhunun sami'at walaa khatara 'alaa qalbi basharin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aqtaraaa hadhihi alayaaa ‏{‏ tatajaafaa junuwbuhum 'ani almadaaji'i yad'uwna rabbahum khawfana watama'ana wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiquwna * falaa ta'lamu nafsun maa aukhfiya lahum min qurraai aa'yunin jazaa'an bimaa kaanuwa ya'maluwna‏}‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd as-Sa'idi reported:I was in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he gave a description of Paradise and then Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) concluded with these words: There would be bounties which the eye has not seen and the ear has not heard and no human heart has ever perceived them. He then recited this verse:" They forsake (their) beds, calling upon their Lord in fear and in hope, and spend out of what We have given them. So no soul knows what refreshment of the eyes is hidden for them: a reward for what they did" (xxxii)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْمَقْبُرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَشَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ سَنَةٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy sa'iydin almaqburiyyi, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ iinna fiy aljannaai lashajaraaan yasiyru alrraakibu fiy zillihaa miaiaaa sanaain ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:In Paradise, there is a tree under the shadow of which a rider can travel for a hundred years
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ وَزَادَ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alhizaamiyya - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi wazaada ‏ "‏ laa yaqta'uhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters with the addition of these words:" He will not be able to cover this distance
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الْحَنْظَلِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا الْمَخْزُومِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، عَنْ أَبِي، حَازِمٍ عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَشَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ فِي ظِلِّهَا مِائَةَ عَامٍ لاَ يَقْطَعُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو حَازِمٍ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِهِ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ الزُّرَقِيَّ، فَقَالَ حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ شَجَرَةً يَسِيرُ الرَّاكِبُ الْجَوَادَ الْمُضَمَّرَ السَّرِيعَ مِائَةَ عَامٍ مَا يَقْطَعُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma alhanzaliyyu, aakhbaranaa almakhzuwmiyyu, haddathanaa wuhaybun, 'an aabiy, haazimin 'an sahli bni sa'din, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna fiy aljannaai lashajaraaan yasiyru alrraakibu fiy zillihaa miaiaaa 'aamin laa yaqta'uhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw haazimin fahaddathtu bihi alnnu'maana bna aabiy 'ayyaashin alzzuraqiyya, faqaala haddathaniy aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna fiy aljannaai shajaraaan yasiyru alrraakibu aljawaada almudammara alssariy'a miaiaaa 'aamin maa yaqta'uhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:In Paradise, there is a tree under the shadow of which a rider can travel for a hundred years without covering (the distance) completely. This hadith has also been transmitted on the authority of Abu Sa'id al-Khudri that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) is reported to have said: In Paradise, there is a tree under the shadow of which a rider of a fine and swift-footed horse would travel for a hundred years without covering the distance completely. There would be the pleasure of Allah for the inmates of Paradise and He would never be annoyed with them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَهْمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُبَارَكِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَالِكُ، بْنُ أَنَسٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَسْلَمَ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يَقُولُ لأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ لَبَّيْكَ رَبَّنَا وَسَعْدَيْكَ وَالْخَيْرُ فِي يَدَيْكَ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ هَلْ رَضِيتُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ وَمَا لَنَا لاَ نَرْضَى يَا رَبِّ وَقَدْ أَعْطَيْتَنَا مَا لَمْ تُعْطِ أَحَدًا مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَيَقُولُ أَلاَ أُعْطِيكُمْ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُونَ يَا رَبِّ وَأَىُّ شَىْءٍ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَيَقُولُ أُحِلُّ عَلَيْكُمْ رِضْوَانِي فَلاَ أَسْخَطُ عَلَيْكُمْ بَعْدَهُ أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani bni sahmin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu almubaaraki, aakhbaranaa maaliku, bnu aanasin h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an zaydi bni aaslama, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha yaquwlu laahli aljannaai yaa aahla aljannaai ‏.‏ fayaquwluwna labbayka rabbanaa wasa'dayka waalkhayru fiy yadayka ‏.‏ fayaquwlu hal radiytum fayaquwluwna wamaa lanaa laa nardaa yaa rabbi waqad aa'taytanaa maa lam tu'ti aahadana min khalqika fayaquwlu aalaa au'tiykum aafdala min dhalika fayaquwluwna yaa rabbi waaaaau shaa'in aafdalu min dhalika fayaquwlu auhillu 'alaykum ridwaaniy falaa aaskhatu 'alaykum ba'dahu aabadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said that Allah would say to the inmates of Paradise:O, Dwellers of Paradise, and they would say in response: At thy service and pleasure, our Lord, the good is in Thy Hand. He (the Lord) would say: Are you well pleased now? They would say: Why should we not be pleased, O Lord, when Thou hast given us what Thou hast not given to any of Thy creatures? He would, however, say: May I not give you (something) even more excellent than that? And they would say: O Lord, what thing can be more excellent than this? And He would say: I shall cause My pleasure to alight upon you and I shall never be afterwards annoyed with you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لَيَتَرَاءَوْنَ الْغُرْفَةَ فِي الْجَنَّةِ كَمَا تَرَاءَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ فِي السَّمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَحَدَّثْتُ بِذَلِكَ النُّعْمَانَ بْنَ أَبِي عَيَّاشٍ، فَقَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيَّ، يَقُولُ كَمَا تَرَاءَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ الدُّرِّيَّ فِي الأُفُقِ الشَّرْقِيِّ أَوِ الْغَرْبِيِّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an sahli bni sa'din, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna aahla aljannaai layataraa'awna alghurfaaa fiy aljannaai kamaa taraa'awna alkawkaba fiy alssamaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fahaddathtu bidhalika alnnu'maana bna aabiy 'ayyaashin, faqaala sami'tu aabaa sa'iydin alkhudriyya, yaquwlu kamaa taraa'awna alkawkaba alddurriyya fiy alaufuqi alshharqiyyi aawi algharbiyyi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sahl b. Sa'd reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The inmates of Paradise will look to the upper apartment of Paradise as you see the planets in the sky. I narrated this hadith to Nu'man b. Abi 'Ayyash and he said: I heard Abu Sa'id al-Khudri as saying: As you see the shining planets in the eastern and western (sides of) horizon
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى بْنِ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي مَالِكُ بْنُ أَنَسٍ، عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ سُلَيْمٍ، عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لَيَتَرَاءَوْنَ أَهْلَ الْغُرَفِ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ كَمَا تَتَرَاءَوْنَ الْكَوْكَبَ الدُّرِّيَّ الْغَابِرَ مِنَ الأُفُقِ مِنَ الْمَشْرِقِ أَوِ الْمَغْرِبِ لِتَفَاضُلِ مَا بَيْنَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ تِلْكَ مَنَازِلُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ لاَ يَبْلُغُهَا غَيْرُهُمْ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ بَلَى وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ رِجَالٌ آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَصَدَّقُوا الْمُرْسَلِينَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu ja'fari bni yahyaa bni khaalidin, haddathanaa ma'nun, haddathanaa maalikun, h wahaddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy maaliku bnu aanasin, 'an safwaana bni sulaymin, 'an 'ataa'i bni yasaarin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ iinna aahla aljannaai layataraa'awna aahla alghurafi min fawqihim kamaa tataraa'awna alkawkaba alddurriyya alghaabira mina alaufuqi mina almashriqi aawi almaghribi litafaaduli maa baynahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa yaa rasuwla alllahi tilka manaazilu alaanbiyaa'i laa yablughuhaa ghayruhum ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ balaa waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi rijaalun amanuwa bialllahi wasaddaquwa almursaliyna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The inmates of Paradise would see the inmates of the apartment over them just as you see the shining planets which remain in the eastern and the western horizon because of the superiority some have over others. They said: Allah's Messenger, would in these abodes of Apostles others besides them not be able to reach? He said: Yes, they will, by Him, in Whose hand is my life, those who believe in God and acknowledge the Truth, will reach them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مِنْ أَشَدِّ أُمَّتِي لِي حُبًّا نَاسٌ يَكُونُونَ بَعْدِي يَوَدُّ أَحَدُهُمْ لَوْ رَآنِي بِأَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ min aashaddi aummatiy liy hubbana naasun yakuwnuwna ba'diy yawaddu aahaduhum law raaniy biaahlihi wamaalihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The people most loved by me from amongst my Ummah would be those who would come after me but everyone amongst them would have the keenest desire to catch a glimpse of me even at the cost of his family and wealth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عُثْمَانَ، سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْجَبَّارِ الْبَصْرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، الْبُنَانِيِّ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَسُوقًا يَأْتُونَهَا كُلَّ جُمُعَةٍ فَتَهُبُّ رِيحُ الشَّمَالِ فَتَحْثُو فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ وَثِيَابِهِمْ فَيَزْدَادُونَ حُسْنًا وَجَمَالاً فَيَرْجِعُونَ إِلَى أَهْلِيهِمْ وَقَدِ ازْدَادُوا حُسْنًا وَجَمَالاً فَيَقُولُ لَهُمْ أَهْلُوهُمْ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدِ ازْدَدْتُمْ بَعْدَنَا حُسْنًا وَجَمَالاً ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُونَ وَأَنْتُمْ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدِ ازْدَدْتُمْ بَعْدَنَا حُسْنًا وَجَمَالاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw 'uthmaana, sa'iydu bnu 'abdi aljabbaari albasriyyu haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, albunaaniyyi 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna fiy aljannaai lasuwqana yaatuwnahaa kulla jumu'aain fatahubbu riyhu alshhamaali fatahthuw fiy wujuwhihim wathiyaabihim fayazdaaduwna husnana wajamaalaan fayarji'uwna iilaa aahliyhim waqadi azdaaduwa husnana wajamaalaan fayaquwlu lahum aahluwhum waalllahi laqadi azdadtum ba'danaa husnana wajamaalaan ‏.‏ fayaquwluwna waaantum waalllahi laqadi azdadtum ba'danaa husnana wajamaalaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:In Paradise there is a street to which they would come every Friday. The north wind will blow and would scatter fragrance on their faces and on their clothes and would add to their beauty and loveliness, and then they would go back to their family after having an added lustre to their beauty and loveliness, and their family would say to them: By Allah, you have been increased in beauty and loveliness after leaving us, and they would say: By Allah, you have also increased in beauty and loveliness after us
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَيَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِيَعْقُوبَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَيُّوبُ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ إِمَّا تَفَاخَرُوا وَإِمَّا تَذَاكَرُوا الرِّجَالُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَكْثَرُ أَمِ النِّسَاءُ فَقَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ أَوَلَمْ يَقُلْ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ وَالَّتِي تَلِيهَا عَلَى أَضْوَإِ كَوْكَبٍ دُرِّيٍّ فِي السَّمَاءِ لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مِنْهُمْ زَوْجَتَانِ اثْنَتَانِ يُرَى مُخُّ سُوقِهِمَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ اللَّحْمِ وَمَا فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَعْزَبُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, - waalllafzu liya'quwba - qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu abnu 'ulayyaaa, aakhbaranaa aayyuwbu, 'an muhammadin, qaala iimmaa tafaakharuwa waiimmaa tadhaakaruwa alrrijaalu fiy aljannaai aaktharu aami alnnisaa'u faqaala aabuw hurayraaa aawalam yaqul aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna aawwala zumraain tadkhulu aljannaaa 'alaa suwraai alqamari laylaaa albadri waallatiy taliyhaa 'alaa aadwaii kawkabin durriyyin fiy alssamaa'i likulli amriiin minhum zawjataani athnataani yuraa mukhhu suwqihimaa min waraa'i alllahmi wamaa fiy aljannaai aa'zabu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad reported that some (persons) stated with a sense of pride and some discussed whether there would be more men in Paradise or more women. It was upon this that Abu Huraira reported that Abu'l Qasim (the Holy Prophet) (ﷺ) said:The (members) of the first group to get into Paradise would have their faces as bright as full moon during the night, and the next to this group would have their faces as bright as the shining stars in the sky, and every person would have two wives and the marrow of their shanks would glimmer beneath the flesh and there would be none without a wife in Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، قَالَ اخْتَصَمَ الرِّجَالُ وَالنِّسَاءُ أَيُّهُمْ فِي الْجَنَّةِ أَكْثَرُ فَسَأَلُوا أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ فَقَالَ قَالَ أَبُو الْقَاسِمِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aayyuwba, 'ani abni siyriyna, qaala akhtasama alrrijaalu waalnnisaa'u aayyuhum fiy aljannaai aaktharu fasaaaluwa aabaa hurayraaa faqaala qaala aabuw alqaasimi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَاحِدِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ زِيَادٍ - عَنْ عُمَارَةَ بْنِ، الْقَعْقَاعِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو زُرْعَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَوَّلُ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ زُمْرَةٍ يَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ وَالَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ عَلَى أَشَدِّ كَوْكَبٍ دُرِّيٍّ فِي السَّمَاءِ إِضَاءَةً لاَ يَبُولُونَ وَلاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلاَ يَتْفُلُونَ أَمْشَاطُهُمُ الذَّهَبُ وَرَشْحُهُمُ الْمِسْكُ وَمَجَامِرُهُمُ الأَلُوَّةُ وَأَزْوَاجُهُمُ الْحُورُ الْعِينُ أَخْلاَقُهُمْ عَلَى خُلُقِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى صُورَةِ أَبِيهِمْ آدَمَ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا فِي السَّمَاءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaahidi, - ya'niy abna ziyaadin - 'an 'umaaraaa bni, alqa'qaa'i haddathanaa aabuw zur'aaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aawwalu man yadkhulu aljannaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ h wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wazuhayru bnu harbin, - waalllafzu liqutaybaaa - qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'umaaraaa, 'an aabiy zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna aawwala zumraain yadkhuluwna aljannaaa 'alaa suwraai alqamari laylaaa albadri waalladhiyna yaluwnahum 'alaa aashaddi kawkabin durriyyin fiy alssamaa'i iidaa'aaan laa yabuwluwna walaa yataghawwatuwna walaa yamtakhituwna walaa yatfuluwna aamshaatuhumu aldhhahabu warashhuhumu almisku wamajaamiruhumu alaaluwwaau waaazwaajuhumu alhuwru al'iynu aakhlaaquhum 'alaa khuluqi rajulin waahidin 'alaa suwraai aabiyhim adama sittuwna dhiraa'ana fiy alssamaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The (members of the) first group which would get into Paradise will have their faces as bright as stars in the sky. They would neither pass water, nor void excrement, nor will they suffer from catarrh, nor will they spit, and their combs would be made of gold, and their sweat will be musk, the fuel of their brazier will be aloes, and their wives will be large-eyed maidens and their form would be alike as one single person after the form of their father (Adam) sixty cubits tall
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ مِنْ أُمَّتِي عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ ثُمَّ الَّذِينَ يَلُونَهُمْ عَلَى أَشَدِّ نَجْمٍ فِي السَّمَاءِ إِضَاءَةً ثُمَّ هُمْ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ مَنَازِلُ لاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ وَلاَ يَبُولُونَ وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلاَ يَبْزُقُونَ أَمْشَاطُهُمُ الذَّهَبُ وَمَجَامِرُهُمُ الأَلُوَّةُ وَرَشْحُهُمُ الْمِسْكُ أَخْلاَقُهُمْ عَلَى خُلُقِ رَجُلٍ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى طُولِ أَبِيهِمْ آدَمَ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ عَلَى خُلُقِ رَجُلٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ عَلَى خَلْقِ رَجُلٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ أَبِيهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aawwalu zumraain tadkhulu aljannaaa min aummatiy 'alaa suwraai alqamari laylaaa albadri thumma alladhiyna yaluwnahum 'alaa aashaddi najmin fiy alssamaa'i iidaa'aaan thumma hum ba'da dhalika manaazilu laa yataghawwatuwna walaa yabuwluwna walaa yamtakhituwna walaa yabzuquwna aamshaatuhumu aldhhahabu wamajaamiruhumu alaaluwwaau warashhuhumu almisku aakhlaaquhum 'alaa khuluqi rajulin waahidin 'alaa tuwli aabiyhim adama sittuwna dhiraa'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy shaybaaa 'alaa khuluqi rajulin ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw kuraybin 'alaa khalqi rajulin ‏.‏ waqaala abnu aabiy shaybaaa 'alaa suwraai aabiyhim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The first group of my Ummah to get into Paradise would be like a full moon in the night. Then those who would be next to them; they would be like the most significantly glittering stars in regard to brightness, then after them (others) in ranks. They would neither void excrement, nor pass water, nor suffer from catarrh, nor would they spit. And their combs would be made of gold, and the fuel of their braziers would be aloes and their sweat would be musk and their form would be the form of one single person according to the length of their father sixty cubits tall. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn Abi Shaiba with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَوَّلُ زُمْرَةٍ تَلِجُ الْجَنَّةَ صُوَرُهُمْ عَلَى صُورَةِ الْقَمَرِ لَيْلَةَ الْبَدْرِ لاَ يَبْصُقُونَ فِيهَا وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ فِيهَا آنِيَتُهُمْ وَأَمْشَاطُهُمْ مِنَ الذَّهَبِ وَالْفِضَّةِ وَمَجَامِرُهُمْ مِنَ الأَلُوَّةِ وَرَشْحُهُمُ الْمِسْكُ وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ زَوْجَتَانِ يُرَى مُخُّ سَاقِهِمَا مِنْ وَرَاءِ اللَّحْمِ مِنَ الْحُسْنِ لاَ اخْتِلاَفَ بَيْنَهُمْ وَلاَ تَبَاغُضَ قُلُوبُهُمْ قَلْبٌ وَاحِدٌ يُسَبِّحُونَ اللَّهَ بُكْرَةً وَعَشِيًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aawwalu zumraain taliju aljannaaa suwaruhum 'alaa suwraai alqamari laylaaa albadri laa yabsuquwna fiyhaa walaa yamtakhituwna walaa yataghawwatuwna fiyhaa aniyatuhum waaamshaatuhum mina aldhhahabi waalfiddaai wamajaamiruhum mina alaaluwwaai warashhuhumu almisku walikulli waahidin minhum zawjataani yuraa mukhhu saaqihimaa min waraa'i alllahmi mina alhusni laa akhtilaafa baynahum walaa tabaaghuda quluwbuhum qalbun waahidun yusabbihuwna alllaha bukraaan wa'ashiyyana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:These are some of the ahidith which Abu Huraira reported from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one is this that he is reported to have said: The (members of the) first group that would be admitted to Paradise would have their faces as bright as full moon during the night. They would neither spit nor suffer catarrh, nor void excrement. They would have their utensils and their combs made of gold and silver and the fuel of their braziers would be aloes and their sweat would be musk and every one of them would have two spouses (so beautiful) that the marrow of their shanks would be visible through the flesh. There would be no dissension amongst them and no enmity in their hearts. Their hearts would be like one heart, glorifying Allah morning and evening
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ يَأْكُلُونَ فِيهَا وَيَشْرَبُونَ وَلاَ يَتْفُلُونَ وَلاَ يَبُولُونَ وَلاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَمَا بَالُ الطَّعَامِ قَالَ ‏"‏ جُشَاءٌ وَرَشْحٌ كَرَشْحِ الْمِسْكِ يُلْهَمُونَ التَّسْبِيحَ وَالتَّحْمِيدَ كَمَا يُلْهَمُونَ النَّفَسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu li'uthmaana - qaala 'uthmaanu haddathanaa waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iinna aahla aljannaai yaakuluwna fiyhaa wayashrabuwna walaa yatfuluwna walaa yabuwluwna walaa yataghawwatuwna walaa yamtakhituwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa famaa baalu altta'aami qaala ‏"‏ jushaa'un warashhun karashhi almiski yulhamuwna alttasbiyha waalttahmiyda kamaa yulhamuwna alnnafasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying that the inmates of Paradise would eat and drink but would neither spit, nor pass water, nor void excrement, nor suffer catarrah. It was said: Then, what would happen with food? Thereupon he said: They would belch and sweat (and it would be over with their food), and their sweat would be that of musk and they would glorify and praise Allah as easily as you breathe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏ "‏ كَرَشْحِ الْمِسْكِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi iilaa qawlihi ‏ "‏ karashhi almiski ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of A'mash with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ أَبِي عَاصِمٍ، - قَالَ حَسَنٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، - عَنِ ابْنِ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ، عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَأْكُلُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ فِيهَا وَيَشْرَبُونَ وَلاَ يَتَغَوَّطُونَ وَلاَ يَمْتَخِطُونَ وَلاَ يَبُولُونَ وَلَكِنْ طَعَامُهُمْ ذَاكَ جُشَاءٌ كَرَشْحِ الْمِسْكِ يُلْهَمُونَ التَّسْبِيحَ وَالْحَمْدَ كَمَا يُلْهَمُونَ النَّفَسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ حَجَّاجٍ ‏"‏ طَعَامُهُمْ ذَلِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, kilaahumaa 'an aabiy 'aasimin, - qaala hasanun haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, - 'ani abni jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, aannahu sami'a jaabira bna, 'abdi alllahi yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaakulu aahlu aljannaai fiyhaa wayashrabuwna walaa yataghawwatuwna walaa yamtakhituwna walaa yabuwluwna walakin ta'aamuhum dhaaka jushaa'un karashhi almiski yulhamuwna alttasbiyha waalhamda kamaa yulhamuwna alnnafasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala wafiy hadiythi hajjaajin ‏"‏ ta'aamuhum dhalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that the inmates of Paradise would eat therein and they would also drink, but they would neither void excrement, nor suffer catarrh, nor pass water, and their eating (would be digested) in the form of belching and their sweat would be musk aged they would glorify and praise Allah as easily ai you breathe
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى الأُمَوِيُّ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ جُرَيْجٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ وَيُلْهَمُونَ التَّسْبِيحَ وَالتَّكْبِيرَ كَمَا يُلْهَمُونَ النَّفَسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy sa'iydu bnu yahyaa alaumawiyyu, haddathaniy aabiy, haddathanaa abnu jurayjin, aakhbaraniy aabuw alzzubayri, 'an jaabirin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ wayulhamuwna alttasbiyha waalttakbiyra kamaa yulhamuwna alnnafasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Jabir with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَبِي رَافِعٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ يَنْعَمُ لاَ يَبْأَسُ لاَ تَبْلَى ثِيَابُهُ وَلاَ يَفْنَى شَبَابُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin, 'an aabiy raafi'in, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man yadkhulu aljannaaa yan'amu laa yabaasu laa tablaa thiyaabuhu walaa yafnaa shabaabuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who would get into Paradise (would be made to enjoy such an everlasting) bliss that he would neither become destitute, nor would his clothes wear out, nor his youth would decline
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لإِسْحَاقَ - قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، قَالَ قَالَ الثَّوْرِيُّ فَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو إِسْحَاقَ، أَنَّ الأَغَرَّ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، وَأَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يُنَادِي مُنَادٍ إِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَصِحُّوا فَلاَ تَسْقَمُوا أَبَدًا وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَحْيَوْا فَلاَ تَمُوتُوا أَبَدًا وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَشِبُّوا فَلاَ تَهْرَمُوا أَبَدًا وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ أَنْ تَنْعَمُوا فَلاَ تَبْتَئِسُوا أَبَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ وَنُودُوا أَنْ تِلْكُمُ الْجَنَّةُ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ‏}‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, - waalllafzu liishaaqa - qaalaa aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, qaala qaala althhawriyyu fahaddathaniy aabuw iishaaqa, aanna alaagharra, haddathahu 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, waaabiy hurayraaa 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ yunaadiy munaadin iinna lakum aan tasihhuwa falaa tasqamuwa aabadana waiinna lakum aan tahyawa falaa tamuwtuwa aabadana waiinna lakum aan tashibbuwa falaa tahramuwa aabadana waiinna lakum aan tan'amuwa falaa tabtaiisuwa aabadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhalika qawluhu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ wanuwduwa aan tilkumu aljannaau auwrithtumuwhaa bimaa kuntum ta'maluwna‏}‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri and Abu Huraira both reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There would be an announcer (in Paradise) who would make this announcement: Verily I there is in store for you (everlasting) health and that you should never fall ill and that you live (for ever) and do not die at all. And that you would remain young and never grow old. And that you would always live in affluent circumstances and never become destitute, as words of Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, are:" And it would be announced to them: This is the Paradise. You have been made to inherit it for what you used to do". (VII;)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قُدَامَةَ، - وَهُوَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَبِي، عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ لَخَيْمَةً مِنْ لُؤْلُؤَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ مُجَوَّفَةٍ طُولُهَا سِتُّونَ مِيلاً لِلْمُؤْمِنِ فِيهَا أَهْلُونَ يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ فَلاَ يَرَى بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu mansuwrin, 'an aabiy qudaamaaa, - wahuwa alhaarithu bnu 'ubaydin - 'an aabiy, 'imraana aljawniyyi 'an aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alllahi bni qaysin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna lilmuumini fiy aljannaai lakhaymaaan min luuluuaain waahidaain mujawwafaain tuwluhaa sittuwna miylaan lilmuumini fiyhaa aahluwna yatuwfu 'alayhimu almuuminu falaa yaraa ba'duhum ba'dana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakr b. Abdullah b. Qais reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that in Paradise there would be for a believer a tent of a single hollowed pearl the breadth of which would be sixty miles. It would be meant for a believer and the believers would go around it and none would be able to see the others
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَبْدِ الصَّمَدِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ فِي الْجَنَّةِ خَيْمَةٌ مِنْ لُؤْلُؤَةٍ مُجَوَّفَةٍ عَرْضُهَا سِتُّونَ مِيلاً فِي كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْهَا أَهْلٌ مَا يَرَوْنَ الآخَرِينَ يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمُ الْمُؤْمِنُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, haddathanaa aabuw 'abdi alssamadi, haddathanaa aabuw 'imraana aljawniyyu, 'an aabiy bakri bni 'abdi alllahi bni qaysin, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ fiy aljannaai khaymaaun min luuluuaain mujawwafaain 'arduhaa sittuwna miylaan fiy kulli zaawiyaain minhaa aahlun maa yarawna alakhariyna yatuwfu 'alayhimu almuuminu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakr b. Abdullah b. Qais reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said that in Paradise there would be a tent made of a single hollowed pearl, the breadth of which would be sixty miles from all sides and there would live a family in each corner and the other would not be able to see the believer who goes around them
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، أَخْبَرَنَا هَمَّامٌ، عَنْ أَبِي، عِمْرَانَ الْجَوْنِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرِ بْنِ أَبِي مُوسَى بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الْخَيْمَةُ دُرَّةٌ طُولُهَا فِي السَّمَاءِ سِتُّونَ مِيلاً فِي كُلِّ زَاوِيَةٍ مِنْهَا أَهْلٌ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ لاَ يَرَاهُمُ الآخَرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, aakhbaranaa hammaamun, 'an aabiy, 'imraana aljawniyyi 'an aabiy bakri bni aabiy muwsaa bni qaysin, 'an aabiyhi, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alkhaymaau durraaun tuwluhaa fiy alssamaa'i sittuwna miylaan fiy kulli zaawiyaain minhaa aahlun lilmuumini laa yaraahumu alakharuwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr b. Abu Musa b. Qais who, on the authority of his father, reported the Apostle (ﷺ) to have said that there would be a tent made of a pearl whose height towards the sky would be sixty miles. In each corner, there would be a family of the believer, out of sight for the others
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ سَيْحَانُ وَجَيْحَانُ وَالْفُرَاتُ وَالنِّيلُ كُلٌّ مِنْ أَنْهَارِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, wa'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, wa'aliyyu bnu mushirin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni 'umara, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an khubaybi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ sayhaanu wajayhaanu waalfuraatu waalnniylu kullun min aanhaari aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Saihan, Jaihan, Euphrates and Nile are all among the rivers of Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النَّضْرِ، هَاشِمُ بْنُ الْقَاسِمِ اللَّيْثِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ أَقْوَامٌ أَفْئِدَتُهُمْ مِثْلُ أَفْئِدَةِ الطَّيْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa aabuw alnnadri, haashimu bnu alqaasimi alllaythiyyu haddathanaa iibraahiymu, - ya'niy abna sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yadkhulu aljannaaa aaqwaamun aafiidatuhum mithlu aafiidaai alttayri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There would enter Paradise people whose hearts would be like those of the hearts of birds
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا بِهِ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ آدَمَ عَلَى صُورَتِهِ طُولُهُ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا فَلَمَّا خَلَقَهُ قَالَ اذْهَبْ فَسَلِّمْ عَلَى أُولَئِكَ النَّفَرِ وَهُمْ نَفَرٌ مِنَ الْمَلاَئِكَةِ جُلُوسٌ فَاسْتَمِعْ مَا يُجِيبُونَكَ فَإِنَّهَا تَحِيَّتُكَ وَتَحِيَّةُ ذُرِّيَّتِكَ قَالَ فَذَهَبَ فَقَالَ السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَقَالُوا السَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ - قَالَ - فَزَادُوهُ وَرَحْمَةُ اللَّهِ - قَالَ - فَكُلُّ مَنْ يَدْخُلُ الْجَنَّةَ عَلَى صُورَةِ آدَمَ وَطُولُهُ سِتُّونَ ذِرَاعًا فَلَمْ يَزَلِ الْخَلْقُ يَنْقُصُ بَعْدَهُ حَتَّى الآنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa bihi aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ khalaqa alllahu 'azza wajalla adama 'alaa suwratihi tuwluhu sittuwna dhiraa'ana falammaa khalaqahu qaala adhhab fasallim 'alaa auwlaiika alnnafari wahum nafarun mina almalaaiikaai juluwsun faastami' maa yujiybuwnaka faiinnahaa tahiyyatuka watahiyyaau dhurriyyatika qaala fadhahaba faqaala alssalaamu 'alaykum faqaaluwa alssalaamu 'alayka warahmaau alllahi - qaala - fazaaduwhu warahmaau alllahi - qaala - fakullu man yadkhulu aljannaaa 'alaa suwraai adama watuwluhu sittuwna dhiraa'ana falam yazali alkhalqu yanqusu ba'dahu hattaa alana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, created Adam in His image with His length of sixty cubits, and as He created him He told him to greet that group, and that was a party of angels sitting there, and listen to the response that they give him, for it would form his greeting and that of his offspring. He then went away and said: Peace be upon you! They (the angels) said: May there be peace upon you and the Mercy of Allah, and they made an addition of" Mercy of Allah". So he who would get into Paradise would get in the form of Adam, his length being sixty cubits, then the people who followed him continued to diminish in size up to this day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُمَرُ بْنُ حَفْصِ بْنِ غِيَاثٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ الْكَاهِلِيِّ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُؤْتَى بِجَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَهَا سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ زِمَامٍ مَعَ كُلِّ زِمَامٍ سَبْعُونَ أَلْفَ مَلَكٍ يَجُرُّونَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'umaru bnu hafsi bni ghiyaathin, haddathanaa aabiy, 'ani al'alaa'i bni khaalidin alkaahiliyyi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yuutaa bijahannama yawmaiidhin lahaa sab'uwna aalfa zimaamin ma'a kulli zimaamin sab'uwna aalfa malakin yajurruwnahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Mas`ud reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Hell would be brought on that day (the Day of Judgment) with seventy thousand bridles, and seventy thousand angels dragging each bridle
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْمُغِيرَةُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْحِزَامِيَّ - عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ نَارُكُمْ هَذِهِ الَّتِي يُوقِدُ ابْنُ آدَمَ جُزْءٌ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ جُزْءًا مِنْ حَرِّ جَهَنَّمَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَاللَّهِ إِنْ كَانَتْ لَكَافِيَةً يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَإِنَّهَا فُضِّلَتْ عَلَيْهَا بِتِسْعَةٍ وَسِتِّينَ جُزْءًا كُلُّهَا مِثْلُ حَرِّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa almughiyraau, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alhizaamiyya - 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ naarukum hadhihi allatiy yuwqidu abnu adama juz'un min sab'iyna juz'ana min harri jahannama ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa waalllahi iin kaanat lakaafiyaaan yaa rasuwla alllahi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faiinnahaa fuddilat 'alayhaa bitis'aain wasittiyna juz'ana kulluhaa mithlu harrihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The fire which sons of Adam burn is only one-seventieth part of the Fire of Hell. His Companions said: By Allah, even ordinary fire would have been enough (to burn people). Thereupon he said: It is sixty-nine parts in excess of (the heat of) fire in this world each of them being equivalent to their heat
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ كُلُّهُنَّ مِثْلُ حَرِّهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithli hadiythi aabiy alzzinaadi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ kulluhunna mithlu harrihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abn Huraira through another chain of transmitters with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، حَدَّثَنَا خَلَفُ بْنُ خَلِيفَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي، حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذْ سَمِعَ وَجْبَةً فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَدْرُونَ مَا هَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ أَعْلَمُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا حَجَرٌ رُمِيَ بِهِ فِي النَّارِ مُنْذُ سَبْعِينَ خَرِيفًا فَهُوَ يَهْوِي فِي النَّارِ الآنَ حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَى قَعْرِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, haddathanaa khalafu bnu khaliyfaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu kaysaana, 'an aabiy, haazimin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm iidh sami'a wajbaaan faqaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ tadruwna maa hadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qulnaa alllahu warasuwluhu aa'lamu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ hadhaa hajarun rumiya bihi fiy alnnaari mundhu sab'iyna khariyfana fahuwa yahwiy fiy alnnaari alana hattaa antahaa iilaa qa'rihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:We were in the company of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that we heard a terrible sound. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Do you know what (sound) is this? We said: Allah and His Messenger know best. Thereupon he said: That is a stone which was thrown seventy years before in Hell and it has'been constantly slipping down and now it has reached its base
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ ‏ "‏ هَذَا وَقَعَ فِي أَسْفَلِهَا فَسَمِعْتُمْ وَجْبَتَهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, waabnu aabiy 'umara, qaalaa haddathanaa marwaanu, 'an yaziyda bni kaysaana, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waqaala ‏ "‏ hadhaa waqa'a fiy aasfalihaa fasami'tum wajbatahaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abfi Huraira with the same chain of transmitters but with this change of wording that the Prophet (may. peace be upon him) said:It reached at its base and you heard its sound
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، قَالَ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا نَضْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ النَّارُ إِلَى كَعْبَيْهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ إِلَى حُجْزَتِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ إِلَى عُنُقِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, qaala qaala qataadaau sami'tu aabaa nadraaa, yuhaddithu 'an samuraaa, aannahu sami'a nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinna minhum man taakhudhuhu alnnaaru iilaa ka'bayhi waminhum man taakhudhuhu iilaa hujzatihi waminhum man taakhudhuhu iilaa 'unuqihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Samura b. Jundub reported Allah's Apostle (may peace -be upon him) as saying:There will be some to whose ankels the fire will reach, some to whose knees, some to whose waist the fire will reach, and some to whose collar-bone the fire will reach
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَطَاءٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا نَضْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَمُرَةَ بْنِ جُنْدَبٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ النَّارُ إِلَى كَعْبَيْهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ النَّارُ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ النَّارُ إِلَى حُجْزَتِهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأْخُذُهُ النَّارُ إِلَى تَرْقُوَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - ya'niy abna 'ataa'in - 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa nadraaa, yuhaddithu 'an samuraaa bni jundabin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ minhum man taakhudhuhu alnnaaru iilaa ka'bayhi waminhum man taakhudhuhu alnnaaru iilaa rukbatayhi waminhum man taakhudhuhu alnnaaru iilaa hujzatihi waminhum man taakhudhuhu alnnaaru iilaa tarquwatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Samura b. Jundub reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There would be among them those to whom the fire will reach up to their ankels and to some of them the fire would reach their knees and to some it would reach their waists and to some it would reach up to their collar-bones
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَجَعَلَ مَكَانَ حُجْزَتِهِ حَقْوَيْهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa rawhun, haddathanaa sa'iydun, bihadhaa aliisnaadi waja'ala makaana hujzatihi haqwayhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ احْتَجَّتِ النَّارُ وَالْجَنَّةُ فَقَالَتْ هَذِهِ يَدْخُلُنِي الْجَبَّارُونَ وَالْمُتَكَبِّرُونَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ هَذِهِ يَدْخُلُنِي الضُّعَفَاءُ وَالْمَسَاكِينُ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لِهَذِهِ أَنْتِ عَذَابِي أُعَذِّبُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ - وَرُبَّمَا قَالَ أُصِيبُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ - وَقَالَ لِهَذِهِ أَنْتِ رَحْمَتِي أَرْحَمُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْكُمَا مِلْؤُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ ahtajjati alnnaaru waaljannaau faqaalat hadhihi yadkhuluniy aljabbaaruwna waalmutakabbiruwna ‏.‏ waqaalat hadhihi yadkhuluniy alddu'afaa'u waalmasaakiynu faqaala alllahu 'azza wajalla lihadhihi aanti 'adhaabiy au'adhhibu biki man aashaa'u - warubbamaa qaala ausiybu biki man aashaa'u - waqaala lihadhihi aanti rahmatiy aarhamu biki man aashaa'u walikulli waahidaain minkumaa miluuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing:There was a dispute between the Hell and the Paradise and it (the Hell) said: The haughty and the proud would find abode in me. And the Paradise said: The meek and the humble would find their abode in me. Thereupon Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, (addressing the Hell) said: You are (the means) of My punishment by which I punish those of My servants whom I wish. (And addressing the Paradise) He said: You are only My Mercy by means of which 1 shall show mercy to those whom I wish, but each one of you would be full
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَبَابَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي وَرْقَاءُ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَحَاجَّتِ النَّارُ وَالْجَنَّةُ فَقَالَتِ النَّارُ أُوثِرْتُ بِالْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ وَالْمُتَجَبِّرِينَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتِ الْجَنَّةُ فَمَا لِي لاَ يَدْخُلُنِي إِلاَّ ضُعَفَاءُ النَّاسِ وَسَقَطُهُمْ وَعَجَزُهُمْ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ لِلْجَنَّةِ أَنْتِ رَحْمَتِي أَرْحَمُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِلنَّارِ أَنْتِ عَذَابِي أُعَذِّبُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْكُمْ مِلْؤُهَا فَأَمَّا النَّارُ فَلاَ تَمْتَلِئُ ‏.‏ فَيَضَعُ قَدَمَهُ عَلَيْهَا فَتَقُولُ قَطْ قَطْ ‏.‏ فَهُنَالِكَ تَمْتَلِئُ وَيُزْوَى بَعْضُهَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa shabaabaau, haddathaniy warqaa'u, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ tahaajjati alnnaaru waaljannaau faqaalati alnnaaru auwthirtu bialmutakabbiriyna waalmutajabbiriyna ‏.‏ waqaalati aljannaau famaa liy laa yadkhuluniy iilaaa du'afaa'u alnnaasi wasaqatuhum wa'ajazuhum ‏.‏ faqaala alllahu liljannaai aanti rahmatiy aarhamu biki man aashaa'u min 'ibaadiy ‏.‏ waqaala lilnnaari aanti 'adhaabiy au'adhhibu biki man aashaa'u min 'ibaadiy walikulli waahidaain minkum miluuhaa faaammaa alnnaaru falaa tamtaliiu ‏.‏ fayada'u qadamahu 'alayhaa fataquwlu qat qat ‏.‏ fahunaalika tamtaliiu wayuzwaa ba'duhaa iilaa ba'din ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing:The Hell and the Paradise fell into dispute and the Hell said: I have been dis- tinguished by the proud and the haughty. And the Paradise said: What is the matter with me that the meek and the humble amongst people and the downtrodden and the simple enter me? Thereupon Allah said to the Paradise: You are (the means) of My Mercy whereby I show mercy to those of My servants whom 1 wish, and He said to the Hell: You are (the means) of punishment whereby 1 punish those of My servants whoml wish. Both of you will be full. The Hell will riot be filled up until Allah puts down His foot in it. The Hell would say: Enough, enough, enough, and at that time it will be filled up, all its parts integrated together
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَوْنٍ الْهِلاَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو سُفْيَانَ، - يَعْنِي مُحَمَّدَ بْنَ حُمَيْدٍ - عَنْ مَعْمَرٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنِ ابْنِ سِيرِينَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ احْتَجَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'awnin alhilaaliyyu, haddathanaa aabuw sufyaana, - ya'niy muhammada bna humaydin - 'an ma'marin, 'an aayyuwba, 'ani abni siyriyna, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ ahtajjati aljannaau waalnnaaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaqtassa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi aabiy alzzinaadi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:The Paradise and the Hell disputed with each other. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَحَاجَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ فَقَالَتِ النَّارُ أُوثِرْتُ بِالْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ وَالْمُتَجَبِّرِينَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتِ الْجَنَّةُ فَمَا لِي لاَ يَدْخُلُنِي إِلاَّ ضُعَفَاءُ النَّاسِ وَسَقَطُهُمْ وَغِرَّتُهُمْ قَالَ اللَّهُ لِلْجَنَّةِ إِنَّمَا أَنْتِ رَحْمَتِي أَرْحَمُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لِلنَّارِ إِنَّمَا أَنْتِ عَذَابِي أُعَذِّبُ بِكِ مَنْ أَشَاءُ مِنْ عِبَادِي ‏.‏ وَلِكُلِّ وَاحِدَةٍ مِنْكُمَا مِلْؤُهَا فَأَمَّا النَّارُ فَلاَ تَمْتَلِئُ حَتَّى يَضَعَ اللَّهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى رِجْلَهُ تَقُولُ قَطْ قَطْ قَطْ ‏.‏ فَهُنَالِكَ تَمْتَلِئُ وَيُزْوَى بَعْضُهَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ وَلاَ يَظْلِمُ اللَّهُ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ أَحَدًا وَأَمَّا الْجَنَّةُ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ يُنْشِئُ لَهَا خَلْقًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tahaajjati aljannaau waalnnaaru faqaalati alnnaaru auwthirtu bialmutakabbiriyna waalmutajabbiriyna ‏.‏ waqaalati aljannaau famaa liy laa yadkhuluniy iilaaa du'afaa'u alnnaasi wasaqatuhum waghirratuhum qaala alllahu liljannaai iinnamaa aanti rahmatiy aarhamu biki man aashaa'u min 'ibaadiy ‏.‏ waqaala lilnnaari iinnamaa aanti 'adhaabiy au'adhhibu biki man aashaa'u min 'ibaadiy ‏.‏ walikulli waahidaain minkumaa miluuhaa faaammaa alnnaaru falaa tamtaliiu hattaa yada'a alllahu tabaaraka wata'aalaa rijlahu taquwlu qat qat qat ‏.‏ fahunaalika tamtaliiu wayuzwaa ba'duhaa iilaa ba'din walaa yazlimu alllahu min khalqihi aahadana waaammaa aljannaau faiinna alllaha yunshiiu lahaa khalqana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported that Abu Huraira narrated to them some ahadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and one of them is this that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The Paradise and the Hell fell into dispute and the Hell said: 1 have been distinguished for accommodating (the haughty and proud in me), and the Paradise said: What is the matter that the meek and the humble and the downtrodden and simple would find an abode in me? Thereupon Allah said to Paradise: You are a (means) of My Mercy. 1 shall show mercy through you to one whom I will from amongst My servants. And lie said to the Hell: You are a (sign) of My chastisement and I shall chastise through you anyone whom I will from amongst My servants and both of you, would be full. And as regards the Hell it would not be full until Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, places His foot therein, and it would say: Enough, enough, enough, and it would be then full and the one part would draw very close to the other one and Allah would not treat unjustly anyone amongst His creation and He would create another creation for the Paradise (to accommodate it)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ احْتَجَّتِ الْجَنَّةُ وَالنَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ ‏"‏ وَلِكِلَيْكُمَا عَلَىَّ مِلْؤُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ مِنَ الزِّيَادَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ahtajjati aljannaau waalnnaaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi aabiy hurayraaa iilaa qawlihi ‏"‏ walikilaykumaa 'alaaaa miluuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu mina alzziyaadaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The Paradise and the Hell disputed with each other. The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Abu Huraira up to the words'." It is essential for Me to fill up both of you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَزَالُ جَهَنَّمُ تَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ ‏.‏ حَتَّى يَضَعَ فِيهَا رَبُّ الْعِزَّةِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى قَدَمَهُ فَتَقُولُ قَطْ قَطْ وَعِزَّتِكَ ‏.‏ وَيُزْوَى بَعْضُهَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tazaalu jahannamu taquwlu hal min maziydin ‏.‏ hattaa yada'a fiyhaa rabbu al'izzaai tabaaraka wata'aalaa qadamahu fataquwlu qat qat wa'izzatika ‏.‏ wayuzwaa ba'duhaa iilaa ba'din ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said that the Hell would continue to say:Is there anything more, until Allah, the Exalted and High, would place His foot therein and that would say: Enough, enough, by Your Honour, and some parts of it would draw close to the other
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبَانُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ، الْعَطَّارِ حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ شَيْبَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, haddathanaa aabaanu bnu yaziyda, al'attaari haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an aanasin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bima'naa hadiythi shaybaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Anas through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الرُّزِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ بْنُ عَطَاءٍ، فِي قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ‏}‏ فَأَخْبَرَنَا عَنْ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَزَالُ جَهَنَّمُ يُلْقَى فِيهَا وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ حَتَّى يَضَعَ رَبُّ الْعِزَّةِ فِيهَا قَدَمَهُ فَيَنْزَوِي بَعْضُهَا إِلَى بَعْضٍ وَتَقُولُ قَطْ قَطْ بِعِزَّتِكَ وَكَرَمِكَ ‏.‏ وَلاَ يَزَالُ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَضْلٌ حَتَّى يُنْشِئَ اللَّهُ لَهَا خَلْقًا فَيُسْكِنَهُمْ فَضْلَ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi alrruzziyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi bnu 'ataa'in, fiy qawlihi 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ yawma naquwlu lijahannama hali amtalati wataquwlu hal min maziydin‏}‏ faaakhbaranaa 'an sa'iydin 'an qataadaaa 'an aanasi bni maalikin 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm aannahu qaala ‏"‏ laa tazaalu jahannamu yulqaa fiyhaa wataquwlu hal min maziydin hattaa yada'a rabbu al'izzaai fiyhaa qadamahu fayanzawiy ba'duhaa iilaa ba'din wataquwlu qat qat bi'izzatika wakaramika ‏.‏ walaa yazaalu fiy aljannaai fadlun hattaa yunshiia alllahu lahaa khalqana fayuskinahum fadla aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abd al-Wahhab b. Ata' reported in connection with the words of Allah, the Exalted and the Glorious:We would say to Hell on the Day of Ressurection: Have you been completely filled up? and it would say: Is there anything -more? And he stated on the authority of Anas b. Malik that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: (The sinners) would be thrown therein and it would continue to say: Is there anything more, until Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, would keep His foot there- in and some of its part would draw close to the other and it would say: Enough, enough, by Thy Honour and by Thy Dignity, and there would be enough space in Paradise until Allah would create a new creation and He would make them accommo- date that spare place in Paradise
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَلَمَةَ - أَخْبَرَنَا ثَابِتٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنسًا، يَقُولُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يَبْقَى مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يَبْقَى ثُمَّ يُنْشِئُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى لَهَا خَلْقًا مِمَّا يَشَاءُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa hammaadun, - ya'niy abna salamaaa - aakhbaranaa thaabitun, qaala sami'tu aansana, yaquwlu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yabqaa mina aljannaai maa shaa'a alllahu aan yabqaa thumma yunshiiu alllahu ta'aalaa lahaa khalqana mimmaa yashaa'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:There would be left some space in Paradise as Allah would like that to be left. Then Allah would create another creation as He would like
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
