verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَتَقَارَبَا فِي اللَّفْظِ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يُجَاءُ بِالْمَوْتِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ كَأَنَّهُ كَبْشٌ أَمْلَحُ - زَادَ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - فَيُوقَفُ بَيْنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ - وَاتَّفَقَا فِي بَاقِي الْحَدِيثِ - فَيُقَالُ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ هَلْ تَعْرِفُونَ هَذَا فَيَشْرَئِبُّونَ وَيَنْظُرُونَ وَيَقُولُونَ نَعَمْ هَذَا الْمَوْتُ - قَالَ - وَيُقَالُ يَا أَهْلَ النَّارِ هَلْ تَعْرِفُونَ هَذَا قَالَ فَيَشْرَئِبُّونَ وَيَنْظُرُونَ وَيَقُولُونَ نَعَمْ هَذَا الْمَوْتُ - قَالَ - فَيُؤْمَرُ بِهِ فَيُذْبَحُ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ يُقَالُ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ خُلُودٌ فَلاَ مَوْتَ وَيَا أَهْلَ النَّارِ خُلُودٌ فَلاَ مَوْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏ وَأَنْذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ الْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِيَ الأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ وَهُمْ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ‏}‏ وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin - wataqaarabaa fiy alllafzi - qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yujaa'u bialmawti yawma alqiyaamaai kaaannahu kabshun aamlahu - zaada aabuw kuraybin - fayuwqafu bayna aljannaai waalnnaari - waattafaqaa fiy baaqiy alhadiythi - fayuqaalu yaa aahla aljannaai hal ta'rifuwna hadhaa fayashraiibbuwna wayanzuruwna wayaquwluwna na'am hadhaa almawtu - qaala - wayuqaalu yaa aahla alnnaari hal ta'rifuwna hadhaa qaala fayashraiibbuwna wayanzuruwna wayaquwluwna na'am hadhaa almawtu - qaala - fayuumaru bihi fayudhbahu - qaala - thumma yuqaalu yaa aahla aljannaai khuluwdun falaa mawta wayaa aahla alnnaari khuluwdun falaa mawta ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala thumma qaraaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏ waaandhirhum yawma alhasraai iidh qudiya alaamru wahum fiy ghaflaain wahum laa yuuminuwna‏}‏ waaashaara biyadihi iilaa alddunyaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Death would be brought on the Day of Resurrection. in the form of a white-coloured ram. Abu Kuraib made this addition: Then it would be made to stand between the Paradise and the Hell. So far as the rest of the hadith is concerned there is perfect agreement (between the two narrators) and it would be said to the inmates of Paradise: Do you recognise this? They would raise up their necks and look towards it and say: Yes, ' it is death. Then it would be said to the inmates of Hell-Fire.. Do you recognise this? And they would raise up their necks and look and say: Yes, it is death. Then command would be given for slaughtering that and then it would be said: 0 inmates of Paradise,, there is an everlasting life for you and no death. And then (addressing) to the inmates of the Hell-Fire, it would be said: 0 inmates of Hell-Fire, there is an everlasting living for you and no death. Allah's Messenger (may peace be u@on him) then recited this verse pointing with his hand to this (material) world:" Warn them, this Day of dismay, and when their affairs would be decided and they would be un- mindful and they believe not" (xix)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، سَعِيدٍ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا أُدْخِلَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ الْجَنَّةَ وَأَهْلُ النَّارِ النَّارَ قِيلَ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَقُلْ ثُمَّ قَرَأَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَيْضًا وَأَشَارَ بِيَدِهِ إِلَى الدُّنْيَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiy, sa'iydin qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa audkhila aahlu aljannaai aljannaaa waaahlu alnnaari alnnaara qiyla yaa aahla aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bima'naa hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa ghayra aannahu qaala ‏"‏ fadhalika qawluhu 'azza wajalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yaqul thumma qaraaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ walam yadhkur aaydana waaashaara biyadihi iilaa alddunyaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When the inmates of Paradise would be admitted to Paradise and the inmates of Hell would be admitted to Hell, it would be said (to the inmates of Paradise): 0 inmates of Paradise. The rest of the hadith is the same but with this variation (that he only) said. That is the word of Allah, the Exalted. And he did not say: Then Allah's Mes- senger (ﷺ) recited, and he did not make a mention of his having pointed with his hand towards the (material) world
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَالْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا نَافِعٌ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يُدْخِلُ اللَّهُ أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ الْجَنَّةَ وَيُدْخِلُ أَهْلَ النَّارِ النَّارَ ثُمَّ يَقُومُ مُؤَذِّنٌ بَيْنَهُمْ فَيَقُولُ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لاَ مَوْتَ وَيَا أَهْلَ النَّارِ لاَ مَوْتَ كُلٌّ خَالِدٌ فِيمَا هُوَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, waalhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaraniy waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, haddathanaa naafi'un, aanna 'abda alllahi, qaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yudkhilu alllahu aahla aljannaai aljannaaa wayudkhilu aahla alnnaari alnnaara thumma yaquwmu muuadhhinun baynahum fayaquwlu yaa aahla aljannaai laa mawta wayaa aahla alnnaari laa mawta kullun khaalidun fiymaa huwa fiyhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Allah would admit the inmates of Paradise into Paradise and the inmates of Hell into Hell. Then the announcer would stand between them and say: 0 inmates of Paradise, there is no death for you,0 inmates of Hell, there is no death for you. You would live for ever therein
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي هَارُونُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ الأَيْلِيُّ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زَيْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ، أَنَّ أَبَاهُ، حَدَّثَهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، عُمَرَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا صَارَ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَصَارَ أَهْلُ النَّارِ إِلَى النَّارِ أُتِيَ بِالْمَوْتِ حَتَّى يُجْعَلَ بَيْنَ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ ثُمَّ يُذْبَحُ ثُمَّ يُنَادِي مُنَادٍ يَا أَهْلَ الْجَنَّةِ لاَ مَوْتَ وَيَا أَهْلَ النَّارِ لاَ مَوْتَ ‏.‏ فَيَزْدَادُ أَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ فَرَحًا إِلَى فَرَحِهِمْ وَيَزْدَادُ أَهْلُ النَّارِ حُزْنًا إِلَى حُزْنِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy haaruwnu bnu sa'iydin alaayliyyu, waharmalaau bnu yahyaa, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu wahbin, haddathaniy 'umaru bnu muhammadi bni zaydi bni 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara bni alkhattaabi, aanna aabaahu, haddathahu 'an 'abdi alllahi bni, 'umara aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa saara aahlu aljannaai iilaa aljannaai wasaara aahlu alnnaari iilaa alnnaari autiya bialmawti hattaa yuj'ala bayna aljannaai waalnnaari thumma yudhbahu thumma yunaadiy munaadin yaa aahla aljannaai laa mawta wayaa aahla alnnaari laa mawta ‏.‏ fayazdaadu aahlu aljannaai farahana iilaa farahihim wayazdaadu aahlu alnnaari huznana iilaa huznihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umar b. Muhammad b. Zaid b. `Abdullah b. `Umar b. al-Khattab reported on the authority of his father `Abdullah b. `Umar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:When the inmates of Paradise would go to Paradise and the inmates of Hell would go to Hell, death would be called and it would be placed between the Paradise and the Hell and then slaughtered and then the announcer would announce: O inmates of Paradise, no death. O inmates of Hell-Fire, no death. And it would increase the delight of the inmates of Paradise and it would increase the grief of the inmates of Hell-Fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُرَيْجُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ، عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ ضِرْسُ الْكَافِرِ أَوْ نَابُ الْكَافِرِ مِثْلُ أُحُدٍ وَغِلَظُ جِلْدِهِ مَسِيرَةُ ثَلاَثٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy surayju bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa humaydu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'ani alhasani bni saalihin, 'an haaruwna bni sa'din, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ dirsu alkaafiri aaw naabu alkaafiri mithlu auhudin waghilazu jildihi masiyraau thalaathin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It is transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The molar tooth of an unbeliever or the canine teeth of an unbeliever will be like Uhud and the thickness of his skin a three night's journey
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْوَكِيعِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَرْفَعُهُ قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا بَيْنَ مَنْكِبَىِ الْكَافِرِ فِي النَّارِ مَسِيرَةُ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ لِلرَّاكِبِ الْمُسْرِعِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرِ الْوَكِيعِيُّ ‏"‏ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, waaahmadu bnu 'umara alwakiy'iyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, yarfa'uhu qaala ‏"‏ maa bayna mankibaai alkaafiri fiy alnnaari masiyraau thalaathaai aayyaamin lilrraakibi almusri'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkuri alwakiy'iyyu ‏"‏ fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported directly from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that he said:The distance of the two shoulders of the non-believer in Hell will be a three-day journey for a swift rider
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي مَعْبَدُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ حَارِثَةَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كُلُّ ضَعِيفٍ مُتَضَعَّفٍ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَهْلِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ كُلُّ عُتُلٍّ جَوَّاظٍ مُسْتَكْبِرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathaniy ma'badu bnu khaalidin, aannahu sami'a haarithaaa bna wahbin, aannahu sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ aalaa aukhbirukum biaahli aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa balaa ‏.‏ qaala sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ kullu da'iyfin mutada''afin law aaqsama 'alaa alllahi laabarrahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala ‏"‏ aalaa aukhbirukum biaahli alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa balaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ kullu 'utullin jawwaazin mustakbirin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Haritha b. Wahb reported that he heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:May I not inform you about the inmates of Paradise? They said: Do this, of course. Thereupon Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said: Every humble person who is considered to be humble if he were to adjure In the name of Allah, He would fulfil it. He then said: May I not inform you about the denizens of Hell-Fire? They said: Yes. And he said: Every haughty, fat and proud (person)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ بِمِثْلِهِ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ قَالَ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ أَدُلُّكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi bimithlihi ghayra aannahu qaala ‏ "‏ aalaa aadullukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ مَعْبَدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حَارِثَةَ بْنَ وَهْبٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ كُلُّ ضَعِيفٍ مُتَضَعَّفٍ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ بِأَهْلِ النَّارِ كُلُّ جَوَّاظٍ زَنِيمٍ مُتَكَبِّرٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an ma'badi bni khaalidin, qaala sami'tu haarithaaa bna wahbin alkhuzaa'iyya, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalaa aukhbirukum biaahli aljannaai kullu da'iyfin mutada''afin law aaqsama 'alaa alllahi laabarrahu aalaa aukhbirukum biaahli alnnaari kullu jawwaazin zaniymin mutakabbirin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Haritha b. Wahb al-KhuzaIi reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:May I not inform you about the inmates of Paradise? (And then informing about them) said: Every meek person who is considered to be humble and if they were to adjure in the name of Allah, Allah would certainly fulfil it. May I not inform you about the inmates of Hell-Fire? They are all proud, mean and haughty
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، عَنِ الْعَلاَءِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ رُبَّ أَشْعَثَ مَدْفُوعٍ بِالأَبْوَابِ لَوْ أَقْسَمَ عَلَى اللَّهِ لأَبَرَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathaniy hafsu bnu maysaraaa, 'ani al'alaa'i bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ rubba aash'atha madfuw'in bialaabwaabi law aaqsama 'alaa alllahi laabarrahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing:Many a people with dishevelled hair are driven away from the door (but they are so pious) that if they are to swear in the name of Allah, He would definitely fulfil that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ، عُرْوَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ زَمْعَةَ، قَالَ خَطَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَذَكَرَ النَّاقَةَ وَذَكَرَ الَّذِي عَقَرَهَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِذِ انْبَعَثَ أَشْقَاهَا انْبَعَثَ بِهَا رَجُلٌ عَزِيزٌ عَارِمٌ مَنِيعٌ فِي رَهْطِهِ مِثْلُ أَبِي زَمْعَةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ النِّسَاءَ فَوَعَظَ فِيهِنَّ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِلاَمَ يَجْلِدُ أَحَدُكُمُ امْرَأَتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ ‏"‏ جَلْدَ الأَمَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ أَبِي كُرَيْبٍ ‏"‏ جَلْدَ الْعَبْدِ وَلَعَلَّهُ يُضَاجِعُهَا مِنْ آخِرِ يَوْمِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ وَعَظَهُمْ فِي ضَحِكِهِمْ مِنَ الضَّرْطَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِلاَمَ يَضْحَكُ أَحَدُكُمْ مِمَّا يَفْعَلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa abnu numayrin, 'an hishaami bni, 'urwaaa 'an aabiyhi, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni zam'aaa, qaala khataba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fadhakara alnnaaqaaa wadhakara alladhiy 'aqarahaa faqaala ‏"‏ iidhi anba'atha aashqaahaa anba'atha bihaa rajulun 'aziyzun 'aarimun maniy'un fiy rahtihi mithlu aabiy zam'aaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara alnnisaa'a fawa'aza fiyhinna thumma qaala ‏"‏ iilaama yajlidu aahadukumu amraaatahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fiy riwaayaai aabiy bakrin ‏"‏ jalda alaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai aabiy kuraybin ‏"‏ jalda al'abdi wala'allahu yudaaji'uhaa min akhiri yawmihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma wa'azahum fiy dahikihim mina alddartaai faqaala ‏"‏ iilaama yadhaku aahadukum mimmaa yaf'alu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Zam'a reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) delivered an address and he made a mention of the dromedary and also made a mention of one (base person) who cut off Its hind legs, and he recited:" When the basest of them broke forth with mischief" (xei. 12). When A mischievous person, strong even because of the strength of a family like Abu Zam'a, broke forth. He then delivered instruction in regard to the women saying: There is amongst you who beats his woman, and in the narration on the authority of Abu Bakr, the words are: He flogs her like a slave-girl. And in the narration of Abu Kuraib (the words are): He flogs like a slave and then comforts his bed with the help of that at the end of the day, and he then advised in regard to laughing of people at the breaking of wind and said: One of you laughs at that which you yourself do
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ رَأَيْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ لُحَىِّ بْنِ قَمَعَةَ بْنِ خِنْدِفَ أَبَا بَنِي كَعْبٍ هَؤُلاَءِ يَجُرُّ قُصْبَهُ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ raaaytu 'amraw bna luhaaai bni qama'aaa bni khindifa aabaa baniy ka'bin hauulaa'i yajurru qusbahu fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing:I saw 'Amr b. Luhayy b. Qam'a b. Khindif, brother of Bani Ka'b, dragging his Intestines in Fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَحَسَنٌ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ، الآخَرَانِ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَعِيدَ بْنَ الْمُسَيَّبِ، يَقُولُ إِنَّ الْبَحِيرَةَ الَّتِي يُمْنَعُ دَرُّهَا لِلطَّوَاغِيتِ فَلاَ يَحْلُبُهَا أَحَدٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَأَمَّا السَّائِبَةُ الَّتِي كَانُوا يُسَيِّبُونَهَا لآلِهَتِهِمْ فَلاَ يُحْمَلُ عَلَيْهَا شَىْءٌ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ رَأَيْتُ عَمْرَو بْنَ عَامِرٍ الْخُزَاعِيَّ يَجُرُّ قُصْبَهُ فِي النَّارِ وَكَانَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ سَيَّبَ السُّيُوبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, wahasanun alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaraniy waqaala, alakharaani haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni, shihaabin qaala sami'tu sa'iyda bna almusayyabi, yaquwlu iinna albahiyraaa allatiy yumna'u darruhaa lilttawaaghiyti falaa yahlubuhaa aahadun mina alnnaasi waaammaa alssaaiibaau allatiy kaanuwa yusayyibuwnahaa lalihatihim falaa yuhmalu 'alayhaa shaa'un ‏.‏ waqaala abnu almusayyabi qaala aabuw hurayraaa qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ raaaytu 'amraw bna 'aamirin alkhuzaa'iyya yajurru qusbahu fiy alnnaari wakaana aawwala man sayyaba alssuyuwba ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Sa'id b. Musayyib explained" al-bahira" as that animal which is not milked but for the idols. and none amongst the people milks them, and" as-sa'iba" as that animal which is let loose for the deities. Nothing is loaded over it, and Ibn Musayyib narrated that Abu Huraira stated that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:I saw 'Amr b. 'Amir al-Khuzili dragging his intestines in fire and he was the first who devoted animals to deity
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ صِنْفَانِ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ لَمْ أَرَهُمَا قَوْمٌ مَعَهُمْ سِيَاطٌ كَأَذْنَابِ الْبَقَرِ يَضْرِبُونَ بِهَا النَّاسَ وَنِسَاءٌ كَاسِيَاتٌ عَارِيَاتٌ مُمِيلاَتٌ مَائِلاَتٌ رُءُوسُهُنَّ كَأَسْنِمَةِ الْبُخْتِ الْمَائِلَةِ لاَ يَدْخُلْنَ الْجَنَّةَ وَلاَ يَجِدْنَ رِيحَهَا وَإِنَّ رِيحَهَا لَتُوجَدُ مِنْ مَسِيرَةِ كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ sinfaani min aahli alnnaari lam aarahumaa qawmun ma'ahum siyaatun kaaadhnaabi albaqari yadribuwna bihaa alnnaasa wanisaa'un kaasiyaatun 'aariyaatun mumiylaatun maaiilaatun ru'uwsuhunna kaaasnimaai albukhti almaaiilaai laa yadkhulna aljannaaa walaa yajidna riyhahaa waiinna riyhahaa latuwjadu min masiyraai kadhaa wakadhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Two are the types amongst the denizens of Hell, the one possessing whips like the tail of an ox and they flog people with their help. (The second one) the women who would be naked in spite of their being dressed, who are seduced (to wrong paths) and seduce others with their hair high like humps. These women would not get into Paradise and they would not perceive the odour of Paradise, although its frag- rance can be perceived from such and such distance (from great distance)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حُبَابٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُوشِكُ إِنْ طَالَتْ بِكَ مُدَّةٌ أَنْ تَرَى قَوْمًا فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ مِثْلُ أَذْنَابِ الْبَقَرِ يَغْدُونَ فِي غَضَبِ اللَّهِ وَيَرُوحُونَ فِي سَخَطِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa zaydun, - ya'niy abna hubaabin - haddathanaa aaflahu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu raafi'in, mawlaa aummi salamaaa qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yuwshiku iin taalat bika muddaaun aan taraa qawmana fiy aaydiyhim mithlu aadhnaabi albaqari yaghduwna fiy ghadabi alllahi wayaruwhuwna fiy sakhati alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If you survive for a time you would certainly see people who would have whips in their hands like the tail of an ox. They would get up in the morning under the wrath of Allah and they would get into the evening with the anger of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَامِرٍ الْعَقَدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا أَفْلَحُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، مَوْلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنْ طَالَتْ بِكَ مُدَّةٌ أَوْشَكْتَ أَنْ تَرَى قَوْمًا يَغْدُونَ فِي سَخَطِ اللَّهِ وَيَرُوحُونَ فِي لَعْنَتِهِ فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ مِثْلُ أَذْنَابِ الْبَقَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in wa'abdu bnu humaydin qaaluwa haddathanaa aabuw 'aamirin al'aqadiyyu haddathanaa aaflahu bnu sa'iydin, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu raafi'in, mawlaa aummi salamaaa qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iin taalat bika muddaaun aawshakta aan taraa qawmana yaghduwna fiy sakhati alllahi wayaruwhuwna fiy la'natihi fiy aaydiyhim mithlu aadhnaabi albaqari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:If you live for a time, you would certainly see people get up (in the morning) in the wrath of Allah and getting into the evening under the curse of Allah, and there would be in their hands (whips) like the tail of an ox
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ إِدْرِيسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا مُوسَى بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ، حَاتِمٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، حَدَّثَنَا قَيْسٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُسْتَوْرِدًا، أَخَا بَنِي فِهْرٍ يَقُولُ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَاللَّهِ مَا الدُّنْيَا فِي الآخِرَةِ إِلاَّ مِثْلُ مَا يَجْعَلُ أَحَدُكُمْ إِصْبَعَهُ هَذِهِ - وَأَشَارَ يَحْيَى بِالسَّبَّابَةِ - فِي الْيَمِّ فَلْيَنْظُرْ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِمْ جَمِيعًا غَيْرَ يَحْيَى سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ذَلِكَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ أَبِي أُسَامَةَ عَنِ الْمُسْتَوْرِدِ بْنِ شَدَّادٍ أَخِي بَنِي فِهْرٍ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِ أَيْضًا قَالَ وَأَشَارَ إِسْمَاعِيلُ بِالإِبْهَامِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu iidriysa, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa aabiy wamuhammadu bnu bishrin, h wahaddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa muwsaa bnu aa'yana, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, kulluhum 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu, haatimin - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, haddathanaa qaysun, qaala sami'tu mustawridana, aakhaa baniy fihrin yaquwlu qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalllahi maa alddunyaa fiy alakhiraai iilaaa mithlu maa yaj'alu aahadukum iisba'ahu hadhihi - waaashaara yahyaa bialssabbaabaai - fiy alyammi falyanzur bima yarji'u ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythihim jamiy'ana ghayra yahyaa sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu dhalika ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi aabiy ausaamaaa 'ani almustawridi bni shaddaadin aakhiy baniy fihrin wafiy hadiythihi aaydana qaala waaashaara iismaa'iylu bialiibhaami ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through five different chains of transmitters and all of them are narrated on the authority of Mustaurid, brother of Bani Fihr, that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:By Allah, this world (is so insigni- ficant in comparison) to the Hereafter that if one of you should dip his finger- (and wnile saying this Yahyg pointed with his forefinger) -in the ocean and then he should see as to what has stuck to it. This hadith has been narrated through another chain of transmitters also but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ حَاتِمِ بْنِ أَبِي صَغِيرَةَ، حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً غُرْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ النِّسَاءُ وَالرِّجَالُ جَمِيعًا يَنْظُرُ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ قَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَا عَائِشَةُ الأَمْرُ أَشَدُّ مِنْ أَنْ يَنْظُرَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَى بَعْضٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an haatimi bni aabiy saghiyraaa, haddathaniy abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani alqaasimi bni muhammadin, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ yuhsharu alnnaasu yawma alqiyaamaai hufaaaan 'uraaaan ghurlaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi alnnisaa'u waalrrijaalu jamiy'ana yanzuru ba'duhum iilaa ba'din qaala sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ yaa 'aaiishaau alaamru aashaddu min aan yanzura ba'duhum iilaa ba'din ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that she heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The people would be assembled on the Day of Resurrection barefooted, naked and uncircumcised. I said: Allah's Messenger, will the male and the female be together on the Day and would they be looking at one another? Upon this Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: 'A'isha, the matter would be too serious for them to look to one another
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ، نُمَيْرٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، عَنْ حَاتِمِ، بْنِ أَبِي صَغِيرَةَ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏ "‏ غُرْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu, numayrin qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, 'an haatimi, bni aabiy saghiyraaa bihadhaa aliisnaadi walam yadhkur fiy hadiythihi ‏ "‏ ghurlaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hatim b. Abi Saghira with the same chain of transmitters and there is no mention of the word" uncircum- cised
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي، عُمَرَ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ عَمْرٍو، عَنْ سَعِيدِ، بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، سَمِعَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَخْطُبُ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِنَّكُمْ مُلاَقُو اللَّهِ مُشَاةً حُفَاةً عُرَاةً غُرْلاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ زُهَيْرٌ فِي حَدِيثِهِ يَخْطُبُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy, 'umara qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an 'amrinw, 'an sa'iydi, bni jubayrin 'ani abni 'abbaasin, sami'a alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yakhtubu wahuwa yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iinnakum mulaaquw alllahi mushaaaan hufaaaan 'uraaaan ghurlaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur zuhayrun fiy hadiythihi yakhtubu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Abbas reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) deliver an address and he was saying that they would meet Allah barefooted, naked and uncircumcised
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي كِلاَهُمَا، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ النُّعْمَانِ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ قَامَ فِينَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطِيبًا بِمَوْعِظَةٍ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ إِنَّكُمْ تُحْشَرُونَ إِلَى اللَّهِ حُفَاةً عُرَاةً غُرْلاً ‏{‏ كَمَا بَدَأْنَا أَوَّلَ خَلْقٍ نُعِيدُهُ وَعْدًا عَلَيْنَا إِنَّا كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ‏}‏ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ أَوَّلَ الْخَلاَئِقِ يُكْسَى يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ إِبْرَاهِيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلاَمُ أَلاَ وَإِنَّهُ سَيُجَاءُ بِرِجَالٍ مِنْ أُمَّتِي فَيُؤْخَذُ بِهِمْ ذَاتَ الشِّمَالِ فَأَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ أَصْحَابِي ‏.‏ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ ‏.‏ فَأَقُولُ كَمَا قَالَ الْعَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ ‏{‏ وَكُنْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ شَهِيدًا مَا دُمْتُ فِيهِمْ فَلَمَّا تَوَفَّيْتَنِي كُنْتَ أَنْتَ الرَّقِيبَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ * إِنْ تُعَذِّبْهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ عِبَادُكَ وَإِنْ تَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ فَإِنَّكَ أَنْتَ الْعَزِيزُ الْحَكِيمُ‏}‏ قَالَ فَيُقَالُ لِي إِنَّهُمْ لَمْ يَزَالُوا مُرْتَدِّينَ عَلَى أَعْقَابِهِمْ مُنْذُ فَارَقْتَهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ وَكِيعٍ وَمُعَاذٍ ‏"‏ فَيُقَالُ إِنَّكَ لاَ تَدْرِي مَا أَحْدَثُوا بَعْدَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy kilaahumaa, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'ani almughiyraai bni alnnu'maani, 'an sa'iydi bni jubayrin, 'ani abni 'abbaasin, qaala qaama fiynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khatiybana bimaw'izaain faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aayyuhaa alnnaasu iinnakum tuhsharuwna iilaa alllahi hufaaaan 'uraaaan ghurlaan ‏{‏ kamaa badaanaa aawwala khalqin nu'iyduhu wa'dana 'alaynaa iinnaa kunnaa faa'iliyna‏}‏ aalaa waiinna aawwala alkhalaaiiqi yuksaa yawma alqiyaamaai iibraahiymu 'alayhi alssalaamu aalaa waiinnahu sayujaa'u birijaalin min aummatiy fayuukhadhu bihim dhaata alshhimaali faaaquwlu yaa rabbi aashaabiy ‏.‏ fayuqaalu iinnaka laa tadriy maa aahdathuwa ba'daka ‏.‏ faaaquwlu kamaa qaala al'abdu alssaalihu ‏{‏ wakuntu 'alayhim shahiydana maa dumtu fiyhim falammaa tawaffaytaniy kunta aanta alrraqiyba 'alayhim waaanta 'alaa kulli shaa'in shahiydun * iin tu'adhhibhum faiinnahum 'ibaaduka waiin taghfir lahum faiinnaka aanta al'aziyzu alhakiymu‏}‏ qaala fayuqaalu liy iinnahum lam yazaaluwa murtaddiyna 'alaa aa'qaabihim mundhu faaraqtahum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi wakiy'in wamu'aadhin ‏"‏ fayuqaalu iinnaka laa tadriy maa aahdathuwa ba'daka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated through other chains of transmitters on the authority of Ibn Abbas, (and) the words are:While Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up to deliver a sermon, he said: 0 people, Allah would make you assemble barefooted, naked and uncircumcised (and then recited the words of the Qur'an):" As We created you for the first time, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon us. Lo! We are to perform it, and the first person who would be clothed on the Day of Resurrection would be (Hadrat) Ibrahim (peace be upon him)" and, behold! some persons of my Ummah would be brought and taken to the left and I would say: My Lord, they are my companions, and it would be said: You do not know what they did after you, and I would say just as the pious servant (Hadrat 'Isa) said:, I was a witness regarding them as I remained among them and Thou art a witness over everything, so if Thou chastisest them, they are Thy servants and if Thou for- givest them, Thou art Mighty, Wise" (v. 117-118). And it would be said to him: They constantly turned to their heels since you left them. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Waki' and Mu'adh (and the words are):" What new things they fabricated
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، قَالاَ جَمِيعًا حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ طَاوُسٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ يُحْشَرُ النَّاسُ عَلَى ثَلاَثِ طَرَائِقَ رَاغِبِينَ رَاهِبِينَ وَاثْنَانِ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ وَثَلاَثَةٌ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ وَأَرْبَعَةٌ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ وَعَشَرَةٌ عَلَى بَعِيرٍ وَتَحْشُرُ بَقِيَّتَهُمُ النَّارُ تَبِيتُ مَعَهُمْ حَيْثُ بَاتُوا وَتَقِيلُ مَعَهُمْ حَيْثُ قَالُوا وَتُصْبِحُ مَعَهُمْ حَيْثُ أَصْبَحُوا وَتُمْسِي مَعَهُمْ حَيْثُ أَمْسَوْا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa aahmadu bnu iishaaqa, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa bahzun, qaalaa jamiy'ana haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu taawusin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ yuhsharu alnnaasu 'alaa thalaathi taraaiiqa raaghibiyna raahibiyna waathnaani 'alaa ba'iyrin wathalaathaaun 'alaa ba'iyrin waaarba'aaun 'alaa ba'iyrin wa'asharaaun 'alaa ba'iyrin watahshuru baqiyyatahumu alnnaaru tabiytu ma'ahum haythu baatuwa wataqiylu ma'ahum haythu qaaluwa watusbihu ma'ahum haythu aasbahuwa watumsiy ma'ahum haythu aamsawa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying, The people will be assembled in three categories. Those desirous (of Paradise), fearing (Hell), coming two upon the came], three upon the camel, four upon the camel, ten upon the camel and the rest will be assembled, Hell-Fire being with them when they are at midday where they would spend the night and where they would spend the morning and where they would spend the evening
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ - عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏{‏ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ لِرَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَقُومُ أَحَدُهُمْ فِي رَشْحِهِ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ الْمُثَنَّى قَالَ ‏"‏ يَقُومُ النَّاسُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ يَوْمَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wa'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin, qaaluwa haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'nuwna abna sa'iydin - 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, aakhbaraniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏{‏ yawma yaquwmu alnnaasu lirabbi al'aalamiyna‏}‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaquwmu aahaduhum fiy rashhihi iilaa aansaafi audhunayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni almuthannaa qaala ‏"‏ yaquwmu alnnaasu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ lam yadhkur yawma ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:When the people stand before Allah, the Lord of the worlds, each one of them would stand submerged into perspiration up to half of his ears, and there is no mention of the "day" in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Ibn Muthanni
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ الْمُسَيَّبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ عِيَاضٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي سُوَيْدُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَفْصُ بْنُ مَيْسَرَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ، بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَالِدٍ الأَحْمَرُ، وَعِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ، اللَّهِ بْنُ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ يَحْيَى حَدَّثَنَا مَعْنٌ، حَدَّثَنَا مَالِكٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو نَصْرٍ التَّمَّارُ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ، بْنُ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ ‏.‏ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ وَصَالِحٍ ‏ "‏ حَتَّى يَغِيبَ أَحَدُهُمْ فِي رَشْحِهِ إِلَى أَنْصَافِ أُذُنَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu iishaaqa almusayyabiyyu, haddathanaa aanasun ya'niy abna 'iyaadin, h wahaddathaniy suwaydu bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa hafsu bnu maysaraaa, kilaahumaa 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, h wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri, bnu aabiy shaybaaa haddathanaa aabuw khaalidin alaahmaru, wa'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, 'ani abni 'awnin, h wahaddathaniy 'abdu, alllahi bnu ja'fari bni yahyaa haddathanaa ma'nun, haddathanaa maalikun, h wahaddathaniy aabuw nasrin alttammaaru, haddathanaa hammaadu, bnu salamaaa 'an aayyuwba, h wahaddathanaa alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, 'an ya'quwba bni iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, kullu hauulaa'i 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi 'ubaydi alllahi 'an naafi'in ‏.‏ ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa wasaalihin ‏ "‏ hattaa yaghiyba aahaduhum fiy rashhihi iilaa aansaafi audhunayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Ibn 'Umar but with a slight variation of wording (and the words are):" One of them would be completely submerged in perspiration up to half of his ears
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ ثَوْرٍ، عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْعَرَقَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ لَيَذْهَبُ فِي الأَرْضِ سَبْعِينَ بَاعًا وَإِنَّهُ لَيَبْلُغُ إِلَى أَفْوَاهِ النَّاسِ أَوْ إِلَى آذَانِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَشُكُّ ثَوْرٌ أَيَّهُمَا قَالَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - 'an thawrin, 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna al'araqa yawma alqiyaamaai layadhhabu fiy alaardi sab'iyna baa'ana waiinnahu layablughu iilaa aafwaahi alnnaasi aaw iilaa adhaanihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ yashukku thawrun aayyahumaa qaala ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing:The perspiration would spread on the Day of Resurrection upon the earth to the extent of seventy cubits and it would reach up to their mouths or up to their ears. Thaur is not sure (which words) he used (mouth or ears)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَكَمُ بْنُ مُوسَى أَبُو صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَمْزَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ، جَابِرٍ حَدَّثَنِي سُلَيْمُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي الْمِقْدَادُ بْنُ الأَسْوَدِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ تُدْنَى الشَّمْسُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ حَتَّى تَكُونَ مِنْهُمْ كَمِقْدَارِ مِيلٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سُلَيْمُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ فَوَاللَّهِ مَا أَدْرِي مَا يَعْنِي بِالْمِيلِ أَمَسَافَةَ الأَرْضِ أَمِ الْمِيلَ الَّذِي تُكْتَحَلُ بِهِ الْعَيْنُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَيَكُونُ النَّاسُ عَلَى قَدْرِ أَعْمَالِهِمْ فِي الْعَرَقِ فَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَكُونُ إِلَى كَعْبَيْهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَكُونُ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَكُونُ إِلَى حَقْوَيْهِ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يُلْجِمُهُ الْعَرَقُ إِلْجَامًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَشَارَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ إِلَى فِيهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhakamu bnu muwsaa aabuw saalihin, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu hamzaaa, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni, jaabirin haddathaniy sulaymu bnu 'aamirin, haddathaniy almiqdaadu bnu alaaswadi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ tudnaa alshhamsu yawma alqiyaamaai mina alkhalqi hattaa takuwna minhum kamiqdaari miylin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala sulaymu bnu 'aamirin fawaalllahi maa aadriy maa ya'niy bialmiyli aamasaafaaa alaardi aami almiyla alladhiy tuktahalu bihi al'aynu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fayakuwnu alnnaasu 'alaa qadri aa'maalihim fiy al'araqi faminhum man yakuwnu iilaa ka'bayhi waminhum man yakuwnu iilaa rukbatayhi waminhum man yakuwnu iilaa haqwayhi waminhum man yuljimuhu al'araqu iiljaamana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala waaashaara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm biyadihi iilaa fiyhi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Miqdad b. Aswad reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) as saying: On the Day of Resurrection, the sun would draw so close to the people that there woum be left only a distance of one mile. Sulaim b. Amir said: By Allah, I do not know whether he meant by" mile" the mile of the (material) earth or dn instrument used for applying collyrium to the eye. (The Prophet is, however, reported to have said): The people would be submerged in perspiration according to their deeds, some up to their. knees, Some up to the waist and some would have the bridle of perspiration and, while saying this, Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) pointed his hand towards his mouth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو غَسَّانَ الْمِسْمَعِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي غَسَّانَ وَابْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ الْمُجَاشِعِيِّ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ فِي خُطْبَتِهِ ‏"‏ أَلاَ إِنَّ رَبِّي أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُعَلِّمَكُمْ مَا جَهِلْتُمْ مِمَّا عَلَّمَنِي يَوْمِي هَذَا كُلُّ مَالٍ نَحَلْتُهُ عَبْدًا حَلاَلٌ وَإِنِّي خَلَقْتُ عِبَادِي حُنَفَاءَ كُلَّهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمْ أَتَتْهُمُ الشَّيَاطِينُ فَاجْتَالَتْهُمْ عَنْ دِينِهِمْ وَحَرَّمَتْ عَلَيْهِمْ مَا أَحْلَلْتُ لَهُمْ وَأَمَرَتْهُمْ أَنْ يُشْرِكُوا بِي مَا لَمْ أُنْزِلْ بِهِ سُلْطَانًا وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ نَظَرَ إِلَى أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ فَمَقَتَهُمْ عَرَبَهُمْ وَعَجَمَهُمْ إِلاَّ بَقَايَا مِنْ أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ وَقَالَ إِنَّمَا بَعَثْتُكَ لأَبْتَلِيَكَ وَأَبْتَلِيَ بِكَ وَأَنْزَلْتُ عَلَيْكَ كِتَابًا لاَ يَغْسِلُهُ الْمَاءُ تَقْرَؤُهُ نَائِمًا وَيَقْظَانَ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنِي أَنْ أُحَرِّقَ قُرَيْشًا فَقُلْتُ رَبِّ إِذًا يَثْلَغُوا رَأْسِي فَيَدَعُوهُ خُبْزَةً قَالَ اسْتَخْرِجْهُمْ كَمَا اسْتَخْرَجُوكَ وَاغْزُهُمْ نُغْزِكَ وَأَنْفِقْ فَسَنُنْفِقَ عَلَيْكَ وَابْعَثْ جَيْشًا نَبْعَثْ خَمْسَةً مِثْلَهُ وَقَاتِلْ بِمَنْ أَطَاعَكَ مَنْ عَصَاكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَأَهْلُ الْجَنَّةِ ثَلاَثَةٌ ذُو سُلْطَانٍ مُقْسِطٌ مُتَصَدِّقٌ مُوَفَّقٌ وَرَجُلٌ رَحِيمٌ رَقِيقُ الْقَلْبِ لِكُلِّ ذِي قُرْبَى وَمُسْلِمٍ وَعَفِيفٌ مُتَعَفِّفٌ ذُو عِيَالٍ - قَالَ - وَأَهْلُ النَّارِ خَمْسَةٌ الضَّعِيفُ الَّذِي لاَ زَبْرَ لَهُ الَّذِينَ هُمْ فِيكُمْ تَبَعًا لاَ يَتْبَعُونَ أَهْلاً وَلاَ مَالاً وَالْخَائِنُ الَّذِي لاَ يَخْفَى لَهُ طَمَعٌ وَإِنْ دَقَّ إِلاَّ خَانَهُ وَرَجُلٌ لاَ يُصْبِحُ وَلاَ يُمْسِي إِلاَّ وَهُوَ يُخَادِعُكَ عَنْ أَهْلِكَ وَمَالِكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَذَكَرَ الْبُخْلَ أَوِ الْكَذِبَ ‏"‏ وَالشِّنْظِيرُ الْفَحَّاشُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ أَبُو غَسَّانَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ وَأَنْفِقْ فَسَنُنْفِقَ عَلَيْكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw ghassaana almisma'iyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaari bni 'uthmaana, - waalllafzu laabiy ghassaana waabni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an mutarrifi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alshhikhhiyri, 'an 'iyaadi bni himaarin almujaashi'iyyi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala dhaata yawmin fiy khutbatihi ‏"‏ aalaa iinna rabbiy aamaraniy aan au'allimakum maa jahiltum mimmaa 'allamaniy yawmiy hadhaa kullu maalin nahaltuhu 'abdana halaalun waiinniy khalaqtu 'ibaadiy hunafaa'a kullahum waiinnahum aatathumu alshhayaatiynu faajtaalathum 'an diynihim waharramat 'alayhim maa aahlaltu lahum waaamarathum aan yushrikuwa biy maa lam aunzil bihi sultaanana waiinna alllaha nazara iilaa aahli alaardi famaqatahum 'arabahum wa'ajamahum iilaaa baqaayaa min aahli alkitaabi waqaala iinnamaa ba'athtuka laabtaliyaka waaabtaliya bika waaanzaltu 'alayka kitaabana laa yaghsiluhu almaa'u taqrauuhu naaiimana wayaqzaana waiinna alllaha aamaraniy aan auharriqa qurayshana faqultu rabbi iidhana yathlaghuwa raasiy fayada'uwhu khubzaaan qaala astakhrijhum kamaa astakhrajuwka waaghzuhum nughzika waaanfiq fasanunfiqa 'alayka waab'ath jayshana nab'ath khamsaaan mithlahu waqaatil biman aataa'aka man 'asaaka ‏.‏ qaala waaahlu aljannaai thalaathaaun dhuw sultaanin muqsitun mutasaddiqun muwaffaqun warajulun rahiymun raqiyqu alqalbi likulli dhiy qurbaa wamuslimin wa'afiyfun muta'affifun dhuw 'iyaalin - qaala - waaahlu alnnaari khamsaaun aldda'iyfu alladhiy laa zabra lahu alladhiyna hum fiykum taba'ana laa yatba'uwna aahlaan walaa maalaan waalkhaaiinu alladhiy laa yakhfaa lahu tama'un waiin daqqa iilaaa khaanahu warajulun laa yusbihu walaa yumsiy iilaaa wahuwa yukhaadi'uka 'an aahlika wamaalika ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wadhakara albukhla aawi alkadhiba ‏"‏ waalshhinziyru alfahhaashu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur aabuw ghassaana fiy hadiythihi ‏"‏ waaanfiq fasanunfiqa 'alayka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Iyad b. Him-ar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), while delivering a sermon one day, said:Behold, my Lord commanded me that I should teach you which you do not know and which He has taught me today. (He has instructed thus): The property which I have conferred upon them is lawful for them. I have created My servants as one having a natural inclination to the worship of Allah but it is Satan who turns them away from the right religion and he makes unlawful what has been declared lawful for them and he commands them to ascribe partnership with Me, although he has no justification for that. And verily, Allah looked towards the people of the world and He showed hatred for the Arabs and the non-Arabs, but with the exception of some remnants from the People of the Book. And He (further) said: I have sent thee (the Holy Prophet) in order to put you to test and put (those to test) through you. And I sent the Book to you which cannot be washed away by water, so that you may recite it while in the state of wakefulness or sleep. Verily, Allah commanded me to burn (kill) the Quraish. I said: My Lord, they would break my head (like the tearing) of bread, and Allah said: You turn them out as they turned you out, you fight against them and We shall help you in this, you should spend and you would be conferred upon. You send an army and I would send an army five times greater than that. Fight against those who disobey you along with those who obey you. The inmates of Paradise are three: One who wields authority and is just and fair, one who Is truthful and has been endowed with power to do good deeds. And the person who is merciful and kind hearted towards his relatives and to every pious Muslim, and one who does not stretch his hand in spite of having a large family to support. And He said: The inmates of Hell are five: the weak who lack power to (avoid evil), the (carefree) who pursue (everything irrespective of the fact that it is good or evil) and who do not have any care for their family or for their wealth. And those dishonest whose greed cannot be concealed even in the case of minor things. And the third. who betray you. morning and evening, in regard to your family and your property. He also made a mention of the miser and the liar and those who are in the habit of abusing people and using obscene and foul language. Abu Ghassan in his narration did not make mention of" Spend and there would be spent for you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى الْعَنَزِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏ "‏ كُلُّ مَالٍ نَحَلْتُهُ عَبْدًا حَلاَلٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa al'anaziyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu aabiy 'adiyyin, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ walam yadhkur fiy hadiythihi ‏ "‏ kullu maalin nahaltuhu 'abdana halaalun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Qatada with the same chain of transmitters but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ هِشَامٍ، - صَاحِبِ الدَّسْتَوَائِيِّ - حَدَّثَنَا قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفٍ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم خَطَبَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ وَقَالَ فِي آخِرِهِ قَالَ يَحْيَى قَالَ شُعْبَةُ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ مُطَرِّفًا فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an hishaamin, - saahibi alddastawaaiiyyi - haddathanaa qataadaau, 'an mutarrifin, 'an 'iyaadi bni himaarin, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm khataba dhaata yawmin ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha waqaala fiy akhirihi qaala yahyaa qaala shu'baau 'an qataadaaa qaala sami'tu mutarrifana fiy hadhaa alhadiythi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of 'Iyad b. Himar that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) gave an address one day. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو عَمَّارٍ، حُسَيْنُ بْنُ حُرَيْثٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْفَضْلُ بْنُ مُوسَى، عَنِ الْحُسَيْنِ، عَنْ مَطَرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي قَتَادَةُ، عَنْ مُطَرِّفِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الشِّخِّيرِ، عَنْ عِيَاضِ بْنِ حِمَارٍ، أَخِي بَنِي مُجَاشِعٍ قَالَ قَامَ فِينَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ خَطِيبًا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ أَمَرَنِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ هِشَامٍ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ وَزَادَ فِيهِ ‏"‏ وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ أَوْحَى إِلَىَّ أَنْ تَوَاضَعُوا حَتَّى لاَ يَفْخَرَ أَحَدٌ عَلَى أَحَدٍ وَلاَ يَبْغِي أَحَدٌ عَلَى أَحَدٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ فِي حَدِيثِهِ ‏"‏ وَهُمْ فِيكُمْ تَبَعًا لاَ يَبْغُونَ أَهْلاً وَلاَ مَالاً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ فَيَكُونُ ذَلِكَ يَا أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ نَعَمْ وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَدْرَكْتُهُمْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَرْعَى عَلَى الْحَىِّ مَا بِهِ إِلاَّ وَلِيدَتُهُمْ يَطَؤُهَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw 'ammaarin, husaynu bnu huraythin haddathanaa alfadlu bnu muwsaa, 'ani alhusayni, 'an matarin, haddathaniy qataadaau, 'an mutarrifi bni 'abdi alllahi bni alshhikhhiyri, 'an 'iyaadi bni himaarin, aakhiy baniy mujaashi'in qaala qaama fiynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhaata yawmin khatiybana faqaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha aamaraniy ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythi hishaamin 'an qataadaaa wazaada fiyhi ‏"‏ waiinna alllaha aawhaa iilaaaa aan tawaada'uwa hattaa laa yafkhara aahadun 'alaa aahadin walaa yabghiy aahadun 'alaa aahadin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala fiy hadiythihi ‏"‏ wahum fiykum taba'ana laa yabghuwna aahlaan walaa maalaan ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu fayakuwnu dhalika yaa aabaa 'abdi alllahi qaala na'am waalllahi laqad aadraktuhum fiy aljaahiliyyaai waiinna alrrajula layar'aa 'alaa alhaaai maa bihi iilaaa waliydatuhum yatauuhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Iyad. b. Himar reported tbat, while Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was delivering an address, he stated that Allah commanded me The rest of the hadith is the same, and there is an addition in it:" Allah revealed to me that we should be humble amongst ourselves and none should show pride upon the others, And it does not behove one to do so, and He also said: There are among you people to follow not caring a bit for their family and property. Qatada said: Abu Abdullah, would this happen? Thereupon he said: Yes. By Allah, I found this in the days of ignorance that a person grazed the goat of a tribe and did not find anyone but their slave-girl (and he did not spare her) but committed adultery with her
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَحَدَكُمْ إِذَا مَاتَ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ مَقْعَدُهُ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَمِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ يُقَالُ هَذَا مَقْعَدُكَ حَتَّى يَبْعَثَكَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, qaala qaraatu 'alaa maalikin 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aahadakum iidhaa maata 'urida 'alayhi maq'aduhu bialghadaaai waal'ashiyyi iin kaana min aahli aljannaai famin aahli aljannaai waiin kaana min aahli alnnaari famin aahli alnnaari yuqaalu hadhaa maq'aduka hattaa yab'athaka alllahu iilayhi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as say- ing:When any one of you dies, he is shown his seat (in the Hereafter) morning and evening; if he is amongst the inmates of Paradise (he is shown the seat) from amongst the inmates of Paradise and if he is one from amongst the denizens of Hell (he is shown the seat) from amongst the denizens of Hell, and it would be said to him: That is your seat until Allah raises you on the Day of Resurrection (and sends you to your proper seat)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِذَا مَاتَ الرَّجُلُ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ مَقْعَدُهُ بِالْغَدَاةِ وَالْعَشِيِّ إِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجَنَّةِ فَالْجَنَّةُ وَإِنْ كَانَ مِنْ أَهْلِ النَّارِ فَالنَّارُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَذَا مَقْعَدُكَ الَّذِي تُبْعَثُ إِلَيْهِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iidhaa maata alrrajulu 'urida 'alayhi maq'aduhu bialghadaaai waal'ashiyyi iin kaana min aahli aljannaai faaljannaau waiin kaana min aahli alnnaari faalnnaaru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ thumma yuqaalu hadhaa maq'aduka alladhiy tub'athu iilayhi yawma alqiyaamaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:When a person dies, he is shown his seat morning and evening. If he is one amongst the inmates of Paradise (he is shown his seat) in Paradise and if he is one amongst the denizens of Hell-Fire (he is shown his seat) in the Hell-Fire. Then it is said to him: That is your seat where you would be sent on the Day of Resurrection
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ أَيُّوبَ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ ابْنُ أَيُّوبَ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، قَالَ وَأَخْبَرَنَا سَعِيدٌ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، عَنْ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ وَلَمْ أَشْهَدْهُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَكِنْ حَدَّثَنِيهِ زَيْدُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ قَالَ بَيْنَمَا النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي حَائِطٍ لِبَنِي النَّجَّارِ عَلَى بَغْلَةٍ لَهُ وَنَحْنُ مَعَهُ إِذْ حَادَتْ بِهِ فَكَادَتْ تُلْقِيهِ وَإِذَا أَقْبُرٌ سِتَّةٌ أَوْ خَمْسَةٌ أَوْ أَرْبَعَةٌ - قَالَ كَذَا كَانَ يَقُولُ الْجُرَيْرِيُّ - فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَنْ يَعْرِفُ أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الأَقْبُرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَمَتَى مَاتَ هَؤُلاَءِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مَاتُوا فِي الإِشْرَاكِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ هَذِهِ الأُمَّةَ تُبْتَلَى فِي قُبُورِهَا فَلَوْلاَ أَنْ لاَ تَدَافَنُوا لَدَعَوْتُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُسْمِعَكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ الَّذِي أَسْمَعُ مِنْهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَقْبَلَ عَلَيْنَا بِوَجْهِهِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ النَّارِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الْفِتَنِ مَا ظَهَرَ مِنْهَا وَمَا بَطَنَ قَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَوَّذُوا بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ فِتْنَةِ الدَّجَّالِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu aayyuwba, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa jamiy'ana 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, qaala abnu aayyuwba haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, qaala waaakhbaranaa sa'iydun aljurayriyyu, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, 'an zaydi bni thaabitin, qaala aabuw sa'iydin walam aashhadhu mina alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm walakin haddathaniyhi zaydu bnu thaabitin qaala baynamaa alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy haaiitin libaniy alnnajjaari 'alaa baghlaain lahu wanahnu ma'ahu iidh haadat bihi fakaadat tulqiyhi waiidhaa aaqburun sittaaun aaw khamsaaun aaw aarba'aaun - qaala kadhaa kaana yaquwlu aljurayriyyu - faqaala ‏"‏ man ya'rifu aashaaba hadhihi alaaqburi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun aanaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ famataa maata hauulaa'i ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala maatuwa fiy aliishraaki ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ iinna hadhihi alaummaaa tubtalaa fiy qubuwrihaa falawlaa aan laa tadaafanuwa lada'awtu alllaha aan yusmi'akum min 'adhaabi alqabri alladhiy aasma'u minhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aaqbala 'alaynaa biwajhihi faqaala ‏"‏ ta'awwadhuwa bialllahi min 'adhaabi alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'uwdhu bialllahi min 'adhaabi alnnaari faqaala ‏"‏ ta'awwadhuwa bialllahi min 'adhaabi alqabri ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'uwdhu bialllahi min 'adhaabi alqabri ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ ta'awwadhuwa bialllahi mina alfitani maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'uwdhu bialllahi mina alfitani maa zahara minhaa wamaa batana qaala ‏"‏ ta'awwadhuwa bialllahi min fitnaai alddajjaali ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa na'uwdhu bialllahi min fitnaai alddajjaali ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id al-Khudri reported:I did not hear this hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) directly but it was Zaid b. Thabit who narrated it from him. As Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was going along with us towards the dwellings of Bani an-Najjar, riding upon his pony, it shied and he was about to fall. He found four, five or six graves there. He said: Who amongst you knows about those lying in the graves? A person said: It is I. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: In what state did they die? He said: They died as polytheists. He said: These people are passing through the ordeal in the graves. If it were not the reason that you would stop burying (your dead) in the graves on listening to the torment in the grave which I am listening to, I would have certainly made you hear that. Then turning his face towards us, he said: Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell. They said: We seek refuge with Allah from the torment of Hell. He said: Seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave. They said: We seek refuge with Allah from the torment of the grave. He said: Seek refuge with Allah from turmoil, its visible and invisible (aspects), and they said: We seek refuge with Allah from turmoil and its visible and invisible aspects and he said: Seek refuge with Allah from the turmoil of the Dajjal, and they said We seek refuge with Allah from the turmoil of the Dajjal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَوْلاَ أَنْ لاَ تَدَافَنُوا لَدَعَوْتُ اللَّهَ أَنْ يُسْمِعَكُمْ مِنْ عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ lawlaa aan laa tadaafanuwa lada'awtu alllaha aan yusmi'akum min 'adhaabi alqabri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:If you were not (to abandon) the burying of the dead (in the grave), I would have certainly supplicated Allah that He should make you listen the torment of the grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي ح، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ عَوْنِ بْنِ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ جَمِيعًا عَنْ يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانِ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنِي عَوْنُ، بْنُ أَبِي جُحَيْفَةَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَعْدَ مَا غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَسَمِعَ صَوْتًا فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ يَهُودُ تُعَذَّبُ فِي قُبُورِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa aabiy h, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, kulluhum 'an shu'baaa, 'an 'awni bni aabiy juhayfaaa, h wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin jamiy'ana 'an yahyaa alqattaani, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - haddathanaa yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathaniy 'awnu, bnu aabiy juhayfaaa 'an aabiyhi, 'ani albaraa'i, 'an aabiy aayyuwba, qaala kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ba'da maa gharabati alshhamsu fasami'a sawtana faqaala ‏ "‏ yahuwdu tu'adhhabu fiy qubuwrihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Ayyub through some other chains of transmitters (and the words are):" Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went out after the sun had set and he heard some sound and said: It is the Jews who are being tormented in their graves
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا وُضِعَ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُ أَصْحَابُهُ إِنَّهُ لَيَسْمَعُ قَرْعَ نِعَالِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَأْتِيهِ مَلَكَانِ فَيُقْعِدَانِهِ فَيَقُولاَنِ لَهُ مَا كُنْتَ تَقُولُ فِي هَذَا الرَّجُلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَأَمَّا الْمُؤْمِنُ فَيَقُولُ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ وَرَسُولُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ انْظُرْ إِلَى مَقْعَدِكَ مِنَ النَّارِ قَدْ أَبْدَلَكَ اللَّهُ بِهِ مَقْعَدًا مِنَ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ فَيَرَاهُمَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَتَادَةُ وَذُكِرَ لَنَا أَنَّهُ يُفْسَحُ لَهُ فِي قَبْرِهِ سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا وَيُمْلأُ عَلَيْهِ خَضِرًا إِلَى يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa shaybaanu bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, qaala qaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinna al'abda iidhaa wudi'a fiy qabrihi watawallaa 'anhu aashaabuhu iinnahu layasma'u qar'a ni'aalihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ yaatiyhi malakaani fayuq'idaanihi fayaquwlaani lahu maa kunta taquwlu fiy hadhaa alrrajuli ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ faaammaa almuuminu fayaquwlu aashhadu aannahu 'abdu alllahi warasuwluhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ fayuqaalu lahu anzur iilaa maq'adika mina alnnaari qad aabdalaka alllahu bihi maq'adana mina aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ fayaraahumaa jamiy'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qataadaau wadhukira lanaa aannahu yufsahu lahu fiy qabrihi sab'uwna dhiraa'ana wayumlau 'alayhi khadirana iilaa yawmi yub'athuwna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) having said:When the servant is placed in his grave, his companions retrace their steps, and he hears the noise of their footsteps, two angels come to him and make him sit and say to him: What you have to say about this person (the Prophet)? If he is a believer, he would say: I bear testimony to the fact that he is a servant of Allah and His Messenger. Then it would be said to him: Look to your seat in the Hellfire, for Allah has substituted (the seat of yours) with a seat in Paradise. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: He would be shown both the seats. Qatada said: It was mentioned to us that his grave (the grave of a believer) expands to seventy cubits and is full with verdure until the Day when they would be resurrected
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِنْهَالٍ الضَّرِيرُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْمَيِّتَ إِذَا وُضِعَ فِي قَبْرِهِ إِنَّهُ لَيَسْمَعُ خَفْقَ نِعَالِهِمْ إِذَا انْصَرَفُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu minhaalin alddariyru, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna almayyita iidhaa wudi'a fiy qabrihi iinnahu layasma'u khafqa ni'aalihim iidhaa ansarafuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:When the dead body. is placed in the grave, he listens to the sound of the shoes (as his friends and relatives return after burying him)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرُو بْنُ زُرَارَةَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَطَاءٍ - عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الْعَبْدَ إِذَا وُضِعَ فِي قَبْرِهِ وَتَوَلَّى عَنْهُ أَصْحَابُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ شَيْبَانَ عَنْ قَتَادَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amruw bnu zuraaraaa, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, - ya'niy abna 'ataa'in - 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna al'abda iidhaa wudi'a fiy qabrihi watawallaa 'anhu aashaabuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara bimithli hadiythi shaybaana 'an qataadaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said:When the servant is placed in his grave and his friends retrace their steps. The rest of the hadith is the same as transmitted by Qatada
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَلْقَمَةَ بْنِ مَرْثَدٍ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ عُبَيْدَةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ ‏{‏ يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ‏}‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَزَلَتْ فِي عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ فَيُقَالُ لَهُ مَنْ رَبُّكَ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيَ اللَّهُ وَنَبِيِّيَ مُحَمَّدٌ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَلِكَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الآخِرَةِ‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaari bni 'uthmaana al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'alqamaaa bni marthadin, 'an sa'di bni 'ubaydaaa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ ‏{‏ yuthabbitu alllahu alladhiyna amanuwa bialqawli althhaabiti‏}‏ qaala ‏"‏ nazalat fiy 'adhaabi alqabri fayuqaalu lahu man rabbuka fayaquwlu rabbiya alllahu wanabiyyiya muhammadun sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhalika qawluhu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ yuthabbitu alllahu alladhiyna amanuwa bialqawli althhaabiti fiy alhayaaai alddunyaa wafiy alakhiraai‏}‏ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. `Azib reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:This verse: "Allah grants steadfastness to those who believe with firm word," was revealed in connection with the torment of the grave. It would be said to him: Who is your Lord? And he would say: Allah is my Lord and Muhammad is my Apostle (ﷺ), and that is (what is implied) by the words of Allah, the Exalted: "Allah keeps steadfast those who believe with firm word in this world and in the Hereafter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، - يَعْنُونَ ابْنَ مَهْدِيٍّ - عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ خَيْثَمَةَ، عَنِ الْبَرَاءِ بْنِ عَازِبٍ، ‏{‏ يُثَبِّتُ اللَّهُ الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا بِالْقَوْلِ الثَّابِتِ فِي الْحَيَاةِ الدُّنْيَا وَفِي الآخِرَةِ‏}‏ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي عَذَابِ الْقَبْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in qaaluwa haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani, - ya'nuwna abna mahdiyyin - 'an sufyaana, 'an aabiyhi, 'an khaythamaaa, 'ani albaraa'i bni 'aazibin, ‏{‏ yuthabbitu alllahu alladhiyna amanuwa bialqawli althhaabiti fiy alhayaaai alddunyaa wafiy alakhiraai‏}‏ qaala nazalat fiy 'adhaabi alqabri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Al-Bara' b. 'Azib reported that this verse:"Allah keeps those who believe steadfast with firm word in this world and the Hereafter" was revealed in connection with the torment of the grave
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بُدَيْلٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، اللَّهِ بْنِ شَقِيقٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ ‏"‏ إِذَا خَرَجَتْ رُوحُ الْمُؤْمِنِ تَلَقَّاهَا مَلَكَانِ يُصْعِدَانِهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حَمَّادٌ فَذَكَرَ مِنْ طِيبِ رِيحِهَا وَذَكَرَ الْمِسْكَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَيَقُولُ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ رُوحٌ طَيِّبَةٌ جَاءَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِ الأَرْضِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْكِ وَعَلَى جَسَدٍ كُنْتِ تَعْمُرِينَهُ ‏.‏ فَيُنْطَلَقُ بِهِ إِلَى رَبِّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ انْطَلِقُوا بِهِ إِلَى آخِرِ الأَجَلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَإِنَّ الْكَافِرَ إِذَا خَرَجَتْ رُوحُهُ - قَالَ حَمَّادٌ وَذَكَرَ مِنْ نَتْنِهَا وَذَكَرَ لَعْنًا - وَيَقُولُ أَهْلُ السَّمَاءِ رُوحٌ خَبِيثَةٌ جَاءَتْ مِنْ قِبَلِ الأَرْضِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَيُقَالُ انْطَلِقُوا بِهِ إِلَى آخِرِ الأَجَلِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ فَرَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم رَيْطَةً كَانَتْ عَلَيْهِ عَلَى أَنْفِهِ هَكَذَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa budaylun, 'an 'abdi, alllahi bni shaqiyqin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala ‏"‏ iidhaa kharajat ruwhu almuumini talaqqaahaa malakaani yus'idaanihaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala hammaadun fadhakara min tiybi riyhihaa wadhakara almiska ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ wayaquwlu aahlu alssamaa'i ruwhun tayyibaaun jaa'at min qibali alaardi sallaa alllahu 'alayki wa'alaa jasadin kunti ta'muriynahu ‏.‏ fayuntalaqu bihi iilaa rabbihi 'azza wajalla thumma yaquwlu antaliquwa bihi iilaa akhiri alaajali ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ waiinna alkaafira iidhaa kharajat ruwhuhu - qaala hammaadun wadhakara min natnihaa wadhakara la'nana - wayaquwlu aahlu alssamaa'i ruwhun khabiythaaun jaa'at min qibali alaardi ‏.‏ qaala fayuqaalu antaliquwa bihi iilaa akhiri alaajali ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw hurayraaa faradda rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm raytaaan kaanat 'alayhi 'alaa aanfihi hakadhaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported:When the soul of a believer would go out (of his body) it would be received bv two angels who would take it to the sky. Hammad (one of the narrators in the chain of transmitters) mentioned the swetness of its odour, (and further said) that the dwellers of the sky say: Here comes the pious soul from the side of the earth Let there be blessings of Allah upon the body in which it resides. And it is carried (by the angels) to its Lord, the Exalted and Glorious. He would say: Take it to its destined end. And if he is a nonbeliever and as it (the soul) leaves the body-Hammad made a mention of its foul smell and of its being cursed-the dwellers of the sky say: There comes a dirty soul from the side of the earth, and it would be said: Take it to its destined end.
