Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) put a thin cloth which was with him upon his nose while making a mention (of the foul smell) of the soul of a non-believer
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ سَلِيطٍ الْهُذَلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، قَالَ قَالَ أَنَسٌ كُنْتُ مَعَ عُمَرَ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ عُمَرَ بَيْنَ مَكَّةَ وَالْمَدِينَةِ فَتَرَاءَيْنَا الْهِلاَلَ وَكُنْتُ رَجُلاً حَدِيدَ الْبَصَرِ فَرَأَيْتُهُ وَلَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يَزْعُمُ أَنَّهُ رَآهُ غَيْرِي - قَالَ - فَجَعَلْتُ أَقُولُ لِعُمَرَ أَمَا تَرَاهُ فَجَعَلَ لاَ يَرَاهُ - قَالَ - يَقُولُ عُمَرُ سَأَرَاهُ وَأَنَا مُسْتَلْقٍ عَلَى فِرَاشِي ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَنْشَأَ يُحَدِّثُنَا عَنْ أَهْلِ بَدْرٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يُرِينَا مَصَارِعَ أَهْلِ بَدْرِ بِالأَمْسِ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ هَذَا مَصْرَعُ فُلاَنٍ غَدًا إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ فَوَالَّذِي بَعَثَهُ بِالْحَقِّ مَا أَخْطَئُوا الْحُدُودَ الَّتِي حَدَّ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - قَالَ - فَجُعِلُوا فِي بِئْرٍ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ فَانْطَلَقَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَتَّى انْتَهَى إِلَيْهِمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ وَيَا فُلاَنَ بْنَ فُلاَنٍ هَلْ وَجَدْتُمْ مَا وَعَدَكُمُ اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ حَقًّا فَإِنِّي قَدْ وَجَدْتُ مَا وَعَدَنِيَ اللَّهُ حَقًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ تُكَلِّمُ أَجْسَادًا لاَ أَرْوَاحَ فِيهَا قَالَ ‏"‏ مَا أَنْتُمْ بِأَسْمَعَ لِمَا أَقُولُ مِنْهُمْ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُمْ لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ أَنْ يَرُدُّوا عَلَىَّ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu 'umara bni saliytin alhudhaliyyu, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, 'an thaabitin, qaala qaala aanasun kuntu ma'a 'umara h wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu almughiyraai, 'an thaabitin, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala kunnaa ma'a 'umara bayna makkaaa waalmadiynaai fataraa'aynaa alhilaala wakuntu rajulaan hadiyda albasari faraaaytuhu walaysa aahadun yaz'umu aannahu raahu ghayriy - qaala - faja'altu aaquwlu li'umara aamaa taraahu faja'ala laa yaraahu - qaala - yaquwlu 'umaru saaaraahu waaanaa mustalqin 'alaa firaashiy ‏.‏ thumma aanshaaa yuhaddithunaa 'an aahli badrin faqaala iinna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kaana yuriynaa masaari'a aahli badri bialaamsi yaquwlu ‏"‏ hadhaa masra'u fulaanin ghadana iin shaa'a alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala 'umaru fawaalladhiy ba'athahu bialhaqqi maa aakhtaiuwa alhuduwda allatiy hadda rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - qaala - faju'iluwa fiy biirin ba'duhum 'alaa ba'din faantalaqa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm hattaa antahaa iilayhim faqaala ‏"‏ yaa fulaana bna fulaanin wayaa fulaana bna fulaanin hal wajadtum maa wa'adakumu alllahu warasuwluhu haqqana faiinniy qad wajadtu maa wa'adaniya alllahu haqqana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala 'umaru yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa tukallimu aajsaadana laa aarwaaha fiyhaa qaala ‏"‏ maa aantum biaasma'a limaa aaquwlu minhum ghayra aannahum laa yastatiy'uwna aan yarudduwa 'alaaaa shayiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported:We were along with Umar between Mecca and Medina that we began to look for the new moon. And I was a man with sharp eye- sight, so I could see it, but none except me saw it. I began to say to 'Umar: Don't you see it? But he would not see it. Thereupon Umar said: I would soon be able to see it (when it will shine more brightly). I lay upon bed. He then made a mention of the people of Badr to us and said: Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) showed us one day before (the actual battle) the place of death of the people (participating) in (the Battle) of Badr and he was saying: This would be the place of death of so and so tomorrow, if Allah wills. Umar said: By Him Who sent him with truth, they did not miss the places (of their death) which Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had pointed for them. Then they were all thrown in a well one after another. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) then went to them and said: O, so and so, the son of so and so; O so and so, the son of so and so, have you found correct what Allah and His Messenger had promised you? I have, however, found absolutely true what Allah had promised with me. Umar said: Allah's Messenger, how are you talking with the bodies without soul in them. Thereupon he said: You cannot hear more distinctly than (their hearing) of what I say, but with this exception that they have not power to make any reply
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا هَدَّابُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ ثَابِتٍ الْبُنَانِيِّ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ، مَالِكٍ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم تَرَكَ قَتْلَى بَدْرٍ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ أَتَاهُمْ فَقَامَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَنَادَاهُمْ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَبَا جَهْلِ بْنَ هِشَامٍ يَا أُمَيَّةَ بْنَ خَلَفٍ يَا عُتْبَةَ بْنَ رَبِيعَةَ يَا شَيْبَةَ بْنَ رَبِيعَةَ أَلَيْسَ قَدْ وَجَدْتُمْ مَا وَعَدَ رَبُّكُمْ حَقًّا فَإِنِّي قَدْ وَجَدْتُ مَا وَعَدَنِي رَبِّي حَقًّا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَسَمِعَ عُمَرُ قَوْلَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ كَيْفَ يَسْمَعُوا وَأَنَّى يُجِيبُوا وَقَدْ جَيَّفُوا قَالَ ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ مَا أَنْتُمْ بِأَسْمَعَ لِمَا أَقُولُ مِنْهُمْ وَلَكِنَّهُمْ لاَ يَقْدِرُونَ أَنْ يُجِيبُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ أَمَرَ بِهِمْ فَسُحِبُوا فَأُلْقُوا فِي قَلِيبِ بَدْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa haddaabu bnu khaalidin, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu salamaaa, 'an thaabitin albunaaniyyi, 'an aanasi bni, maalikin aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm taraka qatlaa badrin thalaathana thumma aataahum faqaama 'alayhim fanaadaahum faqaala ‏"‏ yaa aabaa jahli bna hishaamin yaa aumayyaaa bna khalafin yaa 'utbaaa bna rabiy'aaa yaa shaybaaa bna rabiy'aaa aalaysa qad wajadtum maa wa'ada rabbukum haqqana faiinniy qad wajadtu maa wa'adaniy rabbiy haqqana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fasami'a 'umaru qawla alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala yaa rasuwla alllahi kayfa yasma'uwa waaannaa yujiybuwa waqad jayyafuwa qaala ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi maa aantum biaasma'a limaa aaquwlu minhum walakinnahum laa yaqdiruwna aan yujiybuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma aamara bihim fasuhibuwa faaulquwa fiy qaliybi badrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) let the dead bodies of the unbelievers who fought in Badr (lie unburied) for three days. He then came to them and sat by their side and called them and said:O Abu Jahl b. Hisham, O Umayya b. Khalaf, O Utba b. Rab'ila, O Shaiba b. Rabi'a, have you not found what your Lord had promised with you to be correct? As for me, I have found the promises of my Lord to be (perfectly) correct. Umar listened to the words of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) and said: Allah's Messenger, how do they listen and respond to you? They are dead and their bodies have decayed. Thereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: By Him in Whose Hand is my life, what I am saying to them, even you cannot hear more distinctly than they, but they lack the power to reply. Then'he commanded that they should be buried in the well of Badr
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي يُوسُفُ بْنُ حَمَّادٍ الْمَعْنِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي عَرُوبَةَ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ ذَكَرَ لَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ عَنْ أَبِي طَلْحَةَ، قَالَ لَمَّا كَانَ يَوْمُ بَدْرٍ وَظَهَرَ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَمَرَ بِبِضْعَةٍ وَعِشْرِينَ رَجُلاً - وَفِي حَدِيثِ رَوْحٍ بِأَرْبَعَةٍ وَعِشْرِينَ رَجُلاً - مِنْ صَنَادِيدِ قُرَيْشٍ فَأُلْقُوا فِي طَوِيٍّ مِنْ أَطْوَاءِ بَدْرٍ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ أَنَسٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy yuwsufu bnu hammaadin alma'niyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, 'an sa'iydin, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, 'an aabiy talhaaa, h wahaddathaniyhi muhammadu bnu haatimin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa sa'iydu bnu aabiy 'aruwbaaa, 'an qataadaaa, qaala dhakara lanaa aanasu bnu maalikin 'an aabiy talhaaa, qaala lammaa kaana yawmu badrin wazahara 'alayhim nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aamara bibid'aain wa'ishriyna rajulaan - wafiy hadiythi rawhin biaarba'aain wa'ishriyna rajulaan - min sanaadiydi qurayshin faaulquwa fiy tawiyyin min aatwaa'i badrin ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bima'naa hadiythi thaabitin 'an aanasin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Aba Talha reported:When it was the Day of Badr and Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) had gained victory over them (the Meccans), he commanded more than twenty persons, and in another hadith these are counted as twenty-four persons, from the non-believers of the Quraish to be thrown into the well of Badr. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ، قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَنْ حُوسِبَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عُذِّبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ أَلَيْسَ قَدْ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏{‏ فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا‏}‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ ذَاكِ الْحِسَابُ إِنَّمَا ذَاكِ الْعَرْضُ مَنْ نُوقِشَ الْحِسَابَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عُذِّبَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, jamiy'ana 'an iismaa'iyla, qaala aabuw bakrin haddathanaa abnu 'ulayyaaa, 'an aayyuwba, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ man huwsiba yawma alqiyaamaai 'udhhiba ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu aalaysa qad qaala alllahu 'azza wajalla ‏{‏ fasawfa yuhaasabu hisaabana yasiyrana‏}‏ faqaala ‏"‏ laysa dhaaki alhisaabu iinnamaa dhaaki al'ardu man nuwqisha alhisaaba yawma alqiyaamaai 'udhhiba ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:He who is taken to account on the Day of Resurrection is in fact put to torment. I said: Has Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, not said this: 'He will be made subject to an easy reckoning" (Ixxxiv. 8)? Thereupon he said: (What it implies) is not the actual reckoning, but only the presentation of one's deeds to Him. He who is thoroughly examined in reckoning is put to torment
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَيُّوبُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa aayyuwbu, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ayyub with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرِ بْنِ الْحَكَمِ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سَعِيدٍ الْقَطَّانَ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو يُونُسَ الْقُشَيْرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ يُحَاسَبُ إِلاَّ هَلَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَلَيْسَ اللَّهُ يَقُولُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا قَالَ ‏"‏ ذَاكِ الْعَرْضُ وَلَكِنْ مَنْ نُوقِشَ الْحِسَابَ هَلَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishri bni alhakami al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa yahyaa, - ya'niy abna sa'iydin alqattaana - haddathanaa aabuw yuwnusa alqushayriyyu, haddathanaa abnu aabiy mulaykaaa, 'ani alqaasimi, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laysa aahadun yuhaasabu iilaaa halaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aalaysa alllahu yaquwlu hisaabana yasiyrana qaala ‏"‏ dhaaki al'ardu walakin man nuwqisha alhisaaba halaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Everyone who is reckoned thoroughly is undone. I said: Allah's Messenger, has Allah not called (reckoning) as easy reckoning? Thereupon he said.. It implies only presenta- tion of (one's deeds to Him), but if one is thoroughly examined in reckoning, he in fact is undone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى، - وَهُوَ الْقَطَّانُ - عَنْ عُثْمَانَ بْنِ، الأَسْوَدِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي مُلَيْكَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ مَنْ نُوقِشَ الْحِسَابَ هَلَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ أَبِي يُونُسَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu bishrin, haddathaniy yahyaa, - wahuwa alqattaanu - 'an 'uthmaana bni, alaaswadi 'ani abni aabiy mulaykaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ man nuwqisha alhisaaba halaka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara bimithli hadiythi aabiy yuwnusa ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:He who is examined thoroughly In reckoning is undone
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ زَكَرِيَّاءَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ وَفَاتِهِ بِثَلاَثٍ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَمُوتَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلاَّ وَهُوَ يُحْسِنُ بِاللَّهِ الظَّنَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa yahyaa bnu zakariyyaa'a, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qabla wafaatihi bithalaathin yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yamuwtanna aahadukum iilaaa wahuwa yuhsinu bialllahi alzzanna ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying three days before his death: None of you should court death but only hoping good from Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، وَأَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, waaabuw mu'aawiyaaa kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi mithlahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو دَاوُدَ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ، عَارِمٌ حَدَّثَنَا مَهْدِيُّ بْنُ، مَيْمُونٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَاصِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَبْلَ مَوْتِهِ بِثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لاَ يَمُوتَنَّ أَحَدُكُمْ إِلاَّ وَهُوَ يُحْسِنُ الظَّنَّ بِاللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aabuw daawuda, sulaymaanu bnu ma'badin haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani, 'aarimun haddathanaa mahdiyyu bnu, maymuwnin haddathanaa waasilun, 'an aabiy alzzubayri, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi alaansaariyyi, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qabla mawtihi bithalaathaai aayyaamin yaquwlu ‏ "‏ laa yamuwtanna aahadukum iilaaa wahuwa yuhsinu alzzanna bialllahi 'azza wajalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b. 'Abdullah al-Ansari reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) say three days before his death: None of you should die but hoping only good from Allah, the Exalted and Glorious
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ، عَنْ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يُبْعَثُ كُلُّ عَبْدٍ عَلَى مَا مَاتَ عَلَيْهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, wa'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, qaalaa haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy sufyaana, 'an jaabirin, qaala sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yub'athu kullu 'abdin 'alaa maa maata 'alayhi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying. Every servant would be raised (in the same very state) in which he dies
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ مِثْلَهُ وَقَالَ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَمْ يَقُلْ سَمِعْتُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu naafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu mahdiyyin, 'an sufyaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ mithlahu waqaala 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm walam yaqul sami'tu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of A'mash but with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 53 — The Book of Paradise, its Description, its Bounties and its Inhabitants
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ أَخْبَرَنِي حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ إِذَا أَرَادَ اللَّهُ بِقَوْمٍ عَذَابًا أَصَابَ الْعَذَابُ مَنْ كَانَ فِيهِمْ ثُمَّ بُعِثُوا عَلَى أَعْمَالِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni, shihaabin aakhbaraniy hamzaau bnu 'abdi alllahi bni 'umara, aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ iidhaa aaraada alllahu biqawmin 'adhaabana aasaaba al'adhaabu man kaana fiyhim thumma bu'ithuwa 'alaa aa'maalihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When Allah intends to chastise a people, He chastises all of them then they would be raised according to their deeds
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

chapters.title: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ، بِنْتِ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم اسْتَيْقَظَ مِنْ نَوْمِهِ وَهُوَ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَيْلٌ لِلْعَرَبِ مِنْ شَرٍّ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَعَقَدَ سُفْيَانُ بِيَدِهِ عَشَرَةً ‏.‏ قُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَهْلِكُ وَفِينَا الصَّالِحُونَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ إِذَا كَثُرَ الْخَبَثُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an zaynaba, binti aummi salamaaa 'an aummi habiybaaa, 'an zaynaba binti jahshin, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm astayqaza min nawmihi wahuwa yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waylun lil'arabi min sharrin qadi aqtaraba futiha alyawma min radmi yaajuwja wamaajuwja mithlu hadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wa'aqada sufyaanu biyadihi 'asharaaan ‏.‏ qultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aanahliku wafiynaa alssaalihuwna qaala ‏"‏ na'am iidhaa kathura alkhabathu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zainab bint Jahsh reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) got up from sleep saying:There is no being worthy of worship except Allah; there is a destruction in store for Arabia because of turmoil which is at hand, the barrier of Gog and Magog has opened so much. And Sufyan made a sign of ten with the help of his hand (in order to indicate the width of the gap) and I said: Allah's Messenger, would we be perished in spite of the fact that there would be good people amongst us? Thereupon he said: Of course, but only when the evil predominates
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَسَعِيدُ بْنُ عَمْرٍو الأَشْعَثِيُّ، وَزُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَابْنُ، أَبِي عُمَرَ قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ وَزَادُوا فِي الإِسْنَادِ عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، فَقَالُوا عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ حَبِيبَةَ، عَنْ أُمِّ حَبِيبَةَ، عَنْ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ جَحْشٍ، ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wasa'iydu bnu 'amrinw alaash'athiyyu, wazuhayru bnu harbin, waabnu, aabiy 'umara qaaluwa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ wazaaduwa fiy aliisnaadi 'an sufyaana, faqaaluwa 'an zaynaba binti aabiy salamaaa, 'an habiybaaa, 'an aummi habiybaaa, 'an zaynaba binti jahshin, ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zainab bint Jahsh with a slight variation in the chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عُرْوَةُ بْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، أَخْبَرَتْهُ أَنَّ أُمَّ حَبِيبَةَ بِنْتَ أَبِي سُفْيَانَ أَخْبَرَتْهَا أَنَّ زَيْنَبَ بِنْتَ جَحْشٍ زَوْجَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَتْ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَوْمًا فَزِعًا مُحْمَرًّا وَجْهُهُ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَيْلٌ لِلْعَرَبِ مِنْ شَرٍّ قَدِ اقْتَرَبَ فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَلَّقَ بِإِصْبَعِهِ الإِبْهَامِ وَالَّتِي تَلِيهَا ‏.‏ قَالَتْ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَنَهْلِكُ وَفِينَا الصَّالِحُونَ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ إِذَا كَثُرَ الْخَبَثُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy 'urwaau bnu alzzubayri, aanna zaynaba binta aabiy salamaaa, aakhbarathu aanna aumma habiybaaa binta aabiy sufyaana aakhbarathaa aanna zaynaba binta jahshin zawja alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaalat kharaja rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yawmana fazi'ana muhmarrana wajhuhu yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa iilaha iilaaa alllahu waylun lil'arabi min sharrin qadi aqtaraba futiha alyawma min radmi yaajuwja wamaajuwja mithlu hadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahallaqa biiisba'ihi aliibhaami waallatiy taliyhaa ‏.‏ qaalat faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi aanahliku wafiynaa alssaalihuwna qaala ‏"‏ na'am iidhaa kathura alkhabathu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Zainab bint Jahsh, the wife of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ), reported that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out in a state of excitement with his face quite red. And he was saying:There is no god but Allah; there is a destruction in store for Arabia because of the turmoil which is near at hand as the barrier of Gog and Magog has been opened like it, and he (in order to explain it) made a ring with the help of his thumb and forefinger. I said: Allah's Messenger, would we be destroyed despite the fact that there would be pious people amongst us? He said: Yes, when evil would be predominant
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu, khaalidin h wahaddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, kilaahumaa 'ani abni shihaabin, bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, biiisnaadihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with a different chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِسْحَاقَ، حَدَّثَنَا وُهَيْبٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ، اللَّهِ بْنُ طَاوُسٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ فُتِحَ الْيَوْمَ مِنْ رَدْمِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مِثْلُ هَذِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَعَقَدَ وُهَيْبٌ بِيَدِهِ تِسْعِينَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aahmadu bnu iishaaqa, haddathanaa wuhaybun, haddathanaa 'abdu, alllahi bnu taawusin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ futiha alyawma min radmi yaajuwja wamaajuwja mithlu hadhihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wa'aqada wuhaybun biyadihi tis'iyna ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:Today the wall (barrier) of Gog and Magog has been opened so much, and Wuhaib (in order to explain it) made the figure of ninety with the help of his hand
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ ابْنِ الْقِبْطِيَّةِ، قَالَ دَخَلَ الْحَارِثُ بْنُ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ وَعَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ وَأَنَا مَعَهُمَا، عَلَى أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَسَأَلاَهَا عَنِ الْجَيْشِ الَّذِي يُخْسَفُ بِهِ وَكَانَ ذَلِكَ فِي أَيَّامِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ فَقَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ يَعُوذُ عَائِذٌ بِالْبَيْتِ فَيُبْعَثُ إِلَيْهِ بَعْثٌ فَإِذَا كَانُوا بِبَيْدَاءَ مِنَ الأَرْضِ خُسِفَ بِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَكَيْفَ بِمَنْ كَانَ كَارِهًا قَالَ ‏"‏ يُخْسَفُ بِهِ مَعَهُمْ وَلَكِنَّهُ يُبْعَثُ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ عَلَى نِيَّتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ هِيَ بَيْدَاءُ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, waaabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma - waalllafzu liqutaybaaa - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'abdi al'aziyzi bni rufay'in, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi abni alqibtiyyaai, qaala dakhala alhaarithu bnu aabiy rabiy'aaa wa'abdu alllahi bnu safwaana waaanaa ma'ahumaa, 'alaa aummi salamaaa aummi almuuminiyna fasaaalaahaa 'ani aljayshi alladhiy yukhsafu bihi wakaana dhalika fiy aayyaami abni alzzubayri faqaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ ya'uwdhu 'aaiidhun bialbayti fayub'athu iilayhi ba'thun faiidhaa kaanuwa bibaydaa'a mina alaardi khusifa bihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi fakayfa biman kaana kaarihana qaala ‏"‏ yukhsafu bihi ma'ahum walakinnahu yub'athu yawma alqiyaamaai 'alaa niyyatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala aabuw ja'farin hiya baydaa'u almadiynaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: Harith b Abi Rabi'a and 'Abdullah b. Safwan both went to Umm Salama, the Mother of the Faithful, and they asked her about the army which would be sunk in the earth, and this relates to the time when Ibn Zubair (was the governor of Mecca). She reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had said that a seeker of refuge would seek refuge in the Sacred House and an army would be sent to him (in order to kill him) and when it would enter a plain ground, it would be made to sink. I said:Allah's Messenger, what about him who would be made to accompany this army willy nilly? Thereupon he said: He would be made to sink along with them but he would be raised on the Day of Resurrection on the basis of his intention. Abu Ja'far said. ' This plain, ground means the plain ground of Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ يُونُسَ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ رُفَيْعٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ فَلَقِيتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّهَا إِنَّمَا قَالَتْ بِبَيْدَاءَ مِنَ الأَرْضِ فَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ كَلاَّ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهَا لَبَيْدَاءُ الْمَدِينَةِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaahu aahmadu bnu yuwnusa, haddathanaa zuhayrun, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu rufay'in, bihadhaa aliisnaadi wafiy hadiythihi qaala falaqiytu aabaa ja'farin faqultu iinnahaa iinnamaa qaalat bibaydaa'a mina alaardi faqaala aabuw ja'farin kalaaa waalllahi iinnahaa labaydaa'u almadiynaai ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of 'Abdullah b. Rufai, with the same chain of transmitters (but with the addition of these words):" When I met Abu Ja'far I told him that she (simply) meant the plain ground. Thereupon Abu Ja'far said: No, by God, she meant the plain ground of Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعَمْرٍو - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ، عُيَيْنَةَ عَنْ أُمَيَّةَ بْنِ صَفْوَانَ، سَمِعَ جَدَّهُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ صَفْوَانَ، يَقُولُ أَخْبَرَتْنِي حَفْصَةُ، أَنَّهَا سَمِعَتِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ لَيَؤُمَّنَّ هَذَا الْبَيْتَ جَيْشٌ يَغْزُونَهُ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانُوا بِبَيْدَاءَ مِنَ الأَرْضِ يُخْسَفُ بِأَوْسَطِهِمْ وَيُنَادِي أَوَّلُهُمْ آخِرَهُمْ ثُمَّ يُخْسَفُ بِهِمْ فَلاَ يَبْقَى إِلاَّ الشَّرِيدُ الَّذِي يُخْبِرُ عَنْهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ أَشْهَدُ عَلَيْكَ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَكْذِبْ عَلَى حَفْصَةَ وَأَشْهَدُ عَلَى حَفْصَةَ أَنَّهَا لَمْ تَكْذِبْ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu li'amrinw - qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu, 'uyaynaaa 'an aumayyaaa bni safwaana, sami'a jaddahu 'abda alllahi bna safwaana, yaquwlu aakhbaratniy hafsaau, aannahaa sami'ati alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ layauummanna hadhaa albayta jayshun yaghzuwnahu hattaa iidhaa kaanuwa bibaydaa'a mina alaardi yukhsafu biaawsatihim wayunaadiy aawwaluhum akhirahum thumma yukhsafu bihim falaa yabqaa iilaaa alshhariydu alladhiy yukhbiru 'anhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala rajulun aashhadu 'alayka aannaka lam takdhib 'alaa hafsaaa waaashhadu 'alaa hafsaaa aannahaa lam takdhib 'alaa alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Safwan reported that Hafsa told him that she had heard Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:An army would attack this House in order to fight against the inhabitants of this House and when it would be at the plain ground the ranks in the centre of the army would be sunk and the vanguard would call the rear flanks of the army and they would also be sunk and no flank would be left except some people who would go to inform them (their kith and kin). A person (who had been listening to this hadith from Abdullah b. Safwan) said: I bear testimony in regard to you that you are not imputing a lie to Hafsa. And I bear testimony to the fact that Hafsa is not telling a lie about Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ صَالِحٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ، عَمْرٍو حَدَّثَنَا زَيْدُ بْنُ أَبِي أُنَيْسَةَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ الْعَامِرِيِّ، عَنْ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكَ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ، عَنْ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ سَيَعُوذُ بِهَذَا الْبَيْتِ - يَعْنِي الْكَعْبَةَ - قَوْمٌ لَيْسَتْ لَهُمْ مَنَعَةٌ وَلاَ عَدَدٌ وَلاَ عُدَّةٌ يُبْعَثُ إِلَيْهِمْ جَيْشٌ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانُوا بِبَيْدَاءَ مِنَ الأَرْضِ خُسِفَ بِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ يُوسُفُ وَأَهْلُ الشَّأْمِ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَسِيرُونَ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ مَا هُوَ بِهَذَا الْجَيْشِ ‏.‏ قَالَ زَيْدٌ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ الْعَامِرِيُّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ سَابِطٍ، عَنِ الْحَارِثِ، بْنِ أَبِي رَبِيعَةَ عَنْ أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ، ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُوسُفَ بْنِ مَاهَكٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِيهِ الْجَيْشَ الَّذِي ذَكَرَهُ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu haatimi bni maymuwnin, haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu saalihin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu, 'amrinw haddathanaa zaydu bnu aabiy aunaysaaa, 'an 'abdi almaliki al'aamiriyyi, 'an yuwsufa bni maahaka, aakhbaraniy 'abdu alllahi bnu safwaana, 'an aummi almuuminiyna, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ saya'uwdhu bihadhaa albayti - ya'niy alka'baaa - qawmun laysat lahum mana'aaun walaa 'adadun walaa 'uddaaun yub'athu iilayhim jayshun hattaa iidhaa kaanuwa bibaydaa'a mina alaardi khusifa bihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala yuwsufu waaahlu alshhaami yawmaiidhin yasiyruwna iilaa makkaaa faqaala 'abdu alllahi bnu safwaana aamaa waalllahi maa huwa bihadhaa aljayshi ‏.‏ qaala zaydun wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki al'aamiriyyu, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni saabitin, 'ani alhaarithi, bni aabiy rabiy'aaa 'an aummi almuuminiyna, ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi yuwsufa bni maahakin ghayra aannahu lam yadhkur fiyhi aljaysha alladhiy dhakarahu 'abdu alllahi bnu safwaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Safwan reported the Mother of the Faithful as saying that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:They would soon seek protection in this House, viz. Ka'ba (the defenceless), people who would have nothing to protect themselves in the shape of weapons or the strength of the people. An army would be sent to fight (and kill) them and when they would enter a plain ground the army would be sunk in it. Yusuf (one of the narrators) said: It was a people of Syria (hordes of Hajjaj) who had been on that day coming towards Mecca for an attack (on 'Abdulllah b. Zubair) and Abdullah b. Safwan said: By God, it does not imply this army
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يُونُسُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْقَاسِمُ بْنُ الْفَضْلِ، الْحُدَّانِيُّ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ عَبِثَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي مَنَامِهِ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَنَعْتَ شَيْئًا فِي مَنَامِكَ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَفْعَلُهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ الْعَجَبُ إِنَّ نَاسًا مِنْ أُمَّتِي يَؤُمُّونَ بِالْبَيْتِ بِرَجُلٍ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ قَدْ لَجَأَ بِالْبَيْتِ حَتَّى إِذَا كَانُوا بِالْبَيْدَاءِ خُسِفَ بِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّ الطَّرِيقَ قَدْ يَجْمَعُ النَّاسَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ نَعَمْ فِيهِمُ الْمُسْتَبْصِرُ وَالْمَجْبُورُ وَابْنُ السَّبِيلِ يَهْلِكُونَ مَهْلَكًا وَاحِدًا وَيَصْدُرُونَ مَصَادِرَ شَتَّى يَبْعَثُهُمُ اللَّهُ عَلَى نِيَّاتِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yuwnusu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa alqaasimu bnu alfadli, alhuddaaniyyu 'an muhammadi bni ziyaadin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alzzubayri, aanna 'aaiishaaa, qaalat 'abitha rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy manaamihi faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi sana'ta shayiana fiy manaamika lam takun taf'aluhu ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ al'ajabu iinna naasana min aummatiy yauummuwna bialbayti birajulin min qurayshin qad lajaaa bialbayti hattaa iidhaa kaanuwa bialbaydaa'i khusifa bihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi iinna alttariyqa qad yajma'u alnnaasa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ na'am fiyhimu almustabsiru waalmajbuwru waabnu alssabiyli yahlikuwna mahlakana waahidana wayasduruwna masaadira shattaa yab'athuhumu alllahu 'alaa niyyaatihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was startled in the state of sleep. We said:Allah's Messenger, you have done something in the state of your sleep which you never did before, Thereupon he said: Strange it is that some people of my Ummah would attack the House (Ka'ba) (for killing) a person who would belong to the tribe of the Quraish and he would try to seek protection in the House. And when they would reach the plain ground they would be sunk. We said: Allah's Messenger, all sorts of people throng the path. Thereupon he said: Yes, there would be amongst them people who would come with definite designs and those who would come under duress and there would be travellers also, but they would all be destroyed through one (stroke) of destruction. though they would be raised in different states (on the Day of Resurrection). Allah would, however, raise them according to their intention
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ عُرْوَةَ، عَنْ أُسَامَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَشْرَفَ عَلَى أُطُمٍ مِنْ آطَامِ الْمَدِينَةِ ثُمَّ قَالَ ‏ "‏ هَلْ تَرَوْنَ مَا أَرَى إِنِّي لأَرَى مَوَاقِعَ الْفِتَنِ خِلاَلَ بُيُوتِكُمْ كَمَوَاقِعِ الْقَطْرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy shaybaaa - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an 'urwaaa, 'an ausaamaaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm aashrafa 'alaa autumin min ataami almadiynaai thumma qaala ‏ "‏ hal tarawna maa aaraa iinniy laaraa mawaaqi'a alfitani khilaala buyuwtikum kamawaaqi'i alqatri ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Usama reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) climbed up a battlement amongst the battlements of Medina and then said:You do not see what I am seeing and I am seeing the places of turmoil between your houses as the places of rainfall
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Zuhri with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَالْحَسَنُ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ، الآخَرَانِ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ، شِهَابٍ حَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، وَأَبُو سَلَمَةَ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ سَتَكُونُ فِتَنٌ الْقَاعِدُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْقَائِمِ وَالْقَائِمُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمَاشِي وَالْمَاشِي فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ السَّاعِي مَنْ تَشَرَّفَ لَهَا تَسْتَشْرِفُهُ وَمَنْ وَجَدَ فِيهَا مَلْجَأً فَلْيَعُذْ بِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waalhasanu alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaraniy waqaala, alakharaani haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni, shihaabin haddathaniy abnu almusayyabi, waaabuw salamaaa bnu 'abdi alrrahmani aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ satakuwnu fitanun alqaa'idu fiyhaa khayrun mina alqaaiimi waalqaaiimu fiyhaa khayrun mina almaashiy waalmaashiy fiyhaa khayrun mina alssaa'iy man tasharrafa lahaa tastashrifuhu waman wajada fiyhaa maljaaan falya'udh bihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There will be soon a period of turmoil in which the one who sits will be better than one who stands and the one who stands will be better than one who walks and the one who walks will be better than one who runs. He who would watch them will be drawn by them. So he who finds a refuge or shelter against it should make it as his resort
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَالْحَسَنُ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ، الآخَرَانِ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ مُطِيعِ بْنِ الأَسْوَدِ، عَنْ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ مُعَاوِيَةَ، ‏.‏ مِثْلَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ هَذَا إِلاَّ أَنَّ أَبَا بَكْرٍ، يَزِيدُ ‏ "‏ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ صَلاَةٌ مَنْ فَاتَتْهُ فَكَأَنَّمَا وُتِرَ أَهْلَهُ وَمَالَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waalhasanu alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaraniy waqaala, alakharaani haddathanaa ya'quwbu, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, haddathaniy aabuw bakri bnu 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni mutiy'i bni alaaswadi, 'an nawfali bni mu'aawiyaaa, ‏.‏ mithla hadiythi aabiy hurayraaa hadhaa iilaaa aanna aabaa bakrin, yaziydu ‏ "‏ mina alssalaaai salaaaun man faatathu fakaaannamaa wutira aahlahu wamaalahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Abu Huraira but with this variation of wording that in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Abu Bakr, there is an addition of these words:" There is a prayer among prayers ('Asr) and one who misses it is as if his family and property have been ruined
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ الطَّيَالِسِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا إِبْرَاهِيمُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَكُونُ فِتْنَةٌ النَّائِمُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَقْظَانِ وَالْيَقْظَانُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْقَائِمِ وَالْقَائِمُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ السَّاعِي فَمَنْ وَجَدَ مَلْجَأً أَوْ مَعَاذًا فَلْيَسْتَعِذْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa aabuw daawuda alttayaalisiyyu, haddathanaa iibraahiymu bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ takuwnu fitnaaun alnnaaiimu fiyhaa khayrun mina alyaqzaani waalyaqzaanu fiyhaa khayrun mina alqaaiimi waalqaaiimu fiyhaa khayrun mina alssaa'iy faman wajada maljaaan aaw ma'aadhana falyasta'idh ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:There would be turmoil and the one who would sleep would be better than who would be awake and the one who would be awake would be better than one who would stand and one who would stand would be better than one who would run. So he who finds refuge or shelter should take that refuge or shelter
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ، الشَّحَّامُ قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ أَنَا وَفَرْقَدٌ السَّبَخِيُّ، إِلَى مُسْلِمِ بْنِ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ وَهُوَ فِي أَرْضِهِ فَدَخَلْنَا عَلَيْهِ فَقُلْنَا هَلْ سَمِعْتَ أَبَاكَ يُحَدِّثُ فِي الْفِتَنِ حَدِيثًا قَالَ نَعَمْ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا بَكْرَةَ يُحَدِّثُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا سَتَكُونُ فِتَنٌ أَلاَ ثُمَّ تَكُونُ فِتْنَةٌ الْقَاعِدُ فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْمَاشِي فِيهَا وَالْمَاشِي فِيهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ السَّاعِي إِلَيْهَا أَلاَ فَإِذَا نَزَلَتْ أَوْ وَقَعَتْ فَمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ إِبِلٌ فَلْيَلْحَقْ بِإِبِلِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ غَنَمٌ فَلْيَلْحَقْ بِغَنَمِهِ وَمَنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ أَرْضٌ فَلْيَلْحَقْ بِأَرْضِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ مَنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ إِبِلٌ وَلاَ غَنَمٌ وَلاَ أَرْضٌ قَالَ ‏"‏ يَعْمِدُ إِلَى سَيْفِهِ فَيَدُقُّ عَلَى حَدِّهِ بِحَجَرٍ ثُمَّ لْيَنْجُ إِنِ اسْتَطَاعَ النَّجَاءَ اللَّهُمَّ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ اللَّهُمَّ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ اللَّهُمَّ هَلْ بَلَّغْتُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَرَأَيْتَ إِنْ أُكْرِهْتُ حَتَّى يُنْطَلَقَ بِي إِلَى أَحَدِ الصَّفَّيْنِ أَوْ إِحْدَى الْفِئَتَيْنِ فَضَرَبَنِي رَجُلٌ بِسَيْفِهِ أَوْ يَجِيءُ سَهْمٌ فَيَقْتُلُنِي قَالَ ‏"‏ يَبُوءُ بِإِثْمِهِ وَإِثْمِكَ وَيَكُونُ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, fudaylu bnu husaynin haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu, alshhahhaamu qaala antalaqtu aanaa wafarqadun alssabakhiyyu, iilaa muslimi bni aabiy bakraaa wahuwa fiy aardihi fadakhalnaa 'alayhi faqulnaa hal sami'ta aabaaka yuhaddithu fiy alfitani hadiythana qaala na'am sami'tu aabaa bakraaa yuhaddithu qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahaa satakuwnu fitanun aalaa thumma takuwnu fitnaaun alqaa'idu fiyhaa khayrun mina almaashiy fiyhaa waalmaashiy fiyhaa khayrun mina alssaa'iy iilayhaa aalaa faiidhaa nazalat aaw waqa'at faman kaana lahu iibilun falyalhaq biiibilihi waman kaanat lahu ghanamun falyalhaq bighanamihi waman kaanat lahu aardun falyalhaq biaardihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta man lam yakun lahu iibilun walaa ghanamun walaa aardun qaala ‏"‏ ya'midu iilaa sayfihi fayaduqqu 'alaa haddihi bihajarin thumma lyanju iini astataa'a alnnajaa'a alllahumma hal ballaghtu alllahumma hal ballaghtu alllahumma hal ballaghtu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala rajulun yaa rasuwla alllahi aaraaayta iin aukrihtu hattaa yuntalaqa biy iilaa aahadi alssaffayni aaw iihdaa alfiiatayni fadarabaniy rajulun bisayfihi aaw yajiy'u sahmun fayaqtuluniy qaala ‏"‏ yabuw'u biiithmihi waiithmika wayakuwnu min aashaabi alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakra reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:There would soon be turmoil. Behold! there would be turmoil in which the one who would be seated would be better than one who would stand and the one who would stand would be better than one who would run. Behold! when the turmoil comes or it appears, the one who has camel should stick to his camel and he who has sheep or goat should stick to his sheep and goat and he who has land should stick to the land. A person said: 'Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion about one who has neither camel nor sheep nor land? Thereupon, he said: He should take hold of his sword and beat its edge with the help of stone and then try to find a way of escape. O Allah, I have conveyed (Thy Message) ; O Allah, I have conveyed (Thy Message) ; O Allah, I have conveyed (Thy Message). A person said: Allah's Messenger, what is your opinion if I am drawn to a rank in spite of myself, or in one of the groups and made to march and a man strikes with his sword or there comes an arrow and kills me? Thereupon he said: He will bear the punishment of his sin and that of yours and he would be one amongst the denizens of Hell
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ عُثْمَانَ الشَّحَّامِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ حَدِيثُ ابْنِ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ حَمَّادٍ إِلَى آخِرِهِ وَانْتَهَى حَدِيثُ وَكِيعٍ عِنْدَ قَوْلِهِ ‏ "‏ إِنِ اسْتَطَاعَ النَّجَاءَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw kuraybin qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu, bnu almuthannaa haddathanaa abnu aabiy 'adiyyin, kilaahumaa 'an 'uthmaana alshhahhaami, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ hadiythu abni aabiy 'adiyyin nahwa hadiythi hammaadin iilaa akhirihi waantahaa hadiythu wakiy'in 'inda qawlihi ‏ "‏ iini astataa'a alnnajaa'a ‏"‏ ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Waki' with a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، وَيُونُسَ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ الأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، قَالَ خَرَجْتُ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ، هَذَا الرَّجُلَ فَلَقِيَنِي أَبُو بَكْرَةَ فَقَالَ أَيْنَ تُرِيدُ يَا أَحْنَفُ قَالَ قُلْتُ أُرِيدُ نَصْرَ ابْنِ عَمِّ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم - يَعْنِي عَلِيًّا - قَالَ فَقَالَ لِي يَا أَحْنَفُ ارْجِعْ فَإِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِذَا تَوَاجَهَ الْمُسْلِمَانِ بِسَيْفَيْهِمَا فَالْقَاتِلُ وَالْمَقْتُولُ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ أَوْ قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ هَذَا الْقَاتِلُ فَمَا بَالُ الْمَقْتُولِ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ قَدْ أَرَادَ قَتْلَ صَاحِبِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin aljahdariyyu haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, wayuwnusa 'ani alhasani, 'ani alaahnafi bni qaysin, qaala kharajtu waaanaa auriydu, hadhaa alrrajula falaqiyaniy aabuw bakraaa faqaala aayna turiydu yaa aahnafu qaala qultu auriydu nasra abni 'ammi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm - ya'niy 'aliyyana - qaala faqaala liy yaa aahnafu arji' faiinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iidhaa tawaajaha almuslimaani bisayfayhimaa faalqaatilu waalmaqtuwlu fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqultu aaw qiyla yaa rasuwla alllahi hadhaa alqaatilu famaa baalu almaqtuwli qaala ‏"‏ iinnahu qad aaraada qatla saahibihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ahnaf b. Qais reported:I set out with the intention of helping this person (Hadrat 'Ali) when Abu Bakra met me. He said: Ahnaf, where do you intend to go? I said: I intend to help the cousin of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), viz. 'Ali. Thereupon he said to me: Ahnaf, go back, for I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: When two Muslims confront one another with swords (in hand) both the slayer and the slain would be in Fire. He (Ahnaf) said: I said, or it was said: Allah's Messenger, it may be the case of one who kills. but what about the slain (why he would be put in Hell-Fire)? Thereupon he said: He also intended to kill his companion
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عَبْدَةَ الضَّبِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، وَيُونُسَ، وَالْمُعَلَّى بْنِ زِيَادٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنِ الأَحْنَفِ بْنِ قَيْسٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِذَا الْتَقَى الْمُسْلِمَانِ بِسَيْفَيْهِمَا فَالْقَاتِلُ وَالْمَقْتُولُ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aahmadu bnu 'abdaaa alddabbiyyu, haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, wayuwnusa, waalmu'allaa bni ziyaadin, 'ani alhasani, 'ani alaahnafi bni qaysin, 'an aabiy bakraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iidhaa altaqaa almuslimaani bisayfayhimaa faalqaatilu waalmaqtuwlu fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ahnaf b. Qais reported on the authority of Abu Bakra that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:When two Muslims confront each other with their swords, both the slayer and the slain are doomed to Hell-Fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، مِنْ كِتَابِهِ أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي كَامِلٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ، إِلَى آخِرِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy hajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, min kitaabihi aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'an aayyuwba, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwa hadiythi aabiy kaamilin 'an hammaadin, iilaa akhirihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hammad through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ بَشَّارٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِذَا الْمُسْلِمَانِ حَمَلَ أَحَدُهُمَا عَلَى أَخِيهِ السِّلاَحَ فَهُمَا فِي جُرُفِ جَهَنَّمَ فَإِذَا قَتَلَ أَحَدُهُمَا صَاحِبَهُ دَخَلاَهَا جَمِيعًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa ghundarun, 'an shu'baaa, h wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu bashhaarin qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an mansuwrin, 'an rib'iyyi bni hiraashin, 'an aabiy bakraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iidhaa almuslimaani hamala aahaduhumaa 'alaa aakhiyhi alssilaaha fahumaa fiy jurufi jahannama faiidhaa qatala aahaduhumaa saahibahu dakhalaahaa jamiy'ana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Bakra reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:When two Muslims (confront each other) and the one amongst them attacks his brother with a weapon, both of them are at the brink of Hell-Fire. And when one of them kills his companion, both of them get into Hell-Fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَكْثُرَ الْهَرْجُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا وَمَا الْهَرْجُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْقَتْلُ الْقَتْلُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yakthura alharju ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa wamaa alharju yaa rasuwla alllahi qaala ‏"‏ alqatlu alqatlu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The last Hour will not come unless there is much bloodshed. They said: What is harj? Thereupon he said: Bloodshed. bloodshed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ الْعَتَكِيُّ، وَقُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِقُتَيْبَةَ - حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ زَوَى لِيَ الأَرْضَ فَرَأَيْتُ مَشَارِقَهَا وَمَغَارِبَهَا وَإِنَّ أُمَّتِي سَيَبْلُغُ مُلْكُهَا مَا زُوِيَ لِي مِنْهَا وَأُعْطِيتُ الْكَنْزَيْنِ الأَحْمَرَ وَالأَبْيَضَ وَإِنِّي سَأَلْتُ رَبِّي لأُمَّتِي أَنْ لاَ يُهْلِكَهَا بِسَنَةٍ بِعَامَّةٍ وَأَنْ لاَ يُسَلِّطَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَدُوًّا مِنْ سِوَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَيَسْتَبِيحَ بَيْضَتَهُمْ وَإِنَّ رَبِّي قَالَ يَا مُحَمَّدُ إِنِّي إِذَا قَضَيْتُ قَضَاءً فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يُرَدُّ وَإِنِّي أَعْطَيْتُكَ لأُمَّتِكَ أَنْ لاَ أُهْلِكَهُمْ بِسَنَةٍ بِعَامَّةٍ وَأَنْ لاَ أُسَلِّطَ عَلَيْهِمْ عَدُوًّا مِنْ سِوَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ يَسْتَبِيحُ بَيْضَتَهُمْ وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِمْ مَنْ بِأَقْطَارِهَا - أَوْ قَالَ مَنْ بَيْنَ أَقْطَارِهَا - حَتَّى يَكُونَ بَعْضُهُمْ يُهْلِكُ بَعْضًا وَيَسْبِي بَعْضُهُمْ بَعْضًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw alrrabiy'i al'atakiyyu, waqutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, kilaahumaa 'an hammaadi bni zaydin, - waalllafzu liqutaybaaa - haddathanaa hammaadun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy aasmaa'a, 'an thawbaana, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha zawaa liya alaarda faraaaytu mashaariqahaa wamaghaaribahaa waiinna aummatiy sayablughu mulkuhaa maa zuwiya liy minhaa waau'tiytu alkanzayni alaahmara waalaabyada waiinniy saaaltu rabbiy laummatiy aan laa yuhlikahaa bisanaain bi'aammaain waaan laa yusallita 'alayhim 'aduwwana min siwaa aanfusihim fayastabiyha baydatahum waiinna rabbiy qaala yaa muhammadu iinniy iidhaa qadaytu qadaa'an faiinnahu laa yuraddu waiinniy aa'taytuka laummatika aan laa auhlikahum bisanaain bi'aammaain waaan laa ausallita 'alayhim 'aduwwana min siwaa aanfusihim yastabiyhu baydatahum walawi ajtama'a 'alayhim man biaaqtaarihaa - aaw qaala man bayna aaqtaarihaa - hattaa yakuwna ba'duhum yuhliku ba'dana wayasbiy ba'duhum ba'dana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Allah drew the ends of the world near one another for my sake. And I have seen its eastern and western ends. And the dominion of my Ummah would reach those ends which have been drawn near me and I have been granted the red and the white treasure and I begged my Lord for my Ummah that it should not be destroyed because of famine, nor be dominated by an enemy who is not amongst them to take their lives and destroy them root and branch, and my Lord said: Muhammad, whenever I make a decision, there is none to change it. I grant you for your Ummah that it would not be destroyed by famine and it would not be dominated by an enemy who would not be amongst it and would take their lives and destroy them root and branch even if all the people from the different parts of the world join hands together (for this purpose), but it would be from amongst them, viz. your Ummah, that some people would kill the others or imprison the others
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرُونَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي أَسْمَاءَ الرَّحَبِيِّ، عَنْ ثَوْبَانَ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى زَوَى لِيَ الأَرْضَ حَتَّى رَأَيْتُ مَشَارِقَهَا وَمَغَارِبَهَا وَأَعْطَانِي الْكَنْزَيْنِ الأَحْمَرَ وَالأَبْيَضَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharuwna, haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, 'an aabiy qilaabaaa, 'an aabiy aasmaa'a alrrahabiyyi, 'an thawbaana, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha ta'aalaa zawaa liya alaarda hattaa raaaytu mashaariqahaa wamaghaaribahaa waaa'taaniy alkanzayni alaahmara waalaabyada ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma dhakara nahwa hadiythi aayyuwba 'an aabiy qilaabaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Thauban reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said. Verily, Allah drew the ends of the world near me until I saw its east and west, and He bestowed upon me two treasures, the red and the white. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَقْبَلَ ذَاتَ يَوْمٍ مِنَ الْعَالِيَةِ حَتَّى إِذَا مَرَّ بِمَسْجِدِ بَنِي مُعَاوِيَةَ دَخَلَ فَرَكَعَ فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَصَلَّيْنَا مَعَهُ وَدَعَا رَبَّهُ طَوِيلاً ثُمَّ انْصَرَفَ إِلَيْنَا فَقَالَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ سَأَلْتُ رَبِّي ثَلاَثًا فَأَعْطَانِي ثِنْتَيْنِ وَمَنَعَنِي وَاحِدَةً سَأَلْتُ رَبِّي أَنْ لاَ يُهْلِكَ أُمَّتِي بِالسَّنَةِ فَأَعْطَانِيهَا وَسَأَلْتُهُ أَنْ لاَ يُهْلِكَ أُمَّتِي بِالْغَرَقِ فَأَعْطَانِيهَا وَسَأَلْتُهُ أَنْ لاَ يَجْعَلَ بَأْسَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ فَمَنَعَنِيهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu numayrin, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu hakiymin, aakhbaraniy 'aamiru bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aaqbala dhaata yawmin mina al'aaliyaai hattaa iidhaa marra bimasjidi baniy mu'aawiyaaa dakhala faraka'a fiyhi rak'atayni wasallaynaa ma'ahu wada'aa rabbahu tawiylaan thumma ansarafa iilaynaa faqaala sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ saaaltu rabbiy thalaathana faaa'taaniy thintayni wamana'aniy waahidaaan saaaltu rabbiy aan laa yuhlika aummatiy bialssanaai faaa'taaniyhaa wasaaaltuhu aan laa yuhlika aummatiy bialgharaqi faaa'taaniyhaa wasaaaltuhu aan laa yaj'ala baasahum baynahum famana'aniyhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that one day Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came from a high, land. He passed by the mosque of Banu Mu'awiya, went in and observed two rak'ahs there and we also observed prayer along with him and he made a long supplication to his Lord. He then came to us and said:I asked my Lord three things and He has granted me two but has withheld one. I begged my Lord that my Ummah should not be destroyed because of famine and He granted me this. And I begged my Lord that my Ummah should not be destroyed by drowning (by deluge) and He granted me this. And I begged my Lord that there should be no bloodshed among the people of my Ummah, but He did not grant it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ بْنُ مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ حَكِيمٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي عَامِرُ بْنُ سَعْدٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّهُ أَقْبَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي طَائِفَةٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فَمَرَّ بِمَسْجِدِ بَنِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ نُمَيْرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa marwaanu bnu mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu hakiymin alaansaariyyu, aakhbaraniy 'aamiru bnu sa'din, 'an aabiyhi, aannahu aaqbala ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy taaiifaain min aashaabihi famarra bimasjidi baniy mu'aawiyaaa ‏.‏ bimithli hadiythi abni numayrin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Amir b. Sa'd reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came with a group of his Companions and he passed by the mosque of Banu Mu'awiya. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّ أَبَا إِدْرِيسَ الْخَوْلاَنِيَّ، كَانَ يَقُولُ قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ بْنُ الْيَمَانِ وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ النَّاسِ بِكُلِّ فِتْنَةٍ هِيَ كَائِنَةٌ فِيمَا بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ السَّاعَةِ وَمَا بِي إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَسَرَّ إِلَىَّ فِي ذَلِكَ شَيْئًا لَمْ يُحَدِّثْهُ غَيْرِي وَلَكِنْ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَهُوَ يُحَدِّثُ مَجْلِسًا أَنَا فِيهِ عَنِ الْفِتَنِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَعُدُّ الْفِتَنَ ‏ "‏ مِنْهُنَّ ثَلاَثٌ لاَ يَكَدْنَ يَذَرْنَ شَيْئًا وَمِنْهُنَّ فِتَنٌ كَرِيَاحِ الصَّيْفِ مِنْهَا صِغَارٌ وَمِنْهَا كِبَارٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ فَذَهَبَ أُولَئِكَ الرَّهْطُ كُلُّهُمْ غَيْرِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aanna aabaa iidriysa alkhawlaaniyya, kaana yaquwlu qaala hudhayfaau bnu alyamaani waalllahi iinniy laa'lamu alnnaasi bikulli fitnaain hiya kaaiinaaun fiymaa bayniy wabayna alssaa'aai wamaa biy iilaaa aan yakuwna rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aasarra iilaaaa fiy dhalika shayiana lam yuhaddithhu ghayriy walakin rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala wahuwa yuhaddithu majlisana aanaa fiyhi 'ani alfitani faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa ya'uddu alfitana ‏ "‏ minhunna thalaathun laa yakadna yadharna shayiana waminhunna fitanun kariyaahi alssayfi minhaa sighaarun waminhaa kibaarun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala hudhayfaau fadhahaba auwlaiika alrrahtu kulluhum ghayriy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa b. al-Yaman reported:By Allah, I have the best knowledge amongst people about every turmoil which is going to appear in the period intervening me and the Last Hour; and it is not for the fact that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) told me something confidentially pertaining to it and he did not tell anybody else about it, but it is because of the fact that I was present in the assembly in which he had been describing the turmoil. and he especially made a mention of three turmoils which would not spare anything and amongst these there would be turmoils like storms in the hot season. Some of them would be violent and some of them would be comparatively mild. Hudhaifa said: All (who were present) except I have gone (to the next world)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ، إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ قَامَ فِينَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَقَامًا مَا تَرَكَ شَيْئًا يَكُونُ فِي مَقَامِهِ ذَلِكَ إِلَى قِيَامِ السَّاعَةِ إِلاَّ حَدَّثَ بِهِ حَفِظَهُ مَنْ حَفِظَهُ وَنَسِيَهُ مَنْ نَسِيَهُ قَدْ عَلِمَهُ أَصْحَابِي هَؤُلاَءِ وَإِنَّهُ لَيَكُونُ مِنْهُ الشَّىْءُ قَدْ نَسِيتُهُ فَأَرَاهُ فَأَذْكُرُهُ كَمَا يَذْكُرُ الرَّجُلُ وَجْهَ الرَّجُلِ إِذَا غَابَ عَنْهُ ثُمَّ إِذَا رَآهُ عَرَفَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala 'uthmaanu haddathanaa waqaala, iishaaqu aakhbaranaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala qaama fiynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maqaamana maa taraka shayiana yakuwnu fiy maqaamihi dhalika iilaa qiyaami alssaa'aai iilaaa haddatha bihi hafizahu man hafizahu wanasiyahu man nasiyahu qad 'alimahu aashaabiy hauulaa'i waiinnahu layakuwnu minhu alshhaa'u qad nasiytuhu faaaraahu faaadhkuruhu kamaa yadhkuru alrrajulu wajha alrrajuli iidhaa ghaaba 'anhu thumma iidhaa raahu 'arafahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood before us one day and he did not leave anything unsaid (that he had to say) at that very spot which would happen (in the shape of turmoil) up to the Last Hour. Those who had to remember them preserved them in their minds and those who could not remember them forgot them. My friends knew them and there are certain things which slip out of my mind, but I recapitulate them when anyone makes a mention of them just as a person is lost from one's mind but is recalled to him on seeing his face
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ إِلَى قَوْلِهِ وَنَسِيَهُ مَنْ نَسِيَهُ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ مَا بَعْدَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa wakiy'un, 'an sufyaana, 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi iilaa qawlihi wanasiyahu man nasiyahu ‏.‏ walam yadhkur maa ba'dahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of A'mash with the same chain of transmitters up to the words:And he forgot who had to forget that and. he did not make a mention of what follows after this
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ، بْنُ نَافِعٍ حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيِّ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَا هُوَ كَائِنٌ إِلَى أَنْ تَقُومَ السَّاعَةُ فَمَا مِنْهُ شَىْءٌ إِلاَّ قَدْ سَأَلْتُهُ إِلاَّ أَنِّي لَمْ أَسْأَلْهُ مَا يُخْرِجُ أَهْلَ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, h wahaddathaniy aabuw bakri, bnu naafi'in haddathanaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'adiyyi bni thaabitin, 'an 'abdi alllahi bni yaziyda, 'an hudhayfaaa, aannahu qaala aakhbaraniy rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimaa huwa kaaiinun iilaa aan taquwma alssaa'aau famaa minhu shaa'un iilaaa qad saaaltuhu iilaaa aanniy lam aasaalhu maa yukhriju aahla almadiynaai mina almadiynaai
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed me of what is going to happen before the approach of the Last Hour. And there is nothing that I did not ask him in this connection except this that I did not ask him as to what would turn the people of Medina out from Medina
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنِي وَهْبُ بْنُ جَرِيرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا شُعْبَةُ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathaniy wahbu bnu jariyrin, aakhbaranaa shu'baau, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، وَحَجَّاجُ بْنُ الشَّاعِرِ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي عَاصِمٍ، - قَالَ حَجَّاجٌ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَاصِمٍ، - أَخْبَرَنَا عَزْرَةُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِلْبَاءُ بْنُ أَحْمَرَ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو زَيْدٍ، - يَعْنِي عَمْرَو بْنَ أَخْطَبَ - قَالَ صَلَّى بِنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْفَجْرَ وَصَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ فَخَطَبَنَا حَتَّى حَضَرَتِ الظُّهْرُ فَنَزَلَ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ صَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ فَخَطَبَنَا حَتَّى حَضَرَتِ الْعَصْرُ ثُمَّ نَزَلَ فَصَلَّى ثُمَّ صَعِدَ الْمِنْبَرَ فَخَطَبَنَا حَتَّى غَرَبَتِ الشَّمْسُ فَأَخْبَرَنَا بِمَا كَانَ وَبِمَا هُوَ كَائِنٌ فَأَعْلَمُنَا أَحْفَظُنَا ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy ya'quwbu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, wahajjaaju bnu alshhaa'iri, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy 'aasimin, - qaala hajjaajun haddathanaa aabuw 'aasimin, - aakhbaranaa 'azraau bnu thaabitin, aakhbaranaa 'ilbaa'u bnu aahmara, haddathaniy aabuw zaydin, - ya'niy 'amraw bna aakhtaba - qaala sallaa binaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alfajra wasa'ida alminbara fakhatabanaa hattaa hadarati alzzuhru fanazala fasallaa thumma sa'ida alminbara fakhatabanaa hattaa hadarati al'asru thumma nazala fasallaa thumma sa'ida alminbara fakhatabanaa hattaa gharabati alshhamsu faaakhbaranaa bimaa kaana wabimaa huwa kaaiinun faaa'lamunaa aahfazunaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Zaid (viz. Amr b. Akhtab) reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) led us in the dawn prayer and then mounted the pulpit and addressed us until it was (time for the) noon prayer. He then came down the pulpit and observed prayer and then again mounted the pulpit and again addressed us until it was time for the 'Asr prayer. He then again came down and observed the prayer and again mounted the pulpit and addressed us until the sun was set and he informed (about) everything (pertaining to turmoil) that lay hidden in the past and what lies in (the womb) of) the future and the most learned amongst us is one who remembers them well
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ أَبِي، مُعَاوِيَةَ قَالَ ابْنُ الْعَلاَءِ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ عُمَرَ فَقَالَ أَيُّكُمْ يَحْفَظُ حَدِيثَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الْفِتْنَةِ كَمَا قَالَ قَالَ فَقُلْتُ أَنَا ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنَّكَ لَجَرِيءٌ وَكَيْفَ قَالَ قَالَ قُلْتُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ فِتْنَةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي أَهْلِهِ وَمَالِهِ وَنَفْسِهِ وَوَلَدِهِ وَجَارِهِ يُكَفِّرُهَا الصِّيَامُ وَالصَّلاَةُ وَالصَّدَقَةُ وَالأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَالنَّهْىُ عَنِ الْمُنْكَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ لَيْسَ هَذَا أُرِيدُ إِنَّمَا أُرِيدُ الَّتِي تَمُوجُ كَمَوْجِ الْبَحْرِ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ مَا لَكَ وَلَهَا يَا أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِنَّ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَهَا بَابًا مُغْلَقًا قَالَ أَفَيُكْسَرُ الْبَابُ أَمْ يُفْتَحُ قَالَ قُلْتُ لاَ بَلْ يُكْسَرُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ذَلِكَ أَحْرَى أَنْ لاَ يُغْلَقَ أَبَدًا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقُلْنَا لِحُذَيْفَةَ هَلْ كَانَ عُمَرُ يَعْلَمُ مَنِ الْبَابُ قَالَ نَعَمْ كَمَا يَعْلَمُ أَنَّ دُونَ غَدٍ اللَّيْلَةَ إِنِّي حَدَّثْتُهُ حَدِيثًا لَيْسَ بِالأَغَالِيطِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَهِبْنَا أَنْ نَسْأَلَ حُذَيْفَةَ مَنِ الْبَابُ فَقُلْنَا لِمَسْرُوقٍ سَلْهُ فَسَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i aabuw kuraybin, jamiy'ana 'an aabiy, mu'aawiyaaa qaala abnu al'alaa'i haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala kunnaa 'inda 'umara faqaala aayyukum yahfazu hadiytha rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alfitnaai kamaa qaala qaala faqultu aanaa ‏.‏ qaala iinnaka lajariy'un wakayfa qaala qaala qultu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ fitnaau alrrajuli fiy aahlihi wamaalihi wanafsihi wawaladihi wajaarihi yukaffiruhaa alssiyaamu waalssalaaau waalssadaqaau waalaamru bialma'ruwfi waalnnahau 'ani almunkari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru laysa hadhaa auriydu iinnamaa auriydu allatiy tamuwju kamawji albahri - qaala - faqultu maa laka walahaa yaa aamiyra almuuminiyna iinna baynaka wabaynahaa baabana mughlaqana qaala aafayuksaru albaabu aam yuftahu qaala qultu laa bal yuksaru ‏.‏ qaala dhalika aahraa aan laa yughlaqa aabadana ‏.‏ qaala faqulnaa lihudhayfaaa hal kaana 'umaru ya'lamu mani albaabu qaala na'am kamaa ya'lamu aanna duwna ghadin alllaylaaa iinniy haddathtuhu hadiythana laysa bialaaghaaliyti ‏.‏ qaala fahibnaa aan nasaala hudhayfaaa mani albaabu faqulnaa limasruwqin salhu fasaaalahu faqaala 'umaru ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported:We were one day in the company of 'Umar that he said: Who amongst you has preserved in his mind most perfectly the hadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in regard to the turmoil as he told about it? I said: It is I. Thereupon he said: You are bold (enough to make this claim). And he further said: How? I said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: There would (first) be turmoil for a person in regard to his family, his property, his own self, his children, his neighbours (and the sins committed in their connection) would be expiated by fasting, prayer, charity, enjoining good and prohibiting evil. Thereupon 'Umar said: I do not mean (that turmoil on a small scale) but that one which would emerge like the mounting waves of the ocean. I said: Commander of the Faithful, you have nothing to do with it, for the door is closed between you and that. He said: Would that door be broken or opened? I said: No, it would be broken. Thereupon he said: Then it would not be closed despite best efforts. We said to Hudhaifa: Did Umar know the door? Thereupon he said: Yes, he knew it (for certain) just as one knows that night precedes the next day. And I narrated to him something in which there was nothing fabricated.
