Shaqiq (one of the narrators) said: We dared not ask Hudhaifa about that door. So we requested Masruq to ask him. So he asked him and he said: (By that door, he meant) 'Umar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَأَبُو سَعِيدٍ الأَشَجُّ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عِيسَى بْنُ يُونُسَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ عِيسَى، كُلُّهُمْ عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ أَبِي مُعَاوِيَةَ وَفِي حَدِيثِ عِيسَى عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ حُذَيْفَةَ، يَقُولُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waaabuw sa'iydin alaashajju qaalaa haddathanaa wakiy'un, h wahaddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa jariyrun, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, aakhbaranaa 'iysaa bnu yuwnusa, h wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa yahyaa bnu 'iysaa, kulluhum 'ani alaa'mashi, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwa hadiythi aabiy mu'aawiyaaa wafiy hadiythi 'iysaa 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, qaala sami'tu hudhayfaaa, yaquwlu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Hudhaifa through other chains of transmitters also
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنْ جَامِعِ بْنِ أَبِي رَاشِدٍ، وَالأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ مَنْ يُحَدِّثُنَا عَنِ الْفِتْنَةِ، وَاقْتَصَّ الْحَدِيثَ، بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara, haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'an jaami'i bni aabiy raashidin, waalaa'mashu, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala qaala 'umaru man yuhaddithunaa 'ani alfitnaai, waaqtassa alhadiytha, binahwi hadiythihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported that Umar said:Who would narrate to us (the ahadith pertaining to turmoil) and he reported a hadith similar to these ahadith
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، عَوْنٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ جُنْدُبٌ جِئْتُ يَوْمَ الْجَرَعَةِ فَإِذَا رَجُلٌ جَالِسٌ فَقُلْتُ لَيُهَرَاقَنَّ الْيَوْمَ هَا هُنَا دِمَاءٌ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ذَاكَ الرَّجُلُ كَلاَّ وَاللَّهِ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلَى وَاللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَلاَّ وَاللَّهِ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلَى وَاللَّهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ كَلاَّ وَاللَّهِ إِنَّهُ لَحَدِيثُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم حَدَّثَنِيهِ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ بِئْسَ الْجَلِيسُ لِي أَنْتَ مُنْذُ الْيَوْمِ تَسْمَعُنِي أُخَالِفُكَ وَقَدْ سَمِعْتَهُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلاَ تَنْهَانِي ثُمَّ قُلْتُ مَا هَذَا الْغَضَبُ فَأَقْبَلْتُ عَلَيْهِ وَأَسْأَلُهُ فَإِذَا الرَّجُلُ حُذَيْفَةُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu haatimin, qaalaa haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu mu'aadhin, haddathanaa abnu, 'awnin 'an muhammadin, qaala qaala jundubun jiitu yawma aljara'aai faiidhaa rajulun jaalisun faqultu layuharaaqanna alyawma haa hunaa dimaa'un ‏.‏ faqaala dhaaka alrrajulu kalaaa waalllahi ‏.‏ qultu balaa waalllahi ‏.‏ qaala kalaaa waalllahi ‏.‏ qultu balaa waalllahi ‏.‏ qaala kalaaa waalllahi iinnahu lahadiythu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm haddathaniyhi ‏.‏ qultu biisa aljaliysu liy aanta mundhu alyawmi tasma'uniy aukhaalifuka waqad sami'tahu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm falaa tanhaaniy thumma qultu maa hadhaa alghadabu faaaqbaltu 'alayhi waaasaaluhu faiidhaa alrrajulu hudhayfaau ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jundub reported:I came on the day of Jara`a that a person was (found) sitting. I said: They would shed their blood today. That person said: By Allah. not at all. I said: By Allah, of course, they would do it. He said: By Allah, they would not do it. I said: By Allah, of course, they would do it. He said: By Allah, they would not do it, and I have heard a hadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) which I am narrating to you in this connection. I said: You are a bad seat fellow. I have been opposing you since morning and you are listening to me in spite of the fact that you have heard a hadith from Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) (contrary to my statement). I myself felt that there was no use of this annoyance. (He could tell me earlier that it was a hadith of the Prophet (may peace be upon him], and I would not have opposed him at all.) I turned my face toward him and asked him and he was Hadrat Hudhaifa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الْقَارِيَّ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَحْسِرَ الْفُرَاتُ عَنْ جَبَلٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ يَقْتَتِلُ النَّاسُ عَلَيْهِ فَيُقْتَلُ مِنْ كُلِّ مِائَةٍ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ وَيَقُولُ كُلُّ رَجُلٍ مِنْهُمْ لَعَلِّي أَكُونُ أَنَا الَّذِي أَنْجُو ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani alqaariyya - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yahsira alfuraatu 'an jabalin min dhahabin yaqtatilu alnnaasu 'alayhi fayuqtalu min kulli miaiaain tis'aaun watis'uwna wayaquwlu kullu rajulin minhum la'alliy aakuwnu aanaa alladhiy aanjuw ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Last Hour would not come before the Euphrates uncovers a mountain of gold, for which people would fight. Ninety-nine out of each one hundred would die but every man amongst them would say that perhaps he would be the one who would be saved (and thus possess this gold)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أُمَيَّةُ بْنُ بِسْطَامَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ زُرَيْعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ وَزَادَ فَقَالَ أَبِي إِنْ رَأَيْتَهُ فَلاَ تَقْرَبَنَّهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy aumayyaau bnu bistaama, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu zuray'in, haddathanaa rawhun, 'an suhaylin, bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu wazaada faqaala aabiy iin raaaytahu falaa taqrabannahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Suhail with the same chain of transmitters but with this addition:" My father said: If you see that, do not even go near it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ، سَهْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ السَّكُونِيُّ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ، اللَّهِ عَنْ خُبَيْبِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ، عَنْ حَفْصِ بْنِ عَاصِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُوشِكُ الْفُرَاتُ أَنْ يَحْسِرَ عَنْ كَنْزٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَمَنْ حَضَرَهُ فَلاَ يَأْخُذْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw mas'uwdin, sahlu bnu 'uthmaana haddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu khaalidin alssakuwniyyu, 'an 'ubaydi, alllahi 'an khubaybi bni 'abdi alrrahmani, 'an hafsi bni 'aasimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yuwshiku alfuraatu aan yahsira 'an kanzin min dhahabin faman hadarahu falaa yaakhudh minhu shayiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Last Hour would not come unless the Euphrates would uncover a treasure of gold, so he who finds it should not take anything out of that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا سَهْلُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ، حَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ خَالِدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُوشِكُ الْفُرَاتُ أَنْ يَحْسِرَ عَنْ جَبَلٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَمَنْ حَضَرَهُ فَلاَ يَأْخُذْ مِنْهُ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa sahlu bnu 'uthmaana, haddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu khaalidin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yuwshiku alfuraatu aan yahsira 'an jabalin min dhahabin faman hadarahu falaa yaakhudh minhu shayiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Euphrates would soon uncover a mountain of gold but he who is present there should not take anything from that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ، فُضَيْلُ بْنُ حُسَيْنٍ وَأَبُو مَعْنٍ الرَّقَاشِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي مَعْنٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ سُلَيْمَانَ بْنِ، يَسَارٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ وَاقِفًا مَعَ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ فَقَالَ لاَ يَزَالُ النَّاسُ مُخْتَلِفَةً أَعْنَاقُهُمْ فِي طَلَبِ الدُّنْيَا ‏.‏ قُلْتُ أَجَلْ ‏.‏ قَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ يُوشِكُ الْفُرَاتُ أَنْ يَحْسِرَ عَنْ جَبَلٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ فَإِذَا سَمِعَ بِهِ النَّاسُ سَارُوا إِلَيْهِ فَيَقُولُ مَنْ عِنْدَهُ لَئِنْ تَرَكْنَا النَّاسَ يَأْخُذُونَ مِنْهُ لَيُذْهَبَنَّ بِهِ كُلِّهِ قَالَ فَيَقْتَتِلُونَ عَلَيْهِ فَيُقْتَلُ مِنْ كُلِّ مِائَةٍ تِسْعَةٌ وَتِسْعُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو كَامِلٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ قَالَ وَقَفْتُ أَنَا وَأُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ فِي ظِلِّ أُجُمِ حَسَّانَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin, fudaylu bnu husaynin waaabuw ma'nin alrraqaashiyyu - waalllafzu laabiy ma'nin - qaalaa haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi bnu ja'farin, aakhbaraniy aabiy, 'an sulaymaana bni, yasaarin 'an 'abdi alllahi bni alhaarithi bni nawfalin, qaala kuntu waaqifana ma'a aubaaai bni ka'bin faqaala laa yazaalu alnnaasu mukhtalifaaan aa'naaquhum fiy talabi alddunyaa ‏.‏ qultu aajal ‏.‏ qaala iinniy sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ yuwshiku alfuraatu aan yahsira 'an jabalin min dhahabin faiidhaa sami'a bihi alnnaasu saaruwa iilayhi fayaquwlu man 'indahu laiin taraknaa alnnaasa yaakhudhuwna minhu layudhhabanna bihi kullihi qaala fayaqtatiluwna 'alayhi fayuqtalu min kulli miaiaain tis'aaun watis'uwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw kaamilin fiy hadiythihi qaala waqaftu aanaa waaubaaau bnu ka'bin fiy zilli aujumi hassaana ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Harith b. Naufal reported:I was standing along with Ubayy b. Ka`b and he said: The opinions of the people differ in regard to the achievement of worldly ends. I said: Yes, of course. Thereupon he said: I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Euphrates would soon uncover a mountain of gold and when the people would bear of it they would flock towards it but the people who would possess that (treasure) (would say): If we allow these persons to take out of it they would take away the whole of it. So they would fight and ninety-nine out of one hundred would be killed. Abu Kamil in his narration said: I and Ubayy b. Ka`b stood under the shade of the battlement of Hassan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ بْنُ يَعِيشَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُبَيْدٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى، بْنُ آدَمَ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ مَوْلَى خَالِدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي صَالِحٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَنَعَتِ الْعِرَاقُ دِرْهَمَهَا وَقَفِيزَهَا وَمَنَعَتِ الشَّأْمُ مُدْيَهَا وَدِينَارَهَا وَمَنَعَتْ مِصْرُ إِرْدَبَّهَا وَدِينَارَهَا وَعُدْتُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ بَدَأْتُمْ وَعُدْتُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ بَدَأْتُمْ وَعُدْتُمْ مِنْ حَيْثُ بَدَأْتُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ شَهِدَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ لَحْمُ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ وَدَمُهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu bnu ya'iysha, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu li'ubaydin - qaalaa haddathanaa yahyaa, bnu adama bni sulaymaana mawlaa khaalidi bni khaalidin haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an suhayli bni aabiy saalihin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ mana'ati al'iraaqu dirhamahaa waqafiyzahaa wamana'ati alshhaamu mudyahaa wadiynaarahaa wamana'at misru iirdabbahaa wadiynaarahaa wa'udtum min haythu badaatum wa'udtum min haythu badaatum wa'udtum min haythu badaatum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ shahida 'alaa dhalika lahmu aabiy hurayraaa wadamuhu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:Iraq would withhold its dirhams and qafiz; Syria would withhold its mudd and dinar and Egypt would withhold its irdab and dinar and you would recoil to that position from where you started and you would recoil to that position from where you started and you would recoil to that position from where you started, the flesh and blood of Abu Huraira would bear testimony to it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُعَلَّى بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ بِلاَلٍ، حَدَّثَنَا سُهَيْلٌ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَنْزِلَ الرُّومُ بِالأَعْمَاقِ أَوْ بِدَابِقَ فَيَخْرُجُ إِلَيْهِمْ جَيْشٌ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ مِنْ خِيَارِ أَهْلِ الأَرْضِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَإِذَا تَصَافُّوا قَالَتِ الرُّومُ خَلُّوا بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَ الَّذِينَ سَبَوْا مِنَّا نُقَاتِلْهُمْ ‏.‏ فَيَقُولُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ لاَ نُخَلِّي بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَ إِخْوَانِنَا ‏.‏ فَيُقَاتِلُونَهُمْ فَيَنْهَزِمُ ثُلُثٌ لاَ يَتُوبُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَبَدًا وَيُقْتَلُ ثُلُثُهُمْ أَفْضَلُ الشُّهَدَاءِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ وَيَفْتَتِحُ الثُّلُثُ لاَ يُفْتَنُونَ أَبَدًا فَيَفْتَتِحُونَ قُسْطُنْطِينِيَّةَ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ يَقْتَسِمُونَ الْغَنَائِمَ قَدْ عَلَّقُوا سُيُوفَهُمْ بِالزَّيْتُونِ إِذْ صَاحَ فِيهِمُ الشَّيْطَانُ إِنَّ الْمَسِيحَ قَدْ خَلَفَكُمْ فِي أَهْلِيكُمْ ‏.‏ فَيَخْرُجُونَ وَذَلِكَ بَاطِلٌ فَإِذَا جَاءُوا الشَّأْمَ خَرَجَ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ يُعِدُّونَ لِلْقِتَالِ يُسَوُّونَ الصُّفُوفَ إِذْ أُقِيمَتِ الصَّلاَةُ فَيَنْزِلُ عِيسَى ابْنُ مَرْيَمَ فَأَمَّهُمْ فَإِذَا رَآهُ عَدُوُّ اللَّهِ ذَابَ كَمَا يَذُوبُ الْمِلْحُ فِي الْمَاءِ فَلَوْ تَرَكَهُ لاَنْذَابَ حَتَّى يَهْلِكَ وَلَكِنْ يَقْتُلُهُ اللَّهُ بِيَدِهِ فَيُرِيهِمْ دَمَهُ فِي حَرْبَتِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa mu'allaa bnu mansuwrin, haddathanaa sulaymaanu bnu bilaalin, haddathanaa suhaylun, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yanzila alrruwmu bialaa'maaqi aaw bidaabiqa fayakhruju iilayhim jayshun mina almadiynaai min khiyaari aahli alaardi yawmaiidhin faiidhaa tasaaffuwa qaalati alrruwmu khalluwa baynanaa wabayna alladhiyna sabawa minnaa nuqaatilhum ‏.‏ fayaquwlu almuslimuwna laa waalllahi laa nukhalliy baynakum wabayna iikhwaaninaa ‏.‏ fayuqaatiluwnahum fayanhazimu thuluthun laa yatuwbu alllahu 'alayhim aabadana wayuqtalu thuluthuhum aafdalu alshhuhadaa'i 'inda alllahi wayaftatihu althhuluthu laa yuftanuwna aabadana fayaftatihuwna qustuntiyniyyaaa fabaynamaa hum yaqtasimuwna alghanaaiima qad 'allaquwa suyuwfahum bialzzaytuwni iidh saaha fiyhimu alshhaytaanu iinna almasiyha qad khalafakum fiy aahliykum ‏.‏ fayakhrujuwna wadhalika baatilun faiidhaa jaa'uwa alshhaama kharaja fabaynamaa hum yu'idduwna lilqitaali yusawwuwna alssufuwfa iidh auqiymati alssalaaau fayanzilu 'iysaa abnu maryama faaammahum faiidhaa raahu 'aduwwu alllahi dhaaba kamaa yadhuwbu almilhu fiy almaa'i falaw tarakahu laandhaaba hattaa yahlika walakin yaqtuluhu alllahu biyadihi fayuriyhim damahu fiy harbatihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Last Hour would not come until the Romans would land at al-A'maq or in Dabiq. An army consisting of the best (soldiers) of the people of the earth at that time will come from Medina (to counteract them). When they will arrange themselves in ranks, the Romans would say: Do not stand between us and those (Muslims) who took prisoners from amongst us. Let us fight with them; and the Muslims would say: Nay, by Allah, we would never get aside from you and from our brethren that you may fight them. They will then fight and a third (part) of the army would run away, whom Allah will never forgive. A third (part of the army) which would be constituted of excellent martyrs in Allah's eye, would be killed and the third who would never be put to trial would win and they would be conquerors of Constantinople. And as they would be busy in distributing the spoils of war (amongst themselves) after hanging their swords by the olive trees, the Satan would cry: The Dajjal has taken your place among your family. They would then come out, but it would be of no avail. And when they would come to Syria, he would come out while they would be still preparing themselves for battle drawing up the ranks. Certainly, the time of prayer shall come and then Jesus (peace be upon him) son of Mary would descend and would lead them. When the enemy of Allah would see him, it would (disappear) just as the salt dissolves itself in water and if he (Jesus) were not to confront them at all, even then it would dissolve completely, but Allah would kill them by his hand and he would show them their blood on his lance (the lance of Jesus Christ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي اللَّيْثُ، بْنُ سَعْدٍ حَدَّثَنِي مُوسَى بْنُ عُلَىٍّ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ قَالَ الْمُسْتَوْرِدُ الْقُرَشِيُّ عِنْدَ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْعَاصِ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ وَالرُّومُ أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ عَمْرٌو أَبْصِرْ مَا تَقُولُ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَقُولُ مَا سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ إِنَّ فِيهِمْ لَخِصَالاً أَرْبَعًا إِنَّهُمْ لأَحْلَمُ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ فِتْنَةٍ وَأَسْرَعُهُمْ إِفَاقَةً بَعْدَ مُصِيبَةٍ وَأَوْشَكُهُمْ كَرَّةً بَعْدَ فَرَّةٍ وَخَيْرُهُمْ لِمِسْكِينٍ وَيَتِيمٍ وَضَعِيفٍ وَخَامِسَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ جَمِيلَةٌ وَأَمْنَعُهُمْ مِنْ ظُلْمِ الْمُلُوكِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathaniy 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy alllaythu, bnu sa'din haddathaniy muwsaa bnu 'ulaaain, 'an aabiyhi, qaala qaala almustawridu alqurashiyyu 'inda 'amriw bni al'aasi sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ taquwmu alssaa'aau waalrruwmu aaktharu alnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala lahu 'amrunw aabsir maa taquwlu ‏.‏ qaala aaquwlu maa sami'tu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala laiin qulta dhalika iinna fiyhim lakhisaalaan aarba'ana iinnahum laahlamu alnnaasi 'inda fitnaain waaasra'uhum iifaaqaaan ba'da musiybaain waaawshakuhum karraaan ba'da farraain wakhayruhum limiskiynin wayatiymin wada'iyfin wakhaamisaaun hasanaaun jamiylaaun waaamna'uhum min zulmi almuluwki ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mustaurid al-Qurashi reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would come (when) the Romans would form a majority amongst people. 'Amr said to him (Mustaurid Qurashi): See what you are saying? He said: I say what I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Thereupon he said: If you say that, it is a fact for they have four qualities. They have the patience to undergo a trial and immediately restore themselves to sanity after trouble and attack again after flight. They (have the quality) of being good to the destitute and the orphans, to the weak and, fifthly, the good quality in them is that they put resistance against the oppression of kings
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى التُّجِيبِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ وَهْبٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو شُرَيْحٍ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ الْكَرِيمِ بْنَ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَهُ أَنَّ الْمُسْتَوْرِدَ الْقُرَشِيَّ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ وَالرُّومُ أَكْثَرُ النَّاسِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَبَلَغَ ذَلِكَ عَمْرَو بْنَ الْعَاصِ فَقَالَ مَا هَذِهِ الأَحَادِيثُ الَّتِي تُذْكَرُ عَنْكَ أَنَّكَ تَقُولُهَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ لَهُ الْمُسْتَوْرِدُ قُلْتُ الَّذِي سَمِعْتُ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ فَقَالَ عَمْرٌو لَئِنْ قُلْتَ ذَلِكَ إِنَّهُمْ لأَحْلَمُ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ فِتْنَةٍ وَأَجْبَرُ النَّاسِ عِنْدَ مُصِيبَةٍ وَخَيْرُ النَّاسِ لِمَسَاكِينِهِمْ وَضُعَفَائِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa alttujiybiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu wahbin, haddathaniy aabuw shurayhin, aanna 'abda alkariymi bna alhaarithi, haddathahu aanna almustawrida alqurashiyya qaala sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏ "‏ taquwmu alssaa'aau waalrruwmu aaktharu alnnaasi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala fabalagha dhalika 'amraw bna al'aasi faqaala maa hadhihi alaahaadiythu allatiy tudhkaru 'anka aannaka taquwluhaa 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm faqaala lahu almustawridu qultu alladhiy sami'tu min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala faqaala 'amrunw laiin qulta dhalika iinnahum laahlamu alnnaasi 'inda fitnaain waaajbaru alnnaasi 'inda musiybaain wakhayru alnnaasi limasaakiynihim wadu'afaaiihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Mustaurid Qurashi reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The Last Hour would come when the Romans would form a majority amongst people. This reached 'Amr b. al-'As and he said: What are these ahadith which are being transmitted from you and which you claim to have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ)? Mustaurid said to him: I stated only that which I heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). Thereupon 'Amr said: If you state this (it is true), for they have the power of tolerance amongst people at the time of turmoil and restore themselves to sanity after trouble, and are good amongst people so far as the destitute and the weak are concerned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ حُجْرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، الْعَدَوِيِّ عَنْ يُسَيْرِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ هَاجَتْ رِيحٌ حَمْرَاءُ بِالْكُوفَةِ فَجَاءَ رَجُلٌ لَيْسَ لَهُ هِجِّيرَى إِلاَّ يَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ مَسْعُودٍ جَاءَتِ السَّاعَةُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَعَدَ وَكَانَ مُتَّكِئًا فَقَالَ إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لاَ تَقُومُ حَتَّى لاَ يُقْسَمَ مِيرَاثٌ وَلاَ يُفْرَحَ بِغَنِيمَةٍ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ بِيَدِهِ هَكَذَا - وَنَحَّاهَا نَحْوَ الشَّأْمِ - فَقَالَ عَدُوٌّ يَجْمَعُونَ لأَهْلِ الإِسْلاَمِ وَيَجْمَعُ لَهُمْ أَهْلُ الإِسْلاَمِ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ الرُّومَ تَعْنِي قَالَ نَعَمْ وَتَكُونُ عِنْدَ ذَاكُمُ الْقِتَالِ رَدَّةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فَيَشْتَرِطُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ شُرْطَةً لِلْمَوْتِ لاَ تَرْجِعُ إِلاَّ غَالِبَةً فَيَقْتَتِلُونَ حَتَّى يَحْجُزَ بَيْنَهُمُ اللَّيْلُ فَيَفِيءُ هَؤُلاَءِ وَهَؤُلاَءِ كُلٌّ غَيْرُ غَالِبٍ وَتَفْنَى الشُّرْطَةُ ثُمَّ يَشْتَرِطُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ شُرْطَةً لِلْمَوْتِ لاَ تَرْجِعُ إِلاَّ غَالِبَةً فَيَقْتَتِلُونَ حَتَّى يَحْجُزَ بَيْنَهُمُ اللَّيْلُ فَيَفِيءُ هَؤُلاَءِ وَهَؤُلاَءِ كُلٌّ غَيْرُ غَالِبٍ وَتَفْنَى الشُّرْطَةُ ثُمَّ يَشْتَرِطُ الْمُسْلِمُونَ شُرْطَةً لِلْمَوْتِ لاَ تَرْجِعُ إِلاَّ غَالِبَةً فَيَقْتَتِلُونَ حَتَّى يُمْسُوا فَيَفِيءُ هَؤُلاَءِ وَهَؤُلاَءِ كُلٌّ غَيْرُ غَالِبٍ وَتَفْنَى الشُّرْطَةُ فَإِذَا كَانَ يَوْمُ الرَّابِعِ نَهَدَ إِلَيْهِمْ بَقِيَّةُ أَهْلِ الإِسْلاَمِ فَيَجْعَلُ اللَّهُ الدَّبْرَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ فَيَقْتُلُونَ مَقْتَلَةً - إِمَّا قَالَ لاَ يُرَى مِثْلُهَا وَإِمَّا قَالَ لَمْ يُرَ مِثْلُهَا - حَتَّى إِنَّ الطَّائِرَ لَيَمُرُّ بِجَنَبَاتِهِمْ فَمَا يُخَلِّفُهُمْ حَتَّى يَخِرَّ مَيْتًا فَيَتَعَادُّ بَنُو الأَبِ كَانُوا مِائَةً فَلاَ يَجِدُونَهُ بَقِيَ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ الرَّجُلُ الْوَاحِدُ فَبِأَىِّ غَنِيمَةٍ يُفْرَحُ أَوْ أَىُّ مِيرَاثٍ يُقَاسَمُ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ كَذَلِكَ إِذْ سَمِعُوا بِبَأْسٍ هُوَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَجَاءَهُمُ الصَّرِيخُ إِنَّ الدَّجَّالَ قَدْ خَلَفَهُمْ فِي ذَرَارِيِّهِمْ فَيَرْفُضُونَ مَا فِي أَيْدِيهِمْ وَيُقْبِلُونَ فَيَبْعَثُونَ عَشَرَةَ فَوَارِسَ طَلِيعَةً ‏.‏ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُ أَسْمَاءَهُمْ وَأَسْمَاءَ آبَائِهِمْ وَأَلْوَانَ خُيُولِهِمْ هُمْ خَيْرُ فَوَارِسَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَوْ مِنْ خَيْرِ فَوَارِسَ عَلَى ظَهْرِ الأَرْضِ يَوْمَئِذٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ أُسَيْرِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, kilaahumaa 'ani abni 'ulayyaaa, - waalllafzu laibni hujrin - haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'an aayyuwba, 'an humaydi bni hilaalin, 'an aabiy qataadaaa, al'adawiyyi 'an yusayri bni jaabirin, qaala haajat riyhun hamraa'u bialkuwfaai fajaa'a rajulun laysa lahu hijjiyraa iilaaa yaa 'abda alllahi bna mas'uwdin jaa'ati alssaa'aau ‏.‏ qaala faqa'ada wakaana muttakiiana faqaala iinna alssaa'aaa laa taquwmu hattaa laa yuqsama miyraathun walaa yufraha bighaniymaain ‏.‏ thumma qaala biyadihi hakadhaa - wanahhaahaa nahwa alshhaami - faqaala 'aduwwun yajma'uwna laahli aliislaami wayajma'u lahum aahlu aliislaami ‏.‏ qultu alrruwma ta'niy qaala na'am watakuwnu 'inda dhaakumu alqitaali raddaaun shadiydaaun fayashtaritu almuslimuwna shurtaaan lilmawti laa tarji'u iilaaa ghaalibaaan fayaqtatiluwna hattaa yahjuza baynahumu alllaylu fayafiy'u hauulaa'i wahauulaa'i kullun ghayru ghaalibin watafnaa alshhurtaau thumma yashtaritu almuslimuwna shurtaaan lilmawti laa tarji'u iilaaa ghaalibaaan fayaqtatiluwna hattaa yahjuza baynahumu alllaylu fayafiy'u hauulaa'i wahauulaa'i kullun ghayru ghaalibin watafnaa alshhurtaau thumma yashtaritu almuslimuwna shurtaaan lilmawti laa tarji'u iilaaa ghaalibaaan fayaqtatiluwna hattaa yumsuwa fayafiy'u hauulaa'i wahauulaa'i kullun ghayru ghaalibin watafnaa alshhurtaau faiidhaa kaana yawmu alrraabi'i nahada iilayhim baqiyyaau aahli aliislaami fayaj'alu alllahu alddabraaa 'alayhim fayaqtuluwna maqtalaaan - iimmaa qaala laa yuraa mithluhaa waiimmaa qaala lam yura mithluhaa - hattaa iinna alttaaiira layamurru bijanabaatihim famaa yukhallifuhum hattaa yakhirra maytana fayata'aaddu banuw alaabi kaanuwa miaiaaan falaa yajiduwnahu baqiya minhum iilaaa alrrajulu alwaahidu fabiaaaai ghaniymaain yufrahu aaw aaaau miyraathin yuqaasamu fabaynamaa hum kadhalika iidh sami'uwa bibaasin huwa aakbaru min dhalika fajaa'ahumu alssariykhu iinna alddajjaala qad khalafahum fiy dharaariyyihim fayarfuduwna maa fiy aaydiyhim wayuqbiluwna fayab'athuwna 'asharaaa fawaarisa taliy'aaan ‏.‏ qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ iinniy laa'rifu aasmaa'ahum waaasmaa'a abaaiihim waaalwaana khuyuwlihim hum khayru fawaarisa 'alaa zahri alaardi yawmaiidhin aaw min khayri fawaarisa 'alaa zahri alaardi yawmaiidhin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu aabiy shaybaaa fiy riwaayatihi 'an ausayri bni jaabirin ‏.‏
verses.translation: Yusair b. Jabir reported:Once there blew a red storm in Kufah that there came a person who had nothing to say but (these words): `Abdullah b. Mas`ud, the Last Hour has come. He (`Abdullah b. Mas`ud) was sitting reclining against something, and he said: The Last Hour would not come until shares of inheritance are not distributed and there is no rejoicing over spoils of war. Then he said pointing towards Syria, with the gesture of his hand like this: The enemy shall muster strength against Muslims and the Muslims will muster strength against them (Syrians). I said: You mean Rome? And he said: Yes, and there would be a terrible fight and the Muslims would prepare a detachment (for fighting unto death) which would not return but victorious. They will fight until night will intervene them; both the sides will return without being victorious and both will be wiped out. The Muslims will again prepare a detachment for fighting unto death so that they may not return but victorious. When it would be the fourth day, a new detachment out of the remnant of the Muslims would be prepared and Allah will decree that the enemy should be routed. And they would fight such a fight the like of which would not be seen, so much so that even if a bird were to pass their flanks, it would fall down dead before reaching the end of them. (There would be such a large scale massacre) that when counting would be done, (only) one out of a hundred men related to one another would be found alive. So what can be the joy at the spoils of such war and what inheritance would be divided! They would be in this very state that they would hear of a calamity more horrible than this. And a cry would reach them: The Dajjal has taken your place among your offspring. They will, therefore, throw away what would be in their hands and go forward sending ten horsemen, as a scouting party. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I know their names and the names of their forefathers and the color of their horses. They will be the best horsemen on the surface of the earth on that day or amongst the best horsemen on the surface of the earth on that day
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عُبَيْدٍ الْغُبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادُ بْنُ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ حُمَيْدِ بْنِ، هِلاَلٍ عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ يُسَيْرِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ ابْنِ مَسْعُودٍ فَهَبَّتْ رِيحٌ حَمْرَاءُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِنَحْوِهِ ‏.‏ وَحَدِيثُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ أَتَمُّ وَأَشْبَعُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'ubaydin alghubariyyu, haddathanaa hammaadu bnu zaydin, 'an aayyuwba, 'an humaydi bni, hilaalin 'an aabiy qataadaaa, 'an yusayri bni jaabirin, qaala kuntu 'inda abni mas'uwdin fahabbat riyhun hamraa'u ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha binahwihi ‏.‏ wahadiythu abnu 'ulayyaaa aatammu waaashba'u ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I was in the company of Ibn Mas'ud that there blew a red storm. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُلَيْمَانُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْمُغِيرَةِ - حَدَّثَنَا حُمَيْدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ هِلاَلٍ - عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ أُسَيْرِ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، قَالَ كُنْتُ فِي بَيْتِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مَسْعُودٍ وَالْبَيْتُ مَلآنُ - قَالَ - فَهَاجَتْ رِيحٌ حَمْرَاءُ بِالْكُوفَةِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa shaybaanu bnu farruwkha, haddathanaa sulaymaanu, - ya'niy abna almughiyraai - haddathanaa humaydun, - ya'niy abna hilaalin - 'an aabiy qataadaaa, 'an ausayri bni jaabirin, qaala kuntu fiy bayti 'abdi alllahi bni mas'uwdin waalbaytu malanu - qaala - fahaajat riyhun hamraa'u bialkuwfaai ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi abni 'ulayyaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir reported:I was in the house of 'Abdullah b. Mas'ud and the house was fully packed that a red storm blew in Kufah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ سَمُرَةَ، عَنْ نَافِعِ بْنِ عُتْبَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غَزْوَةٍ - قَالَ - فَأَتَى النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَوْمٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْمَغْرِبِ عَلَيْهِمْ ثِيَابُ الصُّوفِ فَوَافَقُوهُ عِنْدَ أَكَمَةٍ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَقِيَامٌ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَاعِدٌ - قَالَ - فَقَالَتْ لِي نَفْسِي ائْتِهِمْ فَقُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَهُ لاَ يَغْتَالُونَهُ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ قُلْتُ لَعَلَّهُ نَجِيٌّ مَعَهُمْ ‏.‏ فَأَتَيْتُهُمْ فَقُمْتُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَهُ - قَالَ - فَحَفِظْتُ مِنْهُ أَرْبَعَ كَلِمَاتٍ أَعُدُّهُنَّ فِي يَدِي قَالَ ‏ "‏ تَغْزُونَ جَزِيرَةَ الْعَرَبِ فَيَفْتَحُهَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ فَارِسَ فَيَفْتَحُهَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ تَغْزُونَ الرُّومَ فَيَفْتَحُهَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ تَغْزُونَ الدَّجَّالَ فَيَفْتَحُهُ اللَّهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ نَافِعٌ يَا جَابِرُ لاَ نَرَى الدَّجَّالَ يَخْرُجُ حَتَّى تُفْتَحَ الرُّومُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an jaabiri bni samuraaa, 'an naafi'i bni 'utbaaa, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghazwaain - qaala - faaataa alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qawmun min qibali almaghribi 'alayhim thiyaabu alssuwfi fawaafaquwhu 'inda aakamaain faiinnahum laqiyaamun warasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaa'idun - qaala - faqaalat liy nafsiy aitihim faqum baynahum wabaynahu laa yaghtaaluwnahu - qaala - thumma qultu la'allahu najiyyun ma'ahum ‏.‏ faaataytuhum faqumtu baynahum wabaynahu - qaala - fahafiztu minhu aarba'a kalimaatin aa'udduhunna fiy yadiy qaala ‏ "‏ taghzuwna jaziyraaa al'arabi fayaftahuhaa alllahu thumma faarisa fayaftahuhaa alllahu thumma taghzuwna alrruwma fayaftahuhaa alllahu thumma taghzuwna alddajjaala fayaftahuhu alllahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala faqaala naafi'un yaa jaabiru laa naraa alddajjaala yakhruju hattaa tuftaha alrruwmu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' b. Utba reported:We were with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in an expedition that there came a people to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) from the direction of the west. They were dressed in woollen clothes and they stood near a hillock and they met him as Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was sitting. I said to myself: Better go to them and stand between him and them that they may not attack him. Then I thought that perhaps there had been going on secret negotiation amongst them. I however, went to them and stood between them and him and I remember four of the words (on that occasion) which I repeat (on the fingers of my hand) that he (Allah's Messenger) said: You will attack Arabia and Allah will enable you to conquer it, then you would attack Persia and He would make you to conquer it. Then you would attack Rome and Allah will enable you to conquer it, then you would attack the Dajjal and Allah will enable you to conquer him. Nafi' said: Jabir, we thought that the Dajjal would appear after Rome (Syrian territory) would be conquered
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ فُرَاتٍ، الْقَزَّازِ عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ الْغِفَارِيِّ، قَالَ اطَّلَعَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَيْنَا وَنَحْنُ نَتَذَاكَرُ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا تَذَاكَرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا نَذْكُرُ السَّاعَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا لَنْ تَقُومَ حَتَّى تَرَوْنَ قَبْلَهَا عَشْرَ آيَاتٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ الدُّخَانَ وَالدَّجَّالَ وَالدَّابَّةَ وَطُلُوعَ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا وَنُزُولَ عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَيَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ وَثَلاَثَةَ خُسُوفٍ خَسْفٌ بِالْمَشْرِقِ وَخَسْفٌ بِالْمَغْرِبِ وَخَسْفٌ بِجَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَآخِرُ ذَلِكَ نَارٌ تَخْرُجُ مِنَ الْيَمَنِ تَطْرُدُ النَّاسَ إِلَى مَحْشَرِهِمْ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw khaythamaaa, zuhayru bnu harbin waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma waabnu aabiy 'umara almakkiyyu - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an furaatin, alqazzaazi 'an aabiy alttufayli, 'an hudhayfaaa bni aasiydin alghifaariyyi, qaala attala'a alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm 'alaynaa wanahnu natadhaakaru faqaala ‏"‏ maa tadhaakaruwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa nadhkuru alssaa'aaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinnahaa lan taquwma hattaa tarawna qablahaa 'ashra ayaatin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fadhakara alddukhaana waalddajjaala waalddaabbaaa watuluw'a alshhamsi min maghribihaa wanuzuwla 'iysaa abni maryama sla allh 'lyh wslm wayaajuwja wamaajuwja wathalaathaaa khusuwfin khasfun bialmashriqi wakhasfun bialmaghribi wakhasfun bijaziyraai al'arabi waakhiru dhalika naarun takhruju mina alyamani tatrudu alnnaasa iilaa mahsharihim ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa b. Usaid al-Ghifari reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came to us all of a sudden as we were (busy in a discussion). He said: What do you discuss about? They (the Companions) said. We are discussing about the Last Hour. Thereupon he said: It will not come until you see ten signs before and (in this connection) he made a mention of the smoke, Dajjal, the beast, the rising of the sun from the west, the descent of Jesus son of Mary (Allah be pleased with him), the Gog and Magog, and land-slides in three places, one in the east, one in the west and one in Arabia at the end of which fire would burn forth from the Yemen, and would drive people to the place of their assembly
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ فُرَاتٍ الْقَزَّازِ، عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَرِيحَةَ، حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ أَسِيدٍ قَالَ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غُرْفَةٍ وَنَحْنُ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُ فَاطَّلَعَ إِلَيْنَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا تَذْكُرُونَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا السَّاعَةَ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ السَّاعَةَ لاَ تَكُونُ حَتَّى تَكُونَ عَشْرُ آيَاتٍ خَسْفٌ بِالْمَشْرِقِ وَخَسْفٌ بِالْمَغْرِبِ وَخَسْفٌ فِي جَزِيرَةِ الْعَرَبِ وَالدُّخَانُ وَالدَّجَّالُ وَدَابَّةُ الأَرْضِ وَيَأْجُوجُ وَمَأْجُوجُ وَطُلُوعُ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا وَنَارٌ تَخْرُجُ مِنْ قُعْرَةِ عَدَنٍ تَرْحَلُ النَّاسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ بْنُ رُفَيْعٍ عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي سَرِيحَةَ ‏.‏ مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ لاَ يَذْكُرُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ أَحَدُهُمَا فِي الْعَاشِرَةِ نُزُولُ عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ وَرِيحٌ تُلْقِي النَّاسَ فِي الْبَحْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an furaatin alqazzaazi, 'an aabiy alttufayli, 'an aabiy sariyhaaa, hudhayfaaa bni aasiydin qaala kaana alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghurfaain wanahnu aasfala minhu faattala'a iilaynaa faqaala ‏"‏ maa tadhkuruwna ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa alssaa'aaa ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ iinna alssaa'aaa laa takuwnu hattaa takuwna 'ashru ayaatin khasfun bialmashriqi wakhasfun bialmaghribi wakhasfun fiy jaziyraai al'arabi waalddukhaanu waalddajjaalu wadaabbaau alaardi wayaajuwju wamaajuwju watuluw'u alshhamsi min maghribihaa wanaarun takhruju min qu'raai 'adanin tarhalu alnnaasa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau wahaddathaniy 'abdu al'aziyzi bnu rufay'in 'an aabiy alttufayli 'an aabiy sariyhaaa ‏.‏ mithla dhalika laa yadhkuru alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala aahaduhumaa fiy al'aashiraai nuzuwlu 'iysaa abni maryama sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ waqaala alakharu wariyhun tulqiy alnnaasa fiy albahri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa b. Usaid reported:Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) was in an apartment and we were beneath that, that he peeped in and said to us: What are you discussing about? We said: (We are discussing about the Last) Hour. Thereupon he said: The Last Hour would not come until the ten signs appear: land-sliding in the east, and land-sliding in the west, and land-sliding in the peninsula of Arabia, the smoke, the Dajjal, the beast of the earth, Gog and Magog, the rising of the sun from the west and the fire which would emit from the lower part of 'Adan. Shu'ba said that 'Abd al-'Aziz b. Rufai' reported on the authority of Abu Tufail who reported on the authority of Abu Sariha a hadith like this that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not make a mention of (the tenth sign) but he said that out of the ten one was the descent of Jesus, son of Mary (peace be upon him), and in another version it is the blowing of the violent gale which would drive the people to the ocean
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ جَعْفَرٍ - حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ فُرَاتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَرِيحَةَ، قَالَ كَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي غُرْفَةٍ وَنَحْنُ تَحْتَهَا نَتَحَدَّثُ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَأَحْسِبُهُ قَالَ تَنْزِلُ مَعَهُمْ إِذَا نَزَلُوا وَتَقِيلُ مَعَهُمْ حَيْثُ قَالُوا ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَحَدَّثَنِي رَجُلٌ هَذَا الْحَدِيثَ عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ عَنْ أَبِي سَرِيحَةَ وَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ قَالَ أَحَدُ هَذَيْنِ الرَّجُلَيْنِ نُزُولُ عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَقَالَ الآخَرُ رِيحٌ تُلْقِيهِمْ فِي الْبَحْرِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu bashhaarin, haddathanaa muhammadun, - ya'niy abna ja'farin - haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an furaatin, qaala sami'tu aabaa alttufayli, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy sariyhaaa, qaala kaana rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy ghurfaain wanahnu tahtahaa natahaddathu ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bimithlihi ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau waaahsibuhu qaala tanzilu ma'ahum iidhaa nazaluwa wataqiylu ma'ahum haythu qaaluwa ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau wahaddathaniy rajulun hadhaa alhadiytha 'an aabiy alttufayli 'an aabiy sariyhaaa walam yarfa'hu qaala aahadu hadhayni alrrajulayni nuzuwlu 'iysaa abni maryama waqaala alakharu riyhun tulqiyhim fiy albahri ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sariha reported:Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) was in an (upper) apartment and we were standing lower to him and discussing (about the Last Hour). The rest of the hadith is the same, and Shu'ba said: I think he also said these words: The fire would descend along with them where they would land and where they would take rest (during midday (it would also cool down for a while). Shu'ba said: This hadith has been transmitted to me through Abu Tufail and Abu Sariha and none could trace it back directly to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ). However, there is a mention of the descent of Jesus Christ son of Mary in one version and in the other there is a mention of the blowing of a violent gale which would drive them to the ocean
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْعِجْلِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ فُرَاتٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا الطُّفَيْلِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَرِيحَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَتَحَدَّثُ فَأَشْرَفَ عَلَيْنَا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ بِنَحْوِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ وَابْنِ جَعْفَرٍ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو النُّعْمَانِ الْحَكَمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَبْدِ، الْعَزِيزِ بْنِ رُفَيْعٍ عَنْ أَبِي الطُّفَيْلِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَرِيحَةَ، بِنَحْوِهِ قَالَ وَالْعَاشِرَةُ نُزُولُ عِيسَى ابْنِ مَرْيَمَ ‏.‏ قَالَ شُعْبَةُ وَلَمْ يَرْفَعْهُ عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani alhakamu bnu 'abdi alllahi al'ijliyyu, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an furaatin, qaala sami'tu aabaa alttufayli, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy sariyhaaa, qaala kunnaa natahaddathu faaashrafa 'alaynaa rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ binahwi hadiythi mu'aadhin waabni ja'farin ‏.‏ waqaala abnu almuthannaa haddathanaa aabuw alnnu'maani alhakamu bnu 'abdi alllahi, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an 'abdi, al'aziyzi bni rufay'in 'an aabiy alttufayli, 'an aabiy sariyhaaa, binahwihi qaala waal'aashiraau nuzuwlu 'iysaa abni maryama ‏.‏ qaala shu'baau walam yarfa'hu 'abdu al'aziyzi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Another chain of transmitters reports the like of the previous two chains. Abu Sariha reported:We were discussing (the Last Hour) that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) looked towards us. The rest of the hadith is the same and the tenth (sign) was the descent of Jesus Christ son of Mary, and Shu'ba said: 'Abd al-'Aziz did not trace it directly to Allah's Apostle (ﷺ)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ح وَحَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي عُقَيْلُ بْنُ، خَالِدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تَخْرُجَ نَارٌ مِنْ أَرْضِ الْحِجَازِ تُضِيءُ أَعْنَاقَ الإِبِلِ بِبُصْرَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy abnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, aakhbarahu aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala h wahaddathaniy 'abdu almaliki bnu shu'aybi bni alllaythi, haddathanaa aabiy, 'an jaddiy, haddathaniy 'uqaylu bnu, khaalidin 'ani abni shihaabin, aannahu qaala qaala abnu almusayyabi aakhbaraniy aabuw hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa takhruja naarun min aardi alhijaazi tudiy'u aa'naaqa aliibili bibusraa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:The Last Hour would not come until fire emits from the earth of Hijaz which would illuminate the necks of the camels of the Busra
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَسْوَدُ بْنُ عَامِرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرٌ، عَنْ سُهَيْلِ بْنِ أَبِي، صَالِحٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَبْلُغُ الْمَسَاكِنُ إِهَابَ أَوْ يَهَابَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ زُهَيْرٌ قُلْتُ لِسُهَيْلٍ فَكَمْ ذَلِكَ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ قَالَ كَذَا وَكَذَا مِيلاً ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, haddathanaa alaaswadu bnu 'aamirin, haddathanaa zuhayrun, 'an suhayli bni aabiy, saalihin 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tablughu almasaakinu iihaaba aaw yahaaba ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala zuhayrun qultu lisuhaylin fakam dhalika mina almadiynaai qaala kadhaa wakadhaa miylaan ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:(The Last Hour would not come) until the habitations of Medina would extend to Ihab or Yahab. Zubair said: I said to Suhail how far these were from Medina. He said: So and so miles
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لَيْسَتِ السَّنَةُ بِأَنْ لاَ تُمْطَرُوا وَلَكِنِ السَّنَةُ أَنْ تُمْطَرُوا وَتُمْطَرُوا وَلاَ تُنْبِتُ الأَرْضُ شَيْئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laysati alssanaau biaan laa tumtaruwa walakini alssanaau aan tumtaruwa watumtaruwa walaa tunbitu alaardu shayiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The famine would not break out because of drought, but there would be famine despite heavy rainfall as nothing would grow from the earth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا لَيْثٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رُمْحٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا اللَّيْثُ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُسْتَقْبِلُ الْمَشْرِقِ يَقُولُ ‏ "‏ أَلاَ إِنَّ الْفِتْنَةَ هَا هُنَا أَلاَ إِنَّ الْفِتْنَةَ هَا هُنَا مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa laythun, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu rumhin, aakhbaranaa alllaythu, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aannahu sami'a rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa mustaqbilu almashriqi yaquwlu ‏ "‏ aalaa iinna alfitnaaa haa hunaa aalaa iinna alfitnaaa haa hunaa min haythu yatlu'u qarnu alshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying (in a state) that he had turned his face towards the east:Behold, turmoil would appear from this side, from where the horns of Satan would appear
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ، سَعِيدٍ كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ يَحْيَى الْقَطَّانِ، قَالَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، عُمَرَ حَدَّثَنِي نَافِعٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَامَ عِنْدَ بَابِ حَفْصَةَ فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ نَحْوَ الْمَشْرِقِ ‏ "‏ الْفِتْنَةُ هَا هُنَا مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَهَا مَرَّتَيْنِ أَوْ ثَلاَثًا ‏.‏ وَقَالَ عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ قَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عِنْدَ بَابِ عَائِشَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wahaddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu, sa'iydin kulluhum 'an yahyaa alqattaani, qaala alqawaariyriyyu haddathaniy yahyaa bnu sa'iydin, 'an 'ubaydi alllahi bni, 'umara haddathaniy naafi'un, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaama 'inda baabi hafsaaa faqaala biyadihi nahwa almashriqi ‏ "‏ alfitnaau haa hunaa min haythu yatlu'u qarnu alshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaalahaa marratayni aaw thalaathana ‏.‏ waqaala 'ubaydu alllahi bnu sa'iydin fiy riwaayatihi qaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm 'inda baabi 'aaiishaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn `Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood by the door (of the apartment of) Hafsa and, pointing towards the east, he said:The turmoil would appear from this side, viz. where the horns of Satan would appear, and he uttered these words twice or thrice and `Ubaidullah b. Sa`id in his narration said: The Messenger of Allah (ﷺ) had been standing by the door of `A'isha
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ وَهُوَ مُسْتَقْبِلُ الْمَشْرِقِ ‏ "‏ هَا إِنَّ الْفِتْنَةَ هَا هُنَا هَا إِنَّ الْفِتْنَةَ هَا هُنَا هَا إِنَّ الْفِتْنَةَ هَا هُنَا مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, 'an aabiyhi, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala wahuwa mustaqbilu almashriqi ‏ "‏ haa iinna alfitnaaa haa hunaa haa iinna alfitnaaa haa hunaa haa iinna alfitnaaa haa hunaa min haythu yatlu'u qarnu alshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Salim b. Abdullah reported on the authority of his father that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ), while turning his face towards the east, said:The turmoil would appear from this side; verily, the turmoil would appear from this side; verily, the turmoil would appear from this side - the side where appear the horns of Satan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، عَنْ عِكْرِمَةَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، قَالَ خَرَجَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنْ بَيْتِ عَائِشَةَ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ رَأْسُ الْكُفْرِ مِنْ هَا هُنَا مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنُ الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ يَعْنِي الْمَشْرِقَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: hadaathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, hadaathanaa wakiy'un, 'an 'ikrimaaa bni 'amaaarin, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, qaala kharaja rasuwlu allaahi sla allh 'lyh wslm min bayti 'aaiishaaa faqaala ‏ "‏ raasu alkufri min haa hunaa min haythu yatlu'u qarnu alshaaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ya'niy almashriqa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) came out from the house of 'Aisha and said:It would be from this side that there would appear the height of unbelief, viz. where appear the horns of Satan, i.e. the east
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ سُلَيْمَانَ - أَخْبَرَنَا حَنْظَلَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمًا، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يُشِيرُ بِيَدِهِ نَحْوَ الْمَشْرِقِ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ هَا إِنَّ الْفِتْنَةَ هَا هُنَا هَا إِنَّ الْفِتْنَةَ هَا هُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثَلاَثًا ‏"‏ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنَا الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, haddathanaa iishaaqu, - ya'niy abna sulaymaana - aakhbaranaa hanzalaau, qaala sami'tu saalimana, yaquwlu sami'tu abna 'umara, yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yushiyru biyadihi nahwa almashriqi wayaquwlu ‏"‏ haa iinna alfitnaaa haa hunaa haa iinna alfitnaaa haa hunaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thalaathana ‏"‏ haythu yatlu'u qarnaa alshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying while pointing his hands towards the east: The turmoil would appear from this side; verily, the turmoil would appear from this side (he repeated it thrice) where appear the horns of Satan
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبَانَ، وَوَاصِلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْوَكِيعِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبَانَ - قَالُوا حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ سَالِمَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، بْنِ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ يَا أَهْلَ الْعِرَاقِ مَا أَسْأَلَكُمْ عَنِ الصَّغِيرَةِ وَأَرْكَبَكُمْ لِلْكَبِيرَةِ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ يَقُولُ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّ الْفِتْنَةَ تَجِيءُ مِنْ هَا هُنَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَوْمَأَ بِيَدِهِ نَحْوَ الْمَشْرِقِ ‏"‏ مِنْ حَيْثُ يَطْلُعُ قَرْنَا الشَّيْطَانِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَنْتُمْ يَضْرِبُ بَعْضُكُمْ رِقَابَ بَعْضٍ وَإِنَّمَا قَتَلَ مُوسَى الَّذِي قَتَلَ مِنْ آلِ فِرْعَوْنَ خَطَأً فَقَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لَهُ ‏{‏ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَاكَ مِنَ الْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّاكَ فُتُونًا‏}‏ قَالَ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُمَرَ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ عَنْ سَالِمٍ لَمْ يَقُلْ سَمِعْتُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara bni aabaana, wawaasilu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, waaahmadu bnu 'umara alwakiy'iyyu, - waalllafzu laibni aabaana - qaaluwa haddathanaa abnu fudaylin, 'an aabiyhi, qaala sami'tu saalima bna 'abdi alllahi, bni 'umara yaquwlu yaa aahla al'iraaqi maa aasaalakum 'ani alssaghiyraai waaarkabakum lilkabiyraai sami'tu aabiy 'abda alllahi bna 'umara yaquwlu sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iinna alfitnaaa tajiy'u min haa hunaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaawmaaa biyadihi nahwa almashriqi ‏"‏ min haythu yatlu'u qarnaa alshhaytaani ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaantum yadribu ba'dukum riqaaba ba'din waiinnamaa qatala muwsaa alladhiy qatala min ali fir'awna khataaan faqaala alllahu 'azza wajalla lahu ‏{‏ waqatalta nafsana fanajjaynaaka mina alghammi wafatannaaka futuwnana‏}‏ qaala aahmadu bnu 'umara fiy riwaayatihi 'an saalimin lam yaqul sami'tu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Fudail reported on the authority of his father that he heard Salim b. `Abdullah b. `Umar as saying:O people of Iraq, how strange it is that you ask about the minor sins but commit major sins? I heard from my father `Abdullah b. `Umar, narrating that he heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying while pointing his hand towards the east: Verily, the turmoil would come from this side, from where appear the horns of Satan and you would strike the necks of one another; and Moses killed a person from among the people of Pharaoh unintentionally and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, said: "You killed a person but We relieved you from the grief and tried you with (many a) trial" (xx. 40). Ahmad b. `Umar reported this hadith from Salim, but he did not make a mention of the words: "I heard
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تَضْطَرِبَ أَلَيَاتُ نِسَاءِ دَوْسٍ حَوْلَ ذِي الْخَلَصَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَكَانَتْ صَنَمًا تَعْبُدُهَا دَوْسٌ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ بِتَبَالَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaala 'abdun aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'ani abni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa tadtariba aalayaatu nisaa'i dawsin hawla dhiy alkhalasaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wakaanat sanamana ta'buduhaa dawsun fiy aljaahiliyyaai bitabaalaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Last Hour would not come until the women of the tribe of Daus would be seen going round Dhi al-Khalasa (for worship) and Dhi al-Khalasa is a place in Tabala, where there was a temple in which the people of the tribe of Daus used to worship the idol
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، وَأَبُو مَعْنٍ زَيْدُ بْنُ يَزِيدَ الرَّقَاشِيُّ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي مَعْنٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، عَنِ الأَسْوَدِ بْنِ الْعَلاَءِ، عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ، عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، قَالَتْ سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَذْهَبُ اللَّيْلُ وَالنَّهَارُ حَتَّى تُعْبَدَ اللاَّتُ وَالْعُزَّى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنْ كُنْتُ لأَظُنُّ حِينَ أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ ‏{‏ هُوَ الَّذِي أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُ بِالْهُدَى وَدِينِ الْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُ عَلَى الدِّينِ كُلِّهِ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ‏}‏ أَنَّ ذَلِكَ تَامًّا قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ سَيَكُونُ مِنْ ذَلِكَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ رِيحًا طَيِّبَةً فَتَوَفَّى كُلَّ مَنْ فِي قَلْبِهِ مِثْقَالُ حَبَّةِ خَرْدَلٍ مِنْ إِيمَانٍ فَيَبْقَى مَنْ لاَ خَيْرَ فِيهِ فَيَرْجِعُونَ إِلَى دِينِ آبَائِهِمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kaamilin aljahdariyyu, waaabuw ma'nin zaydu bnu yaziyda alrraqaashiyyu - waalllafzu laabiy ma'nin - qaalaa haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, haddathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi bnu ja'farin, 'ani alaaswadi bni al'alaa'i, 'an aabiy salamaaa, 'an 'aaiishaaa, qaalat sami'tu rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa yadhhabu alllaylu waalnnahaaru hattaa tu'bada allaaatu waal'uzzaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqultu yaa rasuwla alllahi iin kuntu laazunnu hiyna aanzala alllahu ‏{‏ huwa alladhiy aarsala rasuwlahu bialhudaa wadiyni alhaqqi liyuzhirahu 'alaa alddiyni kullihi walaw kariha almushrikuwna‏}‏ aanna dhalika taammana qaala ‏"‏ iinnahu sayakuwnu min dhalika maa shaa'a alllahu thumma yab'athu alllahu riyhana tayyibaaan fatawaffaa kulla man fiy qalbihi mithqaalu habbaai khardalin min iiymaanin fayabqaa man laa khayra fiyhi fayarji'uwna iilaa diyni abaaiihim ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: A'isha reported:I heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: The (system) of night and day would not end until the people have taken to the worship of Lat and 'Uzza. I said: Allah's Messenger, I think when Allah has revealed this verse:" He it is Who has sent His Messenger with right guidance, and true religion, so that He may cause it to prevail upon all religions, though the polytheists are averse (to it)" (ix. 33), it implies that (this promise) is going to be fulfilled. Thereupon he (Allah's Apostle) said: It would happen as Allah would like. Then Allah would send the sweet fragrant air by which everyone who has even a mustard grain of faith in Him would die and those only would survive who would have no goodness in them. And they would revert to the religion of their forefathers
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرٍ، - وَهُوَ الْحَنَفِيُّ - حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaahu muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa aabuw bakrin, - wahuwa alhanafiyyu - haddathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi, bnu ja'farin bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn Ja'far with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ الْمَكِّيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا مَرْوَانُ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ كَيْسَانَ - عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَيَأْتِيَنَّ عَلَى النَّاسِ زَمَانٌ لاَ يَدْرِي الْقَاتِلُ فِي أَىِّ شَىْءٍ قَتَلَ وَلاَ يَدْرِي الْمَقْتُولُ عَلَى أَىِّ شَىْءٍ قُتِلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu aabiy 'umara almakkiyyu, haddathanaa marwaanu, 'an yaziyda, - wahuwa abnu kaysaana - 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi layaatiyanna 'alaa alnnaasi zamaanun laa yadriy alqaatilu fiy aaaai shaa'in qatala walaa yadriy almaqtuwlu 'alaa aaaai shaa'in qutila ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:By Him in Whose Hand is my life, a time would come when the murderer would not know why he has committed the murder, and the victim would not know why he has been killed
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ بْنِ أَبَانَ، وَوَاصِلُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ فُضَيْلٍ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ الأَسْلَمِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي حَازِمٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لاَ تَذْهَبُ الدُّنْيَا حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ عَلَى النَّاسِ يَوْمٌ لاَ يَدْرِي الْقَاتِلُ فِيمَ قَتَلَ وَلاَ الْمَقْتُولُ فِيمَ قُتِلَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقِيلَ كَيْفَ يَكُونُ ذَلِكَ قَالَ ‏"‏ الْهَرْجُ ‏.‏ الْقَاتِلُ وَالْمَقْتُولُ فِي النَّارِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ أَبَانَ قَالَ هُوَ يَزِيدُ بْنُ كَيْسَانَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ ‏.‏ لَمْ يَذْكُرِ الأَسْلَمِيَّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara bni aabaana, wawaasilu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu fudaylin 'an aabiy iismaa'iyla alaaslamiyyi, 'an aabiy haazimin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi laa tadhhabu alddunyaa hattaa yaatiya 'alaa alnnaasi yawmun laa yadriy alqaatilu fiyma qatala walaa almaqtuwlu fiyma qutila ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqiyla kayfa yakuwnu dhalika qaala ‏"‏ alharju ‏.‏ alqaatilu waalmaqtuwlu fiy alnnaari ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni aabaana qaala huwa yaziydu bnu kaysaana 'an aabiy iismaa'iyla ‏.‏ lam yadhkuri alaaslamiyya ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The world would not come to an end until a day would come to the people on which the murderer would not know as to why he has killed and the slain would not know as to why he has been murdered. It would be said: Why would It happen? To which he replied: It would be because of general massacre and bloodshed. And the slaughterers and the slain would be in Fire, and in the narration of Ibn Aban, the name of Abu Isma'il has been mentioned
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي بَكْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ زِيَادِ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، سَمِعَ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، يَقُولُ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُخَرِّبُ الْكَعْبَةَ ذُو السُّوَيْقَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْحَبَشَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu laabiy bakrin - qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an ziyaadi bni sa'din, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydin, sami'a aabaa hurayraaa, yaquwlu 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yukharribu alka'baaa dhuw alssuwayqatayni mina alhabashaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Ka'ba would be destroyed by an Abyssinian having two small shanks
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يُخَرِّبُ الْكَعْبَةَ ذُو السُّوَيْقَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْحَبَشَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'ani abni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yukharribu alka'baaa dhuw alssuwayqatayni mina alhabashaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: (The above mentioned) hadith has been narrated on the authority of Abu Huraira through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي الدَّرَاوَرْدِيَّ - عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ، زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ ذُو السُّوَيْقَتَيْنِ مِنَ الْحَبَشَةِ يُخَرِّبُ بَيْتَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy alddaraawardiyya - 'an thawri bni, zaydin 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ dhuw alssuwayqatayni mina alhabashaai yukharribu bayta alllahi 'azza wajalla ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:It would be an Abyssinian having two small shanks who would destroy the House ol Allah, the Exalted and Glorious
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْعَزِيزِ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ - عَنْ ثَوْرِ بْنِ، زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْغَيْثِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ رَجُلٌ مِنْ قَحْطَانَ يَسُوقُ النَّاسَ بِعَصَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu al'aziyzi, - ya'niy abna muhammadin - 'an thawri bni, zaydin 'an aabiy alghaythi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yakhruja rajulun min qahtaana yasuwqu alnnaasa bi'asaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messengar (ﷺ) as saying:The Last Hour would not come before a person of Qahtan comes forth driving people with his stick
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ الْعَبْدِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْكَبِيرِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ أَبُو بَكْرٍ الْحَنَفِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْحَمِيدِ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْحَكَمِ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَذْهَبُ الأَيَّامُ وَاللَّيَالِي حَتَّى يَمْلِكَ رَجُلٌ يُقَالُ لَهُ الْجَهْجَاهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ مُسْلِمٌ هُمْ أَرْبَعَةُ إِخْوَةٍ شَرِيكٌ وَعُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ وَعُمَيْرٌ وَعَبْدُ الْكَبِيرِ بَنُو عَبْدِ الْمَجِيدِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bashhaarin al'abdiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alkabiyri bnu 'abdi almajiydi aabuw bakrin alhanafiyyu, haddathanaa 'abdu alhamiydi bnu ja'farin, qaala sami'tu 'umara bna alhakami, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa tadhhabu alaayyaamu waalllayaaliy hattaa yamlika rajulun yuqaalu lahu aljahjaahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala muslimun hum aarba'aau iikhwaain shariykun wa'ubaydu alllahi wa'umayrun wa'abdu alkabiyri banuw 'abdi almajiydi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The day and the night would not come to an end before a man called al-Jahjah would occupy the throne
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدٍ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تُقَاتِلُوا قَوْمًا كَأَنَّ وُجُوهَهُمُ الْمَجَانُّ الْمُطْرَقَةُ وَلاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تُقَاتِلُوا قَوْمًا نِعَالُهُمُ الشَّعَرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy 'umara - qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydin, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa tuqaatiluwa qawmana kaaanna wujuwhahumu almajaannu almutraqaau walaa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa tuqaatiluwa qawmana ni'aaluhumu alshha'aru ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Last Hour would not come unless you fight with people whose faces are like hammered shields and the Last Hour would not come until you would fight against those wearing the shoes of hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ الْمُسَيَّبِ، أَنَّ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تُقَاتِلَكُمْ أُمَّةٌ يَنْتَعِلُونَ الشَّعَرَ وُجُوهُهُمْ مِثْلُ الْمَجَانِّ الْمُطْرَقَةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy sa'iydu bnu almusayyabi, aanna aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa tuqaatilakum aummaaun yanta'iluwna alshha'ara wujuwhuhum mithlu almajaanni almutraqaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Last Hour would not come until a people wearing shoes of hair fight against you having their faces like hammered shields
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ بْنُ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الزِّنَادِ، عَنِ الأَعْرَجِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، يَبْلُغُ بِهِ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تُقَاتِلُوا قَوْمًا نِعَالُهُمُ الشَّعَرُ وَلاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى تُقَاتِلُوا قَوْمًا صِغَارَ الأَعْيُنِ ذُلْفَ الآنُفِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa sufyaanu bnu 'uyaynaaa, 'an aabiy alzzinaadi, 'ani alaa'raji, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, yablughu bihi alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa tuqaatiluwa qawmana ni'aaluhumu alshha'aru walaa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa tuqaatiluwa qawmana sighaara alaa'yuni dhulfa alanufi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Last Hour would not come until you fight with a people wearing shoes of hair and the Last Hour would not come until you fight with a people having small eyes and broad snub noses
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا قُتَيْبَةُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ - عَنْ سُهَيْلٍ، عَنْ أَبِيهِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ لاَ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ حَتَّى يُقَاتِلَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ التُّرْكَ قَوْمًا وُجُوهُهُمْ كَالْمَجَانِّ الْمُطْرَقَةِ يَلْبَسُونَ الشَّعَرَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِي الشَّعَرِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa qutaybaau bnu sa'iydin, haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - ya'niy abna 'abdi alrrahmani - 'an suhaylin, 'an aabiyhi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ laa taquwmu alssaa'aau hattaa yuqaatila almuslimuwna altturka qawmana wujuwhuhum kaalmajaanni almutraqaai yalbasuwna alshha'ara wayamshuwna fiy alshha'ari ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:The Last Hour would not come until the Muslims fight with the Turks-a people whose faces would be like hammered shields wearing clothes of hair and walking (with shoes) of hair
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا وَكِيعٌ، وَأَبُو أُسَامَةَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ أَبِي خَالِدٍ، عَنْ قَيْسِ، بْنِ أَبِي حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تُقَاتِلُونَ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ السَّاعَةِ قَوْمًا نِعَالُهُمُ الشَّعَرُ كَأَنَّ وُجُوهَهُمُ الْمَجَانُّ الْمُطْرَقَةُ حُمْرُ الْوُجُوهِ صِغَارُ الأَعْيُنِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw kuraybin, haddathanaa wakiy'un, waaabuw ausaamaaa 'an iismaa'iyla bni aabiy khaalidin, 'an qaysi, bni aabiy haazimin 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ tuqaatiluwna bayna yadaai alssaa'aai qawmana ni'aaluhumu alshha'aru kaaanna wujuwhahumu almajaannu almutraqaau humru alwujuwhi sighaaru alaa'yuni ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:You shall fight in the hours to come against a nation wearing shoes made of hair and faces like hammered shields, with red complexion and small eyes
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، وَعَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِزُهَيْرٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، قَالَ كُنَّا عِنْدَ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ يُوشِكُ أَهْلُ الْعِرَاقِ أَنْ لاَ يُجْبَى إِلَيْهِمْ قَفِيزٌ وَلاَ دِرْهَمٌ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا مِنْ أَيْنَ ذَاكَ قَالَ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْعَجَمِ يَمْنَعُونَ ذَاكَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ يُوشِكَ أَهْلُ الشَّأْمِ أَنْ لاَ يُجْبَى إِلَيْهِمْ دِينَارٌ وَلاَ مُدْىٌ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا مِنْ أَيْنَ ذَاكَ قَالَ مِنْ قِبَلِ الرُّومِ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ سَكَتَ هُنَيَّةً ثُمَّ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ يَكُونُ فِي آخِرِ أُمَّتِي خَلِيفَةٌ يَحْثِي الْمَالَ حَثْيًا لاَ يَعُدُّهُ عَدَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لأَبِي نَضْرَةَ وَأَبِي الْعَلاَءِ أَتَرَيَانِ أَنَّهُ عُمَرُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْعَزِيزِ فَقَالاَ لاَ ‏.‏
