verses.translit: haddathanaa zuhayru bnu harbin, wa'aliyyu bnu hujrin, - waalllafzu lizuhayrin - qaalaa haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, bnu iibraahiyma 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy nadraaa, qaala kunnaa 'inda jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi faqaala yuwshiku aahlu al'iraaqi aan laa yujbaa iilayhim qafiyzun walaa dirhamun ‏.‏ qulnaa min aayna dhaaka qaala min qibali al'ajami yamna'uwna dhaaka ‏.‏ thumma qaala yuwshika aahlu alshhaami aan laa yujbaa iilayhim diynaarun walaa mudaun ‏.‏ qulnaa min aayna dhaaka qaala min qibali alrruwmi ‏.‏ thumma sakata hunayyaaan thumma qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ yakuwnu fiy akhiri aummatiy khaliyfaaun yahthiy almaala hathyana laa ya'udduhu 'adadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu laabiy nadraaa waaabiy al'alaa'i aatarayaani aannahu 'umaru bnu 'abdi al'aziyzi faqaalaa laa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Nadra reported:"We were in the company of Jabir b. 'Abdullah that he said it may happen that the people of Iraq may not send their qafiz and dirhams (their measures of food stuff and their money). We said: Who would be responsible for it? He said: The non-Arabs would prevent them. He again said: There is the possibility that the people of Syria may not send their dinars and mudds. We said: Who would be responsible for it? He said this prevention would be made by the Romans. He (Jabir b. Abdullah) kept quiet for a while and then reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) having said there would be a caliph in the last (period) of my Ummah who would freely give handfuls of wealth to the people without counting it. I said to Abu Nadra and Abu al-'Ala: Do you mean 'Umar b. 'Abd al-Aziz? They said: No (he would be Imam Mahdi)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ، حَدَّثَنَا سَعِيدٌ، - يَعْنِي الْجُرَيْرِيَّ - بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa 'abdu alwahhaabi, haddathanaa sa'iydun, - ya'niy aljurayriyya - bihadhaa aliisnaadi nahwahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith hab been narrated by Sa'id with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْمُفَضَّلِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ، بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ عُلَيَّةَ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مِنْ خُلَفَائِكُمْ خَلِيفَةٌ يَحْثُو الْمَالَ حَثْيًا لاَ يَعُدُّهُ عَدَدًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَفِي رِوَايَةِ ابْنِ حُجْرٍ ‏"‏ يَحْثِي الْمَالَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa bishrun ya'niy abna almufaddali, h wahaddathanaa 'aliyyu, bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu haddathanaa iismaa'iylu, - ya'niy abna 'ulayyaaa - kilaahumaa 'an sa'iydi bni yaziyda, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ min khulafaaiikum khaliyfaaun yahthuw almaala hathyana laa ya'udduhu 'adadana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wafiy riwaayaai abni hujrin ‏"‏ yahthiy almaala ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (may peace he upon him) I said:There would be amongst your caliphs a caliph who would give handfuls of wealth to the people, but would not count it. In the narration transmitted on the authority of Ibn Hujr, there is a slight variation of wording
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ، بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا نَضْرَةَ، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ، هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِعَمَّارٍ حِينَ جَعَلَ يَحْفِرُ الْخَنْدَقَ وَجَعَلَ يَمْسَحُ رَأْسَهُ وَيَقُولُ ‏ "‏ بُؤْسَ ابْنِ سُمَيَّةَ تَقْتُلُكَ فِئَةٌ بَاغِيةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu, bnu ja'farin haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy maslamaaa, qaala sami'tu aabaa nadraaa, yuhaddithu 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala aakhbaraniy man, huwa khayrun minniy aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala li'ammaarin hiyna ja'ala yahfiru alkhandaqa waja'ala yamsahu raasahu wayaquwlu ‏ "‏ buusa abni sumayyaaa taqtuluka fiiaaun baaghiyaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa`id Khudri reported:One who is better than I informed me, that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to `Ammar as he was digging the ditch (on the ocassion of the Battle of the Ditch) wiping over his head: O son of Summayya, you will be involved in trouble and a group of the rebels would kill you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مُعَاذِ بْنِ عَبَّادٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، وَهُرَيْمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، وَمَحْمُودُ بْنُ غَيْلاَنَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ قُدَامَةَ قَالُوا أَخْبَرَنَا النَّضْرُ بْنُ شُمَيْلٍ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ نَحْوَهُ غَيْرَ أَنَّ فِي حَدِيثِ النَّضْرِ أَخْبَرَنِي مَنْ هُوَ خَيْرٌ مِنِّي أَبُو قَتَادَةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ خَالِدِ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ قَالَ أُرَاهُ يَعْنِي أَبَا قَتَادَةَ ‏.‏ وَفِي حَدِيثِ خَالِدٍ وَيَقُولُ ‏"‏ وَيْسَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ أَوْ يَقُولُ ‏"‏ يَا وَيْسَ ابْنِ سُمَيَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu mu'aadhi bni 'abbaadin al'anbariyyu, wahuraymu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa haddathanaa khaalidu bnu alhaarithi, h wahaddathanaa iishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waiishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, wamahmuwdu bnu ghaylaana, wamuhammadu bnu qudaamaaa qaaluwa aakhbaranaa alnnadru bnu shumaylin, kilaahumaa 'an shu'baaa, 'an aabiy maslamaaa, bihadhaa aliisnaadi ‏.‏ nahwahu ghayra aanna fiy hadiythi alnnadri aakhbaraniy man huwa khayrun minniy aabuw qataadaaa ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi khaalidi bni alhaarithi qaala auraahu ya'niy aabaa qataadaaa ‏.‏ wafiy hadiythi khaalidin wayaquwlu ‏"‏ waysa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ aaw yaquwlu ‏"‏ yaa waysa abni sumayyaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the same authority but with this variation that the hadith transmitted on the authority of Nabra (the words are):One who is better than I informed me, and he was Abu Qatada, and in the hadith transmitted on the authority of Khalid instead of the word 'bu'us' there is 'wayys' or 'ya wayys', i.e., " how sad it is
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَمْرِو بْنِ جَبَلَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عُقْبَةُ بْنُ، مُكْرَمٍ الْعَمِّيُّ وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ عُقْبَةُ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ خَالِدًا، يُحَدِّثُ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ لِعَمَّارٍ ‏ "‏ تَقْتُلُكَ الْفِئَةُ الْبَاغِيَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu 'amriw bni jabalaaa, haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, h wahaddathanaa 'uqbaau bnu, mukramin al'ammiyyu waaabuw bakri bnu naafi'in qaala 'uqbaau haddathanaa waqaala aabuw bakrin, aakhbaranaa ghundarun, haddathanaa shu'baau, qaala sami'tu khaalidana, yuhaddithu 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy alhasani, 'an aummihi, 'an aummi salamaaa, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala li'ammaarin ‏ "‏ taqtuluka alfiiaau albaaghiyaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Umm Salama that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to 'Ammar:A group of rebels would kill you
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ مَنْصُورٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الصَّمَدِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ الْحَذَّاءُ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي الْحَسَنِ، وَالْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِمَا، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy iishaaqu bnu mansuwrin, aakhbaranaa 'abdu alssamadi bnu 'abdi alwaarithi, haddathanaa shu'baau, haddathanaa khaalidun alhadhhaa'u, 'an sa'iydi bni aabiy alhasani, waalhasani, 'an aummihimaa, 'an aummi salamaaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Umm Salama through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَوْنٍ، عَنِ الْحَسَنِ، عَنْ أُمِّهِ، عَنْ أُمِّ سَلَمَةَ، قَالَتْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ تَقْتُلُ عَمَّارًا الْفِئَةُ الْبَاغِيَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa iismaa'iylu bnu iibraahiyma, 'ani abni 'awnin, 'ani alhasani, 'an aummihi, 'an aummi salamaaa, qaalat qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ taqtulu 'ammaarana alfiiaau albaaghiyaau ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Umm Salama reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:A band of rebels would kill `Ammar
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي التَّيَّاحِ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ يُهْلِكُ أُمَّتِي هَذَا الْحَىُّ مِنْ قُرَيْشٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالُوا فَمَا تَأْمُرُنَا قَالَ ‏"‏ لَوْ أَنَّ النَّاسَ اعْتَزَلُوهُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنَا أَحْمَدُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، وَأَحْمَدُ بْنُ عُثْمَانَ النَّوْفَلِيُّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو دَاوُدَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، فِي هَذَا الإِسْنَادِ فِي مَعْنَاهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an aabiy alttayyaahi, qaala sami'tu aabaa zur'aaa, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏"‏ yuhliku aummatiy hadhaa alhaaau min qurayshin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaaluwa famaa taamurunaa qaala ‏"‏ law aanna alnnaasa a'tazaluwhum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathanaa aahmadu bnu iibraahiyma alddawraqiyyu, waaahmadu bnu 'uthmaana alnnawfaliyyu, qaalaa haddathanaa aabuw daawuda haddathanaa shu'baau, fiy hadhaa aliisnaadi fiy ma'naahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) as saying:This tribe of the Quraish would kill (people) of my Ummah. They (the Companions) said: What do you command us to do (in such a situation)? Thereupon he said: Would that the people remain aside from them (and not besmear their hands with the blood of the Muslim). This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Shu'ba with the same chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَمْرٌو النَّاقِدُ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَرَ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا سُفْيَانُ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ الْمُسَيَّبِ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ قَدْ مَاتَ كِسْرَى فَلاَ كِسْرَى بَعْدَهُ وَإِذَا هَلَكَ قَيْصَرُ فَلاَ قَيْصَرَ بَعْدَهُ وَالَّذِي نَفْسِي بِيَدِهِ لَتُنْفَقَنَّ كُنُوزُهُمَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَحَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى، أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي ابْنُ رَافِعٍ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، بِإِسْنَادِ سُفْيَانَ وَمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'amrunw alnnaaqidu, waabnu aabiy 'umara, - waalllafzu laibni aabiy 'umara - qaalaa haddathanaa sufyaanu, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an sa'iydi bni almusayyabi, 'an aabiy hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ qad maata kisraa falaa kisraa ba'dahu waiidhaa halaka qaysaru falaa qaysara ba'dahu waalladhiy nafsiy biyadihi latunfaqanna kunuwzuhumaa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ wahaddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa, aakhbaranaa abnu wahbin, aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, h wahaddathaniy abnu raafi'in, wa'abdu bnu humaydin 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, kilaahumaa 'ani alzzuhriyyi, biiisnaadi sufyaana wama'naa hadiythihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Kisra (Khusrau king of Persia) would die and Qaisar (Ceasar King of Rome) would die; there would be no Qaisar after him, but, by the One in Whose Hand is my life, you would spend their treasures in the cause of Allah. This hadith has been transmitted on the authority of Zuhri
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنْ هَمَّامِ بْنِ مُنَبِّهٍ، قَالَ هَذَا مَا حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ أَحَادِيثَ مِنْهَا وَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ هَلَكَ كِسْرَى ثُمَّ لاَ يَكُونُ كِسْرَى بَعْدَهُ وَقَيْصَرُ لَيَهْلِكَنَّ ثُمَّ لاَ يَكُونُ قَيْصَرُ بَعْدَهُ وَلَتُقْسَمَنَّ كُنُوزُهُمَا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrazzaaqi, haddathanaa ma'marun, 'an hammaami bni munabbihin, qaala hadhaa maa haddathanaa aabuw hurayraaa, 'an rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏ fadhakara aahaadiytha minhaa waqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ halaka kisraa thumma laa yakuwnu kisraa ba'dahu waqaysaru layahlikanna thumma laa yakuwnu qaysaru ba'dahu walatuqsamanna kunuwzuhumaa fiy sabiyli alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hammam b. Munabbih reported:This is what Abu Huraira reported from Allah's messenger (ﷺ) and in this connection he reported so many hadith (and one of them was this): Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Kisra would die and then there would be no Kisra after him. Qaisar would die and there would be no Qaisar after him, but you will distribute their treasures in the cause of Allah
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لِعُثْمَانَ - قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ، عُثْمَانُ حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ أَبِي وَائِلٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَرَرْنَا بِصِبْيَانٍ فِيهِمُ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ فَفَرَّ الصِّبْيَانُ وَجَلَسَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ فَكَأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَرِهَ ذَلِكَ فَقَالَ لَهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَرِبَتْ يَدَاكَ أَتَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لاَ ‏.‏ بَلْ تَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ذَرْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ حَتَّى أَقْتُلَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنْ يَكُنِ الَّذِي تَرَى فَلَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ قَتْلَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'uthmaanu bnu aabiy shaybaaa, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu li'uthmaana - qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala, 'uthmaanu haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an aabiy waaiilin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm famararnaa bisibyaanin fiyhimu abnu sayyaadin fafarra alssibyaanu wajalasa abnu sayyaadin fakaaanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm kariha dhalika faqaala lahu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ taribat yadaaka aatashhadu aanniy rasuwlu alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala laa ‏.‏ bal tashhadu aanniy rasuwlu alllahi ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi dharniy yaa rasuwla alllahi hattaa aaqtulahu ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iin yakuni alladhiy taraa falan tastatiy'a qatlahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported:We were along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that we happened to pass by children amongst whom there was Ibn Sayyad. The children made their way but Ibn Sayyad kept sitting there (and it seemed) as if Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) did not like it (his sitting with the children) and said to him: May your nose he besmeared with dust, don't you bear testimony to the fact that I am the Messenger of Allah? Thereupon he said: No, but you should bear testimony that I am the messenger of Allah. Thereupon 'Umar b. Khattab said: Allah's Messenger, permit me that I should kill him. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If he is that person who is in your mind (Dajjal ), you will not be able to kill him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَأَبُو كُرَيْبٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كُرَيْبٍ - قَالَ ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ حَدَّثَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا الأَعْمَشُ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ كُنَّا نَمْشِي مَعَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَمَرَّ بِابْنِ صَيَّادٍ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ قَدْ خَبَأْتُ لَكَ خَبِيئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ دُخٌّ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اخْسَأْ فَلَنْ تَعْدُوَ قَدْرَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ دَعْنِي فَأَضْرِبَ عُنُقَهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ دَعْهُ فَإِنْ يَكُنِ الَّذِي تَخَافُ لَنْ تَسْتَطِيعَ قَتْلَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, waaabuw kuraybin - waalllafzu laabiy kuraybin - qaala abnu numayrin haddathanaa waqaala alakharaani, aakhbaranaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, haddathanaa alaa'mashu, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an 'abdi alllahi, qaala kunnaa namshiy ma'a alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm famarra biabni sayyaadin faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ qad khabaatu laka khabiyiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala dukhhun ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ akhsaa falan ta'duwa qadraka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru yaa rasuwla alllahi da'niy faaadriba 'unuqahu faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ da'hu faiin yakuni alladhiy takhaafu lan tastatiy'a qatlahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah reported:We were walking with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) that Ibn Sayyad happened to pass by him. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: I have concealed for you (something to test you, so tell me that). He said: It is Dukh. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: Be off. You cannot get farther than your rank, whereupon 'Umar said: Allah's Messenger, permit me to strike his neck. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Leave him; if he is that one (Dajjal) whom you apprehend, you will not be able to kill him
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ لَقِيَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ فِي بَعْضِ طُرُقِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ أَتَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ هُوَ أَتَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلاَئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ مَا تَرَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرَى عَرْشًا عَلَى الْمَاءِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ تَرَى عَرْشَ إِبْلِيسَ عَلَى الْبَحْرِ وَمَا تَرَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَرَى صَادِقَيْنِ وَكَاذِبًا أَوْ كَاذِبَيْنِ وَصَادِقًا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لُبِسَ عَلَيْهِ دَعُوهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa saalimu bnu nuwhin, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala laqiyahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaabuw bakrin wa'umaru fiy ba'di turuqi almadiynaai faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ aatashhadu aanniy rasuwlu alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala huwa aatashhadu aanniy rasuwlu alllahi faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ amantu bialllahi wamalaaiikatihi wakutubihi maa taraa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aaraa 'arshana 'alaa almaa'i ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ taraa 'arsha iibliysa 'alaa albahri wamaa taraa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aaraa saadiqayni wakaadhibana aaw kaadhibayni wasaadiqana ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ lubisa 'alayhi da'uwhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) met him (Ibn Sayyad) and so did Abu Bakr and 'Umar on some of the roads of Medina. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Do you bear testimony to the fact that I am the Messenger of Allah? Thereupon he said: Do you bear testimony to the fact that I am the messenger of Allah? Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: I affirm my faith in Allah and in His Angels and in His Books, and what do you see? He said: I see the throne over water. Whereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: You see the throne of Iblis upon the water, and what else do you see? He said: I see two truthfuls and a liar or two liars and one truthful. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Leave him He has been confounded
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي قَالَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، قَالَ لَقِيَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ابْنَ صَائِدٍ وَمَعَهُ أَبُو بَكْرٍ وَعُمَرُ وَابْنُ صَائِدٍ مَعَ الْغِلْمَانِ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ نَحْوَ حَدِيثِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu aabiy qaala, haddathanaa aabuw nadraaa, 'an jaabiri bni 'abdi alllahi, qaala laqiya nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm abna saaiidin wama'ahu aabuw bakrin wa'umaru waabnu saaiidin ma'a alghilmaani ‏.‏ fadhakara nahwa hadiythi aljurayriyyi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Jabir b 'Abdullah reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) met Ibn Sa'id (Sayyad) and there were with him Abu Bakr and 'Umar and Ibn Sayyad was in the company of children. The rest of the hadith is the same
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ الْقَوَارِيرِيُّ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الأَعْلَى، حَدَّثَنَا دَاوُدُ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ صَحِبْتُ ابْنَ صَائِدٍ إِلَى مَكَّةَ فَقَالَ لِي أَمَا قَدْ لَقِيتُ مِنَ النَّاسِ يَزْعُمُونَ أَنِّي الدَّجَّالُ أَلَسْتَ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ لاَ يُولَدُ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَدْ وُلِدَ لِي ‏.‏ أَوَلَيْسَ سَمِعْتَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏"‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْمَدِينَةَ وَلاَ مَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْتُ بَلَى ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَدْ وُلِدْتُ بِالْمَدِينَةِ وَهَذَا أَنَا أُرِيدُ مَكَّةَ - قَالَ - ثُمَّ قَالَ لِي فِي آخِرِ قَوْلِهِ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ مَوْلِدَهُ وَمَكَانَهُ وَأَيْنَ هُوَ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَلَبَسَنِي ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy 'ubaydu alllahi bnu 'umara alqawaariyriyyu, wamuhammadu bnu almuthannaa, qaalaa haddathanaa 'abdu alaa'laa, haddathanaa daawudu, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala sahibtu abna saaiidin iilaa makkaaa faqaala liy aamaa qad laqiytu mina alnnaasi yaz'umuwna aanniy alddajjaalu aalasta sami'ta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ iinnahu laa yuwladu lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala qultu balaa ‏.‏ qaala faqad wulida liy ‏.‏ aawalaysa sami'ta rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏"‏ laa yadkhulu almadiynaaa walaa makkaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qultu balaa ‏.‏ qaala faqad wulidtu bialmadiynaai wahadhaa aanaa auriydu makkaaa - qaala - thumma qaala liy fiy akhiri qawlihi aamaa waalllahi iinniy laa'lamu mawlidahu wamakaanahu waaayna huwa ‏.‏ qaala falabasaniy ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported:I accompanied Ibn Sayyad to Mecca and he said to me: What I have gathered from people is that they think that I am Dajjal. Have you not heard Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) as saying: He will have no children, I said: Yes, of course. Thereupon he said: But I have children. Have you not heard Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying: He would not enter Mecca and Medina? I said: Yes, of course. Thereupon he said I have been once in Medina and now I intend to go to Mecca. And he said to me at the end of his talk: By Allah, I know his place of birth his abode where he is just now. He (Abu Sa'id) said: This caused confusion in my mind (in regard to his identity)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الأَعْلَى، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعْتَمِرٌ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبِي يُحَدِّثُ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِيَ ابْنُ صَائِدٍ وَأَخَذَتْنِي مِنْهُ ذَمَامَةٌ هَذَا عَذَرْتُ النَّاسَ مَا لِي وَلَكُمْ يَا أَصْحَابَ مُحَمَّدٍ أَلَمْ يَقُلْ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ يَهُودِيٌّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ أَسْلَمْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ وَلاَ يُولَدُ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ وُلِدَ لِي ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ حَرَّمَ عَلَيْهِ مَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ حَجَجْتُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَمَا زَالَ حَتَّى كَادَ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ فِيَّ قَوْلُهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْلَمُ الآنَ حَيْثُ هُوَ وَأَعْرِفُ أَبَاهُ وَأُمَّهُ ‏.‏ قَالَ وَقِيلَ لَهُ أَيَسُرُّكَ أَنَّكَ ذَاكَ الرَّجُلُ قَالَ فَقَالَ لَوْ عُرِضَ عَلَىَّ مَا كَرِهْتُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa yahyaa bnu habiybin, wamuhammadu bnu 'abdi alaa'laa, qaalaa haddathanaa mu'tamirun, qaala sami'tu aabiy yuhaddithu, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala qaala liya abnu saaiidin waaakhadhatniy minhu dhamaamaaun hadhaa 'adhartu alnnaasa maa liy walakum yaa aashaaba muhammadin aalam yaqul nabiyyu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinnahu yahuwdiyyun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqad aaslamtu ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ walaa yuwladu lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqad wulida liy ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ iinna alllaha qad harrama 'alayhi makkaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqad hajajtu ‏.‏ qaala famaa zaala hattaa kaada aan yaakhudha fiyya qawluhu ‏.‏ qaala faqaala lahu aamaa waalllahi iinniy laa'lamu alana haythu huwa waaa'rifu aabaahu waaummahu ‏.‏ qaala waqiyla lahu aayasurruka aannaka dhaaka alrrajulu qaala faqaala law 'urida 'alaaaa maa karihtu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id Khudri reported:Ibn Sa'id said to me something for which I felt ashamed. He said: I can excuse others; but what has gone wrong with you, O Companions of Muhammad, that you take me as Dajjal? Has Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) not said that he would be a Jew whereas I am a Muslim and he also said that he would not have children, whereas I have children, and he also said: verily, Allah has prohibited him to enter Mecca whereas I have performed Pilgrimage, and he went on saying this that I was about to be impressed by his talk. He (however) said this also: I know where he (Dajjal) is and I know his father and mother, and it was said to him: Won't you feel pleased if you would be the same person? Thereupon he said: If this offer is made to me, I would not resent that
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا سَالِمُ بْنُ نُوحٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي الْجُرَيْرِيُّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيِّ، قَالَ خَرَجْنَا حُجَّاجًا أَوْ عُمَّارًا وَمَعَنَا ابْنُ صَائِدٍ - قَالَ - فَنَزَلْنَا مَنْزِلاً فَتَفَرَّقَ النَّاسُ وَبَقِيتُ أَنَا وَهُوَ فَاسْتَوْحَشْتُ مِنْهُ وَحْشَةً شَدِيدَةً مِمَّا يُقَالُ عَلَيْهِ - قَالَ - وَجَاءَ بِمَتَاعِهِ فَوَضَعَهُ مَعَ مَتَاعِي ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ الْحَرَّ شَدِيدٌ فَلَوْ وَضَعْتَهُ تَحْتَ تِلْكَ الشَّجَرَةِ - قَالَ - فَفَعَلَ - قَالَ - فَرُفِعَتْ لَنَا غَنَمٌ فَانْطَلَقَ فَجَاءَ بِعُسٍّ فَقَالَ اشْرَبْ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ ‏.‏ فَقُلْتُ إِنَّ الْحَرَّ شَدِيدٌ وَاللَّبَنُ حَارٌّ ‏.‏ مَا بِي إِلاَّ أَنِّي أَكْرَهُ أَنْ أَشْرَبَ عَنْ يَدِهِ - أَوْ قَالَ آخُذَ عَنْ يَدِهِ - فَقَالَ أَبَا سَعِيدٍ لَقَدْ هَمَمْتُ أَنْ آخُذَ حَبْلاً فَأُعَلِّقَهُ بِشَجَرَةٍ ثُمَّ أَخْتَنِقَ مِمَّا يَقُولُ لِيَ النَّاسُ يَا أَبَا سَعِيدٍ مَنْ خَفِيَ عَلَيْهِ حَدِيثُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَا خَفِيَ عَلَيْكُمْ مَعْشَرَ الأَنْصَارِ أَلَسْتَ مِنْ أَعْلَمِ النَّاسِ بِحَدِيثِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَلَيْسَ قَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هُوَ كَافِرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَأَنَا مُسْلِمٌ أَوَلَيْسَ قَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ هُوَ عَقِيمٌ لاَ يُولَدُ لَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ تَرَكْتُ وَلَدِي بِالْمَدِينَةِ أَوَ لَيْسَ قَدْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ يَدْخُلُ الْمَدِينَةَ وَلاَ مَكَّةَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَدْ أَقْبَلْتُ مِنَ الْمَدِينَةِ وَأَنَا أُرِيدُ مَكَّةَ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ الْخُدْرِيُّ حَتَّى كِدْتُ أَنْ أَعْذِرَهُ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَمَا وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَعْرِفُهُ وَأَعْرِفُ مَوْلِدَهُ وَأَيْنَ هُوَ الآنَ ‏.‏ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ تَبًّا لَكَ سَائِرَ الْيَوْمِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa saalimu bnu nuwhin, aakhbaraniy aljurayriyyu, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin alkhudriyyi, qaala kharajnaa hujjaajana aaw 'ummaarana wama'anaa abnu saaiidin - qaala - fanazalnaa manzilaan fatafarraqa alnnaasu wabaqiytu aanaa wahuwa faastawhashtu minhu wahshaaan shadiydaaan mimmaa yuqaalu 'alayhi - qaala - wajaa'a bimataa'ihi fawada'ahu ma'a mataa'iy ‏.‏ faqultu iinna alharra shadiydun falaw wada'tahu tahta tilka alshhajaraai - qaala - fafa'ala - qaala - farufi'at lanaa ghanamun faantalaqa fajaa'a bi'ussin faqaala ashrab aabaa sa'iydin ‏.‏ faqultu iinna alharra shadiydun waalllabanu haarrun ‏.‏ maa biy iilaaa aanniy aakrahu aan aashraba 'an yadihi - aaw qaala akhudha 'an yadihi - faqaala aabaa sa'iydin laqad hamamtu aan akhudha hablaan faau'alliqahu bishajaraain thumma aakhtaniqa mimmaa yaquwlu liya alnnaasu yaa aabaa sa'iydin man khafiya 'alayhi hadiythu rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm maa khafiya 'alaykum ma'shara alaansaari aalasta min aa'lami alnnaasi bihadiythi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aalaysa qad qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ huwa kaafirun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waaanaa muslimun aawalaysa qad qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ huwa 'aqiymun laa yuwladu lahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqad taraktu waladiy bialmadiynaai aawa laysa qad qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ laa yadkhulu almadiynaaa walaa makkaaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqad aaqbaltu mina almadiynaai waaanaa auriydu makkaaa qaala aabuw sa'iydin alkhudriyyu hattaa kidtu aan aa'dhirahu ‏.‏ thumma qaala aamaa waalllahi iinniy laa'rifuhu waaa'rifu mawlidahu waaayna huwa alana ‏.‏ qaala qultu lahu tabbana laka saaiira alyawmi ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa`id al-Khudri reported:We came back after having performed Pilgrimage or `Umra and lbn Sa'id was along with us. And we encamped at a place and the people dispersed and I and he were left behind. I felt terribly frightend from him as it was said about him that he was the Dajjal. He brought his goods and placed them by my luggage and I said: It is intense heat. Would you not place that under that tree? And he did that. Then there appeared before us a flock of sheep. He went and brought a cup of milk and said: Abu Sa`id, drink that. I said it is intense heat and the milk is also hot (whereas the fact was) that I did not like to drink from his hands or to take it from his hand and he said: Abu Sa`id, I think that I should take a rope and suspend it by the tree and then commit suicide because of the talks of the people, and he further said. Abu Sa`id he who is ignorant of the saying of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) (he is to be pardoned), but O people of Ansar, is this hadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) concealed from you whereas you have the best knowledge of the hadith of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) amongst people? Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not say that he (Dajjal) would be a non believer whereas I am a believer? Did Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) not say he would be barren and no child would be born to him, whereas I have left my children in Medina? Did Allah's Messenger (may peace upon him) not say: He would not get into Medina and Mecca whereas I have been coming from Medina and now I intend to go to Mecca? Abu Sa`id said: I was about to accept the excuse put forward by him. Then he said: I know the place where he would be born and where he is now. So I said to him: May your whole day be spent
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا نَصْرُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْجَهْضَمِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا بِشْرٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ مُفَضَّلٍ - عَنْ أَبِي مَسْلَمَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاِبْنِ صَائِدٍ ‏"‏ مَا تُرْبَةُ الْجَنَّةِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ دَرْمَكَةٌ بَيْضَاءُ مِسْكٌ يَا أَبَا الْقَاسِمِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏"‏ صَدَقْتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa nasru bnu 'aliyyin aljahdamiyyu, haddathanaa bishrun, - ya'niy abna mufaddalin - 'an aabiy maslamaaa, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laibni saaiidin ‏"‏ maa turbaau aljannaai ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala darmakaaun baydaa'u miskun yaa aabaa alqaasimi ‏.‏ qaala ‏"‏ sadaqta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has transmitted on the authority of Abu Sa'id that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) asked Ibn Sa'id about the earth of Paradise. Thereupon he said:Abu'l-Qasim, It is like a fine white musk, whereupon he (the Holy Prophet) said: 'You have told the the truth
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، عَنِ الْجُرَيْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ ابْنَ صَيَّادٍ، سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنْ تُرْبَةِ الْجَنَّةِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ دَرْمَكَةٌ بَيْضَاءُ مِسْكٌ خَالِصٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, 'ani aljurayriyyi, 'an aabiy nadraaa, 'an aabiy sa'iydin, aanna abna sayyaadin, saaala alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm 'an turbaai aljannaai faqaala ‏ "‏ darmakaaun baydaa'u miskun khaalisun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Sa'id reported that Ibn Sayyad asked Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) about the earth of Paradise. Whereupon he said:It is like white shining pure musk
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، قَالَ رَأَيْتُ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ يَحْلِفُ بِاللَّهِ أَنَّ ابْنَ صَائِدٍ الدَّجَّالُ، فَقُلْتُ أَتَحْلِفُ بِاللَّهِ قَالَ إِنِّي سَمِعْتُ عُمَرَ يَحْلِفُ عَلَى ذَلِكَ عِنْدَ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَلَمْ يُنْكِرْهُ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi bnu mu'aadhin al'anbariyyu, haddathanaa aabiy, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an sa'di bni iibraahiyma, 'an muhammadi bni almunkadiri, qaala raaaytu jaabira bna 'abdi alllahi yahlifu bialllahi aanna abna saaiidin alddajjaalu, faqultu aatahlifu bialllahi qaala iinniy sami'tu 'umara yahlifu 'alaa dhalika 'inda alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm falam yunkirhu alnnabiyyu sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏.‏
verses.translation: Muhammad b. Munkadir reported:As I saw Jabir b. 'Abdullah taking an oath in the name of Allah that it was Ibn Sa'id who was the Dajjal I said: Do you take an oath in the name of Allah? Thereupon he said: I heard 'Umar taking an oath in the presence of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) to this effect but Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) did not disapprove of it
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي حَرْمَلَةُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ حَرْمَلَةَ بْنِ عِمْرَانَ التُّجِيبِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنِي ابْنُ، وَهْبٍ أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ سَالِمِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ عُمَرَ بْنَ الْخَطَّابِ انْطَلَقَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي رَهْطٍ قِبَلَ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ حَتَّى وَجَدَهُ يَلْعَبُ مَعَ الصِّبْيَانِ عِنْدَ أُطُمِ بَنِي مَغَالَةَ وَقَدْ قَارَبَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ يَوْمَئِذٍ الْحُلُمَ فَلَمْ يَشْعُرْ حَتَّى ضَرَبَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ظَهْرَهُ بِيَدِهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاِبْنِ صَيَّادٍ ‏"‏ أَتَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَنَظَرَ إِلَيْهِ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ فَقَالَ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ رَسُولُ الأُمِّيِّينَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَتَشْهَدُ أَنِّي رَسُولُ اللَّهِ فَرَفَضَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَالَ ‏"‏ آمَنْتُ بِاللَّهِ وَبِرُسُلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ مَاذَا تَرَى ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ يَأْتِينِي صَادِقٌ وَكَاذِبٌ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ خُلِّطَ عَلَيْكَ الأَمْرُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنِّي قَدْ خَبَأْتُ لَكَ خَبِيئًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ ‏"‏ هُوَ الدُّخُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ اخْسَأْ فَلَنْ تَعْدُوَ قَدْرَكَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ ذَرْنِي يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ أَضْرِبْ عُنُقَهُ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ إِنْ يَكُنْهُ فَلَنْ تُسَلَّطَ عَلَيْهِ وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْهُ فَلاَ خَيْرَ لَكَ فِي قَتْلِهِ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ سَمِعْتُ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ بْنَ عُمَرَ، يَقُولُ انْطَلَقَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَأُبَىُّ بْنُ كَعْبٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ إِلَى النَّخْلِ الَّتِي فِيهَا ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ حَتَّى إِذَا دَخَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم النَّخْلَ طَفِقَ يَتَّقِي بِجُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ وَهُوَ يَخْتِلُ أَنْ يَسْمَعَ مِنِ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ شَيْئًا قَبْلَ أَنْ يَرَاهُ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ فَرَآهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ عَلَى فِرَاشٍ فِي قَطِيفَةٍ لَهُ فِيهَا زَمْزَمَةٌ فَرَأَتْ أُمُّ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ يَتَّقِي بِجُذُوعِ النَّخْلِ فَقَالَتْ لاِبْنِ صَيَّادٍ يَا صَافِ - وَهُوَ اسْمُ ابْنِ صَيَّادٍ - هَذَا مُحَمَّدٌ ‏.‏ فَثَارَ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لَوْ تَرَكَتْهُ بَيَّنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ سَالِمٌ قَالَ عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عُمَرَ فَقَامَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي النَّاسِ فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اللَّهِ بِمَا هُوَ أَهْلُهُ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ الدَّجَّالَ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنِّي لأُنْذِرُكُمُوهُ مَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُ قَوْمَهُ لَقَدْ أَنْذَرَهُ نُوحٌ قَوْمَهُ وَلَكِنْ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ فِيهِ قَوْلاً لَمْ يَقُلْهُ نَبِيٌّ لِقَوْمِهِ تَعَلَّمُوا أَنَّهُ أَعْوَرُ وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى لَيْسَ بِأَعْوَرَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ شِهَابٍ وَأَخْبَرَنِي عُمَرُ بْنُ ثَابِتٍ الأَنْصَارِيُّ أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ يَوْمَ حَذَّرَ النَّاسَ الدَّجَّالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهُ مَكْتُوبٌ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ كَافِرٌ يَقْرَؤُهُ مَنْ كَرِهَ عَمَلَهُ أَوْ يَقْرَؤُهُ كُلُّ مُؤْمِنٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ تَعَلَّمُوا أَنَّهُ لَنْ يَرَى أَحَدٌ مِنْكُمْ رَبَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ حَتَّى يَمُوتَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy harmalaau bnu yahyaa bni 'abdi alllahi bni harmalaaa bni 'imraana alttujiybiyyu, aakhbaraniy abnu, wahbin aakhbaraniy yuwnusu, 'ani abni shihaabin, 'an saalimi bni 'abdi alllahi, aakhbarahu aanna 'abda alllahi bna 'umara aakhbarahu aanna 'umara bna alkhattaabi antalaqa ma'a rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy rahtin qibala abni sayyaadin hattaa wajadahu yal'abu ma'a alssibyaani 'inda autumi baniy maghaalaaa waqad qaaraba abnu sayyaadin yawmaiidhin alhuluma falam yash'ur hattaa daraba rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm zahrahu biyadihi thumma qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm laibni sayyaadin ‏"‏ aatashhadu aanniy rasuwlu alllahi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ fanazara iilayhi abnu sayyaadin faqaala aashhadu aannaka rasuwlu alaummiyyiyna ‏.‏ faqaala abnu sayyaadin lirasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aatashhadu aanniy rasuwlu alllahi farafadahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waqaala ‏"‏ amantu bialllahi wabirusulihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ maadhaa taraa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu sayyaadin yaatiyniy saadiqun wakaadhibun faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ khullita 'alayka alaamru ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma qaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iinniy qad khabaatu laka khabiyiana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala abnu sayyaadin ‏"‏ huwa alddukhhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ akhsaa falan ta'duwa qadraka ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi dharniy yaa rasuwla alllahi aadrib 'unuqahu ‏.‏ faqaala lahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ iin yakunhu falan tusallata 'alayhi waiin lam yakunhu falaa khayra laka fiy qatlihi ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi sami'tu 'abda alllahi bna 'umara, yaquwlu antalaqa ba'da dhalika rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm waaubaaau bnu ka'bin alaansaariyyu iilaa alnnakhli allatiy fiyhaa abnu sayyaadin hattaa iidhaa dakhala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alnnakhla tafiqa yattaqiy bijudhuw'i alnnakhli wahuwa yakhtilu aan yasma'a mini abni sayyaadin shayiana qabla aan yaraahu abnu sayyaadin faraahu rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa mudtaji'un 'alaa firaashin fiy qatiyfaain lahu fiyhaa zamzamaaun faraaat aummu abni sayyaadin rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm wahuwa yattaqiy bijudhuw'i alnnakhli faqaalat laibni sayyaadin yaa saafi - wahuwa asmu abni sayyaadin - hadhaa muhammadun ‏.‏ fathaara abnu sayyaadin ‏.‏ faqaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ law tarakathu bayyana ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala saalimun qaala 'abdu alllahi bnu 'umara faqaama rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alnnaasi faaathnaa 'alaa alllahi bimaa huwa aahluhu thumma dhakara alddajjaala faqaala ‏"‏ iinniy laundhirukumuwhu maa min nabiyyin iilaaa waqad aandharahu qawmahu laqad aandharahu nuwhun qawmahu walakin aaquwlu lakum fiyhi qawlaan lam yaqulhu nabiyyun liqawmihi ta'allamuwa aannahu aa'waru waaanna alllaha tabaaraka wata'aalaa laysa biaa'wara ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala abnu shihaabin waaakhbaraniy 'umaru bnu thaabitin alaansaariyyu aannahu aakhbarahu ba'du aashaabi rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala yawma hadhhara alnnaasa alddajjaala ‏"‏ iinnahu maktuwbun bayna 'aynayhi kaafirun yaqrauuhu man kariha 'amalahu aaw yaqrauuhu kullu muuminin ‏"‏ ‏.‏ waqaala ‏"‏ ta'allamuwa aannahu lan yaraa aahadun minkum rabbahu 'azza wajalla hattaa yamuwta ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported:'Umar b. Khattab went along with Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) in the company of some persons to Ibn Sayyad that he found him playing with children near the battlement of Bani Maghala and Ibn Sayyad was at that time just at the threshold of adolescence and he did not perceive (the presence of Holy Prophet) until Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) struck his back with his hands. Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: Ibn Sayyad, don't you bear witness that I am the messenger of Allah? Ibn Sayyad looked toward him and he said: I bear witness to the fact that you the messenger of the unlettered. Ibn Sayyad said to the Allah's Messenger (ﷺ): Do you bear witness to the fact that I am the messenger of Allah? Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) rejected this and said: I affirm my faith in Allah and in His messengers. Then Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said to him: What do you see? Ibn Sayyad said: It is a Dukh. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: May you be disgraced and dishonoured, you would not not be able to go beyond your rank. 'Umar b. Khattab said: Allah's Messenger, permit me that I should strike his neck. Thereupon Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If he is the same (Dajjal) who would appear near the Last Hour, you would not be able to overpower him, and if he is not that there is no good for you to kill him. 'Abdullah b. 'Umar further narrated that after some time Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) and Ubayy b. Ka'b went towards the palm trees where Ibn Sayyad was. When Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went near the tree he hid himself behind a tree with the intention of hearing something from Ibn sayyad before Ibn Sayyad could see him, but Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) saw him on a bed with a blanket around him from which a murmuring sound was being heard and Ibn Sayyad's mother saw Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) behind the trunk of the palm tree. She said to Ibn Sayyad: Saf (that being his name), here is Muhammad. Thereupon Ibn Sayyad jumped up murmuring and Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said: If she had left him alone he would have made things clear. Abdullah b. Umar told that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) stood up amongst the people and lauded Allah as He deserved, then he made a mention of the Dajjal and said: I warn you of him and there is no Prophet who has not warned his people against the Dajjal. Even Noah warned (against him) but I am going to tell you a thing which no Prophet told his people. You must know that he (the Dajjal) is one-eyed and Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, is not one-eyed. Ibn Shihab said: 'Umar b. Thabit al-Ansari informed me that some of the Companions of Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) informed him that the day when Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) warned people against the Dajjal, he also said: There would be written between his two eyes (the word) Kafir (infidel) and everyone who would resent his deeds would be able to read or every Muslim would be about to read, and he also said: Bear this thing in mind that none amongst you would be able to see Allah, the Exalted and Glorious, until he dies
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ عَلِيٍّ الْحُلْوَانِيُّ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ - حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي سَالِمُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، أَنَّالله عليه وسلم وَمَعَهُ رَهْطٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِيهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ حَتَّى وَجَدَ ابْنَ صَيَّادٍ غُلاَمًا قَدْ نَاهَزَ الْحُلُمَ يَلْعَبُ مَعَ الْغِلْمَانِ عِنْدَ أُطُمِ بَنِي مُعَاوِيَةَ ‏.‏ وَسَاقَ الْحَدِيثَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ إِلَى مُنْتَهَى حَدِيثِ عُمَرَ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ وَفِي الْحَدِيثِ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ قَالَ قَالَ أُبَىٌّ - يَعْنِي فِي قَوْلِهِ لَوْ تَرَكَتْهُ بَيَّنَ - قَالَ لَوْ تَرَكَتْهُ أُمُّهُ بَيَّنَ أَمْرَهُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa alhasanu bnu 'aliyyin alhulwaaniyyu, wa'abdu bnu humaydin, qaalaa haddathanaa ya'quwbu, - wahuwa abnu iibraahiyma bni sa'din - haddathanaa aabiy, 'an saalihin, 'ani abni shihaabin, aakhbaraniy saalimu bnu 'abdi alllahi, aannaallh 'lyh wslm wama'ahu rahtun min aashaabihi fiyhim 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi hattaa wajada abna sayyaadin ghulaamana qad naahaza alhuluma yal'abu ma'a alghilmaani 'inda autumi baniy mu'aawiyaaa ‏.‏ wasaaqa alhadiytha bimithli hadiythi yuwnusa iilaa muntahaa hadiythi 'umara bni thaabitin wafiy alhadiythi 'an ya'quwba qaala qaala aubaaaun - ya'niy fiy qawlihi law tarakathu bayyana - qaala law tarakathu aummuhu bayyana aamrahu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abdullah b. Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) went along with him in the company of some persons and there was Umar b. Khattab also amongst them till they saw Ibn Sayyad as a young boy just on the threshold of adolescence playing with children near the battlement of Bani Mu'awiya; the rest of the hadith is the same but with these concluding words:" Had his mother left him (to murmur) his matter would have become clear
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، وَسَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، جَمِيعًا عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ سَالِمٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَرَّ بِابْنِ صَيَّادٍ فِي نَفَرٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِيهِمْ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ وَهُوَ يَلْعَبُ مَعَ الْغِلْمَانِ عِنْدَ أُطُمِ بَنِي مَغَالَةَ وَهُوَ غُلاَمٌ ‏.‏ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَصَالِحٍ غَيْرَ أَنَّ عَبْدَ بْنَ حُمَيْدٍ لَمْ يَذْكُرْ حَدِيثَ ابْنِ عُمَرَ فِي انْطِلاَقِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم مَعَ أُبَىِّ بْنِ كَعْبٍ إِلَى النَّخْلِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, wasalamaau bnu shabiybin, jamiy'ana 'an 'abdi alrrazzaaqi, aakhbaranaa ma'marun, 'ani alzzuhriyyi, 'an saalimin, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm marra biabni sayyaadin fiy nafarin min aashaabihi fiyhim 'umaru bnu alkhattaabi wahuwa yal'abu ma'a alghilmaani 'inda autumi baniy maghaalaaa wahuwa ghulaamun ‏.‏ bima'naa hadiythi yuwnusa wasaalihin ghayra aanna 'abda bna humaydin lam yadhkur hadiytha abni 'umara fiy antilaaqi alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm ma'a aubaaai bni ka'bin iilaa alnnakhli ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn 'Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) happened to pass by Ibn Sayyad along with his Companions including 'Umar b. Khattab as he was playing with children near the battlement of Bani Maghala and he was also a child by that time. The rest of the hadith is the same as narrated by Ibn Umar (in which there is a mention of) setting out of Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) along with Ubayy b. Ka'b towards the date-palm trees
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا رَوْحُ بْنُ عُبَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا هِشَامٌ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ لَقِيَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ ابْنَ صَائِدٍ فِي بَعْضِ طُرُقِ الْمَدِينَةِ فَقَالَ لَهُ قَوْلاً أَغْضَبَهُ فَانْتَفَخَ حَتَّى مَلأَ السِّكَّةَ فَدَخَلَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ عَلَى حَفْصَةَ وَقَدْ بَلَغَهَا فَقَالَتْ لَهُ رَحِمَكَ اللَّهُ مَا أَرَدْتَ مِنِ ابْنِ صَائِدٍ أَمَا عَلِمْتَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْ غَضْبَةٍ يَغْضَبُهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'abdu bnu humaydin, haddathanaa rawhu bnu 'ubaadaaa, haddathanaa hishaamun, 'an aayyuwba, 'an naafi'in, qaala laqiya abnu 'umara abna saaiidin fiy ba'di turuqi almadiynaai faqaala lahu qawlaan aaghdabahu faantafakha hattaa malaa alssikkaaa fadakhala abnu 'umara 'alaa hafsaaa waqad balaghahaa faqaalat lahu rahimaka alllahu maa aaradta mini abni saaiidin aamaa 'alimta aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ iinnamaa yakhruju min ghadbaain yaghdabuhaa ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Umar met Ibn Si'id on some of the paths of Medina and he said to him a word which enraged him and he was so much swollen with anger that the way was blocked. Ibn 'Umar went to Hafsa and informed her about this. Thereupon she said:May Allah have mercy upon you, why did you incite Ibn Sayyad in spite of the fact that you knew it would be the extreme anger which would make Dajjal appear in the world?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ حَسَنِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ - حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ، عَوْنٍ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، قَالَ كَانَ نَافِعٌ يَقُولُ ابْنُ صَيَّادٍ ‏.‏ قَالَ قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ لَقِيتُهُ مَرَّتَيْنِ - قَالَ - فَلَقِيتُهُ فَقُلْتُ لِبَعْضِهِمْ هَلْ تَحَدَّثُونَ أَنَّهُ هُوَ قَالَ لاَ وَاللَّهِ - قَالَ - قُلْتُ كَذَبْتَنِي وَاللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَخْبَرَنِي بَعْضُكُمْ أَنَّهُ لَنْ يَمُوتَ حَتَّى يَكُونَ أَكْثَرَكُمْ مَالاً وَوَلَدًا فَكَذَلِكَ هُوَ زَعَمُوا الْيَوْمَ - قَالَ - فَتَحَدَّثْنَا ثُمَّ فَارَقْتُهُ - قَالَ - فَلَقِيتُهُ لَقْيَةً أُخْرَى وَقَدْ نَفَرَتْ عَيْنُهُ - قَالَ - فَقُلْتُ مَتَى فَعَلَتْ عَيْنُكَ مَا أَرَى قَالَ لاَ أَدْرِي - قَالَ - قُلْتُ لاَ تَدْرِي وَهِيَ فِي رَأْسِكَ قَالَ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ خَلَقَهَا فِي عَصَاكَ هَذِهِ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَنَخَرَ كَأَشَدِّ نَخِيرِ حِمَارٍ سَمِعْتُ - قَالَ - فَزَعَمَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِي أَنِّي ضَرَبْتُهُ بِعَصًا كَانَتْ مَعِيَ حَتَّى تَكَسَّرَتْ وَأَمَّا أَنَا فَوَاللَّهِ مَا شَعَرْتُ - قَالَ - وَجَاءَ حَتَّى دَخَلَ عَلَى أُمِّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فَحَدَّثَهَا فَقَالَتْ مَا تُرِيدُ إِلَيْهِ أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّهُ قَدْ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا يَبْعَثُهُ عَلَى النَّاسِ غَضَبٌ يَغْضَبُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, haddathanaa husaynun, - ya'niy abna hasani bni yasaarin - haddathanaa abnu, 'awnin 'an naafi'in, qaala kaana naafi'un yaquwlu abnu sayyaadin ‏.‏ qaala qaala abnu 'umara laqiytuhu marratayni - qaala - falaqiytuhu faqultu liba'dihim hal tahaddathuwna aannahu huwa qaala laa waalllahi - qaala - qultu kadhabtaniy waalllahi laqad aakhbaraniy ba'dukum aannahu lan yamuwta hattaa yakuwna aaktharakum maalaan wawaladana fakadhalika huwa za'amuwa alyawma - qaala - fatahaddathnaa thumma faaraqtuhu - qaala - falaqiytuhu laqyaaan aukhraa waqad nafarat 'aynuhu - qaala - faqultu mataa fa'alat 'aynuka maa aaraa qaala laa aadriy - qaala - qultu laa tadriy wahiya fiy raasika qaala iin shaa'a alllahu khalaqahaa fiy 'asaaka hadhihi ‏.‏ qaala fanakhara kaaashaddi nakhiyri himaarin sami'tu - qaala - faza'ama ba'du aashaabiy aanniy darabtuhu bi'asana kaanat ma'iya hattaa takassarat waaammaa aanaa fawaalllahi maa sha'artu - qaala - wajaa'a hattaa dakhala 'alaa aummi almuuminiyna fahaddathahaa faqaalat maa turiydu iilayhi aalam ta'lam aannahu qad qaala ‏ "‏ iinna aawwala maa yab'athuhu 'alaa alnnaasi ghadabun yaghdabuhu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Nafi' reported that Ibn 'Umar said:I met lbn Sayyad twice and said to some of them (his friends): You state that it was he (the Dajjal). He said: By Allah, it is not so. I said: You have not told me the truth; by Allah some of you informed me that he would not die until he would have the largest number of offspring and huge wealth and it is he about whom it is thought so. Then Ibn Sayyad talked to us. I then departed and met him again for the second time and his eye had been swollen. I said: What has happened to your eye? He said: I do not know. I said: This is in your head and you do not know about it? He said: If Allah so wills He can create it (eye) in your staff. He then produced a sound like the braying of a donkey. Some of my companions thought that I had struck him with the staff as he was with me that the staff broke into pieces, but, by Allah, I was not conscious of it. He then came to the Mother of the Faithful (Hafsa) and narrated it to her and she said: What concern you have with him? Don't you know that Allah's Apostle (ﷺ) said that the first thing (by the incitement of which) he would come out before the public would be his anger?
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ، اللَّهِ عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ نُمَيْرٍ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بِشْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ، عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ذَكَرَ الدَّجَّالَ بَيْنَ ظَهْرَانَىِ النَّاسِ فَقَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى لَيْسَ بِأَعْوَرَ ‏.‏ أَلاَ وَإِنَّ الْمَسِيحَ الدَّجَّالَ أَعْوَرُ الْعَيْنِ الْيُمْنَى كَأَنَّ عَيْنَهُ عِنَبَةٌ طَافِئَةٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa aabuw ausaamaaa, wamuhammadu bnu bishrin, qaalaa haddathanaa 'ubaydu, alllahi 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, h wahaddathanaa abnu numayrin, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa muhammadu bnu bishrin, haddathanaa 'ubaydu alllahi, 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, aanna rasuwla alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm dhakara alddajjaala bayna zahraanaai alnnaasi faqaala ‏ "‏ iinna alllaha ta'aalaa laysa biaa'wara ‏.‏ aalaa waiinna almasiyha alddajjaala aa'waru al'ayni alyumnaa kaaanna 'aynahu 'inabaaun taafiiaaun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Ibn Umar reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ). made a mention of Dajjal in the presence of the people and said:Allah is not one-eyed and behold that Dajjal is blind of the right eye and his eye would be like a floating grape
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الرَّبِيعِ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا حَمَّادٌ، - وَهُوَ ابْنُ زَيْدٍ - عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبَّادٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حَاتِمٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ - عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ عُقْبَةَ، كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ نَافِعٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عُمَرَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمِثْلِهِ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy aabuw alrrabiy'i, waaabuw kaamilin qaalaa haddathanaa hammaadun, - wahuwa abnu zaydin - 'an aayyuwba, wahaddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abbaadin, haddathanaa haatimun, - ya'niy abna iismaa'iyla - 'an muwsaa bni 'uqbaaa, kilaahumaa 'an naafi'in, 'ani abni 'umara, 'ani alnnabiyyi sla allh 'lyh wslm bimithlihi ‏.‏
verses.translation: This hadith has been narrated on the authority of Ibn 'Umar through another chain of transmitters
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَنَسَ بْنَ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ مَا مِنْ نَبِيٍّ إِلاَّ وَقَدْ أَنْذَرَ أُمَّتَهُ الأَعْوَرَ الْكَذَّابَ أَلاَ إِنَّهُ أَعْوَرُ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَيْسَ بِأَعْوَرَ وَمَكْتُوبٌ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ ك ف ر ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu almuthannaa, wamuhammadu bnu bashhaarin, qaalaa haddathanaa muhammadu bnu ja'farin, haddathanaa shu'baau, 'an qataadaaa, qaala sami'tu aanasa bna maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ maa min nabiyyin iilaaa waqad aandhara aummatahu alaa'wara alkadhhaaba aalaa iinnahu aa'waru waiinna rabbakum laysa biaa'wara wamaktuwbun bayna 'aynayhi k f r ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:There is never a prophet who has not warned the Ummah of that one-eyed liar; behold he is one-eyed and your Lord is not one-eyed. On his forehead are the letters k f. r. (Kafir)
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، وَابْنُ، بَشَّارٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ الْمُثَنَّى - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا مُعَاذُ بْنُ هِشَامٍ، حَدَّثَنِي أَبِي، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا أَنَسُ بْنُ مَالِكٍ، أَنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏ "‏ الدَّجَّالُ مَكْتُوبٌ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ ك ف ر أَىْ كَافِرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa abnu almuthannaa, waabnu, bashhaarin - waalllafzu laibni almuthannaa - qaalaa haddathanaa mu'aadhu bnu hishaamin, haddathaniy aabiy, 'an qataadaaa, haddathanaa aanasu bnu maalikin, aanna nabiyya alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm qaala ‏ "‏ alddajjaalu maktuwbun bayna 'aynayhi k f r aaa kaafirun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:There would be written three letters k. f. r., i. e. Kafir, between the eyes of the Dajjal
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: وَحَدَّثَنِي زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَفَّانُ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَارِثِ، عَنْ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ الْحَبْحَابِ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ الدَّجَّالُ مَمْسُوحُ الْعَيْنِ مَكْتُوبٌ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ كَافِرٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ تَهَجَّاهَا ك ف ر ‏"‏ يَقْرَؤُهُ كُلُّ مُسْلِمٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: wahaddathaniy zuhayru bnu harbin, haddathanaa 'affaanu, haddathanaa 'abdu alwaarithi, 'an shu'aybi bni alhabhaabi, 'an aanasi bni maalikin, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏"‏ alddajjaalu mamsuwhu al'ayni maktuwbun bayna 'aynayhi kaafirun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ thumma tahajjaahaa k f r ‏"‏ yaqrauuhu kullu muslimin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Anas b. Malik reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Dajjal is blind of one eye and there is written between his eyes the word" Kafir". He then spelled the word as k. f. r., which every Muslim would be able to read
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ نُمَيْرٍ، وَمُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْعَلاَءِ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ الآخَرَانِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو مُعَاوِيَةَ، عَنِ الأَعْمَشِ، عَنْ شَقِيقٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ الدَّجَّالُ أَعْوَرُ الْعَيْنِ الْيُسْرَى جُفَالُ الشَّعَرِ مَعَهُ جَنَّةٌ وَنَارٌ فَنَارُهُ جَنَّةٌ وَجَنَّتُهُ نَارٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa muhammadu bnu 'abdi alllahi bni numayrin, wamuhammadu bnu al'alaa'i, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala alakharaani, haddathanaa aabuw mu'aawiyaaa, 'ani alaa'mashi, 'an shaqiyqin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ alddajjaalu aa'waru al'ayni alyusraa jufaalu alshha'ari ma'ahu jannaaun wanaarun fanaaruhu jannaaun wajannatuhu naarun ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa reported that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) said:Dajjal is blind of left eye with thick hair and there would be a garden and fire with him and his fire would be a garden and his garden would be fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا يَزِيدُ بْنُ هَارُونَ، عَنْ أَبِي مَالِكٍ الأَشْجَعِيِّ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ بْنِ حِرَاشٍ، عَنْ حُذَيْفَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ لأَنَا أَعْلَمُ بِمَا مَعَ الدَّجَّالِ مِنْهُ مَعَهُ نَهْرَانِ يَجْرِيَانِ أَحَدُهُمَا رَأْىَ الْعَيْنِ مَاءٌ أَبْيَضُ وَالآخَرُ رَأْىَ الْعَيْنِ نَارٌ تَأَجَّجُ فَإِمَّا أَدْرَكَنَّ أَحَدٌ فَلْيَأْتِ النَّهْرَ الَّذِي يَرَاهُ نَارًا وَلْيُغَمِّضْ ثُمَّ لْيُطَأْطِئْ رَأْسَهُ فَيَشْرَبَ مِنْهُ فَإِنَّهُ مَاءٌ بَارِدٌ وَإِنَّ الدَّجَّالَ مَمْسُوحُ الْعَيْنِ عَلَيْهَا ظَفَرَةٌ غَلِيظَةٌ مَكْتُوبٌ بَيْنَ عَيْنَيْهِ كَافِرٌ يَقْرَؤُهُ كُلُّ مُؤْمِنٍ كَاتِبٍ وَغَيْرِ كَاتِبٍ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw bakri bnu aabiy shaybaaa, haddathanaa yaziydu bnu haaruwna, 'an aabiy maalikin alaashja'iyyi, 'an rib'iyyi bni hiraashin, 'an hudhayfaaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ laanaa aa'lamu bimaa ma'a alddajjaali minhu ma'ahu nahraani yajriyaani aahaduhumaa raaaa al'ayni maa'un aabyadu waalakharu raaaa al'ayni naarun taaajjaju faiimmaa aadrakanna aahadun falyaati alnnahra alladhiy yaraahu naarana walyughammid thumma lyutaatii raasahu fayashraba minhu faiinnahu maa'un baaridun waiinna alddajjaala mamsuwhu al'ayni 'alayhaa zafaraaun ghaliyzaaun maktuwbun bayna 'aynayhi kaafirun yaqrauuhu kullu muuminin kaatibin waghayri kaatibin ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: It was narrated that Hudhaifah said:The Messenger of Allah said: 'I know what the Dajjal will have with him. He will have two flowing rivers, one that appears to the eye to be clear water, and one that appears to the eye to be flaming fire. If anyone sees that, let him go to the river which he thinks is fire and close his eyes, then lower his head and drink from it, for it is cool water. The Dajjal has one blind eye, with a layer of thick skin over it, and between his eyes is written "disbeliever," which every believer will read, whether he is literate or illiterate
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعَيْبُ بْنُ صَفْوَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الْمَلِكِ بْنِ عُمَيْرٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ، بْنِ حِرَاشٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَمْرٍو أَبِي مَسْعُودٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، قَالَ انْطَلَقْتُ مَعَهُ إِلَى حُذَيْفَةَ بْنِ الْيَمَانِ فَقَالَ لَهُ عُقْبَةُ حَدِّثْنِي مَا سَمِعْتَ مِنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الدَّجَّالِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ‏ "‏ إِنَّ الدَّجَّالَ يَخْرُجُ وَإِنَّ مَعَهُ مَاءً وَنَارًا فَأَمَّا الَّذِي يَرَاهُ النَّاسُ مَاءً فَنَارٌ تُحْرِقُ وَأَمَّا الَّذِي يَرَاهُ النَّاسُ نَارًا فَمَاءٌ بَارِدٌ عَذْبٌ فَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ ذَلِكَ مِنْكُمْ فَلْيَقَعْ فِي الَّذِي يَرَاهُ نَارًا فَإِنَّهُ مَاءٌ عَذْبٌ طَيِّبٌ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ عُقْبَةُ وَأَنَا قَدْ، سَمِعْتُهُ تَصْدِيقًا، لِحُذَيْفَةَ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin, haddathanaa shu'aybu bnu safwaana, 'an 'abdi almaliki bni 'umayrin, 'an rib'iyyi, bni hiraashin 'an 'uqbaaa bni 'amrinw aabiy mas'uwdin alaansaariyyi, qaala antalaqtu ma'ahu iilaa hudhayfaaa bni alyamaani faqaala lahu 'uqbaau haddithniy maa sami'ta min rasuwli alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm fiy alddajjaali ‏.‏ qaala ‏ "‏ iinna alddajjaala yakhruju waiinna ma'ahu maa'an wanaarana faaammaa alladhiy yaraahu alnnaasu maa'an fanaarun tuhriqu waaammaa alladhiy yaraahu alnnaasu naarana famaa'un baaridun 'adhbun faman aadraka dhalika minkum falyaqa' fiy alladhiy yaraahu naarana faiinnahu maa'un 'adhbun tayyibun ‏"‏ ‏.‏ faqaala 'uqbaau waaanaa qad, sami'tuhu tasdiyqana, lihudhayfaaa ‏.‏
verses.translation: Uqba b. 'Amr Abu Mas'ud al-Ansari reported:I went to Hudhaifa b. Yaman and said to him: Narrate what you have heard from Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) pertaining to the Dajjal. He said that the Dajjal would appear and there would be along with him water and fire and what the people would see as water that would be fire and that would burn and what would appear as fire that would be water and any one of you who would see that should plunge in that which he sees as fire for it would be sweet, pure water, and 'Uqba said: I also heard it, testifying Hudhaifa
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ حُجْرٍ السَّعْدِيُّ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لاِبْنِ حُجْرٍ قَالَ إِسْحَاقُ أَخْبَرَنَا وَقَالَ ابْنُ حُجْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ، عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ أَبِي هِنْدٍ، عَنْ رِبْعِيِّ، بْنِ حِرَاشٍ قَالَ اجْتَمَعَ حُذَيْفَةُ وَأَبُو مَسْعُودٍ فَقَالَ حُذَيْفَةُ ‏ "‏ لأَنَا بِمَا مَعَ الدَّجَّالِ أَعْلَمُ مِنْهُ إِنَّ مَعَهُ نَهْرًا مِنْ مَاءٍ وَنَهْرًا مِنْ نَارٍ فَأَمَّا الَّذِي تَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُ نَارٌ مَاءٌ وَأَمَّا الَّذِي تَرَوْنَ أَنَّهُ مَاءٌ نَارٌ فَمَنْ أَدْرَكَ ذَلِكَ مِنْكُمْ فَأَرَادَ الْمَاءَ فَلْيَشْرَبْ مِنَ الَّذِي يَرَاهُ أَنَّهُ نَارٌ فَإِنَّهُ سَيَجِدُهُ مَاءً ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو مَسْعُودٍ هَكَذَا سَمِعْتُ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَقُولُ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa 'aliyyu bnu hujrin alssa'diyyu, waiishaaqu bnu iibraahiyma, - waalllafzu laibni hujrin qaala iishaaqu aakhbaranaa waqaala abnu hujrin, haddathanaa jariyrun, 'ani almughiyraai, 'an nu'aymi bni aabiy hindin, 'an rib'iyyi, bni hiraashin qaala ajtama'a hudhayfaau waaabuw mas'uwdin faqaala hudhayfaau ‏ "‏ laanaa bimaa ma'a alddajjaali aa'lamu minhu iinna ma'ahu nahrana min maa'in wanahrana min naarin faaammaa alladhiy tarawna aannahu naarun maa'un waaammaa alladhiy tarawna aannahu maa'un naarun faman aadraka dhalika minkum faaaraada almaa'a falyashrab mina alladhiy yaraahu aannahu naarun faiinnahu sayajiduhu maa'an ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qaala aabuw mas'uwdin hakadhaa sami'tu alnnabiyya sla allh 'lyh wslm yaquwlu ‏.‏
verses.translation: Hudhaifa and Ibn Mas'ud met together. Hudhaifa said:I know more than you as to what there would be along with the Dajjal. There would be along with him two canals (one flowing with water) and the other one (having) fire (within it), and what you would see as fire would be water and what you would see as water would be fire. So he who amongst you is able to see that and is desirous of water should drink out of that which he sees as fire
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ رَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا حُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ، عَنْ يَحْيَى، عَنْ أَبِي، سَلَمَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا هُرَيْرَةَ، قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏ "‏ أَلاَ أُخْبِرُكُمْ عَنِ الدَّجَّالِ حَدِيثًا مَا حَدَّثَهُ نَبِيٌّ قَوْمَهُ إِنَّهُ أَعْوَرُ وَإِنَّهُ يَجِيءُ مَعَهُ مِثْلُ الْجَنَّةِ وَالنَّارِ فَالَّتِي يَقُولُ إِنَّهَا الْجَنَّةُ هِيَ النَّارُ وَإِنِّي أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ بِهِ كَمَا أَنْذَرَ بِهِ نُوحٌ قَوْمَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathaniy muhammadu bnu raafi'in, haddathanaa husaynu bnu muhammadin, haddathanaa shaybaanu, 'an yahyaa, 'an aabiy, salamaaa qaala sami'tu aabaa hurayraaa, qaala qaala rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm ‏ "‏ aalaa aukhbirukum 'ani alddajjaali hadiythana maa haddathahu nabiyyun qawmahu iinnahu aa'waru waiinnahu yajiy'u ma'ahu mithlu aljannaai waalnnaari faallatiy yaquwlu iinnahaa aljannaau hiya alnnaaru waiinniy aandhartukum bihi kamaa aandhara bihi nuwhun qawmahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translation: Abu Huraira reported Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) as saying:May I not inform you about the Dajjal what no Apostle of Allah narrated to his people? He would be blind and he would bring along with him an Image of Paradise and Hell-Fire and what he would call as Paradise that would be Hell-Fire and I warn you as Noah warned his people
verses.translator: Abdul Hamid Siddiqui (as distributed in the open hadith-api dataset)

verses.chapterTitle: Book 54 — The Book of Tribulations and Portents of the Last Hour
verses.original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو خَيْثَمَةَ، زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ، بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ حَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ جَابِرٍ الطَّائِيُّ، قَاضِي حِمْصَ حَدَّثَنِي عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ، جُبَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ الْحَضْرَمِيِّ أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ النَّوَّاسَ بْنَ سَمْعَانَ الْكِلاَبِيَّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مِهْرَانَ الرَّازِيُّ، - وَاللَّفْظُ لَهُ - حَدَّثَنَا الْوَلِيدُ بْنُ مُسْلِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ يَزِيدَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ، عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ جَابِرٍ الطَّائِيِّ، عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ جُبَيْرِ بْنِ، نُفَيْرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ، جُبَيْرِ بْنِ نُفَيْرٍ عَنِ النَّوَّاسِ بْنِ سَمْعَانَ، قَالَ ذَكَرَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم الدَّجَّالَ ذَاتَ غَدَاةٍ فَخَفَّضَ فِيهِ وَرَفَّعَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّاهُ فِي طَائِفَةِ النَّخْلِ فَلَمَّا رُحْنَا إِلَيْهِ عَرَفَ ذَلِكَ فِينَا فَقَالَ ‏"‏ مَا شَأْنُكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ذَكَرْتَ الدَّجَّالَ غَدَاةً فَخَفَّضْتَ فِيهِ وَرَفَّعْتَ حَتَّى ظَنَنَّاهُ فِي طَائِفَةِ النَّخْلِ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ غَيْرُ الدَّجَّالِ أَخْوَفُنِي عَلَيْكُمْ إِنْ يَخْرُجْ وَأَنَا فِيكُمْ فَأَنَا حَجِيجُهُ دُونَكُمْ وَإِنْ يَخْرُجْ وَلَسْتُ فِيكُمْ فَامْرُؤٌ حَجِيجُ نَفْسِهِ وَاللَّهُ خَلِيفَتِي عَلَى كُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ إِنَّهُ شَابٌّ قَطَطٌ عَيْنُهُ طَافِئَةٌ كَأَنِّي أُشَبِّهُهُ بِعَبْدِ الْعُزَّى بْنِ قَطَنٍ فَمَنْ أَدْرَكَهُ مِنْكُمْ فَلْيَقْرَأْ عَلَيْهِ فَوَاتِحَ سُورَةِ الْكَهْفِ إِنَّهُ خَارِجٌ خَلَّةً بَيْنَ الشَّأْمِ وَالْعِرَاقِ فَعَاثَ يَمِينًا وَعَاثَ شِمَالاً يَا عِبَادَ اللَّهِ فَاثْبُتُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا لَبْثُهُ فِي الأَرْضِ قَالَ ‏"‏ أَرْبَعُونَ يَوْمًا يَوْمٌ كَسَنَةٍ وَيَوْمٌ كَشَهْرٍ وَيَوْمٌ كَجُمُعَةٍ وَسَائِرُ أَيَّامِهِ كَأَيَّامِكُمْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ فَذَلِكَ الْيَوْمُ الَّذِي كَسَنَةٍ أَتَكْفِينَا فِيهِ صَلاَةُ يَوْمٍ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ اقْدُرُوا لَهُ قَدْرَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قُلْنَا يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ وَمَا إِسْرَاعُهُ فِي الأَرْضِ قَالَ ‏"‏ كَالْغَيْثِ اسْتَدْبَرَتْهُ الرِّيحُ فَيَأْتِي عَلَى الْقَوْمِ فَيَدْعُوهُمْ فَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَيَسْتَجِيبُونَ لَهُ فَيَأْمُرُ السَّمَاءَ فَتُمْطِرُ وَالأَرْضَ فَتُنْبِتُ فَتَرُوحُ عَلَيْهِمْ سَارِحَتُهُمْ أَطْوَلَ مَا كَانَتْ ذُرًا وَأَسْبَغَهُ ضُرُوعًا وَأَمَدَّهُ خَوَاصِرَ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي الْقَوْمَ فَيَدْعُوهُمْ فَيَرُدُّونَ عَلَيْهِ قَوْلَهُ فَيَنْصَرِفُ عَنْهُمْ فَيُصْبِحُونَ مُمْحِلِينَ لَيْسَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ شَىْءٌ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَيَمُرُّ بِالْخَرِبَةِ فَيَقُولُ لَهَا أَخْرِجِي كُنُوزَكِ ‏.‏ فَتَتْبَعُهُ كُنُوزُهَا كَيَعَاسِيبِ النَّحْلِ ثُمَّ يَدْعُو رَجُلاً مُمْتَلِئًا شَبَابًا فَيَضْرِبُهُ بِالسَّيْفِ فَيَقْطَعُهُ جَزْلَتَيْنِ رَمْيَةَ الْغَرَضِ ثُمَّ يَدْعُوهُ فَيُقْبِلُ وَيَتَهَلَّلُ وَجْهُهُ يَضْحَكُ فَبَيْنَمَا هُوَ كَذَلِكَ إِذْ بَعَثَ اللَّهُ الْمَسِيحَ ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ فَيَنْزِلُ عِنْدَ الْمَنَارَةِ الْبَيْضَاءِ شَرْقِيَّ دِمَشْقَ بَيْنَ مَهْرُودَتَيْنِ وَاضِعًا كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى أَجْنِحَةِ مَلَكَيْنِ إِذَا طَأْطَأَ رَأَسَهُ قَطَرَ وَإِذَا رَفَعَهُ تَحَدَّرَ مِنْهُ جُمَانٌ كَاللُّؤْلُؤِ فَلاَ يَحِلُّ لِكَافِرٍ يَجِدُ رِيحَ نَفَسِهِ إِلاَّ مَاتَ وَنَفَسُهُ يَنْتَهِي حَيْثُ يَنْتَهِي طَرْفُهُ فَيَطْلُبُهُ حَتَّى يُدْرِكَهُ بِبَابِ لُدٍّ فَيَقْتُلُهُ ثُمَّ يَأْتِي عِيسَى ابْنَ مَرْيَمَ قَوْمٌ قَدْ عَصَمَهُمُ اللَّهُ مِنْهُ فَيَمْسَحُ عَنْ وُجُوهِهِمْ وَيُحَدِّثُهُمْ بِدَرَجَاتِهِمْ فِي الْجَنَّةِ فَبَيْنَمَا هُوَ كَذَلِكَ إِذْ أَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَى عِيسَى إِنِّي قَدْ أَخْرَجْتُ عِبَادًا لِي لاَ يَدَانِ لأَحَدٍ بِقِتَالِهِمْ فَحَرِّزْ عِبَادِي إِلَى الطُّورِ ‏.‏ وَيَبْعَثُ اللَّهُ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ وَهُمْ مِنْ كُلِّ حَدَبٍ يَنْسِلُونَ فَيَمُرُّ أَوَائِلُهُمْ عَلَى بُحَيْرَةِ طَبَرِيَّةَ فَيَشْرَبُونَ مَا فِيهَا وَيَمُرُّ آخِرُهُمْ فَيَقُولُونَ لَقَدْ كَانَ بِهَذِهِ مَرَّةً مَاءٌ ‏.‏ وَيُحْصَرُ نَبِيُّ اللَّهُ عِيسَى وَأَصْحَابُهُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ رَأْسُ الثَّوْرِ لأَحَدِهِمْ خَيْرًا مِنْ مِائَةِ دِينَارٍ لأَحَدِكُمُ الْيَوْمَ فَيَرْغَبُ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ عِيسَى وَأَصْحَابُهُ فَيُرْسِلُ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهُمُ النَّغَفَ فِي رِقَابِهِمْ فَيُصْبِحُونَ فَرْسَى كَمَوْتِ نَفْسٍ وَاحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ يَهْبِطُ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ عِيسَى وَأَصْحَابُهُ إِلَى الأَرْضِ فَلاَ يَجِدُونَ فِي الأَرْضِ مَوْضِعَ شِبْرٍ إِلاَّ مَلأَهُ زَهَمُهُمْ وَنَتْنُهُمْ فَيَرْغَبُ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ عِيسَى وَأَصْحَابُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ فَيُرْسِلُ اللَّهُ طَيْرًا كَأَعْنَاقِ الْبُخْتِ فَتَحْمِلُهُمْ فَتَطْرَحُهُمْ حَيْثُ شَاءَ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ يُرْسِلُ اللَّهُ مَطَرًا لاَ يَكُنُّ مِنْهُ بَيْتُ مَدَرٍ وَلاَ وَبَرٍ فَيَغْسِلُ الأَرْضَ حَتَّى يَتْرُكَهَا كَالزَّلَفَةِ ثُمَّ يُقَالُ لِلأَرْضِ أَنْبِتِي ثَمَرَتَكِ وَرُدِّي بَرَكَتَكِ ‏.‏ فَيَوْمَئِذٍ تَأْكُلُ الْعِصَابَةُ مِنَ الرُّمَّانَةِ وَيَسْتَظِلُّونَ بِقِحْفِهَا وَيُبَارَكُ فِي الرِّسْلِ حَتَّى أَنَّ اللِّقْحَةَ مِنَ الإِبِلِ لَتَكْفِي الْفِئَامَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَاللِّقْحَةَ مِنَ الْبَقَرِ لَتَكْفِي الْقَبِيلَةَ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَاللِّقْحَةَ مِنَ الْغَنَمِ لَتَكْفِي الْفَخِذَ مِنَ النَّاسِ فَبَيْنَمَا هُمْ كَذَلِكَ إِذْ بَعَثَ اللَّهُ رِيحًا طَيِّبَةً فَتَأْخُذُهُمْ تَحْتَ آبَاطِهِمْ فَتَقْبِضُ رُوحَ كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَكُلِّ مُسْلِمٍ وَيَبْقَى شِرَارُ النَّاسِ يَتَهَارَجُونَ فِيهَا تَهَارُجَ الْحُمُرِ فَعَلَيْهِمْ تَقُومُ السَّاعَةُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
verses.translit: haddathanaa aabuw khaythamaaa, zuhayru bnu harbin haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani, bnu yaziyda bni jaabirin haddathaniy yahyaa bnu jaabirin alttaaiiyyu, qaadiy himsa haddathaniy 'abdu alrrahmani bnu, jubayrin 'an aabiyhi, jubayri bni nufayrin alhadramiyyi aannahu sami'a alnnawwaasa bna sam'aana alkilaabiyya, h wahaddathaniy muhammadu bnu mihraana alrraaziyyu, - waalllafzu lahu - haddathanaa alwaliydu bnu muslimin, haddathanaa 'abdu alrrahmani bnu yaziyda bni jaabirin, 'an yahyaa bni jaabirin alttaaiiyyi, 'an 'abdi alrrahmani bni jubayri bni, nufayrin 'an aabiyhi, jubayri bni nufayrin 'ani alnnawwaasi bni sam'aana, qaala dhakara rasuwlu alllahi sla allh 'lyh wslm alddajjaala dhaata ghadaaain fakhaffada fiyhi waraffa'a hattaa zanannaahu fiy taaiifaai alnnakhli falammaa ruhnaa iilayhi 'arafa dhalika fiynaa faqaala ‏"‏ maa shaanukum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi dhakarta alddajjaala ghadaaaan fakhaffadta fiyhi waraffa'ta hattaa zanannaahu fiy taaiifaai alnnakhli ‏.‏ faqaala ‏"‏ ghayru alddajjaali aakhwafuniy 'alaykum iin yakhruj waaanaa fiykum faaanaa hajiyjuhu duwnakum waiin yakhruj walastu fiykum faamruuun hajiyju nafsihi waalllahu khaliyfatiy 'alaa kulli muslimin iinnahu shaabbun qatatun 'aynuhu taafiiaaun kaaanniy aushabbihuhu bi'abdi al'uzzaa bni qatanin faman aadrakahu minkum falyaqraa 'alayhi fawaatiha suwraai alkahfi iinnahu khaarijun khallaaan bayna alshhaami waal'iraaqi fa'aatha yamiynana wa'aatha shimaalaan yaa 'ibaada alllahi faathbutuwa ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi wamaa labthuhu fiy alaardi qaala ‏"‏ aarba'uwna yawmana yawmun kasanaain wayawmun kashahrin wayawmun kajumu'aain wasaaiiru aayyaamihi kaaayyaamikum ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi fadhalika alyawmu alladhiy kasanaain aatakfiynaa fiyhi salaaau yawmin qaala ‏"‏ laa aqduruwa lahu qadrahu ‏"‏ ‏.‏ qulnaa yaa rasuwla alllahi wamaa iisraa'uhu fiy alaardi qaala ‏"‏ kaalghaythi astadbarathu alrriyhu fayaatiy 'alaa alqawmi fayad'uwhum fayuuminuwna bihi wayastajiybuwna lahu fayaamuru alssamaa'a fatumtiru waalaarda fatunbitu fataruwhu 'alayhim saarihatuhum aatwala maa kaanat dhurana waaasbaghahu duruw'ana waaamaddahu khawaasira thumma yaatiy alqawma fayad'uwhum fayarudduwna 'alayhi qawlahu fayansarifu 'anhum fayusbihuwna mumhiliyna laysa biaaydiyhim shaa'un min aamwaalihim wayamurru bialkharibaai fayaquwlu lahaa aakhrijiy kunuwzaki ‏.‏ fatatba'uhu kunuwzuhaa kaya'aasiybi alnnahli thumma yad'uw rajulaan mumtaliiana shabaabana fayadribuhu bialssayfi fayaqta'uhu jazlatayni ramyaaa algharadi thumma yad'uwhu fayuqbilu wayatahallalu wajhuhu yadhaku fabaynamaa huwa kadhalika iidh ba'atha alllahu almasiyha abna maryama fayanzilu 'inda almanaaraai albaydaa'i sharqiyya dimashqa bayna
